340: अङ्गिर, अस्, or usually अङ्गिरस्, आस्, m. (related to ἄγγελος or ἄγγαρος ?), a celebrated mythological name, usually ascribed to a Ṛṣi, the author of a number of hymns in the Ṛg-veda, of a code of laws, and of a treatise on astronomy; he is said by some to have been born from Brahmā's mouth, and to have been the husband of Smṛti, of Śraddhā, of two daughters of Maitreya, of several daughters of Dakṣa, &c.; he is considered as one of the seven Ṛṣis of the first Manvantara, as a Prajāpati, as a teacher of the Brahma-vidyā, which he had learnt from Satyavāha, a descend-ant of Bharadvāja, &c. Among his sons, the chief is Agni, others are Saṃvarta, Utathya, and Bṛhaspati; among his daughters are mentioned Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Rākā, and Anumati; but the Ṛcas (or Vedic hymns), the manes of Haviṣmat, and mankind itself are styled his offspring. In astronomy he is the planet Jupiter, and a star in Ursa Major. (असस्), m. pl. de-scendants of Aṅgiras or of Agni, mostly personifications of luminous objects; the hymns of the Atharva-veda; priests who, by using the magical formulas of those hymns, protect the sacrifice against the effects of inauspicious accidents. —अङ्गिरस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, very rapid, especially (like Agni) in devouring food. —अङ्गिरस्-वत्, ind. like Aṅgiras; (आन्, अती, अत्), connected with or accompanied by the Aṅgirasas.

418: अच्युत अ-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, what has not given way or fallen; firm, solid; imperishable, per-manent; not leaking or dripping; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; also of a physician; N. of a plant, Morinda Tinctoria; N. of a gift to Agni. —अच्युत-क्षित्, त्, m., Ved. having solid ground, an epithet of Soma. —अच्युत-च्युत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. throwing down that which is fixed. —अच्युत-ज, आस्, m. pl. a class of Jaina deities produced by Viṣṇu. —अच्युत-जल्लकिन्, ई, m., N. of a commentator of the Amara-Koṣa. —अच्युत-दन्त or अच्युतन्त, अस्, m., N. of the ancestor of a warrior tribe called Ācyutadanti or Ācyutanti, though possibly the names refer to two distinct persons and tribes. —अच्युत-मूर्ति, इस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu. —अच्युत-रुष्, ट्, f. inveterate hatred. —अच्युत-वास, अस्, m. the sacred fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa. —अच्युत-स्थल, अम्, n., N. of a place in the Pañjāb. —अच्युताग्रज (°त-अग्°), अस्, m. (Viṣṇu's elder brother), Balarāma; Indra. —अच्युतो-पाध्याय (°त-उप्°), अस्, m. = अच्युत-जल्लकिन्, q. v.
419: अज् अज्, cl. 1. P. (defect. verb, supple-mented fr. rt. वी), अजति, आजीत्, अजितुम्, to go, to drive, propel, throw, cast: Desid. अजिजिषति, to be desirous of driving [cf. Gr. ἄγω Lat. ago].
420: 1. अज, अस्, m. a drove; a driver, mover, instigator, leader; epithet given in the Vedas to Indra. Rudra, one of the Maruts, Agni, and the sun; in later works to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Kāma (see also 2 अ-ज); the leader of a flock; a he-goat or ram [cf. Gr. αἴξ αἰγος Lith. ožys]; the sign Aries; the vehicle of the sun; N. of a descendant of Viśvāmitra, and of Daśaratha's or Dīrghabāhu's father; N. of a mineral substance; of a kind of rice; of the moon; (अस्), m. pl., N. of a class of Ṛṣis; of a people mentioned in the Vedas; (आ), f., N. of Prakṛti or Nature, of Māyā or Illusion; a she-goat; N. of a plant whose bulbs resemble the udder of a goat. —अज-कर्ण, अस्, m. a goat's ear; a plant or tree, Terminalia Alata Tomentosa. —अज-कर्णक, अस्, m. the Śāl-tree, Shorea Robusta. —अज-कूला, f., N. of a town of the Bodhis. —अज-क्षीर, अम्, n., Ved. goat's milk. —अज-गन्ध, अस्, m. smell of a he-goat; (अस्, आ, अम्), smelling like a goat. —अज-गन्धा or अज-गन्धिका, f. shrubby basil, Ocymum Gratissimum. —अज-गन्धिनी, f. a plant, also called अजशृङ्गी, q. v. —अज-गर, अस्, m. (that swallows a goat), a huge serpent, probably boa constrictor; (ई), f., N. of a plant. —अज-गल्लिका, f. ‘goat's cheek,’ an infantile disease. —अज-जीव or अज-जीविक, अस्, m. ‘who lives by goats,’ a goat-herd. —अज-ता, f. a multitude of goats; the being a goat. —अज-त्व or अजा-त्व, अम्, n. the being a goat. —अज-दण्डी, f. a plant, also called ब्रह्मदण्डी. —अज-देवता, आस्, f. pl. the 25th lunar mansion. —अज-नामक, अस्, m. (named Aja or Viṣṇu), a mineral substance. —अज-प, अस्, m. a goat-herd. —अज-पथ, अस्, m. ‘goat's road,’ probably synonymous with अज-वीथी, q. v. —अज-पद or अज-पाद, अस्, आ, अम्, goat-footed. —अज-पाद्, त्, m., Ved. epithet of the divinity called अज। —अज-पार्श्व, अस्, m. (having black sides like a goat), epithet of Śvetakarṇa's son Rājīvalocana. —अज-पाल, अस्, m. a goat-herd; N. of Daśaratha's father. —अज-भक्ष, अस्, m. ‘goat's food,’ N. of a plant, Varvūra. —अज-मायु, उस्, m., Ved. bleating like a goat. —अज-मार, अस्, m., N. of a tribe or a prince. —अज-मीढ or अज-मीऌह, अस्, m., N. of a son of Suhotra, the author of some Vedic hymns; of a grandson of Suhotra; surname of Yudhisṭhira. —अज-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, goat-faced; (ई), f., N. of a Rākṣasī. —अज-मेरु, N. of a place, Ajmir (?). —अज-मोद, अस्, m. or अज-मोदा or अज-मोदिका, f. ‘goat's delight,’ N. of various plants, common Carroway, the species called Ajwaen (Ligusticum Ajwaen), and especially a species of Parsley, Apium Involucratum. —अजर्षभ (°ज-ऋष्°), अस्, m. the best goat. —अज-लम्बन, अम्, n. antimony. —अज-लोमन्, आ, m. or अज-लोमी, f., N. of a plant, Cowage, Carpopogon Pruriens; (अ), n. goat's hair. —अज-वस्ति, इस्, m., N. of a tribe; (अयस्), m. pl. the members of that tribe. —अज-वाह, अस्, m., N. of a district. —अज-वीथी, f. ‘goat's road,’ N. of one of the three divisions of the southern path, or one of the three paths in which the sun, moon, and planets move, comprehending the asterisms मूला, पूर्वाषाढ, and उत्तराषाढ. —अज-शृङ्गी, f. ‘goat's horn,’ N. of a shrub, Odina Wodier, used as a charm and as a remedy for sore eyes, — the fruit resembles a goat's horn. —अज-स्तुन्द, अम्, n., N. of a town. —अज-हा, f. Cowage, Carpopogon Pruriens. —अजा-कृपाणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, like the goat and shears in the fable. —अजा-क्षीर, अम्, n. goat's milk. —अजा-गल, अस्, m. goat's neck. —अजागल-स्तन, अस्, m. nipple or fleshy protuberance on the neck of some Indian goats, and an emblem of any useless or worthless object or person. —अजा-जीव, अस्, m. (who lives by goats), a goat-herd. —अजा-तौल्वलि, इस्, m., N. of a Muni who lived on the milk of goats; (given by grammarians as an example of compounds in which the middle term is left out). —अजाद (अज-अद), अस्, m. ‘goat-eater,’ the ancestor of a warrior tribe. —अजादनी (°ज-अद्°), f. a species of prickly night-shade. —अजान्त्री (°ज-अन्°), f. a pot-herb, Convolvulus Argenteus. —अजा-पयस्, अस्, n. goat's milk. —अजा-पालक, अस्, आ, अम्, tending goats; (अस्), m. a goat-herd. —अजाविक (अज-अव्°), अम्, n. goats and sheep, small cattle. —अजाश्व (अज-अश्), अम्, n. goats and horses; (अस्), m. Pūṣan or the Sun who has goats for horses. —अजैकपाद् (अज-एक्°), त्, m. epithet of Viṣṇu; of one of the eleven Rudras. —अजैडक (अज-एड्°), अम्, n. goats and rams.
421: अजक, अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Purūravas; also of a king of Magadha; अजका or अजिका, f. a young she-goat; a disease of the pupil of the eye, small reddish tumours (compared to kids), protruding through the transparent cornea and discharging pus. —अजका-जात, अम्, n. the same disease of the eyes.
422: अजन, अजनि, अजि, अज्म, &c., see s. v.
423: अज 2. अ-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, not born, existing from all eternity; (अस्), m. Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, Kāma; (आ), f. Prakṛti or Nature, Māyā or Illusion (see also 1. अज, s. v. अज् and 1. अजन).
424: अजकव अजकव, अस्, m. (etymology un-known), Śiva's bow. —अजकाव, अस्, अम्, m. n. Śiva's bow; (अस्), m. a venomous kind of vermin, cen-tipede or scorpion; (अम्), n. sacrificial vessel dedicated to Mitra and Varuṇa. —अजगव or अजगाव, अम्, n. Śiva's bow; the southern portion of the path of the sun, moon, and planets; N. of a snake priest.
425: अजघन्य अ-जघन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not last; not least.
426: अजघ्निवस् अ-जघ्निवस्, आन्, उषी, अत् (perf. part. fr. rt. हन्), not having killed.
427: अजटा अ-जटा, f. a plant, Flacourtia Cata-phracta; also अजडा and अज्झटा।
428: अजड अ-जड, अस्, आ, अम्, not torpid or stupid; (आ), f., N. of two plants; see अजटा and कपिकच्छु, Carpopogon Pruriens. —अजड-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, of a vigorous mind, energetic, bold.
429: अजथ्या अजथ्या, f. yellow jasmin (fit for goats ?).
430: अजन 1. अजन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अज्।), Brahmā ‘the agitator;’ (अम्), n. act of instigating or mov-ing. —अजन-योनि-ज, अस्, m. (born fr. अजन, i. e. Brahmā); N. of Dakṣa.
431: अजनि, इस्, f. a path, road; see also अजि।
432: अजन 2. अ-जन, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जन्), desti-tute of living beings, especially of men; desert; (अस्), m. an insignificant person.
433: अ-जननि, इस्, f. privation of birth, cessation of exist-ence; अजननिर् अस्तु तस्य, ‘may he cease to exist !’
434: अ-जन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, improper to be produced or born; unfit or unfavourable for mankind; (अम्), n. any portent or natural phenomenon unfavourable to mankind, as an earthquake.
435: अजप 1. अ-जप, अस्, m. (rt. जप्), one who does not repeat prayers; a reader of heterodox works; (आ), f. the mantra or formula called haṃsa, which con-sists only of a number of inhalations and exhalations.
436: अजप 2. अज-प, अस्, m. a goat-herd. See s. v. 1. अज।
437: अजमीढ अज-मीढ, अस्, m. See s. v. 1. अज।
438: अजम्भ अ-जम्भ, अस्, m. (toothless), a frog.
439: अजय अ-जय, अस्, m. non-victory, defeat; (अस्, आ, अम्), unconquered, unsurpassed, invincible; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu; of a lexicographer; of a river; (आ), f. hemp; N. of a friend of Durgā; Māyā or Illusion.
440: अ-जय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, invincible, improper to be won at play.
441: अजर अ-जर, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जॄ), not subject to old age, undecaying, ever young; (आ), f., N. of two plants, Aloe Perfoliata and Jīrṇapañjhī. —अजरामर-वत् (°र-अम्°), ind. as if undecaying and immortal.
442: अ-जरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not suffering from old age, not decaying.
443: अ-जरयु, उस्, उस्, उ, not subject to old age or decay.
444: अ-जरस्, another form for अजर, used only in some cases.
445: अ-जर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not friable, not digestible; not subject to old age or decay; (अम्), n. friendship.
446: अजवस् अ-जवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. not quick, inactive.
447: अजस्र अ-जस्र, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जस्, ‘to injure’ not to be killed or interrupted), perpetual. —अजस्रम् or अजस्रेण, ind. perpetually, for ever, ever.
448: अजहत् अ-जहत् (pres. part. fr. rt. हा with अ), not dropping or losing (used in compounds). —अजहत्-स्वार्था, f., N. of a rhetorical figure, an elliptical use of words in which their original meaning is not dropped, as “white ones” for “white horses,” “lances” for “men with lances.” —अजहल्-लिङ्ग, अस्, m. (in grammar) said of a noun not dropping its original gender, when used like an adjective.
449: अजा अजा, f. a goat; Prakṛti; Māyā. See s.v. 1. अज, where the compounds of अजा will also be found.
450: अजागर अ-जागर, अस्, आ, अम्, not awake, not wakeful; (अस्), a plant, Eclipta or Verbesina Prostrata.
451: अजाजि अजा-जि, इस्, or अजा-जी, f. (अजा with rt. जि?, that overcomes goats); Cumin seed, Cuminum Cyminum; Ficus Oppositifolia; Nigella Indica.
452: अजात अ-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, unborn, not yet born, not yet developed. —अजात-ककुद्, त्, m. a young bull whose hump (ककुद्) is yet undeveloped. —अजात-पक्ष, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having undeveloped wings. —अजात-व्यञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, having an unde-veloped beard. —अजात-व्यवहार, अस्, m. having his majority unattained, a minor, a youth under fif-teen. —अजात-शत्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, having no enemy; having no adversary of equal standing; (उस्), m., N. of Śiva, of Yudhiṣṭhira, of a king of Kāśī, of a son of Śamīka, of a son of Vidmisāra or Bimbisāra, and con-temporary of Śākyamuni. —अजातानुशय (°त-अनु°), अस्, आ, अम्, having no regret. —अजातारि (°त-अरि), इस्, m. (having no enemy), Yudhiṣṭhira.
453: अजानत् अ-जानत्, अन्, अती, अत् (pres. part. of rt. ज्ञा with अ), not knowing, unaware.
454: अजानि अ-जानि, इस्, or अ-जानिक, अस्, m. having no wife.
455: अजानेय अजानेय, better आजानेय, अस्, आ, अम् (from आजान, आजानि, birth, descent), of high breed; undaunted, fearless; (अस्), m. a horse of high breed.
456: अजामि अ-जामि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. not of kin, not related; unfriendly; (in grammar) not corres-ponding. —अजामि-ता, f., Ved. absence of connection, friendliness, or similarity.
457: अजायमान अ-जायमान, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जन्), not being born, not subject to birth.
458: अजि अजि, f. (fr. अज्, q. v.), a road.
459: अजिका अजिका, f. (fr. अजा), a young goat [cf. 1. अज].
460: अजित अ-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, not conquered, unsubdued, unsurpassed, invincible, irresistible; (अस्), m., N. of an antidote, a poisonous sort of rat; N. of various persons, viz. Viṣṇu; Śiva; one of the Saptar-shis of the fourteenth Manvantara; Maitreya or a future Buddha; the second of the Arhats or saints of the present (Jaina) Avasrapiṇī, a descendant of Ikṣvāku; the attendant of Suvidhi, who is the ninth of those Arhats; (आस्), m. pl. a class of deified beings in the first Manvantara. —अजित-केश-कम्बल, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —अजित-बला, f., N. of a Jaina deity, who acts under the direction of the Arhat Ajita. —अजित-विक्रम, अस्, m. (having invincible power), epithet of king Candragupta the second. —अजितात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, having an unsubdued self or spirit. —अजितापीड (°त-आप्°), अस्, m. having an unsurpassed crown; N. of a king. —अजितेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्द्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having an unsubdued sensuous nature, whose passions are not controlled.
461: अजिन अजिन, अम्, n. (probably at first the skin of a goat, अज, with the hair on, then any skin which would answer the same purpose); the hairy skin of an antelope, especially a black antelope, which serves the religious student for a couch, seat, covering, &c.; the hairy skin of a tiger, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of a descendant of Pṛthu. —अजिन-पत्त्रा or अजिन-पत्त्री or अजिन-पत्त्रिका, f. a bat. —अजिन-फला, f., N. of a plant (?). —अजिन-योनि, इस्, m. (origin of the skin), an antelope, deer. —अजिन-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, clad in a skin. —अजिन-सन्ध, अस्, m. (who joins or prepares skins), a furrier.
462: अजिर अजिर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अज्), agile, quick, rapid; (अस्), m., N. of a snake priest; (आ), f., N. of Durgā, and of a river; (अम्), n. place to run or fight in, area, court [Lat. ager?]; the body; any object of sense, air, wind; a frog; (अम्), ind. quickly. —अजिर-वती, f., N. of the river on which the town Śrāvasti was situated. —अजिर-शोचिस्, इस्, m., Ved. having a quick light, glittering, epithet of Agni and Soma. —अजिराधिराज (°र-अध्°), अस्, m., Ved. an agile emperor, epithet of death.
463: अजिराय, nom. A. अजिरायते, -यितुम्, Ved. to be agile or quick.
464: अजिरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, connected (by proximity or ownership &c.) with an ajira or court &c.
465: अजिह्म अ-जिह्म, अस्, आ, अम्, not crooked, straight, straightforward, upright; (अस्), m. a frog, a fish; see अ-जिह्व, of which this may be a corruption. —अजिह्म-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going straight on; (अस्), m. an arrow. —अजिह्माग्र (°ह्म-अग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a straight point.
466: अजिह्व अ-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, tongueless; (अस्), m. a frog.
467: अजीकव अजीकव, अम्, n. Śiva's bow. See अजकव।
468: अजीगर्त अ-जीगर्त, अस्, m. (that has nothing to swallow), N. of a Ṛṣi, Śunaḥśepha's father.
469: अजीत अ-जीत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ज्या usually makes जीन), not faded, not faint. —अजीत-पुनर्व-ण्य, अम्, n., Ved. (unfaded and recoverable), N. of a twofold rite to be performed by Kṣatriyas.
470: अ-जीति, इस्, f., Ved. unfadingness; freedom from decay, prosperity.
471: अजीर्ण अ-जीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जॄ), not de-composed; unimpaired; undigested; (अम्), n. free-dom from decay, indigestion.
473: अ-जीर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from indigestion.
474: अजीव अ-जीव, अस्, m. (non-life), non-ex-istence, death; (अस्, आ, अम्), lifeless.
475: अ-जीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not living, destitute of a livelihood.
476: अ-जीवन, अम्, n. non-existence, death; (अस्, आ, अम्), destitute of a livelihood.
477: अ-जीवनि, इस्, f. non-existence, death; अजीवनिस् तस्य भूयात्, ‘may death befal him!’
479: अजुगुप्सित अ-जुगुप्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, not blamed.
480: अजुर अ-जुर or अ-जुर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जूर्), Ved. not subject to old age or decay.
481: अजुष्ट अ-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not enjoyed, unsatisfactory.
482: अ-जुष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. non-enjoyment, feeling of dis-appointment.

624: अति अति, ind. [probably neut. of an obsolete adj. अतिन्, passing, going, beyond; see rt. अत् and cf. As a prefix to verbs and nouns, expresses beyond, over; too far past; as अति-क्रमितुम्, to overstep. —अति-क्रम, transgression. As a separable adverb or preposition (with acc.), Ved. beyond.

1213: अधि-भौतिक (better आधिभौतिक, q. v.), अस्, ई, अम्, natural (?).
1214: अधिभोजन अधि-भोजन, अम्, n. an addi-tional gift.

1266: अधिविकर्तन अधि-वि-कर्तन, अम्, n. the act of cutting off.

(एण), in another form, disguised; (अस्, आ, अम्), changed, altered. —अन्य-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having another shape. —अन्य-लिङ्ग or अन्य-लिङ्गक, अस्, आ, अम्, having the gender of another (word, viz. of the substantive), an adjective. —अन्य-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having another colour. —अन्य-वाप, अस्, m. the kokila or Indian cuckoo (‘sowing for others,’ i. e. leaving his eggs in the nests of other birds). —अन्य-वीज-ज or अन्य-वीज-समुद्भव or अन्य-वीजोत्पन्न (°ज-उत्°), अस्, m. (‘born from the seed of another’), an adopted son. —अन्य-व्रत, अस्, m., Ved. following other (than Vedic) observances; devoted to other (gods), infidel, unbelieving. —अन्य-शाखक, अस्, m. a Brāhman who has left his school; an apostate. —अन्य-सङ्गम, अस्, m. intercourse with another, adulterous intercourse. —अन्य-साधारण, अस्, आ, अम्, common to others. —अन्य-स्त्री-ग, अस्, m. going to another's wife, an adulterer. —अन्या-दृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, or अन्य-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, or अन्य-दृश, अस्, ई, अम्, of another kind, like another. —अन्याधीन (°य-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, subject to others, dependent. —अन्याश्रयण (°य-आश्°), अम्, n. going to another (as an inheritance). —अन्या-श्रित (°य-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, gone to another. —अन्यासक्त (°य-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, intent on some-thing else. —अन्यासाधारण (°य-अस्°), अस्, ई, अम्, not common to another, peculiar. —अन्योढा (°य-ऊढ्°), f. married to another, another's wife. —अन्-योत्पन्न (°य-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, begotten by another. —अन्योदर्य (°य-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, born from another womb; (अस्), m. a step-mother's son.
2999: अन्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, any one of many, either, any.
3000: अन्य-तर, अस्, आ, अत्, either of two, other, differ-ent; अन्यतर अन्यतर, the one, the other; अन्यतरस्याम्, loc. f. either way. —अन्यतर-तस्, ind. on one of two sides. —अन्यतरतो-दन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having teeth on one side (only). —अन्य-तरे-द्युस्, ind. on either of two days.
3001: अन्य-तस्, ind. from another; from another mo-tive; on one side (अन्यतः अन्यतः, on the one, on the other side); elsewhere; on the other side, on the contrary, in one direction; towards some other place. —अन्यत-एत, एतस्, एनी, m. f., Ved. variegated on one side. —अन्यतः-क्ष्णुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sharp on one side. —अन्यतः-प्लक्षा, f., N. of a Lotus pond in Kurukṣetra. —अन्यतो-घातिन्, ई, m., Ved. striking in one direction. —अन्यतो-ऽरण्य (°तस्-अर्°), अम्, n., Ved. a land which is woody here and there, or only on one side (?). —अन्यतो-वात, अस्, m. a certain disease of the eye.
3003: अन्य-त्र, ind. (equivalent to अन्यस्मिन्, loc. of अन्य), elsewhere, in another place (with abl.); on another occasion; (as last member of a comp.) at another time than; otherwise, in another manner; to another place; except, without [cf. Goth. aljathrô]. —अन्यत्र-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, whose mind is di-rected to something else, inattentive.
3004: अन्य-था, ind. otherwise, in a different manner (with अतस्, इतस् or ततस् = in a manner different from this; अन्यथा अन्यथा, in one way, in another way); inaccurately, untruly, falsely, erroneously; from another motive; in the contrary case, otherwise [cf. 3005: अन्य-दा, ind. at another time; sometimes; one day, once; in another case [cf. Old Slav. inogda, inŭda].
3006: अन्यदीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to another.
3008: अन्ये-द्युस्, ind. on the other day, on the following day; the other day, once. —अन्येद्युष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, occurring every other day, daily, diurnal; (अस्), m. a quotidian fever.
3009: अन्योन्य or अन्यो-ऽन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one another, mutual [this word is said to be fr. अन्यस्, nom. sing. m., and अन्य; cf. परस्पर। In most cases, ac-cordingly, it will be found that the first अन्य may be regarded as the subject of the sentence, while the latter assumes the acc., inst., gen., or loc. cases as re-quired by the verb; there are many instances, however, in which the first अन्य, originally a nominative, must be regarded as equivalent to an oblique case]; अन्यो-न्यम् or अन्योन्य-तस्, ind. mutually. —अन्योन्य-कलह, अस्, m. mutual quarrel. —अन्योन्य-घात, अस्, m. mutual conflict, killing one another. —अन्योन्य-पक्ष-नयन, अम्, n. transposing (of numbers) from one side to another. —अन्योन्य-भेद, अस्, m. mutual division or enmity. —अन्योन्य-मिथुन, अम्, n. mu-tual union; (अस्), m. united mutually. —अन्योन्य-वि-भाग, अस्, m. mutual partition (of an inheritance). —अ-न्योन्य-वृत्ति, इस्, m. mutual effect of one upon another. —अन्योन्य-व्यतिकर, अस्, m. reciprocal action, re-lation or influence. —अन्योन्य-संश्रय, अस्, m. reciprocal relation (of cause and effect). —अन्योन्य-सापेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, mutually relating. —अन्योन्य-हाराभिहत (°र-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, (two quantities) mutually multiplied by their denominators. —अन्यो-न्यापहृत (°य-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, taken or secreted from one another, taken secretly. —अन्योन्याभाव (°य-अभ्°), अस्, m. mutual non-existence, mutual negation, relative difference. —अन्योन्याश्रय (°य-आश्°), अस्, m. mutual or reciprocal support, connec-tion or dependance; mutually depending. —अन्यो-न्याश्रित (°य-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, mutually supported or depending. —अन्योन्योक्ति (°य-उक्°), इस्, f. con-versation.
3010: अन्यङ्ग अ-न्यङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. spotless. —अ-न्यङ्ग-श्वेत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. white and without spot (as a sacrificial animal).
3011: अन्यच्च, अन्यतस्, अन्यथा, अन्यदा, अन्योन्य। See under अन्य।
3012: अन्या अ-न्या, f., Ved. (न्या contracted fr. निया ?), not drying up (as the milk of a cow ?); or अन्या, f. of अन्य, other (the accent being altered ?).
3013: अन्याय अ-न्याय, अस्, m. unjust or unlawful action; impropriety, indecorum; irregularity, disor-der. —अन्याय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or अन्याय-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, acting unjustly; following evil courses.
3014: अ-न्यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or अ-न्याय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unjust, improper, indecorous, unbecoming.
3015: अन्यून अ-न्यून, अस्, आ, अम्, not defective, entire, complete. —अ-न्यूनाधिक (°न-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, not too little and not too much; neither de-ficient nor excessive.
3016: अन्योकस् अ-न्य्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, not remaining in one's own (ओकस्) habitation.
3017: अन्वक्ष अन्व्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अक्ष, the eye, with अनु), following; (अम्), ind. afterwards; immediately after; directly.
3018: अन्वक्षरसन्धि अन्व्-अक्षर-सन्धि, इस्, m. a kind of Sandhi in the Vedas, euphonic conjunction of a vowel and consonant.
3019: अन्वङ्गम् अन्व्-अङ्गम्, ind. after every member or part.
3020: अन्वञ्च् अन्वञ्च्, अङ्, ऊची, अक् (fr. rt. अञ्च् with अनु), following the direction of another, going after, following; lying lengthwise; अनूचि, loc. c. in the rear, behind; (अक्), ind. afterwards. —अन्वग्-भा-वम्, ind. afterwards; friendly disposed. —अन्वग्-भूय, ind. becoming friendly disposed.
3021: अन्वती अन्व्-अती (अनु-अति-इ), cl. 2. P. -अत्येति, -तुम्, to follow in crossing or passing.
3022: अन्वध्यायम् अन्व्-अध्यायम्, ind. according to the chapters (especially of the Veda), according to the sacred texts.
3023: अन्वय अन्व्-अय, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. इ with अनु, see अन्व्-इ), following, succession; (अस्), m. con-nection, association, being linked to or concerned with; the natural order or connection of words in a sentence, syntax, construing; logical connection of words; logical connection of cause and effect, or pro-position and conclusion; drift, tenor, purport; de-scendants, race, lineage, family. —अन्वय-ज्ञ, अस्, m. a genealogist. —अन्वय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a connection (as a consequence), following, agreeing with; belonging to race or family. —अन्वय-वत्, ind. in connection with, in the sight of. —अन्वय-व्यतिरेक, अम्, n. a positive and negative proposition; agreement and contrariety; species and difference; rule and exception; logical connection and discon-nection. —अन्वय-व्यतिरेकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, (in phil.) affirmative and negative. —अन्वय-व्याप्ति, इस्, f. an affirmative argument.
3024: अन्वयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, connected (as a consequence). —अन्वयि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being a necessary consequence.
3025: अन्वर्च् अन्व्-अर्च् (अनु-अर्च्), cl. 1. P. -अर्चति, -चितुम्, to honour with shouts or songs of jubilee.
3026: अन्वर्ज् अन्व्-अर्ज् (अनु-अर्ज्), cl. 1. P. -अर्जति, -जितुम्, to let go.
3027: अन्वर्तितृ अन्व्-अर्तितृ, ता, m. (fr. अनु-अर्त् for अनु-अर्थ्), Ved. an inviter, one who allows to take.
3028: अन्वर्थ अन्व्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the meaning obvious, intelligible, clear. —अन्वर्थ-ग्र-हण, अम्, n. the literal acceptation of the meaning of a word (as opposed to the conventional). —अन्वर्-थ-सञ्ज्ञा, f. a term whose meaning is intelligible in itself (opposed to such technical terms as भ, घु, &c.).
3029: अन्वव् अन्व्-अव् (अनु-अव्), cl. 1. P. -अवति, -वितुम्, to encourage.
3030: अन्ववकॄ अन्व्-अव-कॄ (अनु-अव°), cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम् or -रीतुम्, to scatter or strew about: Caus. P. -कीरयति, -यितुम्, to make one scatter about.
3031: अन्व्-अवकिरण, अम्, n. scattering about succes-sively.
3032: अन्ववक्रम् अन्व्-अव-क्रम् (अनु-अव°), cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमितुम्, to descend or enter in succession.
3033: अन्ववगा अन्व्-अव-गा (अनु-अव°), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to go and join another.
3034: अन्ववचर् अन्व्-अव-चर् (अनु-अव°), cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रितुम्, to insinuate one's self into, enter stealthily.
3035: अन्व्-अवचार, अस्, m., Ved. descending and going after.
3036: अन्ववपा अन्व्-अव-पा, cl. 1. P. -पिबति, पातुम्, to drink after others.
3037: अन्ववसर्ग अन्व्-अवसर्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृज् with अनु and अव), letting down, slackening; friendly invitation; permission to do as one likes.
3038: अन्ववसित अन्व्-अवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. सि with अनु and अव), fastened to, bound to, attached; see अनुवसित।
3039: अन्ववार्ज् अन्व्-अवार्ज् (अनु-अव-अर्ज्), cl. 1. P. -अवार्जति, -जितुम्, to cause to go after or in a par-ticular direction; to visit with anything.
3040: अन्ववे अन्व्-अवे (अनु-अव-इ), cl. 2. P. -अवैति, -तुम्, to follow, walk up to or get into.
3042: अन्व्-अवायन, अम्, n., Ved. descending and going after.
3043: अन्ववेक्ष् अन्व्-अवेक्ष् (अनु-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -अवेक्षते, -क्षितुम्, to look at, inspect.
3045: अन्वश् अन्व्-अश् (अनु-अश्), cl. 5. P. A. -अश्नोति, -नुते, -अशितुम् or -अष्टुम्, to reach, come up to, equal.
3046: अन्वष्टका अन्व्-अष्टका, f. the ninth day in the latter half of the three months following the full moon in Āgrahāyaṇa, Pauṣa, Māgha, Phālguna.
3047: अन्वष्टक्य, अम्, n. a Śrāddha or funeral cere-mony performed on the Anvaṣṭakās.
3048: अन्वस् अन्व्-अस्, (अनु-अस्), cl. 2. P., Ved. -अस्ति, to be at hand, to reach.
3049: अन्वस्त अन्व्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. अस्, अस्यति), shot along, shot; interwoven (as in silk), chequered.
3050: अन्वह् अन्व्-अह् (अनु-अह्), perf. -आह, to pro-nounce, especially a ceremonial formula (Gram. 384. b).
3051: अन्वहम् अन्व्-अहम् (अनु-अहम्), ind. day after day, every day.
3052: अन्वाक्रम् अन्व्-आ-क्रम् (अनु-आ°), cl. 1. A. -क्रमते, -मितुम्, to ascend towards or to; P. -क्रामति, to visit in succession.
3053: अन्वाख्या अन्व्-आ-ख्या (अनु-आ°), cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -तुम्, to enumerate.
3054: अन्व्-आख्यान, अम्, n. enumeration; section; chapter.
3055: अन्वागम् अन्व्-आ-गम् (अनु-आ°), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to follow, come after: Desid. -जिगांसति, to wish or intend to follow.
3056: अन्वागा अन्व्-आ-गा (अनु-आ°), cl. 3. P., Ved. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to follow.
3057: अन्वाचक्ष् अन्व्-आ-चक्ष् (अनु-आ°), cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, Ved. Inf. -चक्षसे, to name after.
3058: अन्वाचम् अन्व्-आ-चम् (अनु-आ°), cl. 1. P. -चामति, -चमितुम्, to follow in rinsing the mouth.
3059: अन्वाचय अन्व्-आचय, अस्, m. (rt. चि), laying down a rule of secondary importance after that which is प्रधान or primary; connecting of a secondary action with the main action (e. g. the conjunction च is sometimes used अन्वाचये।) — अन्वाचय-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, propounded as a rule or matter of secon-dary importance.
3060: अन्व्-आचित, अस्, आ, अम्, secondary, inferior.
3061: अन्वाचर् अन्व्-आ-चर् (अनु-आ°), cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रितुम्, to follow or imitate in doing.
3062: अन्वाजे अन्वाजे (fr. अनु and अज्?), only used in connection with rt. कृ, e. g. अन्वाजे कृ, to sup-port, aid, assist.
3063: अन्वातन् अन्व्-आ-तन् (अनु-आ°), cl. 8. P. -तनोति, -नितुम्, to extend, spread; to overspread, extend over.
3064: अन्वादा अन्व्-आ-दा (अनु-आ°), cl. 3. A. -दत्ते, दातुम्, to resume.
3065: अन्वादिश् अन्व्-आ-दिश् (अनु-आ°), cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to name or mention afresh; to employ again.
3066: अन्व्-आदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned after or ac-cording to, employed again; inferior.
3067: अन्व्-आदेश, अस्, m. mentioning after, a repeated mention, referring to what has been stated previously, re-employment of the same word in a subsequent part of a sentence, the employment again of the same thing to perform a subsequent operation.
3068: अन्वाधान अन्व्-आधान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. धा with अनु and आ), putting fuel (on the three sacred fires), depositing.

3463: अपविष अप-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, free from poison; (आ), f. a species of grass, Kyllingia Mono-cephala.
3464: अपविष्णु अप-विष्णु, ind. except or with-out Viṣṇu.
3465: अपवीण अप-वीण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bad or no lute; (आ), f. a bad lute; (अम्), ind. without a lute.

3467: अपवृ अप-वृ, cl. 5. P. -वृणोति, -वरितुम्, रीतुम्, to open, uncover, exhibit.
3468: अप-वरक, अस्, m. an inner apartment, the lying-in chamber.
3469: अप-वरण, अम्, n. covering, screening; gar-ment.

3471: अप-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed, dis-appeared.
3472: अप-वारितक, अम्, n. concealed, secret manner; अपवारितकेन, (in theatrical language) apart, aside (speaking so that only the addressed person may hear; opposed to प्रकाशम्).

3474: अप-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovered, opened.

3479: अप-वर्जनीय, or अप-वृज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be abandoned, to be avoided.
3480: अप-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, quitted, got rid of, given or cast away; made good as a promise, discharged as a debt.
3482: अप-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completed.
3484: अपवृत् अप-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -तितुम्, to turn away, depart; to turn back, to come to an end.
3485: अप-वर्त, अस्, m. taking away; (in arithmetic or algebra) reduction to a common measure; the divisor, which is applied to both or either of the quantities of an equation.
3486: अप-वर्तक, अस्, m. a common measure.
3487: अप-वर्तन, अम्, n. taking away; removal; transferring from one place to another; abbreviation, abridging; reduction of a fraction to its lowest terms; division without remainder; divisor.
3488: अप-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away; removed; divided by a common measure without remainder.
3489: अप-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reversed, inverted, over-turned; ended; (अम्), n. ecliptic (in astronomy).
3491: अपव्यध् अप-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to pierce badly, to throw away, to neglect.
3492: अप-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced; thrown away, re-jected, dismissed, removed. —अपविद्ध-पुत्र, अस्, m. a son rejected by his natural parents and adopted by a stranger; one of the twelve objects of filiation in law. —अपविद्ध-लोक, अस्, आ, अम्, dead.
3493: अप-वेध, अस्, m. piercing anything in the wrong direction or manner (spoiling a jewel by so piercing it).
3494: अपव्यय अप-व्यय, अस्, m. (rt. इ with अप and वि), prodigality.
3495: अप-व्ययत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going away.
3496: अप-व्ययमान, अस्, आ, अम्, squandering; deny-ing a debt.
3497: अप-व्ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ, squandering, wasting, pro-digal.
3498: अपव्यादा अप-व्य-आ-दा (-वि-आ-दा), cl. 3. P. -ददाति, -दातुम्, to open.
3499: अपव्रत अप-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dis-obedient, unfaithful; not performing holy acts, irre-ligious; perverse.
3500: अपशकुन अप-शकुन, अम्, n. a bad omen.
3501: अपशङ्क अप-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, having no fear or hesitation; (अम्), ind. fearlessly.
3502: अपशद अप-शद or अप-सद, अस्, m. a low man.
3503: अपशब्द अप-शब्द, अस्, m. common or vulgar speech; a bad word; any form of language not Sanskrit; ungrammatical language. See अप-भ्रंश।
3505: अपषिरस् अप-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or अप-शिर्-ष, अस्, आ, अम्, or अप-शीर्षन्, आ, आ, अ, headless.
3506: अपशु अ-पशु, उस्, m. not cattle; (उस्, उस्, उ), deprived of cattle, poor. —अ-पशु-हन्, हा, घ्नी, ह, not killing cattle.
3507: अपशुच् 1. अप-शुच्, Intens. P., Ved. -शो-शोक्ति, to disappear, vanish.
3508: 2. अप-शुच्, क्, m. (without sorrow), the soul. अप — शोक, अस्, आ, अम्, sorrowless; (अस्), m. a tree, Jonesia Aśoka.
3509: अपश्चादघ्वन् अ-पश्चा-दघ्वन् or अ-पश्चाद्-दघ्वन्, आ, m., Ved. not staying behind; not coming short of, not being a loser.
3510: अपश्चिम अ-पश्चिम, अस्, आ, अम्, not having another in the rear, last; having no end.
3511: अपश्य अ-पश्य, अस्, आ, अम् Ved., or अ-पश्यत्, -अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not seeing.
3513: अपश्रय अप-श्रय, अस्, m., Ved. a bolster; see उप-श्रय।
3514: अपश्री अप-श्री, ईस्, इ, deprived of beauty.
3515: अपश्वास अप-श्वास, अस्, m. one of the five vital airs; see अपान।
3516: अपष्ठ अप-ष्ठ, अम्, n. (rt. स्था), the end or point of the hook for driving an elephant.
3517: अप-ष्ठु, उस्, उस्, उ, contrary, opposite; per-verse; left; (उ), ind. contrary, perversely, badly; well, properly; handsomely; (उस्), m. time.
3518: अप-ष्ठुर or अप-ष्ठुल, अस्, आ, अम्, oppo-site, contrary.
3519: अपस् अपस्, अस्, n. (fr. obs. rt. अप्), Ved. work, action; sacred act, sacrificial act; water; (आस्), m. f. (असस्), m. f. pl., Ved. active, skilful in any art: अपसस्, f. pl., is a name of the hands and fingers which are busy in kindling the sacred fire and in performing the sacrifices; also a name of the three goddesses of sacred speech, or of the three divinities, fire, wind, and sun; also of the active or running waters [cf. Lat. opus].
3520: अपस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम् (superl.), Ved. most active or rapid.
3521: 1. अपस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, active, fit for an act, running away; watery; (आ), f. a kind of brick (twenty are used in building the sacrificial altar); activity; water.
3522: 2. अपस्य, nom. P. अपस्यति, to be active.
3523: अपस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. active.
3524: अपसद अप-सद, अस्, m. the children of six degrading connections, viz. of a Brāhman with the women of the three lower classes, of a Kṣatriya with women of the two lower, and of a Vaiśya with one of the Sūdra; a low man; an outcast (in this sense generally as last member of a comp., e. g. ब्राह्मणापसद).
3526: अपसर्जन अप-सर्जन, अम्, n. (rt. सृज्), abandonment; gift or donation; final emancipation of the soul [cf. अप-वृज्].
3527: अपसलवि अप-सलवि, ind., Ved. to the left (opposed to प्र-सलवि); the space between the thumb and the forefinger (sacred to the Manes).
3528: अपसव्य अप-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, or अप-सव्यक, अस्, इका, अम्, not on the left side, right; opposite, contrary; (अम्), ind. to the right; the same as अप-सलवि. —अपसव्यं कृ = प्रदक्-षिणं कृ, to circumambulate a person keeping the right side towards him; to put the sacred cord on the right shoulder. —अपसव्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the sacred thread worn on the right shoulder, (as during a Śrāddha, &c.)
3529: अपसिद्धान्त अप-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m. (rt. 1. सिध्), an erroneous conclusion.
3530: अपसिध् अप-सिध्, cl. 1. P. -सेधति, -सेद्-धुम्, -सेधितुम्, to ward off, remove, drive away.
3531: अपसृ अप-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to walk off, go away: Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to make or let one go away, to remove.
3533: अप-सरण, अम्, n. going away. retreating; egress.
3534: अप-सार, अस्, m. going out; egress, passage for going forth; escape.
3535: अप-सारण, अम्, n. removing to a distance.
3536: अप-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, removed, put away, thrown aside.
3537: अपसृप् अप-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्-तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to glide or move off.
3538: अप-सर्प or अप-सर्पक, अस्, m. a secret emis-sary or agent, spy.
3539: अप-सर्पण, अम्, n. going back, retreating.
3541: अपस्कम्भ अप-स्कम्भ, अस्, m. Ved. fasten-ing, making firm.
3542: अपस्कर अप-स्कर, अस्, m. any part of a carriage, a wheel, &c.; fæces; anus; vulva.
3543: अप-स्कार, अस्, m. the root or under part of the knee.
3544: अपस्खल अप-स्खल, अस्, m. leaping off, jumping off; outside of a threshing floor (?).
3546: अपस्तम्भ अप-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. a vessel in the side of the breast containing vital air.
3547: अप-स्तम्भिनी, f., N. of a plant.
3548: अपस्नाप्त अप-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed or bathing after death or mourning, or upon the death of a connection, preparatory to other ceremonies.

3550: अपस्पति अप्-पति, इस्, m., N. of a son of Uttānapāda.

3557: अपस्मार अप-स्मार, अस्, m. or अप-स्मृति, इस्, f. forgetfulness; epilepsy, falling sickness.
3558: अप-स्मारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, epileptic, convulsed.
3560: अपस्य अपस्य, अपस्यु. See under अपस्।
3561: अपस्वर अप-स्वर, अस्, m. an unmusical note or sound.
3562: अपहन् अप-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -तुम्, to beat off, ward off, repel, destroy.

3564: अप-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, warded off, killed.
3566: अप-हनन, अम्, n. or अप-घात (q. v.), ward-ing off.
3567: अप-हन्तृ, ता, m. beating off, destroying.
3569: अपहल अप-हल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bad plough.
3570: अपहस् अप-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -सितुम्, to deride: Caus. P. -हासयति, -यितुम्, to deride, ridicule.

3572: अप-हास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laughed at.
3573: अपहस्त अप-हस्त, अम्, n. taking or throw-ing away or off; stealing, plundering.
3574: अप-हस्तय, nom. P. अप-हस्तयति, -यितुम्, to throw away, lose.
3575: अप-हस्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away, lost, parted with.
3576: अपहा 1. अप-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, -हातुम्, to go off, come to an end.
3577: अपहा 2. अप-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति, -हातुम्, to leave, abandon.
3578: अप-हान, अस्, आ, अम् (or fr. 1. अप-हा?), leaving, abandoning; also written अप-हायन।
3579: अप-हानि, इस्, f. leaving; leaving off, abandonment, stopping, vanishing; exception, exclusion.
3580: अप-हाय, ind. leaving out of view, excepting, except, besides.
3581: अपहिङ्कार अप-हिङ्-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, without the syllable हिम्, which is pronounced in singing the Sāma verses.
3582: अपहृ अप-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. (?) -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to snatch away, carry off, plunder; to re-move, to throw away: Caus. -हारयति, -यितुम्, to have (anything) carried off.
3583: अप-हरण, अम्, n. taking away, carrying off; stealing.
3584: अप-हरणीय or अप-हर्तव्य or अप-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken away, carried off, stolen, &c.; to be taken back or resumed.
3585: अप-हर्तृ, ता, m. (with gen. or acc.) taking away; expiating.
3586: अप-हार, अस्, m. taking away, stealing; spending another person's property; secreting, concealment; e. g. आत्मापहारं कृ, to conceal one's real cha-racter.
3587: अप-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अप-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who takes away, seizes, steals, &c.; a plun-derer, a thief.
3588: अप-हारण, अम्, n. causing to take away, spoiling.
3589: अप-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, carried off, stolen, &c.; taken back, resumed. —अपहृत-वि-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, bereft of sense.
3591: अपह्नु अप-ह्नु, cl. 2. A. -ह्नुते, -ह्नोतुम्, to conceal, disguise; to refuse, deny, disown.
3592: अप-ह्नव, अस्, m. concealment of knowledge; denial of or turning off of the truth; dissimulation; appeasing, satisfying; affection, love.
3593: अप-ह्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, concealed, denied.
3594: अप-ह्नुति, इस्, f. denial, concealment of know-ledge; a figure of rhetoric, applying a description or simile to other than its obvious application.
3595: अप-ह्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, denying.
3596: अप-ह्नोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who conceals or denies or disowns.
3597: अपहास अप-ह्रास, अस्, m. diminishing, reducing.
3598: अपाक् अपाक्, ind. westward, southward; see अपाच् next col.
3599: अपाक 1. अपाक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अप), situated aside or behind; distant; coming from a distant place; incomparable. —अपाक-चक्षस्, आस्, m., Ved. looking or shining far; of incomparable brightness.
3600: अपाका or अपाकात्, ind., Ved. aside, distant. —अपा-के-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing behind.
3601: अपाक्तात्, ind., Ved. from behind, from the west.
3602: अपपाक 2. अ-पाक, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. पच्), im-mature, raw, unripe, undigested; (अस्), m. immaturity, indigestion. —अ-पाक-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, not produced by cooking or ripening; original; natural. —अपाक-शाक, अम्, n. ginger.
3603: अ-पाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, unripe, undigested.
3604: अपाकृ अपा-कृ (अप-आ°), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, or Ved. -कर्तोस्, to remove, drive away, keep away; to take away; to reject (an opinion); to cast off, reject; to desist from, to drop; to free one's self from; to pay.
3605: अपा-करण, अम्, n. driving away, removal; pay-ment, liquidation.
3606: अपा-करिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, driving away; excelling.
3608: अपा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, removed, de-stroyed, void of; paid.
3609: अपा-कृति, इस्, f. taking away, removal.
3610: अपाकृष् अपा-कृष् (अप-आ°), cl. 1. 6. P. A. -कर्षति, -ते, -कृषति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to turn off or away, to avert.
3611: अपाकॄ अपा-कॄ (अप-आ°), cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम्, -रीतुम्, to throw any one off; to abandon to contemn.
3612: अपाक्रम् अपा-क्रम् (अप-आ°), cl. 1. P. poet. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to retire from.
3613: अपाक्ष अपाक्ष (अप-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, pre-sent, perceptible; (अस्, ई, अम्), eyeless, having bad eyes.
3614: अपाङ्क्त अ-पाङ्क्त or अ-पाङ्क्तेय or अ-पाङ्क्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not in a line or row; not in the same degree or class, unworthy, inadmissible into society, ejected from caste, excluded, outcast. —अ-पाङ्क्त्योपहत (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, defiled or contaminated by the presence of impure or improper persons.
3615: अपाङ्ग अपाङ्ग (अप-अङ्°) or अपाङ्गक, अस्, आ, अम्, maimed, crippled; wanting or deformed in some limb; (अस्), m. the outer corner of the eye (sometimes as last member of a feminine comp. ending in आ or ई); a sectarial mark or circlet on the forehead; N. of Kāma, the god of love; a plant, Achyranthes Aspera. —अपाङ्ग-दर्शन, अम्, n. a side glance, a leer, a wink. —अपाङ्ग-देश, अस्, m. the place round the outer corner of the eye. —अपाङ्ग-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes with beautiful outer angles.
3616: अपाच् अपाच् or अपाञ्च्, ङ्, ची, क् (fr. अञ्च् with अप), going or situated backwards, behind; western (opposed to प्राञ्च्); southern (opposed to उदञ्च्); (क्), ind. behind, westward, southward.
3617: अपाची, f. the south. —अपाचीतरा (°ची-इत्°), f. the north, i. e. other than the south.

3687: अपि अपि, or sometimes पि (as a particle or preposition prefixed to verbs and nouns), expresses placing near or over, uniting to, annexing, reaching to, proximity, &c. [cf. Gr. ἐπί Zend api; Germ. and Eng. prefix be]; in later Sanskrit its places seems frequently supplied by अभि। (As a separable adv.) and, also moreover, besides, assuredly, surely; अपि अपि or अपि-च, as well as; न वापि or न अपिवा or न नचापि, neither, nor; चापि, (and at the beginning of a sentence) अपि-च, moreover.
3688: अपि is often used to express emphasis, in the sense of even, also, very; e. g. अन्यद् अपि, also another, something more; अद्यापि, this very day, even now; तथापि, even thus, notwithstanding; यद्य् अपि, even if, although; यद्यपि तथापि, although, nevertheless; न कदाचिद् अपि, never at any time: sometimes in the sense of but, only, at least, e. g. मुहूर्तम् अपि, only a moment.
3689: अपि may be affixed to an interrogative to make it indefinite. e. g. को ऽपि, any one; कुत्रापि, anywhere.
3690: अपि imparts to numerals the notion of totality, e. g. चतुर्णाम् अपि वर्णानाम्, of all the four castes.
3691: अपि may be interrogative at the beginning of a sentence.
3692: अपि may strengthen the original force of the po-tential. or may soften the imperative, like the English ‘be pleased to;’ sometimes it is a mere expletive.

(a prefix to verbs and nouns, expressing) to, towards, into, over, upon. .(As a prefix to verbs of motion) it expresses the notion of moving or going towards, approaching, &c. .(As a prefix to nouns not derived from verbs) it ex-presses superiority, intensity, &c.; e. g. अभि-ताम्र, अभि-नव, q. v. . (As a separable adverb or preposition) it expresses (with acc.) to, towards, in the direction of, against; in, into, to; for, for the sake of; on account of; on, upon, with regard to; by, before, in front of; over. 7825: आ 3. आ a prefix to verbs and nouns, (ex-pressing) near, near to, towards, from all sides, all around; and sometimes redundant. As a prefix to verbs of motion it expresses the notion of moving or going towards; e. g. आ-क्रामति, he goes towards. When prefixed to roots like गम्, या, and इ, to go, and दा, to give, it reverses the action; e. g. आ-गच्छति, he comes; आ-दत्ते, he takes. As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns it forms with them either compound adverbs or adjectives, implying the limit conclusive (until, unto, as far as), or the limit inceptive (from, from thence or that time); e. g. आ-मरणम्, till death; आ-कुमारम्, from childhood [cf. a puero]; आ-गोपाला द्विजातयः, the twice-born including the cowherds. (Prefixed to adjectives &c. it implies) diminution; e. g. आ-पाण्डु, a little pale; आ-पक्व, half-cooked. (As a separable adverb आ implies) near, near to, towards; thereto, further, also, and; especially, even. In many places in the Vedas आ gives force to the word which precedes it (e. g. महिमा वाम् इन्-द्राग्नी पनिष्ठ आ, ‘your greatness, O Indra and Agni, is praiseworthy indeed’); and in a similar man-ner we find it in the Veda placed after prepositions, the sense of which is strengthened by it. (As a separable preposition with acc. or abl.) near to, up to, to, as far as; e. g. शतम् आ जातीस्, as far as a hundred births; आ समुद्रात्, as far as the ocean: (with abl.) away from, from; out of, of, from among; e. g. आ मूलात्, from the beginning; बहुभ्य आ, from among many: (with loc.) in, at; e. g. दम आ, in a house.

8110: आ-घ्राण, अम्, n. smelling; satisfaction, satiety; (अस्, आ, अम्), satisfied, satiated.
8111: आ-घ्रात, अस्, आ, अम्, smelled, scented; satisfied, satiated; surmounted, surpassed.
8112: आ-घ्रेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be smelled at.
8113: आङ्कुशायन आङ्कुशायन, adj. formed fr. अङ्कुश। See Gaṇa to Pāṇini IV. 2, 80.
8114: आङ्कृति आङ्कृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
8115: आङ्क्षी आङ्क्षी, f. a musical instrument, a tabor.
8116: आङ्ग आङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. अङ्ग), re-lating to the base (अङ्ग), of a word in grammar; bodily, corporeal; having limbs or parts or relating to them; relating to the inferior persons of a drama, to a portion of the Vedas, &c.; (अम्), n. a soft deli-cate form or body; (अस्, ई, अम्, pl. ăङ्गास्), produced or born in the country Aṅga; a prince of that country.
8117: आङ्गक, अस्, m. the ruler of the country Aṅga; an inhabitant of the same.

8119: आङ्गिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bodily, corporeal; gesticulated, expressed by bodily action (dramatic sentiment, pas-sion &c., exhibited by attitude, gesture &c.); (अस्), m. a player on a tabor or drum.
8120: आङ्गदी आङ्गदी, f., N. of the capital of Aṅgada's kingdom.
8121: आङ्गार आङ्गार, अम्, n. (fr. अङ्गार), a mul-titude of firebrands.
8122: आङ्गिरस आङ्गिरस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अङ्गिरस्), descended from or belonging to or referring to the Aṅgirasas or to Aṅgiras; (अस्), m. a descendant of Aṅgiras; especially a N. of Vṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods; a Kṣatriya by will of Brahmā and by profession.

8125: आङ्गूष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praising aloud, sound-ing; fit for praise.
8126: आङ्गेयी आङ्गेयी probably = आङ्गी। See आङ्ग।
8127: आङ्ग्य, adj. fr. अङ्ग, q. v.
8128: आच 1. आच, अस्, m., N. of a man.
8129: आच 2. आच, in the words आच-पराच and आचोपच, ‘turned towards and away from’ (?).
8130: आचक्ष् आ-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -ष्टुम्, to look at, inspect; to tell, relate, make a communication about anything (with acc.); to announce, declare; to make known, confess; to acquaint, introduce to; to address any one (with acc.); to call, name.
8131: आ-चक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, saying, declaring.
8132: आ-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. a learned man, a Paṇḍit.
8133: आचतुरम् आ-चतुरम्, ind. till the fourth generation.
8134: आचतुर्य आचतुर्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-चतुर), clumsiness, stupidity.
8135: आचम् आ-चम्, cl. 1. P. -चामति, -चमितुम्, to sip; to rinse the mouth (with inst. of the thing); to lap up, lick up, to cause to disappear (as the wind licks up moisture): Caus. -चामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sip water.
8136: आ-चम, अस्, m. rinsing the mouth.

8138: आ-चमनक, अस्, m. a spitting pot.
8139: आचमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, used for rinsing the mouth; (अम्), n. water for rinsing the mouth, a gargle.
8140: आ-चम्य, ind. having rinsed the mouth, having sipped and ejected a little water.
8141: आ-चान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sipped and ejected (as water); one who has rinsed his mouth.
8142: आ-चाम, अस्, m. sipping water, rinsing the mouth; the water or foam of boiled rice.
8143: आ-चामक, अस्, आ, अम्, rinsing the mouth.
8144: आ-चामनक, अस्, m. a spitting pot.
8145: आ-चाम्य, अम्, n. rinsing the mouth, water so used, a gargle; (अस्, आ, अम्), to be rinsed.
8146: आचय आ-चय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चि with आ), collection, plenty.
8147: आचयक, अस्, आ, अम्, collecting, skilful in col-lecting.
8148: आचर् आ-चर्, cl. 1. P. ep. A. -चरति, -ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -रध्यै, -रितवे, -रसे, to come near to, approach; to step upon, pass through; to pro-ceed, manage, behave one's self towards (with loc.); to treat; to have intercourse with, frequent; to act, undertake, do, exercise, practice, perform; to devour, eat into; to help forward, put into.
8149: आ-चरण, अम्, n. approaching, arrival; following, observing, conduct, usage, practice; an institute, rite or rule of conduct; a cart, carriage.
8150: आ-चरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done or performed; to be followed or observed, right, proper.
8151: आ-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, following, practising, ob-serving.
8152: आ-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, observed, practised, as a rite or usage; usual, customary; enjoined, fixed by rule.
8153: आ-चरितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be performed in a customary manner; to be done or performed.
8154: आ-चर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone to or approached; to be done or performed.
8155: आ-चार, अस्, m. conduct, manner of action; beha-viour; good conduct, good behaviour; custom, prac-tice, usage; an established rule of conduct, an ordi-nance, an institute, a precept; manner of conducting one's self, diet; rule; [cf. Hib. acara, ‘convenience, conveniency, use.’] —आचार-चन्द्रिका, f. title of a work on the religious customs of the Śūdras. —आचार-तन्त्र, अम्, n. one of the four classes of Tantras with Buddhists. —आचार-दीप, अस्, m. ‘lamp of re-ligious customs,’ title of a work. —आचार-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from established usage, apostate. —आचार-मयूख, अस्, m. ‘ray of religious cus-toms,’ title of a work. —आचार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, well-conducted, virtuous. —आचार-वरिजित, अस्, आ, अम्, irregular, out of rule; outcast. —आचार-विरुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, contrary to custom. —आचार-वेदी, f. ‘altar of religious customs,’ a N. of Āryāvarta. —आ-चार-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of established ordi-nances, outcast. —आचाराङ्ग (°र-अङ्°), अम्, n. title of the first of the twelve sacred books of the Jainas. —आचारादर्श (°र-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘looking-glass of religious customs,’ title of a work. —आचारार्क (°र-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘sun of religious customs,’ title of a work. —आचारोल्लास (°र-उल्ल्°), अस्, m. ‘light of religious customs,’ title of a work.
8156: आचारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, conformable to rule or prac-tice, prescriptive, authorized; (अम्), n. rules for the preservation of health, habit of life, regimen, diet.
8157: आचारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, following established rites or practice.
8158: आ-चारी, f. the plant Hingtsha Repens, also called Hilamocikā.
8159: आ-चार्य, अस्, m. lit. ‘one to whom one must have recourse’ or ‘one who is to be attended to or waited on’ or ‘one whose precepts are to be followed’ or ‘one who knows the आचार or rules;’ a spiritual guide or teacher, especially one who invests the student with the sacrificial thread, and instructs him in the Vedas, in the law of sacrifice and religious mysteries (Manu 2. 140, 171); an epithet of Droṇa the teacher of the Pāṇḍus; (आ), f. a spiritual preceptress. The title आचार्य affixed to names of learned men is rather like our Dr.; e. g. राघवाचार्य, &c. —आचार्य-करण, अम्, n. acting as teacher. —आ-चार्य-ता, f. or आचार्य-त्व, अम्, n. the office or pro-ficiency of a holy teacher. —आचार्य-देव, अस्, m. one whose preceptor is his god. —आचार्य-भो-गीन, अस्, आ, अम्, delighting the holy teacher. —आचार्य-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, venerable, honourable. —आचार्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has a teacher. —आचार्योपासन (°य-उप्°), अम्, n. waiting upon or serving the spiritual preceptor.
8160: आचार्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, originating from a spiritual teacher; (अम्), n. the proficiency of a holy teacher.
8161: आचार्यानी, f. (with dental न्, Pāṇini IV. 1, 49. Vārt. 6), the wife of an Ācārya or holy teacher.
8162: आ-चीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (anom. past pass. part.), de-voured, eaten into.
8163: आचरण्य आ-चरण्य (nom. fr. चरण), P. -चरण्यति, -यितुम्, to move one's self, to move or extend towards.
8164: आचल् आ-चल्, Caus. P. -चालयति, -यितुम्, to move, draw away from one's place, stir up.
8166: आचि आ-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते, -चेतुम्, to accumulate; to collect; to heap up, load with; to cover.

8169: आचिख्यासा आ-चिख्यासा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. ख्या with आ), desire or intention of expressing or denoting something.
8170: आचित् 1. आ-चित्, cl. 1. 3. P. -चेतति, -चिकेत्ति, A. -चिकिते, -चेत्तुम्, to attend to, to keep in mind; to comprehend, understand, know; to invent; to ap-pear, become visible, distinguish one's self: Desid. -चिकित्सति, -ते, to wait for, watch clandestinely, lurk.
8171: 2. आ-चित्, त्, f., Ved. taking notice or cognizance, attention to; (according to Sāy. the form आ-चिता may stand for आ-चिते fr. आ-चित above.)
8172: आचीर्ण आ-चीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्। See under आ-चर् last col.

8174: आचृत् आ-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्, to fasten, tie, affix.
8175: आचेश्वर आचेश्वर (°च-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a sanctuary built by Āca.
8176: आचेष्ट् आ-चेष्ट्, cl. 1. P. A. -चेष्टति, -ते, -टितुम्, to undertake; to do.
8178: आच्छद् 1. आ-च्छद् (-छद्), cl. 10. P. -च्छ-दयति or -च्छादयति, -यितुम्, to cover, hide; to clothe, to dress, put on clothes; to conceal.

8180: आ-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed, clothed.
8182: आ-च्छादक, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, hiding.

8189: आच्छिद् आ-च्छिद् (-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छि-नत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to tear or cut off; to cut or break in pieces; to take out of; to draw off; remove; to cut off, exclude; to snatch away, to tear from, to rob; to disregard, not to take notice of.

8195: आच्छुरित आ-च्छुरित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. छुर् with आ), scratched; irritated; (अम्), n. making a noise with the finger-nails by rubbing them on one another; a horse-laugh.

8200: आच्यु आ-च्यु, Caus. P. A. -च्यावयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to flow over, pour out; to draw or bring near; to induce (any one) to come near.

8209: आजगव आजगव, अस्, m. the bow of Śiva [cf. अजकाव].
8210: आजन् आ-जन्, cl. 4. A., Ved. -जायते, -जनि-तुम्, to be born or come into existence, to be pro-duced or born from; to beget, cause to be born, render prolific.

8217: आजानेय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of good breed, well-bred.
8218: आजप् आ-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -पितुम्, to mutter or whisper to.
8219: आजमीढ आजमीढ, अस्, m., N. of a king in the Mahā-bhārata.

8223: आजवाह आजवाह or आजवाहक fr. अज-वाह Pāṇini IV. 2, 133.
8224: आजातशत्रव आजातशत्रव, अस्, m. (fr. अजा-त-शत्रु), epithet of Bhadrasena in the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa V. 5. 5, 14.

8226: आजान आ-जान, आजानेय। See under आजन्।
8227: आजि 1. आजि। See under आज् above.

(fr. 4. अ), Ved. afterwards, then; (in which senses it is often used in a concluding paragraph antithetically to यद्, यदा, यदि, being then sometimes strengthened by the particles अह, इद्, ईम्, उ; e. g. यदेद् अयुक्त हरितः सधस्थाद् आद् रात्री वासस् तनुते सिमस्मै, ‘at the very time when he has unyoked his coursers from his car, then night extends the veiling darkness over all;’ वृत्रं यद् इन्द्र शवसावधीर् अहिम् आद् इत् सूर्यं दिव्य् आरोहयो दृशे, ‘when, O Indra, thou didst slay with thy power the dragon Vṛtra, then indeed thou didst raise the sun in the sky, that it might be seen.’ In other passages आत् is simply used like a conjunc-tion, equivalent to ‘then, further, also, and.’ Sometimes it only serves to strengthen the meaning of another word, or to give emphasis to an interrogative pronoun, in the same way as उ, नु, अङ्ग, &c.; e. g. य एक इद् अप्रतिर् मन्यमान आद् अस्माद् अन्यो अज-निष्ट तव्यान्, ‘he who considered himself alone irresistible, another was born mightier even than he;’ किम् आत् प्र ब्रवाम, ‘How can we at all pro-claim ?’

Goth. ahma; Old Germ. ātum, Them. ātuma; Angl. Sax. œdhm; Mod. Germ. 8415: आदित्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or devoted to, or originating from Aditi; belonging or relating to, or originating from the Ādityas; (अस्), m. a son of Aditi. In the earliest times this is the N. of seven deities of the heavenly sphere, of whom Varuṇa is the chief and to whom therefore especially belongs the title Āditya. The names of six of the seven are Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, Dakṣa, and Aṃśa; that of the seventh is not clearly ascertained. Sometimes their number is supposed to be eight; and in the period of the Brāhmaṇas twelve, as representing the sun in the twelve months of the year. The name Āditya was afterwards applied to any god, though especially applicable to Sūrya, the sun; N. of Viṣṇu in his Vāmana or dwarf avatār, as son of Kaśyapa and Aditi and younger brother of Indra; the plant Calotropis Gigantea; N. of a man; (औ), m. du., N. of a constel-lation, the seventh lunar mansion. —आदित्य-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —आदित्य-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —आदित्य-चन्द्रौ, m. du. sun and moon. —आदित्य-दास, अस्, m., N. of a man. —आदित्य-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a plant = अर्क-पत्त्र. —आदित्य-पर्णिनी, f. a creeping plant with gold-coloured flowers, growing near the banks of water. —आदित्य-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of an Upa-purāṇa. —आदित्य-पुष्पिका, f. red swallow wort. —आदित्य-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a king. —आदित्य-भक्ता, f. = अर्क-भक्ता, q. v. —आदित्य-मण्डल, अम्, n. the disc or orb of the sun. —आदित्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, surrounded by the Ādityas. —आदित्य-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. winning the (favour of the) Ādityas. —आदित्य-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having the colour of the sun; (अस्), m., N. of a man. —आदित्य-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —आदित्य-व्रत, अम्, n. = अर्क-व्रत, q. v. —आदित्य-सदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, like the sun. —आदित्य-सूनु, उस्, m., son of the sun; N. of Sugrīva, the monkey-king; of Yama, Saturn, Sāvarṇi Manu, and Vaivasvata Manu. —आदित्य-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king of Ujjayinī. —आदित्याचार्य (°त्य-आच्), अस्, m., N. of an author.

8790: आप्री आ-प्री, f. (fr. rt. प्री with आ), Ved. gaining one's favour, conciliation, propitiation; (आ-प्रि-यस्), propitiatory verses; N. of certain invocations addressed to a series of deified objects in order, and said to be introductory to the animal sacrifice. Accord-ing to others, the objects propitiated by these hymns are the real āprīs or आप्रियस्; whence the hymns themselves are called आप्री hymns. The objects in-voked are in a series of twelve verses, as follows: 1. Su-samiddha (or the fuel); 2. and 3. Tanūnapāt and Narāśaṃsa (these are sometimes invoked in one verse as mystic names of fire); 4. The divine being who bears the invocations to the gods (see under इड्); 5. Barhis (or the sacred grass); 6. The doors of the chambers in which the sacrifice is offered; 7. Night and dawn; 8. The two divine beings, sometimes called Pracetasas, who preside over and protect the sacrificial rite; 9. The three goddesses, Ilā (see under इडा), Sarasvatī (goddess of eloquence), and Mahī (a form of Bhāratī or speech); 10. Tvaṣṭṛ (the maker or creator); 11. Vanas-pati (the tree or wooden column to which the victim is tied); 12. Svāhā (the exclama-tion used in inviting the gods to the sacrifice when finally offered in the fire). All these are by Sāy. re-garded as forms of Agni. See Ṛg-veda I. 13.

9151: आ-रोपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to ascend; to be raised, placed, &c.
9152: आ-रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, elevated; fixed, placed, made; strung (as a bow); deposited, intrusted; conse-crated; accidental, adventitious.
9153: 1. आ-रोप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or fixed on or in.
9154: 2. आ-रोप्य, ind. having made to ascend, having caused to mount, having placed upon.
9155: आ-रोप्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being strung, being tried to be strung.
9156: आ-रोह, अस्, m. one who mounts or ascends, a rider (on a horse &c.), one who is seated in a carriage; ascent, rising, creeping up, mounting, riding; haughti-ness, pride; elevation, elevated place, altitude; a heap, mountain; a woman's waist, the buttocks; length; measure; descending (= अव-रोह?); a mine.
9157: आ-रोहक, अस्, आ, अम्, ascending; rising; raising up; (अस्), m. a rider; a tree.
9158: आ-रोहण, अम्, n. the act of rising, ascending; the rising or growing of new shoots, growing (of plants); Ved. a carriage; an elevated stage for dancing; a ladder, a staircase; riding on (a horse &c.).
9159: आरोहणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to ascent or mounting.
9160: आ-रोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ascending, mounting; one who mounts or rides.
9161: आरू आरू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, of a tawny colour; (ऊस्), m. tawny (the colour).
9162: आरे आरे, ind. (see 2. आर), Ved. far, far from (with abl.); near. —आरे-अघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having evil far removed. —आरे-अवद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one from whom blame or insult is far removed. —आरे-शत्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one whose enemies are driven far away.
9163: आरेवत आरेवत, अस्, m. a tree, = आरग्-बध, q. v.; (अम्), n. the fruit of this tree.
9164: आरेहण आ-रेहण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. रिह् for लिह् with आ), Ved. licking, kissing.
9165: आरोग्य आरोग्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-रोग), free-dom from disease, health.
9166: आर्कि आर्कि, इस्, m. a son of Arka or the sun; epithet of the planet Saturn.
9167: आर्क्ष आर्क्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋक्ष), stellar, regulated by the stars or constellations; (अस्), m. a son or descendant of Ṛkṣa; epithet of Āśvamedha, of Śrutarvan, of Saṃvaraṇa. —आर्क्ष-वर्ष, अस्, m. a stellar year or revolution of a constellation.
9168: आर्क्ष्य, patronymic of ऋक्ष Pāṇini IV. 1, 105.
9169: आर्क्षोद आर्क्षोद, अस्, ई, अम्, inhabiting the mountain Ṛkṣoda.
9170: आर्गल आर्गल, अस्, ई, m. f. a bolt or bar. See अर्गल।
9171: आर्ग्बध आर्ग्बध, अस्, m. = आरग्-बध, q. v.
9172: आर्घा आर्घा, f. a sort of yellow bee.
9173: आर्घ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to this bee; (अम्), n. its honey.
9174: आर्च आर्च, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अर्चा or fr. ऋच्), devout, worshipping; relating to the Ṛc or Ṛg-veda.
9175: आर्चिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the Ṛg-veda; (अम्), n. an epithet of the Sāma-veda.
9176: आर्चत्क आर्चत्क, अस्, m. a patronymic of Śara.
9177: आर्चाभिन् आर्चाभिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school, founded by a pupil of Vaiśampāyana.
9178: आर्छ् आर्छ् (आ-ऋछ्), cl. 6. P. आर्च्छति, -छि-तुम्, to fall into (mischief); to obtain; to partake of.
9179: आर्जव आर्जव, अम्, n. (fr. ऋजु), straight-ness, straight direction; rectitude, propriety of act or observance; honesty, open behaviour; sincerity.
9180: आर्जीक आर्जीक, अस्, m. (cf. ऋजीक), Ved. originally perhaps a milk-vessel. This word probably denotes a celestial vessel, in which the heavenly Soma is purified, or one of the rivers which it forms in the sky; (Sāy.) a lake in the country Ṛjīkā.
9181: आर्जीकीय, अस्, m. = the preceding; (आ), f. a terres-trial river; N. of the river Vipāśā.
9182: आर्जुनायन आर्जुनायन, आस्, m. pl. (fr. अर्-जुन), N. of a people.
9183: आर्जुनायनक, अस्, ई, अम्, inhabited by the Ārju-nāyanas.
9184: आर्जुनि आर्जुनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Arjuna.
9185: आर्जुनेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Kutsa.
9186: आर्ञ्ज् आर्ञ्ज् (आ-ऋञ्ज्), cl. 1. A. आर्ञ्जते, -जितुम्, to strive after, to endeavour to obtain, to wish to possess.
9187: आर्त आर्त, अस्, आ, अम् (probably past pass. part. of rt. ऋ with prep. आ, but according to some fr. rt. ऋत्, and according to others an irreg. formation fr. rt. अर्द्, which ought to form अर्ण with prep. सम्, नि and वि, and अर्दित in other cases), struck by calamity, afflicted, pained, disturbed; injured; op-pressed, suffering, sick, unhappy. —आर्त-गल, अस्, m., N. of the plant Barleria Cærulea. —आर्त-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, extremely pained, disturbed, confounded. —आर्त-ता, f. state of affliction, pain. —आर्त-नाद or आर्त-स्वर, अस्, m. a cry of pain. —आर्त-बन्धु, उस्, m. friend of the distressed.
9188: आर्ति, इस्, f. painful occurrence, pain, injury, mischief, evil; sickness; the end of a bow [cf. अर्ति and आर्त्नी]. —आर्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having or suffering pain; (आन्), m., N. of a serpent. —आर्ति-हन्, आ, आ, अ, or आर्ति-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying pain. —आर्त्य्-अपहरण, अम्, n. the relieving of distress, pain, &c.
9189: आर्तना आर्तना, f. (according to Sāy. de-rived fr. आर्त above), Ved. a destructive combat; (as an adj. ?) uncultivated, wild ground (? connected with आर, अरण, अरण्य, &c.).
9190: आर्तपर्णि आर्तपर्णि, इस्, m. the son of Ṛta-parṇa, a patronymic of Sudāsa.
9191: आर्तभाग आर्तभाग, अस्, m. son of Ṛta-bhāga, a patronymic of Jarat-kārava.
9192: आर्तव आर्तव, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. ऋतु), be-longing or conforming to the seasons or periods of time, seasonable; menstrual, relating to or produced by this discharge; (अस्), m. a section of the year, a combination of several seasons; (ई), f. a mare; (अम्), n. the menstrual discharge, certain days after the men-strual discharge fit for generation; fluid discharged by the female of an animal at the time of rut; a flower.
9193: आर्त्वेयी, f. a woman during her courses.
9194: आर्त्नी आर्त्नी, f., Ved. the end of a bow, the place where the string or sinew is fastened; (κορώνη)
9195: आर्त्विजीन आर्त्विजीन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋत्विज्), fit for the office of a priest.
9196: आर्त्विज्य, अम्, n. the office or business of a sacri-ficing priest, his rank or order.
9197: आर्त्व्य आर्त्व्य, अस्, m. a patronymic of Dvi-mūrdhan, a kind of Asura.
9198: आर्थ आर्थ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अर्थ), relating to a thing or object; material, significant (opposed to शाब्द, q. v.).
9199: आर्थपत्य, अम्, n. (fr. अर्थ-पति), power over or possession of a thing.
9200: आर्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, significant, wise, rich; substan-tial, real, pertaining to the true substance of a thing.
9201: आर्द्र आर्द्र, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. अर्द्), wet, moist, damp; fresh, not dry, succulent, green (as a plant), living; fresh, new; soft, tender, full of feeling, warm; loose, flaccid; (अस्), m., N. of a grandson of Pṛthu; (आ), f. the fourth or sixth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion. —आर्द्र-काष्ठ, अम्, n. green wood, timber not dry. —आर्द्र-ता, f. or आर्द्र-त्व, अम्, n. wetness, moisture; freshness, greenness; softness, tenderness. —आर्द्र-दानु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. granting moisture. —आर्द्र-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, moist-eyed, weeping, suffused with tears. —आर्द्र-पवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having moist or drip-ping fellies (said of a carriage). —आर्द्र-पवित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a wet strainer; epithet of the Soma. —आर्द्र-माषा, f. a leguminous shrub, Glycine Debilis. —आर्द्र-शाक, अम्, n. fresh ginger. —आर्द्र-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moist-handed. —आर्द्रा-लुब्धक, अस्, m. the dragon's tail or de-scending node.
9202: आर्द्रक, अम्, n. ginger in its undried state; (अस्, ई, अम्), born under the constellation Ārdrā; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Vasumitra.
9203: आर्द्रय, nom. P. आर्द्रयति, -यितुम्, to make wet, moisten.
9204: आर्ध् आर्ध् (आ-ऋध्), Desid. A. एर्त्सते, to wish to obtain or to collect.
9205: आर्ध आर्ध (fr. अर्ध), used at the begin-ning of compounds to express ‘half.’
9206: आर्धद्रौणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bought with half a drona, containing it, &c.
9207: आर्धधातुक, अस्, ई, अम्, applicable to half the root or to the shorter form of the verbal base; this is the name of those terminations and affixes which belong to the six non-conjugational or general tenses. These terminations are supposed to be affixed im-mediately to the root or with the interposition only of an augment, such as the inserted इ।
9208: आर्धप्रस्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bought &c. with half a prastha.
9209: आर्धमासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, lasting &c. for half a month; observing or practising (continence &c.) for a fortnight.
9210: आर्धरात्रिक, आस्, m. pl. (fr. अर्ध-रात्र), N. of an astronomical school who reckoned the begin-ning of the motions of the planets from midnight.
9211: आर्धिक, अस्, ई, अम्, sharing half, an equal partner; relating to half; (अस्), m. one who ploughs the ground for half the crop.
9212: आर्धुक आर्धुक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. ऋध्), Ved. conducive to success, useful, beneficial.
9213: आर्पय् आर्पय्, Caus. fr. rt. ऋ with आ। See 2. आर्।
9214: आर्पयितृ, ता, m., Ved. one who injures or hurts.
9215: आर्भव आर्भव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋभु), be-longing or sacred to the Ṛbhus.
9216: आर्य आर्य, अस्, आ, m. f. (fr. अर्य, rt. ऋ), a loyal or faithful man, a man of one's own race; one who is faithful to the deities of his country; N. of the Hindū and Iranian people (opposed to अन्-आर्य, दस्यु, दास); in later times N. of the first three castes (opposed to शूद्र); a man highly esteemed, a respectable, honourable man; a master, an owner; a friend; a Vaiśya; Buddha; (with Buddhists) a man who has thought on the four chief principles of Buddhism and lives according to them; a son of Manu Sāvarṇa; (अस्, आ, or ई, अम्), Āryan, favourable to the Āryan people; behaving like an Āryan, worthy of one, honourable, respectable, noble; of a good family; excellent; wise; suitable; (आ), f. a name of Pārvatī; a kind of metre of two lines, each, line consisting of seven and a half feet; each foot containing four in-stants, except the sixth of the second line, which con-tains only one, and is therefore a single short syllable; hence there are thirty instants in the first line and twenty-seven in the second; [with आर्य cf. the Old Germ. êra and Mod. Germ. Ehre.] —आर्य-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, easily to be got by honourable men, to be received with honour by noble men; decorous, respectable, right. —आर्य-ता, f. or आर्य-त्व, अम्, n. honourable behaviour. —आर्य-देव, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Nāgārjuna. —आर्य-देश, अस्, m. a region inhabited by Āryans or followers of the Āryan laws. —आर्यदेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, originating from such a region. —आर्य-पुत्र, अस्, m. son of an Āryan or honourable man; the son of a spiritual preceptor; honorific designation of the son of an elder brother; of a husband by his wife; of a prince by a general; a husband (in theatrical language). —आर्य-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, inhabited by Āryan people; abound-ing with respectable persons. —आर्य-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a renowned astronomer, the inventor of algebra, among the Hindūs. —आर्य-भाव, अस्, m. honourable character or behaviour. —आर्य-मार्ग, अस्, m. the way of the honourable, the respectable way. —आर्य-मिश्र, आस्, m. pl. an as-sembly of respectable or honourable men; (अस्, आ, अम्), distinguished, respectable; (अस्), m. a gentleman, a man of consequence. —आर्य-युवन्, आ, m. an Āryan youth. —आर्य-राज, अस्, m., N. of a king. —आर्य-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has only the form of an Āryan; a hypocrite, an impostor. —आर्यलिङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who bears the external semblance of an Āryan or honourable man, an impostor. —आर्य-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —आर्य-वृत्त, अम्, n. the behaviour of an Āryan or noble man; (अस्, आ, अम्), behaving like an Āryan; virtuous, good, pious. —आर्य-वेश, अस्, आ, अम्, dressed like an Āryan, well clothed, fine. —आर्य-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who observes the laws and ordinances of the Āryans or honourable men. —आर्य-सङ्घ, अस्, m. the whole body of the Āryans, the collective body of noblemen; N. of a renowned philosopher, founder of the school of the Yogākāras. —आर्य-सत्य, अम्, n. a noble or sublime truth; four such truths form the four chief principles of Buddhism. —आर्य-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist patriarch. —आर्य-हृद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, beloved by the noble. —आर्या-गीति, इस्, f. a variety of the Āryā metre, containing eight equal feet or thirty-two syllabic in-stants in each verse of the couplet. —आर्यावर्त (°य-आव्°), अस्, m. abode of the noble or excellent; the sacred land or place of residence of the Āryans; N. of the land extending from the eastern to the western sea, and bounded on the north and south by the Himālaya and Vindhya mountains. —आर्या-विलास, अस्, m. title of a work. —आर्याष्टशत (°य-अष्ट-श°), अम्, n. title of a work of Ārya-bhaṭṭa's, consisting of eight hundred distichs.
9217: आर्यक, अस्, m. an honourable, respectable man; a grandfather; N. of a cowherd who became king; of a Nāga. —आर्यका or आर्यिका, f. a respectable woman; (इका), f., N. of a Nakṣatra; (अकम्), n. a ceremony performed to the manes, the vessel &c. used in sacri-fices made to the manes.
9219: आर्वाक् आर्वाक्, ind. after, afterwards, be-hind. See अर्वाक्।
9220: आर्श आर्श, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋश्य), Ved. belong-ing to the antelope.
9221: आर्ष आर्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋषि), relating or belonging to or derived from Ṛṣis, i. e. the poets of the Vedic and other old hymns, archaistic; (अस्), m. a form of marriage derived from the Ṛṣis, the father of the bride receiving one or two pairs of kine from the bridegroom; (अम्), n. the speech of a Ṛṣi, the holy text, the Vedas; sacred descent; the derivation (of a poem) from a Ṛṣi author; (आ), f. a class of Vedic metres. —आर्षोढा (°ष-ऊढ्°), f. a wife married according to the Ārṣa form.
9222: आर्षेय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi, of sacred descent; venerable, respectable; (अम्), n. sacred descent. —आर्षेय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with sacred descent.
9223: आर्षभ आर्षभ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋषभ), derived from a bull, produced by one.
9224: आर्षभि, इस्, m., N. of the first Cakravartin in Bhārata; a son of the first Tīrthakṛt Ṛṣabha.
9225: आर्षभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, a steer sufficiently full-grown to be used or one fit to be castrated.
9226: आर्ष्टिषेण आर्ष्टिषेण, अस्, m. a patronymic of Devāpi.
9227: आर्हत आर्हत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अर्हत्), belong-ing to the doctrine of Jina or the Jains; (अस्), m. a Jaina, a follower of the doctrines of Jina.
9228: आर्हत्य, अम्, n. the quality or practice of an Arhat or Jain saint.
9229: आल आल, अम्, n. spawn, any discharge of venomous matter from poisonous animals; yellow arsenic, orpiment; (अस्, आ, अम्), not small, large, ex-tensive. —आलाक्त (°ल-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. anointed with poison (as an arrow).
9230: आलक्ष् आ-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to descry, behold.
9231: 1. आ-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed, visible, apparent.
9232: आलक्षण्य आलक्षण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-ल-क्षण), misfortune, crime.
9233: आलक्ष्य 2. आ-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम् (3. आ pre-prefixed in the sense of diminution), scarcely visible.
9234: आलगर्द आलगर्द, अस्, m. a species of Cobra. See अलगर्द।
9235: आलप् आ-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, -पितुम्, to address, speak to, converse: Caus. -लापयति, -यितुम्, to engage (another) in conversation, to question.
9236: आ-लाप, अस्, m. speaking to, addressing, speech, conversation, communication; statement of the ques-tion in an arithmetical or algebraic sum; a question. —आलाप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, speaking, addressing.
9237: आ-लापन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to speak or converse about; (अम्), n. speaking to, conversing with.
9238: आ-लापनीय or आ-लाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken, to be spoken to or addressed.
9239: आ-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking or conversing with; (इनी), f. a lute made of a gourd.
9240: आलभ् आ-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते, -लब्धुम्, to take hold of, touch, handle.
9241: आ-लभन, अम्, n. taking hold of, bringing (?).
9242: 1. आ-लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fit to be killed or sacrificed.
9243: 2. आ-लभ्य, ind. having received or obtained.
9244: आ-लम्भ, अस्, m. taking hold of, seizing, touching; tearing off, rooting out (of plants); the killing of the animal at a sacrifice.
9245: आ-लम्भन, अम्, n. taking hold of, touching; killing.
9246: आ-लम्भनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken hold of or handled, to be touched.
9247: आ-लम्भिन्, ई, इनी, इ, touching, taking hold of.
9248: आ-लम्भ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, obtainable, to be obtained; fit or proper to be killed.
9249: आलम्ब् आ-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, -बितुम्, to rest or lean upon; to hang from; to depend; to lay hold of, support, seize; to strike up (a tune or note).

9403: आविस् आविस्, ind. (said to be connected with वहिस् and अव; or, according to others, fr. आ-विद्: cf. Gr. ἐξ Lat. ex?), before the eyes, openly, manifestly, evidently; (very often joined to the roots अस्, भू, and कृ।)
