9405: आविष्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make apparent, reveal, uncover, show. —आविष्-करण, अम्, n. or आविष्-कार, अस्, m. making visible, mani-festation. —आविष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made visible, revealed, uncovered, evident, manifest, known.
9406: आविष्ट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. apparent, manifest.
9407: आविस्-तराम्, ind., Ved. in a more manifest way.
9408: आवी 1. आ-वी, cl. 2. P., Ved. -वेति, -तुम्, to go towards, approach, enter.
9409: 2. आ-वी, f. the pangs of child-birth. (For आवी, f. of आव्य, see आव्य next col.)
9410: आ-वीत, अस्, आ, अम्, entered, passed, gone; placed, hung; (अस्), m. the sacrificial cord worn in a parti-cular manner.
9411: आवीतिन्, ई, m. a Brāhman who wears the sacrificial cord in a particular manner, especially on the right shoulder.
9412: आवुक आवुक, अस्, m. a father (in theatrical language).
9413: आवृ आ-वृ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, वृणाति, -णीते, -वरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to choose, de-sire; to cover, hide, conceal; fill, surround; to enclose, comprehend, shut, hem in; to keep off: Caus. P. -वारयति, -यितुम्, to cover, enclose, ward off, keep off.
9414: आ-वरक, अस्, आ, अम्, what covers or conceals, a cover, a veil.
9415: आ-वरण, अस्, आ, अम्, covering, hiding, concealing; (अम्), n. covering, concealing, hiding; shutting, en-closing; an obstruction, interruption; a covering, a garment, cloth; anything that protects, an outer bar or a fence, a wall; a shield; a bolt, lock; mental blindness. —आवरण-शक्ति, इस्, f. the power of illu-sion, that which veils the real nature of things.
9416: आ-वार, enclosing, keeping off, in the words दुर्-आवार, स्कन्धावार, q. q. v. v.
9417: आ-वारि, इस्, m. a shop, a stall.
9418: आ-वार्य, ind. having enclosed, having covered; concealing; warding off.
9419: आ-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, enclosed, encompassed, sur-rounded (by a ditch, wall, &c.); covered, screened, con-cealed; invested, involved; spread, overspread, over-cast; filled with, abounding with; (अस्), m. a man of mixed origin, the son of a Brāhman by a woman of the Ugra caste.
9420: आ-वृति, इस्, f. covering, enclosing, hiding.
9421: आवृज् आ-वृज्, cl. 1. A. -वर्जते, -जितुम्, to bestow, give: Caus. P. -वर्जयति, -यितुम्, to turn over, incline, bend, pour out, to cause to yield, over-come.
9422: आ-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined, poured down, made to flow downwards.
9423: आ-वर्ज्य, ind. turning down slantwise, inclining, pouring out.
9424: आवृत् 1. आ-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -तितुम्, to turn or go towards, to turn round, turn back, revolve, return: Caus. P. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to turn; to roll; to cause to roll down, shed; to attract; A. -वर्तयते, to turn round or back.
9425: आ-वर्त, अस्, m. turning, winding, turning round, revolving; whirl, gulf, whirlpool; deliberation, revolv-ing (in the mind); a lock of hair that curls backwards, especially on a horse; the two depressions of the fore-head above the eyebrows; a crowded place where many men live close together; a kind of jewel; N. of a form of cloud personified; (आ), f., N. of a river; (अम्), n. a mineral substance, pyrites, marcasite.
9426: आ-वर्तक, अस्, m. a kind of poisonous insect; N. of a form of cloud personified; depression above the frontal ridge or over the eyebrows; whirlpool; revo-lution; revolution of the mind from the influence of the senses; a curl of hair; (ई), f., N. of a creeping plant.
9427: आ-वर्तन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. turning round or towards; revolving; (अम्), n. turning, turning round, returning; circular motion, gyration, churning, stirring anything in fusion; melting metals together, alli-gation; the time when the sun begins to cast shadows towards the east or when shadows are cast in an opposite direction; repeating, doing over again; study, practising; (ई), f. a crucible. —आवर्तन-मणि, इस्, m. a gem of secondary order, generally known as Rājāvarta.
9428: आ-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be turned round or whirled; to be reversed; to be repeated.
9429: आ-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, going round, revolving; advancing, proceeding.
9430: आ-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, stirred round.
9431: आ-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, what whirls or turns upon itself; returning; (ई), m. a horse having curls of hair on various parts of his body, considered as a lucky mark; (इनी), f. a whirlpool; N. of the plant Odina Pinnata.
9432: 2. आ-वृत्, त्, f. turning towards or round, entering; (Sāy.) causing to turn towards; turn of a path or way, course, process, direction; progress of an action, occurrence, a series of actions, order, method. —आवृत्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. turned or turning towards.
9433: आ-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, stirred, whirled; reverted, averted; retreated, fled.
9434: आ-वृत्ति, इस्, f. turning towards, entering, turning back or from, reversion, retreat, flight; recurrence to the same point; repetition; turn of a way, course, direction; occurrence; revolving, going round; worldly existence, the revolution of births; use, employment, application. —आवृत्ति-दीपक, अम्, n. (in rhetoric) laying stress upon a word by repeating it.
9435: आ-वृत्य, ind. having turned, turning towards.
9436: आवृध् आ-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -धितुम्, to increase.
9437: आवृष् आ-वृष्, cl. 1. P. A., Ved. -वर्षति, -ते, -षितुम्, to rain, to pour out (a libation).
9439: आवेग आ-वेग, अस्, m. (rt. विज्), hurry, haste produced by excitement; flurry, agitation; (ई), f. the plant Convolvolus Argenteus.
9440: आवेणिक आवेणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-वेणि), not connected with anything else; independant.
9443: आवेष्ट आ-वेष्ट, अस्, m. (rt. वेष्ट्), sur-rounding, covering with.
9444: आ-वेष्टक, अस्, m. a wall, a fence, an enclosure.
9445: आ-वेष्टन, अम्, n. wrapping round, binding, ty-ing; a wrapper, an envelope, a bandage; an en-closure.
9446: आ-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enveloped, in-closed, bound or tied.
9447: आव्य आव्य, अस्, f. आवी, अम्, Ved. belonging to sheep; woollen.
9448: आव्यध् आ-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्-धुम्, poet. -वेद्धुम्, to shoot at, to throw; to hit, pierce, wound; to pin on.
9449: आ-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, cast, thrown, sent; pierced, wounded; disappointed; crooked; false, fallacious; stupid, foolish. —आविद्ध-कर्णी or आविद्ध-कर्-णिका, f., N. of a plant.
9450: आ-विध, अस्, m. an awl, a drill, a kind of gimlet worked by a string.
9451: आ-वेध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pierced, pinned on, put on.
9452: आ-व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. wounding, attacking; (इनी), f. a band of robbers.
9453: आव्युषम् आ-व्युषम् Ved., ind. till the dawn.
9454: आव्रज् आ-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. A. -व्रजति, -ते, -जितुम्, to walk towards or up to; to return.
9455: आव्रश्च् आ-व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P., Ved. -वृश्चति, -व्रश्चितुम् or -व्रष्टुम्, to tear off, cut off, tear in pieces, interrupt.
9456: आ-व्रश्चन, अम्, n., Ved. the stump of a tree.
9457: आ-व्रस्क, अस्, m., Ved. the being torn off or tear-ing itself off.
9458: आश् 1. आश् (आ-अश्), cl. 5. P. A. (Class. only A.) आश्नोति, -नुते, आशितुम्, to reach to; to obtain, gain; to addict one's self to.
9459: आश् 2. आश् (आ-अश्), cl. 9. P. आश्नाति, आशितुम्, to eat: Caus. आशयति, -यितुम्, to give to eat.
9460: आश आश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. अश्), an eater, eating; often in this sense at the end of compounds; (अस्), m. eating.
9462: आशयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, feeding, a feeder, one who gives food; protecting, a protector.
9463: 1. आशि, इस्, f. the act of eating food.
9464: आशित, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten; given to eat; voracious. —आशितङ्-गवीन, अस्, आ, अम्, formerly grazed by cattle. —आशितम्-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, satiating; (अम्), n. food, victuals; (अस् or अम्), m. n. satisfaction, satiety.
9465: आशितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, voracious, gluttonous, eating excessively.
9467: 1. आशिर, अस्, आ, अम्, voracious; (अस्), m. fire; a Rakṣas. (For 2. आशिर see under आशिर्।)
9468: आशंस् आ-शंस्, cl. 1. P. -शंसति, -सितुम्, to tell; A. or ep. P. -शंसते, to hope for, desire, be-lieve: Caus. P. Ved. -शंसयति, -यितुम्, to render famous or celebrated.
9469: आ-शंसन, अम्, n. expecting, wishing; declaring, asserting.
9470: आ-शंसा, f. wish, desire, hope; speech, declaration.
9471: आ-शंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, hoped, expected; declared, said.
9472: आ-शंसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, wishing, desiring; as-serting.
9473: आ-शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, declaring, announcing.
9474: आ-शंसु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing, hoping, desiring.
9475: आ-शस्, अस्, f., Ved. wish, desire, hope; (Say.) praise.
9476: 1. आ-शा, f. wish, desire, hope, expectation, pros-pect; hope personified as the wife of a Vasu: (for 2. आशा see next page.) —आशा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, lit. ‘made expectation,’ attended with the expectation (of being gratified) or hope of success. —आशान्वित (°शा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having hope. —आशा-पिशाचिका, f. fallacious hopes. —आशा-प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, success-ful, possessing the object hoped for. —आशा-बन्ध, अस्, m. band of hope, confidence, trust, expectation; a spider's web. —आशा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. disappointment. —आशा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, hoping, having hope, trust-ing. —आशा-वह, अस्, m. bringing hope; N. of a son of heaven; of a Vṛṣṇi. —आशा-विभिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, disappointed in expectation. —आशा-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost all hope, desponding, despairing.
9477: आशक् आ-शक्, cl. 5. P., Ved. -शक्नोति, -शक्-तुम्, to render one capable, to make one master or possessor of: Desid. Ved. -शिक्षति, to render one master of, impart.
9478: आ-शक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, able, powerful, capable.
9479: आ-शक्ति, इस्, f. power, ability, might.
9480: आ-शिक्षा, f., Ved. desire of learning.
9481: आशङ्क् आ-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते, -कितुम्, to fear, suspect, doubt, hesitate.
9482: आ-शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted; to be apprehended; questionable.
9483: आ-शङ्कमान, अस्, आ, अम्, fearing, apprehending.
9484: आ-शङ्का, f. fear, apprehension; doubt, uncertainty; distrust, suspicion. —आशङ्कान्वित (°का-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, apprehensive, doubting, uncertain; afraid.
9485: आ-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, feared, dreaded; doubted.
9486: आ-शङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, fearing, doubting, hesitating.
9487: आ-शङ्क्य, ind. having suspected, fearing, appre-hending, doubting.
9488: आशद् आ-शद्, cl. 6. A. -शीयते, -शत्तुम्, to go.
9489: आशन आशन, अस्, m., N. of the tree Pentaptera Tomentosa. See 3. अशन।
9491: आशयाश आशयाश। See under आ-शय below.
9492: आशर आ-शर, अस्, m. (rt. शॄ), fire; a Rakṣas, a goblin; the wind ? [cf. 1. आशिर].
9493: आ-शरीक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a disease, violent and acute pain in the limbs.
9494: आशल आशल, अस्, m. a tree. See जीवक।
9495: आशव आशव, अम्, n. (fr. आशु), speed, quick-ness; (for आ-सव, q. v.) a spirit distilled from molasses.
9496: आशसन आ-शसन, अम्, n. (rt. शस्), Ved. cutting up an animal when killed.
9497: आशा 2. आशा, f. (fr. rt. 1. अश्; for 1. आ-शा see last page under आ-शंस्), space, region, quarter of the compass, an intermediate region. —आशा-गज, अस्, m. an elephant of a quarter or point of the compass, sup-porting one division of the globe. —आशा-दामन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —आशादित्य (°शा-आद्°) or आशार्क (°शा-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —आशा-पाल, अस्, m., Ved. a defender or guardian of the regions or quarters. —आशा-पुर, आम्, n., N. of a town. —आशा-पुर-गुग्गुलु, उस्, or आशापुर-सम्भव, अस्, m. a kind of Bdellium.
9498: आशाढ आशाढ for आषाढ, q. v.
9499: आशार आ-शार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with आ), shelter. —आशारैषिन् (°र-एष्°), ई, इणी, इ, Ved. seek-ing shelter.
9500: आशास् आ-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, to order, command, relate; A. -शास्ते, to wish well towards, pray for; to praise; to desire.
9501: आ-शास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished, desirable; (अम्), n. wish, benediction.
9502: 1. आ-शिस्, ईस्, f. asking for, prayer, wish; blessing, benediction; bestowing or praying for a blessing upon others; one of the eight chief medicaments. —आशिर्-वाद or आशीर्-वाद, अस्, m. expression of a prayer or wish, benediction. —आशीर्-गेय, अम्, n. a song ac-companied with benedictions. —आशीर्-दा, f., Ved. the offering of a prayer. —आशीर्-वचन, अम्, n. a bless-ing, a benediction.
9503: 1. आ-शी, f. wishing or bestowing a blessing.
9504: आशि 2. आ-शि, cl. 3. P., Ved. -शिशेति, -शेतुम्, to incite. (For 1. आशि see under आश last page.)
9506: आशिञ्जित आ-शिञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, tinkling (as of the ornaments worn on the hands and feet).
9507: आशित, आशिन्, आशिर। See under आश last page.
9508: आशिन आशिन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. अश्), Ved. aged; (reaching to many years.)
9509: आशिमन् आशिमन्। See under आशु next col.
9510: आशिर् आशिर्, ईस्, f. (fr. rt. शॄ for श्री with आ), Ved. the milk which is mixed with the Soma juice to purify it (e. g. दध्याशिरः सोमासः = Soma offer-ings purified by mixture with thickened milk). —आशीर्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. mixed with milk (as Soma).
9511: 2. आशिर, a form sometimes used for आशिर्। See also under आश।
9512: आशिरःपादम् आ-शिरः-पादम्, ind. from head to foot.
9513: आशिस् 2. आशिस्, ईस्, f. (fr. rt. 1. अश्), a ser-pent's fang: (for 1. आ-शिस् see above.) —आशिर्-विष, अस्, m. a snake (having venom in its fang).
9514: 2. आशी, f. a serpent's fang; a kind of venom, the venom of a snake. —आशी-विष, see आशिर्-विष।
9515: आशी 3. आ-शी, cl. 2. A. -शेते, -शयितुम्, to lie or sleep on, pass (the night) in sleep; to inhabit, have for one's home.
9516: आ-शय, अस्, m. bed-chamber, resting-place, seat, place, an asylum, an abode or retreat; a receptacle; any recipient, any vessel or viscus of the body (e. g. रक्ताशय, the heart; आमाशय, the stomach, &c.); the stomach in particular; the seat of feelings and thoughts, the mind, heart; the thought lying in the mind, meaning, intention; disposition of mind, mode of thinking; will or pleasure; virtue, vice; fate, for-tune; property, possessions; a miser, a niggard; N. of the plant Artocarpus Integrifolia. —आशयाश (°य-आश), अस्, m. fire; [cf. आश्रयाश under 1. आ-श्रि।]
9517: आशु आशु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. 1. अश्), fast, quick, going quickly; (उ), ind. quickly, quick, immediately, directly; (उस्), m., Ved. the quick one, a horse; (उस् or उ), m. n. rice ripening quickly in the rainy season; [cf. Gr. ὠκύς, ὤκιστος Lat. acu in acupedeus, ôcissimus: of the same origin may be the Lat. aquila and accipiter.] —आशु-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing anything quickly, smart, active; (in medic.) operating speedily. —आशु-कोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, easily pro-voked, irritable. —आशु-क्रिया, f. quick procedure. —आशु-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going or moving quickly, swift, fleet; (अस्), m. the wind; the sun; an arrow; N. of one of the first five followers of Śākya-muni. —आशु-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going or moving quickly; (ई), m. an epithet of the sun. —आशुङ्-ग, अस्, m., Ved. N. of an animal, perhaps a bird; going to the horse (?). —आशु-तोष, अस्, आ, अम्, easily pleased or appeased; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva. —आशु-त्व, अम्, n. quickness. —आशु-पत्त्री, f. a tree which yields frankincense, Boswellia Serrata. —आशु-पत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. flying quickly. —आशु-फल, अस्, m. a kind of weapon. —आशु-बोध, ‘easily understood,’ ‘teaching quickly,’ title of a grammar. —आशु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. quick; (अत्), ind. quickly. —१। आशु-या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) going quickly. —आशु-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pos-sessing a fast chariot. —आशु-व्रीहि, इस्, m. rice ripen-ing quickly in the rainy season. —आशु-षेण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having swift arrows. —आशु-हेमन्, आ, m., Ved. urged to fast course, running on quickly; inciting his horses (as an epithet of Agni, especially when regarded as Apāṃ-napāt). —आशु-हेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having neighing horses; (Sāy.) having quick horses or quickly praised; epithet of the Aśvins. —आश्व्-अपस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. acting quickly. —आश्व्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. possessed of quick horses; an epithet of the Maruts. —आश्वश्व्य, अम्, n., Ved. possession of quick horses.

(fr. rt. श्रम् with आ), a hermitage, the abode of ascetics, the cell of a hermit or of retired saints or sages; a period in the religious life of a Brāhman, of which there are four referable to the different periods of life (viz. 1st, that of the Brahma-cārin or student; 2nd, that of the Gṛha-stha or householder; 3rd, that of the Vāna-prastha or anchorite; and 4th, that of the Bhikṣu or beggar: in some places the law-givers mention only three such periods of religious life, the first period being then omitted); a college, a school; a wood or thicket. —आश्रम-गुरु, उस्, m. the head of a re-ligious order, a preceptor, a principal. —आश्रम-धर्म, अस्, m. the special duty or duties of each order or period of life. —आश्रम-पद, अम्, n. a hermitage; a period in the religious life of a Brāhman. —आश्रम-पर्वन्, अ, n. the first section of the fif-teenth book of the Mahā-bhārata. —आश्रम-भ्र-ष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen or apostatising from an आश्रम or religious order. —आश्रम-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circle of a hermitage, a hermitage. —आश्रमवासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to residence in a hermitage; आश्रमवासिकम् पर्व, title of the fifteenth book of the Mahā-bhārata. —आश्रम-वासिन्, ई, or आश्रम-सद्, त्, m. an inhabitant of a hermitage, an ascetic. —आश्रम-स्थान, अम्, n. the abode of hermits, a hermitage. —आश्रमालय (°म-आल्°), अस्, m. an in-habitant of a hermitage, an ascetic. —आश्रमोपनि-षद् (°म-उप्°), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.

9538: आश्रि 1. आ-श्रि, cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to resort to, betake one's self to; seek refuge in, enter, inhabit; depend on, choose, prefer; to assist, adhere to, be subject to, keep in mind.
9539: आ-श्रय, अस्, m. that to which anything is annexed, or with which anything is closely connected, or on which anything depends or rests; a recipient, the per-son or thing in which any quality or article is inherent or retained or received; seat, resting-place; dwelling, asylum, place of refuge, shelter; depending on, having recourse to; help, assistance, protection; authority, sanction, warrant; a plea, an excuse; being inclined or addicted to, following, practising; attaching to, choosing, taking; joining, union, attachment; de-pendance, contiguity, vicinity; relation; connection; appropriate act or one consistent with the character of the agent; (in gram.) the subject, that to which the predicate is annexed; (with Buddhists) the five organs of sense with मनस् or mind (the six together being the recipients of the आश्रित or objects which enter them by way of their आलम्बन or qualities); source, origin. आश्रय may occur at the end of compounds in the sense of ‘depending on, resting on, endowed or furnished with’ (e. g. अष्ट-गुणाश्रय, see under अष्ट). —आश्रय-तस्, ind. in consequence of the proximity. —आश्रय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of आ-श्रय above. —आश्रय-भुज्, क्, m. fire; see आश्रयाश। —आश्रय-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who is the refuge or support of another person, protecting, supporting. —आश्रय-लिङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, a word the gender of which must agree with the gender of the word to which it is referred, an adjective. —आश्रय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having help or support. —आश्रयाश (°य-आश), अस्, आ, अम्, consuming everything with which (it) comes in contact; (अस्), m. fire; a forfeiter of an asylum, one who by misconduct &c. loses patronage or protection.
9540: आ-श्रयण, अस्, ई, अम्, resorting to, seeking refuge in; relating to; (अम्), n. betaking one's self to; joining, accepting, choosing; refuge, asylum, means of protection or security.
9541: आ-श्रयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be had recourse to, to be practised or followed.
9542: आ-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, inhabiting, dwelling in, resort-ing to as a retreat or asylum; having recourse to; following, practising, observing; using, employing; receiving anything as an inherent or integral part; taking one's station at a window or seat &c.; depend-ant on, a dependant; (आनि), n. pl. the objects perceived by the senses and मनस् or mind. —आश्रित-त्व, अम्, n. dependance.

9584: आ-श्वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, encouraged, animated, com-forted, consoled.
9585: आ-श्वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, breathing freely, reviving, be-coming cheerful; consoling.
9586: आ-श्वास्य, ind. having consoled, having cherished; having recovered or revived.
9587: आषाढ आषाढ, अस्, m. (fr. अ-षाढा), N. of a month, corresponding to part of June and July, in which the full moon is near the constellation Aṣāḍhā; a staff of the wood of the Palāśa, carried by an ascetic during certain vows in the month Āṣāḍha; N. of a prince; the Malaya mountain; (आ), f. the twenty-first and twenty-second lunar mansions, commonly compounded with पूर्व and उत्तर; (ई), f. the day of full moon in the month Āṣāḍha. —आषाढ-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the month Āṣāḍha; (अस्), m. the planet Mars. —आषाढ-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a man. —आषाढा-भू, ऊस्, m. produced in the month Āṣāḍha; the planet Mars.

9590: आषाढीय, अस्, आ, अम्, born under the constella-tion Aṣāḍhā.
9591: आष्टक आष्टक, N. of a region.
9592: आष्टम आष्टम, अस्, m. (fr. अष्टम), the eighth part.
9593: आष्ट्र आष्ट्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. अश्), ether, sky, atmosphere.

9595: आष्ठा आष्ठा, f. [cf. 2. आशा], region, quarter.

9598: 3. आस् (fr. 2. आस् above ? or fr. rt. 2. अस्; cf. Lat. os), mouth, face; only used in two forms, as follows: आसस्, abl., Ved. from mouth to mouth, in close proximity; आसा, inst., Ved. before one's eyes; by word of mouth, personally; present; in one's own person; immedi-ately. —आस्-पात्र, अम्, n., Ved. a vessel which is as it were the mouth of the gods.
9599: आस् 4. आस्, cl. 2. A. आस्ते (Ved. and poet. also cl. 1. A. आसते), आसाञ्-चक्रे, आसिष्यते, -आसिष्ट, -सितुम्, to sit, sit down, rest, lie; to be present, to exist, to inhabit, dwell in; to make one's abode in; to sit quietly, abide, remain, continue; to cease, have an end; to solemnize, celebrate; to do anything without interruption, to continue doing any-thing, to continue in any situation, to last. It is used in the sense of ‘continuing,’ with a participle, adj., or subst. (e. g. एतत् साम गायन्न् आस्ते, ‘he continues singing this verse’); with an indeclinable participle in त्वा, य, or अम् (e. g. उपरुध्य अरिम् आसीत, ‘he should continue blockading the foe’); with an adverb (e. g. तूष्णीम् आस्ते, ‘he continues quiet;’ सुखम् आस्व, ‘continue well’); with an inst. case (e. g. सुखेन आस्ते, ‘he continues well’); with a dat. case (e. g. आस्तां तुष्टये, ‘may it be to your satisfac-tion’): Caus. आसयति, -यितुम्, to cause any one to sit down: Desid. आसिसिषते; [cf. Gr. ἧ(σ)-μαι, ἧσ-ται Lat. âsa changed to âra; â-nus for âs-nus.]
9600: 1. आस, seat (e. g. in the compound स्वास-स्थ, ‘staying in one's own seat’); (अम्), n. the seat or lower part of the body; proximity.

9848: इङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, movable, locomotive; surprising, wonderful; (अस्), m. a hint or sign, an indication of sentiment by gesture, knowledge; (आ), f. a kind of counting.

9851: इङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, movable from its place; in the Prātiśākhyas a term for those words or rather parts of a compound word which in certain grammatical operations may be separated from the preceding parts, a word which in the Pada-pātḥa is divided by the अव-ग्रह or mark of tmesis.

9866: इड् इड्, Ved. (only in inst., gen., abl. sing., and acc. pl. इडा and इडस्; or, according to the spell-ing of the Ṛg-veda, इऌआ and इऌअस्), a refreshing draught, refreshment, libation offered to the gods; the flow of speech, the stream of sacred words and worship, prayer; (Sāy.) the earth, food; (इडस् or इऌअस्), pl. the object of devotion, addressed in the third or fourth verses of the Āprī hymns, (so used only in Ṛg-veda 3, 4. 3; but also erroneously referred to in the Brāhmaṇas &c. as if etymologically connected with the words ईड्य, ईडित, ईऌइत, ‘the praiseworthy,’ ‘the praised,’ which are used in the third or fourth verses of the other Āprīs as the designation of the same object of worship.) —इडस्-पति, इस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu. —इड्-देवता, f. deity of the libation. —इऌअस्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. a N. of Pūṣan. —इऌअस्-पदे, in the place of sacred libation, i. e. at the altar or place of offering.
9867: इड, अस्, m., Ved. This word occurs only in one sacred formula as an epithet of Agni, who is to be addressed with prayers, or invoked with the stream or flow of praise.
9868: इडा, f. or (in Ṛg-veda) इऌआ, (not to be confounded with the inst. case of इड् above), refreshing draught, refreshment, animation, recreation, comfort, vital spirit; food; offering, libation, especially a holy liba-tion, coming between the Prayāga and Anuyāga, and consisting of four preparations of milk, poured into a vessel containing water, and then partially drank by the priest and sacrificers; (metaphorically cf. इड्) stream or flow of praise and worship, personified as the goddess of sacred speech and action, invoked toge-ther with Aditi and other deities, but especially in the Āprī hymns together with Sarasvatī and Mahī or Bhāratī; (Sāy.) the earth, food; (इडा, as the libation and offering of milk is personified in the cow, the symbol of feeding and giving, whence the word इडा is given as a synonym of ‘cow.’ The goddess इडा or इला is the daughter of Manu or of man thinking on and worshipping the gods; she is the wife of Budha and mother of Purū-ravas; in another aspect she is called Maitrāvaruṇi as daughter of Mitra-Varuṇa, two gods who were objects of the highest and most spiritual devotion. इला is also a N. of Durgā, of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Kaśyapa, of a wife of Vasudeva and of the Rudra, Rita-dhvaja); heaven; a tubular vessel, one of the principal channels of the vital spirit, that which is on the right side of the body. इऌआयास्-पदे, at the place of Iḍā, i. e. of worship and libation, earth. —इडा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. refreshing, granting fresh vital spirits; possessed of refreshment, refreshed; (Sāy.) possessed of sacri-ficial food.

9873: इण्डीन्थ इण्डीन्थ, अस्, m. a knife (?).

9875: इण्वीन्दु इण्वीन्दु, उस्, m. the tree Trochis Aspera (?).
9876: इण्वेरिका इण्वेरिका, f. a kind of cake.
9877: इतर इ-तर, अस्, आ, अत्, Ved. अम् (comparative form of pronom. base 3. इ; cf. Lat. iterum; Hib. iter), the other (of two), another; (pl.) the rest; (with abl.) different from; low, vile; expelled, rejected; इतर इतर, the one — the other, this — that. (इतर connected antithetically with a preceding word often signifies the contrary idea, e. g. विजयाय इतराय वा, to victory or defeat; so in Dvandva compounds, सुखेतरेषु, in happiness and distress. It some-times, however, forms a Tat-puruṣa compound with another word to express the one idea implied in the contrary of that word, e. g. दक्षिणेतर, the left hand.) —इतर-जन, आस्, m. pl. other men; a euphe-mistic title of certain beings who appear to be consi-dered as spirits of darkness; Kuvera belongs to them. —इतर-तस्, ind. otherwise than, different from; इतश्चेतरतश्च, hither and thither. —इतर-था, ind. in another manner, in a contrary manner; per-versely; on the other hand, else.

9880: इतरे-द्युस्, ind. at another or different day.
9881: इ-तम, अस्, आ, अत् (superlative form of 3. इ), another (of many ?).
9882: इतस् इ-तस्, ind. (fr. 3. इ with affix तस्, used like the abl. case of the pronoun इदम्), from hence, hence, here (opposed to अमु-तस् and अमु-त्र); from this point; from this world, in this world; इतस् इतस्, here — there; इतश्चेतश्च, hence and thence, hither and thither, here and there, to and fro; from this time, now; therefore. —इत-ऊति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. extending or reaching from hence; existing or lasting longer than the present time, future; (Sāy.) one who has obtained help. —इतस्-ततस्, ind. here and there, hither and thither.
9883: इति 2. इति, ind. (fr. pronominal base 3. इ), in this manner, thus. In its original signification इति refers to something that has been said or thought, or lays stress on what precedes. In the Brāhmaṇas it is often equivalent to ‘as you know,’ reminding the hearer or reader of certain customs, conditions, &c., supposed to be known to him. In quotations of every kind इति means that the pre-ceding words are the very words which some person has or might have spoken, and placed thus at the end of a speech it serves the purpose of inverted commas (e. g. इत्य् उक्त्वा, having so said; इति कृत्वा, having so considered, having so decided). It may often have reference merely to what is passing in the mind, e. g. बालोऽपि नावमन्तव्यो मनुष्य इति भूमिपः, a king, though a child, is not to be despised, saying to one's self, ‘he is a mortal,’ (Gram. 928.) In theatrical language इति तथा करोति = after these words he acts so. Sometimes इति is used to include under one head a number of separate objects aggregated together (e. g. इज्याध्ययनदानानि तपः सत्यं क्षमा दमः अलोभ इति मार्गोऽयम्, ‘sacrificing, study-ing, liberality, penance, truth, patience, self-restraint, absence of desire,’ this course of conduct, &c.).
9884: इति is sometimes followed by एवम्, इव, or a demonstrative pronoun pleonastically (e. g. ताम् ब्रूयाद् भवतीत्य् एवम्, her he may call ‘lady,’ thus).
9885: इति may form an adverbial compound with the name of an author (e. g. इतिपाणिनि, thus according to Pāṇini). It may also express manifestation (lo! behold!), some-thing additional (as in इत्य्-आदि, et cetera), order, ar-rangement specific or distinctive, and identity. It is used by native commentators after quoting a rule to express ‘according to such a rule’ (e. g. अनुदात्त-ङित इत्य् आत्मनेपदम् भवति, according to the rule of Pāṇini 1. 3, 12, the Ātmane-pada takes place). किम् इति = किम्, wherefore, why ? (In the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa ति occurs for इति; cf. Prākṛt ति and त्ति।) —इति-कथ, अस्, आ, अम्, unworthy of trust, not fit to be credited; wicked, lost; (आ), f. unmeaning or nonsensical discourse; (? for अति-कथ, q. v.) —इति-करण, अम्, n. or इति-कार, अस्, m. the word इति। —इति-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, proper or necessary to be done according to certain conditions; (अम्), n. duty, obligation. —इतिकर्तव्य-ता, f. or इतिकार्य-ता or इति-कृत्य-ता, f. any proper or necessary measure, obliga-tion. —इतिकर्तव्यता-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, embar-rassed, dumbfounded, wholly at a loss what to do. —इति-थ, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. such a one, such, e. g. पुरेति-थ्यै (? रात्र्यै dat. sing.) मरिष्यसि, before such and such a day thou wilt die. —इति-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, of such extent or quality. —इति-वत्, ind. in the same manner. —इति-वृत्त, अम्, n. occurrence, event. —इत्य्-अर्थम्, ind. for this purpose. —इत्य्-आदि, इस्, इस्, इ, having such (thing or things) at the begin-ning, thus beginning, and so forth, et cetera. —इत्य्-उक्त, अम्, n. information, report, narrative.
9886: इति-ह, ind. thus indeed, (according to tradition.)
9887: इति-हास, अस्, m. (इति-ह-आस, ‘so indeed it was’), talk, legend, tradition, history, traditional accounts of former events, heroic history, as the Mahā-bhārata.
9888: इतिहास इति-हास। See under 2. इति above.
9889: इतीक इतीक, अस्, m., N. of a people.
9890: इत्कट इत्कट, अस्, m. a kind of reed or grass. See इक्कट।
9891: इत्किला इत्किला, f., N. of a perfume. See रोचना।
9892: इत्थ इत्थ, अम्, n. in astronomy = ἰχθύς
9893: इत्थम् इत्थम्, ind. (fr. इद्, q. v.), thus, in this manner; [cf. Lat. item.] —इत्थं-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of such a kind, endowed with such qualities. —इत्थङ्-कारम्, ind. in this manner. —इत्थम्-भाव, अस्, m. the being thus endowed. —इत्थम्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become thus, being thus or in such manner; so circumstanced.

9895: इत्था इत्था, ind., Ved. thus; (often used in the Ṛg-veda, and sometimes only to lay stress on a following word; therefore by native etymologists considered as a particle of affirmation.) इत्था is often connected with words expressing devotion to the gods &c. in the sense of thus, truly, really; especially with धी as an adjective. Hence इत्था-धी = such, i. e. true (सत्या) or real worship. Simi-larly, इत्था-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, so devout, so pious, i. e. very devout; (Sāy.) performing such or true works.
9896: इत्थात् इत्थात्, ind. (= इत्थम्), Ved. thus, in this way.
9897: इद् इद्, ind., Ved. (probably the neut. form of the pronom. base इ, see 3. इ; a particle of affirma-tion), even, just, only; (especially in strengthening an antithesis, e. g. यथा वशन्ति देवास् तथा इद् असत्, as the gods wish it, thus indeed it will be; दिप्-सन्त इद् रिपवो नाह देभुः, the enemies wishing indeed to hurt were in nowise able to hurt.)
9898: इद् is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion (e. g. विश्व इत्, everyone indeed; शश्वद् इत्, constantly indeed; एक इत्, one only). At the be-ginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pro-nouns, prepositions, particles (e. g. त्वम् इत्, thou indeed; यदि इत्, if indeed, &c.).
9899: इद् occurs often in the Ṛg-veda, seldom in the Brāhmaṇas, and its place is taken in classical Sanskrit by एव and other particles.
9900: इदम् इदम्, अयम्, इयम्, इदम् (fr. इद्, a kind of neut. of the pronom. base 3. इ with अम्; cf. Lat. is, ea, id, and idem; the regular forms are partly de-rived from the pronom. base अ; see Gram. 224. The Veda exhibits various irregular formations, e. g. fr. pronom. base अ, an inst. एना, अया, and gen. loc. du. अयोस्; fr. the base इम, a gen. sing. इमस्य, &c.; the forms derived fr. अ are used enclitically if they take the place of the third personal pronoun, do not stand at the beginning of a verse or period, and have no peculiar stress laid upon them), this, this here, referring to something near the speaker; known, pre-sent; (opposed to अदस्, e. g. अयं लोकः or इदं विश्वम् or इदं सर्वम्, this earthly world, this universe; अयम् अग्निः, this fire which burns on the earth; but असाव् अग्निः, that fire in the sky, i. e. the lightning: so also इदम् or इयम् alone signifies ‘this earth;’ इमे स्मः, here we are.)
9901: इदम् often refers to something immediately fol-lowing, whereas एतद् points to what precedes (e. g. श्रुत्वा एतद् इदम् ऊचुः, having heard that they said this).
9902: इदम् occurs connected with यद्, तद्, एतद्, किम्, and a personal pronoun, partly to point out anything more distinctly and emphatically, partly pleonastically (e. g. तद् इदम् वाक्यम्, this speech here following; सोऽयं विदूषकः, this Vidūṣaka here).

9904: इदंयु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing this.
9905: इदा इ-दा, ind. (fr. pronom. base 3. इ), Ved. now, at this moment; (often connected with a gen. of अहन्, e. g. इदा अह्नः or अह्न इदा, this present day, ‘now-a-days;’ and with ह्यस्, e. g. इदा ह्यः, only yesterday.) —इदा-वत्सर, अस्, m. originally perhaps ‘the present or current year;’ then one of the names given to the single years of a period of five years; one of the five years in which gifts of clothes and food are productive of great rewards. —इदा-वत्सरीय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to such a year. —इदु-वत्सर and इद्-वत्सर = इदा-वत्सर above. —इद्-वत्सरीय = इदावत्सरीय above.
9906: इ-दानीम्, ind. now, at this moment, in this case, just, even; (with gen. of अहन्, e. g. इदानीम् अह्नः, this present day, ‘now-a-days;’ इदानीम् एव, just now; immediately; इदानीम् अपि, in this case too; तत इदानीम्, thereupon, then.) In rare cases it is an expletive, affecting but slightly the sense. इदानीम् as a measure of time is the fifteenth part of an एतर्हि, and is then declinable (e. g. यावन्त्य् एतर्हीणि ताव-न्ति पञ्चदशकृत्व इदानीनि, as many Etarhis, so many Idānīms fifteen times repeated). —इदानीन्-तन, अस्, ई, अम्, present, momentary, of the present moment.

9914: इन्द् इन्द्, cl. 1. P. इन्दति, ऐन्दत्, इन्दाम्-बभूव, इन्दितुम्, to be powerful; (this root seems to be formed merely for the etymology of the word इन्द्र, q. v.)

9916: इन्दिन्दिर इन्दिन्दिर, अस्, m. a large bee.

9920: इन्दु इन्दु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. उन्द्; per-haps connected with विन्दु, which last is unknown in the Ṛg-veda), Ved. a drop, especially of Soma, Soma; a bright drop, a spark; the moon; (अवस्), m. pl. the moons, i. e. the periodic changes of the moon; time of moonlight, night; (उस्), m. camphor. (In the Brāhmaṇas इन्दु is used only for the moon; but the connection between the senses ‘Soma juice’ and ‘moon’ in the word इन्दु has led to the same two ideas being transferred in classical Sanskrit to the word सोम, although the latter has properly only the sense ‘Soma juice.’) —इन्दु-कमल, अम्, n. the white lotus. —इन्दु-कला, f. a digit of the moon; N. of several plants, Cocculus Cordifolius, Sarcostema Viminale, Ligusticum Ajowan. —इन्दु-कलिका, f. the plant Pandanus Odoratissimus. —इन्दु-कान्त, अस्, m. the lunar gem, the moon-stone; (आ), f. night. —इन्दु-ज, अस्, m. epithet of the planet mercury, ‘son of the moon;’ (आ), f., N. of the river Revā or Narmadā in the Dekhan. —इन्दु-जनक, अस्, m. the ocean, lit. ‘father of the moon,’ (the moon being produced amongst other things at the churning of the ocean.) —इन्दु-दल, अस्, m. a portion of the moon, a digit, crescent. —इन्दु-पुत्र, अस्, m. epithet of the planet Mercury. —इन्दु-पुष्पिका, f. the plant Methonica Superba. —इन्दु-भृत्, त्, m. epithet of Śiva. ‘bearing the crescent on his forehead.’ —इन्दु-मणि, इस्, m. the moon-stone. —इन्दु-मण्डल, अम्, n. the orb or disc of the moon. —इन्दु-मत्, आन्, m., Ved. (in liturgical language) an epithet of Agni, because in the verses in which he is addressed the word इन्दु occurs; (ती), f. day of full moon; N. of the sister of Bhoja and wife of Aja; N. of a river. —इन्दु-मौलि, इस्, m. epithet of Śiva; see इन्दु-भृत्. —इन्दु-रत्न, अम्, n. a pearl. —इन्दु-राज्, ट्, m. the moon, king of the stars. —इन्दु-रेखा, f. a digit of the moon. —इन्दु-लेखा, f. a digit of the moon; the plant Menispermum Glabrum; the moon-plant Asclepias Acida; a kind of lovage, Ligusticum Ajwæn. —इन्दु-लोहक, अम्, n. silver. —इन्दु-वदना, f. a metre of four verses of which each contains fourteen syllables. —इन्दु-वल्ली, f. the plant Sarcostemma Viminale. —इन्दुवार in astrology = the Arabic إِدْبار —इन्दु-व्रत, अम्, n. a reli-gious observance depending on the age of the moon; diminishing the quantity of food by a certain portion daily, for a fortnight or a month, &c. —इन्दु-शेखर, अस्, m. ‘moon-crested,’ an epithet of Śiva.

9923: इन्द्र इन्द्र, अस्, m. (fr. rt. इन् or इन्द् or ob-solete rt. इद् ?), the god who in Vedic mythology reigns over the deities of the intermediate region or atmosphere; he fights against and conquers with his thunderbolt (वज्र) the demons of darkness, and is in general a symbol of generous heroism; (इन्द्र was not originally lord of the gods of the sky, but his deeds were most useful to mankind, and he was there-fore addressed in prayers and hymns more than any other deity, and ultimately superseded the more lofty and spiritual Varuṇa. In the later mythology इन्द्र is subordinated to the triad Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, but remained the chief of all other deities in the popular mind; he is also regent of the east quarter, and considered one of the twelve Ādityas: in the Vedānta he is identified with the supreme being); the first, the chief (of any class of objects); a prince; the pupil of the right eye (that of the left being called Indrāṇī or Indra's wife); N. of the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica, &c. (see कुटज); a vegetable poi-son; N. of the twenty-sixth Yoga or division of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic; the Yoga star in the twenty-sixth Nakṣatra, γ Pegasi; the human or animal soul, the portion of spirit residing in the body; night; one of the nine divisions of Jambu-dvīpa or the known continent; best, excellent (in compounds); (आ), f. the wife of Indra, see इन्द्राणी; N. of a plant, Marjoram (?), see फणिज्झव. —इन्द्र-ऋषभ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having Indra as a bull, or impregnated by Indra, epithet of the earth. —इन्द्र-कर्मन्, आ, m. epithet of Viṣṇu, ‘per-forming Indra's deeds.’ —इन्द्र-कील, अस्, m., N. of a mountain; a rock. —इन्द्र-कुञ्जर, अस्, m. Indra's elephant; see ऐरावत. —इन्द्र-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a mountain. —इन्द्र-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ploughed by Indra, growing in a wild state. —इन्द्र-केतु, उस्, m. Indra's banner; N. of a man. —इन्द्र-कोश or इन्द्र-कोष or इन्द्रकोषक, अस्, m. a platform, a scaffold; a projection of the roof of a house, forming a kind of balcony or terrace; a pin or bracket projecting from the wall. —इन्द्र-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain. —इन्द्र-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. guarded or protected by Indra; (अस्), m., N. of a Brāhman. —इन्द्र-गुरु, उस्, m. teacher of Indra; an epithet of Kaśyapa. —इन्द्र-गोप, अस्, or आ, आस्, m., Ved. having Indra as one's protector; (अस्), m. the insect cochineal of various kinds; in this sense also इन्द्रगोपक. —इन्द्र-घोष, अस्, m., Ved. noise of Indra personified; having the name Indra. —इन्द्र-चन्दन, अम्, n. = हरि-चन्दन. —इन्-द्र-चाप, अस्, m. 9929: इन्द्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for or belonging to or agreeable to Indra; (अस्), m. a companion of Indra; (अम्), n. power, force, the quality which belongs especially to the mighty Indra; exhibition of power, powerful act; bodily power, power of the senses; virile power; semen virile; faculty of sense, sense, organ of sense; the number five as symbolical of the five senses. (In addition to the five organs of per-ception, बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि or ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणि, i. e. eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin, the Hindūs enu-merate five organs of action, कर्मेन्द्रियाणि, i. e. larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; be-tween these ten organs and the soul or आत्मन् stands मनस् or mind, considered as an eleventh organ. In the Vedānta, मनस्, बुद्धि, अहङ्कार, and चित्त form the four inner or internal organs, अन्तर्-इन्द्रियाणि, so that according to this reckoning the organs are fourteen in number, each being presided over by its own ruler or नियन्तृ; thus, the eye by the Sun, the ear by the Quarters of the world, the nose by the two Aśvins, the tongue by Pracetas, the skin by the Wind, the voice by Fire, the hand by Indra, the foot by Viṣṇu, the anus by Mitra, the parts of generation by Prajāpati, manas by the Moon, buddhi by Brahman, ahaṅkāra by Śiva, citta by Viṣṇu as Acyuta. In the Nyāya philosophy each organ is connected with its own peculiar element, the nose with the Earth, the tongue with Water, the eye with Light or Fire, the skin with Air, the ear with Ether. The Jainas divide the whole creation into five sections, according to the number of organs attributed to each being.) —इन्द्रिय-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring or endeavouring to obtain power. —इन्द्रि-यगोचर, अस्, आ, अम्, perceptible, capable of being ascertained by the senses. —इन्द्रिय-ग्राम, अस्, m. the assemblage of the organs, the senses or organs of sense collectively. —इन्द्रिय-ज्ञान, अम्, n. the faculty of perception, sense, consciousness. —इन्द्रिय-निग्रह, अस्, m. restraint of the organs of sense. —इन्द्रिय-बुद्धि, इस्, f. perception by the senses, the exercise of any sense, the faculty of any organ. —इन्द्रिय-बोधन, अस्, आ, अम्, exciting power, arousing or sharpening the senses; (अम्), n. any excitement of sense, an object of perception, a stimulus, &c. —इन्द्रिय-वर्ग, अस्, m. the assem-blage of organs, the organs of sense collectively. —इन्द्रिय-विप्रतिपत्ति, इस्, f. perversion of the organs, erroneous or perverted perception. —इन्द्रिय-स्वाप, अस्, m. sleep of the senses, unconsciousness, insensibility; the end of the world. —इन्द्रियागोचर (°य-अ-गोच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, imperceptible. —इन्द्रि-यात्मन् (°य-आत्°), आ, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. —इन्द्रियायतन (°य-आय्°), अम्, n. the residence of the senses; the body. —इन्द्रियार्थ (°य-अर्°), अस्, m. an object of sense (as sound, smell, &c.), anything exciting the senses. —इन्द्रिया-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or इन्द्रिया-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. powerful, mighty; sometimes also इन्द्रिय-वत्. —इन्द्रिया-सङ्ग (°य-अ-स्°), अस्, m. non-attachment to sensual objects, stoicism, philosophy.

10138: उ 2. उ, ind. an interjection of assent, call-ing, compassion, anger, and command.
10139: उ 3. उ, ind. an enclitic copula, used fre-quently in the Vedas; (as a particle implying re-striction and antithesis, generally after pronominals, prepositions, particles, and before नु and सु, equiva-lent to) and, also, further; on the other hand (espe-cially in connection with a relative, e. g. य उ, he on the contrary who &c.). This particle may serve to give emphasis, like इद् and एव, especially after prepositions or demonstrative pronouns, in conjunction with नु, वै, हि, चिद्, &c. (e. g. अयम् उ वाम् पुरुतमो जोहवीमि, I this very person invoke you constantly). It is especially used in the figure of speech called Anaphora, and particularly when the pronouns are repeated (e. g. तम् उ स्तुष इन्द्रम् तम् गृणीषे, him I praise, Indra, him I sing). It may be used in drawing a conclusion, like the English ‘now’ (e. g. तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात्, that now he should not do in such a manner), and is frequently found in interrogative sentences (e. g. क उ तच् चिकेत, who, I ask, should know that ?). Pāṇini calls this particle उञ् to distinguish it from the interrogative उ। In the Pada-pāṭha it is written ऊं। In the classical language उ occurs only after अथ, न, and किम्, with a slight modification of the sense, and often only as an expletive (see किम्); उ-उ or उ-उत, on the one hand — on the other hand; partly — partly; as well — as.

10319: उत 2. उत, ind. (as a particle of doubt or deliberation) and, also, even, or. Often used for the sake of emphasis, especially at the end of a line after इति or a verb (e. g. सर्व-भूतानि तम् पार्थ सदा परिभवन्त्य् उत, all creatures, O king, certainly always despise him). (As an interrogative particle, generally at the begin-ning of the second or following part of a double in-terrogation) or, utrum-an (e. g. कथम् निर्णीयते किं स्यान् निष्कारणो बन्धुर् उत विश्वास-घा-तकः, how can it be decided whether he be a friend without a motive or a violator of confidence ?). In this sense it may be strengthened by आहो (e. g. कच्चित् त्वम् असि मानुषी उताहो सुराङ्गना, art thou a mortal woman or divine ?), or by आहो-स्वित् (e. g. शालिहोत्रः किं नु स्याद् उताहोस्विद् राजा नलः, can it be Śālihotra or king Nala ?). Rarely किम् is repeated before उत used in this sense (e. g. किं नु स्वर्गात् प्राप्ता तस्या रूपेण किमुत अन्या आगता, has she arrived from heaven or has another come in her form ?). (As a particle of wishing, especially at the beginning of a sentence followed by a potential) would that! utinam! (e. g. उत अधीयीत, would that he would read!). (उत preceded by किम्) on the contrary, how much more, how much less (e. g. समर्थो ऽसि स-हस्रम् अपि जेतुं किमुत एकम्, thou art able to conquer even a thousand, how much more one ?). (उत preceded by प्रति) on the contrary, rather (e. g. एष पृष्टो ऽस्माभिर् न जल्पति हन्ति प्रत्युत पाषाणैः, this one questioned by us does not speak, but rather throws stones at us). उत वा, or else, and (e. g. समुद्राद् उत वा पुरीषात्, from the sea or from the moisture in the air); वा-उत वा or उताहो वापि-वा, either — or; उत-उत, both — and (e. g. उत बलवान् उत अबलः, both the strong and the weak); किम्-उत वा, whether — or else.

the concluding book of the Padma-purāṇa, also of the Śiva-purāṇa. —उत्तर-खण्डन, अम्, n. cutting off a reply, refutation. —उत्तर-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. title of a supplement of the Yoni-grantha. —१। उत्तरङ्-ग, अम्, n. a wooden arch surmounting the door frame. —उत्तर-च्छद, अस्, m. a cover, what is thrown over anything. —उत्तर-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born in the latter (or last-mentioned kind of wedlock); born subsequently or afterwards, posterity. —उत्तर-ज्या, f. the versed sine of an arc, or rather the second half of the chord halved by the versed sine. —उत्तर-ज्योतिष, अम्, n., N. of a country. —उत्तर-तन्त्र, अम्, n. ‘concluding doctrine,’ N. of a supplementary section in the medical manual of Suśruta. —उत्तर-तर, अस्, आ, अम् (compar. fr. उत्तर), still further removed, still more distant, still higher. —उत्तर-तस्, ind. at the top, above, from the north, north-ward, to the left (opposed to दक्षिण-तस्); after-wards; behind. —उत्तरतः-पश्चात्, ind. north-westward (with gen.). —उत्तर-तापनीय, title of the second part of the Nṛsiṃha-tāpanīyopaniṣad. —उत्तर-त्र, ind. in what follows, after, subse-quently, later, further on, beyond, below (in a work), northward; (पूर्वत्र उत्तरत्र, in the first case or place — in the second.) —उत्तर-दायक, अस्, आ, अम्, replying, giving an answer, impertinent. —उत्तरदिक्-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated in the north, northern. —उत्तर-दिश्, क्, f. the north quarter. —उत्तर-देश, अस्, m. the country towards the north, the up-country. —उत्तर-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done subsequently. —उत्तर-पक्ष, अस्, m. the northern or left wing (side); second or following part of an argument, the reason प्रो, the reply, refutation; the answer to the first or objectionable argument, the right argument, demonstrated truth, or conclusion; the minor proposition in a syllogism. —उत्तरपक्ष-ता, f. or उत्तरपक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. conclusion, de-monstration, reply. —उत्तर-पट, अस्, m. an upper garment. —उत्तर-पथ, अस्, m. the northern way, the way leading to the north. —उत्तरपथिक, अस्, ई, अम्, inhabiting the northern country. —उत्-तर-पद, अम्, n. the last member of a com-pound word. —उत्तरपदिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or उत्तर-पदकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or studying the last word or term. —उत्तर-पर्वत, अस्, m. the northern mountain. —उत्तर-पश्चार्ध (°च-अर्°), अस्, m. the north-western half. —उत्तर-पश्चिम, अस्, आ, अम्, north-western; (आ), f. the north-west (scil. दिश्). —उत्तर-पाद, अस्, m. a division of legal practice, that part which relates to the reply or de-fence, four divisions being admitted in every suit. —उत्तर-पुरस्तात्, ind. north-eastward (with gen.). —उत्तर-पुरुष, अस्, m. = उत्तम-पुरुष (?). —उत्तर-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, north-eastward; see मीमांसा). —उत्तर-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of reply, having no answer. —उत्तर-राम-चरित or -चरित्र, अम्, n. ‘the further or later deeds of Rāma,’ title of a drama of Bhavabhūti. —उत्तर-लक्षण, अम्, n. the indication of an actual reply; (अस्, आ, अम्), marked on the left side. —उत्तर-लोमन्, आ, आ, अ, having the hairs turned upwards or outwards. —उत्तर-वयस, अम्, n. the latter or declining years of life. —उत्तर-वल्ली, f. title of the second section of the Kāṭhakopaniṣad when divided into two Adhyāyas. —उत्तर-वस्ति, इस्, f. a small syringe, a urethra injection pipe. —उत्तर-वस्त्र, अम्, n. an upper garment. —उत्तर-वादिन्, ई, m. a replicant; the northern part; the latter half; the further end. —उत्तरार्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being on the northern side. —उत्तरा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. victorious, overpowering. —उत्तराशा (°र-आशा), f. the northern quarter, the north. —उत्-तराशाधिपति (°शा-अध्°) or उत्तराशा-पति, इस्, m. the regent of the northern quarter, an epithet of Kuvera. —उत्तराश्मन् (°र-अश्°), आ, m., N. of a rocky river in the north. —उत्तराषाढा (°र-अष्°), f. the twenty-first of the lunar mansions, figured by an elephant's tooth or a bed, and containing two stars, one of which is ß in Sagittarius. —उत्तरासङ्ग (°र-आस्°), अस्, m. an upper or outer garment. —उत्-तराह (°र-अह्°), अस्, m. the following day. —उत्-तरेतरा (°र-इत्°), f. the southern quarter. —उत्-तरोत्तर (°र-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, more and more, higher and higher, further and further; always in-creasing, always following; (अम्), ind. higher and higher, more and more, in constant continuation, one on the other; (अम्), n. reply to an answer, reply on reply; conversation; a rejoinder; excess, exceed-ing quantity or degree; succession, gradation; de-scending. —उत्तरोत्तरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, constantly in-creasing; one following the other. —उत्तरोष्ठ or उत्तरौष्ठ (°र-ओष्°), अस्, m. the upper lip.

10526: उत्-थाय, ind. having risen (from a seat &c.); having risen (in rank &c.). —उत्थायोत्थाय (°य-उत्°), every time one rises (from one's bed).
10527: उत्-थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, rising, coming forth, becom-ing visible.

10533: उत्-पट, अस्, m. sap issuing from the cleft of a tree.

10546: उत्-पतितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, rising, jumping up, going upwards.
10547: उत्-पतिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, rising, jumping up.

10555: उत्-पाद, अस्, m. coming forth, birth, production. —उत्पाद-पूर्व, अम्, n. title of the first of the fourteen Pūrvas or older sacred writings of the Jainas. —उत्-पाद-शयन, see s. v. next col.
10556: उत्-पादक, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, producing, productive, effective; (अस्), m. a producer, a genera-tor; a fabulous animal, called Śarabha, with eight legs; written also उत्पातक; (इका), f. a certain insect, perhaps the white ant (termes); N. of the pot-herb Enhydra Hingtsha, also of Basilla Rubra or Lucida; (अम्), n. origin, cause.
10557: उत्-पादन, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, producing, productive; (अम्), n. producing, generating, beget-ting, causing.

10569: उत्पारण उत्-पारण, अम्, n., Ved. transport-ing over, transportation.

10574: उत्पिष् उत्-पिष् (उद्-प्°), cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, -पेष्टुम्, to rub together; to crush, grind.

10580: उत्पुटक उत्-पुटक, अस्, m. a disease of the external ear; [cf. उत्-पाट।]
10581: उत्पुलक उत्-पुलक, अस्, आ, अम्, joyful, de-lighted.
10582: उत्पू उत्-पू (उद्-पू), cl. 9. P. A. -पुनाति, -पुनीते, -पवितुम्, to cleanse, purify; to extract anything that has been purified.

10645: उत्सर्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, leaving out or off; omitting, abandoning, quitting.

10663: उत्स्वप्नाय उत्स्वप्नाय, nom. (fr. उद्-स्वप्न) A. उत्स्वप्नायते, to talk in one's sleep; to dream uneasily.
10664: उद् 1. उद्, a particle and prefix to verbs and nouns. (As implying superiority in place, rank, station, or power) up, upwards; upon, on; over, above. (As implying separation and disjunction) out, out of, from, off, away from, apart. (According to native authorities उद् may also imply publicity, pride, indisposition, weakness, helplessness, binding, loosing, existence, acquisition.)
10665: उद् is not used as a separable adverb or preposition; in those rare cases, in which it appears in the Veda uncompounded with a verb, the latter has to be sup-plied from the context (e. g. उद् उत्सम् शतधारम्, out (pour) a fountain of a hundred streams).
10666: उद् is sometimes repeated in the Veda to fill out the verse (e. g. किं न उद् उद् उ हर्षसे). [Cf. Zend उश्; Hib. uas and in composition os, ois, e. g. os-car, ‘a leap, bound,’ &c. See also उत्-तम, 1. उत्-तर, &c.]
10667: उद् 2. उद् or उन्द्, cl. 7. P. उनत्ति, उन्दाञ्-चकार, उन्दिष्यति, औन्दीत्, उन्दितुम्, to flow or issue out, to spring (said of water); to wet, bathe: Caus. उन्दयति, aor. औन्दिदत्: Desid. उन्दि-दिषति; [cf. Gr. ὕδωρ Lat. unda; Goth. vato; Lit. wandū́.]

10733: उदाजन् उद्-आ-जन्, cl. 4. A., Ved. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to arise from; to become visible above.
10734: उदातन् उद्-आ-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -नुते, -नितुम्, to erect one's self, to rise.
10735: उदादा उद्-आ-दा, cl. 3. P., Ved. -ददाति, -दा-तुम्, to lift up, elevate.
10736: उद्-आत्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for उद्-आ-दत्त), elevated, high, upraised, lofty; highly or acutely accented; great, illustrious; generous, gentle, and bountiful; giving, a donor; dear, beloved; (अस्), m. the acute accent, a high or sharp tone; a gift, donation; a kind of musical instrument, a large drum; an orna-ment or figure of speech in rhetoric; work, business; (अम्), n. an ornament or figure in rhetoric. —उदात्त-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more elevated, more acute. —उदात्-त-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having the acute accent. —उदात्त-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, similar to the high tone or accent. —उदात्त-राघव, अम्, n. title of a drama. —उदात्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pronounced with the acute accent. —उदात्त-श्रुति, इस्, इस्, इ, pronounced with the Udātta accent. —उदात्तश्रुति-ता, f. the state of being pronounced with the acute accent.
10737: उदाद्यन्त उद्-आद्य्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded and followed by an Udātta.
10738: उदान उद्-आन। See under 2. उद्-अन्, p. 153.
10739: उदानी उद्-आ-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead up (out of water); to elevate.

10743: उदायम् उद्-आ-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्-तुम्, to show, to make known.
10744: उदायस उद्-आयस, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
10745: उदायुध उद्-आयुध, अस्, आ, अम्, with uplifted weapon, upraising weapons.
10746: उदार उद्-आर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम् (fr. rt. ऋ with उद्), high, lofty, exalted, noble, illustrious, generous, liberal, gentle, munificent, great, best; upright, honest, sincere; proper, right; eloquent; unperplexed; Ved. causing to rise, exciting, driving forth; (अम्), ind. aloud; (अस्), m., Ved. a rising fog or vapour; a sort of grain with long stalks; a figure in rhetoric, attri-buting nobleness to an inanimate object; (आस्), pl. nebulous forms, spirits (?). —उदार-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, of a generous disposition, noble-minded. —उदार-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, high-minded, magnanimous. —उदा-र-ता, f. liberality, generosity. —उदार-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, highly intelligent, wise, sagacious, noble-minded. —उदार-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of great power. —उदार-सत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, generous-minded.
10747: उदारक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
10748: उदारथि उद्-आरथि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. ऋ with उद्?), Ved. steaming (as a hot dish); (Sāy.) rising, or enlightening the organs of sense; (इस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
10749: उदावत्सर उदावत्सर, अस्, m. a year, one of the five years forming a period. See इदावत्सर।
10750: उदावर्त उद्-आवर्त, अस्, m. a class of diseases, marked by the retention of the excrements; disease of the bowels, iliac passion; (आ), f. painful menstrua-tion with foamy blood.
10751: उदावर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from such diseases.
10752: उदावसु उदावसु, उस्, m., N. of a king of Videha, a son of Janaka; [cf. उपावसु।]
10753: उदावह् उद्-आ-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to extol, to praise; to draw, lead along; to marry.
10754: उदास् उद्-आस्, cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to sit separate or away from, to sit on one side or apart, not to share in, not to show interest in; to be un-concerned about, to be indifferent or passive.
10755: 2. उद्-आस, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under उद्-अस्), indifferent, unconcerned, apathetic; (अस्), m. a stoic, a philosopher; indifference, apathy, stoicism.
10756: उद्-आसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, indifferent, disregarding, stoical, one void of concern or affection.
10757: उद्-आसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, indifferent, disregarding; (ई), m. a stoic, a philosopher; one who has no passion nor affection for anything; in popular acceptation, a religious mendicant in general, or one of a particular order.
10758: उद्-आसीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting apart, indifferent, free from affection; (in law) not involved in the dispute; (अस्), m. a stranger, a neutral, a common acquaintance, a person neither a friend nor a foe. —उदासीन-ता, f. indifference, apathy.
10759: उदास्थित उद्-आस्थित, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्था with आ and उद्), a superintendent, a doorkeeper; a spy, an emissary; an ascetic who has given up his vow; (अस्, आ, अम्), set over.
10760: उदाहित उद्-आहित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धा with आ and उद्), elevated, raised.
10761: उदाहृ उद्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to relate, declare, announce; illustrate.

10763: उद्-आहार, अस्, m. an example or illustration; the beginning of a speech.
10764: उद्-आहार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be referred as a general rule to a special case.
10765: उद्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, said, illustrated, called, named, entitled.
10766: उद्-आ-हृति, इस्, f. an example, an illustration.
10767: उदि उद्-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, to go up or proceed; to rise (e. g. as a star), to come up (as a cloud); to go out of; to come out or arise from; to escape; to start up; to rise up against.
10768: उद्-अय, अस्, आ, अम्, (in gram.) following, coming after or upon (as one letter, accent &c. upon another); (अस्), m. going upwards; rising (of the sun or planets or of a cloud); the eastern mountain behind which the sun is supposed to rise; coming forth, creation, production, becoming visible, appearance, develop-ment; light, splendor; conclusion, result, conse-quence; rising, reaching one's aim, elevation; profit, advantage, income, revenue, interest; outlet, exit; N. of the seventh Arhat of the future Utsarpiṇi, = Udayā-śva; a son of Yājñika; a follower of Śākya-muni. —उदय-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a man. —उदय-जित्, त्, m., N. of a son of Guṇala. —उदय-धवल, अस्, m., N. of a prince. —उदय-पर्वत, अस्, m. or उदय-गिरि, इस्, m. or उदय-शैल, अस्, m. or उदयाचल (°य-अच्°), अस्, m. or उदयाद्रि (°य-अद्°), इस्, m. the eastern mountain behind which the sun rises. —उदय-पुर, अम्, n., N. of the capital of Marvar. —उदय-प्रस्थ, अस्, m. the plateau of the mountain behind which the sun rises. —उदय-राज, अस्, m., N. of a man. —उदय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, risen. —उदय-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a king. —उदया-दित्य (°य-आद्°), अस्, m., N. of a man. —उदयाश्व (°य-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a grandson of Ajāta-śatru.
10769: उद्-अयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going upwards, rising.
10770: उद्-अयन, अम्, n. rising, ascending (of the sun); exit, result; conclusion, end; (अस्), m. an epithet of Agastya; N. of a king of Vatsa; N. of a Purohita of king Śuddhodana. —उदयन or उदयनाचार्य, अस्, m. a philosopher and violent persecutor of the Bud-dhists. —उदयन-चरित, अम्, n. title of a play.
10771: उदयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to an end or conclusion, finishing (as a ceremony).

10775: 1. उद्-इति, इस्, f., Ved. ascending, rising (of the sun); going away or down, setting (of the sun).

10787: उदीप उद्-ईप, अस्, m. (fr. 1. उद् and अप्, water), high water, an inundation; (अस्, आ, अम्), flooded.

A. -ईर्ते, -ईरितुम्, to rise; to start (in order to go or to come); to move up-wards, ascend; to arise, originate: Caus. -ईरयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rise or move; to throw or cast upwards, to cast, throw, discharge, to drive forward; to rouse up, excite; to raise one's voice; to utter, speak; to effect; to make visible: Pass. -ईर्यते, to be cast or thrown upwards; to be excited; to be uttered, announced, enunciated; to sound; to issue forth.

10791: उद्-ईर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, issued out, excited, increased, intense; generous, great, excellent. —उदीर्ण-ता, f. excitement, activity, agility. —उदीर्ण-दीधिति, इस्, इस्, इ, intensely bright. —उदीर्ण-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, impetuous in its course (as a torrent), violent.

10798: उदुब्ज् उद्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, -जितुम्, to cleave asunder (?); to set up, erect.

10800: उदुम्बल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. copper-coloured?; (Say.) of extended power (for उरु-बल; said of the two dogs, the messengers of Yama).

10802: उदुष् उद्-उष्, cl. 1. P. -ओषति, -षितुम्, to expel by heat.
10803: उदुष्ट-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a red mouth (as a horse).
10804: उदूखल उदूखल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wooden mortar used for pounding rice and separating the husk; any mortar; bdellium; a mortar-shaped joint.
10805: उदूढ उद्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वह् with उद्), married; coarse, gross, heavy, fat; material, substantial; much, exceeding.
10806: उदूह् उद्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -हितुम्, to push or press upwards, move or bear upwards.
10807: उदृ उद्-ऋ, cl. 3. P. -इयर्ति (Ved. aor. A. -आर्त), -अर्तुम्, -अरितुम्, or -रीतुम्, to start up, rise; to move up, raise, excite: Caus. -अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rise.

10813: उद्-एजय, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, making tremble.
10814: उदोजस् उद्-ओजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. exceedingly powerful or violent.
10815: उद्गन्धि उद्-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, fragrant.
10816: उद्गम् उद्-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go up, rise, ascend; to shoot up; to go out, come from, break out, depart; to spread.

10821: उद्-गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone up or ascended; (अम्), n. a pair of bleached cloths or sheets.

10828: उद्गुर् उद्-गुर्, cl. 6. A. -गुरते, -रितुम्, to raise the voice in a threatening manner.
10829: उद्-गूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, lifted, held up; erected, excited.
10830: उद्गुह् उद्-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते, -गूहि-तुम् or -गोढुम्, to pierce through and through, to twist through.
10831: उद्गॄ उद्-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति, -गरि-तुम् or -लितुम्, or -गरीतुम् or -लीतुम्, to eject (from the mouth), spit out, vomit out or up, belch out, pour out, discharge; breathe out; to rise from: Caus. P. -गिरयति, -यितुम्, to cause to pour forth, to raise (a sound), to cause to utter sounds.
10832: उद्-गार, अस्, m. spitting out, ejecting anything from the mouth, vomiting; belching, eructation; re-lating repeatedly; spittle, saliva; speaking in the throat, sound, roaring, hissing.
10833: उद्-गारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ejecting, spitting, vomiting.
10834: उद्-गिरण, अम्, n. vomiting; ejecting anything (as saliva &c.) from the mouth, slavering.
10835: उद्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited forth, ejected, cast forth, breathed out, exhaled, disdained.
10836: उद्गै उद्-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to be-gin to sing; to sing or chant (applied especially to the singing or chanting of the Sāma-veda, from which one order of priests take the name of Udgātṛ); to announce, to celebrate in song; to sing before any one (with acc.); to fill with song.
10837: उद्गातु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to sing.
10838: उद्-गातृ, ता, m. one of the four chief-priests, viz. the one who chants the hymns of the Sāma-veda; a chanter.
10839: उद्-गाथा, f. a variety of the Āryā measure, the same as the Gīti, a stanza of four half-lines, contain-ing alternately twelve and eighteen instants.
10840: उद्-गीति, इस्, f. singing; chanting of the Sāma-veda; a variety of the Āryā metre, a verse of four half-lines, containing twelve, fifteen, twelve, eighteen instants.
10841: उद्-गीथ, अस्, m. chanting of the Sāma-veda, the office of the Udgātṛ; the second part of the Sāma-veda; N. of a son of Bhava; N. of a commentator of Vedic texts; designation of ॐ or the triliteral name of God.
10842: उद्ग्रन्थ् उद्-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. 1. P. A. -ग्रथ्नाति, नीते, or -ग्रन्थति, -ते, -ग्रन्थितुम्, to bind up, tie into bundles; to tie up, truss; to fasten, wind; to unbind, loosen.
10843: उद्-ग्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, interlaced; unbound, loosened.
10844: उद्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. a section, chapter.
10845: उद्-ग्रन्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, untied, free from worldly ties.
10846: उद्ग्रह् उद्-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति or Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to take or lift up; to set up, erect, elevate; to take out, draw out, take away; to take away from, to preserve; to cease, especially to cease to rain; to break off, discontinue (speaking); A. to raise one's self: Caus. -ग्राहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to take up or out, to cause to pay; to extol, extol with praise.
10847: उद्-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken up, turned up, up-raised.
10848: उद्-ग्रभण, अम्, n., Ved. taking up, raising.
10849: उद्-ग्रह, अस्, m. taking up; any object that may be accomplished by religious or other acts.
10850: उद्-ग्रहण, अम्, n. taking up, lifting up, taking away or out.
10851: उद्-ग्राभ, अस्, m., Ved. raising, elevating.
10852: उद्-ग्राह, अस्, m. taking up or away; (in the Prā-tiśākhyas) the rule of Sandhi which causes the change of the terminations अः, ए, and ओ, to अ before a follow-ing vowel; replying in argument; objection. —उद्-ग्राह-पदवृत्ति, इस्, f. the Sandhi called Udgrāha before a long vowel. —उद्ग्राह-वत्, ind. (in the Prātiśākhyas) ‘like the Udgrāha,’ a term applied to that kind of Sandhi by which final अ and आ appear as अम्म् before ऋ।
10854: उद्-ग्राहित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, lifted up; de-posited, delivered; seized; bound, tied; excellent, exalted; recalled, remembered.
10855: उद्ग्रीव उद्-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, or उद्-ग्रीविन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who lifts up or raises the neck (in trying to see anything).
10856: उद्घ उद्-घ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with उद्), excellence, happiness; the hollow hand; fire; a model, a pattern; organic air in the body.
10857: उद्-घन, अस्, m. a carpenter's bench, a plank on which he works.
10858: उद्-घात, अस्, m. striking, wounding, inflicting a hurt; a wound, a blow; slipping, tripping; raising, elevation; a beginning, a thing begun; breathing through the nostrils as a religious exercise; a club, a mallet, a weapon; the division of a book, a chapter, a section.
10859: उद्घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, uneven, having elevations, rough.
10860: उद्घट् उद्-घट्, Caus. -घाटयति, -यितुम्, to open, unlock, unfasten; to peel, shell; to reveal, ex-pose; to undertake, commence; to rub over, stroke, tickle.
10861: उद्-घाट, अस्, m. a watch or guard-house.
10862: उद्-घाटक, अस्, m. an opener, the instrument or implement for opening anything, a key; (अम्), n. the rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket used for drawing water.
10863: उद्-घाटन, अम्, n. opening, unlocking; an opener, the instrument or means of opening, a key, &c.; the rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket used for drawing water; hoisting, raising, lifting up.
10864: उद्-घाटनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opened.
10865: उद्-घाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, opened, manifested; un-dertaken, commenced; raised, hoisted or lifted up; done with effort, exerted. —उद्घाटित-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, intelligent. —उद्घाटिताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, naked; intelligent, wise.
10866: उद्-घाटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, opening, commencing.
10867: उद्घट्टक उद्-घट्टक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घट्ट् with उद्), a kind of time (in music).
10868: उद्-घट्टन, अम्, n. kicking of a horse (?); friction; opening, opening upwards as a lid.
10869: उद्-घट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, opened, unlocked.
10870: उद्घस उद्-घस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घस्), flesh.
10871: उद्घुष् उद्-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -षितुम्, to sound, cry out, fill with cries: Caus. -घोषयति, यितुम्, to cause to sound aloud, to declare aloud; proclaim, noise abroad.
10872: उद्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded out; proclaimed; (अम्), n. sound, noise.
10873: उद्-घोष, अस्, m. announcing or proclaiming aloud; popular talk, general report.
10874: उद्घृष् उद्-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, -षि-तुम्, to rub, comminute by rubbing; to rub over, strike against.
10875: उद्-घर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, rubbing up; rub-bing the skin with hard substances, as vitrified brick &c.; a cudgel.
10876: उद्-घृष्ट, अम्, n. a peculiar fault in pronun-ciation.
10877: उद्दंश उद्-दंश, अस्, m. (rt. दंश्), a bug; a mosquito, a gadfly.
10878: उद्दण्ड उद्-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, whose staff is raised, whose stalk is erect; raised on a staff or pole. —उद्दण्ड-पाल, अस्, m. a punisher, whether king or magistrate; a sort of snake, a kind of fish; [cf. उद्-अण्ड-पाल।]
10879: उद्दन्तुर उद्-दन्तुर, अस्, आ, अम्, large-toothed, having projecting teeth; high, tall; terrific, for-midable.
10880: उद्दम् उद्-दम्, cl. 4. P. -दाम्यति, -दमितुम्, cl. 10. P. -दमयति, -यितुम्, to subdue, to over-power, become master of.
10882: उद्-दान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, energetic, humble, elevated; (? for उद्-वान्त), vomited by an elephant.
10883: उद्दा उद्-दा, cl. 3. P. -ददाति, -दातुम्, to take away, snatch away.
10884: उद्दान उद्-दान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 4. दा, to bind, with उद्), binding, confinement; taming, subdu-ing; the middle, the waist; a fire-place; submarine fire; entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac.
10885: उद्-दाम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद् and दामन्, a bond), unrestrained, unbound, set free; self-willed; unlimited, extraordinary; proud, haughty; large, great; (अस्), m. an epithet of Yama (‘whose noose is raised’); an epithet of Varuṇa; (अम्), ind. in an unrestrained manner, without any limits.
10886: उद्-दित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound, tied.
10887: उद्दाल उद्-दाल, अस्, m. (fr. दॄ with उद् ?), the plant Cordia Myxa or Latifolia; also Paspalum Frumentaceum. —उद्दाल-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a Gan-dharba.
10888: उद्दालक, अस्, m., N. of the above plants; N. of a teacher; (अम्), n. a kind of honey. —उद्दालक-पुष्प-भञ्जिका, f. ‘breaking of Uddālaka flowers,’ a sort of game played by people in the eastern districts.
10889: उद्दालिन्, ई, m., N. of a teacher.
10892: उद्दिश् 1. उद्-दिश्, cl. 6. P. A., 3. P. -दिशति, -ते, -दिदेष्टि, -देष्टुम्, to show or direct towards; to point out, signify, declare, determine; to enunciate, prophesy; to mean; to aim at, intend, destine; to explain, instruct, teach.
10893: 2. उद्-दिश्, क्, f., Ved. a particular direction or quarter of the sky.
10894: उद्-दिश्य, ind. having shown or explained; stipu-lating for, demanding; aiming at, in the direction of, with reference to; towards; with regard to, for, for the sake of, in the name of.
10895: उद्-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned, particularized, described, promised.
10896: उद्-देश, अस्, m. pointing to or at, direction; ascer-tainment; brief statement; exemplification, illustra-tion, explanation; mentioning a thing by name; assignment, prescription; stipulation, bargain; quarter, spot, region, place; an object, a motive; upper region, high situation; (in Nyāya phil.) the enunciation of a thing that is to be further discussed and elucidated; (at the end of compounds) relative to. —उद्देश-तस्, ind. pointedly, distinctly; by way of explanation.
10897: उद्-देशक, अस्, आ, अम्, illustrative, explanatory; (अस्), m. an illustration, an example; an illustrator, a guide; (in mathematics) a question, problem.
10898: उद्-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be illustrated or explained; anything to which one refers or which one has in view; (अम्), n. the end in view, an incentive.
10899: उद्-देष्टॄ, टा, ट्री, टृ, pointing out &c.; one who acts with a certain scope or design.
10900: उद्दिह् उद्-दिह्, cl. 2. P. A., Ved. -देग्धि, -दिग्धे, -देग्धुम्, to throw or heap up.
10901: उद्-देहिक, अस्, m., N. of a people; (आ), f. the white ant.
10902: उद्दीप् उद्-दीप्, cl. 4. A. -दीप्यते, -दीपितुम्, to flame, blaze up, be kindled: Caus. -दीपयति, -यितुम्, to light up, inflame, illuminate, excite, ani-mate.
10903: उद्-दीप, अस्, m. inflaming, lighting; an inflamer; animating, who or what animates; (अम्), n. a gummy and resinous substance, bdellium.
10904: उद्-दीपक, अस्, आ, अम्, inflaming, exciting, ren-dering more intense; lighting, setting alight.
10905: उद्-दीपन, अम्, n. inflaming (as passion), exciting, animating; illuminating; burning of a body &c.; any aggravating thing or circumstance, giving poig-nancy to feeling or passion.
10906: उद्-दीपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, lighting up, brighten-ing, becoming light.
10907: उद्-दीप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted, set on fire or alight; shining; inflamed, aggravated (as passion).
10909: उद्दृश् उद्-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to see above (in the sky), to look upwards; to look into the future, expect; to become aware of; to doubt: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to make visible, cause to appear.
10910: उद्-दर्शन, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Nāgas.
10911: उद्दॄ उद्-दॄ, cl. 9. P. -दृणाति, -दरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to tear out.
10912: उद्युत् उद्-द्युत्, cl. 1. A. -द्योतते, -तितुम्, to blaze up, shine: Caus. -द्योतयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine: Intens. Ved. -दविद्युतीति, to shine intensely.
10913: उद्-द्योत, अस्, आ, अम्, flashing up, shining; (अस्), m. light, lustre; revelation.
10914: उद्-द्योतित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up, emblazoned.
10915: उद्द्राव उद्-द्राव, अस्, m. (rt. द्रु), flight, retreat, going upwards; (अस्, आ, अम्), running away.
10916: उद्-द्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, fled, retreated, run away; ascended; gone up or upwards.
10917: उद्धन् उद्-धन् (उद्-हन्), cl. 2. P. -धन्ति (Ved. cl. 1. P. -धनति), -धन्तुम्, to raise up, elevate.
10918: उद्-धत, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, elevated; exceeding, excessive; haughty, vain, puffed up; excited, intense; rude, ill-behaved; (अस्), m. a king's wrestler. —उद्-धत-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or उद्धत-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, high-minded, haughty, proud. —उद्धत-मनस्क-त्व, अम्, n. pride, arrogance. —उद्धतार्-णव-निस्वन (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, raising a noise like the ocean.
10919: उद्-धति, इस्, f. elevation; pride, haughtiness; a stroke, shaking.
10921: उद्धय उद्-धय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धे with उद्), who or what drinks.
10923: उद्धर्ष 1. उद्-धर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. धृष् with उद्), courage to undertake a thing.
10924: 1. उद्-धर्षण, अस्, आ, अम् (or fr. next ?), animat-ing, encouraging; (अम्), n. animating, encouraging.
10925: उद्धर्ष 2. उद्-धर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हृष् with उद्), great joy; a festival (especially a religious one).
10926: 2. उद्-धर्षण, अम्, n. erection of the hair of the body, occasioned by great pleasure.
10927: उद्-धर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. whose hair is erected; (इणी), f., N. of a metre of four verses, of fourteen syllables each.
10928: उद्धव उद्-धव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हु with उद्), a sacrificial fire; a festival, a holiday; N. of a Yādava, the friend and counsellor of Kṛṣṇa. —उद्धव-दूत and उद्धव-सन्देश, अस्, m. title of two poems. —उद्धव-ब्राह्मण, अस्, m., N. of a copyist.
10929: उद्धस्त उद्-धस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. हस्त and उद्), extending the hands, raising the hands.
10930: उद्धा 1. उद्-धा, cl. 3. P., Ved. -दधाति, -धातुम्, to abandon or expose (an infant); to set up, erect, build up.
10931: उद्-धि, इस्, m., Ved. a particular part of a carriage, perhaps the part which rests on the axles; an earthen stand on which the Ukhā rests.
10932: उद्-धित, अस्, आ, अम्, set up, erected.
10933: उद्धा 2. उद्-धा (उद्-हा), cl. 3. A. उज्-जिहीते, उद्-धातुम्, to go upwards, move upwards; to raise; to go away from.
10934: 1. उद्-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up, ascended.
10935: उद्धान 2. उद्धान, अस्, आ, अम् (for उद्-वान्त, उद्-ध्मात, and उद्-ध्मान?), ejected, vomited; inflated, corpulent; (अम्), n. ejecting, vomiting; a fire-place.
10936: उद्धान्त उद्धान्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for उद्-वान्त?), ejected, vomited; (अस्), m. an elephant out of rut (from whose temples the juice ceases to flow).
10937: उद्धुर उद्-धुर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद् and धुर्), freed from a yoke or burden; ceasing from, leaving off; unrestrained, lively, cheerful; heavy, thick, gross, firm; high.
10938: उद्धुषण उद्धुषण, a corruption of 2. उद्-धर्षण, q. v.
10939: उद्धू उद्-धू, cl. 5. P. A. -धूनोति or -धु-नोति, -नुते, -धवितुम् or -धोतुम्, to rouse up, shake up, move; to disturb, excite; to shake off, throw off; to expel.
10940: उद्-धूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken off, fallen from or off; tossed up, scattered above; exalted; high, loud. —उद्धूत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has shaken off (his) sins.
10942: उद्धूलय उद्धूलय, nom. P. -धूलयति, -यितुम्, to powder, sprinkle with dust or powder.
10943: उद्धूषण उद्धूषण, अम्, n. horripilation; also उद्धुषण। See 2. उद्-धर्षण।
10944: उद्धूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs erected.
10945: उद्धृ 1. उद्-धृ, cl. 1. P. A. -धरति, -ते, -धर्तुम्, to draw out, raise up, make honoured.
10947: उद्धृ 2. उद्-धृ (उद्-हृ), cl. 1. P. A. -ध-रति, -ते, -धर्तुम्, to draw out, take out, to extri-cate, deliver; to tear out, pull out, eradicate; to extend, elevate, raise: Caus. -धारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to draw out; to raise: Desid. उज्-जिहीर्षति, to wish to elevate or draw out, to elevate.
10948: उद्-धर, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas; (अस्, आ, अम्) = उद्-धुर (?)।
10949: उद्-धरण, अम्, n. the act of drawing out, taking out, tearing out; taking off (clothes); extricating, de-livering, rescuing; raising, lifting; eradication; ex-termination; act of destroying; taking a part or share; taking from the Gārhapatya fire to supply the other sacred fires; vomiting, bringing up; vomited food; final emancipation; (अस्), m., N. of the father of king Śantanu, the author of a commentary on a portion of the Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa.
10950: उद्-धरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be raised or taken up, to be extracted.
10951: उद्-धर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drawn out.
10952: उद्-धर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who raises or lifts up; a sharer, a coheir; one who recovers property; (ता), m. a destroyer, exterminator; redeemer, deliverer.
10953: उद्-धार, अस्, m. raising, elevating, lifting up; drawing out, extraction, deliverance, redemption, ex-trication; taking away; deduction, a part to be set aside, selected part; a portion, share, a surplus given by the Hindū law to the eldest son beyond the shares of the younger ones; the first division of a patrimony; the sixth part of booty taken in war which belongs to the prince; debt, especially a debt not bearing interest, obligation; recovering property; selecting (a passage), quoting; (आ), f. the plant Cocculus Cor-difolius; (अम्), n. a fire-place. —उद्धार-विभाग, अस्, m. division of shares, partition.
10954: उद्-धारक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what raises or lifts, drawing out.
