11211: उप उप, a prefix to verbs and nouns (ex-pressing) towards, near to (opposed to अप, away), by the side of, with, together with, under, down (e. g. उप-गम्, to go near, undergo; उप-गमन, approach-ing. In the Veda the verb has sometimes to be supplied from the context, and sometimes उप is placed after the verb with which it ought to have been compounded, e. g. आययुर् उप = उपाययुः, they approached). (As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns उप expresses) direction towards, nearness, contiguity in space, time, number, degree, resemblance, and re-lationship, but with the idea of subordination and inferi-ority (e. g. उप-कनिष्ठिका, the finger next to the little finger; उप-पुराणम्, a secondary or subordinate Purāṇa; उप-दश, nearly ten); sometimes forming with the nouns to which it is prefixed compound ad-verbs (e. g. उप-मूलम्, at the root; उप-पूर्व-रात्रम्, towards the beginning of night; उप-कूपे, near a well), which adverbs lose their adverbial ter-minations if they are again compounded with nouns (e. g. उपकूप-जलाशय, a reservoir in the neigh-bourhood of a well). Prefixed to proper names उप may express in classical literature ‘a younger brother’ (e. g. उपेन्द्र, ‘the younger brother of Indra’), and in Buddhist literature ‘a son.’ (As a separable adverb उप rarely expresses) thereto, further, moreover (e. g. तत्र उप ब्रह्म यो वेद, who further knows the Veda). (As a separable preposition with locative) near to, towards, in the direction of, under, below (e. g. उप आशाः, towards the regions); near to, at, on, upon; at the time of, upon, up to, in, above (with loc., e. g. उप सानुषु, on the tops of the mountains); with, together with, at the same time with, according to (with inst., e. g. उप धर्मभिः, according to the rules of duty). Besides the meanings given above उप is said to imply disease, extinction; ornament; command; re-proof; undertaking; giving; killing; diffusing; wish; power; effort; resemblance, &c.; [cf. Gr. ὑπό Lat. sub; Goth. up; Old Germ. oba; Mod. Germ. ob in obdach, obliegen, &c.]

11359: उप-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be collected or heaped up.
11360: उपचि 2. उप-चि, cl. 3. P., Ved. -चिकेति, -चे-तुम्, to honour, worship.
11361: उपचित्तचिन्त उपचित्त-चिन्त, अस्, m., N. of a son of Pāpīyas.
11362: उपचित्र उप-चित्र, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ), f. the plants Salvinia Cuculluta and Croton Polyandra; N. of several metres, namely, 1. a variety of Mātrāsamaka, containing 4×16 syllabic instants; 2. a metre of four lines of eleven syllables each; 3. a metre of two lines of twenty-two syllables each.
11363: उपचूलन उप-चूलन, अम्, n. heating, burn-ing (?).
11364: उपचृत् उप-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्, to fasten, tie, bind on.
11365: उपच्छद् 1. उप-च्छद् (उप-छद्), cl. 10. P. A. -छादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cover, hide, conceal, keep secret.
11366: उप-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, secret, concealed.
11367: उपच्छद् 2. उप-च्छद् or -च्छन्द् (उप-छद्), Caus. -च्छन्दयति, -यितुम्, to present any one (acc.) with anything (inst.); to persuade a person to do anything; to coax, to seek to seduce a person; to conciliate.
11368: उप-च्छन्दन, अम्, n. persuasion, persuading, coaxing.
11369: उपच्यव उप-च्यव, अस्, m. (rt. च्यु), Ved. pressing close to (in sexual intercourse); (Sāy.) going into (the chamber).
11370: उपजगती उप-जगती, f. a variety of the Triṣṭubh metre, in which three Pādas contain twelve syllables instead of eleven.
11371: उपजन् उप-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be produced in addition, to be born, originate; to happen, become visible, appear; to be born again; to exist, be: Caus. -जनयति, -यितुम्, to produce, cause.
11372: उप-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, being produced in addition, increasing; (अस्), m., N. of a divine being (?).
11373: उप-जन, अस्, m. additional production, addition, increase; appendage; addition of a letter in the forma-tion of words; letters, syllables or affixes added.
11374: उप-जा, f., Ved. distant or not immediate posterity.
11375: उप-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, engendered, aroused. —उपजात-कोप or उपजात-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, provoked, excited, moved to anger. —उपजात-विश्वास, अस्, आ, अम्, believing, confiding, confident, trusting.
11376: उप-जाति, इस्, f. a mixed metre, especially a con-junction of Indravajrā and Upendravajrā, and a con-junction of Vaṃśastha and Indravaṃśa.
11377: उपजप् उप-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -जपितुम्, to whisper into the ears (of another), to bring over to one's own party by secretly suggesting anything in the ear, to instigate to rebellion or treachery; to make mischief.
11378: उप-जप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought over or in-stigated to rebellion by secret suggestions or whisper-ing in the ear.
11379: उप-जाप, अस्, m. the act of whispering into the ears, rousing to rebellion, bringing over to one's own party; treason, treachery; disunion, separation.
11380: उप-जापक, अस्, आ, अम्, whispering anything into the ears, rousing to rebellion; a traitor, treacherous; a mischief-maker, one who foments quarrels.
11381: उपजरसम् उप-जरसम्, ind. towards old age, in old age.
11382: उपजला उप-जला, f., N. of a river.
11383: उपजल्प् उप-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -पितुम्, to talk to, chatter, advise.
11385: उप-जल्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, talking to a person, giving advice.
11386: उपजायम् उप-जायम्, ind. near a wife.
11387: उपजिगमिषु उप-जिगमिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. गम्), desirous of going near.
11388: उपजिहीर्षा उप-जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. हृ with उप), desire, intention to rob.
11389: उपजिह्वा उप-जिह्वा or उपजिह्विका, f. the uvula or soft palate, the epiglottis; enlargement of the under side of the tongue; a kind of ant.
11390: उपजीक उपजीक, अस्, m., Ved. a water deity.
11391: उपजीव् उप-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -वितुम्, to live or exist upon (food), subsist, support one's self on, be supported by, derive profit from, make use of (with acc.); to live under, be dependant on, to serve; to live for a profession, practice.
11392: उप-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. living on &c. (?).
11393: उप-जीवक, अस्, आ, अम्, living upon, subsisting by (with inst.); living under, depending upon, subject to, a dependant; (अम्), n. means of subsistence, act.
11394: उप-जीवन, अम्, n. means of living, subsistence.
11395: उप-जीवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, granting means of sub-sistence, affording a livelihood.
11397: उप-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, living on, subsisting by (with acc. or gen.); living in dependance, dependant, subject.
11398: उप-जीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, that by which one lives, affording a livelihood; (अम्), n. means of subsistence, cause.
11399: उपजोषम् उप-जोषम्, ind. (rt. जुष्), ac-cording to one's desire or pleasure, quietly; an expres-sion indicative of joy.
11401: उपज्ञा 1. उप-ज्ञा, cl. 9. A. -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to ascertain; excogitate, invent, find out, hit upon: Desid. A., ep. also P. -जिज्ञासते, -ति, to seek to ascertain or invent.
11402: उप-जिज्ञास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. enigmatical, unin-telligible, mysterious.
11403: 2. उप-ज्ञा, f. a knowledge obtained by one's self and not handed down by tradition, primitive or un-taught knowledge, invention; commencement of a thing not previously done; (at the end of a compound used in neut., e. g. पाणिन्य्-उपज्ञम्, the grammar invented by Pāṇini.)
11404: उपज्मन् उप-ज्मन्, आ, m., Ved. striding or stepping upon (?).
11405: उपज्योतिष उप-ज्योतिष, N. of a region.
11406: उपज्रि उप-ज्रि, cl. 1. P., Ved. -ज्रयति, -ज्रे-तुम्, to extend to; (Sāy.) to go near to, approach.
11407: उपज्वलित उप-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up.
11408: उपढौक् उप-ढौक्, Caus. P. -ढौकयति, -यितुम्, to present an offering, make a respectful offering; carry out, accomplish.
11409: उप-ढौकन, अम्, n. a respectful offering or present, a Nazr.
11410: उपतक्ष उप-तक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a certain semi-divine being, belonging to the class of Gandhar-vas or of Nāgas.
11411: उपतटम् उप-तटम्, ind. near the skirt; (अस्), m. (?) the skirt.
11412: उपतप् उप-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, to make warm, to heat; to feel pain, become sick; to afflict, befal (as an illness; sometimes used im-personally with gen. or acc.): Pass. -तप्यते, to feel pain, become ill, be afflicted with; to be emaciated with penance (तपस्): Caus. -तापयति, -यितुम्, to kindle, ignite, burn, consume; to cause pain, ma-cerate the body by penance; torment, hurt, offend, oppress.
11413: उप-तपत्, अम्, m., Ved. (scil. अग्नि) interior heat, a disease.
11414: उप-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, heated, parched; distressed, pained.
11415: उप-तप्तृ, ता, m. morbid heat; any cause of heat, burning or inflammation.
11416: उप-तप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being distressed.
11417: उप-ताप, अस्, m. heat, warmth, heating, paining, pain, trouble, misfortune; sickness, disease, injury; haste, hurry.
11419: उप-तापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heating, inflaming, exciting, causing pain; suffering heat or pain, sick.
11420: उपतारक उप-तारक, अस्, इका, अम् (rt. तॄ), overflowing.
11421: उपतिष्य उप-तिष्य, अस्, m., N. of a son of Tiṣya by Śārikā.
11422: उपतीरम् उप-तीरम्, ind. on the shore.
11423: उपतुष् उप-तुष्, Caus. -तोषयति, -यितुम्, to content, satisfy.
11424: उपतूलम् उप-तूलम्, ind. at the cotton.
11425: उपतृण्य उप-तृण्य, अस्, m., Ved. epithet of a snake (lurking in grass).
11426: उपत्य उपत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप), situated under or below.
11427: उपत्यका, f. low-land, land at the foot of a hill or mountain; a forest at the foot of a mountain; a vale, valley.
11428: उपदंश् उप-दंश्, cl. 1. P. -दशति, -दंष्-टुम्, to bite or eat anything as a relish.
11429: उप-दंश, अस्, m. a relish, anything to excite drinking or appetite, anything eaten in addition; biting, stinging; the venereal disease, chancre; a tree, the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish, Morunga Hyperanthera.
11430: उपदंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, afflicted with the above disease.
11432: उपदम्भ् उप-दम्भ्, Caus. P., Ved. -दम्भ-यति, -यितुम्, to lesson, diminish, destroy.
11433: उपदश उप-दश, आस्, आस्, आनि, pl. almost ten, nearly ten.
11434: उपदस् उप-दस्, cl. 4. P. -दस्यति, -सितुम्, to fail, be wanting, be extinguished, be exhausted, dry up; (in Ved. used impersonally with inst. or abl.): Caus. P. -दासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fail or cease, extinguish.
11435: उप-दासुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. failing, wanting.
11436: उपदह् उप-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn, set fire to.
11437: उपदा 1. उप-दा, cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, दातुम्, to give in addition, offer, grant, give; to add: Ved. cl. 1. A. -ददते, to take upon one's self; to erect, support.
11438: 2. उप-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. giving a present; (आ), f. a present, an offering to a king or great man &c.; a Nazr.
11439: उप-दान or उपदानक, अम्, n. an oblation, a present; a gift which is for the purpose of procuring favour or protection.
11440: उपदानवी उप-दानवी, f., N. of the daughter of the Dānava Vṛṣa-parvan and mother of Dush-manta.
11441: उपदिग्ध उप-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. दिह् with उप), smeared, covered; spotted over.
11442: उप-देह, अस्, m. a cover; liniment, ointment; (उप implying inferiority) a minor or secondary body growing on diseased parts of the body.
11443: उप-देहिका, f. a kind of ant; [cf. उपजिह्विका।]
11444: उपदिश् 1. उप-दिश्, cl. 6. P. A. -दिशति, -ते, -देष्टुम्, to point out to; to indicate, specify, ex-plain, instruct, teach; advise, admonish; to assign the right place to anything, arrange; to mention, exhibit; to inform; to settle, prescribe; to dictate, command, govern; to name: Pass. -दिश्यते, to be taught &c., to be called.
11445: 2. उप-दिश्, क्, or उप-दिशा, f. an intermediate region, as north-east &c.
11446: उप-दिश, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu-deva.
11447: उप-दिश्य, ind. having advised or instructed.
11448: उप-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, specified, particularized; taught, instructed, advised; assigned as a plea or reason; initiated; (अम्), n. council, advice.
11449: उप-देश, अस्, m. pointing out to, instruction, teach-ing, informing, advice, prescription; specification; plea, pretext; initiation, communication of the initiatory Mantra or formula; (in gram.) a form in a rule, an indicatory form, i. e. a root, base, affix, augment, or any other word or part of a word furnished with in-dicatory letters (anubandhas) which serve as a guide to the application of particular grammatical rules and are rejected when the word or part of a word is ready for use. —उपदेश-ता, f. the state of being a precept or rule; injunction; manner of instructing; doc-trine. —उपदेश-सहस्री, f. title of a work of Śaṅkara on philosophy. —उपदेशार्थवक्य (°श-अर्°), अम्, n. a parable.
11450: उप-देशक, अस्, आ, अम्, giving instruction, in-structing, instructive, didactic; (अस्), m. an instructor, a guide, especially a spiritual guide.
11451: उप-देशन, अम्, n. advising, instructing; (आ), f. information, doctrine.
11452: उप-देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, advising, instructing, inform-ing; (ई), m. a teacher, adviser; a word or affix &c. in the shape in which it appears in grammatical works.
11453: उप-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be taught; that which is to be taught or learnt.
11454: उप-देष्टव्य or उप-देशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taught or advised, fit or proper to be taught.
11455: उप-देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who points out, an adviser, teacher; a Guru or spiritual guide.
11456: उपदी उपदी, f. the plant Vanda Roxburghii or Aërides Tesselata.
11457: उपदीका उपदीका, f. a kind of ant; also उप-देहिका।
11458: उपदीक्षिन् उप-दीक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sharing in an initiatory or other religious rite; a near relation.
11459: उपदीप् उप-दीप्, Caus. P. -दीपयति, -यितुम्, to kindle, set fire to.
11460: उपदृश् 1. उप-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to look at; to perceive, observe: Pass. -दृश्यते, to be or become visible, appear: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to see, show, exhibit; to present a false show, impose upon another person by sham appearances; to illude; to explain, illustrate.
11461: उप-दर्शक, अस्, m. a guide, one who shows the way, a door-keeper.
11463: उप-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, perceived, distinguished.
11464: 2. उप-दृश्, क्, f., Ved. a view, aspect.
11465: उप-दृष्टि, इस्, f. aspect, view, show.
11466: उप-द्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, Ved. a supervisor, in-spector; overseeing, overlooking; (टा), m. a witness.
11467: उपदृषद् उप-दृषद् or उप-दृषदम्, ind. near a boundary stone.
11468: उपदेव उप-देव, अस्, m. an inferior deity; N. of a son of Akrūra; also of Devaka; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Vasu-deva; of a daughter of Devaka.
11469: उप-देवता, f. a minor deity, as a Yakṣa, Gan-darbha, Apsaras, &c.
11471: उपदोह उप-दोह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. दुह् with उप), a nipple of the udder of a cow.
11472: उपद्रु उप-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run near to, run towards, run at, rush at, assault, attack.
11473: उप-द्रव, अस्, m. that which befalls suddenly, an unhappy accident, misfortune, calamity, mischief; national distress (whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c.); national commotion, rebellion; violence, outrage; a symptom, a super-venient disease, one brought on whilst a person labours under another.
11474: उप-द्रविन्, ई, इणी, इ, attacking, falling on; tyran-nical, violent, factious; (ई), m. a tyrant, an oppressor, a rebel.
11475: उप-द्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, visited by calamities, op-pressed, attacked, persecuted, tyrannized over; (in astron.) eclipsed; boding evil, inauspicious; (अम्), n. a term of the Bāṣkalas for that kind of Sandhi, which is also called उद्ग्राहवत्, q. v.
11476: उपद्वीप उप-द्वीप, अस्, m. an island.
11477: उपधर्म उप-धर्म, अस्, m. a minor or sub-ordinate duty; a by-law; a heretic, a schismatic.
11478: उपधा 1. उप-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place or lay upon, place near to, put into; to place, lay; to put to (as horses to a carriage); to impose, lay upon, bestow upon, charge with (as a duty); to lay a command upon, enjoin, instruct in (with acc.); to place under one's self, to lie down upon; to place over, cover, conceal; to locate; to place in addition, to add; to communicate, cause to share in; (in gram.) to lie or be placed close to, to precede without the intervention of another syllable.
11479: उप-दधि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. placing upon.
11480: 2. उप-धा, f. imposition, forgery, fraud, deceit, trick, a false pretence; trial or test of honesty &c., of four kinds, viz. of loyalty, disinterestedness, conti-nence, and courage; (in gram.) a penultimate letter. —उपधा-भृत, अस्, m. a servant who has been guilty of dishonesty. —उपधा-रञ्जन, अम्, n. nasalization of the penultimate (?). —उपधा-शुचि, इस्, इस्, इ, approved, tried, of approved loyalty &c.
11481: उप-धान, अम्, n. placing or resting upon; that on which one rests, a pillow, cushion; individuality, peculiarity; affection, kindness; religious observance or obligation; poison; excellence, excellent quality; (अस्, आ, अम्), employed in placing upon, i. e. used (as a Mantra) in the putting up (of the sacrificial bricks).
11482: उपधानीय, अम्, n. a pillow, cushion.
11483: उप-धाय, ind. having placed or rested upon.
11484: उप-धायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, placing under.
11485: उप-धि, इस्, m. the part of a wheel between the nave and the circumference; fraud, circumvention; fear, terror; foundation, (with Buddhists) substratum (?).
11486: उपधिक, अस्, m. a cheat, a knave, especially one who imposes by threats, fraud.
11487: उप-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being preceded by.
11488: उप-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed upon.
11490: उपधातु उप-धातु, उस्, m. an inferior mine-ral, a semi-metal, (seven are specified; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpi-ment, and calx of brass); secondary secretion of the body, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph.
11491: उपधारण उप-धारण। See under उप-धृ below.
11492: उपधाव् उप-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -वितुम्, to run near to, approach hastily; have re-course to for assistance; A. to run, glide, soar.
11495: उपधूपित उप-धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, fumigated; one to whom decline or death is near; being at the point of death; suffering extreme pain.
11496: उपधृ उप-धृ, Caus. P. -धारयति, -यितुम्, to hold up, support, bear, carry; to hold as, consider as, regard as; to hold in the mind, to comprehend, perceive, hear, experience, observe; to reflect or me-ditate on.
11497: उप-धारण, अम्, n. considering, consideration, reflection.
11498: उप-धार्य, ind. having taken or held up.
11499: उप-धृति, इस्, f. a ray of light.
11500: उपधे उप-धे, Caus. A., Ved. -धापयते, -यितुम्, to rear by suckling.
11501: उपध्मा 1. उप-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मातुम्, to blow or breathe at or upon, fan.
11502: 2. उप-ध्मा, f. blowing upon, breathing; the effort of the voice which produces the sound Upa-dhmānīya.
11503: उप-ध्मान, अम्, n. blowing upon, breathing.
11504: उपध्मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, blowing upon, fanning, breathing.
11505: उप-ध्मानीय, अस्, m. the aspirate Visarga before the letters प् and फ्।
11506: उपध्यै उप-ध्यै, cl. 1. P., ep. also A. -ध्यायति, -ते, -ध्यातुम्, to think of, remember.

11670: उपमाति उप-माति, इस्, f. 11671: उप-मीमांसा, f., Ved. deliberation, investigation, consideration.

11726: उपरि उपरि, ind. (as a separable adverb) above, upon, on, upwards, towards the upper side of (opposed to अधस् and नीचा, e. g. उपरि या, to go upwards; sometimes written with a following word as if compounded with it, e. g. उपरि-चिह्नित, marked above); besides, in addition to, further (सहस्रं शतान्य् उपरि चाष्टौ, 1000 and 800 in addition); afterwards (e. g. उपरि पयः पिबेत्, he should drink milk afterwards); उपरि उपरि, higher and higher; repeatedly, continuously. (As a separable preposition, with acc., loc., or gen.) over, above, upon, on, at the head of, on the upper side of, beyond (e. g. उपरि शैलं गम्, to go over the mountain; उपरि लङ्कायां सम्प्राप्तः सः, he arrived over Laṅkā; उपर्य् उपरि सर्वेषाम् अतिष्ठत्, he stood at the very head of all; आत्मानं तस्य उपरि क्षिप्त्वा, having thrown himself upon him); in connection with, with reference to, with regard to, towards (with gen., e. g. मम उपरि विकारितः, changed in feeling with regard to me; पुत्रस्य उपरि क्रुद्धः, enraged towards his son); after (with abl., e. g. मुहूर्ताद् उपरि, after a minute); [cf. Zend upara; Goth. ufar; Old Germ. obar; Mod. Germ. über; Eng. over; Gr. ὑπέρ Lat. super.]
11727: उपरि may also be used at the end of a compound; e. g. तदुपरि गन्तुम्, to fall upon him, to attack him.

11729: उपरितन, अस्, ई, अम्, upper (opposed to अधस्-तन).
11730: उपरिष्टात्, ind. 12078: उप-हव्य, अस्, m., N. of a ceremony.
12079: उप-हूत, अस्, आ, अम्, invoked, invited.
12080: उप-हूय, ind. having invoked or called or ad-dressed.
12081: उप-ह्वान, अम्, n. act of inviting.
12082: उपांशु उपांशु, ind. in a low voice, in a whisper; secretly, in secret (e. g. उपांशु-व्रत, a vow observed in secret); (उस्), m. a prayer uttered in a low voice; muttering prayers, reciting them in a low voice so as not to be overheard; N. of a Soma offering. —उपांशु-क्रीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, played with in secret, made the companion of (a king's) private amusements.

12087: उपा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought near, invited, ad-dressed with invitatory sentences; (अस्), m. a sacri-ficial animal killed during the recitation of prescribed prayers; attended with evil omens, disastrous, cala-mitous; (अस्), m. misfortune; a portent, a pheno-menon announcing calamity.
12088: उपाक्रम् उपा-क्रम् (उप-आ-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A., 4. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमते (ep. also -क्रामते), -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to advance against in order to seize, to fall upon, take possession of.
12089: उपाक्षम् उपाक्षम् (उप-अक्°), ind. before the eyes.

12100: उपाग्र उपाग्र (उप-अग्°), अम्, n. the part which is next to the end or top; a secondary member.

12103: उपाग्रहायणम् उपाग्रहायणम् or उपाग्रहा-यणि (उप-अग्°), ind. towards the day of full moon in the month Agrahāyaṇa.

12105: उपाङ्क्य उपाङ्क्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप-अङ्क), to be marked.

12110: उपाच्छिद् उपा-च्छिद् (उप-आ-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to tear away from, cut off from.
12111: उपाज् उपाज् (उप-अज्), cl. 1. P. A., Ved. उपा-जति, -ते, -जितुम्, to bring near to.
12112: उपाजे-कृ, to support. —उपाजे-कृत्य or उपाजे-कृत्वा, having supported.
12113: उपाञ्च् उपाञ्च् (उप-अञ्च्) or उपाच् (उप-अच्), cl. 1. P. A. उपाञ्चति, -ते, or उपाचति, -ते, -चितुम्, to draw (water).
12114: उपाञ्जन उपाञ्जन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. अञ्ज् with उप), anointing, plastering the ground with cow dung &c.
12115: उपातिगम् उपाति-गम् (उप-अति-गम्), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to pass over, cross (a river).
12116: उपाती उपाती (उप-अति-इ), cl. 2. P. उपात्य्-एति, -तुम्, to pass over; to be added as a surplus.
12117: उपात्य्-अय, अस्, m. neglect or disobedience of customs; disorderly behaviour.
12118: उपादा उपा-दा (उप-आ-दा), cl. 3. 12121: उपा-दाय, ind. having seized, containing; includ-ing, inclusive of; together with; by means of.
12122: उपा-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or received, acceptable, admissible; to be chosen; to be selected, excellent, admirable.
12123: उपादिक उपादिक, अस्, m. a sort of insect; [cf. उत्पादक।]
12124: उपादिश् उपा-दिश् (उप-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -दि-शति, -ते, -देष्टुम्, to advise, show, point out, to indi-cate, inform, declare; to prescribe, give an order.
12125: उपाद्रु उपा-द्रु (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run near to.
12126: उपाधा उपा-धा (उप-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place near, place upon; to offer; render, make, effect, fix; to keep, hold.
12127: 1. उपा-धि, इस्, m. (for 2. see below), deceit, de-ception, disguise (in the Vedānta this is especially applied to certain natural forms or properties, con-sidered as disguises of the spirit); that which more closely defines, a discriminative or distinguishing pro-perty, an attribute, a peculiarity, an indispensable condition; limitation (e. g. अन्-उपाधि-रमणीयो देशः, a country beautiful without limitation, i. e. altogether beautiful); a title, a discriminative appella-tion, a nickname; a purpose, an occasion, an object; (in logic) a special cause for a general effect; (in rhetoric) the natural character of species, quality or action. उपाधि-तस्, ind. in consequence of a pe-culiarity. 12128: उपा-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, deposited, placed; put on, worn; joined, annexed; agreed upon, made or done mutually; (अस्), m. a fiery portent, a meteor, a comet.

12130: उपाधिक उपाधिक (उप-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, exceeding, supernumerary.

(fr. rt. 5. इ with उप-अधि), a sub-teacher who instructs in a part only of the Veda or in grammar and the other Vedāṅgas, and is therefore inferior to the Ācārya who instructs in the whole Veda with the Kalpa and Upaniṣads (see Manu II. 141); a spiritual teacher, a teacher in general; (आ), f. a female preceptor; (ई), f. a female teacher or the wife of a teacher.

12134: उपानह् उपा-नह्, त्, f. (rt. नह्), a sandal, a shoe. —उपानद्-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with a shoe.
12135: उपानी उपा-नी (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead or carry or bring near or towards; lead away, carry off; to initiate, conse-crate; [cf. उप-नी।]
12136: उपानुवाक्य उपानुवाक्य (उप-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. an epithet of Agni; (अम्), n., N. of a section of the Taittirīya-Saṃhitā.
12137: उपान्त उपान्त (उप-अन्°), अम्, n. proximity to the edge or margin, border, edge; the angle of the eye; immediate proximity; the last letter but one; (अस्, आ, अम्), near to the end, last but one; near. —उपान्त-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming near.
12138: उपान्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, near, proximate, neighbour-ing; (अम्), n. proximity.

12145: उपाभृति उपा-भृति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. भृ with उप-आ), Ved. act of bringing near.
12146: उपामन्त्र्य उपा-मन्त्र्य (उप-आ-), ind. having taken leave, having received permission to go.
12147: उपाय उपाय। See under 1. उपे 3rd col.
12148: उपाया उपा-या (उप-आ-), cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्, to approach, arrive at.
12149: उपा-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, approached; (अम्), n. arrival; an event, an accident.
12150: उपार् उपार् (उप-ऋ), cl. 3. P., Ved. उपे-यर्ति, उपार्तुम्, -रितुम् or -रीतुम्, to offend against, make a mistake; to injure: Caus. P. उपार्पयति, यितुम्, to bring near.
12151: उपार, अस्, m. or उपारण, अम्, n., Ved. a mis-take, offence, sin.

12155: उपाराध् उपा-राध् (उप-आ-), cl. 5. P. -राध्-नोति, -राद्धुम्, to serve, wait upon.

12158: उपारुह् उपा-रुह्, क्, f. (rt. रुह् with उप and आ), Ved. the shoot of a plant.
12159: उपा-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased. —उपा-रूढ-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, whose affection has in-creased.
12160: उपार्ज् उपार्ज् (उप-अर्ज्), cl. 1. P. उपार्जति, जितुम्, to bring near to: Caus. उपार्जयति, -यितुम्, to cause to bring near, convey near, acquire, gain.
12161: उपार्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, acquiring, obtaining, earn-ing, gaining.

12165: उपार्थ उपार्थ (उप-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of little worth.
12166: उपार्ध् उपार्ध् (उप-ऋध्), Desid. P. उपेर्त्-सति, to wish to accomplish, persevere, hold out.
12167: उपार्ष् उपार्ष् (उप-ऋष्), cl. 6. P. उपार्षति, षितुम्, to pierce, prick, goad.
12168: उपालभ् उपा-लभ् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. A. -ल-भते, -लब्धुम्, to obtain; to censure, revile, abuse, scold.
12169: उपा-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, reproached, reviled.

12174: उपाव् उपाव् (उप-अव्), cl. 1. P. -वति, -वितुम्, to cherish, behave friendly towards; to encourage (with dat. or acc.).

12176: उपावरुह् उपाव-रुह् (उप-अव-), cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to descend towards.

12178: उपावसायिन् उपाव-सायिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. सो with उप-अव), Ved. submissive, compliant, obey-ing, accommodating.

12509: ऊन ऊन, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. अव् and opposed to पूर्ण, अति-रिक्त, अधिक), wanting, de-ficient, defective, short of any quantity, less than the right number, not sufficient; less (in number, size, or degree), minus, fewer, smaller, inferior, &c. 12633: ऋत् ऋत्, A. ऋतीयते, to reproach, contemn, pity; to rival, have power, domineer; hate; go; (a Sautra root, i. e. a root occurring only in grammatical Sūtras and not in the Dhātu-pāṭha.) 12634: ऋत ऋत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 4. ऋ), proper, right; honest, brave, competent; true; worshipped, respected; enlightened, luminous; gone, risen, moved, affected by; (अम्), ind. right, duly, properly, ener-getically; ऋतम् इ, to go the right way, to live virtuously; (अस्), m., N. of a Rudra; of a prince; (अम्), n. fixed or settled order, law, rule (especially in religion); sacred or pious custom, pious action; divine law, faith, divine truth; (Sāy.) water, sacrifice, sacrificial rite; the sun (e. g. ऋतम् बृहत्, the great divine law, supreme truth, or according to Sāy. a great sacrifice; ऋतस्य गर्भः or प्रजाः, the off-spring of divine truth, or according to Sāy. the off-spring of the water or of sacrifice, as an epithet of Agni, of Soma, or of Viṣṇu; प्रथमजा ऋतस्य, the first-born of divine truth or Prajāpati; ऋतस्य सदनम् or सदः or सद्म or पदम् or नाभिः, the seat or centre of religious faith, as the altar &c., or according to Sāy. the seat of water or of the sun; ऋतस्य योनिः, water; ऋतस्य गोपाः or नेता or रथीः or पतिः, the protector or leader or lord of divine truth, or according to Sāy. of the sacrifice, as an epithet of Agni, of Soma, of the Ādityas, and other gods, or sometimes applied to men who are guardians of the truth); truth in general, right (e. g. पथ्या or पन्था ऋतस्य, the path of truth, the right way, a virtuous life, or according to Sāy. the way of the water); truth personified (as an object of worship, and hence enumerated among the sacred objects in the last chapter of the Nighaṇṭavas. 12644: ऋतु ऋतु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 4. ऋ?), any settled point of time, a fixed time, time appointed for sacrifices and other regular worship, right time, fit season (especially in the inst. pl. ऋतुभिस्, at the right time or at the appointed time for sacrifice or for a festival); an epoch, a period, a period of the year, a season; (the number of seasons is sometimes limited to three, or sometimes to five, viz. Vasanta, ‘spring;’ Grīṣma, ‘the hot season;’ Varṣa, pl. ‘the rains;’ Sarad, ‘the autumn;’ Hemanta-śiśira, du. ‘the cold and dewy season:’ but is more com-monly reckoned as six, Hemanta and Śiśira being regarded as distinct: occasionally as seven, or even as twelve, in the latter case each season lasting one month. 12677: ऋषि ऋषि, इस्, m. (said to be either fr. rt. दृश्, ‘to see,’ or fr. 1. ऋष्; perhaps related to अर्च् or ऋच्, ‘to praise’), a singer of sacred hymns, an in-spired poet or sage, any person who alone or with others invokes the deities in rhythmical speech or song, especially in song of a sacred character (e. g. the ancient hymn-singers Kutsa, Atri, Rebha, Agastya, Kuśika, Vasiṣṭha, Vy-aśva, who were regarded by later generations as patriarchal sages or saints, occupy-ing the same position in Indian history as the heroes and patriarchs of other countries. They Ṛṣis con-stitute a peculiar class of beings in the early mythical system, as distinct from gods, men, Asuras, &c.; they are the authors or rather seers of the Vedic hymns, i. e. according to orthodox Hindū ideas they are the inspired personages to whom these hymns were revealed, and such an expression as ‘the Ṛṣi says’ is equivalent to ‘so it stands in the sacred texts.’ Seven Ṛṣi, सप्त ऋषयः or सप्तऋषयः or सप्तर्षयः, are often mentioned in the Brāhmaṇas and later works as typical representatives of the charac-ter and spirit of the pre-historic or mythical period; in the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa their names are given as follows, Gotama, Bharadvāja, Viśvā-mitra, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, and Atri; in the Mahā-bhārata thus, Marīci, Atri, Aṅgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulastya, Vasiṣṭha; in Manu they are called Prajāpatis or patriarchs, and are reckoned as ten, three other names being added, viz. Pracetas or Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and Nā-rada, these ten being created by Manu Svāyambhuva for the production of all other beings including gods and men. The seven Ṛṣis form in astronomy the constellation of ‘the Great Bear.’ Metaphorically, the seven Ṛṣis may stand for the seven senses or the seven vital airs of the body); in later times a saint or sanctified sage in general, an ascetic, an an-chorite, (sometimes three orders of these Ṛṣis are enu-merated, viz. 12695: एक एक, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 5. इ; perhaps fr. the pronom. base ए contained in एतद्), one, alone, solitary, single, happening only once; the same, one and the same, identical; single of its kind, unique, singular, chief, pre-eminent, excellent; one of two or many [cf. एक-तर, एक-तम]; in later Sanskrit used as an indefinite article; (अस्), m., N. of a man, the son of Raja.
12696: एक follows the declension of pronominals (see Gram. 200, 237), and may be declined in the plural (e. g. एके, some, several; एके — एके or एके — अपरे or एके — अन्ये or एके — एके — अपरे or एके — अन्ये — एके — अपरे —अपरे, some — others). Sometimes एक may be repeated in the sense of ‘the one — the other, one — an-other’ (e. g. एक — एक = एक — अन्य or एक — द्वितीय, one — the other), or in the sense of ‘one after another’ (e. g. एक एकः पुरुषः, one man after another). It is often used in the middle of compounds either sub-stantively or adverbially (e. g. पुण्यैक-कर्मा, prac-tising only virtue; स्वर्गैक-सम्मुखी, f. look-ing only up to the sky; कर-पादैक-हीनस्, de-prived of one foot and one hand). In Vedic Sanskrit it may sometimes be placed, together with न, before a decad to lessen it by one, being then used in the inst. or acc. fem., inst. or abl. neut. (e. g. एकया न त्रिंशत् or एकां न त्रिंशत् = twenty-nine; एकेन न विंशतिः or एकाद् न विंशतिः = nineteen). In compounds and derivatives एक never appears in its fem. form एका (e. g. एकस्याः क्षीरम्, the milk of one female, is compounded into एक-क्षीरम् not एका-क्षीरम्); [cf. Lith. ni-ékas, ‘no:’ Hib. each, ‘any;’ neach, ‘any one, one, some one, he;’ neach-tar, ‘neither;’ neachdarach, ‘neutral:’ Gr. ἑκάτερος ἕκα-τος Lat. œquus, c-ocles fr. êc-ocles: Goth. ha in compounds, as haihs, Them. haiha, ha-iha, ‘one-eyed;’ ha-nfs, Them. ha-nfa, ‘one-handed;’ halts, Them. ha-lta, ‘lame;’ ha-lbs, Them. ha-lba, ‘half.’] —एक-ऋक्थिन्, &c.; 12735: एतद् एतद्, एषस्, एषा, एतद् (fr. ए with pro-nom. base त। The vowel ए appears also in एक, एव, &c.; and just as the simple base त substitutes स for the nom. sing. m. and f., so एत makes एषस्, एषा; but एत appears in all the other cases, and the neut. एतद् is used as the base to form derivatives such as एतदीय &c., and at the beginning of com-pounds), this, this here, here, especially as pointing to what is nearest to the speaker (e. g. एष वाणः, this arrow here in my hand; एष याति पन्थाः, here goes the way; एष कालः, here, i. e. now, is the time; एतद्, this here, i. e. this world here below). एतद् is sometimes used in this sense to give emphasis to the personal pronouns (e. g. एषो ऽहम्, I this very person here) or with omission of those pronouns (e. g. एष त्वां स्वर्गं नयानि, I standing here will convey you to heaven; एतौ प्रविष्टौ स्वः, we two here have entered). एतद् as the subject of a sentence agrees in gender and number with the predicate without reference to the noun to be supplied (e. g. एतद् मे धनम्, this [scil. cow] is my wealth); but may sometimes remain in the neut. sing. (e. g. एतद् गुरुषु वृत्तिः, this is the custom among Gurus).
12736: एतद् often refers to what precedes, especially when it is associated with इदम्, the latter then referring to what follows (e. g. एष प्रथमः कल्पः — अनुकल्पस् to अयं ज्ञेयः, this before-mentioned is the first rule, but this following may be considered a secondary rule).
12737: एतद् may be used in connection with a relative clause, in which case the relative generally follows (e. g. एष चैव गुरुर् धर्मो यम् प्रवक्ष्-याम्य् अहं तव, this is the important law, which I will proclaim to you).
12738: एतद्, ind. in this manner, thus, so, here, at this time, now (e. g. एतत् सुप्तः, asleep in this manner; न वा उ एतद् म्रियसे, not at this time dost thou die).
12739: एतद् appears at the beginning of compounds, as in the following examples. —एतज्-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, arising from this. —एतत्-काल, अस्, m. the present time; (ए), ind. now. —एतत्कालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the present time. —एतत्-क्षणात्, ind. from this moment, henceforth; (ए), ind. now. —एतत्-तुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, similar to this. —एतत्-प्रथम, अस्, आ, अम्, one who does anything for the first time. —एतत्-सम, अस्, आ, अम्, equal to this. —एतद्-अतिरिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, besides this. —एतद्-अनन्तरम्, ind. immediately after this. —एतद्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, terminating with this, ending thus. —एतद्-अर्थ, अस्, m. this matter; (अम् or ए), ind. on this account, for this end, therefore; एतद्-अर्थम् — यत्, for this end — that. —एतद्-अवधि, ind. to this limit, so far. —एतद्-अवस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, of such a state or con-dition. —एतद्-आत्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in this Ātman or supreme soul. —एतद्-आदि, इस्, इस्, इ, be-ginning thus, and so forth. —एतद्-एव, ind. this very same. —एतद्-द्वितीय, अस्, आ, अम्, one who does anything for the second time. —एतद्-योनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, residing or having one's origin in that. —एतद्-वत्, ind. like this, thus. —एतन्-न, ind. not so. —एतन्-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of this, of such a kind; [cf. Zend aiśa, aita; Old Pers. aita; Armen. ais, aid; Osk. eiso; Hib. ise, ‘he, himself;’ isa and isi, ‘she, herself.’]
12740: एतदीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to this.
12741: एतर्हि, ind., Ved. (very often in the Brāhmaṇas), now, at this time, at present, now-a-days; then (cor-relative to यर्हि); a certain measure of time = fifteen इदानीम्s or one fifteenth of a क्षिप्र।
12742: एतादृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved., or एतादृश्, क्, क्, क्, or एतादृश, अस्, ई, अम्, such, such like; so formed, of this kind, similar to this.
12743: एतावत्, आन्, अती, अत्, so great, so much, so many, of such a measure or compass, of such extent, so far, of such quality or kind; often found in connection with a relative clause, in which case the latter gene-rally follows (e. g. एतावान् एव पुरुषो यज् जायात्मा प्रजेति ह, a man is of such a measure as [i. e. is made complete by] himself, his wife, and his progeny); (वत्), ind. so far, thus far, so much, in such a degree, thus, &c. —एतावत्-त्व, अम्, n. quantity, number; greatness; (with following यद्) such a state or con-dition that; such extent.
12744: एतन एतन, अस्, m. expiration, breathing out, discharging air from the lungs; the fish Silurus Pelorius.
12745: एतृ एतृ, ता, m. (rt. 5. इ), Ved. going, ap-proaching, asking, requesting.
12746: एम, अस्, m. or एमन्, अ, n., Ved. a course, way.
12747: एदिधिषुःपति एदिधिषुःपति, इस्, m., Ved. the husband of a younger sister, whose elder sister has not yet been married. See दिधिषु।
12748: एध् एध् (connected with rt. ऋध्), cl. 1. A. (rarely P.) एधते, एधाञ्-चक्रे, एधिष्यते, ऐधिष्ट, एधितुम्, to prosper, increase, grow, be-come happy, grow strong, become great; to extend; to swell, rise (as waters): Caus. एधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to prosper, increase, celebrate, honour: Desid. एदिधिषते; [said to be related to Gr. οἶδος, οἰδἀω; perhaps also to Lat. œsculus.]
12749: 1. एधतु, उस्, m. (for 2. see एन्ध् next page), Ved. prosperity, happiness; a man; (उस्, उस्, उ), increased, grown.
12750: एधनीय or एधितव्य or एध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased or enlarged.
12751: एधमान, अस्, आ, अम्, prospering, increasing. —एधमान-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. hating the pros-perous, especially those rendered insolent by pros-perity; (Sāy.) hating the impious who prosper.
12754: एधित, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased.
12755: एधितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, increasing, growing, enlarging.
12756: एन एन, a pronom. base (used for certain cases of the 3rd personal pronoun, and occurring only in the acc. sing. du. pl. (एनम्, एनाम्, एनद्, &c.), inst. sing. (एनेन, एनया), gen. loc. du. (एनयोस्, Ved. एनोस्); the other cases are formed fr. the pronom. base अ, see under इदम्), he, she, it; this, that. This pronoun is enclitic and cannot begin a sentence. It is generally used alone, so that एनम् पुरुषम्, ‘that man,’ would be very unusual if not incorrect. Grammarians assert that the substitution of एनम् for इमम् or एतम् takes place in case of the re-em-ployment of these pronouns in the subsequent part of a sentence; see Gram. 836; [cf. Gr. ἕν, οἶος Goth. ains; Old Pruss. ains; Lat oinos, unus.]
12757: एना, ind., Ved. in this manner, thus; here, there; then, at that time; पर एना, further on; पर एना पृथिव्या, beyond the earth here.
12758: एनस् एनस्, अस्, n. (fr. इन्, but said to be fr. rt. 5. इ), mischief, crime; curse, unhappiness; sin, offence, fault; censure, blame. —एनस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or एनस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, wicked, sinful, a sinner.
12759: एनस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. caused by crime; sinful, wicked, wrong.
12761: एन्ध् एन्ध् (आ-इन्ध्), cl. 7. A. एन्धे, एन्धितुम्, to kindle, inflame; to be inflamed, to flame.
12762: एध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. simple rt. इन्ध्), kindling, one who kindles, cf. अग्न्य्-एध; (अस्), m. fuel, as wood, grass, &c.; [cf. Gr. αἰθός] —एधाहार (एध-आह्°), अस्, m. one who collects fuel.
12765: एन्व् एन्व् (आ-इन्व्), cl. 1. P. एन्वति, -वितुम्, to bring near, to bestow.
12766: एम एम। See under एतृ above.
12767: एमूष एमूष, अस्, m., Ved. corrupted from एमुषम्, the part. perf. of rt. अम्।
12768: एर् एर् (आ-ईर्), cl. 2. A. एर्ते, एरितुम्, to go to or into: Caus. एरयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to bring near, pro-cure; to obtain; to raise (the voice in singing &c.).
12769: एरक एरक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga; (आ), f. a sort of grass of emollient and diluent properties; (in the Mausala-parva of the Mahā-bh. this grass when plucked by Kṛṣṇa and his family turned to clubs); (अम्), n. a woollen carpet; [cf. ऐरक्य।]
12770: एरङ्ग एरङ्ग, अस्, m. a kind of fish; [cf. एलङ्ग।]
12771: एरण्ड एरण्ड, अस्, m. the castor-oil plant, Palma Christi or Ricinus Communis; (आ), f. long pepper. —एरण्ड-पत्त्रिका, f. or एरण्ड-फला, f. the plant Croton Polyandrum.
12772: एरण्डक, अस्, m. the plant Ricinus Communis.
12773: एरमत्तक एरमत्तक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
12774: एरु एरु, a word of doubtful meaning in Atharva-veda VI. 22, 3.
12775: एर्त्स् एर्त्स्, Desid. of आर्ध्, q. v.
12776: एर्वारु एर्वारु, उस्, m. f. or एर्वारुक, अस्, m. a kind of cucumber, Cucumis Utilissimus.
12777: एल एल, अम्, n. a particular number.
12778: एलद, अम्, n. a particular number.
12779: एलक एलक, अस्, m. a ram. See एडक।
12780: एलङ्ग एलङ्ग, अस्, m. a kind of fish; [cf. एरङ्ग।]
12781: एलपुर एलपुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
12782: एलवालु एलवालु, n. or एलवालुक or एल्ववा-लुक, अम्, n. the fragrant bark of Feronia Elephantum; a granular substance, apparently a vegetable of a red-dish-brown colour (it is used as a drug and perfume).
12783: एलविल एलविल, अस्, m. an epithet of Ku-vera. See ऐलविल।
12784: एला एला, f. cardamoms, the seed of the Elettaria Cardamomum or Alpinia Cardamomum, it applies to both the large and small cardamom, but more commonly to the former; N. of a river; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each. —एला-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga. —एला-पर्णी, f. the plant Mimosa Octandra. —एला-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
12785: एलाक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
12787: एलाय एलाय (less correctly इलाय), nom. P. एलायति, -यितुम्, to be wantonly mischievous or wild in behaviour, to be merry.
12788: एलु एलु, n. a particular number.
12789: एलुक एलुक, N. of a medicinal substance or plant.
12790: एलूक एलूक, अम्, n. probably identical with एडूक, a wall enclosing bones.
12791: एव 1. एव (fr. pronom. base ए, see एतद्, Zend ऐव), so, just so, exactly so (e. g. य एवेदम् इति ब्रवत्, who may say ‘it is so;’ in this sense एव = the more modern word एवम्); like (e. g. त्वम् एव यन्ता, a driver like you; but examples of एव in the sense of इव are rare); indeed, truly, really (often in this sense found in the Veda at the begin-ning of a verse in conjunction with other particles of affirmation, especially with इद्, इद् नु कम्, हि, &c., e. g. एवेन्नु कं ततार, he most certainly crossed; एवा ह्य् असि वीरयुः, thou art indeed hero-like. (In its most frequent use of strengthening the idea expressed by any word, एव, if translateable, must be variously rendered by such adverbs as) just, exactly, very, merely, only, even, at the very moment, immediately on, scarcely, still, already, &c. (e. g. तावतीम् एव रात्रिम्, just so long a night; एवम् एव, exactly so; तान् एव, these very persons; नचिराद् एव, in no very long time; अपः स्पृष्ट्वैव, by merely touching water; जप्येनैव, by sole repetition; अभुक्त्वैव, even without having eaten; इति वदन्न् एव, at the very moment of saying so; नाम्नि कीर्तित एव, scarcely had the name been mentioned; स जीवन्न् एव, he while still living.
12792: एव may often be connected with other adverbs in the sense of ‘also,’ ‘likewise,’ &c., as in the fol-lowing examples: तथैव, so also; तथैव च, and so likewise; एव च, and also; चैव, and also; एव वा, or also; न त्व् एव, but not also. Grammarians assert that एव cuts off the final of क्व when it follows that adverb, as क्व्-एव, where pos-sibly ? i. e. nowhere. Lexicographers affirm that एव may imply emphasis, affirmation, detraction, diminution, command, restraint; or be used as an expletive; [cf. Goth. aiv, Them. aiva; Old Germ. eo, io; Mod. Germ. je: perhaps also Lat. œvum; Goth. ibus; Old Germ. ebanêr; Mod. Germ. ebener, eben.]
12793: एवथा, ind., Ved. indeed, certainly, even; (Sāy. either fr. rt. 5. इ) assailing the strongholds of enemies, going to war; (or fr. rt. अव्) protecting, protection, assistance.
12794: एव 2. एव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 5. इ), Ved. going, moving, speedy, quick; (अस्), m. a course, way, (often in inst. pl., e. g. सनाद् दिवम् परि भुमा स्वेभिर् एवैर् अक्तोषा चरतः, from all eternity day and night move round heaven and earth in their accus-tomed course); earth, world?; (Sāy.) a courser, a fleet horse; (आस्), m. pl. way or manner of acting, mode of proceeding, custom, usage, habit; (Sāy.) desire, a hymn which goes or is directed to the object of praise (e. g. अभि चष्टे सूरो अर्य एवान्, the sun sees into the conduct of the worshipper; or according to Sāy. the sun being a lord makes mani-fest or grants desires). When the inst. c. is used, the meaning is hardly to be distinguished from that in the first example (e. g. स्वैर् एवैः, in his usual way of proceeding; पूर्व्येभिर् एवैः, in the ancient mode; or according to Sāy. with ancient hymns). —एव-या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. going in ways or courses, i. e. either going quickly or going the usual way; epithet of Viṣṇu; (Sāy.) granting protection. —एवया-मरुत्, Ved., (Sāy.) N. of the author of a Ṛg-veda hymn, but perhaps rather an exclamation meaning either एव-या, i. e. ‘Viṣṇu (cf. the pre-ceding word) and the Maruts!’ or ‘moving Maruts.’ —एव-यावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going quickly, or going the usual way; epithet of Viṣṇu and of the Maruts; (Sāy.) going with horses; granting desires.
12795: एवम् एवम्, ind. (cf. 1. एव and एतद्), so, thus, in this way, in such a manner, such. एवम् is not found in the oldest hymns of the Veda, where its place is taken by एव, but occurs in later hymns and in the Brāhmaṇas, especially in connection with the rt. विद्, ‘to know,’ and its derivatives (e. g. य एवं वेद, he who knows so; cf. एवं-विद् below). In classical Sanskrit एवम् occurs very frequently, espe-cially in connection with the roots वच्, ‘to speak,’ and श्रु, ‘to hear,’ and refers to what precedes as well as to what follows (e. g. एवम् उक्त्वा, having so said; एवमेवैतत्, this is so; एवम् अस्तु or एवम् भवतु, be it so, I assent; अस्त्य् एवम्, it is so; यद्य् एवम्, if this be so; किम् एवम्, how so? what is the meaning of it? what does this refer to? मैवम्, not so! एवम् — यथा or यथा — एवम्, so — as). एवम् is often used like an adjective (e. g. एवं ते वचने रतः, rejoicing in such words of thine; where एवम् = एवं-विधे). Sometimes एवम् is merely an expletive. According to lexico-graphers एवम् may imply likeness (so); sameness of manner (thus); assent (yes, verily); affirmation (certainly, indeed, assuredly); command (thus, &c.); and be used as an expletive. —एवं-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, of such a form or kind. —एवं-वाद, अस्, m. such an expression. —एवं-विद्, त्, त्, त्, or एवं-विद्वस्, आन्, उषी, अस्, Ved. knowing so or such, well instructed, familiar with what is right. —एवं-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of such a kind, in such form or manner, such. —एवं-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, strong in such a manner, possessing such a power. —एवं-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, behaving or acting thus, of such a kind. —एवं-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, behaving thus. —एवङ्-कारम्, ind. in this manner. —एवङ्-काल, अस्, आ, अम्, containing so many syllabic instants. —एवङ्-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. thus minded. —एवङ्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, being in such a condition or state, so circumstanced, of such kind; (ए), ind. under such circumstances. —एवङ्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing such qualities or such good qualities. —एवन्-दुःसह, अस्, आ, अम्, so hard to bear. —एवन्-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. so called. —एवम्-अवस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, so situated. —एवम्-आदि, इस्, इस्, इ, or एवम्-आद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having such a beginning, of such qualities or kind. —एवम्-प्रकार or एवम्-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, of such a kind. —एवम्-प्रभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of such power. —एवम्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, of such quality, of such a description, in such a manner, so, such. —एवम्भूत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with any-thing similar. —एवम्-भूमि, इस्, f. such a place, a place like the one just described.
12796: एवार एवार, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. एव and अरम्?), Ved. so prepared, ready; (Sāy.) N. of a man.
12797: एवावद एवा-वद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. so speak-ing, true; (अस्), m., (Sāy.) N. of a man.
12798: एष् 1. एष् (आ-इष्), cl. 6. P. एच्छति, ऐषि-तुम् or -ष्टुम्, to wish, desire.

12869: ऐतशायन, आस्, m. pl. the descendants of Aitaśa.

12976: ओम् ॐ, ind. (said to be fr. rt. अव्; perhaps originally ॐ, which may be derived fr. आं, and this fr. आ), a word of solemn affirmation and respectful assent (sometimes translated by yes, verily, so be it, and in this sense compared with Amen). It is placed at the commencement of most Hindū works, and as a sacred exclamation may be uttered (but not so as to be heard by ears profane) at the beginning and end of a reading of the Vedas or previously to any prayer. It is also regarded as a particle of auspicious salutation (Hail!). ॐ appears first in the Upani-shads as a mystic monosyllable, and is there set forth as the object of profound religious meditation, the highest spiritual efficacy being attributed not only to the whole word but also to the three sounds अ, उ, म्, of which it consists. In later times ॐ is the mystic name for the Hindū triad, and represents the union of the three gods, viz. अ (Viṣṇu), उ (Śiva), म् (Brahmā). It may also be typical of the three Vedas. ॐ is usually called प्रणव, more rarely अक्षरम् or एकाक्षरम्, and only in later times ॐ-कार। The Buddhists use ॐ at the commencement of their विद्या षड्-अक्षरी or mystical formulary in six syllables (viz. ॐ मानि पद्मे हूं). Lexico-graphers affirm that besides the above uses, ॐ may imply command or injunction, removal or warding off (Away! Hence!), and be used as an inceptive par-ticle. Grammarians assert that before ॐ a preced-ing अ or आ at the end of a word should be cut off (e. g. विजयोङ्कारः for विजयौङ्कारः (°य-ओङ्°), thanksgiving for victory; see Gram. 38. b). —ॐ-कार, अस्, m. the sacred and mystical syllable ॐ; the ex-clamation ॐ; pronouncing the syllable ॐ; (आ), f. a Buddhist Śakti or female personification of divine energy. —ओंकार-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. title of a work of Nārāyaṇa. —ओंकार-तीर्थ, N. of a Tīrtha. —ओंकार-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a man.

13239: क 1. क, the first consonant of the alphabet, and the first of the guttural letters, corresponding in sound to क् in keep or किन्ग्. —क-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound क. —ककार-वर्ग, अस्, m. the guttural consonants collectively.
13240: क 2. क, कस्, का, किम्, interrog. pron. (see किम् and 2. कद्, and cf. the following words in which the interrogative base क appears, कतम, कतर, कति, कथम्, कदा, कर्हि, का, &c.), who? which? what? In its declension क follows the pronoun तद् (Gram. 223) except in nom. acc. sing. neut., where किम् has taken the place of कद् or कत् in classical Sanskrit; but the old form कद् is found in the Veda. The interrogative sentence introduced by क is often terminated by इति (e. g. कस्य स पुत्र इति कथ्-यताम्, let it be said, ‘whose son is he?’), but इति may be omitted and the sentence lose its direct interrogative character (e. g. कस्य स पुत्रो न ज्ञायते, it is not known whose son he is). क with or without अस्, ‘to be,’ may express ‘how is it possible that?’ ‘what power have I, you, they, &c.?’ (e. g. के मम धन्विनो ऽन्ये, what can the other archers do against me? के आवाम् परित्रातुम्, what power have we to rescue you?). क is often connected with a demonstrative pron. (e. g. को ऽयम् आयाति, who comes here?) or with the potential (e. g. को हरिं निन्देत्, who will blame Hari?). क is sometimes repeated (e. g. कः को ऽत्र, who is there? कान् कान्, whom? whom? i. e. which of them? cf. Gram. 53. a), and the repetition is often due to a kind of attrac-tion (e. g. केषां किं शास्त्रम् अध्ययनीयम्, which book is to be read by whom? Gram. 836. a). When किम् is connected with the inst. c. of a noun or with the indecl. participle it may express ‘what is gained by doing so, &c.?’ (e. g. नीरुजः किम् औ-षधैः, what is the use of medicine to the healthy? किं विलम्बेन, what is gained by delay? किम् ब-हुना, what is the use of more words? किम् पौरु-षं हत्वा सुप्तम्, what manliness is there in killing one asleep ?).
13241: क is often followed by the particles इव, उ, नाम, नु, वा, स्विद्, some of which serve merely to gene-ralize the interrogation (e. g. किम् इव एतद्, what can this be? क उ श्रवत्, who can possibly hear? को नाम जानाति, who indeed knows? को न्व् अयम्, who is this? किं नु कार्यम्, what is to be done? को वा देवाद् अन्यः, who possibly other than a god? कस्य स्विद् हृदयं नास्ति, of what person is there no heart ?).
13242: क is occasionally used alone as an indefinite pro-noun, especially in negative sentences (e. g. न कस्य को वल्लभः, no one is a favourite of any one; नान्यो जानाति कः, no one else knows; कथं स घातयति कम्, how does he kill any one? More usually, however, क is only made indefinite when con-nected with the particles च, चन, चिद्, वा, and अपि, in which case क may sometimes be preceded by the relative य (e. g. ये के च, any persons whatsoever; यस्यै कस्यै च देवतायै, to any deity whatso-ever; यानि कानि च मित्राणि, any friends whatsoever; यत् किञ्च, whatever). The particle चन, being composed of च and न, properly gives a negative force to the pronoun (e. g. यस्माद् इन्द्राद् ऋते किञ्चन, without which Indra there is nothing), but the negative sense is generally dropped (e. g. कश्चन, any one; न कश्चन, no one), and a relative is sometimes connected with it (e. g. यत् किञ्चन, anything whatsoever). Examles of चिद् with the interrogative are common; वा and अपि are not so common, but the latter is often found in classical Sanskrit (e. g. कश्चिद्, any one; केचिद्, some; न कश्चिद्, no one; न किञ्चिद् अपि, nothing whatso-ever; यः कश्चिद्, any one whatsoever; केचित् — केचित्, some — others; यस्मिन् कस्मिन् वा देशे, in any country whatsoever; न को ऽपि, no one; न किमपि, nothing whatever).
13243: क may sometimes be used, like 2. कद्, at the beginning of a compound. See क-पूय, &c.

13270: ककुह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eminent, excelling others, excellent; (अस्), m., Ved. a part of a carriage, perhaps the seat.
13271: ककेरुक ककेरुक, अस्, m. a worm in the stomach.
13272: कक्क् कक्क्, a various reading for कख्, q. v.
13273: कक्कट कक्कट, अस्, m., Ved. a species of animal, perhaps a kind of bird.
13274: कक्कुल कक्कुल, अस्, m., N. of a Bhikṣu.
13275: कक्कोल कक्कोल, अस्, m., N. of a plant bear-ing a berry, the inner part of which is a waxy and aromatic substance; (अम्), n. or कक्कोलक, अम्, n. a perfume prepared from the berries of this plant.
13276: कक्क्वल्ल कक्क्वल्ल, अस्, m. a patronymic of Guṇacandra.
13277: कक्ख् कक्ख्, a various reading for कख्, q. v.
13278: कक्खट कक्खट, अस्, आ, अम्, hard, solid; (ई), f. chalk. —कक्खट-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. the plant Corchorus Olitorius; (rope is made from its fibre.)
13279: कक्ष कक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कष्), a lurking or hiding-place; an inner recess, the interior of a forest; a forest of dead trees, a dry wood (the lair of wild beasts), grass, dry grass; a spreading creeper, a climbing plant; (आ), f. painful boils in the armpit, side, shoulder, &c.; an elephant's rope, the string round his neck, also his girth; a woman's girdle or zone; a surrounding wall, a wall; a place surrounded by walls; a court or court-yard; an en-closure; a secluded portion of an edifice; a private or inner chamber, the private apartment for women &c., a room in general; a particular part of a carriage; resemblance, similarity; objection or reply in argu-ment; emulation, rivalry, object of emulation; the jeweller's weight, the Retti; (अस्, आ), m. f. the end of the lower garment which, after the cloth is carried round the body, is brought up behind and tucked into the waistband; a border, lace; the scale or basin of a balance; (अम्), n. a star, a constellation (perhaps a wrong reading for ऋक्ष); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —कक्ष-धर, अम्, n. the part of the body where the upper arm is connected with the shoulder, the shoulder-joint. —कक्ष-प, अस्, m. one of the nine treasures of Kuvera; [cf. कच्छप।] —कक्ष-पुट, अस्, m. the armpit; title of a work on magic. —कक्ष-रुहा, f. a fragrant grass, Cyperus. —कक्ष-शाय, अस्, m. a dog; [cf. कङ्कशाय।] —कक्ष-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a Rā-jarshi. —कक्ष-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated on the side, seated on the hip or flank. —कक्षाध्याय (°ष-अध्°), अस्, m., N. of a part of a commentary by Bhūdhara on the Sūrya-siddhānta. —कक्षान्-तर (°ष-अन्°), अम्, n. the inner or private apartment. —कक्षा-पट, अस्, m. a cloth passed between the legs to cover the privities. —कक्षा-पुटि, इस्, m., N. of a physician; (wrong reading for काक्षपुटि ?). —कक्षावेक्षक, अस्, m. (कक्षा + अवेक्षक fr. rt. ईक्ष् with अव), a guard of the inner or queen's apartments; keeper of a royal garden; a door-keeper; a poet; a debauchee; a player, a painter; warmth of feeling, strength of sentiment. —कक्षी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, assented, pro-mised, (touching the armpit with the hand was per-haps a manner of affirming anything; cf. उरसि कृ under उरस्।) —कक्षोत्था (°ष-उत्°), f. a fragrant grass, Cyperus.
13280: कक्षक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
13281: कक्षतु, उस्, m., N. of a plant.
13282: कक्षाय, nom. A. कक्षायते, -यितुम्, to wait for any one in a hidden place, lie in ambush; to intend anything wicked.
13283: कक्षीवत्, आन्, m. (fr. कक्ष्या), N. of a renowned Ṛṣi, sometimes called Pajriya; he is the author of several hymns of the Ṛg-veda, and is described in legends as a son of Uśij and Dīrgha-tamas; (अन्तस्), m. pl. the family or the descendants of Kakṣīvat.
13284: कक्षेयु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Raudrāśva and Ghṛtācī.
13285: कक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. consisting of shrubs or dry grass; secret; (Sāy.) filling the girth, as a well-fed horse; (आ), f. the girth of an elephant or horse, con-sisting of rope or leather; a woman's girdle or zone; metaphorically the fingers (encircling the Soma cup); an upper garment, the border or lace of one; the enclosure of an edifice, i. e. either the wall &c. so en-closing it, or the court or chamber constituting the enclosure, the inner apartment of a palace; similarity; effort, exertion; a shrub yielding the black and red berry that serves as a jeweller's weight, the Retti or Gunja, Abrus Precatorius; (अम्), n. the cup or re-ceptacle of a balance; a part of a carriage. —कक्ष्य-प्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. filling the girth (as a well-fed horse). —कक्ष्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with a girth. —कक्ष्यावेक्षक, अस्, m. = कक्षा-वेक्षक, q. v. —कक्ष्या-स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a hymn by Divākara-vatsa.
13286: कख् कख्, cl. 1. P. कखति, -खितुम्, to laugh, laugh at or deride: Caus. P. कखयति, -यितुम्, to cause to laugh; [cf. Lat. cachinnare; Gr. καχάζω, καγχάζω.]
13287: कख्या कख्या, f. an enclosure, a division of a large building; (a wrong reading for कक्ष्या।)
13288: कग् कग्, cl. 1. P. कगति, -गितुम्, to act, perform.
13289: कङ्क् कङ्क्, cl. 1. A. कङ्कते, -कितुम्, to go; [cf. Hib. cichet, ‘walking;’ ciocair, ‘a way, a road:’ Lith. kankù; ifs-kankù, ‘to come to.’]
13290: कङ्क कङ्क, अस्, m. a heron (a bird of prey?); a kind of mango; an epithet of Yama; N. of a king; a Vṛṣṇi; a son of Ugra-sena, a son of Śūra; pl., N. of a people; a title of Yudhiṣṭhira (from his assuming the disguise of a Brāhman before king Virāṭa); a false or pretended Brāhman; a man of the second or military tribe (perhaps a man of that caste pretending to be a Brāhman); one of the eighteen divisions of the continent; the brother of Kaṃsa; (आ), f. a sort of sandal; scent of the lotus; N. of a daughter of Ugra-sena and sister of Kaṅka. —कङ्क-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. collected into a heap resembling a heron. —कङ्क-तुण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas. —कङ्क-त्रोट, अस्, or कङ्क-त्रोटि, इस्, m. a kind of fish, commonly काङ्किला; Esox Kankila. —कङ्क-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a heron's feather fixed on an arrow; (अस्, आ, अम्), furnished with the feathers of a heron; (अस्), m. an arrow furnished with heron's feathers. —कङ्कपत्त्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, furnished with heron's feathers. —कङ्क-पर्वन्, आ, m., N. of a serpent. —कङ्क-माला, f. a kind of musical instru-ment; beating time by clapping the hands. —कङ्क-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, shaped like a heron's mouth; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a pair of tongs, a sort of forceps. —कङ्क-शत्रु, उस्, m. the plant Desmodium Gangeticum. —कङ्क-शाय, अस्, m. a dog (sleeping like a heron).
13291: कङ्कट कङ्कट or कङ्कटक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कङ्क्), mail, defensive armour; an iron hook to goad an elephant.
13293: कङ्कण कङ्कण, अस्, अम्, m. n. Lith. kan-kala-s.] —कङ्कण-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town, called from कङ्कण-वर्ष. —कङ्कण-प्रिय, अस्, m., N. of a servant of Śiva. —कङ्कण-भू-षण, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with tinkling orna-ments. —कङ्कण-मणी, f. the jewel in a bracelet. —कङ्कण-वर्ष, अस्, m., N. of an alchemist; epithet of the king Kṣemagupta.
13294: कङ्कणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ornamented with a bracelet.
13295: कङ्कणीका, f. an ornament furnished with bells; a string tied round the wrist.
13296: कङ्कत कङ्कत, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. or कङ्क-तिका, f. a comb, a hair-comb; (अस्), m. a tree; (accord-ing to Sāy.) a poisonous animal, a slightly venomous reptile (mentioned in a verse of Ṛg-veda 1. 191, used as a mystical spell against poison).
13297: कङ्कतीय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a family.
13298: कङ्कर कङ्कर, अस्, ई, अम्, vile, bad; (अम्), n. buttermilk mixed with water; a high number, = 100 niyutas.
13299: कङ्करोल कङ्करोल, अस्, m. the plant Alan-gium Hexapetalum. See निकोचक।
13300: कङ्कलोड्य कङ्कलोड्य, अम्, n. a kind of drug, = अल्कलोड्य।
13301: कङ्काल कङ्काल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a skeleton; [cf. Mod. Gr. κώκαλον.] —कङ्काल-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a Dānava. —कङ्काल-भैरव-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —कङ्कालमालिन्, ई, m. an epi-thet of Śiva, whose necklace is formed of bones.
13302: कङ्कालय कङ्कालय or कल्कालय, अस्, m., N. of an author.

13304: कङ्कुष्ठ कङ्कुष्ठ, अस्, m. a medicinal earth, described as of two colours, one of a silvery and one of a gold colour, or one of a light and one of a dark yellow.
13306: कङ्केरु कङ्केरु, उस्, m. a kind of crow.
13307: कङ्केल्ल कङ्केल्ल, अस्, m. the tree Jonesia Aśoka; a kind of pot-herb, Chenopodium Esculentum.
13309: कङ्कोल कङ्कोल, अस्, m. a king of the Nāgas; N. of the author of a hymn called Gaṇapatyārādhana.
13310: कङ्ख कङ्ख, अम्, n. enjoyment, fruition; (perhaps a combination of क and ख।)
13311: कङ्गु कङ्गु, उस्, f. or कङ्गुनी, f. a kind of Panic seed, Panicum Italicum; several varieties of it are cultivated and form articles of food for the poor. —कङ्गुनी-पत्त्रा, f. a kind of grass, = पण्यान्धा।
13312: कङ्गुल कङ्गुल, अस्, m. the hand; [cf. अङ्गुलि।]
13313: कच् कच्, cl. 1. A. कचते, चकचे, कचि-तुम्, to bind; to shine; P. कचति, to sound, cry; [cf. कञ्च्; cf. also Hib. cacht, ‘a strait, a narrow place; bonds, fetters.’]
13314: कच, अस्, m. the hair (especially of the head); a cicatrix, a dry or healed sore, a scar; a binding, band; the hem of a garment; a cloud; N. of a son of Bṛhaspati; N. of a place; (आ), f. a female elephant; beauty, brilliancy; [cf. अ-कच, उत्-कच, &c.] —कच-प, अस्, m. ‘cloud-drinker,’ grass; a leaf; (अम्), n. a vessel for vegetables; a leaf of a vegetable (?). —कच-पक्ष or कच-पाश, अस्, m. thick or ornamented hair. —कच-माल, अस्, m. smoke; (per-haps a wrong reading for खतमाल?). —कच-रिपु-फला, f., N. of a tree; see शमी. —कच-हस्त, अस्, m. thick or ornamented hair, a beautiful head of hair. —कचा-कचि, ind. hair against hair, pulling each other's hair. —कचाचित (°च-अच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having long or dishevelled hair. —कचामोद (°च-आम्°), अम्, n. a fragrant ointment for the hair.
13315: कचङ्गन कचङ्गन, अम्, n. a free market, a place of sale paying no duty or custom; [cf. कराङ्-गण, अङ्गण, and अङ्गन।]
13316: कचङ्गल कचङ्गल, अम्, n. the ocean; N. of a region.
13317: कचाकु कचाकु, उस्, उस्, उ, ill-disposed, wicked; intolerable, difficult to be borne; difficult to be attained; (उस्), m. a snake.
13318: कचाटुर कचाटुर, अस्, m. a gallinule. See दात्यूह।
13319: कचु कचु, उस्, f. an esculent root, Arum Colocasia and other kinds, many of which are culti-vated for food. See कच्वी।
13320: कचेल कचेल, अम्, n. a string or cover con-taining and keeping together the leaves of a manu-script; (perhaps a various reading for काचन।)
13321: कच्चट कच्चट, अम्, n. an aquatic plant, = जलपिप्पली।
13322: कच्चर कच्चर (कद्-चर,) अस्, आ, अम्, dirty, foul; spoiled, spoiled by dirt; vile, wicked, bad; (अम्), n. buttermilk diluted with water; [cf. कङ्-कर, कटुर, &c.]
13323: कच्चिद् कच्-चिद् (= कद्-चिद्)। See under 2. कद्।
13324: कच्छ कच्छ, अस्, अम्, m. n. 13325: कच्छटिका or कच्छाटिका or कच्छाटी, f. the end or hem of a lower garment or cloth gathered up behind and tucked into the waistband.
13326: कच्छपिका, f. a pimple, a blotch or wart; a wart accompanying gonorrhœa.
13327: कच्छर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
13329: कच्छिय कच्छिय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (various readings have कक्ष and कच्छ।)
13330: कच्छु कच्छु, उस्, or कच्छू, ऊस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. कष्), itch, formation of watery pustules on the hands &c., scab. 13331: कच्छुर, अस्, आ, अम्, scabby, itchy; unchaste, libidinous; (आ), f. the plant Alhagi Maurorum; a species of Curcuma; the plant Carpopogon Pruriens.
13332: कच्छोर, अम्, n. a kind of Curcuma.
13333: कच्वी कच्वी, f. a plant with an esculent root (Arum Colocasia) cultivated for food.
13334: कज् कज्, cl. 1. P. कजति, -जितुम्, to be happy; to be confused with joy, pride or sorrow; to grow, (in the last sense a Sautra root.)
13336: कजिङ्ग कजिङ्ग, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
13337: कज्जल कज्जल, अस्, m. (in the first sense from कद्-जल), a cloud; (अम्), n. lampblack, con-sidered as a collyrium and applied to the eyelashes or eyelids medicinally or as an ornament, also sulphu-ret of lead or antimony so used; (आ, ई), f. the fish Cyprinus Atratus, or any kind peculiar to stagnant waters, whence the name; (ई), f. sulphuret of mer-cury, Æthiop's mineral; ink. —कज्जल-ध्वज, अस्, m. a lamp. —कज्जल-रोचक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the wooden stand or tripod on which a lamp is placed, a candlestick. —कज्जली-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
13338: कज्जलित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with lampblack or with a collyrium prepared from it.
13339: कज्ज्वल कज्ज्वल, अम्, n. lampblack, especially considered as an application to the eyes; [cf. कज्जल।]
13340: कञ्च् कञ्च्, cl. 1. A. कञ्चते, चकञ्चे, कञ्चितुम्, to bind; to shine; [cf. कच् and काञ्च्।]
13341: कञ्चट कञ्चट, अस्, m. the aquatic plant Commelina Salicifolia and C. Bengalensis.
13342: कञ्चड, अस्, m. the plant Commelina Bengalensis.
13343: कञ्चार कञ्चार, अस्, m. the sun.
13344: कञ्चिका कञ्चिका, f. a small boil; the branch of a bamboo.
13345: कञ्चुक कञ्चुक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कञ्च् ?), a dress fitting close to the upper part of the body; armour, mail; a bodice, jacket; the skin of a snake; cloth, clothes; a kind of drawers or short breeches; a strap of leather; the cast-off skin of a snake; (ई), f., N. of a plant.
13347: कञ्चुकित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with armour or mail.
13348: कञ्चुकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with armour or mail; (ई), m. an attendant on or overseer of the women's apartments, a chamberlain; a libidinous man, a de-bauchee, one addicted to women; a serpent; N. of several plants, Agallochum, barley, Cicer Arietinum. —कञ्चुकि-रेचक, औ, m. du. the chamberlain and the forester.
13349: कञ्चुलिका, f. a bodice or jacket.
13350: कञ्चूल, अस्, अम्, m. n. an article of female dress, perhaps a bodice.
13351: कञ्ज कञ्-ज, अस्, m.
