(अस्), m. a kind of medicinal plant; (आ), f. a species of plant, = देव-बला, = सह-देवी. —देवालय (°व-आल्°), अस्, m. ‘the residence of the gods,’ heaven; a temple. —देवा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = देव-वत्, q. v. —देवावतार (°व-अव्°), अस्, m. ‘the place of descent of a god (?),’ N. of a place. —देवा-वसथ (°व-आव्°), अस्, m. ‘the habitation of a deity,’ a temple. —देवावास (°व-आव्°), अस्, m. ‘the residence of a god or gods,’ a temple; an epithet of the tree Ficus Religiosa. —देवावी (°व-अवी), ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. gladdening or satisfying the gods, agreeable to the gods. —देवा-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. gladdening or satisfying the gods; (त्), m., N. of a mountain; (also read देवा-वृध।) —देवा-वृध, अस्, m., N. of a prince who was father of Babhru [cf. दैवा-वृध]; of a mountain; [cf. देवा-वृध्।] —दे-वाश्व (°व-अश्°), अस्, m. the horse of a god, a divine horse; Indra's horse Uccaiḥ-śravas. —देवासुर (°व-अस्°), आस्, m. pl. the gods and the Asuras; [cf. दै-वासुर।] —देवासुर-गुरु, उस्, m. ‘the preceptor of the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवासुर-नमस्कृत, अस्, m. ‘worshipped by the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवासुर-महामात्र, अस्, m. ‘the chief of the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवासुर-महाश्रय (°हा-आश्°), अस्, m. ‘the great refuge of the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवासुर-महेश्वर (°हा-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘the great lord of the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवासुर-युद्ध, अम्, n. the battle between the gods and Asuras. —देवासुर-वर-प्रद, अस्, m. ‘conferring boons on the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवासुर-सङ्ग्राम, अस्, m. the war between the gods and Asuras. —देवासुरेश्वर (°र-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘the lord of the gods and Asuras,’ epithet of Śiva. —देवाहार (°व-आह्°), अस्, m. ‘food of the gods,’ divine food, ambrosia. —देवाह्वय (°व-आह्°), अस्, m. ‘called Deva,’ N. of a prince. —देवि-दास, अस्, m. (for देवी-द्°), ‘the slave of the goddess,’ N. of a man; N. of a commentator on the Mugdha-bodha. —देवी-कोट, अस्, m. = शोनित-पुर, N. of a town (the city of Vāṇa, probably Devicotta on the Coromandel coast). —देवी-गर्भ-गृह, अस्, m. ‘a house containing an image of the goddess Durgā,’ a shrine of the goddess Durgā. —देवी-गृह, अम्, n. a temple of the goddess (Durgā); the apartment of a queen. —देवी-तन्त्र, अम्, n. ‘the Tantra of the goddess (Durgā),’ N. of a Tantra. —देवी-त्व, अम्, n. ‘the state of being a goddess,’ the rank of a goddess; the rank of a queen. —देवी-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of the father of Rāma-sevaka and grandfather of Kṛṣṇa-mitra. —देवीन्-धियक, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the words देवीं धिया (as an Anu-vāka or Adhyāya). —देवी-पाद-द्वय, अम्, n. ‘the two feet of the goddess, i. e. of Durgā,’ N. of a holy bathing-place. —देवी-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa. —देवी-भवन, अम्, n. the temple of the goddess (Durgā). —देवी-भा-गवत-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa. —देवी-महादेव, अम्, n., N. of a play. —देवी-महिमन्, आ, m., N. of a work, (perhaps = the following.) —देवी-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. ‘the majesty of Durgā,’ N. of a section of the Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa. —देवीर्-आपसक, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the words देवीर् आपः (as an Anu-vāka or Adhyāya). —देवी-सूक्त, अम्, n. ‘the hymn of the goddess,’ N. of a hymn to Durgā. —देवेज् (°व-इज्), ट्, ट्, ट्, sacrificing to the gods, worshipping them. —देवेज्य (°व-इज्°), अस्, m. ‘the preceptor of the gods,’ an epithet of Bṛhas-pati, the planet Jupiter. —देवेद्ध (°व-इद्ध), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. kindled by the gods. —देवेन्द्र (°व-इन्°), अस्, m. ‘the chief of the gods,’ an epithet of Indra; of Śiva; N. of a man. —देवेन्द्र-बुद्-धि, इस्, m. ‘having the intellect of the chief of the gods,’ N. of a learned Buddhist. —देवेन्द्र-स-मय, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist work; of a part of the Suvarṇa-prabhāsa. —देवेश (°व-ईश), अस्, m. ‘the chief of the gods,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; of Indra; (ई), f. ‘the queen of the gods,’ epithet of Durgā; of Devakī who was mother of Kṛṣṇa. —देवेश-तीर्थ, अम्, n. ‘the Tīrtha of the chief of the gods,’ N. of a Tīrtha. —देवे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘resting or reposing on a god,’ epithet of Viṣṇu. —देवेश्वर (°व-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘the sovereign of the gods,’ an epithet of Śiva; N. of an author. —देवेश्वर-पण्डित, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —दे-वेषित (°व-इष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sent or impelled by the gods. —देवेष्ट (°व-इष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wished by the gods, acceptable to the gods; (अस्, आ), m. f. a sort of drug (reckoned among the Aṣṭa-varga, = महा-मेदा); bdellium; (आ), f. the wild lime tree (= वन-वीजपूरक). —देवैनस (°व-एन्°), अम्, n., Ved. the curse of the gods. —देवोद्-यान (°व-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘the grove of the gods,’ a sacred grove, a garden near a temple or consecrated to a deity. —देवोपासक (°व-उप्°), अस्, m. a worshipper of the gods. —देवौकस् (°व-ओक्°), अस्, n. ‘the residence of the gods,’ the mountain Meru. —देव्य्-आगम, अस्, m. ‘the arrival of the goddess,’ N. of a work. —देव्य्-उपनिषद्, त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
22687: देवक, अस्, इका, अम्, who or what sports or plays; divine, celestial, godlike, &c.; (अस्), m. a god, deity, (at the end of an adj. comp.); N. of a man; of a Gandharva; of a prince, son of Āhuka and father of Devakī who was mother of Kṛṣṇa; of a son of Yudhi-ṣṭhira and Yaudheyī or Pauravī [cf. देविका]; a familiar diminutive for Deva-datta, q. v.; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the inhabitants of a Varṣa in Krauñca-dvīpa; (इका), f. a diminutive of Devī; N. of a class of goddesses of an inferior order; (आस्), f. pl. the oblations made to the aforesaid goddesses (viz. to Anu-matī, Rākā, Sinīvālī, Kuhū, and to Dhātṛ); N. of the wife of Yudhi-ṣṭhira and mother of Yaudheya; of a river; of a country [? cf. दाविक]; the thorn-apple (= धुस्तूरा); (अका), f. a familiar diminutive for Deva-dattā, q. v.; (अकी), f., N. of a daughter of Devaka, (she was the wife of Vasu-deva and mother of Kṛṣṇa); N. of Aditi; of Dākṣāyaṇī. —देवकी-नन्दन or देवकि-नन्दन or देवकी-पुत्र, अस्, m. or देवकी-सूनु, उस्, m. ‘the son of Devakī,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —देवकी-मातृ, ता, f. the mother of Devakī.
22688: देवकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, divine, godlike, belonging or relating to a divinity; [cf. देवक्य।]
22689: देवक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, divine, godlike; correspond-ing to the number of the gods; (आ), f. epithet of the metre Anuṣṭubh; [cf. देवकीय।]
22690: देवत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp.) having as one's deity; sacred to a deity [cf. एक-द्°, किं-द्°, दैवत्य]; (आ), f., Ved. (perhaps) N. of a particular species of animal.
22691: देवन्, आ, m. a husband's brother; [cf. देवृ।]
22692: 2. देवन, अस्, m. (for 1. see rt. देव्, p. 430, col. 1), a die, dice for gambling; (आ), f. sport, wanton sport or pastime; service; (अम्), n. shining, splendor, lustre, beauty; gaming, gambling, a game at dice; sport, play, pastime; a play or pleasure-ground, a garden; a lotus; praise; emulation, desire to excel or overcome; affair, business, profession; going, motion.
22693: देवयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (from a Nom. देवय), Ved. following the gods, serving the gods, religious; desirous of divinity (?); shining (?); [cf. अ-द्° and देवायत्।]
22694: देवयु, उस्, ऊ, उ, Ved. loving the gods, devoted to the gods, pious, virtuous, righteous; frequenting sacred festivals; (उस्), m. a deity; [cf. अ-द्°।]
22695: देवर or देवरक, अस्, m. a husband's brother, especially his younger brother; a beloved person; a husband; [cf. Lith. de†weris; Gr. δαήρ; Lat. levir for devir; Slav. dever; Angl. Sax. tacur, tacor; Old Germ. zeihur.]
22696: देवल, अस्, m. an attendant upon an idol; a Brāhman of an inferior order who subsists upon the offerings made to the idols he attends, and who conducts various ceremonies for hire; a holy or virtuous man; N. of a descendant of Kaśyapa, author of the hymns of the ninth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda; an epithet of Asita, (according to other authorities a son of Asita); N. of an astronomer; of a legislator; of the son of Pratyūṣa; of the elder brother of Dhaumya; of the husband of Eka-parṇā; of the father of Sannati who was wife of Brahma-datta; of the grandfather of Pāṇini; of a son of Kṛśāśva by Dhiṣaṇā, wrongly identified with Nārada, with whom Asita Devala is sometimes associated.
22697: देवलक, अस्, m. the attendant on an idol. See the preceding.
22699: देवाला, f. one of the female personifications of music.
22700: देविक, अस्, ई, अम्, appertaining to or derived from a deity, divine; (अस्), m. a familiar diminutive of Deva-datta; (आ), f., see under देवक।
22701: देवितृ, ता, m. a dice-player, gamester, dicer.
22703: देविन्, ई, इनी, इ, gambling, a gambler, gamester.
22704: देविय, अस्, m. a familiar diminutive of Deva-datta.
22705: देविल, अस्, आ, अम्, appertaining to a deity, divine; virtuous, pious, just; (अस्), m. a familiar diminutive of Deva-datta.
22706: देवीक for देवी, a queen &c. (at the end of an adj. comp.; cf. स-द्°।) —देवीक-वच, अम्, n. ‘the prayer of Durgā,’ N. of a mystical book treating of the worship of Durgā.
22707: देवृ, आ, m. a husband's brother, especially his younger brother; the husband of a woman previously married. —देवृ-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, loving the brother of one's husband.
22708: देव्य, अम्, n., Ved. divine dignity or power, rank, godhead.
22709: देवकड देवकड, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a Grāma.
22710: देवट देवट, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. देव्, q. v.), an artist, artisan.
22711: देवट्टी देवट्टी, f. a sort of gull, Larus Ridibundus (= गङ्गाचिल्ली).
22712: देश देश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. दिश्), any place or spot shown or pointed out; place or spot in general, region, country (whether inhabited or unin-habited, e. g. देशम् आवस् or निविश्, to settle in a place; आत्मीय-देश, one's own country); a province, part, department, side, portion; an institute, ordinance; देश occurs at the end of some comps., the fem. ending in आ; [cf. अ-द्°, एक-द्°, वि-द्°, &c.] —देश-काल, औ, m. du. place and time. —देश-कालज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the (proper) place and time. —देश-काल-विद्, त्, त्, त्, knowing place and time. —देश-काल-विभाग, अस्, m. apportioning of place and time. —देश-काल-व्यवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, regulated by place and time. —देश-ज or देश-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘country-born,’ native, indigenous; born in the right place; produced in the right country (as a horse, ele-phant, &c.); of genuine descent; genuine; [cf. देश्य।] —देश-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the district, familiar with places. —देश-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seen or experienced in a country; customary in a country; considered locally, judged as to place. —देश-धर्म, अस्, m. local law, local rights or customs, the law or usage of any country. —देश-निर्णय, अस्, m. ‘description of countries,’ N. of a work. —देश-भाषा, f. the dialect of a country. —देश-भ्र-मण, अम्, n. wandering about, peregrination, tour. —देश-राज-चरित, अम्, n. ‘history of native princes,’ N. of a work. —देश-रूप, अम्, n. ‘the being in the right place,’ conformity with place, pro-priety, fitness. —देश-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, residing in a country. —देश-वृत्त, अम्, n. a circle depending upon its relative position with regard to the spot from which it is observed. —देश-व्यवहार, अस्, m. local usage, custom of the country. —देश-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated or living in a country. —देशा-चार (°श-आच्°), अस्, m. local usage or custom. —दे-शातिथि (°श-अत्°), इस्, m. ‘a guest in a country,’ a foreigner. —देशान्तर (°श-अन्°), अम्, n. another country, abroad, foreign parts; longitude or difference of longitude; the distance from the chief meridian. —देशान्तर-फल, अम्, n. the equation for dif-ference of meridian. —देशान्तर-भाण्डानयन (°ड-आन्°), अम्, n. importing wares from foreign coun-tries. —देशान्तरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, belonging to another country, foreign, a foreigner. —देशापेक्ष (°श-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, spying or inspecting a land.
22713: देशक, अस्, इका, अम्, who or what shows, points out, describes, directs, teaches, &c.; a shower, indi-cator; (अस्), m. a ruler, governor; a guide, instructor.
22714: देशना, f. direction, command, instruction, doctrine.
22715: देशिक, अस्, आ, अम्, familiar with a place, a guide; (अस्), m. a Guru or spiritual teacher; a traveller, stranger, sojourner; [cf. दैशिक।]
22716: देशित, अस्, आ, अम्, directed, commanded; shown, pointed out; advised, instructed.
22717: देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, showing, pointing out, instructing, guiding; of or belonging to a country; (इनी), f. the index or fore-finger.
22718: देशी, f., scil. भाषा, the dialect of a country; N. of a Rāgiṇī, (according to Hanu-mat) wife of the Rāga Dīpaka. —देशी-कोष, अस्, m. a vocabulary of the dialect of a country.
22719: देशीय, अस्, आ, अम्, peculiar or belonging to a country or province, provincial, native; (at the end of a comp.) inhabiting any country (e. g. मागध-देशीयस्, an inhabitant of Māgadha); bordering upon, contiguous, not very distant from, almost (in this sense regarded by Indian grammarians as an affix, see पञ्च-वर्षक-द्°, पटु-द्°, &c.). —देशीय-भाषा, f. the dialect of a country, native dialect. —देशीय-वराडी, N. of a Rāga ?; (also read देशी-वराडी।)
22720: देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pointed out, to be ordered or proved; being in a place or on the spot, present at any transaction (and so witnessing it); belonging to or being in a country, local, provincial, inhabiting or coming from a country, (often at the end of a comp., e. g. नाना-द्°, coming from various countries; तद्-द्°, inhabiting the same country); born in or belonging to one's own country, native; born at the right place or in the right country, of genuine descent; genuine [cf. देश-ज]; contiguous, not far from, almost [cf. देशीय above, and see वितस्ति-द्°, शिशु-द्°, पटु-द्°, &c.]; (अस्), m. an eye-witness of anything, one who was on the spot; the inhabitant of a country; (अम्), n. the proposition, the statement or exhibition of a question or argument; the fact or thing to be proved or substantiated; [cf. अ-द्°।] —देश्य-भिक्षु, उस्, m. a native mendicant.
22721: देष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pointed out or shown or declared.
22722: देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who shows or directs or points out, an indicator; (ट्री), f., N. of a divine female (= धर्माद्य्-उपदेश-कर्त्री).
22723: देष्ट्र, अम्, n., Ved. direction, order; promise.
22724: देशकारी देशकारी, f., N. of a Rāgiṇī or musical mode, (according to Hanu-mat) the wife of the Rāga Megha; [cf. देव-किरी।]
22725: देशाख देशाख and देशाग, अस्, m., N. of a Rāga; (ई), f., N. of a Rāgiṇī.
22726: देष्ठ देष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. 1. दा), Ved. giving the most, most liberal, greatest giver.
22727: देष्ण, अम्, n., Ved. giving, a gift; [cf. कु-मार-द्°, चारु-द्°, तुवि-द्°।]
22728: 1. देष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, liberal, giving, a donor.
22729: देष्णु 2. देष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. 3. दा or 4. दा ?), difficult of subjection, intractable, ungovernable.
22730: देष्णु 3. देष्णु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 7. दा), a washerman.
22731: देह देह, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. 1. दिह्, be-cause it defiles or perhaps rather because it envelopes the soul), the body; (ई), f. a mound, bank, rampart, surrounding wall; [cf. Goth. leik, ‘dead body;’ Old Germ. līh; Mod. Germ. leiche.] —देह-कर, अस्, m. ‘the former of the body,’ a father. —देह-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘creating the bodies, i. e. body and life,’ an epithet of the Sun; a father. —देह-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, forming the body; (त्), m. a father; epithet of Śiva. —देह-कोष, अस्, m. the covering of the body; skin, epidermis; a feather, wing; [cf. देह-धि।] —देह-क्षय, अस्, m. decay of the body, sickness, disease. —देह-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘gone into a body,’ incarnate. —देह-ग्रहण, अम्, n. assuming a body or visible form. —देह-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, separated or detached from the body (as excrement or the spirit). —देह-ज, अस्, m. ‘born of the body,’ a son. —देह-तन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, see तन्त्र, p. 362, col. 1. —देह-त्याग, अस्, m. resigning or relinquishing the body, dying; death in general, voluntary death. —देह-द, अस्, m. ‘what gives a body or life (?),’ quicksilver (= पार-द). —देह-दीप, अस्, m. ‘lamp of the body,’ the eye. —देह-धर्म, अस्, m. the function or law of the body. —देह-धारक, अम्, n. ‘sup-porter of the body,’ a bone. —देह-धारण, अम्, n. ‘supporting the body,’ living, life (e. g. पूर्वस्मिन् देह-धारणे, in a former life or existence). —देह-धि, इस्, m. ‘sustaining the body,’ a wing; [cf. देह-कोष।] —देह-धृष्, क्, m. ‘carrying or sustaining the body,’ air, wind; (धृक् is by some derived fr. rt. धृ or दृह्।) —देह-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possessed of a body, corporeal; (क्), m. a being possessed of a body or of life, especially a man. —देह-भुज्, क्, m. ‘possessed of a body,’ an epithet of Śiva. —देह-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, ‘carrying a body,’ embodied, corporeal; (त्), m. a living being, especially a man; an epithet of Śiva; life, vitality. —देह-मात्रावशेषित (°त्र-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of all except the body, having merely the body left. —देह-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, proud of the body. —दे-हम्-भर, अस्, आ, अम्, intent upon nourishing the body, minding only one's own body, an epi-cure, gluttonous. —देह-यात्रा, f. ‘departure of the body,’ dying, death; nourishment, food, prolonging bodily life. —देह-लक्षण, अम्, n. a mole, spot or mark upon the body. —देह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with a body, embodied; (आन्), m. a living being, a man; the soul. —देह-वायु, उस्, m. an air of the body, a vital air; [cf. अपान, उदान, प्राण, व्यान, समान।] —देह-विसर्जन, अम्, n. quitting the body, death. —देह-शङ्कु, उस्, m. (according to a commentator) a column or pillar of stone. —देह-सञ्चारिणी, f. a daughter. —देह-सार, अस्, m. ‘essence of the body,’ marrow. —देह-स्वभाव, अस्, m. bodily temperament. —देहात्म-वाद, अस्, m. materialism; see the next. —देहात्म-वादिन् (°ह-आत्°), ई, इनी, इ, one who asserts that the body and soul are one, a materialist, a Cārvāka. —देहान्-तर (°ह-अन्°), अम्, n. another body, another embodied state (in the doctrine of metempsychosis). —देहान्तर-प्राप्ति, इस्, f. ‘obtaining another body,’ transmigration. —देहावरण (°ह-आव्°), अम्, n. ‘screen for the body,’ armour; dress. —देहेश्वर (°ह-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of the body,’ the soul. —देहोद्-भव or देहोद्भूत (°ह-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, born in the body, innate.
22733: देहलि, इस्, or देहली, f. the threshold of a door, the sill or lower part of the wooden frame of a door or a raised terrace in front of it. —देहली-मुक्त-पुष्प, अम्, n. a flower dropped on the threshold.
22734: देहिका, f. a sort of ant or insect which throws up the earth; [cf. उद्-देहिका।]
22735: देहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a body, corporeal, em-bodied; (ई), m. living, a living being, especially a man; the spirit, soul (enveloped in the body); (इनी), f. the earth.
22736: दै दै, cl. 1. P. दायति, &c., to purify, cleanse; to protect; [cf. rts. 5. दा and दे।]
22737: दैक्ष दैक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दीक्षा), relating to initiation, inauguration, &c.
22738: दैतेय दैतेय, अस्, m. (fr. दिति), a son of Diti, an Asura, an enemy of the gods, (especially) epithet of Rāhu; (अस्, ई, अम्), proceeding from or belonging to the Daiteyas.
22739: दैत्य, अस्, m. a son of Diti, a demon; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging or relating to the Daityas; (आ), f. a kind of fragrant plant (= मुरा); a perfume; a drug (= चण्डौषधि); spirituous liquor. —दैत्य-गुरु, उस्, m. ‘the preceptor of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Śukra, the regent of the planet Venus. —दैत्य-दानव-मर्दन, अस्, m. ‘subduer or crusher of Daityas and Dānavas,’ a title of Indra. —दैत्य-देव, अस्, m. ‘the god of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Varuṇa, deity of the waters; Air or Wind personified. —दैत्य-द्वीप, अस्, m. ‘refuge or pro-tector of the Daityas (?),’ N. of a son of Garuḍa. —दैत्य-निसूदन, अस्, m. ‘the destroyer of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —दैत्य-प, अस्, or दैत्य-पति, इस्, m. ‘the prince of the Daityas,’ epi-thet of Bali. —दैत्य-पुरोधस्, आस्, or दैत्य-पु-रोहित, or दैत्य-पूज्य, अस्, m. ‘family priest of the Daityas, to be honoured by them,’ epithet of Śukra, regent of Venus. —दैत्य-मातृ, ता, f. ‘mother of the Daityas,’ epithet of Diti. —दैत्य-मेद-ज, अस्, m. ‘produced from the marrow of a Daitya,’ a kind of bdellium (= भूमिज-गुग्गुलु); (आ), f. the earth (supposed to be produced from the Meda or marrow of the Daityas Madhu and Kaiṭabha). —दैत्य-युग, अम्, n. an age of the demons (consisting of 12000 divine years or the sum of the four Yugas or ages of man). —दैत्य-सेना, f., N. of a daughter of Prajā-pati and sister of Deva-senā. —दैत्यारि (°य-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; a god in general. —दैत्याहोरात्र (°य-अह्°), अस्, m. a day and night of the demons (being a year of mortals). —दैत्येज्य (°य-इज्°), अस्, m. ‘preceptor of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Śukra who is the regent of Venus; [cf. दैत्य-गुरु।] —दैत्येन्द्र (°य-इन्°), अस्, m. ‘a prince of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Pātāla-ketu. —दैत्येन्द्र-पूज्य, अस्, m. ‘to be honoured by the chief of the Daityas,’ an epithet of Śukra, regent of Venus.
22740: दैधिषव्य दैधिषव्य, अस्, m. (fr. दिधिषू), the son of a woman by her second husband (?) .
22741: दैन 1. दैन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दिन), relating to a day, diurnal, daily.
22742: दैनन्दिन, अस्, ई, अम्, happening daily, diurnal, quotidian. —दैनन्दिन-प्रलय, अस्, n. destruc-tion of the world after the lapse of fifteen years of Brahmā's age.
22743: दैनिक, अस्, ई, अम्, diurnal, relating daily to a day; (ई), f. a day's hire or wages.
22744: दैन 2. दैन or दैन्य, अम्, n. (fr. दीन), wretchedness, feebleness, weakness, affliction, sorrow, grief, depression, low-spiritedness; poverty, humble-ness, a poor and pitiable state, miserable state; mean-ness, covetousness.
22745: दैनार दैनार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दीनार), bought with a Dīnār, of the value of a Dīnār.
22746: दैप दैप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दीप), relating or belonging to a lamp.
22747: दैयांपाति दैयाम्पाति, इस्, m., Ved. a patro-nymic from Dyāmpāta, q. v.
22748: दैर्घ दैर्घ, अम्, n. (fr. दीर्घ), length. —दैर्घतम, अस्, m. (fr. दीर्घ-तम), a patronymic of Dhanvantari. —दैर्घतमस, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Dīrgha-tamas; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Dīrgha-tamas. —दैर्घवरत्र, अस्, m. (fr. दीर्घ-वरत्रा), scil. कूप, a well in which a long rope is used. —दैर्घ-श्रवस, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Dīrgha-śravas.
22749: दैर्घ्य, अम्, n. length, longness. —दैर्घ्य-संयुत, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing length, lengthy.
22750: दैलीपि दैलीपि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Dilīpa, q. v.
22751: दैव दैव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव; only the fem. दैवी occurs in the Ṛg-veda), of or belonging to a deity or divinity, coming from the gods, divine, celestial; royal; (अस्), m. (with or without विवाह), one of the forms of marriage, the gift of a daughter at a sacrifice to the officiating priest; a patronymic of Atharvan; (अम्), n. a deity [cf. कुल-द्°]; a religious offering or rite, an oblation to the gods; divine power, destiny, fortune, chance, fate, accident (e. g. दैवात्, ind. by chance, accidentally); the part of the hands sacred to the gods, i. e. the tips of the fingers [cf. तीर्थ]; (ई), f. a division of medicine, the medical use of charms, prayers, &c.; [cf. अ-द्°।] —दैव-कर्मन्, अ, n. offering oblations to the gods, worship of the gods, a religious rite. —दैव-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by destiny, fated; formed by nature, natural. —दैव-कोविद, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with the destinies of men; (अस्, आ), m. f. a fatalist, astrologer, fortune-teller. —दैव-गति, इस्, f. course of destiny, fortune. —दैव-चिन्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘reflecting on fate or the destiny of men,’ an epithet of Śiva; (अस्), m. an astrologer, a fatalist. —दैव-चिन्तन, अम्, n. or दैव-चिन्ता, f. fatalism, reliance on fate; foretelling fate by astrology (?). —दैव-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with fate, knowing the destinies of men, foretelling, prophetic; (अस्), m. an astrologer; (आ), f. a female fortune-teller. —दैवज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n. fatalism, astrology. —दै-वज्ञ-विलास, अस्, m., N. of a work. —दैवज्ञ-सन्-मुनि, इस्, m., N. of an astrologer. —दैव-तन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, subject to fate. —दैव-तस्, ind. by fate or destiny, through fortune, by chance. —१। दैव-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, granted by fate or fortune; (for 2. see col. 3.) —दैव-दीप, अस्, m. ‘the heavenly lamp,’ the eye; [cf. देव-दीप and देह-दीप।] —दैव-दुर्-विपाक, अस्, m. ‘the hard or cruel ripening of destiny,’ hardness of fortune, unpro-pitiousness of fate. —दैव-दोष, अस्, m. the fault or evil result of destiny; badness of fate. —दैव-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, trusting to fate, believing in pre-destination, a fatalist; fated, willed, predestined. —दैव-प्रश्न, अस्, m. inquiring of fate, fortune-telling, astrology; (according to the lexicographers) a supernatural and prophetic voice heard at night; [cf. उप-श्रुति and देव-प्रश्न।] —दैव-युग, अस्, m. an age of the gods or immortals; [cf. दैत्य-युग।] —दैव-योग, अस्, m. a fortuitous combination, the occurrence of any unforeseen event, the intervention of destiny, fortune, chance; (एन) or (आत्), ind. through the influence of fortune, by chance, accidentally. —दैव-रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, guarded by destiny. —दैव-रथ, अस्, m. a divine chariot; (perhaps wrongly for देव-रथ।) —दैव-राज्य, अम्, n. dominion over the gods; [cf. देव-राज्य।] —दैव-लेखक, अस्, m. a fortune-teller, an astrologer. —दैव-लौकिक, अस्, ई, अम्, celestial and worldly. —दैव-वश, अस्, अम्, m. n. the will or power of destiny; दैव-वशात्, by chance, by accident, fatally. —दैव-वाणी, f. a voice from heaven. —दैव-विद्, त्, त्, त्, knowing the destiny of man, acquainted with astrology, an astrologer. —दैव-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, favoured by destiny. —दैवसम्पन्न-ता, f. the state of being favoured by destiny. —दैव-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, stricken by destiny, fate-stricken. —दैव-हतक, अस्, आ, अम्, beaten or struck by destiny; (अम्), n. a blow of destiny; [cf. दैवोपहतक।] —दैवात्यय (°व-अत्°), अस्, m. danger or evil resulting from unusual natural phenomena. —दैवाधीन (°व-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, depending on fate, subject to fate. —दैवा-नुरोधिन् (°व-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, subject or obedient to the gods. —दैवायत्त (°व-आय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dependant upon destiny. —दैवाहोरात्र (°व-अह्°), अस्, m. a day of the gods, the human year; [cf. दैत्याहोरात्र।] —दैवोढा (°व-ऊढा), f. a woman married according to the Daiva ritual; [cf. above.] —दैवोद्यान (°व-उद्°), अम्, n. a divine grove, a grove or garden of the gods. —दैवोप-हत or दैवोपहतक (°व-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, struck by fate, ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky.
22752: दैवक (at the end of an adj. comp.) = दैव, a deity, &c.; (ई), f. = देवकी, N. of the mother of Kṛṣṇa. —दैवकी-नन्दन, अस्, m. ‘the son of Daivakī’ or ‘Devakī's joy,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa; (also read देवकी-नन्दन।)
22753: दैवत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देवता), of or relating to a god or to the gods, especially relating to the peculiar deity honoured by any religious rite or a hymn &c., belonging to such a deity, divine; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (usually n.), a god, a deity, (often col-lectively) the deities, especially as celebrated in any hymn, a number of gods; an idol; (at the end of an adj. comp.) having as one's deity, worshipping as one's deity. —दैवत-काण्ड or दैवत, अम्, n. that part (books 7-12) of Yāska's Nirukta in which the names or epithets of deities collected in the fifth Adhyāya of the Nighaṇṭus are explained. —दैवत-पति, इस्, m. ‘the prince of the gods,’ an epithet of Indra. —दैवत-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, a worshipper of the gods. —दैवत-प्रतिमा, f. the image of a deity.
22754: दैवत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. देवता), having as one's deity, addressed to some deity, sacred to a deity; [cf. देवत्य।]
22755: दैवलक, अस्, m. the servant or worshipper of an evil spirit, an attendant on an idol (?); [cf. देवलक।]
22756: दैवात्, ind. by chance, by accident, fatally. See दैव।
22757: दैवातिथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देवातिथि), relating to Devātithi.
22758: दैविक, अस्, ई, अम्, peculiar to the gods, relating to the deities, divine, deific; performed in honour of the gods; (अम्), n. an inevitable accident.
22760: दैव्य, अस्, वी or व्या, अम्, divine; (अम्), n. divine power or effect; fortune, fate.
22761: दैवजन दैवजन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-जन), Ved. belonging to the gods collectively.
22762: दैवदत्त 2. दैवदत्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-दत्त; for 1. see under दैव, col. 2), being in the village Deva-datta; (आस्), m. pl. the disciples of Deva-datta.
22763: दैवदत्तिक, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, relating to Deva-datta.
22764: दैवदर्शनिन् दैवदर्शनिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the adherents or disciples of Deva-darśana.
22765: दैवदारव दैवदारव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-दारु), made of the tree Deva-dāru, being upon it.
22766: दैवयातक दैवयातक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-यात), inhabited by the Deva-yātas.
22767: दैवयातवक दैवयातवक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-यातु), inhabited by the Deva-yātus.
22768: दैवयानेय दैवयानेय, अस्, m. (fr. देव-यानी), a patronymic from Deva-yānī.
22769: दैवराति दैवराति, इस्, m. (fr. देव-रात), a descendant of Deva-rāta; a patronymic of Janaka; a N. of Yājñavalkya.
22770: दैववात दैववात, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-वात), relating to Deva-vāta; (अस्), m. an epithet of Sṛñjaya.
22771: दैवाकरि दैवाकरि, इस्, m. (fr. दिवाकर), ‘the son of the Sun,’ a patronymic of Yama and Śani or the planet Saturn; (ई), f. ‘the daughter of the Sun,’ an epithet of Yamunā or the river Jumnā.
22772: दैवादिक दैवादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दिव्-आदि), belonging to the class of roots which begins with दिव्, i. e. to the fourth class.
22773: दैवावृध दैवावृध, अस्, m. (fr. देवा-वृ-ध), a patronymic of Babhru.
22774: दैवासुर दैवासुर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देव-असुर), relating to the gods and Asuras; (with वैर) the natural enmity perpetually subsisting between the gods and Asuras; containing the word देवासुर (as an Adhyāya or Anu-vāka; cf. देवासुर).
22775: दैवोदास दैवोदास, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Divo-dāsa; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Divo-dāsa. —दैवोदासि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Pratardana, and of Parucchepa.
22776: दैशिक दैशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देश), belong-ing or relating to a place, local, provincial; relating or having reference to space; belonging to a country, national; produced in any place or country; acquainted with any place or country; teaching, directing, show-ing, pointing out [cf. देशिक and देश्य]; (अस्), m. a guide; a teacher.
22777: दैष्टिक दैष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दिष्ट), fated, predestined; (अस्), m. a predestinarian, a fatalist. —दैष्टिक-ता, f. or दैष्टिक-त्व, अम्, n. fatalism, predestinarianism.
22778: दैहिक दैहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देह), cor-poreal, bodily.
22779: दैह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the body; (अस्), m. the soul (enclosed by the body).
22780: दो दो (sometimes written दा, see 3. दा, p. 408, col. 1), cl. 4. 2. P. द्यति, दाति, ददौ, दास्यति, अदासीत् and अदात्, दातुम्, to cut, divide; to reap, mow; to untie, loosen: Pass. दीयते and दायते, Aor. 3rd sing. अदायि: Desid. दित्सति and दिदासति: Intens. देदीयते and दादायते।
22781: दोग दोग, अस्, m. a bull (?).
22782: दोग्धव्य दोग्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. दुह्), to be milked.
22783: दोग्धु-काम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the inf. दोग्धुम् + काम), wishing to milk.
22784: दोग्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, a milker, who or what milks; one who performs anything from interested motives or who makes profit out of (with acc.); yielding milk or desirable objects of any kind; (धा), m. a cowherd; a calf; a poet, panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire or reward; (ध्री), f. a cow which yields milk; a wet-nurse who has much milk; a female who yields or grants anything (with acc.).
22785: दोघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. milking; (अस्), m. milking.
22786: दोडी दोडी, f. a species of plant and its fruit; [cf. डोदी and दाडी।]
22787: दोदुल्यमान दोदुल्यमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens. of rt. दुल्), swinging backwards and forwards, being swung repeatedly or violently.
22788: दोध दोध, अस्, m. (fr. दोग्धृ?), a calf.
22789: दोधक दोधक or दोधक-वृत्त, अम्, n. a kind of metre consisting of four lines of eleven syllables each.
22790: दोधूयमान दोधूयमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens. of rt. 1. धू), shaking or trembling violently.
22791: दोमन् दोमन्, अ, n. (fr. rt. 2. दु), pain, inconvenience, (occurring only in अ-दोम-द, q. v.)
22792: दोरक दोरक, अस्, इका, m. f. a string for fastening the wires of a lute.
22793: दोल दोल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. दुल्), swinging, rocking, oscillating; a festival on the fourteenth of the month Phālguna (February — March) when figures of the juvenile Kṛṣṇa are swung in an ornamental swing; a swing, litter; a peculiar position of the closed hand; (आ), f. a litter, a swinging cradle or cot or hammock, a dooly, palanquin, sedan, a swing, swinging; fluctuation, incertitude, doubt; the indigo plant. —दोलाकुल-धी (°ला-आक्°), ईस्, ईस्, इ, or दोला-चल-चित्तवृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, whose mind is agitated like a swing. —दोलाधिरूढ (°ला-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on a swing; restless, disquieted. —दोला-यात्रा, f. ‘the swing festival,’ N. of a festival in honour of Kṛṣṇa when figures of him and his consort Rādhā are carried about in a litter or swung in an ornamental swing.
22794: दोलाय, Nom. A. दोलायते, &c., to swing, rock about like a swing, shake, toss, move to and fro, fluctuate, oscillate, be unsteady.
22795: दोलायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, oscillating, swinging, rocking, tossing, being swung backwards and for-wards; vacillating, wavering; perplexed, doubting. —दोलायमान-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, wavering in mind, with a wavering mind.
22796: दोलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, swinging about, oscillating, moving to and fro, rocking. —दोलायित-श्रवण-कुण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, whose ear-rings swing to and fro.
22797: दोलिका, f. a litter, swing; a cradle.
22798: दोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, swung, shaken, rocked, tossed backwards and forwards.
22799: दोष दोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. दुष्), fault, vice, defect, deficiency, want, blemish, blame, accu-sation, reproach (with rt. गम्, to accuse, e. g. दो-षेण मां गच्छति, he accuses me); a bad or noxious quality; badness, wickedness, sinfulness; offence, transgression, sin, guilt, crime; damage, harm, detriment; bad consequence, detrimental effect (e. g. मातृ-दोषात्, q. v.); morbid affection, morbid element, disease; disorder of the three humors of the human body, defect in the functions of वायु or wind, पित्त or bile, and श्लेष्मन् or phlegm (e. g. त्रिदोष-कृत्, causing disorder of the three humors); a N. applied to the three fluid elements or humors themselves (as causing diseases when in a state of derangement); evening, dusk, darkness, Evening personified as one of the eight Vasus and husband of Night; refutation; a calf; (1. दोषा), f. evening, darkness, night; Night personified (regarded with Prabhā as wife of Puṣpārṇa and mother of Pra-doṣa or Evening, Niśitha or Midnight, and Vyuṣṭa or Day-break); दोषाम्, ind. in the evening; दोषा, old inst. in the evening, at dusk, at night; [cf. अन्न-द्°, त्वग्-द्°, दोषस्, प्र-दोष, प्रति-दोषम्।] —दोष-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, or दोष-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or दोष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing evil or harm, hurtful. —दोष-कल्पन, अम्, n. attributing blame, reprehending, condemning. —दोष-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, involved in guilt, convicted, guilty. —दोष-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, fault-finding, censorious, vituperative, malicious, malignant; [cf. गुण-ग्राहिन्।] —दोष-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, removing vitiation or disease of the humors. —दोष-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with what is noxious or dangerous, discerning sins, understanding diseases, knowing faults, &c.; (अस्), m. a physician; a Pandit, teacher, discerning man. —दोष-तस्, ind. from a fault or defect; दोषतो ब्रू, to accuse of a fault. —दोष-त्रय, अम्, n. vitiation of the three humors, or wind, bile, and phlegm; any com-bination of three defects. —दोषत्रय-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, removing vitiation of the three humors. —दोष-त्व, अम्, n. faultiness, deficiency. —दोष-दृष्टि, इस्, f. looking at faults, fault-finding. —दोष-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, m. attaching blame, attribution of blame, censure, condemnation. —दोष-बल-प्र-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, proceeding from the influence of bad humors (a disease). —दोष-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing faults, wrong, faulty, doing wrong, being defective or to blame. —दोष-भीति, इस्, f. fear of offence. —दोष-भेद, अस्, m. a peculiar modifi-cation of disease of the three humors. —दोष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having faults, faulty, defective, blemished, deficient; guilty of an offence; detrimental, con-nected with crime or guilt, sinful, wicked; noxious, dangerous. —दोष-शमन, अस्, आ, अम्, allaying disorder of the humors. —दोष-स्थान, अम्, n. the seat of disorder of the humors. —दोष-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, removing disease of the humors. —दोषाकर (°ष-आक्°), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, ‘a mine of faults,’ full of defects, faulty; (°षा-क°), अस्, m. ‘the night-maker,’ epithet of the Moon. —दोषा-क्लेशी, f. ‘fading in the evening,’ a kind of plant (= वन-वर्वरिका)। —दोषाक्षर (°ष-अक्°), अस्, m. ‘a word of blame,’ accusation, censure. —दोषा-तन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दोषा, ind.), nocturnal, at evening, nightly. —दोषा-तिलक, अस्, m. ‘the ornament of the night,’ a lamp. —दोषानुवाद (°ष-अन्°), अस्, m. talking over faults, tale-bearing. —दोषा-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, having become night, turned into night. —दोषा-मन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, considering one's self as night, regarding as night; [cf. दिवा-मन्य।] —दोषारोप (°ष-आर्°), अस्, m. imputing fault, accusation. —दोषा-वस्तृ, ता, m. (generally occur-ring in loc. दोषा-वस्तर्), Ved. ‘illuminating the darkness or shining in the evening,’ an epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) by night and day. —दोषास्य (°षा-आस्°), अस्, m. ‘the face of the night,’ a lamp. —दो-षैकदृश् (°ष-एक्°), क्, क्, क्, seeing only defects, fault-finding, censorious, malevolent. —दोषोच्छ्राय (°ष-उच्°), or दोषोपचय (°ष-उप्°), अस्, m. the rise or undue accumulation of vitiated humors.
22801: दोषण, अम्, n. imputation of a crime, accu-sation.
22802: दोषल, अस्, आ, अम्, of a faulty nature, defective, corrupt.
22804: दोषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, faulty, defective, bad; (अस्), m. sickness, disease.
22805: दोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, becoming defiled or impure or contaminated; faulty, defective; criminal, wicked, bad.
22806: दोषन् दोषन्, m. n. (defective; substituted for दोस्, q. v., in certain cases), the fore-arm, the lower part of the fore-foot of an animal, the arm in general. —दोषणि-श्रिष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, leaning or hanging on the arm.
22807: दोषण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to the arm, seated in the arm (as a disease).
22808: 2. दोषा, f. the arm. (For 1. दोषा see col. 2.)
22809: दोस्, स्, m. n. (nom. sing. दोस्, du. m. दोषौ, n. दोषी, acc. pl. दोषस् or दोष्णस्, inst. sing. दोषा or दोष्णा, du. दोर्भ्याम्, loc. pl. दोःषु, Gram. 166. द्), the fore-arm, the arm; the part of an arc de-fining its sine; the side of a triangle or square, [cf. बाहु and भुज।] —दोः-सहस्र-भृत्, त्, m. ‘thousand-armed,’ N. of a king also called Kārtavīrya. —दोर्-आन्दोलन, अम्, n. swinging the arm. —दोर्-गडु, उस्, उस्, उ, having a crippled arm, crooked-armed. —दोर्-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘seizing with the arms,’ strong, powerful; (अस्), m. pain in the arm. —दोर्-ज्या, f. the sine of the base. —दोर्-दण्ड, अस्, m. the arm; [cf. दण्ड।] —दोर्-निकर्तन, अम्, n. ampu-tation of the arm. —दोर्-मध्य, अम्, n. the middle of the arm. —दोर्-मूल, अम्, n. ‘the root of the arm,’ the armpit. —दोष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having arms. —दो-स्थ (for दोः-स्थ), placed on the arm; (अस्), m. ‘standing near the arm,’ a servant [cf. पार्श्व-स्थ]; service; a player, one who plays or sports; play, sport.
22810: दोह दोह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. दुह्), milking; milk; a milk-pail; making profit out of anything, satisfaction, success. —दोह-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of being milked. —दोह-ज, अम्, n. ‘pro-duced by milking,’ milk. —दोहदोहीय, अम्, n. (fr. दोह-दोह), N. of a Sāman. —दोहापनय (°ह-अप्°), अस्, m. milk.
22811: दोहन, अस्, आ, अम्, milking, a milker; giving or yielding milk or other desirable objects; (ई), f. a milk-vessel, milk-pail; (अम्), n. milking, the result of milking; a milk-pail; [cf. गो-द्°।]
22812: दोहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, proper to be milked.
22813: दोहस्, अस्, n., Ved. milking; (the dat. दोहसे is used as an inf. of rt. 2. दुह्।)
22814: दोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to yield milk, milked.
22815: दोहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, milking; giving milk, granting or yielding desirable objects; a milker.
22816: दोहीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, giving much milk, yielding abundance of milk.
22817: दोह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be milked, milkable; (अस्), m. (?) a cow; [cf. दुह्य, दुःख-द्°, सुख-द्°।]
22818: दोहडिका दोहडिका, f. a kind of Prākṛt metre consisting of thirty-five syllables, (commonly called दोहा।)
22819: दोहद दोहद, अस्, अम्, m. n. (a Prākṛt form for दौर्हृद; cf. दौहृद), the longing of a pregnant woman, that craving after particular objects which is regarded as a sign of impregnation; (sometimes) the desired object itself; pregnancy; the desire of plants at budding time to be touched by the foot of a beautiful girl, (poetically imagined to cause the production of blossoms); violent or morbid desire, desire in general, wish; a kind of incense used as a manure. —दोहद-लक्षण, अम्, n. ‘having longing desire as its mark,’ the fetus, the embryo, (sometimes confounded with the womb itself); the period of passing from one season of life to another (as from childhood to youth, from youth to manhood). —दोहद-वती, f. or दोहदान्विता (°द-अन्°), f. ‘possessing the desire of a pregnant woman,’ a pregnant woman longing for anything; [cf. दोहल and दिव्य-दोहद।]
22820: दोहदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, eagerly longing for, desirous of, craving after.
22821: दोहल, अस्, m. = दोहद, longing, wish, desire, craving after; (ई), f. the Aśoka tree. —दोहल-वती = दोहद-वती।
22822: दौःशलेय दौःशलेय, अस्, m. probably a metronymic from Duḥ-śalā.
22823: दौःशासनि दौःशासनि, इस्, m. (fr. दुः-शा-सन), a patronymic from Duḥ-śāsana.
22824: दौःशील्य दौःशील्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुः-शील), bad inclination or custom, bad character, badness of disposition, wickedness.
22825: दौःष्वप्न्य दौःष्वप्न्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुष्-स्वप्न), Ved. evil dreams; [cf. दुः-ष्वप्न्य।]
22826: दौःसाधिक दौःसाधिक, अस्, m. (the first syllable fr. द्वार् ?), a door-keeper, a warder, a porter; a beadle; the superintendent of a village; [cf. दुः-साधिन्।]
22827: दौःस्त्र दौःस्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. दुः-स्त्री), dis-cord or wrangling contention between women.
22828: दौकूल दौकूल or दौकूलक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दुकूल), covered with fine silk, see दुकूल; (अम्), n. cloth made of Dukūla, silk cloth.
22830: दौत्य दौत्य, अम्, n. (fr. दूत), the state of a messenger, an embassy or message, mission; the office of a messenger; function of an ambassador.
22831: दौरात्म्य दौरात्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-आत्मन्), evil-mindedness, badness of soul, wickedness, depravity, mischievousness.
22832: दौरित दौरित, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-इत), mischief.
22833: दौरुधर दौरुधर, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the lunar mansion called Durudhara, q. v.
22834: दौरेश्रवस दौरेश्रवस, अस्, m. (fr. दूरे-श्रवस्), a patronymic of the priest of the serpents called Pṛthu-śravas.
22835: दौरेश्रुत, अस्, m. (fr. दूरे-श्रुत), a patro-nymic of the serpent-priest Timirgha.
22836: दौर्ग दौर्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दुर्-ग), relating to Durga or Durgā.
22837: दौर्गसिंह, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to or com-posed by Durga-siṃha.
22838: दौर्गायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Durga.
22840: दौर्गत्य दौर्गत्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-गत), misfortune, bad circumstances, want, wretchedness, distress.
22841: दौर्गन्धि दौर्गन्धि, इस्, m. or दौर्गन्ध्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-गन्ध), bad or disagreeable smell, badness of smell, fetor.
22842: दौर्जन दौर्जन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दुर्-जन), consisting of wicked men.
22843: दौर्जन्य, अम्, n. wickedness, maliciousness, depravity, vileness.
22844: दौर्जीवित्य दौर्जीवित्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-जी-वित), a miserable life, a wretched state of existence.
22845: दौर्बल दौर्बल or दौर्बल्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-बल), impotency, feebleness, weakness, debility.
22846: दौर्भागिणेय दौर्भागिणेय, अस्, m. (fr. दुर्-भगा), the son of a woman disliked by her husband; (ई), f. the daughter of such a woman.
22847: दौर्भाग्य, अम्, n. ill luck, misfortune, bad condition; the unhappiness of a woman resulting from the dislike of her husband.
22848: दौर्भ्रात्र दौर्भ्रात्र, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-भ्रा-तृ), a bad understanding between brothers.
22849: दौर्मद्य दौर्मद्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-मद), a drunken brawl, a fight, battle.
22850: दौर्मनस्य दौर्मनस्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-मनस्), evil-mindedness, evil disposition; mental pain, discomposure of mind, affliction, distress; despair.
22851: दौर्मन्त्र्य दौर्मन्त्र्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-मन्त्र), bad consultation or counsel, evil advice.
22852: दौर्मित्रि दौर्मित्रि, इस्, f. a metronymic from Dur-mitrā, q. v.
22853: दौर्मुखि दौर्मुखि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Dur-mukha.
22854: दौर्योधन दौर्योधन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दुर्-यो-धन), belonging or relating to Dur-yodhana &c.
22855: दौर्योधनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Dur-yodhana, q. v.
22856: दौर्लभ्य दौर्लभ्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-लभ), difficulty of attainment, rarity, scarceness.
22857: दौर्वचस्य दौर्वचस्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-वचस्), evil speech, bad language.
22858: दौर्वास दौर्वास or दौर्वासस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दुर्-वासस्), belonging to or composed by Dur-vā-sas; (अम्), n., scil. पुराणम्, N. of an Upa-Purāṇa.
22859: दौर्वीण दौर्वीण, अम्, n. (fr. दूर्वा), the sap or juice of bent grass; a clean leaf.
22860: दौर्व्रत्य दौर्व्रत्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-व्रत), Ved. disobedience, ill conduct.
22861: दौर्हार्द दौर्हार्द, अम्, n. (fr. दुर्-हृद्), badness of heart; hard-heartedness; evil disposition of mind, enmity.
22862: दौर्हृद, अम्, n. evil disposition of mind, enmity; the longing of pregnant women, (perhaps originally the disgust felt by pregnant women for certain things); longing, desire.
22863: दौर्हृदय, अम्, n. evil disposition of mind, enmity.
22864: दौलेय दौलेय, अस्, m. (fr. दुलि), a turtle or tortoise.
22865: दौल्मि दौल्मि, इस्, m. an epithet of Indra; [cf. दल्मि and दाल्मि।]
22866: दौवारिक दौवारिक, अस्, m. (fr. द्वार् or द्वार), a door-keeper, warder, porter; the door-keeper of paradise (?).
22867: दौवालिक दौवालिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
22868: दौश्चर्म्य दौश्चर्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुश्-चर्-मन्), a disease of the skin, a defect in the gene-rative organs (supposed to be a disease of the prepuce or paraphimosis).
22869: दौश्चर्य दौश्चर्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुश्-चर), acting wickedly, evil conduct, wickedness; a bad deed.
22870: दौष्क दौष्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दोस्), one who swims or crosses a stream by the help of his arms.
22871: दौष्कुल दौष्कुल or दौष्कुलेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दुष्-कुल), sprung from a bad or low or contemptible family or race.
22872: दौष्कुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a bad or low family; (अम्), n. lowness of origin, low extraction.
22873: दौष्कृत्य दौष्कृत्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुष्-कृत), bad conduct, badness of conduct, wickedness.
22874: दौष्ट्य दौष्ट्य, अम्, n. (fr. दुष्ट), de-pravity, badness, wickedness.
22875: दौष्ठव दौष्ठव, अम्, n. (fr. दु-ष्ठु), badness, wickedness.
22876: दौष्मन्त दौष्मन्त, अस्, or दौष्मन्ति, इस्, m. (fr. दुष्-मन्त), ‘the son of Dush-manta,’ a patro-nymic of Bharata, the first sole monarch of India.
22877: दौष्यन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Dushyanta.
22878: दौष्यन्ति or दौष्वन्ति or दौःषन्ति, इस्, m. a patronymic of Bharata.
22879: दौहित्र दौहित्र, अस्, m. (fr. दुहितृ), a daughter's son; a term applied to a rhinoceros; (ई), f. a daughter's daughter; (अम्), n. sesamum-seed; ghee from a brownish cow (?) . —दौहित्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having or possessing a daughter's son.
22880: दौहित्रक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a daughter's son.
22881: दौहित्रायण, अस्, m. the son of a daughter's son.
22882: दौहृद दौहृद, अम्, n. (see दौर्हृद), the longing or desire of pregnant women for certain things, pregnancy; [cf. दोहद।]
22883: दौहृदिनी, f. a woman who has the longing which attends pregnancy, a pregnant woman.
22886: द्या द्या, f. = ज्या, the sinew of a bow, a bow-string; (in Śatapatha-Br. XIV. 6, 8, 2, उ-द्य = उज्-ज्य।)
22887: द्याम्पात द्याम्पात, अस्, m. (fr. द्याम्, acc. sing. of द्यो, + पात), N. of a man; [cf. दयाम्पाति।]
22888: द्यावा द्यावा (according to Sāy., Ṛg-veda VII. 65, 2) = द्यावा-पृथिवी, du. heaven and earth. —द्यावा-क्षमे or द्यावा-क्षामा or द्यावा-पृथिवी or द्यावा-पृथिव्यौ or द्यावा-भूमी or द्यावा-भूम्यौ, f. du. (the comp. consisting of two Vedic duals which may even be separated by intermediate words), heaven and earth. —द्यावा-पृथिवी-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with heaven and earth.
22889: द्यावापृथिवीय or द्यावापृथिव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to heaven and earth, sacred to them.
22890: द्यु 1. द्यु, cl. 2. P. द्यौति, दुद्याव, द्योष्यति, अद्यौषीत्, द्योतुम्, to advance towards or against, approach, assail, attack; [cf. दिद्यु, rt. 2. दिव्।]
22891: 1. द्युत्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of a comp.) advancing against, assaulting.
22892: द्यु 2. द्यु, sharpness, in अ-द्यु, q. v.
22893: द्यु 3. द्यु, उस्, m. (connected with 3. दिव्, q. v.), a N. of Agni or fire; (उ), n. a day, bright-ness; heaven, sky, ether, paradise; द्यु is the form of 3. दिव्, used before terminations beginning with consonants and in comp., see 3. दिव्; द्युभिस् = उप-द्युभिस्, in the course of days, in the course of time; [cf. Lat. nu-diu-s; Hib. an-diu, ‘to-day.’] —द्यु-क्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. द्यु and क्ष = 3. क्षि ?), Ved. heavenly, celestial; light, brilliant; (अस्), m. epithet of Varuṇa; of Aryaman; of Indra; of Agni; of Soma. —द्युक्ष-वचस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. uttering heavenly words. —द्यु-ग, अस्, m. ‘going in the sky,’ a bird; [cf. खे-चर।] —द्यु-गण, अस्, m. a given term of days (as a month &c.). —द्यु-गत्, ind. (गत् fr. rt. गम्), Ved. pervading the sky, going through the sky; (according to Naigh. II. 15), quickly. —द्यु-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘going or moving in heaven,’ an inhabitant of heaven. —द्यु-जय, अस्, m. conquering or gaining heaven; attainment of heaven. —द्यु-तरु, उस्, m. the tree of heaven; [cf. देव-तरु।] —द्यु-दल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), ‘dividing of the sky,’ noon. —द्यु-धुनि, इस्, f. ‘the river of heaven,’ the Ganges. —द्यु-नदी, f. ‘the river of heaven,’ the Ganges. —द्युनदी-सङ्गम, अस्, m. ‘the confluence of the river of the sky,’ N. of a place of pilgrimage mentioned in the Rasika-ramaṇa by Raghu-nātha. —द्यु-निवास, अस्, m. ‘heavenly abode,’ heaven; an inhabitant of heaven, a deity. —द्युनिवास-भूय, अम्, n. the becoming a deity. —द्यु-निवा-सिन्, ई, m. ‘an inhabitant of heaven,’ a deity; a pious person. —द्यु-निश्, औ, f. du. or द्यु-निश, अम्, n. or द्यु-निशे, n. du. day and night; द्यु-निशम् or द्यु-निशि, for a day and night, by day and night. —द्यु-पति, इस्, m. ‘the lord of heaven,’ the sun; an epithet of Indra. —द्यु-पथ, अस्, m. ‘the path of heaven,’ the upper part of the sky. —द्यु-मणि, इस्, m. ‘the jewel of the sky,’ the sun; an epithet of Śiva. —द्यु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. bright, light, brilliant; clear, loud, heard from afar; serene; brisk, energetic, strong; excellent, conspicuous; (आन्), m. an epithet of Agni; of Soma; of Brahmā; of the chariot of the gods; N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha; of Divo-dāsa (= Pra-tardana); of Manu Svārociṣa; (अत्), ind. clearly, brightly. —द्युमत्-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince of Śālva, father of Satya-vat. —द्युमद्-गामन्, आ, m., Ved. one who sings distinctly (rt. गै) or one who walks (rt. गम्) within the sacred enclosure. —द्यु-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, light, clear; (ई), f., N. of a daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ and wife of the Sun. —द्यु-मार्ग, अस्, m. the path of the sky or air. —द्यु-योषित्, त्, f. ‘a heavenly woman,’ an Apsaras. —द्यु-लोक, अस्, m. the heavenly world; [cf. पृथिवी-लोक, अन्तरिक्ष-लोक, द्यौर्-लोक।] —द्यु-षद्, त्, m. (fr. द्यु-सद्), an inhabitant of heaven, a god, deity; a planet. —द्यु-सद् = द्यु-षद्. —द्यु-सद्मन्, आ, m. ‘an inhabitant of heaven,’ a god. —द्यु-सरस्, n. the lake of heaven. —द्यु-सरित्, त्, f. or द्यु-सिन्धु, उस्, f. ‘the river of heaven,’ the Ganges.
22894: द्युम्न, अम्, n. splendor, glory, majesty; clear-ness or serenity of mind, enthusiasm, inspiration; energy, ability, strength, power; wealth, property, substance; N. of a Sāman; (Sāy.) sacrificial offering, oblation; (अस्), m., N. of an author of a Ṛg-veda hymn; of a son of Manu and Naḍvalā; [cf. अभिष्टि-द्°, इन्द्र-द्°, ऋत-द्°, तुवि-द्°।] —द्युम्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. inspired, sounding clearly; having wealth, rich, powerful; (Sāy.) accompanied by obla-tions. —द्युम्न-वर्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in-creasing strength. —द्युम्न-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. producing a strong or clear sound; (Sāy.) having splendid food or offerings. —द्युम्न-सह् or द्युम्-न-साह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. bearing or bringing strength; (Sāy.) carrying off or taking away wealth. —द्युम्न-साति, इस्, f., Ved. receiving inspiration or power; (Sāy.) obtaining food or glory. —द्युम्न-हूति, इस्, f., Ved. inspired invocation; (Sāy.) invocation cha-racterized by oblations or accompanied by offerings. —द्युम्नोदा, आस्, आस्, अम् (fr. द्युम्नस् = द्युम्-न ? and दा), Ved. granting splendor.
22895: द्युम्निन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. majestic; strong, spiritual; inspired, courageous; (Sāy.) having wealth, having food or oblations; (ई), m., N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha and author of a hymn of the Ṛg-veda.
22896: द्युवन्, आ, m. the sun; heaven.
22897: द्युस्, a contraction of दिवस्, the gen. sing. of 3. दिव्, day; [cf. अधरे-द्युस्, अन्यतरे-द्°, अपरे-द्°।]
22898: द्यो, औस्, f. (considered by native grammarians as another form of the base 3. दिव्, forming in the nom. द्यौस्, as गौस् fr. गो, and used in a few comp.), the sky, heaven, paradise, &c.; see 3. दिव्। —द्यो-कार, अस्, m. ‘a maker of brightness,’ a goldsmith (?), a N. applied to some sort of handicraft. —द्यो-भूमि, इस्, m. ‘moving between heaven and earth (?),’ a bird; (ई), f. du. heaven and earth. —द्यो-षद्, त्, m. (fr. द्यो + सद्), ‘sitting in heaven,’ a deity, a celestial. —द्यौर्-दा, आस्, आस्, अम् (द्यौर् for द्यौस्, nom. of द्यो), giving heaven. —द्यौर्-लोक, अस्, m. (द्यौर् for द्यौस्, nom. of द्यो), the heavenly world. —द्यौ-संशित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. impelled or incited by heaven.
22899: द्युक द्युक, अस्, m. an owl. —द्युकारि (°क-अरि), इस्, m. ‘the owl's enemy,’ a crow; (wrong forms for द्यूक and द्यूकारि।)
22900: द्युत् 1. द्युत्, occurring in the Atharva-veda, and said to mean ‘to be broken, to break;’ it occurs IV. 12, 2, XII. 3, 22, in the past part. द्युत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, broken: Caus. द्योतयति, यितुम्, to break.
22901: द्युत् 2. द्युत्, cl. 1. A. द्योतते, दिद्युते (Pāṇ. VII. 4, 67; part. दिद्युतान), द्यो-तिष्यते, अद्योतिष्ट and अद्युतत् (Ved. अद्यौत्, अदिद्युतत्), द्योतितुम्, to shine, to be bright or brilliant: Caus. P. द्योतयति, &c., Aor. अदि-द्युतत्, to make bright or brilliant, illuminate, irra-diate; to cause to appear or become manifest, to enlighten, cause to understand; to express, mean: Desid. दिद्युतिषते and दिद्योतिषते: Intens. दे-द्युत्यते, देद्योत्ति, Ved. Intens. दविद्योत्ति, दवि-द्योत्, 3rd pl. दविद्युतति, part. दविद्युतत्; [cf. rt. ज्युत्, which is probably derived fr. द्युत् with change of द् to ज्।]
22902: 3. द्युत्, त्, f., Ved. shining, splendor, a ray of light.
22903: द्युतद्-यामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having a shining or brilliant path.
22904: द्युतान, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi with the patro-nymic Māruta or Māruti, who is author of a hymn of the Ṛg-veda; N. of the hymn ascribed to him.
22905: द्युति, इस्, f. splendor, brightness, brilliancy, lustre, beauty; light, a ray of light; majesty, dignity; Splendor personified as a deity; (इस्), m., N. of one of the Saptarṣis under the reign of Manu Meru-sāvarṇa IV; of a son of Manu Tāmasa. —द्युति-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, producing splendor, illuminating, shining, handsome; (अस्), m. the polar star or (in mythology) the divine sage Dhruva. —द्युति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, resplendent, bright, brilliant; majestic, dignified; (आन्), m., N. of a prince of the Madras and father-in-law of Saha-deva; of a prince of the Śālvas and father of Ṛcīka; of a son of Madirāśva and father of Su-vīra; of a son of Priya-vrata and king of Krauñca-dvīpa; of a son of Prāṇa (or Pāṇḍu); of one of the seven sages under the first Manu Meru-sāvarṇa or under Manu Dākṣasāvarṇi; N. of a son of Manu Svayam-bhuva; N. of a mountain. —द्युति-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, of brilliant understanding, clear-minded.
22906: द्युतित, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminated, enlightened, shining; [cf. द्योतित।]
22907: द्युतित्वा or द्योतित्वा, ind. (Pāṇ. 1. 2, 26), having become bright or brilliant.
22908: द्युतिला, f. the plant Hemionitis Cordifolia.
22909: द्योत, अस्, m. light, lustre, brilliance; sunshine; heat; [cf. ख-द्° and चिन्त्य-द्°।]
22910: द्योतक, अस्, आ, अम्, shining; illuminating [cf. ख-द्°]; making clear, explaining; meaning, signifi-cant, expressing, expressive of. —द्योतक-त्व, अम्, n. the power or faculty of expressing, expressiveness.
22911: द्योतन, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, shining, bright, bril-liant; illuminating, enlightening [cf. ख-द्°]; ex-plaining, meaning; (अस्), m. a lamp; N. of a prince; (अम्), n. shining; illumination; making manifest, explaining, showing; sight, seeing.
22912: द्योतनक, अस्, इका, अम्, making manifest, ex-plaining; (इका), f. explanation.
22913: द्योतनि, इस्, f., Ved. splendor, brightness.
22914: द्योतमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, being bright, brilliant.
22915: द्योतयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminating, enlighten-ing, irradiating.
22916: द्योतित, अस्, आ, अम्, shone upon, illustrated, illu-minated, &c., = द्युतित, q. v. —द्योतित-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, resplendent.
22917: द्योतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shining, brilliant, splendid.
22918: द्योतिस्, इस्, n. light, brightness; a star. —द्योतिर्-इङ्गण, अस्, m. a shining insect, fire-fly. —द्योतिष्-पथ, अस्, m. ‘the path of the stars,’ the upper part of the sky; (also read ज्योतिष्-पथ।)
22919: द्योत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made clear or expressed or explained.
22920: द्यौत, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
22921: द्यौतान, अम्, n. (fr. द्युतान), N. of a Sāman.
22922: द्यौत्त्र, अम्, n. light, splendor; forked lightning.
22923: द्युत द्युत, अम्, n. (in astrology) N. of the seventh mansion; (also read द्युन or द्यून, q. v.)
22925: द्यू द्यू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (fr. rt. 2. दिव्), playing, sporting with, delighting in, (used at the end of a comp., see अक्ष-द्°, एक-द्°, कम-द्°); going after, (explained by some native commentators as derived fr. 1. द्यु।)
22926: द्यूत, अस्, अम् (past part. pass. of 2. दिव्), gam-bled; (अस्, अम्), m. n. play, gaming, gambling, playing with dice or any inanimate object; (figura-tively) a battle or fight (the end of a battle being as uncertain as that of a game); the prize won, that which is gained in battle; [cf. अक्ष-द्°।] —द्यूत-कर, अस्, m. a gambler. —द्यूत-कार or द्यूत-कारक, अस्, m. the keeper of a gaming-house; a gambler. —द्यूत-कृत्, त्, m. a gambler. —द्यूत-क्रीडा, f. playing at dice, gambling. —द्यूत-ता, f. gambling, gaming, playing with dice. —द्यूत-पर्-वन्, अ, n., N. of a section of the Sabhā-parva of the Mahā-bhārata, comprising Adhyāyas 45-69. —द्यूत-पूर्णिमा, f. or द्यूत-पौर्णमी (or more correctly -पौर्णिमी), f. the day of full moon in the month Kārttika (October — November), the night of which is spent in games of chance in honour of Lakṣmī, goddess of fortune. —द्यूत-प्रतिपद्, त्, f. the first day of the bright half of the month Kārttika kept as a festival and celebrated by gambling. —द्यूत-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of gambling. —द्यूत-भूमि, इस्, f. gambling-ground, playing-place. —द्यूत-विशेष, आस्, m. pl. ‘the different sorts of play,’ N. of a chapter in the Kāma-sūtra by Vātsyāyana. —द्यूत-वीज, अम्, n. a cowrie, a small shell used as a coin and in playing. —द्यूत-वृत्ति, इस्, m. a gambler by profession or the keeper of a gaming-house. —द्यूत-वैतंसिक, अस्, m. one who lives by exhibiting fights between animals (?) . —द्यू-त-सभा, f. a gaming-house, assembly of gamblers. —द्यूत-समाज, अस्, m. an assembly of gamblers, a gaming-house. —द्यूत-समाह्वय-प्रकरण, अम्, n. ‘a treatise on the lawsuits arising from gambling,’ N. of a chapter of the legal work Su-bo-dhinī by Viśveśvara. —द्यूताधिकारिन् (°त-अध्°), ई, m. the keeper of a gaming-house.
22927: द्यूत्वा, ind. having played or gambled.
22928: द्यून 1. द्यून, अस्, आ, अम् (past part. pass. of 1. दिव् or of 2. दिव्, but not in the sense ‘to gamble’), lamenting, sorrowful; playing (but not with dice); [cf. परि-द्यून।]
22929: द्यून 2. द्यून, अम्, n. the seventh mansion or sign of the zodiac reckoning from that which the sun enters; [also द्यूनक in comp.; cf. द्युत and द्युन।]
22930: द्यै 1. द्यै, cl. 1. P. द्यायति, दद्यौ, &c., to despise, reprove, treat with contempt; to disfigure.
22933: द्योत द्योत, द्योतित, &c. See p. 438, cols. 2, 3.
22935: द्रकट द्रकट or द्रगड, अस्, m. a kettle-drum with which sleepers are awakened.
22936: द्रङ्क्षण द्रङ्क्षण, अम्, n. a measure or weight, = तोलक।
22937: द्रङ्ग द्रङ्ग, अस्, आ, m. f. a town, city; [cf. उद्रङ्ग and त्रङ्ग।]
22938: द्रढय द्रढय (fr. दृढ), Nom. P. द्र-ढयति, -यितुम्, to make firm, fasten, tighten; confirm, corroborate, affirm, assert; [cf. दृढय।]
22939: द्रढिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
22940: द्रढिमन्, आ, m. firmness, hardness; heaviness; affirmation, assertion.
22941: द्रढिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, (superl.) very hard, hardest, firmest, tightest.
22942: द्रढीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, (compar.) harder, firmer, hardest.
22943: द्रधस् द्रधस्, अस्, n., Ved. a garment (?) .
22944: द्रप्स द्रप्स, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. द्रु or rt. 2. द्रा?), dripping, falling in drops, flowing as liquid; (अस्), m. (according to some only used as a subst.), a drop (as of Soma &c.); a drop of fire, i. e. a spark, (the moon is considered in the Veda as a bright drop; cf. इन्दु); diluted sour milk, thin coagulated milk, diluted curds; [cf. त्रप्स्य; Angl. Sax. dropa; Old Germ. trofo, trauf, traufi.] —द्रप्स-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. sprinkled with drops, besprinkled.
22945: द्रप्सिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. dripping, falling in drops, flowing thickly; distilling; gushing (as rain &c.).
22946: द्रप्स्य, अम्, n. thin coagulated milk, diluted sour milk, diluted curds.
22947: द्रबुद्ध द्रबुद्ध, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a particular high number.
22948: द्रम् द्रम्, cl. 1. P. द्रमति, दद्राम, द्रमिष्यति, द्रमितुम्, to run, go, move, run about: Caus. द्रमयति, -यितुम्: Desid. दिद्रमिषति: Intens. दन्द्रम्यते or दन्द्रन्-ति, to run to and fro; [cf. rt. 2. द्रु; Gr. δρέμ-ω, ἔ-δραμ-ο-ν, δέ-δρομ-α, δρόμος.].
22949: द्रमिट द्रमिट or द्रमित, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-king.
22950: द्रमिल द्रमिल, अस्, m., N. of a country; of a lexicographer [cf. द्रिमिल]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a school.
22951: द्रम्म द्रम्म (fr. Gr. δραχμή), a drachma.
22952: द्रव द्रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. द्रु), run-ning (as a horse); flowing, fluid; dropping, dripping, distilling, oozing; liquid; fused, liquefied, melted; (अस्), m. going, motion, quick motion, walking about; flight, retreat; play, sport, amusement; the act of dropping, distilling, trickling, exudation; fusion, fluid condition of a substance, liquefaction, fluidity; a liquid substance; juice, essence; decoction. —द्रव-ज, अस्, m. a treacle. —द्रव-ता, f. or द्रव-त्व, or द्रवत्वक, अम्, n. fluidity, fusibility, fusion, natural or artificial fluid condition of a sub-stance, wetness, distillation; ductility. —द्रव-द्रव्य, अम्, n. a fluid substance. —द्रव-रसा, f. ‘having fluid essence,’ lac; gum; extract. —द्र-वाधार (°व-आध्°), अस्, m. ‘fluid-holder,’ a small vessel or receiver. —द्रवी-करण, अम्, n. lique-fying, melting. —द्रवी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्-तुम्, to liquefy, dissolve, melt. —द्रवी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, liquefied, melted. —द्रवी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भ-वति, -भवितुम्, to become fluid. —द्रवी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become fluid, liquefied, melted, fused. —द्रवेतर (°व-इत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, other than fluid, hard, solid, congealed. —द्रवोत्तर (°व-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, chiefly fluid, very fluid.
22954: द्रवण, अस्, आ, अम्, running, going; flowing, dropping, exuding; heat.
22955: द्रवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running, flowing, going; trickling, oozing; (अन्ती), f. a river in general; the plant Anthericum Tuberosum; (अत्), ind. quickly, speedily. —द्रवच्-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम् (for द्रवत्-चक्र), having rapid wheels. —द्रवत्-पत्त्री, f. a kind of plant (= शिमृडी). —द्रवत्-पाणि, अयस्, m. pl., Ved. ‘swift of foot,’ epithet of the horses of the Aśvins; (ई), m. du. ‘possessed of quick-footed horses,’ (Sāy.) ‘having nimble hands (to seize the oblation),’ epithet of the Aśvins. —द्रवद्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. drawn by swift horses (as a carriage).
22956: द्रवत्य, Nom. P. द्रवत्यति, &c., to become fluid.
22957: द्रवमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing, fluid, melted.
22958: द्रवर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. running quickly.
22959: द्रवस्य (fr. an unused द्रवस्), Nom. P. द्र-वस्यति, -यितुम्, to harass one's self, take great pains; to attend upon or serve any person.
22960: द्रवि, इस्, m., Ved. a smelter, one who melts metal.
22961: द्रविण, अम्, n. (thought by some to be con-nected with 4. द्रु), any valuable possession, property, substance, goods, wealth, gold, money; thing, matter, material; that of which anything consists; substan-tiality; strength, power; N. of a Sāman; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Vasu Dhara (or Dhava); of a son of Pṛthu; of a mountain; (आस्), m. pl. wealth (in Bhāg.-Purāṇa V. 14, 12); the inhabitants of a Varṣa in Krauñca-dvīpa. —द्रविण-नाशन, अस्, m. ‘destroying vigour,’ the plant Hyperanthera Mo-ringa (= शोभाञ्जन). —द्रविण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing goods or property, rich; strong, powerful. —द्रविणाधिपति (°ण-अध्°), इस्, m. or द्रवि-णेश्वर (°ण-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of wealth,’ an epithet of Kuvera.
22962: द्रविणक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu Agni; [cf. द्रविण।]
22963: द्रविणस्, अस्, n., Ved. property, possession, goods, substance; (आस्), m., N. of a son of Pṛthu; (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 7, 10, द्रविणस् is for द्रविण, and means ‘moving, ever moving,’ as applied to Agni.) —द्रविणस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of goods or wealth, procuring wealth. —द्रविणो-द, अस्, आ, अम्, or द्रविणो-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, or द्रविणो-दस्, granting wealth or any desired good; (अस् or आस्), m. an epithet of Agni; of Tvaṣṭṛ. —द्रविणो-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. = द्रविणो-द।
22964: द्रविणस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring goods or wealth; (Sāy.) desiring sacrificial offerings; (उस्), m. an epithet of Agni.
22965: द्रवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a runner, running.
22966: द्रवित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. running, making haste.
22967: 1. द्रव्य, अम्, n. (thought by some to be con-nected with 4. द्रु), a substance, thing, object; the ingredients or materials of anything; medicinal sub-stance or drug; the receptacle or substratum of pro-perties &c., elementary substance (nine kinds of which are reckoned in the Nyāya philosophy, viz. पृथिवी, earth; अप्, water; तेजस्, fire; वायु, air; आकाश, ether; काल, time; दिश्, space; आत्मन्, soul; and मनस्, mind: the Jainas recognize only six, viz. जीव, धर्म, अ-धर्म, पुद्गल, काल, and आकाश); an object possessed, a possession, wealth, property, goods, wares, chattels, money; a fit object; (according to lexicographers द्रव्य may also mean) bell-metal, brass; ointment; anointing, plastering; spirituous liquor; modesty, propriety; a stake, wager. —द्रव्य-गण, अस्, m. a class of similar substances (in medicine &c.). —द्रव्य-गुण, अस्, m. ‘the quality of medicinal substances,’ N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva by Halāyudha. —द्रव्य-तस्, ind. in substance, according to substance, &c. —द्र-व्य-त्व, अम्, n. substantiality, substance. —द्रव्य-द्वैत, अम्, n. duality of substance, instrumental cause (?). —द्रव्य-निश्चय, अस्, m. ‘enquiry into the (elementary) substances,’ N. of a chapter of Bhaṭṭotpala's commentary to Varāha-mihira's Bṛhat-saṃhitā. —द्रव्य-परिग्रह, अस्, m. the possession of property or wealth. —द्रव्य-पूजा, f. ‘adoration of substance,’ N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva. —द्रव्य-प्रकर्ष, अस्, m. the excellence of a matter. —द्रव्य-प्रकृति, इस्, f. the nature of a matter. —द्रव्य-प्रयोजन, अम्, n. use or employ-ment of any article. —द्रव्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, material, substantial; having or holding any substance; consisting of wealth. —द्रव्य-यज्ञ, अस्, m. offer-ing oblations, material sacrifice, &c. —द्रव्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having property, possessed of substance, rich, wealthy; inherent in the substance. —द्रव्य-वर्धन, अस्, m. ‘wealth-increaser,’ N. of an author of a work on augury. —द्रव्य-वाचक, a substan-tive. —द्रव्य-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase of wealth. —द्रव्य-शुद्धि, इस्, f. cleansing of soiled or de-filed articles, purification of inanimate objects; N. of a work. —द्रव्यशुद्धि-दीपिका, f., N. of a com-mentary on the Dravya-śuddhi by Puruṣottama. —द्रव्य-संस्कार, अस्, m. consecration of articles for sacrifice, purification or cleansing of soiled or defiled articles. —द्रव्य-सञ्चय, अस्, m. accumulation of property, a store of worldly goods. —द्रव्य-सार-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘collection of the essence of sub-stances,’ N. of a philosophical work. —द्रव्य-सिद्धि, इस्, f. acquirement of property or wealth; effecting an object by means of wealth. —द्रव्य-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, holding anything in the hand. —द्रव्यात्मक (°य-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, substantial, containing a substance. —द्रव्यात्म-कार्यसिद्धि, इस्, f. effecting one's object by means of wealth. —द्रव्यान्तर (°य-अन्°), अम्, n. another thing. —द्रव्यार्जन (°य-अर्°), अम्, n. acquiring property, gain or acquisition of wealth. —द्रव्यौघ (°य-ओघ), अस्, m. a stream of wealth, abundance of property.
22968: द्रव्यक, अस्, m. = द्रव्य-वाहक, a carrier or taker of anything.
22969: द्रविड द्रविड, अस्, m., N. of a people and district on the east coast of the Dekhan, (the people are regarded as degraded Kṣatriyas; the name is said to be derived from Draviḍa son of Vṛṣabha-svāmin); (ई), f., N. of a Rāgiṇī.
22970: द्रव्य 2. द्रव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 4. द्रु), derived from or relating to a tree; (अम्), n. lac, the animal dye; extract, gum, resin. (For 1. द्रव्य see col. 2.)
22971: द्रष्टव्य द्रष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. दृश्), to be seen, visible, apparent; to be perceived or recog-nized, perceptible; to be understood; to be examined or investigated; to be regarded or considered as.
22972: द्रष्टु-काम, अस्, आ, अम् (द्रष्टु for द्रष्टुम्, inf. of rt. 1. दृश्), wishing to see, desirous of seeing.
22973: द्रष्टु-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having a mind to see, wishing to see.
22974: द्रष्टु-शक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, able to be seen.
22975: द्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a seer, spectator; one who examines or investigates or decides in a court of law, a judge; appearing, any person or thing that appears. —द्रष्टृ-त्व, अम्, n. the faculty of seeing.
22976: द्रह द्रह, अस्, m. a deep lake.
22977: द्रह्यत् द्रह्यत् (fr. rt. दृह्), ind., Ved. firmly, strongly.
22978: द्रा 1. द्रा or द्रै, q. v., cl. 4. 2. P. द्रा-यति, द्राति, &c., to sleep.
22979: द्रा 2. द्रा (connected with rts. 2. द्रु and द्रम्), cl. 2. P. द्राति, दद्रौ, द्रास्यति, द्रातुम्, to run, make haste; run away, fly; to be ashamed or spoiled: Caus. P. द्रापयति, -यितुम्, अदिद्रपत्, to cause to run: Intens. दाद्रायते, दाद्राति, दाद्रेति; Old Intens. दरिद्राति, see द-रिद्रा; [cf. rt. 2. द्रु, rt. द्रम्: Gr. ἀπο-δρᾶ-ναι, δι-δρά-σκ-ω, δρα-σ-μό-ς, ἄ-δρα-σ-το-ς; δρᾱ-π-έτη-ς fr. Caus. द्रा-प्-अय-ति।]
22980: द्राक्, ind. (fr. rt. 2. द्रा + अञ्च्), quickly, speedily, instantly, immediately, shortly, soon. —द्राग्-भृ-तक, अम्, n. water just drawn from the well.
22981: द्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, flown, run away.
22982: द्राक्षा द्राक्षा, f. a vine, grape; (अस्, ई, अम्), made of grapes; [cf. Hib. dearc, ‘a berry;’ perhaps Old Germ. drūbo; Mod. Germ. traube; Lat. racemus with dropped d.] —द्राक्षा-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a town. —द्राक्षा-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with grapes. —द्राक्षा-रस, अस्, m. grape-juice, wine. —द्राक्षा-लता, f. a vine, vine-tendril.
22983: द्राख् द्राख्, cl. 1. P. द्राखति, &c., to become dry or arid; to be able or com-petent or sufficient; to adorn; to prohibit or pre-vent; [cf. rts. ध्राख् and 1. तृष्; Old Germ. truk-an; Angl. Sax. drig, dryg, drī; Old Iceland. thurka, ‘to dry.’]
22984: द्राघ् द्राघ्, cl. 1. A. द्राघते, &c. (pro-bably a Nom. fr. दीर्घ, but regarded as a separate rt.), to be able or competent; to stretch, lengthen; to exert one's self; to be tired or fatigued; to tire, vex, torment; to roam about, stroll.
22985: द्राघय (fr. दीर्घ), Nom. P. द्राघयति, &c., to lengthen, extend, stretch; to tarry, delay, to be slow or dilatory.
22986: द्राघित, अस्, आ, अम्, lengthened, made long.
22987: द्राघिमन्, आ, m. length; a degree of longitude. —द्राघिम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, long, lengthy.
22988: द्राघिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, (superl. fr. दीर्घ), longest, very long.
22989: द्राघीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. दीर्घ), longer, very or exceedingly long.
22991: द्राङ्क्ष् द्राङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. द्राङ्क्षति, &c., to utter a discordant sound; to croak, to caw &c. (as a bird); to desire, wish, long for; [cf. ध्राङ्क्ष्।]
22992: द्राङ्गवध द्राङ्गवध, अस्, m., N. of a man.
22993: द्राड् द्राड्, cl. 1. A. द्राडते, &c., to divide, split, pierce, pull to pieces, &c.; to go to pieces; [cf. ध्राड्।]
22994: द्राप द्राप, अस्, m. mud, mire; heaven, sky; a fool, blockhead, an idiot; a N. of Śiva with his hair twisted or matted; a small shell, Cypræa Moneta.
22995: द्रापि 1. द्रापि, इस्, m., Ved. a mantle, garment.
22996: द्रापि 2. द्रापि, इस्, m. (according to Mahī-dhara fr. the Caus. of rt. 2. द्रा), Ved. ‘one who causes to run,’ epithet of Rudra.
22997: द्रामिल द्रामिल, अस्, m. (fr. द्रमिल), ‘born in Dramila,’ N. of the Muni Cāṇakya; (also द्रोमिण।)
22998: द्रायुध द्रायुध (?), a peculiar species of horse.
22999: द्राव द्राव, अस्, m. (fr. 2. द्रु), flight, retreat; speed, going quickly; running, flowing; fusing, liquefaction; heat. —द्राव-कर, अम्, n. a kind of borax, a flux.
23000: द्रावक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to run; solvent; captivating, enchanting; cunning; (अस्), m. a flux to assist the fusion of metals; a kind of stone, a loadstone; a thief; a wit, wag, sharp or clever man; a libertine, a lecher; a kind of Rasa or sentiment; (इका), f. saliva (as ‘flowing’); (अम्), n. bee's wax (as ‘melting’); a drug employed in diseases of the spleen. —द्रावक-कन्द, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous plant (= तैल-कन्द).
23001: द्रावण, अस्, आ, अम्, putting to flight, causing to run or retreat; fusing; (अम्), n. the act of causing to fly or retreat, putting to flight; fusing, distilling; the fruit of Strychnos Potatorum, used for purifying water; the clearing-nut.
23002: द्रावयत्-सख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing a com-panion to go quickly; carrying a rider quickly away.
23003: द्रावयाण, अस्, आ, अम् (part. fr. the Caus.), put-ting to flight, causing to run.
23004: द्रावयित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. causing to run or to make haste.
23005: द्रावित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to run or fly, put to flight, chased, driven away; melted, liquefied; softened.
23006: द्राव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to run, to be set in motion, to be put to flight; fusible, liquefiable, to be made fluid.
23007: द्राविड द्राविड, अस्, ई, अम्, Drāviḍian, be-longing to the Draviḍas, a Draviḍa; (आस्), m. pl. the Draviḍa people and their country (properly the coast of Coromandel from Madras to Cape Comorin, or the country in which Tamul is spoken); (अस्), m. a Brāhman of Drāviḍa or rather of the south, (the name is applied to a class of Brāhmanical tribes called the five Drāviḍa Brāhmans, comprehending all those of the peninsula, i. e. Drāviḍa, Karṇāta, Gujerāta, Mahārāṣṭra or Marāṭha, and Telinga); a patronymic from Draviḍa; N. of a scholiast of the Amara-koṣa; a particular number; Curcuma Zedoaria (= वेध-मुख्य, = कर्चूर); (ई), f. cardamoms.
23008: द्राविडक, अस्, m. zedoary, Curcuma Zedoaria; (अम्), n. black salt (= विड्-लवण). —द्राविड-भूतिक, अस्, m. Curcuma Zedoaria.
23009: द्राविणोदस द्राविणोदस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्र-विणो-दस्), Ved. coming from or belonging to those who present gifts, i. e. from sacrificers; relating to Draviṇo-das, i. e. Agni.
23010: द्रावित द्रावित। See under द्राव, col. 1.
23011: द्राह् द्राह्, cl. 1. A. द्राहते, &c., to wake; to deposit, pledge, put or cast down.
23012: द्राह्यायण द्राह्यायण, अस्, m., N. of an author of certain Kalpa-sūtras. —द्राह्यायण-सूत्र, अम्, n. the Sūtras of Drāhyāyaṇa. —द्राह्यायण-सूत्र-भाष्य, अम्, n., N. of a commentary on the preceding work by Dhanvin.
23013: द्राह्यायणक, अम्, n. the Sūtras of Drāhyāyaṇa.
23014: द्राह्यायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Drāh-yāyaṇa.
23015: द्राह्यायणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to Drāhyā-yaṇa, composed by him.
23016: द्रिमिल द्रिमिल, अस्, m., N. of a lexicogra-pher; (various reading for द्रमिल, q. v.)
23017: द्रु 1. द्रु, cl. 5. P. द्रुणोति, &c., to hurt, injure, wound or kill; to repent; to go; [cf. Old Germ. drug, ga-driuzit, ar-driuzit.]
23018: द्रु 2. द्रु (connected with rts. 1. द्रा and द्रम्), cl. 1. P. (in the poetry of the later language also A.) द्रवति, -ते, दुद्राव, दुद्रुवे, द्रोष्यति, -ते, अदुद्रुवत् (Ved. अदुद्रोत्, दुद्र-वत्), द्रोतुम्, to run, make haste, run away, retreat, fly; to run up to, rush, attack, assault quickly (with acc.); to move, go; to become fluid, dissolve, melt; to distil or ooze; to drop: Caus. P. (ep. also A.) द्रा-वयति (-ते), Aor. अदुद्रवत् or अदिद्रवत्, &c., to cause to run or flow; to cause to run away, put to flight; to make fluid, melt; Ved. A. द्रवयते, &c., to run, flow: Desid. दुद्रूषति; Desid. of Caus. दु-द्रावयिषति or दिद्रावयिषति: Intens. दोद्रू-यते, दोद्रोति; [cf. Goth. drib, ‘to drive,’ fr. drā-vayati: Angl. Sax. driopan, dropa: Old Germ. trofo, trauf, traufi, triufan: Lith. drebo, ‘I trem-ble;’ drimba, ‘it drops;’ pa-dribbà, ‘running of the eyes:’ Hib. driogaim, ‘I trickle;’ drabh, ‘a chariot:’ probably Germ. tau, ‘dew,’ from original trau, ‘the river Drau:’ probably also Lat. gruere in in-gruere and ruere.]
23019: 3. द्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, at the end of a comp., cf. मित-द्°, रघु-द्°, शत-द्°; (उस्), f. going, motion.
23020: द्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, quick, speedy, swift; quickly pronounced and therefore indistinct; flown, escaped, run or running away; scattered, diffused; liquid, dissolved, melted, fluid; (अस्), m. a scorpion; a tree [cf. द्रुण and द्रुम]; (अम्), ind. quickly, rapidly, instantly, immediately, without delay. —द्रुत-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, quicker, swifter; (अम्), ind. very quickly, as quickly as possible. —द्रुततर-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, having a very swift course, quicker in motion. —द्रुत-त्व, अम्, n. melting, fusion. —द्रुत-पद, अस्, आ, अम्, quick of step, going quickly; (अम्), ind. a quick pace or step, quickly; (अम्), n. a kind of metre consisting of four lines of twelve syllables each. —द्रुत-बोध, अस्, m. ‘quick understanding,’ N. of a grammar. —द्रुतबोधिका, f., N. of a modern commentary on the Raghu-vaṃśa. —द्रुत-मध्या, f. ‘quick in the middle,’ a kind of metre consisting of two lines of twenty-three syllables each. —द्रुत-वराह-कुल, अम्, n. a herd of flying boars. —द्रुत-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having a quick step. —द्रुत-विलम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, quick and slow alternately; (अम्), n. or द्रुत-विलम्बितक, अम्, n. a kind of metre consisting of four lines of twelve syllables each.
23021: द्रुति, इस्, f., N. of the wife of Nakta and mother of Gaya.
23022: द्रु 4. द्रु, उस्, उ, m. n. = दारु (said to be fr. rt. दॄ), wood, any implement made of wood, as a cup or an oar; (उस्), m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. द्रु, to go or grow), a tree; a branch; [cf. 2. दारु; Zend dru, dāuru, ‘wood, spear;’ Gr. δρῦ-ς, δρῠ-μά, δρῡ-μό-ς, δρυ-τόμο-ς, δέν-δρε-ο-ν, δρία, δόρυ, δούρειος, δουράτ-εο-ς, δρύτη, δροίτη; Goth. triu, triv-ein-s, ‘wooden;’ Old Sax. trio, ‘wood, tree;’ Eng. tree; Slav. dre†vo, ‘tree;’ Lith. derva.] —द्रु-किलिम, अम्, n. a tree, a sort of pine, Pinus Deva-dāru; [cf. किलिम।] —द्रु-घण or द्रु-घन, अस्, m. a wooden mace, mallet, hammer; an iron weapon made like a carpenter's hammer; an axe, a hatchet; a kind of plant [cf. भूमि-चम्पक]; an epithet of Brahmā. —द्रु-घ्नी, f. a hatchet for cutting wood. —द्रु-णस, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘having a nose like a tree,’ large-nosed. —द्रु-णह or द्रु-नह, अस्, m. a scabbard, the sheath of a sword. —द्रु-पद, अम्, n., Ved. a pillar or post of wood, a pillar in general; (अस्), m., N. of a king of the Pāñcālas, he was the son of Pṛṣata and was father of Dhṛ-ṣṭa-dyumna, of Śikhaṇḍin, of Śikhaṇḍinī, and of Kṛṣṇā the wife of the Pāṇḍu princes, hence called Draupadī; (आ), f., N. of a Ṛc; (ई), f. having large feet. —द्रुपदात्मजा (°द-आत्°), f. ‘daughter of Dru-pada,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇā or Draupadī, some-times identified with Umā. —द्रुपदादित्य (°द-आद्°), अस्, m. a form of the Sun. —द्रु-पदी, f. a splay-footed female. —द्रु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with wood. —द्रु-षद्, त्, त्, त्, or द्रु-षद्वन्, आ, वरी, अ (fr. द्रु-सद्), Ved. sitting in or on a piece of wood or a tree. —द्रु-सल्लक, अस्, m. a kind of tree. —द्र्व्-अन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose food is wood.
23023: द्रुम, अस्, m. (said by some to be for द्रुह्म fr. rt. दृह्), a tree in general; a tree of Svarga or paradise; N. of a prince of the Kim-puruṣas; a prince of the Yakṣas; (आ), f., N. of a river. —द्रु-म-किन्नर-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a prince of the Gandharvas. —द्रुम-किन्नर-राज, अस्, m., N. of Druma who was king of the Kin-naras. —द्रुम-किन्नरराज-परिपृच्छा, f. ‘the questioning of Druma, king of the Kin-naras,’ N. of a Buddhist work. —द्रुम-नख, अस्, m. ‘tree-nail,’ a thorn. —द्रुम-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of wood, wooden. —द्रुम-रत्न-शाखा-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a prince of the Kin-naras. —द्रुम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, overgrown with trees, woody. —द्रुम-वल्क, अस् or अम्, m. or n.
