24266: निः-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing, sending, putting away; spending, passing (time); wiping away (as tears).
24267: निःप° निः-प° and निः-फ°। See under निष्-प° and निष्-फ°।
24268: निःशंसय निः-शंसय, wrongly spelt for निः-संशय।
24269: निःशङ्क निः-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from fear, fearless, without misgiving or apprehension, having no cares, free from risk; (अम्), ind. fearlessly, without fear or care, without anxiety. —निःशङ्क-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping without care, sleeping calmly and securely.
24270: निः-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from fear or care, free from risk, secure.
24271: निःशब्द निः-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्, noiseless, soundless, not making a noise; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (?), soundlessness, silence, a calm; (अम्), ind. without noise, noiselessly; [cf. नि-शब्द।]
24272: निःशम निः-शम, अस्, m. uneasiness, dis-composure, anxiety.
24273: निःशयान निः-शयान, अस्, आ, अम्, not sleep-ing, not lying down.
24274: निःशरण निः-शरण, अस्, आ, अम्, without protection or refuge, defenceless, unprotected.
24275: निःशर्कर निः-शर्कर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from stones or pebbles (as a bathing-place).
24276: निःशलाक निः-शलाक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from talking birds (as parrots, jays, or crows); solitary, private.
24277: निःशल्य निः-शल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from an arrow; free from spikes or thorns; (अम्), ind. without an arrow; unthorny; without pain or diffi-culty; without reluctance, willingly.
24278: निःशस् निः-शस्, f., Ved. refusing, declin-ing; (Sāy.) disinclination, absence of wish or desire, dislike (= निः-शंसन).
24279: निःशस्त्र निः-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without arms, unarmed, weaponless.
24280: निःशास् निः-शास् (निस्-श्°), cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, Ved. to order off or away; to expel.
24281: निःशिष् निः-शिष् (निस्-श्°), Caus. -शेषयति, -यितुम्, to take away or destroy completely, con-sume entirely, annihilate; (also regarded as a Nom. fr. निः-शेष।)
24282: निः-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no remainder, with-out remainder, completely spent, complete, entire, whole, (often in the sense of an adverb at the be-ginning of a comp. before a participle, e. g. निः-शेष-भग्न, completely broken); (अम् or एण), ind. completely, totally; निःशेषं कृ, to destroy or consume completely; [cf. अ-शेष।] —निःशेष-तस्, ind. without remainder, completely, totally. —निःशेष-ता, f. complete destruction.
24284: निः-शेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, having nothing left, com-pletely consumed or finished, destroyed, annihilated; (wrongly read नि-शेषित।)
24285: निःशुक्र निः-शुक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. without brilliancy; without virile energy, impotent.
24286: निःशूक निः-शूक, अस्, m. beardless rice without any awn.
24288: निःशोक निः-शोक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from sorrow or care.
24289: निःशोध्य निः-शोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be purified, not requiring cleansing; clean, pure.
24290: निःश्मश्रु निः-श्मश्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, beardless; (wrongly read नि-श्मश्रु।)
24292: निःश्रयणी निः-श्रयणी or निः-श्रयिणी, f. a ladder, a staircase, steps, &c.; [cf. नि-श्रयणी, नि-श्रयिणी।]
24293: निः-श्रेणि, इस्, ई, f. a ladder or staircase, a flight of stairs or steps; the wild date tree.
24294: निःश्रेणिका, f. a species of grass.
24295: निःश्री निः-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, deprived of happi-ness or prosperity, unfortunate. —निःश्री-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made unfortunate, rendered unhappy.
24296: निःश्रीक, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of beauty (as a dead body), deprived of happiness, &c.; one whose happiness is destroyed, unhappy, inglorious; (also read नि-श्रीक।) —निःश्रीक-ता, f. absence of good fortune, want of good luck.
24298: निःश्रेयस निः-श्रेयस, अस्, ई, अम्, having nothing better or superior, the best, most excellent; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. final beatitude, ultimate bliss or supreme felicity in the life to come, happiness, welfare; knowledge which brings deliver-ance, learning; belief, faith, devotedness; appre-hension, conception.
24299: निःश्वस् निः-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति, -श्वसि-तुम्, to breathe out, expire, sigh.
24300: निः-श्वसन, अम्, n. breathing out, sighing.
24301: निः-श्वसित, अस्, आ, अम्, breathed out, sighed; sighing, breathing out; (अम्), n. sighing, expiration, a sigh.
24302: निः-श्वस्य, ind. having sighed, sighing, breath-ing out.
24303: निः-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing out, expiration; breath, sighing, a sigh; (often read नि-श्वास।) —निः-श्वास-परम, अस्, आ, अम्, chiefly engaged in sigh-ing, melancholy, sorrowful. —निःश्वास-संहिता, f., N. of a code of laws supposed to have been revealed by Rudra-Śiva.
24304: निःषमम् निः-षमम्, ind. (fr. निस् + स-मम्), at the wrong time, unseasonably.
24305: निःषिध् निः-षिध्, त्, f. (fr. निस् + सिध् = साध्), granting, bestowing; grant, oblation, gift, donation; (Sāy.) hindrance, obstruction; destroying, destructive, adverse.
24306: निः-षिध्वन्, आ, अरी, अ (fr. निस् + सिध्वन्), Ved. granting, presenting; (Sāy.) coming to com-plete perfection.
24307: निःसंशय निः-संशय, अस्, आ, अम्, un-doubted, infallible, unerring, certain; not doubting, not doubtful; (अम्), ind. without doubt, doubtless, infallibly, certainly, surely.
24308: निःसङ्कक्ष निः-सङ्कक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not per-plexed, not confused; (also written नि-सङ्कक्ष।)
24309: निःसङ्ख्य निः-सङ्ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, innu-merable, numberless.
24310: निःसङ्ग निः-सङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, unattached, unobstructed; not attached, not devoted, regardless, indifferent to (with loc.); free from worldly attach-ment or selfish desires, unselfish, disinterested; un-connected, separated; (एन or अम्), ind. without attachment, without interest, unselfishly, without further reflection; (also written निः-षङ्ग; cf. अ-सङ्ग।) —निःसङ्ग-ता, f. or निःसङ्ग-त्व, अम्, n. absence of attachment, unselfishness, disinterested-ness, indifference.
24311: निःसञ्चार निः-सञ्चार, अस्, आ, अम्, not mov-ing, not walking about, not leaving one's home.
24312: निःसञ्ज्ञ निः-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, senseless, insensible, unconscious.
24313: निःसत्त्व निः-सत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, without courage or strength, unenergetic, weak, impotent; insignificant, low, mean; non-existent, unsubstantial; deprived of living beings; (अम्), n. absence of power, want of energy; insignificance; non-existence.
24314: निःसत्य निः-सत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue, false. —निःसत्य-ता, f. insincerity, falsehood, untruth.
24315: निःसन्तति निः-सन्तति, इस्, इस्, इ, destitute of offspring, childless.
24316: निः-सन्तान, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of posterity, childless.
24317: निःसन्दिग्ध निः-सन्दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, un-doubted, not doubtful, certain; (अम्), ind. without any doubt, certainly.
24318: निः-सन्देह, अस्, आ, अम्, free from uncertainty, doubtless, undoubted, certain; (अम्), ind. without any doubt, certainly.
24319: निःसन्धि निः-सन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, having no joints, having no joints perceptible, well knit, com-pact, close, firm.
24320: निःसपत्न निः-सपत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, having no rival, not sharing the possession of anything with another; not claimed by another, belonging exclu-sively to one possessor; having no enemies.
24321: निःसम्पात निः-सम्पात, अस्, आ, अम्, afford-ing no passage, blocked up; (अस्), m. thick dark-ness, midnight.
24322: निःसम्बन्ध निः-सम्बन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, with-out relatives.
24323: निःसम्बाध निः-सम्बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, not contracted, large, spacious.
24324: निःसम्भ्रम निः-सम्भ्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, not perplexed or flurried, unembarrassed.
24325: निःसरण निः-सरण। See under निः-सृ, col. 2.
24326: निःसलिल निः-सलिल, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, having no water.
24327: निःसह निः-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, unable to bear or support or resist, impatient; powerless, weak; intolerable, unbearable, irresistible. —निःसह-ता, f. or निःसह-त्व, अम्, n. inability to bear or support; impatience, unendurance.
24328: निःसहाय निः-सहाय, अस्, आ, अम्, without helpers or associates, unassisted.
24329: निःसाध्वस निः-साध्वस, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, bold; (अम्), ind. fearlessly, boldly. —निःसाध्वस-त्व, अम्, n. fearlessness, boldness.
24330: निःसामर्थ्य निः-सामर्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit, unsuitable.
24331: निःसामान्य निः-सामान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, extra-ordinary, uncommon, unusual, special.
24332: निःसार 1. निः-सार, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. निः-सार see under निः-सृ below), sapless, pithless, worthless, vain, vapid, unsubstantial; (अस्), m. the plant Trophis Aspera; a kind of time in music; (आ), f. the pisang, Musa Sapientum (= कदली). —निःसार-ता, f. saplessness, worthlessness, vanity.
24333: निःसाल निः-साल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being out of the house.
24334: निःसीमन् निः-सीमन्, आ, आ, अ, immeasurable, having no boundaries or limits.
24335: निःसुख निः-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, joyless, sad, unhappy; disagreeable, distressing.
24336: निःसृ निः-सृ (निस्-स्°), cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to go out, come forth, issue, slip out, depart, withdraw: Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go out or away, turn out, expel.
24337: निः-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, issuing out. —निःसर-त्व, अम्, n. = पित्त-रोग।
24338: निः-सरण, अम्, n. going forth or out, coming forth, exit; the egress or outlet from a house, market-place, town, &c., the gate, the gate-way; a means or expedient, a remedy; departure, dying, death; final beatitude.
24339: 2. निः-सार, अस्, m. (for 1. निः-सार see above), going forth or out.
24340: निः-सारण, अम्, n. driving out, expelling, turn-ing out; the egress or outlet from a building, town, &c., a passage, road of ingress or egress.
24341: निः-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned out, made to come out, expelled, dismissed.
24342: निः-सार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be turned out, to be excluded or expelled.
24343: निः-सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth or out, broken forth; having departed (with abl.).
24344: निःस्तम्भ निः-स्तम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, without posts or columns, having no pillars.
24345: निःस्तुति निः-स्तुति, इस्, इस्, इ (also read नि-स्तुति), praising nothing, without praising (anything).
24346: निःस्नेह निः-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, without unction, not greasy or unctuous, dry; without love or affection, insensible, cold, unfeeling; not longing for, indifferent; not loved, uncared for, hated; (आ), f. linseed, Linum Usitatissimum. —निःस्नेह-फला, f. a species of Solanum with white flowers.
24347: निःस्पन्द निः-स्पन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, motionless.
24348: निःस्पृह निः-स्पृह, अस्, आ, अम् (often written नि-स्पृह), free from desire; disregarding, indiffer-ent to (with abl.); content, unenvious.
24350: निःस्रु निः-स्रु (निस्-स्°), Caus. -स्रावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to flow out or off, to empty.
24351: निः-स्रव, अस्, m. remainder, surplus, overplus (with abl.).
24352: निः-स्राव, अस्, m. causing to flow out, expending, expense; the moisture or water of boiled rice; [cf. नि-स्राव।]
24353: निःस्व निः-स्व, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of one's own, having no property, indigent, poor. —निःस्व-ता, f. poverty. —निःस्वी-कृत or निःस्वी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of one's property, impoverished.
24354: निःस्वन निः-स्वन, अस्, m. (fr. स्वन् with निस्), sound, noise, voice; [cf. नि-स्वन।]
24355: निःस्वभाव निः-स्वभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, void of peculiarities, without peculiar properties.
24356: निःस्वादु निः-स्वादु, उस्, उस् or द्वी, उ, taste-less, void of flavour, insipid, unsavoury.
24357: निःस्वाध्याय निः-स्वाध्याय, अस्, आ, अम्, not muttering prayers, not repeating texts. —निःस्वा-ध्याय-वषट्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, neither repeating holy texts nor sacrificing.
24358: निकक्ष नि-कक्ष, अस्, m., Ved. the armpit.
24359: निकट नि-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, situated at the side, near, proximate, close by; without neighbours, kinless?; (अस्, अम्), m. n. proximity; (ए), ind. in the neighbourhood, at hand. —निकटी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, approached.
24360: निकथित नि-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, told, re-lated (?).
24361: निकथितिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has told.
24362: निकम् नि-कम्, cl. 10. A. -कामयते, -च-कमे, &c., to long for, wish for, have a desire for, lust after (with acc.).
24363: नि-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of, longing for, vehemently desiring, (often at the beginning of a comp. in the sense of नि-कामम्, ind.); (अस्), m. desire, wish; (अम्), ind. according to wish or desire, willingly, according to pleasure or to one's satisfaction, to one's heart's content; यदा निकामम्, if you please, if you like. —निकाम-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, covetous. —निकाम-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining ac-cording to wish.
24364: नि-कामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. desirous of, longing for.
24365: नि-कामन, अम्, n. desire, longing after.
24366: नि-कामयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, longing for, wish-ing for.
24367: निकर नि-कर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कॄ with नि), a heap, pile; a flock or multitude; a bundle; pith, sap, essence; suitable gift, a honorarium; a treasure, the best of anything, a treasure belonging to Kuvera.
24368: 1. नि-कार, अस्, m. piling up or winnowing corn; tossing or lifting up.
24369: निकष नि-कष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कष् for कर्ष् = कृष् with नि), the touchstone, the streak of gold or test made on it [cf. नि-काष]; (आ), f., N. of the mother of Rāvaṇa or of the mother of the Piśitāśana fiends or imps in general. —निकषात्-मज (°षा-आत्°), अस्, m. a Rākṣasa, a sort of demon; [cf. कषा-पुत्र।]
24371: नि-कषा, ind. near to (with acc.), proximate; in the middle, betwixt, between (with acc.).
24372: निकषाय, Nom. A. निकषायते, &c., to be used or serve as a touchstone.
24373: निकस नि-कस, निकसात्मज = नि-कष and निकषात्मज, q. v.
24374: निकाणम् नि-काणम्, ind. (fr. rt. कण् with नि), having closed the eyes; निकाणम् अक्षि जल्-पति or अक्षि-निकाणं जल्पति, he speaks with closed eyes.
24375: निकाय नि-काय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. चि with नि), a heap, an assemblage, a group, class, association or set of persons who perform like duties; a congre-gation, a school; a flock, multitude in general; a house, dwelling-place, habitation, hiding-place; the body; (according to Mahī-dhara) the air, wind (Ved.); a butt, aim, mark; the universal Soul, Supreme Being. —निकायान्तरीय (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to another assemblage or school.
24376: नि-कायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, an epithet of particular oblations or sacrifices.
24377: नि-काय्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), a dwelling, house.
24378: निकार 1. and 2. नि-कार। For 1. see above; for 2. see under नि-कृ, p. 483, col. 1.
24380: निकावल्गा निकावल्गा, f., N. of a woman, (perhaps rather two names, निका and वल्गा।)
24381: निकाश नि-काश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. काश् with नि), the horizon; appearance, sight; (at the end of an adj. comp.) having the appearance of, similar, like; [cf. नी-काश।]
24382: निकाषम् नि-काषम्, ind. having pounded or mixed together.
24384: निकिल्बिष नि-किल्बिष, अम्, n., Ved. freeing from sin, deliverance from evil.
24385: निकुचिति नि-कुचिति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. कुञ्च् with नि), contraction ?; [cf. Pāṇ. I. 2, 18.]
24386: निकुच्य-कर्णि, ind. with the ears hanging down.
24387: नि-कुञ्चक, अस्, m. a measure of capacity equal to (1/4) of a Kuḍava; a species of reed (= वानीर).
24389: निकुञ्ज नि-कुञ्ज, अस्, अम्, m. n. = कुञ्ज, an arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with shrubs and creepers, a thicket.
24390: निकुञ्जिकाम्ला (°का-अम्°), f. a species of plant (= कुञ्जिका, कुञ्ज-वल्लरी).
24391: निकुम्भ नि-कुम्भ, अस्, m. the plant Croton Polyandrum; N. of a Dānava who, like Kumbha, was son of Pra-hlāda, (he was father of Sunda and Upa-sunda); N. of a Rakṣas; of a son of Kumbha-karṇa; of an attendant of Śiva; of one of Skanda's attendants; N. of one of the Viśve Devāḥ, (also read विस्कुम्भु); N. of a hero on the side of the Kurus; N. of a king of Ayodhyā, son of Hary-aśva and father of Saṃhatāśva; (ई), f. the plant Croton Polyandrum. —निकुम्भाख्य-जीव (°भ-आख्°), अम्, n. a plant, Croton Jamalgota (= जय-पाल).
24392: नि-कुम्भित, अम्, n. a kind of time in music.
24393: नि-कुम्भिला, f. (fr. कुम्भ, a jar?), a place where oblations are offered; a grove at the western gate of Laṅkā for the performance of sacrificial rites; (according to another commentator) an image of Bhadra-kālī on the west side of Laṅkā; (also, according to some, नि-कुम्भिलस्, m., and नि-कुम्-भिलम्, n.)
24394: निकुरुम्ब नि-कुरुम्ब or नि-कुरुम्बक, अम्, n. a flock, mass, multitude; (also read नि-कुरम्ब, -नि-कुरूम्ब, नि-कुरुम्भ।)
24395: निकुलीनिका नि-कुलीनिका, f. a family art or one inherited by birth, any skill or skilful act pecu-liar to a race.
24396: निकूल नि-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, going down hill, (opposed to उत्-कूल); standing on a declivity or bank.
24397: निकृ नि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to put down, bring down, lower, humiliate, subdue, overcome, overpower, depreciate, debase; to act in a low or base manner, to treat ill; (in the post-Vedic literature only occurring in the past part. नि-कृत, q. v.): Desid. नि-चिकीर्षति, to wish to subdue.
24398: नि-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acted badly or basely, to be injured; (अस्माकं तैर् निकर्तव्यम्, a wrong is to be done us by them.)
24399: 2. नि-कार, अस्, m. putting down, bringing down, humiliation, subjugation; injury, insult, wrong, offence; wickedness, malice, abuse, reproach, disrespect; op-position, contradiction.
24401: नि-कारिन्, ई, m., Ved. an injurer, oppressor.
24402: नि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought down, lowered, cast down, humbled, humiliated; insulted, offended; afflicted; injured; tricked, cheated, deceived; re-moved, set aside, dismissed; dishonest, wicked, per-verse; low, base, vile; (अम्), n. lowering, humbling, humiliation; (also read नि-कृति।) —निकृत-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, evil-minded. —निकृत-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, depraved in mind.
24403: नि-कृति, इस्, f. low conduct, baseness, wicked-ness, dishonest practice, dishonesty, fraud, deception, deceit, cheating; offence, insult; abuse, reproach; rejection, removal; poverty, indigence; wickedness, a wicked person (personified as a daughter of A-dharma and Hiṃsā, or Nirṛti); (इस्, इस्, इ), base, low, dishonest, wicked; (इस्), m., N. of one of the eight Vasus. —निकृति-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, versed in dishonesty, well acquainted with vice.
24404: निकृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. नि-कृत), = नि-कृति, dis-honest, low, base, wicked.
24405: नि-कृत्या, f. wickedness, dishonesty, fraud, &c., = नि-कृति।
24406: नि-कृत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. acting basely, deceitful.
24407: निकृत् नि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut down, hew down, cut away, cut or chop off, cut through, cut asunder, cut to pieces, massacre; tear off, tear away, wear away; A. (-ते), to cut one-self (or one's nails &c.); to cut down &c.: Caus. -कर्तयति, &c., to cause to cut or cut down.
24408: नि-कर्तन, अम्, n. cutting down, cutting to pieces, cutting off.
24409: नि-कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, cut up. —निकृत्त-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up by the roots.
24410: नि-कृन्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, cutting down, cutting off, destroying; (अस्), m., N. of a hell; (अम्), n. massacring, cutting, cutting off, destruction; an in-strument for cutting.
24411: निकृष् नि-कृष्, cl. 1. 6. P. -कर्षति, -कृ-षति, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw down, drag down; to tear asunder (?). In Mahā-bh. 1. 3616. नि-कृष्यते may mean ‘is drawn down by the stream of a river.’
24412: नि-कर्षण, अम्, n. an open space for recreation, a sort of play-ground in or near a town; a court at the entrance of a house; a neighbourhood.
24413: नि-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, debased, low, base, vile, vulgar; despised, outcast; near; (अम्), n. vicinity, proximity. —निकृष्टाशय (°ट-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having base intentions. —निकृष्टाशय-ता, f. the state of one who has base intentions, base disposition of mind; jealousy. —निकृष्टोपाधि-ता (°ट-उप्°), f. a state of base or low deception.
24414: निकेचाय नि-केचाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. चि with नि), piling or collecting repeatedly.
24415: निकेत नि-केत or नि-केतक, अस्, m. = केतन, a house, mansion, habitation; a mark, countersign.
24416: निकेतन नि-केतन, अस्, m. an onion; (अम्), n. = नि-केत, a house, mansion, abode, habitation, temple.
24417: निकोचक नि-कोचक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुञ्च् with नि), the tree Alangium Decapetalum; (अम्), n. the fruit of this tree.
24418: नि-कोचन, अम्, n. contracting, contraction, com-pression.
24419: निकोठक नि-कोठक, अस्, m. = नि-कोचक above.
24420: निकोथक नि-कोथक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुथ् with नि), N. of a teacher with the epithet Bhāyajātya.
24421: निकोश्य नि-कोश्य, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a particular part of the entrails of sacrificial animals; [cf. कोश्य।]
24422: निक्तहस्त निक्त-हस्त। See rt. निज्, p. 485.
24423: निक्रन्द् नि-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. -क्रन्दति, -क्रन्-दितुम्, Ved. to utter a cry in a direction downwards (as a bird on a tree): Caus. -क्रन्दयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to roar &c.
24424: निक्रम् नि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्र-मितुम्, to set the foot on the ground, put down the feet; to enter; to tread down (with acc.)
24425: नि-क्रमण, अम्, n., Ved. putting down the feet, treading down; the place where the foot is put, foot-step, foot-fall.
24426: निक्रीड् नि-क्रीड्, Caus. -क्रीडयति, &c., to play, sport.
24427: नि-क्रीड, अस्, m. play, sport; मरुतां निक्रीडः, N. of a Sāman.
24428: निक्वण नि-क्वण or नि-क्वाण, अस्, m. a musical tone or sound; any sound.
24429: निक्ष् निक्ष्, cl. 1. P. निक्षति, &c., to pierce (Ved.); to kiss.
24431: निक्षा निक्षा, f. a nit; (a wrong form for लिक्षा।)
24432: निक्षिप् नि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw down, cast or put down, throw upon, put or lay down; put in, pour in; to deliver anything (acc.) to a person (loc.); to give or hand over, grant; to deposit, commit, deliver to any one's charge, intrust; to install, appoint, establish; to lay aside, give up, leave off, cast off, repel; to encamp: Caus. -क्षेपयति, &c., to cause to put down, to cause to be set down in writing.
24433: नि-क्षिपत्, अन्, अन्ती or अती, अत्, throwing down or on, placing in or upon.
24434: नि-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown down or upon, put down, laid down or on, placed into, thrust into; deposited, pawned, pledged; rejected, abandoned, foregone, given or thrown away; sent, sent off or away. —निक्षिप्त-वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has ceased talking or left off boasting.
24435: नि-क्षिप्य, ind. having placed or laid down or upon; having given in charge, having intrusted or deposited in a place of safety.
24436: नि-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing upon, casting on (with loc.); a deposit, pledge, trust, anything de-posited without a seal in trust or as a compensation, anything pawned; abandoning, parting with, throw-ing away; sending or putting away; wiping, drying; in निक्षेप-लिपि probably N. of a country; [cf. उत्-क्षेप, प्र-क्षेप, वि-क्षेप।]
24437: नि-क्षेपण, अम्, n. putting down (the feet); a means by which or place in which anything is kept.
24438: नि-क्षेपित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be put down or set down in writing, committed to writing, in-scribed.
24439: नि-क्षेप्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what places or deposits, delivers to one's care; (ता), m. a depositor, a pawner or pledger.
24440: नि-क्षेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited, to be thrust into.
24441: निक्षुभा नि-क्षुभा, f. (fr. rt. क्षुभ् with नि), N. of the mother of Maga.
24442: निखन् नि-खन्, cl. 1. P. A. -खनति, -ते, -खनितुम्, to dig into (the ground), bury; to dig in or up, root up; to infix, pierce (with an arrow &c.), to fix, implant.
24443: नि-खनन, अम्, n. digging in, burying.
24444: नि-खात, अस्, आ, अम्, dug in, buried; dug up, excavated; fixed in the ground as a stake.
24445: नि-खानित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. the Caus.), infixed, dug in, fixed.
24446: निखर्ब नि-खर्ब or नि-खर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, dwarfish, a dwarf; (अम्), n. a billion; [cf. खर्व।]
24448: नि-खर्वट, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas.
24449: निखिद् नि-खिद्, cl. 6. P., Ved. -खिदति, -खेत्तुम्, to press down; (Sāy.) to cut off, remove.
24450: निखिल नि-खिल, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for निः-खिल), complete, all, whole, entire; (एन), ind. completely, totally; [cf. खिल, अ-ख्°।]
24451: निखुर्यप निखुर्य-प (?), अस्, m., Ved. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
24452: निगड नि-गड, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably fr. rt. गड् = rt. गल्; cf. नि-गल), an iron chain for the feet, a fetter, especially the chain used to secure the hind feet of an elephant or a noose for catching the feet and throwing an animal down, a fetter or shackle in general, gyves.
24453: नि-गडन, अम्, n. putting in irons or fetters, binding, fettering.
24454: निगडय, Nom. P. निगडयति, &c., to put in irons or fetters, to bind, fetter.
24456: नि-गडित, अस्, आ, अम्, chained, bound, tied, &c.
24457: निगण नि-गण, अस्, m. the smoke of a burnt offering or sacrificial fire; [cf. नि-गरण।]
24458: निगद् नि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, &c., to recite, proclaim, declare, communicate, tell, speak, say, shout out; to speak to, address any one (with acc.), to tell anything to any one (with two acc.); to enumerate; to call: Pass. -गद्यते, &c., to be re-cited, to be named or called: Caus. -गादयति, &c., to cause to recite, tell, &c.
24459: नि-गद or नि-गाद, अस्, m. reciting, audible recitation of prayers or charms; a prayer or sacrificial formula recited aloud; mention, mentioning; speech, speaking, discourse; N. of a teacher with the epithet Pārṇavalki.
24460: नि-गदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reciting, addressing, speaking, saying, speaking to.
24461: नि-गदित, अस्, आ, अम्, recited, told, said, spoken; (अम्), n. speech. —निगदित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has spoken, having spoken.
24462: नि-गद्य, ind. having told, having declared.
24463: नि-गाद, अस्, m. speech, discourse, recitation, &c.
24464: नि-गादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, reciting, telling, speaking, &c.
24465: निगम् नि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to settle down upon (Ved.); to enter (acc. or loc.); inire feminam (Ved.); to go to any place or state, to undergo, become (e. g. शान्तिं नि-गम्, to be-come pacified); to be inserted: Caus. -गमयति, to cause to go in, to insert.
24466: नि-गम, अस्, m. insertion, especially of the name of a deity into a liturgical formula; the place or passage in a book where a word occurs, especially a passage of the Vedas or the actual word quoted from such a passage; the Veda or the Vedic text; the root (as the source from which a word comes); a sacred precept, the words of a god or holy man; certainty, assurance; a town, a city; a market, a fair; a road, a market road; trade, traffic; a camp or caravan of itinerant merchants, a merchant; = लुण्डी; (अम्), n. a particular number.
24467: नि-गमन, अम्, n. insertion, quotation of words (from the Veda &c.) or the word &c. quoted; the conclusion in a syllogism, the deduction; going in or into.
24468: निगमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, familiar with or versed in the Vedas or in holy writ.
24470: निगर्ह् नि-गर्ह्, cl. 10. P. -गर्हयति, -यि-तुम्, to disdain, despise.
24471: निगल् नि-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, &c., to fall down (?).
24472: नि-गल, अस्, अम्, m. n. = नि-गड, q. v.
24473: निगा नि-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, &c., to go into, enter, attach one's self to; to come or get into any state &c.; to nestle.
24474: निगु नि-गु, उस्, m. = मनस्, the mind, the faculty of feeling and reasoning; (according to others) dirt, excrement [cf. rt. 4. गु]; a root; painting; (उस्, उस्, उ), pleasing, charming.
24475: निगुत् नि-गुत्, त्, m. (probably fr. rt. 3. गु with नि), Ved. (according to Sāy.) an enemy; [cf. नैगुत।]
24476: निगुह् नि-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते, गूहितुम्, to cover, conceal, hide: Caus. -गूहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to cover or hide.
24477: नि-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, concealed; profound, recondite, mysterious, obscure; (अम्), ind. privately, secretly. —निगूढ-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, secret in operation. —निगूढ-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, well con-cealed or hidden. —निगूढ-निश्चय, अस्, आ, अम्, whose resolve or determination is concealed. —नि-गूढ-रोमन्, आ, आ, अ, having concealed hair. —निगूढार्थ (°ढ-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a hidden sense or purpose, difficult to be understood, abstruse, occult.
24478: नि-गूढक, अस्, m. a species of wild bean; [cf. वन-मुद्ग।]
24479: नि-गूहक, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding, concealing.
24481: नि-गूहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hidden or con-cealed; to be covered or protected or defended.
24483: निगॄ नि-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति and -गिलति, &c., to swallow, swallow up, swallow down, ingur-gitate, devour: Caus. Pass. -गार्यते and -गाल्यते: Intens., Ved. -जेगिल्यते, -गल्गलीति, to swallow with a gurgling sound.
24485: नि-गरण, अम्, n. swallowing, devouring, deglu-tition; (अस्), m. the throat, the gullet, esophagus; the smoke of a burnt offering; [cf. नि-गण।]
24487: नि-गार, अस्, m. swallowing, swallowing down, devouring.
24488: नि-गारक, अस्, इका, अम्, = नि-गालक, swallowing.
24489: नि-गाल, अस्, m. the throat or neck of a horse; [cf. गल, नि-गरण।] —निगाल-वत्, आन्, m. a horse.
24490: नि-गालक, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowing, devouring.
24491: नि-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed; (metaphorically) left out, omitted, not expressed; (अ-निगीर्ण, ex-pressed.)
24492: नि-गीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being swallowed down; (with act. sense?), swallowing, devouring.
24493: निगै नि-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to accompany with song; to sing, chant; to proclaim, announce.
24494: नि-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung, chanted; said.
24495: निग्रन्थ् नि-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. P. -ग्रथ्नाति, &c., to intertwine, interweave.
24496: नि-ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. (probably a corruption of नि-क्रन्थन; cf. क्रथ्, क्रथन), killing, de-stroying, slaughter; [cf. निर्-ग्रन्थन।]
24497: निग्रह् नि-ग्रह्, in the older language नि-ग्रभ्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -गृह्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to hold down, keep down, de-press, keep under, keep in check; to keep back, hold back, stop, obstruct, restrain, suppress, con-fine; to seize, catch, apprehend, hold, hold fast; to oppress, overpower, subdue, conquer; to chastise, punish, tame; to draw together, contract, close (as the eyes): Caus. -ग्राहयति, to cause to be apprehended or seized: Caus. of the Desid. -जिघृक्षयति, to cause any one to desire to keep under or suppress.
24498: नि-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, seized, arrested; held back, restrained, confined, subdued, checked; harassed, assailed, attacked.
24499: नि-गृहीति, इस्, f. restraint, check; overpowering.
24500: नि-गृहीतृ, wrong form for नि-ग्रहीतृ, q. v.
24501: नि-गृह्णत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seizing, taking; keeping, suppressing, restraining.
24502: 1. नि-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be held back; to be punished, punishable; deserving chastisement or reproof.
24503: 2. नि-गृह्य, ind. having taken; having arrested or confined; having restrained or suppressed.
24504: नि-ग्रह, अस्, m. keeping down, holding down, keeping under, keeping back, keeping in check, coercion, restraining, binding, restraint, subjugation, subduing, restraint of the appetite &c., abstinence; obstruction, suppression, putting down; seizing, catching, confinement, capture, arrest; the arresting or suppressing of disease, cure; taking down, hum-bling, punishing, punishment, chastisement, rebuke, rebuff, reprimand, blame; aversion, dislike, disgust; (in the Nyāya phil.) putting down in argument, fault in a syllogism, flaw in an argument, failure in proof; any place for catching hold of, a handle; a boundary, a limit; N. of Śiva and of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa. —निग्रह-स्थान, अम्, n. the predicament of rebuke for failure in argument.
24505: नि-ग्रहण, अस्, आ, अम्, holding down, holding back, suppressing; (अम्), n. subduing, suppression; capture, confinement, prison; defeat, punishment.
24506: नि-ग्रहीतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be chastised or punished, punishable.
24507: नि-ग्रहीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who seizes or lays hold of; one who keeps back or prevents; seizing, restraining, binding.
24508: नि-ग्राभ, अस्, m., Ved. pressing down; N. of a verse recited when the Soma plants are pressed.
24509: नि-ग्राभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., with आपस्, the water with which the Soma plants are sprinkled before they are pressed.
24510: नि-ग्राह, अस्, m. punishment, chastisement, (used in imprecations, e. g. निग्राहस् ते भूयात्, confusion seize thee, &c.)
24511: नि-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suppressed or punished, punishable.
24512: निघ नि-घ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. हन् with नि), as high as broad; (anything) whose height and cir-cumference are equal; a round or circle, a ball; sin. —निघानिघ (°घ-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of different forms or sizes.
24513: निघण्ट नि-घण्ट (said to be fr. rt. गम् or हन् or हृ with नि; gender doubtful), a word; a glossary or collection of words or names, (in this sense properly pl.); often the collection of Vedic words explained in the Nirukta, see नि-घण्टु below.
24514: नि-घण्टि, probably only a wrong form for नि-घण्ट or नि-घण्टु।
24515: नि-घण्टिका, f. a species of bulbous plant (= गुलञ्च-कन्द).
24516: नि-घण्टु, उस्, m. (or नि-घण्टुक), any vocabu-lary or collection of words or names, but especially a N. of the Vedic glossary explained by Yāska in his Nirukta, (in this sense usually pl. निघण्टवस् as embracing five chapters.) —निघण्टु-भाष्य, अम्, n. ‘commentary on part of the Nighaṇṭus,’ N. of a work by Deva-rāja on the three chapters of synonyms incompletely treated by Yāska. —निघण्टु-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of glossaries,’ N. of a medical lexicon commonly called Abhidhāna-cūḍā-maṇi.
24518: निघस नि-घस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घस् with नि), eating; food, victuals.
24519: निघात नि-घात, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus. of rt. हन् with नि), a blow, stroke; suppression of accent, absence of accent.
24521: नि-घाति, इस्, f. an iron club or mace or hammer (?).
24522: नि-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking down, killing, de-stroying.
24523: निघुष् नि-घुष् (rt. 2. घुष् = घृष् with नि), Caus. P. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to tread down, trample under foot, crush, pound, grind.
24524: निघुष्ट नि-घुष्ट, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. घुष् with नि), sound, noise.
24525: निघृष् नि-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, &c., to rub into, rub down, rub, pound, grind, triturate; graze, chafe, abrade, wear away by rubbing, excoriate.
24526: नि-घर्ष, अस्, m. rubbing, friction, pounding, crushing.
24527: नि-घर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, friction, grinding, trituration; [cf. निर्-घर्षण।]
24528: नि-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground; chafed, worn, grazed, abraded, excoriated; subdued.
24529: नि-घृष्व, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed off, abraded, excoriated; small, insignificant; (अस्), m. a hoof; wind; an ass or a mule; a boar; a road; (अम्), n. the mark of a hoof (?).
24530: निघ्न नि-घ्न, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. नि-हन्), depend-ant, subservient, docile; dependant on a substantive (as an adjective); (after a numeral) multiplied with; (अस्), m., N. of a son of An-araṇya and father of An-amitra; of a son of An-amitra.
24531: निघ्न-क, अस्, आ, अम्, = नि-घ्न, dependant.
24532: नि-घ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, smiting, slaying, killing, destroying, overcoming.
24533: नि-घ्नान, अस्, आ, अम्, slaying, killing.
24534: निचक्र नि-चक्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
24535: निचङ्कुण नि-चङ्कुण for नि-चुङ्कुण, q. v.
24536: निचन्द्र नि-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.
24537: निचमन नि-चमन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. चम् with नि), sipping, taking liquid into the mouth.
24538: निचय नि-चय। See under 1. नि-चि below.
24539: निचाङ्कुण नि-चङ्कुण for नि-चुङ्कुण, q. v.
24540: निचाय् नि-चाय्, cl. 1. P. -चायति, &c. (oc-curring only in the form नि-चाय्य), Ved. to regard with reverence, honour, worship; to see; [cf. rt. 4. चि।]
24541: नि-चाय्य, ind. having seen, having observed.
24542: निचि 1. नि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to pile up, heap up.
24543: नि-चय, अस्, m. piling up, heaping up; collection, heap, multitude, quantity, store, stock, provisions (e. g. षण्-मास-निचय, provisioned for six months); assemblage, assemblage or collection of parts con-stituting a whole (e. g. शरीर-निचय, the assem-blage of parts of which the body consists; वधू-निचय, a collection of women); certainty, ascertain-ment (in this sense for निश्-चय, q. v.).
24544: नि-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heaped up, containing a quantity, full of, abounding in.
24545: नि-चाय, अस्, m. a heap (as a measure).
24546: नि-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled up, heaped up, full of, filled; covered, overspread; raised up; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe [cf. नैचित्य]; (आ), f., N. of a river.
24547: नि-चेकाय, अस्, m. (fr. the Intens.), continual or repeated piling up.
24548: नि-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be piled or heaped up.
24549: निचि 2. नि-चि, cl. 3. P. -चिकेति, -चिकाय, &c., Ved. to observe, perceive, recognise: Desid., Ved. -चिकीषते, to observe, watch, guard.
24550: नि-चिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. attentive, observant, vigilant; (आ), m. du. epithet of Mitra-Varuṇa; (Sāy.) excessively ancient (= नितरां चिरन्तनौ).
24551: नि-चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. an observer; observing, paying attention.
24552: निचिकी निचिकी, f. an excellent cow (= नैचिकी, q. v.).
24553: निचिर नि-चिर। See under 2. नि-चि above.
24554: निचुङ्कुण नि-चुङ्कुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. Intens. of rt. कुण्?), Ved. roaring, murmuring; (अस्), m., N. of a Vāruṇi; (often read नि-चङ्कुण or नि-चाङ्कुण।)
24555: निचुम्पुण नि-चुम्पुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. चुप्?), Ved. an epithet of Soma (because, according to Yāska, निचमनेन प्रीणाति); of the Ava-bhṛtha; of the sea (because, according to Yāska, निचमनेन पूर्यते); moving about?; (अस्), m., N. of a Śaunaḥśepha.
24556: निचुल नि-चुल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चुल् with नि), the tree Barringtonia Acutangula, commonly called Hijjal, = वेतस; = नि-चोल, an upper garment, over-coat; (also read नि-चूल।)
24557: नि-चुलक, अम्, n. an outer garment; a breast-plate, a cuirass.
24558: नि-चोल, अस्, m. a cover, wrapper, veil, surtout.
24559: नि-चोलक, अस्, m. a sort of jacket, bodice, mantle, but especially a soldier's jacket serving as a cuirass or breast-plate; (अम्), n. = नि-चुलक।
24560: निचृत् 1. नि-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्ति-तुम्, to insert, infix, fix into.
24561: 2. नि-चृत्, त्, f. a defective metre; [cf. अति-न्°, नि-वृत्।]
24562: निचेरु नि-चेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. चर् with नि), Ved. gliding; creeping; an epithet of the Ava-bhṛtha.
24563: निच्छवि निच्छवि, इस्, f., N. of a district (= तीर-भुक्ति), the modern Tirhut; [cf. लिच्छवि।]
24564: निच्छिद्र नि-च्छिद्र for निश्-छिद्र, q. v.
24565: निच्छिवि निच्छिवि, इस्, m., N. of one of the degraded castes sprung from the outcast or Vrātya Kṣatriyas (see Manu X. 22; their occupation appears to have been the public exhibition of gymnastic performances &c., as they are classed with the Jhallas, Mallas, and others).
24566: निच्छेद नि-च्छेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. छिद् with नि), cutting off; (in arithmetic) leaving no common measure, reduced by the common divisor to the least term so as not to allow of further reduction (in this sense for निश्-छेद).
24567: निज् निज्, cl. 3. P. A. नेनेक्ति (3rd pl. नेनिजति), नेनिक्ते, निनेज, निनिजे, नेक्ता, नेक्ष्यति, -ते, अनिजत्, अनैक्षीत्, अनिक्त, नेक्तुम्, to wash, clean, cleanse, purify; A. to wash or clean one's self; to nourish: Pass. निज्यते, &c., to be washed: Caus. नेजयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अनीनि-जत्: Desid. निनिक्षति, -ते: Intens. नेनिज्यते, नेनिजीति, नेनेक्ति; [cf. rt. निञ्ज्: Zend śnizh, ‘to snow:’ Gr. νίζ-ω, νίπ-τ-ω, χέρ-νιβ-α (acc.) νίπ-τρο-ν, νῐ́φ-α (acc.), νιφ-ά(δ)-ς, νῐφ-ετό-ς, νῑ́φει: Lat. Nep-tūnu-s = νιπτόμενο-ς, ‘bathing;’ ning-i-t, ningu-i-t, ningu-i-s, nix, base niv for nigv: Goth. snaivs, ‘snow:’ Old Germ. sneo, ‘snow;’ sniwit, ‘it snows:’ Lith. snig-ti, sning-ti, ‘to snow;’ snḗg-a-s, ‘snow;’ snaig-alà, ‘a flake of snow:’ Slav. sne†g-ŭ, ‘snow:’ Hib. nigh-im, ‘I wash;’ nigh-te, ‘washed,’ = Sanskrit निक्त।]
24568: निक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, washed, cleaned, cleansed, rinsed; sprinkled. —निक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. clean-handed, having clean hands.
24569: निज नि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. जन् with नि), innate, native, congenital, indigenous; own, of one's own party or country; proper, peculiar; continual, per-petual; (आस्), m. pl. one's own people. नि-ज is used in later Sanskrit as a reflexive possessive pronoun, like स्व, for ‘my own,’ ‘his own,’ ‘our own,’ &c.; and frequently for simple ‘my,’ ‘his,’ ‘our,’ &c. —निज-कर्मन्, अ, n. one's own work, any duty pertaining to one's self. —निज-कर्म-बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, fettered by one's own works. —निज-घास, अस्, m. ‘devouring his own,’ N. of a demon. —निज-धृति, इस्, f., N. of a river in Śāka-dvīpa. —निज-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to the commentators) = स्वभाव-मुक्त, liberated in own nature, essen-tially liberated (?). —निज-लाभ-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, engrossed in self-interest, self-satisfied. —निज-स्व, अम्, n. own property. —निजार्थम् (°ज-अर्°), ind. for one's own sake, for one's self.
24570: निजघ्नि नि-जघ्नि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. नि-हन्), Ved. striking down, overpowering; [cf. जघ्नि।]
24571: निजानुका नि-जानुका, f. (fr. नि-जानु), Ved. shaking or trembling of the knees (?).
24572: निजिघृक्षयत् नि-जिघृक्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (Caus. of Desid. of rt. ग्रह् with नि), causing to be desirous of overpowering or excelling.
24573: निजुर्व् नि-जुर्व् or नि-जूर्व्, cl. 1. P. -जूर्वति, &c., to consume by fire; (Sāy.) to destroy, kill.
24574: नि-जुर्, ऊर्, f., Ved. killing, destroying.
24575: निजुह्नूषु नि-जुह्नूषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. ह्नु with नि), wishing to conceal or deny.
24576: निञ्ज् निञ्ज्, cl. 2. A. निक्ते, &c., = rt. निज्, q. v.
24577: निटल नि-टल or नि-टाल, अम्, n. the fore-head. —निटलाक्ष (°ल-अक्ष), अस्, m. ‘having an eye on the forehead,’ an epithet of Śiva; (incor-rectly spelt निटिलाक्ष।)
24578: निडी नि-डी, cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते and -डीयते, &c., to fly down.
24579: नि-डीन, अम्, n. the downward flight or swoop of a bird or a peculiar mode of flying.
24580: निणिज् नि-णिज्, क् (according to Sāy. fr. नि-निज्, to purify), milk; (according to modern scholars this word may be an adverb related to नि-ण्य।)
24581: निण्डिका निण्डिका, f. a species of convol-vulus, = तिण्डी; (probably wrongly for तिण्डिका।)
24582: निण्य नि-ण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि), Ved. in-terior, hidden, concealed, secret, mysterious, (in Ṛg-veda 1. 32, 10, = निर्-नामधेय, nameless, according to Sāy.); (अम्), n. a secret, a mystery; (अम्), ind. secretly, mysteriously.
24583: नितततपम् नितततपम्, ind., Ved. an ono-matopoetic word to denote the speech of a stutterer.
24584: नितन् नि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -नुते, -तनितुम्, Ved. to pervade, penetrate, pierce; to cause to grow downwards (as a shoot, root, &c.).
24585: नि-तत्नी, f., Ved. a species of plant; N. of an Iṣṭakā; N. of one of the seven stars of the asterism Kṛttikā.
24586: नि-तान, अस्, m., Ved. the shoot of a plant which grows downwards; N. of a man with the patronymic Māruta.
24587: नितप् नि-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, Ved. to emit heat downwards; to consume.
24588: नितम् नि-तम्, Caus. P. -तमयति, &c., Ved. to choke, suffocate.
24589: नि-तान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, extraordinary, excessive, exceeding, much, considerable; (अम्), ind. exceed-ingly, excessively, very, much, in a high degree. —नितान्तावृक्ष (°त-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, excessively treeless.
24590: नितम्ब नि-तम्ब, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. तम्ब्, probably connected with rt. स्तम्भ्), the buttocks or posteriors, especially of a woman, (in this sense generally नितम्बौ, m. du.); the cir-cumference of the hip and loins; the ridge or side or protuberant flank or swell of a mountain [cf. गिरि-नितम्ब]; a precipice; the sloping bank or shore of a river; the shoulder; a particular position of the hands in dancing; (आ), f. a form of Durgā. —नि-तम्ब-ता, f. the state of having large hips. —नि-तम्ब-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having beautiful buttocks or hips, καλλίπυγος; (ती), f. a woman. —नितम्ब-विम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having Vimba-like hips.
24591: नितम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.), having buttocks; having beautiful hips; having graceful slopes, having beautiful sides (as a moun-tain); (इनी), f. a woman with large and handsome hips.
24592: नितम्भू नितम्भू, ऊस्, m., N. of a person mentioned in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 1765; (per-haps for नित्यम्-भू।)
24593: नितराम् नि-तराम्, ind. (fr. नि with the comparative affix), downwards, towards the lower part (Ved.); in a low tone (Ved.); completely, wholly, entirely; much, extremely, excessively, in a high degree; in an especial manner, always, con-tinually, eternally; at all events; certainly; [cf. Angl. Sax. nidher; Old Germ. nidar.]
24594: नितल नि-तल, अम्, n. one of the seven divisions of the lower regions. See पाताल।
24596: नितिक्त नि-तिक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तिज् with नि), Ved. excited, roused up.
24597: नि-तिक्ति, इस्, f., Ved. excitement, haste, speed; (इ), ind. quickly, speedily; (Sāy.) = 3rd sing. Pres. of rt. तिज् = तीक्ष्णी-करोति, he sharpens.
24598: नितुद् नि-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते, -तोत्-तुम्, Ved. to pierce, penetrate, pierce into; to goad; (Sāy.) to incite or pain vehemently, or to issue forth (= नितरां व्यथयति or निर्-गच्छति).
24599: नि-तोद, अस्, m. piercing, a prick, puncture, hole.
24600: नि-तोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. piercing, penetrating.
24601: नितृद् नि-तृद्, cl. 7. P. A. -तृणत्ति, -तृन्त्ते, -तर्दितुम्, Ved. to pierce, penetrate, cleave in two.
24602: नितॄ नि-तॄ, cl. 6. P. -तिरति, -तरितुम्, -त-रीतुम्, Ved. to dispel, subdue, overpower, obstruct.
24603: नितोशन नि-तोशन, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. तुश् with नि), Ved. sprinkling, distributing, granting; (अस्), m. a distributer, granter.
24604: नित्य नित्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि), own (Ved.); continual, perpetual, regularly repeated, constant, uninterrupted, endless, eternal, everlasting; invariable, regular, fixed, regularly prescribed, inevitable, not op-tional, (opposed to काम्य &c.); necessary, obligatory, essential; ordinary, usual, (opposed to नैमित्तिक, unusual, produced by an unusual cause); constantly dwelling in, perpetually engaged in, (often at the end of a comp., e. g. अरण्य-नित्य, constantly dwelling in a forest; तपो-नित्य, engaged in constant penance); (with समास) a necessary compound which cannot be resolved without losing its meaning, because the separate ideas have merged in one, as in जमद्-अग्नि; (with स्वरित) = जात्य, the primary or independent Svarita, as opposed to the secondary or dependent; (अस्), m. the ocean; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā; a Śakti or form of Durgā; an epithet of the goddess Ma-nasā; (अम्), n. constant and indispensable rite or act; (अम्), ind. always, ever, daily, constantly, continually, perpetually, everlastingly, eternally; न नित्यम्, not always, never, (in Manu VI. 8. नित्यम् अन्-आदाता = never a receiver.) —नित्य-कर्मन्, अ, n. or नित्य-क्रिया, f. constant act or duty, as observance of the five great sacrifices or any daily and necessary rite. —नित्य-कृत्य, अम्, n. regular and necessary act or ceremony; daily or regular act or routine. —नित्य-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, moving continually; (इस्), m. air or wind, the god of wind. —नित्य-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, constantly born. —नित्य-ता, f. perpetuity, eternity, continuance, continual repetition, (as मैथुन-नित्यता, continually repeated coitus); perseverance; necessity. —नित्य-त्व, अम्, n. invariableness, per-petuity, eternity; endurance; inevitableness, neces-sity. —नित्य-दा, ind. always, ever, perpetually, con-stantly, eternally, at all times. —नित्य-दान, अम्, n. daily alms-giving. —नित्य-धृत्, त्, त्, त्, constantly bearing or maintaining, observing daily duties (?). —नित्य-धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, constantly maintained or kept up. —नित्य-नाथ-सिद्ध, अस्, m., N. of an author. —नित्य-नियम, अस्, m. fixed rule, constant observance. —नित्य-नैमित्तिक, अम्, or नित्य-नैमित्तिकं कर्म, n. any regularly re-curring occasional act or ceremony or any rite con-stantly performed to accomplish some object, as Śrāddhas at fixed lunar periods. —नित्य-परिवृत, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —नित्य-परीक्षण, अम्, n. constant investigation or inspection. —नित्य-पूजा-यन्त्र, अम्, n. a kind of amulet. —नित्य-प्रलय, अस्, m. the constant dissolution of living beings. —नित्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state of being eternal, eternity. —नित्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed of or consisting of anything eternal, eternal. —नित्य-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, always busy, ever engaged in. —नित्य-यौवन, अम्, n. perpetual youth; (अस्, ई, अम्), ever or always young; (आ), f. an epithet of Draupadī. —नित्यर्तु (°य-ऋ), उस्, उस्, उ, regularly recurring at the seasons, annual. —नित्य-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. always possessing a calf; (आ), f. a par-ticular form of Sāma supplication; (अम्), n., N. of several Sāmans. —नित्य-वित्रस्त, अस्, m. ‘constantly scared,’ N. of an antelope. —नित्य-वैकुण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a particular residence of Viṣṇu, the heaven of Viṣṇu. —नित्य-व्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, always expending, constantly disbursing; (आ), f. always ex-pending, ever laying out. —नित्य-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, perpetually alarmed, always suspicious. —नित्य-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, always sleeping or reclining. —नित्य-शस्, ind. always, continually, constantly, eternally. —नित्य-संहृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, always exulting or triumphant; always rivalling one another, (in this sense संहृष्ट = सङ्घृष्ट।) —नित्य-सम, अस्, m. the assertion that all things remain the same (?). —नित्य-समास, see नित्य. —नित्य-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘ever perfect,’ a Jaina predicate of the soul. —नित्य-स्तोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. receiving perpetual praise, constantly lauded. —नित्य-स्नायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, constantly bathing or making ablutions. —नित्यान-ध्याय (°य-अन्°), अस्, m. invariable suspension of repetition of the Vedas, (a term applied to periods when the perusal of the Vedas is invariably prohibited, as the day of full moon, new moon, the eighth and fourteenth days of the half month.) —नित्यानन्द (°य-आन्°), अस्, m. eternal happiness. —नित्यानन्द-रसोदधि (°स-उद्°), इस्, m. ‘ocean of the essence of eternal joy,’ God. —नित्यानन्दाश्रम (°द-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —नित्यानित्य (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, eternal and perishable, permanent and temporary. —नित्यायुक्त (°य-आय्°), अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; (also read नित्योयुक्त; cf. नित्यो-द्युक्त।) —नित्यारित्र (°य-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having (its) own oars, ever fitted with oars (i. e. according to Sāy. with priests). —नित्योत्क्षिप्त-हस्त (°य-उत्°), अस्, m. ‘who always raises his hand,’ N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —नित्योदित (°य-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a man. —नित्योद्युक्त (°य-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; [cf. नित्यायुक्त।]
24605: नित्यज् नि-त्यज्, cl. 1. P. -त्यजति, -त्यक्तुम्, Ved. to scare or drive away.
24606: निद् 1. निद्, cl. 1. P. A. नेदति, नेदते, निनेद, निनिदे or निनेदे, नेदिता, &c., to be near [cf. rt. नेद्, नेदीयस्, नेदिष्ठ]; to ridicule, blame, reproach, censure, &c., (in this sense properly a separate rt., the form of which is usually निन्द्, q. v.): Desid., Ved. निनित्सति, to wish to reproach or depreciate; [cf. rt. निन्द्; Gr. ὄ-νειδ-ο-ς, probably λοίδ-ο-ρο-ς; Goth. ga-nait-yan, nai-teins, probably neith; Old Germ. neiz-yan; Angl. Sax. naet-an, naet-ing, nidh, ge-nidhe, ‘hatred;’ Mod. Germ. neid, ‘envy.’]
24607: 2. निद्, त्, f., Ved. mocking, ridiculing, despising, censure, contempt; (त्), m. one who ridicules or con-temns, a blamer, an enemy.
24609: 1. निदान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (= निद्यमान), reproached, ridiculed. (For 2. see 3. नि-दा, col. 3.)
24610: निद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being reproached, &c.
24611: निद नि-द, अम्, n. (said to be fr. नि-दो), poison, venom.
24612: निदण्ड नि-दण्ड, अस्, m., according to a commentator = निहित-दण्ड, a stick put aside or laid down; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who has put down a stick (i. e. not using force), one who has laid down a staff.
24614: निदद्रु निद-द्रु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. निद + द्रु), a man.
24616: निदह् नि-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn down, consume by fire.
24617: नि-दाघ, अस्, m. (according to native lexicogra-phers also अम्, n.), heat, warmth; the hot season (May and June), summer; internal heat, sweat, perspiration; N. of a man; N. of a son of Pulastya; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of the former person. —निदाघ-कर, अस्, m. ‘heat causer’ or ‘hot-rayed,’ the sun. —निदाघ-काल, अस्, m. ‘the time of heat,’ the hot season, two months previous to the rains, about May and June. —निदाघ-सिन्धु, उस्, m. a river in hot weather, one nearly dry.
24618: निदा 2. नि-दा (rt. 1. दा), cl. 3. P. -ददाति, &c., Ved. to give. (For 1. निदा see above.)
24619: नि-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, given, given absolutely; [cf. नीत्त।]
24620: निदा 3. नि-दा (rt. 4. दा, to bind), cl. 4. P. -द्यति, &c., Ved. to fasten.
24621: नि-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who fastens or ties up; (Sāy.) a restrainer, obstructer, (as if fr. rt. 3. दा।)
24622: 2. नि-दान, अम्, n. (for 1. निदान see col. 2), a band, a rope, a halter; a rope for tying up a calf &c.; a first or original cause, a primary or remote cause [cf. नि-बन्धन]; original form, essence, (निदानेन, ind. originally, essentially, properly); the cause of a disease, inquiry into the causes of disease, pathology, i. e. study of the symptoms with a view to trace the remote or proximate causes, (re-garded as a department of medical science; the six-teen Nidānas being the title of the sixteen divisions into which it is divided; cf. निदान-स्थान); N. of a work on metres and Vedic Stomas (see निदान-सूत्र); end, termination, cessation; purification, purity, correctness; claiming the reward of peni-tential acts. —निदान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. founded on a cause, essential. —निदान-सूत्र, अम्, n. a work in ten Prapāṭhakas on metres and Vedic Stomas. —निदान-स्थान, अम्, n. one of the five depart-ments of medical science, inquiry into the causes of diseases, pathology.
24623: नि-दित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. preserved, concealed; (Sāy.) completely bound or fettered (= नितराम् बद्ध).
24625: निदिग्ध नि-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. दिह् with नि), smeared, anointed, plastered; clinging to; (आ), f. small cardamoms.
24626: निदिग्धिका, f. = कण्ट-कारिका, a species of prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini [cf. निर्-दिग्धिका, निर्-दग्धिका]; cardamoms.
24627: निदिध्यासन नि-दिध्यासन, अम्, n. (fr. the Desid. of rt. ध्यै), profound and repeated medi-tation.
24628: नि-दिध्यासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to meditate upon.
24629: नि-दिध्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deeply meditated upon.
24630: निदिश् नि-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to order, point out, &c.; (perhaps for निर्-दिश् and apparently only used in the derivatives below.)
24631: नि-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ordered, directed; advised, enjoined; explained, pointed out.
24632: नि-देश, अस्, m. order, command, direction, in-struction; speech, speaking, narration, conversation; vicinity, proximity, neighbourhood; = भाजन, a vessel, vase; (ए), ind. in the vicinity, near. —निदेश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, executing orders, obedient, servile.
24633: नि-देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, showing, directing, ordering, pointing out; (इनी), f. a region, quarter, point of the compass.
24634: नि-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ordered, to be told.
24635: नि-देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, who or what points out or orders; explaining, advising, commanding.
24636: निदी नि-दी, cl. 3. P. (see rt. 2. दी), Ved. to shine down upon; (Sāy. = नितराम् प्र-काश्, to shine exceedingly.)
24637: निदुश निदुश, अस्, m. a fish.
24638: निदृश् नि-दृश्, Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to see, to show, point, to point out; to introduce, cause to enter; to impart knowledge, communicate, teach; advise; to appear (in a vision) to any person (acc.).
24639: नि-दर्शक, अस्, आ, अम्, seeing into, perceiving; seeing; pointing out, proclaiming, announcing.
24640: नि-दर्शन, अस्, ई, अम्, pointing to, showing, foreshowing, prognosticating, indicating; proclaim-ing, announcing, teaching; suiting, pleasing?; (आ), f. a simile, a comparison; (अम्), n. seeing, look-ing into, view, insight, sight, vision (e. g. स्वप्न-निदर्शन, a vision in sleep); pointing to; showing; evidence; an example or illustration; a designation of the third member of a complete syllogism (usually called उद्-आहरण, q. v.); a foreboding, prognostic, sign, mark, omen; a scheme, system; injunction, pre-cept, ordinance, scriptural authority; authority, text.
24641: नि-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, illustrated, exemplified.
24642: नि-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing, viewing, having an insight into, familiar with, knowing.
24643: निदेश नि-देश। See नि-दिश्, p. 486, col. 3.
24644: निद्रा 1. नि-द्रा or नि-द्रै, cl. 1. 2. P. A. -द्रायति, -ते, -द्राति, &c., to fall asleep, sleep.
24645: 2. नि-द्रा, f. (said to be fr. rt. निन्द् + affix र), sleep, slumber, sleepiness, sloth; (in flowers the budding state is considered as sleep. hence निद्रां त्यज् = to bloom); a mystical N. of the letter भ्। —निद्रा-दरिद्र, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —निद्रान्-ध (°रा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blind with sleep. —नि-द्रा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. rousing from sleep, awaking; [cf. भग्न-निद्र।] —निद्रा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting in sleep. —निद्रा-योग, अस्, m. sleep and deep meditation; [cf. योग-निद्रा।] —निद्रा-लस (°रा-अल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, slothful from drowsi-ness, fast asleep, sleepy. —निद्रा-वृक्ष, अस्, m. darkness. —निद्रा-सञ्जनन, अम्, n. ‘producing drowsiness,’ phlegm, the phlegmatic humor.
24646: नि-द्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep, sleepy, drowsy; shut up, closed (as a bud or blossom).
24647: नि-द्रात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, sleeping.
24648: नि-द्रायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep.
24649: नि-द्रालु, उस्, उस्, उ, sleeping, sleepy, drowsy, slothful; (उस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; (उस्), f. the plant Solanum Melongena; another plant (= वन-वर्वरिका); a kind of perfume (= नली). —नि-द्रालु-त्व, अम्, n. sleepiness, drowsiness.
24650: निद्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep. —निद्रित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having slept.
24651: निधन नि-धन, अम्, n. (in some senses apparently fr. 1. नि-धा below, but in others more probably fr. धन् = rt. हन्, to kill, with नि; cf. प्र-धन), settling down in a residence, residence, place of residence, domicile, resting-place, receptacle (Ved.); race, family; conclusion, end; dying, death, destruction, loss, disappearance, annihilation, (in these senses also rarely नि-धनस्, m., see Hari-vaṃśa 4846); the concluding passage or words at the end of a Sāman which is sung in chorus, (several words are used for this purpose, e. g. स्वर्-ज्योतिः, वषट्, व्रतम्, ईम्, नाम्, &c.); the finale in music; (अम्), n., N. of the eighth mansion; (अस्), m. the head of a family; (अस्, आ, अम्), without money, poor, (in this sense for निर्-धन); [cf. rt. हन्; Gr. θάν-α-το-ς; Hib. nidh, nith, ‘manslaughter, battle.’] —निधन-काम, अम्, n., Ved., N. of several Sāmans. —निधन-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing death, destroying, destructive. —निधन-क्रिया, f. a funeral ceremony. —निधन-ता, f. poverty, indigence. —निधन-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the end or of destruction. —निधन-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. become final or like a finale in music. —निधन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a finale in music.
24652: निधा 1. नि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put down, lay down, put or lay into, fix in, deposit, lodge, bury; (with मनस्) to fix or direct the thoughts upon or towards (dat.); resolve, determine; (with क्रियाम्) to direct one's labours, use efforts; to appoint; to lay aside, put away, remove, relinquish; lay up, treasure up, put into a safe place; to preserve for one's self (A.); to deliver, intrust, commit, present; (with हृदये or मनसि) to keep in mind, bear in mind, re-member, lay to heart, keep close; to keep down, keep back, restrain; to end, close; to place in any state, render: Pass. -धीयते, to be place on or in, to be deposited, be situated in or on, be absorbed into, to rest in: Caus. -धापयति, &c., to cause to be put or laid on or into, to cause to be deposited or preserved; to appoint: Intens. (?), Ved. 3rd sing. -देध्यत्।
24653: 2. नि-धा, f., Ved. laying snares; a net; a collection of snares, a snare. —निधा-पति, इस्, m. the possessor or bearer of snares.
24654: नि-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be put down or de-posited; to be delivered; to be directed towards; to be concealed.
24655: नि-धातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a depositor, one who deposits, keeps, conceals, &c.
24656: नि-धान, अम्, n. putting down, laying down, depositing, (दण्ड-निधान, putting down or laying aside the stick, i. e. not using force, = mildness, clemency); keeping, preserving; a place where any-thing is laid, a vessel in which anything is deposited, a receptacle; a place of cessation or rest; anything laid up, a treasure, a divine treasure (especially be-longing to Kuvera, god of wealth); store, hoard, property, possessions, wealth. —निधानेश (°न-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasure,’ a Yakṣa.
24657: नि-धान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fit for being laid or put down.
24658: नि-धापक, अस्, m. one who causes to be put down or deposited; a weapon (?); burnt timber (?), charcoal (?); the castor-oil plant (?).
24659: नि-धाप्य, ind. having caused to be placed or fixed in, having installed or appointed.
24660: नि-धाय, ind. having fixed or placed in or on, (मनसि निधाय, fixing or laying up in the mind, reflecting.)
24661: नि-धि, इस्, m. setting down or serving up food &c. (Ved.); the lower part or bottom of the Ukhā (Ved.); a place where anything is laid or deposited, a receptacle, (अपां निधिः, the receptacle of waters, the ocean, sea; also N. of a Sāman; sometimes निधि alone stands for ‘the ocean’); a place for storing up, a storehouse, treasury, granary, a nest, &c.; (figuratively) a treasure-house of good qualities, a man endowed with many good qualities; a treasure, store, hoard, any collection of wealth or valuables; a divine treasure belonging to Kuvera, (nine of which are enumerated, viz. the Padma, Mahā-padma, Śaṅkha, Makara, Kacchapa, Mukunda, Nanda, Nīla, and Kharba; their nature is not exactly defined, though some of them appear to be precious gems; according to the Tāntrika system they are personified and worshipped as demi-gods, attendant either upon Kuvera who is sometimes called निधीनम् अधि-पः, ‘lord of the Nidhis,’ or upon Lakṣmī, the goddess of prosperity); N. of a particular medicinal plant, commonly Jīvikā; a kind of perfume (= नलिका); दैवो निधिः, ‘the divine treasure,’ N. of a particular philosophical doctrine. —निधि-गोप, अस्, m. guardian of treasure. —निधि-नाथ, अस्, m. or निधि-प्रभु, उस्, m. or निधीश्वर (°धि-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera. —निधि-प, अस्, m. guardian of treasure; [cf. निधि-पा।] —निधि-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera; N. of a rich merchant. —निधिपति-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a merchant. —निधि-पा, आस्, Ved., or निधि-पाल, अस्, m. guardian of treasure. —निधि-पालित, अस्, m., N. of a merchant. —निधि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. pos-sessing treasure, forming a store. —निधीश or नि-धीश्वर (°धि-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera. —निध्य्-अर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, treasure seeking.
24662: नि-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being laid down or deposited, &c.
24663: नि-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed in or on, to be deposited.
24664: नि-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, put down, deposited, &c. See s. v.
24666: निधू नि-धू, cl. 5. 6. P. A. -धूनोति, -धू-नुते (in the later language also -धुनोति, -धुनुते), -धुवति, -धोतुम्, -धवितुम्, to throw down, give or deliver over (Ved.); shake to and fro, agitate.
24667: नि-धुवन, अम्, n. shaking about, agitation, trembling; coition, sexual intercourse; pleasure, en-joyment; sport, play, pastime.
24668: निधृ नि-धृ, cl. 10. P. -धारयति, -यितुम् (Ved. -दीधर्), to place down or in, deposit in; determine; establish; render (Ved.); to keep, pre-serve; (Sāy.) to establish firmly; to conceive in the womb: Pass. -धार्यते (Ved. -दध्रे), to be placed in or deposited; to bend down, to stoop (Ved.).
24669: नि-धारय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. placing in or on, depositing.

24789: निभीम नि-भीम, अस्, आ, अम्, terrible, fright-ful. —निभीम-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, of terrible valour, of formidable prowess.
24790: निभूत नि-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, past, gone.
24791: निभूयप निभूयप, अस्, m., Ved. epithet of Viṣṇu, (meaning unknown.)

24793: नि-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, borne or placed down, deposited in a low place, lowered; concealed, hidden, secret, occult, unperceived, imperceptible; modest, humble, unassuming; mild, gentle; lonely, solitary; still, silent; firm, unmoved, immovable; resolute, decided, firmly attached, faithful; filled with, full of, (Bhāgavata-Purāṇa X. 32, 20, = पूर्ण, व्याप्त); (अम्), n. humility, modesty, meekness [cf. नैभृत्य]; (अम्), ind. covertly, secretly, privately, apart, unobservedly, im-perceptibly, in a corner, out of sight. —निभृतागत (°त-आग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, secretly arrived. —निभृतात्-मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, resolute-minded, resolute. —निभृतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a secret meaning, occult.
24794: निभ्रंश् नि-भ्रंश्, Caus. -भ्राशयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to fall off, to strike or break off.
24795: निम निम, अस्, m. a pin, stake (?).

24797: नि-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged or immersed in, dipped into, fallen into (water &c.), submerged, sunk; gone down, set (as the sun); forcibly entered into or penetrated; (with पर-लोकाय) entered into the other world; sunk in, depressed, not prominent; overwhelmed, covered. —निमग्न-ना-भि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a depressed navel. —निमग्न-मध्या, f. a woman having a depressed (and there-fore slender) waist.
24798: नि-मग्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding one's self, lurking.
24799: नि-मज्जत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, bathing, diving, plunging in, sinking.
24800: नि-मज्जथु, उस्, m. the act of diving or entering into, plunging; (with तल्पे) going to bed, sleeping.
24801: नि-मज्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to enter or plunge into (with gen.), immersing, absorbing; (अम्), n. bathing, diving, immersion, sinking.
24802: नि-मज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sinking, plunging into; immersed; being drowned.
24803: नि-मज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged into the water, drowned.
24804: निमद् नि-मद्, Caus. P. -मादयति, -यितुम्, to pronounce distinctly but slowly.
24805: नि-मद, अस्, m. pronunciation which is distinct but slow, one of the seven degrees of pronunciation (वाचः स्थानानि).
24806: निमन्त्र् नि-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. A. -मन्त्रयते, -यितुम्, to invite, summon, call (to a feast), entertain.
24807: नि-मन्त्रक, अस्, m. one who summons or invites, an inviter.
24808: नि-मन्त्रण, अम्, n. inviting, invitation; sum-moning, calling; a summons. —निमन्त्रण-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a written summons, a note of invitation.
24809: नि-मन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, invited, summoned, convoked; bidden to a feast, entertained.
24810: नि-मन्त्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be invited, to be called.
24811: निमन्यु नि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not angry, unresentful, appeased.
24812: निमय नि-मय। See नि-मे, p. 490, col. 2.

24818: निमि 1. निमि, इस्, m., N. of several kings of Videha; of a son of Dattātreya; of a son of Ikṣvāku, (this Nimi lost his body through the curse of Vaśiṣṭha, and when the gods were willing to restore it, requested that instead of receiving his former shape he might occupy the eyes of all living creatures; the request was granted, and in consequence of the presence of Nimi, men's eyelids are ever opening and shutting; cf. नि-मिष, and see Viṣṇu-Purāṇa IV. 5); N. of the twenty-first Jaina Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; of a son of Bhajamāna; of Daṇḍa-pāṇi; of a Dānava; closing or winking of the eyes, twinkling. —निमिन्-धर, अस्, m. (fr. निमिम् acc. sing. + धर), N. of a prince.
24819: निमि 2. नि-मि, cl. 5. P. A. -मिनोति, -मिनुते, &c., to fix in, dig in; to fix, erect.
24820: 2. नि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed in, fixed, erected.
24821: निमित्त नि-मित्त, अम्, n. (probably con-nected with नि-मा above), a mark, an aim; an archer's butt, target; sign, token; prognostic, pre-sage, omen [cf. दुर्-न्°]; cause, motive, reason, instrumental or efficient cause, (opposed to उपा-दान, the material cause); निमित्त is used at the end of a comp. in the sense ‘having as a motive or cause,’ ‘caused or produced by,’ ‘occasioned by,’ e. g. विष-निमित्ता पीडा, pain caused by poison; (अम् acc., एन inst., आय dat., आत् abl., अस्य gen., ए loc.), because of, on account of, for the sake of, for the purpose of, through. —निमित्त-कारण, अम्, n. an instrumental or efficient cause, (especially the Deity considered as the agent in creation.) —निमित्त-कारण-ता, f. the state of being the efficient cause. —निमित्त-काल, अस्, m. the period or moment of time which may be regarded as causing any event; any given or specific time. —निमित्त-कृत्, त्, m. ‘omen-maker,’ a crow, raven. —निमित्त-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with omens. —निमित्त-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ‘knowledge of causes or signs,’ N. of the fifty-eighth chapter of the Kāma-sūtra by Vātsyāyana. —निमित्त-तस्, ind. by or from a special cause or reason. —निमित्त-ता, f. or निमित्त-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being a cause, causality, instrumentality. —निमित्त-धर्म, अस्, m. expiation; any occa-sional or special penance, rite, or obligation. —नि-मित्त-निदान, अम्, n., N. of a work. —निमित्त-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become a cause or reason, being a cause or means. —निमित्त-मात्र, अम्, n. the mere efficient cause or instrument. —निमित्त-विद्, त्, m. ‘omen-knower,’ an astrologer. —निमित्त-वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hitting an aim, piercing the mark. —निमित्त-हेतु, उस्, m. an efficient cause. —नि-मित्तहेतु-त्व, अम्, n. the being an instrumental or efficient cause. —निमित्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. the infinitive mood (in grammar). —निमित्तावृत्ति (°त-आव्°), इस्, f. dependance upon a special cause or occasion. —निमित्ती-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make anything a cause, to use as a cause or means. —निमित्ती-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to become a cause or reason for (with loc.).
24822: नि-मित्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp.), caused or occasioned or produced by; (अम्), n. kissing, a kiss.
24823: निमित्तायमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. an unused Nominal verb निमित्ताय), causing, producing.
24824: निमित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, operated on or influenced by a cause, having a cause or reason.
24825: निमिश्ल नि-मिश्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devoted to, attached to (with loc.); (Sāy.) commixed, com-mingling, mixing with, being mixed. —निमिश्ल-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most attached to (with loc.).
24826: निमिष् 1. नि-मिष्, cl. 6. P. -मिषति, -मे-षितुम्, to shut the eyelids, wink, twinkle, blink.

24828: नि-मिष, अस्, m. twinkling, winking, shutting the eye; the twinkling of an eye considered as a measure of time, a moment; morbid twinkling of the eyes; N. of a son of Garuḍa (Mahā-bh. 24829: नि-मिषत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, winking, blinking, closing the eyes.

24831: नि-मेषक, अस्, m. twinkling of the eye; a fire-fly.
24832: नि-मेषण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing twinkling &c.
24833: निमिह् नि-मिह्, cl. 1. P. -मेहति, &c., to urine, sprinkle down urine.
24834: निमील् नि-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -मीलितुम्, to shut or close the eyes, fall asleep, sleep; to close (as flowers); to die, disappear; Caus. -मीलयति, -यितुम्, to cause (one) to shut the eyes, to close; to kill.
24835: नि-मीलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, closing the eyes, winking the eyelids, twinkling.
24836: नि-मीलन, अम्, n. shutting the eyelids, winking or twinkling of the eyes, winking; closing the eyes in death; (figuratively) dying, death; (in astronomy) immersion, complete obscuration, a total eclipse.
24838: नि-मीलिका, f. shutting the eyes, winking, twink-ling, blinking, conniving at anything; fraud, trick.
24839: नि-मीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, shut (as the eye), winked, blinked; blinded, darkened, obscured; [cf. रजो-निमीलित।] —निमीलिताक्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having the eyes closed.
24840: नि-मीलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, closing the eyes, having the eyelids shut.
24841: निमीव् नि-मीव्, cl. 1. P. -मीवति, &c., to press on, press down.
24842: निमीश्वर निमीश्वर, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of the sixteenth Arhat of the present Ut-sarpiṇī.

24845: नि-मृग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devoted, attached to; (Sāy.) excessively purifying or cleansing.
24846: निमृण् नि-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c., to dash down, strike down.
24847: निमृद् नि-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दि-तुम्, to crush, dash to pieces; to rub off.
24848: निमे नि-मे [cf. नि-मा], cl. 1. A. -मयते, मातुम्, to change, exchange for (with inst.), barter.
24849: नि-मय, अस्, m. barter, change, exchange.
24850: 2. नि-मातव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see नि-मा), to be exchanged or bartered.
24851: 2. नि-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 1. see नि-मा), to be ex-changed; (अस्), m. barter, exchange; [cf. नैमेय।]
24852: निमेष नि-मेष। See under 1. नि-मिष्, col. 1.
24853: निम्न निम्न, अम्, n. (fr. नि or perhaps rather fr. rt. नम् with नि or according to others fr. rt. मन् or rt. म्ना with नि), depth, low ground, low-land; a slope, declivity; gap, chasm or cavity in the ground; a depression, deepening; (अस्, आ, अम्), deep, profound (literally or figuratively); low (as ground), depressed, sunk; (अस्), m., N. of a prince. —निम्न-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going low or deep, going downwards, descending; (आ), f. a river, mountain-stream; [cf. गिरि-न्°।] —निम्न-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, going in deep or low places; (अम्), n. a low place. —निम्न-तल, see under निन्द-तल. —निम्न-ता, f. or निम्न-त्व, अम्, n. depth, lowness, profundity. —निम्न-देश, अस्, m. or निम्न-भाग, अस्, m. a low or deep place. —निम्नोन्नत (°न-उन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, low and high, depressed and elevated, up and down.
24854: निम्नैस्, ind., Ved. in deep places, low, down-wards; [cf. उच्चैस्, नीचैस्।]
24855: निम्ब निम्ब or निम्बक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. नी), a tree with bitter fruits, Azadirachta Indica, the Nimb or Neemb tree, (the leaves of this tree are chewed at funeral ceremonies); [cf. गिरि-न्°, तृण-न्°।] —निम्ब-तरु, उस्, m. the tree Erythrina Fulgens or (according to others) Melia Sempervirens, (it is considered as one of the trees of paradise.) —निम्ब-रजस्, अस्, n. a particular high number; [cf. महा-न्°।] —निम्ब-वती, f., N. of a woman. —निम्ब-वीज, अस्, m. a tree (= राजादनी). —निम्-बार्क-करवीरार्चन-व्रत (°ब-अर्°, °र-अर्°), अम्, n., N. of a particular vow; N. of the seventy-seventh chapter of the Bhaviṣya-Purāṇa.
24856: निम्बूक निम्बूक, अस्, m. the common lime, Citrus Acida; (also read निस्बू।)
24857: निम्लुच् नि-म्लुच् (Ved. नि-म्रुच्), cl. 1. P. -म्लोचति, &c., to set, disappear (as the sun).
24858: नि-म्रुक्ति, Ved., or in later Sanskrit नि-म्लुक्ति, इस्, f. sunset, setting of the sun, disappearance.
24859: नि-म्रुच्, क्, f., Ved. sunset, setting of the sun, evening; (क्, क्, क्), slack, loose.
24860: नि-म्लोच, अस्, m. setting of the sun, sunset.
24861: नि-म्लोचनी, f. (fr. an unused form नि-म्लोचन), N. of the city of Varuṇa situated on the mountain Mānasottara towards the west.
24862: नि-म्लोचि, इस्, m., N. of a prince, son of Bhajamāna.
