24866: नि-यन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained, curbed, checked; governed, guided.
24867: नियम् नि-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्, to check, curb, restrain, hold back, suppress, stop; to hold in (as the breath &c.); govern, control, rule, direct, regulate; to punish; to restrict; to bind, confine, fasten; to conceal; to attain, obtain; to assume; to present, offer; to place or fix upon: Caus. -यमयति, -यितुम्, to restrain, curb, check.
24868: नि-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, curbed, restrained, held in; governed, controlled, subdued, submissive, self-governed; abstemious, self-denying, temperate; attentive, intent upon; fixed, constant, steady, per-manent, incessant; ascertained, certain, destined, settled, sure; inevitable; positive, definite; perme-able, what may be spread through or over?; (अम्), n. elementary or crude matter, the recipient of attri-butes or properties; (अम्), ind. always, constantly, decidedly, positively, surely, certainly, inevitably; for-cibly. —नियत-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued mind or spirit. —नियत-विषय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, steadily abiding in one's own sphere. —नियतात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, self-regulated, self-controlled, self-restrained. —नियताहार (°त-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, abstemious in food, temperate. —नियतेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the passions subdued or restrained.
24869: नि-यति, इस्, f. restraint, restriction; the fixed order of things, necessity, destiny, fate, luck, good or bad fortune; a religious duty or obligation; self-command, self-restraint; (नियति is sometimes per-sonified as a goddess, she and Āyati being regarded as daughters of Meru and wives of Dhātṛ and Vi-dhātṛ); (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.
24870: नि-यन्तवय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be restrained, checked, controlled, tamed; to be forced.
24872: नि-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what holds in, restrains, curbs, governs, guides, tames, &c.; re-straining; (ता), m. a restrainer, charioteer, driver, coachman; a ruler, governor, master; a punisher. —नियन्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. restraint, government, abi-lity to rule, power of restraining, controlling faculty.
24873: नि-यम, अस्, m. restraining, holding back, check-ing, keeping back; taming, subduing, preventing, confining; restraint, restriction, restriction to (with loc.); limitation; fixing, defining, definition; keeping down, lowering (as the tone of the voice); fixed rule or law, necessity, obligation; rule, precept (e. g. स्त्रीणाम् प्राकृत-भाषणम् एव नियमः, the usage of women is to speak only Prākṛt); certainty, ascertainment; agreement, contract, engagement, assent, promise, vow; any self-imposed restraint or religious observance voluntarily practised, as fast-ing, watching, pilgrimage, praying, &c.; voluntary penance, meritorious or supererogatory piety; a lesser vow, minor observance (as opposed to यम, a greater vow which must always be observed); (in rhetoric) a common-place in poetry, any conventional expres-sion or usual comparison (as notice of the birch in describing the Himālaya, of the sandal tree in de-scribing the Malaya mountains, of the peacock's cry in the rains, of the koïl in spring, &c.); Necessity or Fixed Law personified as a son of Dharma by Dhṛti; (एन or आत्), ind. by a fixed rule, necessarily, surely, certainly. —नियम-निष्ठा, f. rigid ob-servance of prescribed rites. —नियम-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a written agreement or stipulation. —नियम-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, observing fixed rules; relating to or corroborative of a rule. —नियम-पाल, अस्, m. ‘observer of vows,’ N. of a sage from whom the Nepalese derive the name of their country, (properly Nipāl.) —नियम-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breach of a stipulation or contract. —नियम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, practising or observing religious observances; (अती), f. (a woman) having the monthly courses. —नियम-स्थिति, इस्, f. a state of self-restraint, steady observance of religious obligations, asceticism.
24874: नि-यमन, अस्, ई, अम्, regulating, controlling, subduing, taming, overpowering; (अम्), n. subduing, checking, restraining; humiliation, coercion; binding; restriction, limitation; precept, fixed practice or rule.
24875: नि-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, restrained, sup-pressed, bound, confined; governed, guided; fixed, regulated, prescribed, stipulated, agreed upon.
24876: 1. नि-यम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be checked or re-strained, restrainable, tamable.
24877: 2. नि-यम्य, ind. having restrained, having guided, &c.
24878: नि-याम, अस्, m. = नि-यम, restraint; religious vow, penance, fasting, &c., especially if an act of supererogation; = नि-यामक, a boatman, sailor; [cf. निर्-याम।]
24879: नि-यामक, अस्, आ, अम्, restraining, checking, con-trolling, subduing, suppressing, overpowering; re-strictive, limiting; defining more closely; guiding, governing, who or what regulates or restrains; a re-strainer, ruler, master; (अस्), m. a charioteer; a boat-man, a sailor, but variously applied to one who rows or steers, a pilot, a helmsman; [cf. निर्-याम।] —नि-यामक-ता, f. controllership, power of restraining, restraint; exact definition, explanation.
24880: नि-यामन, अम्, n. taming, checking, restraining; (probably incorrectly for नि-यमन।)
24881: निययिन् नि-ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. या with नि), Ved. driving over, passing over (as a carriage).
24882: नि-यान, अम्, n., Ved. way, access.
24883: नियव नि-यव। See under 2. नि-यु below.
24884: नियातन नि-यातन, अम्, n. causing to fall or descend; (wrong reading for नि-पातन, q. v.)
24885: नियु 1. नि-यु, cl. 3. P. -युयोति, &c., Ved. to repel, keep off.
24886: नियु 2. नि-यु, cl. 2. P. -यौति, cl. 9. P. A. -युनाति, -नीते, -यवितुम्, to join, yoke, harness; to mix; to bestow.
24887: नि-यव, अस्, m. compact order, continuous line or series; (Sāy.) mixing, mixture.
24888: नि-युत्, त्, f., Ved. series, line, row; (Sāy.) a horse, steed (as harnessed to a car), especially one of the horses of Vāyu called Niyuts; praise, a praiser; (अस्), f. pl. series of words [cf. ग्रन्थ, नि-बन्-धन], verses, a poem; (Sāy.) a team of horses, especially the Niyuts or horses of Vāyu; N. of a wife of Rudra in one of his different forms. —नियुत्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. forming a series; flowing continuously, as the Soma; drawn by a line of horses, as Vāyu or Indra, or the Maruts; (Sāy.) possessing the Niyut steeds, possessing horses; containing the word नियुत् or नियुत्-वत् (as a verse or hymn). —नियुद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose car is drawn by a line or team of horses; (Sāy.) having a harnessed chariot.
24889: नि-युत, अम्, n. (according to some lexicographers also m.), a million; a hundred thousand; 100 Ayutas = 10, 000 Koṭis.
24890: नि-युत्वतीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to Niyut-vat (Vāyu).
24891: नियुज् नि-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to join to, attach or fasten to; to put to (horses), yoke, harness; to place over, appoint, elect or depute any one to any office or duty (with acc. of the person and loc. of the thing or business); to give authority, authorize; to assign, employ, engage; to commit, intrust, commission; to enjoin, order, command; to constrain, urge, coerce, compel; to harass: Caus. (or cl. 10.) -योजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be attached, cause to be placed or put, to fasten; to appoint, commission, charge, employ; to order, command, direct, prescribe; to urge, instigate, coerce; to perform, make, place in any state (e. g. सन्देहे, in jeopardy); to offer, present with, endow.
24892: नि-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened to; engaged in, attached to; directed, enjoined, commanded; autho-rized, appointed; ascertained; (अस्), m. a functionary, official.
24893: नि-युक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, appointed, elected, placed in authority.
24894: नि-युक्ति, इस्, f. injunction, order, command; ap-pointment, commission, charge, office.
24895: नि-युज्य, ind. having joined or attached; having put to or harnessed; having appointed, &c.
24896: नि-युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being appointed, being engaged or employed.
24897: नि-युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, appointing, authorizing, enjoining, constituting, appointing to an office.
24898: नि-योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be appointed or autho-rized, to be employed, ordered, &c.
24899: नि-योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who joins or fastens or attaches; (ता), m. a ruler, lord master.
24900: नि-योग, अस्, m. attaching or fastening to; appli-cation, use, employment, appointment, injunction, direction, order, command, commission, charge, precept; any trust or appointed task or duty, any business or function committed to one's charge; effort, exertion; certainty, ascertainment; necessity; (आत् or एन), ind. according to order or command, necessarily, certainly, surely. —नियोग-करण, अम्, n. making a command, commanding. —नियोग-तस्, ind. according to order or command. —नियोग-पाश, अस्, m. a fastening, (probably) a halter. —नि-योग-प्रयोजन, अम्, n. the object or business of any appointment, authorized act or duty. —नियोग-विधि, इस्, m. the form or rule of appointing to any act or duty. —नियोगार्थ (°ग-अर्°), अस्, m. the object of an authorized act or appointment.
24901: नि-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, appointed, authorized, invested with authority, employed, engaged in any duty, attached to any business; (ई), m. a functionary, an official, officer, man in office, a minister, a deputy, an agent, &c. —नियोग्य्-अर्थ-ग्रहोपाय (°ह-उप्°), अस्, m. the resource of confiscating the property of men in office.
24902: नि-योग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be enjoined or prescribed; fit to be appointed or authorized, able or qualified for a duty [cf. नि-योज्य]; (अस्), m. (according to Vopa-deva) a master.
24903: नि-योजन, अम्, n. tying or fastening (as an animal to the Yūpa or sacrificial post); uniting, attaching to; that with which anything is fastened or tied (Ved.); ordering, prescribing, commanding, directing; urging, impelling; appointing (e. g. क्रि-यासु, to affairs); (ई), f. a halter.
24904: नि-योजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached or joined to, to be appointed or authorized.
24905: नि-योजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be appointed, to be commanded or urged or directed.
24906: नि-योजित, अस्, आ, अम्, joined or attached to, con-nected with, adapted to; appointed, authorized, commissioned; directed, ordered; impelled, urged, instigated.
24907: नि-योज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fastened or attached to; fit to be appointed or employed in; to be ordered, commanded, directed, instigated; proper to be en-joined; (अस्), m. a functionary, official, employé, servant.
24908: नियुत नि-युत। See under 2. नि-यु, col. 1.
24909: नियुत्सा नि-युत्सा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. युध् with नि without reduplication), N. of the wife of Pra-stāva and mother of Vi-bhu.
24910: नि-युद्ध, अम्, n. (fr. rt. युध् with नि), fight-ing, especially fighting on foot, close fight or combat, personal struggle. —नियुद्ध-भू, ऊस्, f. a battle-field, a place where close fighting has taken place.
24911: नि-योद्धृ, धा, m. a combatant, a wrestler, a boxer; a cock.
24912: नि-योधक, अस्, m. a fighter, combatant, wrestler, pugilist.
24913: नियोग नि-योग। See under नि-युज् above.
24914: निर् निर् euphonically substituted for निस्, q. v., before vowels and soft consonants.
24915: निरंश निर्-अंश, अस्, आ, अम्, having no part or fraction remaining, whole. —निरंश-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having no part or fraction over, wholeness, completeness.
24916: निरंशु निर्-अंशु, उस्, उस्, उ, having no rays, rayless.
24917: निरक्ष निर्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no dice; having no latitude; (अस्), m. (in astronomy) the place of no latitude, i. e. the terrestrial equator. —निरक्ष-देश, अस्, m. a first meridian, as Laṅkā; a place where the sun is always vertical and the days and nights are equal; the equatorial region.
24918: निरग्नि निर्-अग्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, or निरग्निक, अस्, आ, अम्, having no fire, having lost or neglected the consecrated fire.
24919: निरघ निर्-अघ, अस्, आ, अम्, sinless, blame-less, free from fault or imperfection.
24920: निरङ्कुश निर्-अङ्कुश, अस्, आ, अम्, unchecked (lit. not held by a hook), uncontrolled, unruly, self-willed, unfettered, independant, completely free; (अम्), ind. freely. —निरङ्कुश-ता, f. or निरङ्कुश-त्व, अम्, n. unruliness, independance, self-will, wil-fulness.
24921: निरङ्ग निर्-अङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having no re-sources, deprived of expedients.
24922: निरज् निर्-अज्, cl. 1. P. -अजति, -अजितुम् (Ved. inf. -अजे), Ved. to drive or bring out, extricate, re-move; to issue out.
24923: निरजिन निर्-अजिन, अस्, आ, अम्, without a skin or hide, skinless.
24924: निरञ्छन नि-रञ्छन, अम्, n. (fr. रञ्छ् = लञ्छ् with नि), a mark or knot in a measuring line.
24925: निरञ्जन 1. निर्-अञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, without collyrium or ointment, unstained, untinged, unblack-ened, unpainted; free from falsehood; artless; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the attendants of Śiva; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā; the day of full moon.
24926: निरञ्जन 2. नि-रञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, void of passion or emotion, (applied to the Supreme Being.)
24927: निरण् नि-रण्, cl. 1. P. -रणति, -रणितुम्, Ved. to rejoice, delight in.
24928: निरत नि-रत। See नि-रम्, p. 492, col. 2.
24929: निरतिशय निर्-अतिशय, अस्, आ, अम्, unsur-passed. —निरतिशय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being unsurpassed, unsurpassedness.
24930: निरत्यय निर्-अत्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from danger, dangerless, secure, infallible, completely successful, faultless, unblamable.
24931: निरधिष्ठान निर्-अधिष्ठान, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing no fixed resting-place, having no solid basis.
24932: निरध्व निर्-अध्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) one who has lost his way.
24933: निरनुक्रोश निर्-अनुक्रोश, अस्, m. absence of compassion, hard-heartedness, unmercifulness; (अस्, आ, अम्), uncompassionate, without pity, pitiless, merci-less; hard-hearted towards any person or thing (with loc.). —निरनुक्रोश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting without compassion or pitilessly. —निरनुक्रोश-ता, f. piti-lessness, unmercifulness; hard-heartedness, cruelty. —निरनुक्रोश-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, uncompassionate, ruthless, hard-hearted.
24934: निरनुग निर्-अनुग, अस्, आ, अम्, unattended, without retinue or followers.
24935: निरनुग्रह निर्-अनुग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, unfa-vourable, unkind, ungracious.
24936: निरनुनासिक निर्-अनुनासिक, अस्, आ, अम्, not marked with the nasal symbol called Anunāsika (Gram. 7), not nasal.
24937: निरनुमान निर्-अनुमान, अस्, आ, अम्, without inference, not binding one's self to conclusions or consequences.
24938: निरनुरोध निर्-अनुरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unfa-vourable, unfriendly, unkind, ungracious, unamiable.
24939: निरन्तर निर्-अन्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, without any intermediate space, having no intervening space, granting no room or free space, having no interval, closely contiguous, close; closely connected, conti-nuous; uninterrupted, continual, constant; without interstices, completely filled, compact, dense, coarse, gross; persevering, faithful, true (as a friend); un-concealed, not hidden from view; not other or dif-ferent, similar, identical; (अम्), ind. without inter-vening space, without interval, without interruption, constantly, incessantly, continually; closely, tightly, firmly; immediately. —निरन्तराभ्यास (°र-अभ्°), अस्, m. constant repetition or study, continual reading to one's self; diligent and uninterrupted exercise or practice.
24940: निरन्तराल निर्-अन्तराल, अस्, आ, अम्, without an intervening space, without intervals or interstices; close, contracted, narrow. —निरन्तराल-ता, f. close contiguity, closeness, compactness, narrowness.
24941: निरन्धस् निर्-अन्धस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, foodless, without food, hungry.
24942: निरन्न निर्-अन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, foodless, want-ing food, hungry, starving; giving no food.
24943: निरन्वय निर्-अन्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no offspring or descendants, childless; unconnected with, unrelated; not agreeing with the context (of a sen-tence); without logical connection, without regular order or sequence, unmethodical; without being seen or observed, out of sight, not visibly committed (Manu VIII. 332).
24944: निरप निर्-अप, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, desti-tute of water.
24945: निरपत्रप निर्-अपत्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, shame-less, impudent; bold, confident.
24946: निरपराध निर्-अपराध, अस्, m. faultless-ness, innocence; (अस्, आ, अम्), unoffending, inoffen-sive, innocent, faultless, guiltless, blameless. —निर्-अपराध-ता, f. faultlessness, innocence. —निरप-राध-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, faultless, innocent.
24947: निरपवर्त निर्-अपवर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not re-turning or turning back; (in arithmetic) leaving no common measure, not to be divided by a common divisor, reduced to the lowest terms.
24948: निरपवाद निर्-अपवाद, अस्, आ, अम्, free from censure, without reproof, blameless.
24949: निरपाय निर्-अपाय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from destruction or decay, imperishable, eternal, free from detriment or loss, free from harm or evil; infallible.
24950: निरपेक्ष निर्-अपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, disregard-ing, not taking notice of (with loc.); careless, negli-gent, without desire, indifferent; not expecting any-thing from another; independant of, unconnected or unconcerned with; (often without any object) re-gardless, indifferent (to praise or blame); without purpose or hope; (आ), f. indifference; disregard, the absence of expectation; (अम्), n. without regard, regardlessly, accidentally. —निरपेक्ष-ता, f. or निरपेक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. disregard, indifference; independance; relationlessness.
24951: निर्-अपेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded; regardless.
24952: निर्-अपेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, disregarding, indifferent, not expecting anything.
24953: निर्-अपेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be regarded.
24954: निरभिभव निर्-अभिभव, अस्, आ, अम्, not subject to defeat or humiliation, not disgraced; not to be surpassed.
24955: निरभिमान निर्-अभिमान or निर्-अभीमान, अस्, आ, अम्, exempt from pride, free from self-con-ceit, devoid of egotism; unconscious.
24956: निरभिलाष निर्-अभिलाष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no desire for, not intent upon, indifferent.
24957: निरभ्र निर्-अभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, cloudless; (ए), ind. in a cloudless sky, when the sky is unclouded.
24958: निरम् नि-रम्, cl. 1. A. -रमते, -रन्तुम्, Ved. to delight in, be delighted; to rest, repose, desist: Caus. -रामयति, -यितुम्, Aor. -अरीरमत्, Ved. to gladden; to cause to rest or abide.
24959: नि-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged or interested in; attached or devoted to; pleased, delighted; rested, ceased.
24960: नि-रति, इस्, f. delighting in; attachment to.
24961: नि-रमण, अम्, n. delighting in; resting; (in Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa XIII. 4, 2, 5, नि-रमण is by some separated into निर्-अमण and explained to mean ‘exhausted,’ ‘worn out.’)
24962: निरमर्ष निर्-अमर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not im-patient; patient, apathetic, devoid of energy.
24963: निरमित्र निर्-अमित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without foes, free from enemies; (अस्), m., N. of several persons; of a son of Nakula; of a king of Tri-garta; of a son of Khaṇḍa-pāṇi or Daṇḍa-pāṇi, (also निर्-आमित्र); of a son of Ayutāyus; of a sage, con-sidered as a son of Śiva, (also निर्-आमित्र।)
24964: निरम्बर निर्-अम्बर, अस्, आ, अम्, undressed, naked.
24965: निरम्बु निर्-अम्बु, उस्, उस्, उ, abstaining from water, not drinking; waterless, destitute of water.
24966: निरय निर्-अय, अस्, m. ‘without happiness,’ hell [cf. तिर्यन्-निरय]; Niraya or Hell personified as a child of fear and death; (according to some निर्-अय, in the sense of ‘hell,’ is fr. निर्-इ and means ‘exit,’ ‘egress from life.’)
24968: निरर्गल निर्-अर्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, unbarred, without a bolt or hindrance, unobstructed, unrestrained, unimpeded; irresistible; (अम्), ind. without bolt or bar; without restraint or constraint, freely.
24969: निरर्थ निर्-अर्थ, अस्, m. loss, detriment; nonsense; (अस्, आ, अम्), destitute of wealth, poor; useless; meaningless, unmeaning, nonsensical, pur-poseless, vain; (a consonant is called निर्-अर्थ, not fulfilling its purpose if it is not followed by a vowel.) —निरर्थ-ता, f. senselessness, nonsense.
24970: निर्-अर्थक, अस्, आ or इका or अकी (?), अम्, not fulfilling one's aim or object, purposeless, useless, vain, unprofitable; having no reasonable sense, unmeaning, nonsensical; a consonant which is not followed by a vowel; (अम्), ind. without a purpose, uselessly, in vain. —निरर्थक-त्व, अम्, n. uselessness, vanity.
24971: निरर्द् निर्-अर्द्, cl. 1. P. -अर्दति, -अर्दितुम्, Ved. to stream forth, flow out.
24972: निरर्बुद निर्-अर्बुद, अस्, m.? (with Bud-dhists) N. of a hell in which the wicked are punished by excessive cold.
24973: निरव निर्-अव, अस्, आ, अम्? (occurring only in the gen. sing. निर्-अवस्य, which might be the ind. part. of rt. सो with preps. निर् and अव; said by others to be = नि = निस् + रव, अस्, m. loss of voice; but according to Sāy.) Ved. having no protector or uttering praise.
24974: निरवकाश निर्-अवकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, without free space; having no room for moving freely, wanting an opportunity, without leisure.
24975: निरवग्रह निर्-अवग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, without obstruction or obstacle, unrestrained, unchecked, un-controlled; irresistible; free, independant; self-willed, unmanageable, headstrong.
24976: निरवत्त निर्-अव-त्त, निर्-अव-त्ति। See un-der निर्-अव-दो, col. 3.
24977: निरवदय् निर्-अव-दय्, cl. 1. A. -दयते, Ved. to distribute, allot a share or shares.
24978: निरवदो निर्-अव-दो [cf. 3. दा], cl. 2. 4. P., Ved. -दाति and -द्यति, -दातुम्, to distribute, allot a share, give any one his share, to satisfy a claim; to divide completely among.
24979: निर्-अव-त्त, अस्, आ, अम्, distributed, completely divided or allotted.
24980: निर्-अव-त्ति, इस्, f., Ved. allotment or distribution of shares.
24981: निरवद्य निर्-अवद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unblamable, blameless, faultless, unobjectionable, unexceptionable; (अम्), n. (or आ?), f. unblamableness, blamelessness, faultlessness; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a particular high number. —निरवद्य-त्व, अम्, n. blamelessness, unblamableness, excellence. —निरवद्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, unblamable, blameless.
24982: निरवधि निर्-अवधि, इस्, इस्, इ, without bounds or boundaries, unlimited.
24983: निरवयव निर्-अवयव, अस्, आ, अम्, without limbs or members, without component parts, not consisting of parts, indivisible. —निरवयव-त्व, अम्, n. indivisibility.
24984: निरवरोध निर्-अवरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unre-strained, unobstructed, unopposed.
24985: निरवलम्ब निर्-अवलम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having no prop or stay; unsupported; not affording support; not depending or relying on.
24986: निर्-अवलम्बन, अम्, n. want of a prop, want of reliance, want of a person or thing to depend upon.
24987: निरवशेष निर्-अवशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, without a residue, complete, whole; (एण), ind. completely, totally, fully, particularly, circumstantially. —निर्-अवशेष-तस्, ind. completely, &c. (= निरवशे-षेण).
24988: निरवसाद निर्-अवसाद, अस्, आ, अम्, not cast down, cheerful, good-humoured.
24989: निरवस्कृत निर्-अवस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, clean?; [cf. अवस्-कर, अन्-अवस्कर।]
24990: निरवस्तार निर्-अवस्तार, अस्, आ, अम्, without a bed or coverlet; not strewn (with leaves &c.), bare.
24991: निरवहालिका निर्-अवहालिका, f. a fence, a hedge, an outer wall; [cf. अवहालिका।]
24992: निरविन्द निरविन्द, अस्, m., N. of a moun-tain.
24993: निरवेक्ष् निर्-अवेक्ष् (-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to perceive.
24994: निर्-अवेक्ष्य, ind. having perceived or observed.
24995: निरव्यय निर्-अवयय, अस्, आ, अम्, undecaying, eternal.
24996: निरश् निर्-अश्, cl. 9. P. -अश्नाति, &c., Ved. to eat up, consume entirely.
24997: निर्-अशित, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten up, completely con-sumed.
24998: निरशन निर्-अशन, अस्, आ, अम्, abstaining from food; (अम्), n. going without food, fasting.
24999: निरष्ट निर्-अष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. अश् or अक्ष् with निस्), Ved. deprived of vigour, exhausted; (Sāy.) = निर्-आकृत, driven away, scattered, dispersed.
25000: निरस् निर्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to cast out, throw away, drive away, banish, expel, evict, drive back, send back; to keep off; to turn out (of doors); to reject, repudiate, decline, refuse; to re-move; to tear out, strip off; to stretch out (e. g. हस्तौ निरस्यति or -ते, he stretches out the hands); to annihilate, destroy, subdue.
25001: निर्-असन, अस्, ई, अम्, expelling, removing, re-jecting; vomiting, spitting out; (अम्), n. expelling, ejecting; expulsion, removal, rejection, denial, con-tradiction, refusal, disallowance; vomiting forth, spitting out; suppressing, checking; killing, destroy-ing, destruction, extermination.
25002: निर्-असनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown out, to be driven away or expelled.
25003: निर्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cast out or away, expelled; thrown out or away, cast off; thrown off (as from a horse); driven away, expelled, banished; rejected, repudiated, abandoned, deserted; disallowed; re-futed; sent forth, sent away; deprived of, removed; shot off, discharged (as an arrow); spit out; uttered hurriedly or rapidly (as a speech or word); torn out or away; destroyed; broken (as an agreement); suppressed, checked; (अम्), n. rejecting; dropping or leaving out, not pronouncing (regarded as a fault in pronunciation). —निरस्त-भेद, अस्, आ, अम्, having all difference removed, identical. —निरस्त-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned worldly desires or has devoted himself to religious penance.
25004: 1. निर्-अस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be expelled or driven out.
25005: 2. निरस्य, ind. having cast out, thrown out or ejected, having expelled.
25006: निर्-अस्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, ejecting, throwing out; expelling; abandoning, neglecting, scattering, de-stroying, &c.
25007: निर्-अस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thrown out or expelled; being abandoned; being suppressed, &c.
25008: निर्-आस, अस्, m. throwing out, casting out, ejection, expulsion, removal, abandonment; dropping (a sound or letter &c.); vomiting; opposing, contradiction, refutation. —निरास-गुटिका, f. a pill to produce vomiting; (also written निराश-गुटिका।)
25009: निर्-आसन, अम्, n. = निर्-असन, p. 492, col. 3.
25010: निरस नि-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, = नी-रस, without flavour, tasteless, insipid, dry; (अस्), m. want of flavour, insipidity; want of juice, dryness; want of passion or feeling; (आ), f. a species of grass (= निः-श्रेणिका).
25011: निरस्त्र निर्-अस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, weaponless, unarmed; (fought) without weapons (as a battle).
25012: निरस्थि निर्-अस्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, having no bones, boneless.
25013: निरह् निर्-अह्, only in perf. निर्-आह, Ved. to utter, pronounce, express.
25014: निरहङ्कार निर्-अहङ्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, free from egotism, devoid of selfishness, free from pride, humble, lowly.
25015: निर्-अहङ्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, having no self-con-sciousness, without individuality or personality; un-selfish.
25016: निर्-अहङ्कृति, इस्, इस्, इ, free from egotism or selfishness.
25017: निर्-अहङ्क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no individu-ality or personality, without self-consciousness.
25018: निर्-अहङ्क्रिया, f. absence of egotism or selfishness.
25019: निरहम् निर्-अहम् or निर्-अहम्मति, इस्, इस्, इ, devoid of self-conceit, free from selfishness.
25020: निराक निराक, अस्, m. cooking; sweat; the recompense of a bad action; (wrong reading for नि-पाक।)
25021: निराकरण निर्-आकरण। See under निर्-आ-कृ, col. 2.
25022: निराकाङ्क्ष निर्-आकाङ्क्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, expect-ing nothing, wishing nothing, free from desire; wanting nothing to fill up or make complete (as the sense of a sentence or word).
25023: निराकाङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, expecting nothing, wish-ing or wanting nothing.
25024: निराकार 1. निर्-आकार, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see निर्-आ-कृ, col. 2), devoid of form, deprived of one's natural form; without external appearance; formless, shapeless, deformed; disguised; unassuming; not claiming anything for one's self, modest; (अस्), m. heaven, Viṣṇu; Śiva; the universal Spirit, God.
25025: 1. निर्-आकृति, इस्, इस्, इ, formless, shapeless, de-formed, ugly; (इस्), m. a person who has not duly gone through a course of study, (especially applied however to the religious student who has not duly read the Vedas); one who neglects the five great religious obligations, who does not worship the gods, &c.; a Brāhman who neglects the duties of his caste (आकृति) by not going through a regular course of study.
25026: निराकाश निर्-आकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, having no free space, leaving no room, completely filled.
25027: निराकुल निर्-आकुल, अस्, आ, अम्, unconfused, not disordered; unperplexed; unbewildered; clear; steady, calm; perspicuous; (अम्), n. calmness, per-spicuity, clearness.
25028: निराकृ निर्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to separate or divide off (Ved.); to push away, turn or drive away, repudiate, keep away, keep off, banish, expel, eject, remove, reject; to refuse; to oppose, obstruct, contradict; to disallow; to omit, intermit; to frustrate; to contemn, spurn.
25029: निर्-आकरण, अम्, n. repudiating, expelling, turn-ing out, turning away, throwing off; removing, banishing; repudiation, obstruction, opposition, con-tradiction, rejection; refutation, reply; contempt, disesteem; forgetting; neglecting the chief sacrificial or religious duties.
25030: निर्-आकरिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, expelling, repudiating, a repudiator; obstructive, obstructing, hindering from (with abl.); spurning, disdaining, despising; seeking to remove from (with abl.), envying any person anything (abl.); forgetful. —निराकरिष्णु-ता, f. the state of being a repudiator; envy, malevolence.
25031: निर्-आकर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a repudiator, repudi-ating; a despiser, contemner (as of the gods).
25032: 2. निर्-आकार, अस्, m. rebuke, reproach, censure, blame. (For 1. निर्-आकार see col. 1.)
25033: निर्-आकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pushed away, driven away, repudiated, expelled, banished, ejected, rejected, re-moved, set aside, turned away, turned out; thrown off; divorced; refused, denied; refuted, replied to; contemned, despised, spurned, made light of; de-prived of. —निराकृतान्योत्तर (°त-अन्य-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, refuting every answer, irrefutable, irrefragable. —निराकृतान्योत्तर-त्व, अम्, n. irrefutableness, irrefragableness.
25034: 2. निर्-आकृति, इस्, f. repudiation, rejection; refusal, disallowance; obstruction, obstacle, impediment, in-terruption; contradiction, opposition; (इस्, इस्, इ), impeding, obstructing; annihilating, destroying; (इस्), m., N. of a son of the first Manu Sāvarṇi.
25035: निर्-आकृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (probably) repudiating, impeding, obstructing; avoiding; making no exertion either to do or avoid.
25036: निर्-आक्रिया, f. repudiation, expulsion, removal; contradiction, denial, refutation.
25037: निराकृति 1. and 2. निर्-आकृति। See under 1. निर्-आकार, col. 1, and under निर्-आ-कृ above.
25038: निराक्रन्द निर्-आक्रन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, not com-plaining; a place where no sound can be heard.
25039: निराक्रम् निर्-आ-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रान्तुम् and -क्रमितुम्, to come forth, to go out of.
25041: निराक्रोश निर्-आक्रोश, अस्, आ, अम्, unaccused, unreviled.
25042: निराग नि-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, passionless, dis-passionate.
25043: निरागम निर्-आगम, अस्, आ, अम्, not founded on revelation, not resting on scripture.
25044: निरागस् निर्-आगस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, sinless, fault-less, innocent.
25045: निराग्रह निर्-आग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, not insist-ing upon, not peremptory or obstinate.
25046: निराचार निर्-आचार, अस्, आ, अम्, without approved usages or customs, lawless, barbarian, (espe-cially applied to those people who have not the ordi-nances of the Vedas or distinction of castes.)
25047: निराजीव्य निर्-आजीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not yield-ing subsistence, not granting a livelihood.
25048: निराडम्बर निर्-आडम्बर, अस्, आ, अम्, without drums. —निराडम्बर-सुन्दर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, (perhaps) beautiful in itself, not requiring a drum to attract attention or not requiring ornaments.
25049: निरातङ्क निर्-आतङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, not feeling pain or uneasiness, without ailment, well, comfort-able; not causing pain or ailment or disagreeable feelings; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva.
25050: निरातप निर्-आतप, अस्, आ, अम्, not pene-trated by the sun's rays, shady; (आ), f. the night.
25051: निरात्मक निर्-आत्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-आत्मन्, आ, आ, अ, or निरात्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having no separate soul or no individual existence.
25052: निरादर निर्-आदर, अस्, आ, अम्, showing no respect, disrespectful.
25053: निरादान निर्-आदान, अस्, आ, अम्, taking nothing, not taking, one from whom nothing is taken; an epithet of Buddha.
25054: निरादिष्ट निर्-आदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, paid off (as a debt).
25055: निर्-आदेश, अस्, m. complete payment or discharge of a debt.
25056: निराधा निर्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, &c., Ved. to take out of, take away.
25057: निराधान निर्-आधान, अस्, आ, अम्, without a receptacle.
25058: निराधार निर्-आधार, अस्, आ, अम्, without a receptacle; without a fulcrum or support.
25059: निराधि निर्-आधि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from anxiety, undisturbed by care.
25060: निरानन्द निर्-आनन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, joyless, sad, sorrowful; not delighting. —निर्-आनन्द-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing no pleasure, causing care or sorrow.
25061: निरान्त्र निर्-आन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. evisce-rated, disembowelled; having the entrails hanging out.
25062: निरापद् निर्-आपद्, त्, f. freedom from mis-fortune or calamity, a prosperous condition, security; (त्, त्, त्), free from calamity or misfortune, prosperous, fortunate.
25063: निराबाध निर्-आबाध, अस्, आ, अम्, undis-turbed, unmolested, unvexed, secure from disturb-ance; unobstructed; not disturbing, not molesting, not injuring, not paining; frivolously or not really vexatious. —निर्-आबाध-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, not causing injury or pain.
25064: निरामय निर्-आमय, अस्, अम्, m. n. freedom from illness, health, happiness, welfare; (अस्, आ, अम्), free from illness, healthy, well, hale, recovered from sickness, free from disease; free from taint, pure; guileless; free from defects or failings; infallible; not liable to failure or miscarriage; complete, full; (अस्), m. a wild goat; a hog, a boar; N. of a king.
25065: निरामर्द निर्-आमर्द, अस्, m. ‘not oppress-ing,’ N. of a king.
25066: निरामालु निर्-आमालु, उस्, m. (fr. निराम-आलु?), the wood apple, Feronia Elephantum; [cf. कपित्थ।]
25068: निरामिन् नि-रामिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. remain-ing, staying in; (Sāy.) delighting in.
25069: निरामिष निर्-आमिष, अस्, आ, अम्, fleshless, without meat or prey; not receiving wages; having no sensual desires, free from covetousness. —निरा-मिषाशिन् (°ष-आश्°), ई, इनी, इ, not feeding on meat; living without meat; free from sensual desires.
25070: निरांय निर्-आय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no in-come or revenue, profitless, yielding no income or profit. —निर्-आय-व्यय-वत्, आन्, m. having neither income nor expenditure, an idler who lives by clan-destine means.
25071: निरायत 1. निर्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. यम् with आ and निस्), stretched out, extended.
25072: निरायत 2. निर्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, unex-tended, contracted, compact.
25073: निरायास निर्-आयास, अस्, आ, अम्, not causing trouble, not requiring efforts, not fatiguing; easily attainable, easy.
25074: निरायुध निर्-आयुध, अस्, आ, अम्, weapon-less, disarmed, unarmed, defenceless.
25075: निरारम्भ निर्-आरम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, not un-dertaking enterprises, not enterprising, abstaining from all work.
25076: निरालक निरालक, अस्, m. a species of fish.
25077: निरालम्ब निर्-आलम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having no prop or support, not resting or depending on another, independent, self-supported, not relying on another, standing alone, friendless; (अस्), m., N. of a man mentioned in the Śaṅkara-vijaya; (आ), f. spikenard, = आकाश-मांसी; (अम्), ind. without support, in-dependently. —निरालम्बोपनिषद् (°ब-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
25078: निर्-आलम्बन, अस्, आ, अम्, having no prop, without support, not resting on another.
25079: निरालस्य निर्-आलस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not slothful.
25080: निरालोक निर्-आलोक, अस्, आ, अम्, not looking about, not moving the eye, without moving the eyes; deprived of light, dark; invisible, uninvestigable (?); an epithet of Śiva.
25081: निरावर्ष निर्-आवर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, unpene-trated by rain, protecting from rain.
25082: निराश निर्-आश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + 1. आ-शा; cf. आ-शंस्), without hope, hopeless, despairing of (with loc., dat., or with प्रति and acc., e. g. स्व-जीविते or स्व-जीविताय or स्व-जीवितम् प्रति निर्-आशः, despairing of one's own life); depriving of all hope; [cf. नैराश्य।] —निराश-त्व, अम्, n. hope-lessness, despair. —निराशी-भाव, अस्, m. hopeless-ness, despair. —निराशी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become hopeless; despairing.
25083: निर्-आशक, अस्, आ, अम्, desponding, despairing of (with abl.).
25084: निर्-आशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hopeless. —निराशि-त्व, अम्, n. = निराश-त्व, hopelessness.
25085: निराशङ्क निर्-आशङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless; (अम्), ind. fearlessly, without fear or hesitation.
25086: निराशिस् निर्-आशिस्, ईस्, ईस्, इस् (see आ-शास्), having no wishes or hopes; without a blessing.
25087: निराश्रम निर्-आश्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-आश्रमिन्; ई, इणी, इ, not being in one of the four periods or orders of a Brāhman's life.
25088: निराश्रय निर्-आश्रय, अस्, आ, अम्, supportless, without prop or stay, not resting or depending on, unsupported, self-supported, without shelter or refuge, unprotected, destitute; not deep (as a wound?).
25089: निरास निर्-आस, अस्, m. See under निर्-अस् at p. 493, col. 1.
25090: निरासित्व निरासि-त्व incorrect reading for निराशि-त्व।
25091: निरास्पद निर्-आस्पद, अस्, आ, अम्, restless, having no place of rest, homeless; portionless.
25092: निरास्वाद निर्-आस्वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, tasteless, flavourless, unsavoury, yielding no enjoyment.
25093: निर्-आस्वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unsavoury, giving no enjoyment. —निरास्वाद्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most unsavoury.
25094: निराहार निर्-आहार, अस्, m. want of food, not eating, fasting; (अस्, आ, अम्), foodless, fasting, abstaining from food, without food, having nothing to eat. —निराहार-ता, f. foodlessness, fasting.
25095: निराहावत् निर्-आहा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, for निर्-आहाव-वत्, without invocation.
25096: निरि निर्-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, &c., -एतुम्, to go out, come forth, go off, depart.
25097: निरिङ्ग निर्-इङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, immovable, not moving to and fro, not flickering.
25099: निरिच्छ निर्-इच्छ, अस्, आ, अम्, without wish or desire, indifferent.
25100: निरिन्द्रिय निर्-इन्द्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. im-potent, destitute of manly vigour or of strength (in general); barren; having lost the use of a limb; imperfect, mutilated, maimed, infirm, weak, frail; (in Manu IX. 18) without evidence or means of certain knowledge (according to Kullūka = प्रमाण-रहित).
25101: निरिन्धन निर्-इन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of fuel.
25102: निरी नि-री, cl. 9. P. -रिणाति, -रेतुम्, Ved. to attack.
25103: निरीक्ष् निर्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षि-तुम्, to look at, look towards, behold, gaze at, look about, regard, observe, view, contemplate, perceive.
25104: निर्-ईक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, seeing, view-ing, observing, visiting.
25105: निर्-ईक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, regarding; (अम्), ṇ. look; looking at, regarding, seeing; ex-pecting; the aspect of the planets.
25106: निर्-ईक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or निर्-ईक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, regarding, expecting, hoping.
25107: निर्-ईक्षा, f. looking at, regarding; considera-tion; hope, expectation; (अया), ind. in respect of, in relation to, as to (e. g. बलाबल-निरीक्षया, in respect of strength and weakness; cf. दुर्-निरीक्ष).
25108: निर्-ईक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seeing, looking, viewing; [cf. नातिदूर-न्°।]
25109: 1. निर्-ईक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at or regarded; to be considered; [cf. दुर्-न्°।]
25110: 2. निर्-ईक्ष्य, ind. having looked at or viewed or scanned.
25111: निर्-ईक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at or regarded; looking, (Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 7694.)
25112: निरीति निर्-ईति, इस्, इस्, इ, free from calami-ties or afflictions, painless.
25113: निर्-ईतिक, अस्, आ, अम्, not inauspicious, not prog-nosticating calamity, auspicious.
25115: निरीश्वर निर्-ईश्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, godless, atheistic. —निरीश्वर-वाद, अस्, m. godlessness, atheism. —निरीश्वर-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, atheistical.
25116: निरीष निर्-ईष, अम्, n. the body of a plough (without the pole and ploughshare; also read निर्-ईश).
25117: निरीह निर्-ईह, अस्, आ, अम्, inactive, effort-less; desireless, not wishful, indifferent, unanxious. —निरीह-ता, f. or निरीह-त्व, अम्, n. or निर्-ईहा, f. indifference, absence of desire or effort. —निरीहा-वस्था (°हा-अव्°), f. a state of indifference.
25118: निरुक्त निर्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वच् with निस्), uttered, pronounced, expressed, explained, de-fined; loud, distinct; (अम्), n. explanation or ety-mological interpretation of a word; N. of one of the six Vedāṅgas or works considered as connected with the Vedas; glossarial explanation of obscure terms, (especially those occurring in the Vedas); N. of a well-known commentary on the Nighaṇṭus by Yāska; [cf. नैरुक्त, नैरुक्तिक।] —निरुक्त-कार, अस्, m. ‘Nirukta-composer,’ N. or epithet of a com-mentator on Kāli-dāsa's Megha-dūta. —निरुक्त-कृत्, त्, m. epithet of a pupil of Śāka-pūrṇi. —नि-रुक्त-ज, अस्, m., N. of a class of sons enumerated in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 2615. —निरुक्त-परि-शिष्ट, अम्, n., N. of a work supplementary to the Nirukta. —निरुक्त-वत्, आन्, m. ‘possessing the Ni-rukta, author of the Nirukta,’ an epithet of Yāska. —निरुक्त-वृत्ति, इस्, f. ‘commentary on the Ni-rukta,’ N. of a commentary on Yāska's Nirukta by Durgācārya.
25119: निर्-उक्ति, इस्, f. explanation, etymological inter-pretation of words; (in rhetoric) an artificial or poetical explanation of the derivation of a word (e. g. deriving दोषा-कर, ‘the moon,’ from दोषा + आकर instead of दोषा + कर); = निर्-उक्त, Yāska's commentary on the Nighaṇṭus.
25120: निर्-उच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being uttered or expressed.
25121: निरुक्ष् निर्-उक्ष्, cl. 6. P. -उक्षति, &c., Ved. to remove by sprinkling.
25122: निरुच्छ्वास निर्-उच्छ्वास, अस्, m. absence of breath, not breathing; (अस्, आ, अम्), without breath-ing, not breathing, breathless; narrow, contracted, crowded; (अम्), n. (?) a particular hell where the wicked cannot breathe. —निरुच्छ्वास-निपीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pained by not breathing (?).
25123: निरुज नि-रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, for नी-रुज, healthy, q. v.
25124: निरुत्तर निर्-उत्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, having no superior; answerless, without a reply, unable to answer, silenced, posed; (अम्), n., N. of a Tantra. —निरुत्तर-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
25125: निरुत्पात निर्-उत्पात, अस्, आ, अम्, free from portents.
25126: निरुत्सव निर्-उत्सव, अस्, आ, अम्, without festivals, having no festivities.
25127: निरुत्साह निर्-उत्साह, अस्, m. absence of exertion, want of energy, indolence, pusillanimity; (अस्, आ, अम्), without energy, devoid of energy, un-dertaking nothing, without courage, indolent, indif-ferent. —निरुत्साह-ता, f. want of energy, cowardice.
25128: निरुत्सुक निर्-उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, careless, indifferent, unconcerned; calm, tranquil, unanxious, unregretful, having no vehement desire for; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Manu Raivata; one of the Saptarṣis under the thirteenth Manu.
25129: निरुदक निर्-उदक, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, devoid of water.
25130: निरुद्यम निर्-उद्यम, अस्, आ, अम्, effortless, inactive, lazy, at rest.
25131: निरुद्योग निर्-उद्योग, अस्, आ, अम्, making no efforts, lazy, listless, idle; disheartened; cause-less (?).
25132: निरुद्विग्न निर्-उद्विग्न or निर्-उद्वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, unexcited, undisturbed, free from perturbation, fearless, sedate, calm. —निरुद्विग्न-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, undisturbed in mind.
25133: निरुध् नि-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to shut in, shut, obstruct, stop, hinder, prevent, restrain, check; to confine; to keep off, remove; to accomplish (?): Caus. -रोध-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to be shut or obstructed.
25134: नि-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopped, obstructed, re-strained, checked, hindered, opposed; confined, im-prisoned; (अस्), m., N. of a prince. —निरुद्ध-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the breath obstructed, suffocated. —निरुद्ध-गुद, अस्, m. contraction or obstruction of the rectum. —निरुद्ध-प्रकश, अस्, m. stricture of the urethra. —निरुद्ध-शम-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘whose state of repose is interrupted,’ wearied, tired.
25135: नि-रुन्धत्, अन्, अती, अत्, checking, hindering, suppressing, &c.
25136: नि-रुन्धान, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing, opposing, hindering, preventing; depriving of, &c.
25137: नि-रोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shut in or confined, to be fenced, to be enclosed with a fence or hedge.
25138: नि-रोध, अस्, m. shutting in, confinement, locking up, imprisonment; enclosing, covering up; check, restraint, coercion, suppression, hindrance, prevention, obstruction, opposition; annihilation, destruction; (in dramatic language) disappointment, frustration of hope; hurting, injuring (= नि-ग्रह); aversion, disfavour, dislike; (with Buddhists) suppression or annihilation of pain (one of the four principles); N. of a man.
25139: नि-रोधक, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructive, obstructing, confining, hindering.
25140: नि-रोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, confining, obstructing; (अस्), m. (with अवट) N. of a hell; (अम्), n. con-finement, imprisonment; keeping back, restraining, keeping down, coercion; denying; (in dramatic language) disappointment, frustration of hope.
25141: नि-रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, obstructing, hindering.
25142: निरुपक्रम निर्-उपक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having no beginning, without a commencement.
25143: निरुपद्रव निर्-उपद्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, free from hostile attacks, free from ravages, not visited by calamity or affliction, free from adversity or danger, lucky, happy, undisturbed, unharmed, un-molested; free from national distress, free from tyranny; causing no affliction or adversity; peaceful, secure; not inauspicious (as a star). —निरुपद्रव-ता, f. absence of calamity or danger, security.
25144: निर्-उपद्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, not visited by calamities; not boding evil (as a star).
25145: निरुपधि निर्-उपधि, इस्, इस्, इ, without guile, guileless, honest, secure.
25146: निरुपपत्ति निर्-उपपत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, unfit, un-suitable. —निरुपपत्ति-त्व, अम्, n. unfitness, un-suitableness.
25147: निरुपपद निर्-उपपद, अस्, आ, अम्, not con-nected with a subordinate word; [cf. उप-पद।]
25148: निरुपप्लव निर्-उपप्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, free from calamity or disturbance, free from trouble or alarm; unharmed; not causing adversity; an epithet of Śiva.
25149: निरुपभोग निर्-उपभोग, अस्, आ, अम्, not enjoying, destitute of enjoyment.
25150: निरुपम निर्-उपम, अस्, आ, अम्, peerless, matchless, without a compeer or equal, unequalled, incomparable; (अस्), m. a species of poisonous animal (= गौधेरक).
25151: निरुपल निर्-उपल, अस्, आ, अम्, stoneless, free from stones.
25152: निरुपलेप निर्-उपलेप, अस्, आ, अम्, un-smeared, free from ointment.
25153: निरुपसर्ग निर्-उपसर्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, free from portents, not portentous.
25154: निरुपस्कृत निर्-उपस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncor-rupted, inartificial, pure.
25155: निरुपहत निर्-उपहत, अस्, आ, अम्, unhurt, uninjured, not afflicted; auspicious.
25156: निरुपाख्य निर्-उपाख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not perceptible by the eyes, invisible, immaterial; unreal, false, non-existent.
25157: निरुपाधिक निर्-उपाधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, without attributes or qualities.
25158: निरुपाय निर्-उपाय, अस्, आ, अम्, without expedients, remediless, helpless; unsuccessful.
25159: निरुपेक्ष निर्-उपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not neg-lectful; free from trick or fraud.
25160: निरुप्ति निर्-उप्ति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. वप् with निस्), = 1. निर्-वाप, q. v.
25161: निर्-उप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be scattered or sprinkled.
25162: निरुब्ज् निर्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, &c., Ved. to press down, cause to flow down, send down, let loose.
25163: निरुष्णीष निर्-उष्णीष, अस्, आ, अम्, without a turban or head-dress, bare-headed.
25164: निरुष्मन् निर्-उष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, devoid of heat, cold. —निरुष्म-त्व, अम्, n. absence of heat, coldness.
25165: निरूढ 1. नि-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-रुह्), inherent, conventional, accepted (as the familiar meaning of words in opposition to their etymological sense); (अस्), m. (in rhetoric) the force or application of words according to their natural or received meanings; (in logic) the inherence of any property in the term implying it (as of redness in the word red &c.).
25166: निरूढ 2. निर्-ऊढ, आ, f. (fr. rt. वह् with निस्), unmarried.
25167: निरूप् नि-रूप्, cl. 10. P. -रूपयति, -यितुम्, to perform; to represent, enact, act dramatically; to see, perceive, look at, look into; to observe, con-sider, reflect upon; to investigate, examine, look out for, discover, search; to ascertain; to select, choose, appoint; to resolve, determine.
25168: नि-रूपण, अस्, ई, अम्, defining, determining; (अम्), n. form, shape; sight, seeing; looking for, searching; looking into, investigation, determination, definition; ascertaining, defining, (in these senses also नि-रूपणा।)
25169: नि-रूपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked for; to be searched into or examined, to be investigated.
25170: नि-रूपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking for, investi-gating, considering.
25171: नि-रूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld; discovered, found; appointed, elected, chosen, deputed; consi-dered, weighed; ascertained, determined, resolved.
25172: नि-रूपिति, इस्, f. definition (of an idea), ascertain-ment.
25173: 1. नि-रूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen or defined or ascertained.
25174: 2. नि-रूप्य, ind. having seen or considered. —निरूप्य-ता, f. or निरूप्य-त्व, अम्, n. ascer-taining, determining.
25176: निरूह् निर्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 1. ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, &c., Ved. inf. निर्-ऊहितवै, to push out, draw out, remove: Caus. -ऊहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to draw out or purge.
25177: 3. निर्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn out, purged, eviscerated; (for 2. निर्-ऊढ see above.) —निर्-ऊढ-पशु-प्रयोग, अस्, m., N. of a treatise on particular sacrifices, (see the next.) —निरूढ-पशु-बन्ध, अस्, m. ‘the offering or oblation of an eviscerated animal,’ N. of one of the regular Havir-yajñas.
25178: निर्-ऊढि, इस्, f. (also to be referred to rt. वह् with निस्), fame, celebrity, renown.
25179: 1. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. a purging clyster; an enema not of an oily kind, = नि-ग्रह?; (for 2. निर्-ऊह see below.) —निरूह-वस्ति-विधि, इस्, m., N. of the twenty-fifth chapter of the Śārṅga-dhara-saṃ-hitā, a medical work by Śārṅga-dhara. —निरूहा-धिकार (°ह-अध्°), अस्, m., N. of a chapter of a medical work by Vṛnda.
25180: 1. निर्-ऊहण, अम्, n. causing to purge with a clyster; administering enemas not of an oily kind. (For 2. निर्-ऊहण see below.)
25182: निरूह 2. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with निस्), logic, disputation; certainty, ascertainment. (For 1. निर्-ऊह see above; for 3. see next col.)
25184: निरूह 3. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. (for 1. and 2. see col. 2), a sentence having no ellipsis, a complete sentence.
25185: निरृ निर्-ऋ, cl. 3. P. -इयर्ति, &c., Ved. to go out from, depart from, liberate one's self from (with abl.); to be excluded, to become deprived of (with abl.); Caus. निर्-अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go to pieces or decay, to dissolve.
25186: निर्-ऋत, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolved, decaying; debili-tated; (अस्), m., N. of a Rudra.
25187: निर्-ऋति, इस्, f. decay, dissolution, destruction, anni-hilation, calamity, evil, adversity; imprecation, curse; Decay or Destruction personified (goddess of death and corruption; she is described as binding mortals with her cords, and is often associated with Mṛtyu, A-rāti, and similar beings; she is variously regarded as the wife of A-dharma, mother of Bhaya, Mahā-bhaya, and Mṛtyu, or as a daughter of A-dharma and Hiṃsā and mother of Naraka and Bhaya; she is regent of the south-west or south-western quarter and of the asterism Mūla); (इस्), f. the bottom or lower depths of the earth (perhaps regarded as the seat of putrefaction; cf. नैरृत); (इस्, इस्, इ), free from adversity, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
25188: निर्-ऋथ, अस्, m. destruction, the Destroyer (i. e. Nirṛtha personified); an epithet of a particular Agni; (according to some) the Sāma-veda.
25189: निरृछ् निर्-ऋछ्, cl. 6. P. -ऋच्छति, &c., Ved. to go out from, fall from, be excluded from (with abl.); to go or cleave asunder.
25190: निरे निर्-ए (निर्-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. निर्-ऐति, Ved. to come forth from, to go off, depart, make way for.
25191: निरेक नि-रेक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रिच् with नि), Ved. a lasting possession (?), wealth, property; (ए), ind. lastingly, for ever; (Sāy.) in poverty or want; in donation or gifts; (according to Mahī-dhara) not empty.
25192: निरेभ नि-रेभ, अस्, आ, अम्, soundless, noise-less.
25195: निर्गन्ध निर्-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, inodorous, scentless, unfragrant, void of smell. —निर्गन्ध-ता, f. absence of smell, want of fragrance, scentlessness. —निर्गन्ध-पुष्पी, f. the silk-cotton tree (= शाल्मलि), Bombax Heptaphyllum.
25196: निर्गन्धन निर्गन्धन, अम्, n. = निर्ग्रन्-थन, killing, slaughter.
25197: निर्गम् निर्-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-तुम्, to go out, come forth, depart from (with abl.), set out; to come out or appear (as a bud); to go away, disappear; to be freed from (with abl.); to enter into any state, undergo (with acc.): Desid. -जिगमि-षति, to wish to go out.
25198: निर्-ग, अस्, m. country, region; place or province.
25199: निर्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out, come forth, come out, appeared; gone away, departed; disappeared, extinct; freed from. —निर्गत-विशङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from fear, fearless.
25200: निर्-गम, अस्, m. going forth or out, setting out, going away, receding; departure, vanishing; exit, issue, outlet; a door; [cf. जल-न्°।]
25201: निर्-गमन, अम्, n. going out or forth.
25202: निर्गर्व निर्-गर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pride, humble, lowly.
25203: निर्गल् निर्-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, &c., to trickle or flow out; to dissolve, melt. —निर्-गलित, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed out, poured forth; dissolved, melted.
25204: निर्गवाक्ष निर्-गवाक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, window-less, without windows.
25205: निर्गा निर्-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति (or -जगाति), -गातुम्, Ved. to go out, come forth.
25206: निर्गुण निर्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, stringless (as a bow); devoid of all qualities or properties; without attributes; having no epithet; devoid of good qualities or virtues, bad, worthless, vicious; (अस्), m. the Supreme Being (as without qualities of any kind). —निर्गुण-ता, f. or निर्गुण-त्व, अम्, n. absence of qualities, want of properties, freedom from all qualities (as an attribute of the Supreme Being); absence or want of good qualities, wickedness, vicious-ness, baseness. —निर्गुणात्मक (°ण-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having no qualities.
25207: निर्गुण्टी निर्गुण्टी or निर्गुण्डी or निर्गुण्डि, इस्, f. the shrub Vitex Negundo; another plant (= नील-शेफालिका); the root of a lotus.
25208: निर्गुप् निर्-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपायति, &c., to guard, protect.
25209: निर्गुल्म निर्-गुल्म, अस्, आ, अम्, free from bushes, destitute of shrubs.
25210: निर्गूढ निर्-गूढ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. गुह् with निस्), the hollow of a tree.
25211: निर्गृह निर्-गृह, अस्, आ, अम्, houseless, homeless.
25212: निर्गॄ निर्-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति, &c., to vomit forth. —निर्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited forth.
25213: निर्गौरव निर्-गौरव, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of respect; without dignity, undignified, affable; (अम्), ind. without pride, condescendingly, affably.
25214: निर्ग्रन्थ निर्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from all ties or hindrances; a saint, a devotee who has withdrawn from the world and lives either as a hermit or a beggar wandering about naked; pos-sessionless, poor, a pauper, beggar [cf. ग्रन्थ, said to mean ‘riches’]; (अस्), m. an idiot; a fool; a gambler; N. of a man, son of Jñāti. —निर्ग्रन्थ-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work.
25215: निर्-ग्रन्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, unattended, unac-companied; abandoned, deserted; fruitless; clever, expert, conversant; (अस्), m. a religious mendicant; a naked devotee; a gambler; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (?), Buddhism (because the Buddhists appeared as religious mendicants, especially as ascetics).
25216: निर्-ग्रन्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from knots, knotless.
25217: निर्-ग्रन्थिक, अस्, m. a naked mendicant, an ascetic; (अस्, आ, अम्), clever, conversant; = हीन, destitute (?).
25218: निर्ग्रन्थन निर्-ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. killing, slaughter; [cf. नि-ग्रन्थन, नि-गन्धन।]
25219: निर्ग्राह्य निर्-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be traced or found out, perceivable.
25220: निर्घट निर्-घट, अम्, n. a fair or crowded market, a free market, a wharf or ghaut where no toll is levied, a place where there is no quay or stairs, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
25221: निर्घण्ट निर्-घण्ट or निर्-घण्टक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a vocabulary, a collection of words, = नि-घण्टु, (perhaps for निर्-ग्रन्थक, ‘singling out the words of a sentence and writing them down in their independent form.’)
25222: निर्घात निर्-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with निस्), destruction; a violent gust of wind, hurricane, whirlwind; the noise of contending vapours in the sky; an earthquake; a thunder-stroke; any severe stroke.
25223: निर्-घातन, अम्, n. forcing out, bringing out.
25224: निर्-घात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be forced or brought out.
25225: निर्घुष्ट निर्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. घुष् with निस्), sounded, resounded.
25226: निर्-घोष, अस्, m. sound in general, noise, a loud noise, rattling, trampling; (अस्, आ, अम्), sound-less, noiseless, (in this sense निर् is a privative.) —निर्घोषाक्षर-विमुक्त (°ष-अक्ष्°), अस्, m., N. of a Samādhi.
25227: निर्घूरिणी निर्-घूरिणी, f. a river, (perhaps a wrong reading for निर्-झरिणी।)
25228: निर्घृण निर्-घृण, अस्, आ, अम्, unmerciful, pitiless, cruel; shameless, immodest; (अम्), ind. without pity, pitilessly. —निर्घृण-ता, f. or निर्-घृण-त्व, अम्, n. pitilessness, unmercifulness, hard-heartedness, cruelty.
25230: निर्घृष् निर्-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, &c., to rub against or on (with loc.).
25232: निर्घर्षणक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what rubs, a rubber, rubbing, a rubbing, a dentifrice fit for cleaning the teeth.
25233: निर्-घृष्य, ind. having rubbed, having rubbed on.
25235: निर्जन निर्-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, unpeopled, de-populated, uninhabited, unfrequented, lonely, de-serted, desolate; (अम्), n. a solitude, desert. —निर्-जन-ता, f. or निर्जन-त्व, अम्, n. depopulation, the state of being unpeopled or deserted. —निर्जन-वन, अम्, n. a lonely or unfrequented forest.
25236: निर्जर 1. निर्-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see निर्-जॄ, col. 3), not becoming old, young, fresh; imperishable, immortal, undecaying; (अस्), m. an immortal, a deity, god; (आ), f. the plant Cocculus Cordifolius; Anethum Graveloens, = तत्त्व-भिद्; (अम्), n. ambrosia, the food of the gods. —निर्-जर-सर्षप, अस्, m. a species of mustard (= देव-सर्षप).
25237: निर्-जरस्, optionally substituted for 1. निर्-जर in certain cases. (See Pāṇ. VII. 2, 101.)
25238: निर्जरायु निर्-जरायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. skin-less (as a snake which has cast its skin).
25239: निर्जर्जल्प निर्-जर्जल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (ac-cording to Mahī-dhara, probably because of its simi-larity to जर्जर, =) ragged, tattered; (another read-ing has निर्-जाल्मक।)
25240: निर्जल निर्-जल, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, desti-tute of water, dry, desert; not mixed with water (as buttermilk); (अस्), m. a desert, waste. —निर्जल-तोयदाभ (°द-आभा), अस्, आ, अम्, of the colour of a waterless cloud, i. e. white, of a fair complexion. —निर्जलैकादशी (°ल-एक्°), f., N. of the eleventh day in the light half of month Jyaiṣṭha, on which even the drinking of water is forbidden.
25241: निर्जात निर्-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, come forth, appeared, visible.
25243: निर्जि निर्-जि, cl. 1. P. A. -जयति, -ते, -जेतुम्, to conquer, win, gain, acquire, subdue, vanquish; to overcome in play.
25244: निर्-जय, अस्, m. conquest, complete victory, van-quishing, subduing; [cf. मन्यु-न्°।]
25245: निर्-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, conquered, completely van-quished, thoroughly subdued, overcome; won, ac-quired, gained; claimed; unconquered. —निर्जित-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —निर्जितारि-गणस् (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has conquered hosts of enemies. —निर्जितेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued passions or feelings. —निर्जितेन्द्रिय-ग्राम, अस्, m. ‘one who has subdued the whole assemblage of his organs,’ a Muni, a saint.
25246: निर्-जिति, इस्, f. conquest, complete victory, sub-duing, subjugation.
25247: निर्-जित्य, ind. having conquered or won or gained.
25248: निर्-जेतृ, ता, m. a conquerer, vanquisher.
25249: निर्जिह्व निर्-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, tongueless, without a tongue.
25250: निर्जीव निर्-जीव, अस्, m. lifelessness, death; (अस्, आ, अम्), lifeless, inanimate, dead. —निर्जीव-कारण, अम्, n. a cause of death, a fatal blow.
25251: निर्-जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, lifeless, dead, inanimate.
25252: निर्जुष्ट निर्-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जुष् with prep. निस्), frequented, inhabited.
25253: निर्जॄ निर्-जॄ, Caus. -जरयति, -यितुम्, to wear down, wear away, rub to pieces, crush.
25254: 2. निर्-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, completely wearing down or destroying. (For 1. निर्-जर see col. 2.)
25255: निर्ज्ञाति निर्-ज्ञाति, इस्, इस्, इ, destitute of relations; having no kinsfolk.
25256: निर्ज्वर निर्-ज्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, feverless, healthy.
25257: निर्झर निर्-झर, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. (perhaps fr. झर् for rt. क्षर् with निस्), a waterfall, cataract, cascade, mountain-torrent, the precipitous descent of water from mountains, &c. [cf. झर]; (अस्), m. burning chaff; an elephant; a horse of the Sun [cf. निर्-णर]; (ई), f. a river [cf. निर्-झरिणी; cf. also निलिम्प-न्°।]
25258: निर्-झरिन्, ई, m. a mountain; (इणी), f. a torrent, river.
25259: निर्णय निर्-णय। See under निर्-णी below.
25260: निर्णर निर्-णर, अस्, m. one of the horses of the Sun; [cf. निर्-झर।]
25261: निर्णाम निर्णाम, अस्, m., Ved. the joint of a wing.
25262: निर्णिज् 1. निर्-णिज्, cl. 3. P. A. -णेनेक्ति, -णे-निक्ते, Ved. inf. निर्-णिजे, निर्-णिजम्, &c., to wash off, wash, cleanse (A.); to wash one's self; to dress one's self.
25263: निर्-णिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, washed, purified, cleaned, cleansed.
25264: 2. निर्-णिज्, क्, f., Ved. a shining dress or ornament, any bright garment [cf. अधि-न्°, अश्व-न्°, घृत-न्°]; purification, cleansing; (Sāy.) a form, shape; well nourished (m. f. n.).
25265: निर्-णेक, अस्, m. washing, cleansing, cleaning; ablution; expiation, atonement.
25266: निर्-णेजक, अस्, m. a washerman, washer.
25267: निर्-णेजन, अम्, n. ablution; expiation, atonement for an offence.
25268: निर्णी निर्-णी, cl. 1. P. A. -णयति, -ते, -णे-तुम्, to lead or take away, carry away, carry off; to trace out, investigate, find out, ascertain, educe, elicit, to settle, come to a decision, decide.
25269: निर्-णय, अस्, m. removing, removal; deciding, rendering certain, complete ascertainment, decision, certainty, determination, proof, affirmation, precise definition, settlement; (in logic) deduction, inference, conclusion, demonstration; application of a conclu-sive argument; (in law) sentence, verdict; (in rhe-toric) narration of events; discussion, consideration, investigation. —निर्णय-कमलाकर (°ल-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘a lotus-bed of conclusions,’ N. of a Mīmāṃsā work. —निर्णय-दर्पण, अम्, n. ‘mirror of certainty,’ N. of a Vedānta work. —निर्णय-दीप, ‘lamp of certainty,’ N. of a work mentioned in the Śūdra-dharma-tattva by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa. —निर्णय-दीपिका, f., N. of a work written about the middle of the seventeenth century. —निर्णय-पाद, अस्, m. a sentence, decree, verdict in law. —निर्णय-सिन्धु, N. of a Mīmāṃsā work by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa; (also read निर्णेय-सिन्धु।) —निर्णया-मृत (°य-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar of certainty,’ N. of a work.
25270: निर्-णयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, concluding, deciding, ascertaining.
25271: निर्-णयन, अम्, n. ascertainment, certainty; positive conclusion.
25272: निर्-णायक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing or leading to certainty, conclusive.
25273: निर्-णायन, अम्, n. rendering certain; the outer angle of the elephant's eye.
25274: निर्-णीत, अस्, आ, अम्, deduced, traced out, brought to a conclusion, ascertained, settled, decided, proved.
25275: निर्-णेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, decisive, certifying, veri-fying, leading to certainty, demonstrating, proving; (ता), m. one who pronounces a sentence, a judge; a voucher; a guide. —निर्णेतृ-त्व, अम्, n. proof, verification.
25276: निर्-णेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ascertained, to be decided or determined.
25277: निर्णुद् निर्-णुद्, cl. 6. P. A. (sometimes wrongly निर्-नुद्), -णुदति, -ते, -णोत्तुम्, to push or drive out; to drive away, expel, reject, remove; to repudiate.
25279: निर्दंश् निर्-दंश्, cl. 1. P. -दशति or -दं-शति, -दंष्टुम्, to bite through, bite; (with दन्-तान्) to gnash the teeth, grind the teeth.
25280: निर्-दंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, biting through; not biting, (Ved., in this sense निर् is a privative.)
25281: निर्-दशत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, biting, biting through; consuming.
25282: निर्-दशमान, अस्, आ, अम्, biting through, biting; gnashing or grinding (the teeth).
25283: निर्-दश्य, ind. having bitten, biting through.
25285: निर्दड निर्-दड, अस्, आ, अम्, unkind, un-feeling, unmerciful; devoid of pity or charity, re-joicing over the faults of others; envious, slanderous, abusive; useless, unnecessary; mad, intoxicated; vio-lent; (sometimes spelt निर्-दट; cf. निर्-दय।)
25286: निर्दण्ड निर्-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, not punishing.
25287: निर्दय निर्-दय, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiless, un-merciful, unkind, cruel, hard-hearted; passionate; excessive, violent; unpitied by any; (अम्), n. without pity, unmercifully; passionately, violently, exces-sively, much. —निर्दय-त्व, अम्, n. unmercifulness, cruelty.
25288: निर्दर निर्-दर, अस्, or निर्-दरि, इस्, m. = दर or दरि, a cave, cavern; [according to some निर्-दर, अस्, आ, अम्, = निर्-दय, pitiless, hard; shameless; also निर्-दरम्, ind. = excessively, and निर्-दर, अम्, n. = pith, essence.] —निर्दरि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inhabiting a cave.
25289: निर्दलन निर्-दलन, अम्, n. splitting, cleaving asunder, breaking.
25290: निर्दश निर्-दश, अस्, आ, अम्, more than ten days old, what happened more than ten days ago; [cf. अ-न्°, नैर्दश्य।] —निर्दशाह (°श-अह), see अ-न्°।
25292: निर्दशन निर्-दशन, अस्, आ, अम्, toothless. —निर्दशनाक्षि-जिह्व (°न-अक्ष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of teeth, eyes, and tongue.
25293: निर्दस्यु निर्-दस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from robbers or bandits.
25294: निर्दह् निर्-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn out, burn up, consume by fire, destroy com-pletely: Caus. -दाहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to burn up or set on fire.
25295: निर्-दग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, burnt up; un-burnt, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)

25664: निर्व्याधि निर्-व्याधि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from sickness, healthy, strong.

25673: निर्व्लयनी निर्-व्लयनी, f. (fr. rt. व्ली with निस्). See निर्-ल्वयनी, p. 500, col. 1.
25674: निर्हन् निर्-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, Ved. to strike out, expel.

25771: 1. नि-वेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be founded (as a town); to be married (as a man); to be returned or paid.
25772: 2. नि-वेश्य, ind. having placed in or on, having made to remain or dwell.

25774: निविशेष नि-विशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, not differ-ent, alike; (अस्), m. want of difference.
25775: निवीत नि-वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. व्ये with नि), having the sacred Brāhmanical thread suspended round the neck; (अम्), n. wearing the Brāhmanical thread round the neck; the Brāhmanical thread so worn; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a veil, mantle, a wrapper (= नि-वृत).
25776: निवीतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing the sacred thread sus-pended round the neck; (ई), m. a Brāhman with the cord so suspended.
25777: निवीर्य नि-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, impotent (= निर्-वीर्य, q. v.).
25778: निवृ नि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -णुते, -वृणाति, -णीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -व-रीतुम्, to surround, defend, restrain: Caus. -वार-यति, -यितुम्, to surround, protect; to keep off, ward off, prohibit, hinder, prevent, hold back from, stop, withhold, forbid, interdict, exclude, obstruct, oppose: Caus. 25780: नि-वार, अस्, m. keeping off, warding off, defend-ing, preventing, hindering, opposition, impediment; (आ), f., N. of a river.
25781: नि-वारक, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off, defending, able to keep off.
25782: नि-वारण, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off, preventing, defending; (अम्), n. keeping back or off, preventing, defending, hindering, opposing; prohibition, an im-pediment; contemning (?).
25783: नि-वारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept off or de-fended, to be checked or hindered, &c.
25784: नि-वारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, preventing, opposing, hindering.
25785: नि-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, hindered, forbidden, pre-vented, checked, opposed.
25787: 2. नि-वार्य, ind. having suppressed, having for-bidden.
25788: नि-वार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being prevented or hindered.
25789: नि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enclosed, en-compassed; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. (= नि-वीत), a veil, a mantle, a wrapper.
25791: निवृज् नि-वृज्, cl. 7. 1. P. -वृणक्ति, -वर्-जति, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to immerse, drown; to over-throw; to pour out; to extirpate.
25792: निवृत् 1. नि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut. Cond. and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to turn back, return, retreat, retire, go back, turn back or away from (with abl.); to recoil; to escape from (with abl.), run away; to cease from, desist from, abstain or refrain from (with abl.); to refuse, decline; to cease; to come to an end, be accomplished; to be finished, stop, set (as the sun); not to occur; to be withheld; to be forbidden; to be reversed; to be occupied or engaged in: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to return; to bring back; to turn away, keep back from, restrain; to cause to desist; to drive back, repel; to accomplish, perform, bring to an end, (for निर्-वृत्।)
25793: नि-वर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing to return or turn back.
25794: नि-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, returning, turning or coming back, flying; desisting from, stopping, ceasing; bringing back, causing to cease, abolishing, expelling, removing. —निवर्तक-त्व, अम्, n. the state of one who turns back, &c.
25795: नि-वर्तन, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back, ceasing, ceas-ing to exist, disappearing; causing to return; (अम्), n. returning, turning or coming back, return; ceasing, not happening, not occurring; desisting or abstaining from (with abl.); desisting from work, inactivity, (opposed to प्र-वर्तन); repenting, reforming; causing to come back, bringing back; turning back (the hair); a means of returning (Ved.); keeping back from (with abl.); a measure of land, 20 rods or 200 cubits or 40,000 Hastas square. —निवर्तन-स्तूप, अस्, m., N. of a Stūpa erected at the spot where the charioteer of Buddha returned.
25796: नि-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought back; to be made to turn back, to be kept back or diverted or hindered.
25797: नि-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back, re-turning.
25798: नि-वर्तयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back, to be restrained, to be diverted.
25799: नि-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned back or away, brought back, made to desist. —निवर्तित-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has turned away before.
25800: नि-वर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought back.
25801: नि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, turning back, returning, flying, (सङ्ग्रामाद् अ-निवर्तिन्, not turning back from the fight, i. e. not flying); leaving off, abstaining from; allowing to return, causing to turn back.
25802: नि-वर्त्य, ind. having turned or brought back, having induced to desist; having desisted or refrained from; having repented; having repaid; [cf. दुर्-न्°।]
25803: नि-विवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Desid.), wishing to return or desist.
25804: नि-विवृत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of turning back, wishing to desist.
25806: नि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, returned, returning, turned back; gone, departed; vanished; ceased, refrained from, abstained, stopped, desisted, prohibited; abstain-ing from worldly acts, &c.; abstaining, abstracted or abstained from or independent of worldly acts or motives, abstracted from this world, quiet; desisting from or repenting of any improper conduct; finished, completed, whole; (अम्), n. return; [cf. दुर्-न्°।] —निवृत्त-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, without further cause or motive; (अस्), m. a virtuous man, one uninfluenced by worldly desires. —निवृत्त-कृषि-गोरक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from agriculture and the tending of cattle. —निवृत्त-देव-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from sacrificial rites or offerings to the gods. —निवृत्त-मांस, अस्, आ, अम्, one who abstains from eating meat. —निवृत्त-यज्ञ-स्वाध्याय, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from sacrifices and the repetition of prayers. —निवृत्त-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued appetites or passions. —निवृत्त-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, quitting any practice or occupation. —निवृत्त-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, with relenting heart. —निवृत्-तात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, m. ‘one whose spirit is ab-stracted,’ a sage; an epithet of Viṣṇu.
25807: नि-वृत्ति, इस्, f. returning, return; disappearing, disappearance, ceasing, cessation, suspension, abstain-ing from action, inactivity, (opposed to प्र-वृत्ति); ceasing to be active, ceasing to be valid or binding (as a rule); leaving off, desisting from (with abl.); resigning, discontinuance of worldly acts, cessation of emotions, separation from the world, abstinence; repose, rest; felicity, bliss, beatitude, (wrongly for निर्-वृत्ति); denial, refusal; abolition, prevention; completion; (इस्), m., N. of a son of Vṛṣṇi; of a son of Dharma, king of Magadha; [cf. निर्-वृत्ति, नि-धृति।]
25808: निवृह् नि-वृह् [cf. नि-बृह्], Caus. -वर्ह-यति, -यितुम्, to throw down; to annihilate; to extirpate.
25809: नि-वर्हण, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, extirpating, annihilating, removing; (अम्), n. destruction, eradi-cation, annihilation, killing, removing; [cf. नि-बर्-हण।]
25810: नि-वर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, annihilated, eradicated.
25811: निवेदक नि-वेदक, नि-वेदन, &c. See under 1. नि-विद्, p. 503, cols. 2, 3.
25812: निवेष्ट नि-वेष्ट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वेष्ट् with नि), a cover, envelope; वसिष्ठस्य निवेष्टस्, N. of a Sāman.
25813: नि-वेष्टन, अम्, n. covering, enveloping, clothing.
25814: निवेष्य नि-वेष्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. विष् with नि), Ved. a whirlpool, a water-spout; a whirlwind or any similar phenomenon [cf. स्तनयित्नु]; a part of the upper or fore-part of an animal, the vertebra?; (according to Mahī-dhara) eddy or hoar-frost; (अस्, आ, अम्), whirling, belonging to a whirlpool or eddy.
25815: निव्याध नि-व्याध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्यध् with नि), Ved. an opening, aperture, a window.
25816: नि-व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. piercing, opening.
25817: निव्यूढ नि-व्यूढ, अम्, n. perseverance, resolution.
25818: निश् 1. निश्, euphonically substituted for निस् before च्, छ्, &c.
25819: निश् 2. निश्, cl. 1. P. -नेशति, &c., to meditate upon, meditate profoundly, to be absorbed in meditation.
25820: निश् 3. निश्, f. (perhaps connected with नक् fr. rt. 2. नश्, or merely a curtailed form of निशा below, which may be connected with नि-शीथ and so derived fr. rt. शी with नि; the form निश् is defective in nom. voc. sing. du. and pl., acc. sing. du., but may be optionally substituted for निशा in acc. pl. and remaining cases, e. g. निशस् or निशास्, निशा or निशया, निड्भ्याम् [according to some also निज्भ्याम्] or निशाभ्याम्, &c.), night; निशि निशि, every night; महा-निशि, at midnight.
25821: निश, अम्, n. (at the end of a comp.) = निशा, night (e. g. अहर्-निशम्, ind. day and night; दिवा-निशम्, ind. day and night; cf. also अ-निश।)
25822: निशा, f. night; a vision, dream; turmeric, Cur-cuma (of two species, = हरिद्रा and दारु-हरिद्रा, probably C. Zedoaria and C. Longa; a collective N. of the asterisms Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius, and Capricorn; cf. निशा-बल।) —निशा-कर, अस्, m. ‘the night-maker,’ the moon, (regarded with दिवा-कर as a son of Garuḍa); a symbolical expression for the numeral one; a cock. —निशा-कर-कला-मौलि, इस्, m. ‘bearing a crescent as diadem,’ an epithet of Śiva. —निशा-काल, अस्, m. the time of night. —निशा-केतु, उस्, m. ‘night-sign,’ the moon. —निशा-क्षय, अस्, m. the close of night. —निशा-गण, अस्, m. a number of nights. —निशा-गम (°शा-आग्°), अस्, m. the coming on or com-mencement of night. —निशा-गृह, अस्, m. a bed-room, sleeping-room. —निशा-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, going or moving about by night, nocturnal, night-walking; (अस्), m. a Rākṣasa, a fiend, an imp or goblin; an epithet of Śiva [cf. निशाचर-पति]; a jackal; an owl; a snake; the ruddy goose, Cakra-vāka; a thief; a ghost, an evil spirit; (ई), f. a she-devil, a female fiend; a woman who goes to an as-signation, a harlot, whore; a sort of perfume, (see केशिनी।) —निशाचर-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of night-walkers,’ an epithet of Śiva. —निशाचरेश (°र-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of the Rākṣasas,’ an epithet of Rāvaṇa. —निशा-चर्मन्, अ, n. ‘the skin of night,’ darkness. —निशा-छद, अस्, m. a species of plant. —निशा-जल, अम्, n. ‘the water of night,’ hoar-frost, frost, dew. —निशाट (°शा-अट), अस्, m. ‘roving by night,’ an owl; a demon, a ghost. —निशाटक, अस्, m. bdellium (= गुग्गुलु, connected with नि-शाट, an owl; cf. कौशिक, = owl and bdellium, उलूखल, उलूखलक). —निशाटन (°शा-अट्°), अस्, m. ‘night-rover,’ an owl; (ई), f. a species of moth. —निशातिक्रम (°शा-अत्°), अस्, m. the passing away of night. —निशात्यय (°शा-अत्°), अस्, m. the close of night, day-break. —निशा-दर्शिन्, ई, m. ‘seeing at night,’ an owl. —निशादि (°शा-आदि), इस्, f. the begin-ning of night, evening, twilight. —निशाधीश (°शा-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon. —निशा-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon. —निशा-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —निशा-निशम्, ind. night by night, every night, always. —१। नि-शान्त (°शा-अन्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 2. नि-शान्त see under नि-शम्, p. 505, col. 1), the end of night, break of day. —निशान्ध (°शा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blind at night; (आ), f. a species of creeper (= जतुका). —निशा-पति, इस्, m. ‘husband of the night,’ the moon; camphor. —निशा-पुत्र, आस्, m. pl. ‘the sons of night,’ N. of certain demons. —निशा-पुष्प, अस्, m. ‘the flower of night,’ the white water-lily; hoar-frost, dew. —निशा-प्राणे-श्वर, अस्, m. ‘husband of night,’ the moon. —निशा-बल, अस्, m. a collective N. of the signs of the zodiac Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagit-tarius, and Capricorn. —निशा-भङ्गा, f. a species of plant (= दुग्ध-पुच्छी). —निशा-मणि, इस्, m. ‘jewel of the night,’ the moon; [cf. ध्वजाग्र-निशामणि।] —निशा-मुख, अम्, n. the beginning of night. —निशा-मृग, अस्, m. ‘night-animal,’ a jackal. —१। निशा-रण, अम्, n. a nocturnal battle; (for 2. see नि-शरण below.) —निशा-रत्न, अम्, n. (or, according to some, अस् m.), ‘the jewel of the night,’ the moon. —निशार्धकाल (°शा-अर्ध-क्°), अस्, m. the first part of the night (opposed to the following). —निशावसान (°शा-अव्°), अम्, n. the close or end of night, the second part of the night (opposed to the preceding). —निशा-विहार, अस्, m. a night-walker, a nocturnal imp or goblin, a Rākṣasa. —निशा-वृन्द, अम्, n. a number of nights. —निशा-वेदिन्, ई, m. ‘knowing the night,’ a cock. —निशा-हस, अस्, m. ‘night-smiler,’ the white water-lily which opens its petals at night. —निशाह्वा (°शा-आह्°), f. turmeric. —निशि-पाल, अस्, m. a kind of metre consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each. —निशि-पुष्पा or निशि-पुष्पी or निशिपुष्-पिका, f. the tree Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis. —निशेश (°श-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon. —नि-शैत (°श-एत), अस्, m. ‘shining at night,’ the crane, Ardea Nivea. —निशोत्सर्ग (°शा-उत्°), अस्, m. the end of night, day-break. —निशोपशाय (°शा-उप्°), अस्, m. resting at night.
25823: निशठ नि-शठ, अस्, आ, अम्, not false, candid, honest; (अस्), m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi, a son of Bala-rāma by Revatī; (also written नि-षठ, नि-सठ, नि-सथ।)

25830: निशान्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to a house (?).

25838: निशात नि-शात। See under नि-शो, col. 2.

25841: निशायिन् नि-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. शी with नि), lying down in, sleeping in (?).

25844: नि-शित, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened, whetted, pointed, stimulated; (अम्), n. iron.

26166: निस् निस्, ind. (as a preposition or prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns, expressing) out, forth, outward, out of, out from, away, away from; (निस् is used as an independent and separable adverb in Atharva-veda VI. 18, 3; VII. 115, 3; XVI. 2, 1.) निस् is also prefixed to nouns, not immediately con-nected with verbs, in the sense ‘out of,’ ‘away from’ [cf. निर्-वन], but more commonly in the sense of a privative or negative adverb = 3. अ, ‘no,’ ‘not,’ ‘without.’ In this latter signification it may form either negative substantives (e. g. fr. अर्थ, ad-vantage, निर्-अर्थ, disadvantage) or more frequently adjectives (e. g. fr. मल, a stain, निर्-मल, stain-less). निस् is liable to be euphonically changed to निर्, निः, निश्, निष् or नी [cf. नी-रस, &c.] accord-ing to the letter which follows it.
