26339: नील, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (probably fr. निश् + ल = निश्ल = निल्ल = नील; according to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 42, the fem. form नीला is used in relation to clothes &c., and नीली in relation to plants, animals, &c.; in proper names either form is allowed), of a dark colour, (especially dark-blue or black); dyed with indigo; (अस्), m. dark-blue or black (the colour); a gem, the sapphire; the Indian fig-tree (= वट); a species of bird, the blue or hill Maina; an ox or bull of a dark colour; one of the nine Nidhis or divine treasures of Kuvera; N. of a man, the prince of Māhiṣmatī; of a son of Yadu; of a historian of Kaśmīra; an epithet of Mañju-śrī; N. of a Nāga; of one of the monkey-chiefs attending on Rāma, (said to be a son of Agni); the blue mountain, one of the principal ranges of mountains dividing the world into nine portions and lying immediately north of Ilāvṛta or the central division [cf. नीलाद्रि]; (आ), f. the indigo plant, Indigofera Tinctoria [cf. नीली]; a species of Boerhavia with blue blossoms (= नील-पुनर्-नवा); a species of blue fly [cf. नीली]; the two arteries in front of the neck, (in this sense नीले, f. du.); a black and blue mark on the skin (either from a bruise or a disease?); a Rāgiṇī or mode of music, personified as the wife of Rāga Mallāra; (ई), f. the indigo plant; another plant, Blyxa Saivala (= शैवल; cf. जल-नीली); a species of blue fly; a kind of disease (= नीली-रोग, नीलिका); N. of the wife of Aja-mīḍha [cf. नीलिनी, नलिनी]; (अम्), n. darkness (Ved.); indigo, the dye; black salt (= काच-लवण); blue vitriol (= तुत्थ); antimony (= सौवीराञ्जन); poison (= तालीश-पत्त्र); a peculiar position in dancing; a kind of metre con-sisting of four times sixteen syllables; [cf. Lat. niger for nigro = निश्-र।] —नील-कणा, f. a species of cumin. —नील-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-necked; (अस्), m. a peacock; a species of gallinule or water-hen (= दात्यूह); a wag-tail; a sparrow; a blue-necked jay; the plant Hyperanthera Moringa (= पीत-सार); an epithet of Śiva (as having a black throat, so stained by the acrimony of the poison which he swallowed on its production at the churn-ing of the ocean); N. of several authors and com-mentators; (अम्), n. a radish; [cf. काल-कण्ठ।] —नीलकण्ठ-चम्पू, ऊस्, f., N. of a work by Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. —नीलकण्ठ-तीर्थ, अम्, n. ‘the bathing-place of Śiva,’ N. of a sacred Tīrtha. —नीलकण्ठ-भारती, m., N. of an author men-tioned in the Sarva-darśana-saṅgraha of Mādhavā-cārya. —नीलकण्ठ-स्तव, अस्, m. ‘the praise of Śiva,’ N. of the fifty-first chapter of the Jñāna-khaṇḍa of the Śiva-Purāṇa. —नीलकण्ठाक्ष (°ठ-अक्°), अम्, n. the berry or seed of Elæocarpus Ganitrus. —नील-कन्द, अस्, m. a species of bulbous plant (= महिष-कन्द-भेद). —नील-कमल, अम्, n. the blue water-lily. —नील-कायिक, आस्, m. pl. (with Buddhists) ‘blue-bodied’ or ‘dark-bodied,’ epithet of a class of deities. —नील-कुन्तला, f., N. of a female friend of Durgā. —नील-कुरण्टक, अस्, m. or नील-कुसुमा, f. or नील-कुरुण्टक, a species of Barleria with blue blossoms (B. Cœrulea, = नील-झिण्टी). —नील-केशी, f. the indigo plant. —नील-क्रान्ता, f. a species of plant (= विष्णु-क्रान्ता). —नील-क्रौञ्च, अस्, m. a species of curlew or heron. —नील-गङ्गा, f., N. of a river. —नील-गणेश, अस्, m. the blue Gaṇeśa. —नील-गर्भ, a young blue water-lily (?). —नील-गिरि-कर्णिका, f. a blue variety of Clitoria Ternatea. —नील-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-necked; (अस्), m. an epithet of Rudra-Śiva or Mahā-deva, (see नील-कण्ठ); N. of a king. —नील-घोर, a various reading for नील-पोर, q. v. —नील-चर्मन्, अ, n. the tree Xylo-carpus Granatum. —नील-च्छद, अस्, m. ‘dark-leaved,’ the date tree; ‘blue-winged,’ an epithet of Garuḍa. —नील-च्छवी, a species of bird (= कुकु; the right form is probably नील-च्छविन्, ई, m.). —नील-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the blue mountains; (अम्), n. blue steel; (आ), f. the river Vitastā. —नील-झिण्टी, f. blue Barleria (= नील-कुरण्टक). —नील-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —नील-तरु, उस्, m. the cocoa-nut tree. —नील-ता, f. blueness, blackness, a blue or dark colour. —नील-ताल, अस्, m. Xanthochymus Pictorius; Phœnix Paludosa. —नील-दूर्वा, f. a species of plant (= हरिता). —नील-द्रुम, अस्, m. a species of tree (= नीलासन). —नील-ध्वज, अस्, m. Xanthochymus Pictorius; N. of a prince of Māhiṣmatī. —नील-नख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. black-clawed, having black claws. —नील-निर्गुण्डी, f. a species of Nirguṇḍī with blue blossoms. —नील-निर्यासक, अस्, m. a species of tree (= नीलासन). —नील-नीरज, अम्, n. the blue water-lily. —नील-पक्ष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having black eyelashes. —नील-पङ्क, अम्, n. darkness; (अस्, अम्), m. n. black mud. —नील-पटल, अम्, n. a sort of dark film or membrane over the eye of a blind person; a dark mass, a black coating or covering. —नील-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-leaved, having black or dark-blue leaves; (अस्), m., N. of several plants, Scir-pus Kysoor; the pomegranate tree; (आ), f. Premna Herbacea; (अम्), n. the blue water-lily. —नील-पद्म, अम्, n. the blue water-lily. —नील-पर्ण, अस्, m. Grevia Orientalis; (ई), f. Vanda (= वन्दा) Roxburghii. —नील-पाचन, अम्, n. steeping or maceration of indigo. —नीलपाचन-भाण्ड, अम्, n. a vessel for steeping indigo, an indigo vat. —नील-पिङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, of a dark-brown colour. —नील-पिच्छ, अस्, m. ‘black-tailed,’ a falcon. —नील-पिट, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) a collection of annals and royal edicts. —नील-पिष्टोडी, f. a species of shrub (= नीलाम्ली). —नील-पुनर्-नवा, f. a species of Punar-navā with blue blossoms. —नील-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —नील-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa. —नील-पुष्प, अस्, m. a species of Verbesina with blue flowers; (आ), f. a plant (= विष्णु-क्रान्ता); (ई), f. a plant (= नील-वुह्ना); (अम्), n. a species of fragrant plant (= ग्रन्थि-पर्ण). —नील-पुष्पिका, f. the indigo plant; linseed, Linum Usitatissimum. —नील-पृष्-ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘black-backed,’ epithet of Agni; (अस्), m. a species of fish, commonly called Rohi, Cyprinus Denticulatus. —नील-पोर, अस्, m. a species of sugar-cane. —नील-भ, अस्, m. ‘having a bluish or dark appearance,’ the moon; a cloud; a bee; [cf. नीलाभ।] —नील-भू, ऊस्, f., N. of a river. —नील-भृङ्गराज, अस्, m. a species of Verbesina with blue blossoms. —नील-मक्षा, f. a species of blue fly or bee. —नील-मणि, इस्, m. a blue gem, the sapphire. —नील-मत, अम्, n., N. of a poem in the Pauranic style, celebrating the sacred places of Kaśmīra, and said to have been inspired by Nīla the serpent-king. —नील-मल्लिका, f. Ægle Marmelos. —नील-माधव, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (as being of a dark colour). —नील-माष, अस्, m. Dolichos Catjang. —नील-मीलिक, अस्, m. a fire-fly. —नील-मृत्तिका, f. iron pyrites; black earth or mould. —नील-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, voiding dark or bluish urine. —नील-यष्-टिका, f. a species of dark sugar-cane. —नील-रत्न, अम्, n. the sapphire. —नील-राजि, इस्, f. a dark line, dark row, dark mass. —नील-रुद्रोपनिषद् (°र-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad. —नील-रूपक, अस्, m. Thespesia Populneoides. —नील-लोह, अम्, n. blue steel. —नील-लोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-blue mixed with red, purple, of a purple colour, dark-red; (अस्), m., N. of Rudra-Śiva; N. of a Kalpa; a mixture of blue and red, a purple colour; (आ), f. a species of vegetable (= भूमि-जम्बु); N. of a goddess, the wife of Śiva. —नील-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. blackish, dark; (आन्), m., N. of a mountain. —नील-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-coloured, blue, of a blue colour; (अस् or अम्), m. n. Grevia Orientalis; radish. —नीलवर्ण-शृगाल-वत्, ind. like the blue jackal. —नील-वल्ली, f. Vanda Roxburghii. —नील-वसन, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing dark-blue or black garments; (अस्), m. the planet Saturn. —नील-वस्त्र, अम्, n. a blue or dark garment, dark-coloured cloth; (अस्, आ, अम्), dressed in dark or blue garments; (अस्), m. an epithet of Bala-rāma; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā. —नील-वानर, अस्, m. ‘the blue monkey,’ a species of monkey. —नील-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, dressed in dark-blue clothes; (आस्), m. the planet Saturn. —नील-वीज, अस्, m. a species of tree (= नीलासन). —नील-वुह्ना, f. Convolvulus Argenteus. —नील-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of plant (= वातारि). —नील-वृन्त, अस्, m. (?), a fan. —नीलवृन्तक, अम्, n. cotton. —नील-वृष, अस्, m. a dark-coloured bull; (आ), f. Solanum Melongena. —नील-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a kind of religious ceremony. —नील-शिखण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, having black tufts or locks of hair. —नील-शिग्रु, उस्, m. Hyperanthera Moringa. —नील-षण्ड, अस्, m. a dark-coloured bull at liberty. —नील-सन्ध्या, f. = नील-गिरि-कर्णिका, q. v. —नील-सरस्वती, f., N. of a goddess (= तारा). —नीलसरस्वती-मनु, N. of an incantation or magical formula. —नील-सिन्दु-वार, अस्, m. Vitex Negundo. —नील-स्कन्दा or नील-स्कन्धा or नील-स्पन्दा, f. the dark Go-karṇī. —नील-स्वरूप, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a metre consisting of four lines of eleven syllables each. —नीलाक्ष (°ल-अक्ष), अस्, m. ‘blue-eyed,’ a goose. —नीलाङ्कित-दल (°ल-अङ्°), अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a species of bulbous plant (= तैल-कन्द). —नीलाङ्ग (°ल-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dark-bodied, having a dark-coloured or dark-blue body; (अस्), m. the Indian crane; the blue jay, Coracias Indica. —नीलाञ्जन (°ल-अञ्°), अम्, n. antimony; blue vitriol; (आ), f. lightning; (ई), f. a species of shrub (= कालाञ्जनी). —नीलाञ्जसा (°ल-अञ्°), f. lightning [cf. नीलाञ्जना]; N. of an Apsaras or courtezan of Svarga; N. of a river. —नीलाद्रि (°ल-अद्°), इस्, m. the mountain Nīla. —नीलाद्रि-कर्-णिका, f. or नीलापराजिता (°ल-अप्°), f. = नील-गिरि-कर्णिका. —नीलाब्ज (°ल-अब्°), अम्, n. the blue water-lily, a blue lotus. —नीलाभ (°ल-आभा), अस्, आ, अम्, blue-looking, blue; (अस्), m. a cloud; [cf. नील-भ।] —नीलाभ्र (°ल-अभ्°), अस्, m. a dark cloud. —नीलाभ्र-संवृत (°ल-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, obscured or concealed by dark clouds. —नीलाम्बर (°ल-अम्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dressed in dark-blue cloth, wearing a blue garment; (अस्), m. a demon, a goblin; the planet Saturn; an epithet of Bala-rāma; (अम्), n. black or dark-blue raiment. —नीलाम्बु-जन्मन् (°ल-अम्°), अ, n. the blue lotus. —नीलाम्-लान (°ल-अम्°), अस्, m. a species of plant (in Hindī कालाकोराठा) = दासी = छादन. —नीलाम्ली (°ल-अम्°), f. a species of shrub. —नीलारुण (°ल-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘the dark-red’ or first dawn of day. —नी-लालि-कुल-सङ्कुल (°ल-अल्°), ‘full of swarms of blue bees,’ the plant Rosa Glandulifera. —नीलालु (°ल-आलु), उस्, m. a species of bulbous plant (= असि-तालु). —नीलाशी, f. the plant Vitex Negundo. —नी-लाशोक (°ल-अश्°), अस्, m. an Aśoka with blue blos-soms. —नीलाश्मन् (°ल-अश्°), आ, m. a blue stone, a sapphire. —नीलाश्व (°ल-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a dis-trict. —नीलासन (°ल-अस्°), अस्, m. a species of tree (= नील-द्रुम, नील-निर्यासक, &c.). —नीलासुर (°ल-अस्°), अस्, m., N. of the author of the commen-tary Nava-kaṇḍikā-bhāṣya on Kātyāyana's Śrāddha-sūtras. —नीली-राग, अस्, m. an affection which is unchangeable as the colour of indigo, unalterable attachment; (अस्, आ, अम्), having the colour of the indigo plant; ‘as unchangeable as the indigo colour,’ constant in affection; (अस्), m. a firm and constant friend. —नीली-सन्धान, अम्, n. fermentation or maceration of indigo. —नीलीसन्धान-भाण्ड, अम्, n. a vessel for steeping indigo, an indigo vat. —नीलेश्वर (°ल-ईश्°), N. of a town on the Mala-bar shore (Νελκύνδα). —नीलोत्पल (°ल-उत्°), अम्, n. a blue lotus, the blue water-lily, Nymphæa Cyanea. —नीलोत्पल-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed or consisting of blue lotuses. —नीलोत्पलिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Mañju-śrī, one of the Jaina saints or teachers. —नी-लोद (°ल-उद), अस्, m., N. of an ocean or river with blue water. —नीलोपल (°ल-उप्°), अम्, n. a blue stone, lapis lazuli.
26340: नीलक, अस्, आ, अम्, blue, especially an epithet of the third unknown quantity or of its square; (अस्), m. the tree Terminalia Tomentosa (= अशन); a species of bee (?); a species of antelope, A. Picta; a dark-coloured horse; (इका), f. a species of rank-grow-ing aquatic plant; = शेफालिका, Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis; = नीली, the indigo plant; = नील-सिन्दुवार, a species of medicinal plant; a slight malady, black and blue marks on the body from bruises &c.; = नीलिका-काच; N. of a river; (अम्), n. black salt (= काच-लवण); blue steel; blue vitriol; [cf. कण्ठ-न्°, जीन-नीलिका।]
26341: नीलङ्गु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. लग्, to go, with नि), = नीलाङ्गु, a species of worm growing in the inside of animals; an insect in general; a large bee; a species of fly (= भ्रमराली or भम्भ-राली); a jackal; = प्र-सून or प्र-सूत, a bud (?).
26343: नीलाय, Nom. P. A. नीलायति, -ते, &c., to be-come blue or dark-coloured.
26344: नीलिका, see under नीलक, p. 513, col. 3. —नीलिका-काच, अस्, m. a disease of the lens or crystalline humor of the eye.
26345: नीलिनी, f. the indigo plant, Indigofera Tinctoria; a species with blue blossoms; N. of the wife of Aja-mīḍha.
26346: नीलिमन्, आ, m. blueness, blackness, darkness.
26347: नीव् नीव् [cf. rts. तीव्, पीव्, मीव्], cl. 1. P. नीवति, नीवितुम्, to become fat or cor-pulent.
26348: नीव नीव, अस्, m. a species of tree; [cf. नीप।]
26349: नीवन् नीवन्, आ, m., N. of one of the ten horses of the Moon.
26350: नीवर नीवर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. नी), trade, traffic; a trader; a religious mendicant; a place suitable for the site of a habitation; mud; (अम्), n. water.
26351: नीवाक नीवाक, अस्, m. (fr. नि-वच्), the increased demand for grain in times of dearth; dearth, scarcity.
26352: नीवार नीवार, अस्, m. rice growing wild or without cultivation; (आस्), m. pl. grains of wild rice; (आ), f., N. of a river.
26353: नीवारक, अस्, m. rice growing wild or without cultivation.
26354: नीवि नीवि, इस् and ई, f. (probably fr. rt. व्ये with नि), a cloth worn round a woman's waist or the ends of the cloth passed round the loins so as to hold the whole together; a petticoat; the tie or encircling band of a woman's drawers; the outer tie of a packet in which the offerings of a Śūdra at funeral obsequies are presented; capital, principal, stock; a stake at play, stake, wager. —नीवि-भार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be worn in an apron, &c.
26355: नीवृत नी-वृत्, त्, त्, त्, m. f. n. (fr. वृत् with नि), any inhabited country, a realm.
26356: नीव्र नीव्र, अम्, n. the edge of a thatch, the edge or side of a sloping roof; a thatch, a roof; a wood; the circumference of a wheel; the constel-lation Revatī; the moon; [cf. नीध्र।]
26357: नीशार नी-शार, अस्, m. (fr. शॄ with नि), a warm cloth or outer garment, a blanket; curtains, musquito curtains; an outer tent or screen.
26358: नीषह् नी-षह्, आट्, आट्, आट् (fr. सह् with नि), Ved. overpowering.
26359: नीहार नी-हार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हृ with नि?), fog, mist; frost, hoar-frost, heavy dew; evacuation. —नीहार-कर, अस्, m. ‘dew-maker’ or ‘cold-rayed,’ the moon.
26360: नीहाराय, Nom. A. नीहारायते, &c., to make frost.
26361: नु 1. नु, ind. (perhaps related to 1. नव; cf. नूतन), written नू in Ved. at the beginning of a verse and frequently in other places. (As an adverb of time in Ved.), now, still (e. g. नू-च पुरा-च, both now and heretofore; अस्ति स्विन् नु वीर्यं तत् -ते, hast thou still that power?). (As an inferential particle in Ved. often beginning the last sentence of a hymn), now therefore, now then, therefore, then (e. g. नू नो रास्व, do thou therefore give us): (as an introductory particle, or in encouraging, in-voking, inviting, summoning), now, then, pray, come then (e. g. अभि नु मा चक्षमीथाः, pray now [Sāy. quickly] have compassion upon me). नु is often employed in questions, both in Vedic and classical Sanskrit, to strengthen an interrogative pro-noun or adverb (e. g. कदा नु, when indeed? कथं नु, how indeed? क्व नु, where indeed? कं नु पृच्छामि, whom can I possibly ask? किं नु स्यात्, what can that possibly be? किं नु खलु, why in the world?). नु is also used inter-rogatively in classical Sanskrit, without an interro-gative pronoun, in sentences of two or more clauses (e. g. स्वप्नो नु माया नु मति-भ्रमो नु, was it a dream? or an illusion of magic? or a mental delusion?). नु also serves as a particle of affirma-tion, to express ‘indeed,’ ‘certainly,’ ‘surely’ (e. g. अहं नु अकार्षम्, Yes, I certainly did so), and often gives emphasis to the word it follows without being itself translateable, in which way it is frequently connected in the Veda with other particles (e. g. with चिद् in चिन् नु; with इद् in इन् नु; with अध in अध नु; with घ in घा नु, &c.); but in the Veda नु sometimes means ‘never’ (especially in the construction नू चित् = never, nevermore; in other passages it is said to = ‘from this time forward,’ ‘for ever’). In classical Sanskrit नु is sometimes found in connection with वा, ‘or;’ and in Rāmāyaṇa II. 72, 27, नु — नु may be translated ‘either’ — ‘or.’ According to native commentators on the Veda नु often = क्षिप्रम्, quickly. According to native lexicographers नु is used in the following senses: पृच्छा, विकल्प, वितर्क, अनुनय, अतीत, अप-मान, हेतु, अपदेश; [cf. नू-नम्, नू-तन; Zend नू, ‘just now;’ Gr. νύ, νῡ-νί, νῦν; Lat. num, nun-c; Goth. nu-h; Old Germ. nu; Slav. nyne, ‘at present.’]

Sax. naca; Bavarian naue, ‘a ship;’ Old Iceland. nau-st, ‘a ship station,’ Nōa-tūn; Hib. naoi, noi.] —नाव्-आकार, अस्, आ, अम्, boat-shaped, cymbiform. —नाव्-आरोह, अस्, m. a passenger on board ship, a sailor. —नौ-कर्णधार, अस्, m. the steersman of a ship, a helmsman, pilot. —नौ-कर्णी, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda. —नौ-कर्मन्, अ, n. ‘boat-business,’ the occupation or business of a sailor. —नौ-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, going in a ship, a sailor. —नौ-जीविक, अस्, m. ‘living in ships or boats,’ a sailor, boatman. —नौ-तार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘passable in a boat,’ navigable, to be traversed in a vessel. —नौ-दण्ड, अस्, m. ‘boat-pole,’ an oar. —नौ-बन्धन, अम्, n. ‘ship-binding,’ N. of the highest peak of the Himālayas to which in the great flood Manu fastened his ship. —नौ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to be a ship, to have been made a ship. —नौ-यान, अम्, n. going in a ship, navigation. —नौ-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a boat or vessel, a passenger; freight. —नौ-वाह, अस्, m. ‘ship-conductor,’ a steersman, pilot, captain. —नौ-व्यसन, अम्, n. ship-wreck, naufrage.

26567: नौधस नौधस, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.

26570: न्यच्छ न्यच्छ, अम्, n. a mole or spot upon the body.
26571: न्यञ्च् 1. न्य्-अञ्च्, cl. 1. P. A. -अचति or -अञ्-चति, -अञ्चितुम्, Ved. to bend down, curve down.
26572: न्यक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make low, lower, humble, humiliate, degrade, treat with dis-respect or contempt, slight. —न्यक्-करण, अम्, n. the act of lowering or degrading, treating with disrespect or contempt. —न्यक्-कार, अस्, m. making low, humiliation, humbling, contempt, disregard, dis-respect. —न्यक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, humbled, treated with contempt or contumely.
26573: न्य्-अक्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bent down. —न्यक्-नाङ्गुलि (°न-अङ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having the fingers bent.
26574: न्य्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. rt. अक्ष्, which may be connected with rt. अच् = अञ्च्], low, inferior; whole, entire; (अस्), m. a buffalo; an epithet of Paraśu-rāma; (अम्), n. the whole; grass.
26575: न्यग्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to become low or humble, to humble one's self: Caus. न्यग्-भाव-यति, to cause to become low, humiliate, treat with disrespect. —न्यग्-भाव, अस्, m. humiliation, degra-dation, debasement, contempt. —न्यग्-भावन, अम्, n. humbling, degrading, treating with contempt, defiling. —न्यग्-भावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who lowers or humbles; humbling.
26576: न्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. a particular part of a carriage.
26577: न्य्-अङ्कु, उस्, m. a deer, an antelope; N. of a Muni; of a Cakra-vartin. —न्यङ्कु-भूरुह, अस्, m. the tree Calosanthes Indica. —न्यङ्कु-शिरस्, scil. ककुभ्, a sort of metre consisting of 11 + 12 + 4 syllables. —न्यङ्कु-सारिणी, f., scil. बृहती, f. a sort of metre, also called उरो-बृहती, consisting of 8 + 12 + 8 + 8 syllables.
26578: 2. न्य्-अञ्च्, न्यङ्, नीची, न्यक् [cf. नीच, p. 512], going downwards, turned or directed downwards, bent down; lying on the face; low, vile, contemptible, base; whole, entire; slow, lazy; नीचा, inst. c. on the ground, (see p. 512, col. 1); (न्यक्), ind. downwards, down, humbly. —न्यग्-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of a low or inferior race, low born. —न्यग्-रोध, अस्, m. (= न्यक्-रोह, growing downwards), the Indian fig-tree, Ficus Indica; another tree [cf. शमी]; a fathom, measured by the arms extended; N. of a son of Ugra-sena; of a Brāhman, of a monastery, of a village; (ई or आ), f. Salvinia Cucculata; a medicinal plant (commonly Mohānā). —न्यग्रोध-परिमण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, being a fathom in circumference; (आ), f. an elegant woman. —न्यग्रोध-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a man.
26579: न्य्-अञ्चन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. taking on one's lap; (ई), f. the lap; (अम्), n. a curve; a hollow, recess; a hiding-place.
26580: न्य्-अञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast down, bent down.
26581: न्यञ्ज् न्य्-अञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -अनक्ति (Ved. also A. -अङ्क्ते), -अञ्जितुम् or -अङ्क्तुम्, to anoint, be-smear; (A.) to creep in, to conceal or hide one's self.
26582: न्य्-अक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, anointed, smeared; mixed up.
26583: न्य्-अङ्ग, अस्, m. a mark, sign; sort, kind (e. g. अवभृथ-न्यङ्ग, a sort of Avabhṛtha); (अम्), n. low abuse (?).
26584: न्यञ्जलिका न्य्-अञ्जलिका, f. an Añjali which is directed downwards.
26585: न्यन्त न्य्-अन्त, m. n. (?), proximity; (एन), ind., Ved. near, near to.
26586: न्यय न्य्-अय, अस्, m. (fr. 3. नी, i. e. rt. 5. इ with नि), destruction, loss, waste.
26587: न्य्-अयन, अम्, n., Ved. entrance or receptacle.
26588: न्यर्ण न्य्-अर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अर्द् or rt. 4. ऋ with नि), dissolved (Ved.); injured; asked, solicited (?); gone (?).
26589: न्यर्थ न्य्-अर्थ, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 4. ऋ with नि), Ved. destruction, annihilation; (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 18, 9) not going in the usual course.
26590: न्यर्पय न्य्-अर्पय, Caus. of न्य्-ऋ, q. v.
26591: न्यर्बुद न्य्-अर्बुद, अम्, n., Ved. one hundred millions.
26592: न्यर्बुदि न्य्-अर्बुदि, इस्, m., N. of a divine being described as taking an active part in war.
26593: न्यवग्रह न्य्-अवग्रह, अस्, m. the accentless vowel at the end of a Pūrva-pada.
26594: न्यवचर् न्य्-अव-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -च-रितुम्, to enter into, penetrate.
26595: न्यस् न्य्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to throw down, cast down, lay down, set or put down (with loc., e. g. भूमौ, on the ground); to lay down, resign, give up (e. g. जीवितं न्य्-अस्, to lay down one's life); to bring forward, adduce, pro-pound (as an argument &c.); to lay or put down or place upon anything (with loc., e. g. चित्रे न्य्-अस्, to place in a picture, paint, depict; पथि न्य्-अस्, to lay down on the road, give up an occupation, &c.; शिरस्य् आज्ञां न्य्-अस्, to place a command on one's head, i. e. receive a command with due reverence; शापम् मयि न्यस्यति, he lays a curse upon me); to put in, place within (with loc.), to deposit with any one (loc.); to give into any one's keeping, make a de-posit, intrust, deliver, consign, commit; to settle, fix, appoint; to support: Caus. न्य्-आसयति, to cause to put or lay down, &c.
26596: न्य्-असन, अम्, n. casting or laying down, de-positing; delivering, giving up.
26597: न्य्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast down, laid down, placed in or upon, put in, inserted, applied; delivered, deposited, consigned; depicted (e. g. चित्र-न्यस्त, committed to a picture, painted); rested on, leaning, resting; given up, resigned, set aside. —न्यस्त-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘laying down the rod,’ giving up all means of punishment. —न्यस्त-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has laid down the body, dead. —न्यस्त-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has laid down or resigned his weapons, laying down arms; unarmed, defenceless; harmless; epithet of the Manes or deified progenitors.
26598: 1. न्य्-अस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited; to be ap-pointed to any office (with loc.); to be delivered.
26599: 2. न्य्-अस्य, ind. having put down, having laid down, having deposited, having given up, &c.
26600: न्य्-आस, अस्, m. putting down, placing, settling, planting or putting down (the feet), stepping, a step; depositing; a deposit, pledge; delivering, intrusting, committing, delivery; putting on colour &c., painting; writing down, writing, impress, stamp, mark; giving up, putting off or away, laying aside; deserting, abandoning; lowering the tone of the voice; bringing forward, adducing; striking or digging in (the claws &c.), seizing (with the claws); con-signing or intrusting anything to the mind; mental appropriation or assignment of various parts of the body to tutelary divinities (accompanied with certain prayers and gesticulations); N. of a commentary on the Kāśikā-vṛtti by Jinendra. —न्यास-धारिन्, ई, m. the holder of a deposit, a mortgagee. —न्यासा-पह्नव (°स-अप्°), अस्, m. repudiation of a deposit. —न्यासी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make a deposit, deposit anything with a person. —न्यासोद्द्योत (°स-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a grammatical work.
26601: न्य्-आसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has abandoned all worldly concerns; (ई), m. a Sannyāsī.
26602: न्यह्न न्य्-अह्न (?), Ved. the closing day.
26603: न्याकृ न्य्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to keep back, hold back.
26604: न्याक्य न्याक्य, अम्, n. fried rice.
26605: न्याग्रोधमूल न्याग्रोधमूल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. न्यग्रोध-मूल), being or situated at the roots of the Ficus Indica.
26606: न्याद न्याद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अद् with नि), eating, feeding.
26607: न्याधा न्य्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. -दधाति, -धा-तुम्, to fix in, place in, appoint; to put down.
26608: न्याय न्य्-आय, अस्, m. (fr. 3. नी, i. e. rt. 5. इ with नि), method, way, rule (lit. that to which any-thing goes back or in which anything goes), model, manner, system, plan, doctrine, right or fit or suitable manner, that which is fitting, fitness, propriety, right, justice, virtue, equity, law, a lawful act; (in gram.) a general or universal rule, an axiom which precedes and must be kept in view in the explanation of special rules; a lawsuit, policy, good government; decision in a lawsuit, judicial sentence, judgment; a celebrated system of Hindū philosophy delivered by Gautama or Gotama in a set of aphorisms divided into five lectures; the proper way of stating an argu-ment, logic, logical philosophy; a logical argument, a complete argument or syllogism (consisting of five members with the Naiyāyikas, viz. प्रतिज्ञा, हेतु, उदाहरण, उपनय, निगमन, and of three members with the Vedāntins); likeness, analogy, apposite illustration; न्यायेन, in the way of, after the manner of (e. g. लीला-न्यायेन, by way of sport, as if in sport; cf. न्याय-तस् below). Placed after a finite verb न्यायम् is said by Pāṇini (VIII. 1, 27, 57) to express either censure or repetition. —न्याय-कल्पलतिका, f., N. of a commentary. —न्याय-कुसु-माञ्जलि, इस्, m., N. of the aphorisms of Udayana; [cf. कुसुमाञ्जलि।] —न्याय-कोकिल (?), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist teacher. —न्याय-कौस्तुभ, अम्, n., N. of a general work on the Nyāya philosophy. —न्याय-चूडा-मणि, N. of a confuta-tion of the Nyāya system of philosophy in favour of the Vedānta by Mādhava Sarasvatī. —न्याय-चूडामणि-प्रभा, f., N. of a commentary on the preceding work by Caṇḍīśvara. —न्याय-तस्, ind. in a fitting manner, as is fitting; suitably, justly, fitly, according to right or justice. —न्याय-ता, f. or न्याय-त्व, अम्, n. fitness, propriety. —न्याय-द्वार-तार-क-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work. —न्याय-पञ्चानन, अस्, m. an epithet of Jaya-rāma; of Dīkṣita-śrī-kaṇṭha-śarman. —न्याय-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, prescribed by rule. —न्याय-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the philosophical system of the Nyāya school; logic (as connected with this school). —न्याय-सङ्क्षेप, अस्, m. or न्याय-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. or न्याय-सार, अस् or अम्, m. or n., N. of certain compendious works on the Nyāya philosophy. —न्याय-सारिणी, f. right or fit behaviour; a woman acting or judging rightly. —न्याय-सिद्-धान्त-पञ्चानन, अस्, m. an epithet of Viśva-nātha. —न्यायसिद्धान्त-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a work. —न्याय-सूत्र, अम्, n. the aphorisms of the Nyāya philosophy by Gautama. —न्यायाचार (°य-आच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, acting justly, virtuous. —न्याया-धार (°य-आध्°), अस्, m. ‘receptacle of justice,’ a term applied to any one who is a model of virtue or propriety. —न्यायानुसार-शास्त्र (°य-अन्°), अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work. —न्यायामृत (°य-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar of Nyāya,’ N. of a Vedānta work by Vyāsa Tīrtha Bindu. —न्यायामृत-त-रङ्गिनी, f., N. of a commentary on the Nyāyāmṛta by Rāma Ācārya. —न्यायार्जित (°य-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, obtained in a regular way. —न्यायालङ्कार-भट्ट (°य-अल्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Śrī-govinda; 26609: न्यायिन्, ई, इनी, ई, right, fit; logical, rational.
26610: न्याय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, regular, proper, just, right, equitable, fit, suitable, adapted, (sometimes giving a passive sense to the infin.); usual, customary. —न्याय्-य-त्व, अम्, n. fitness, suitableness, propriety.
26611: न्याव्यध् न्य्-आ-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to cause to burst forth, let loose, set free.
26612: न्यास न्य्-आस। See under न्य्-अस्, col. 1.
26613: न्युङ्ख न्युङ्ख, अस्, m. a kind of Sāman, the sixfold repetition of the triliteral name of God or ॐ, [cf. न्यूङ्ख]; (अस्, आ, अम्), proper, right; pleasing, agreeable.

26615: न्य्-ओचनी, f., Ved. (probably) a kind of woman's ornament; (Sāy.) a female servant or slave.
26616: न्य्-ओचर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) belonging to or fit for a place.
26617: न्युत्त न्य्-उत्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. उद् or उन्द् with नि), dipped in, sprinkled.
26618: न्युप्त न्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-वप्, q. v.), offered, presented (to the Manes of deceased ancestors).
26619: न्य्-उप्य, ind. having offered, having presented (cakes &c. to the Manes).
26620: न्युब्ज् न्य्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, &c., to bend down, press down, throw down.
26621: न्य्-उब्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or bent downwards, lying on the face or with the face downwards; looking downwards; bent, crooked; hump-backed, crooked-backed (as the result of disease); convex; (अस्), m. the Nyag-rodha tree; a sort of ladle made of Kuśa grass; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Averrhoa Carambola; a vessel used at Śrāddhas. —न्युब्ज-खड्ग, अस्, m. a crooked sword, a sabre.
26622: न्युष् न्य्-उष् [cf. rt. 1. उष्], cl. 1. P. -ओषति, &c., Ved. to burn down; (Sāy.) to consume utterly.
26623: न्यूङ्ख न्यूङ्ख, अस्, m. the insertion of the sound ओ in different places with variety of prosodial length and accentuation in the recitation of hymns, (this sound may be repeated any number of times in the recitation of Mantras, or may be made long, short, or prolated, or may have different accents.)
26624: न्यूङ्खय, Nom. P. न्यूङ्खयति, -यितुम्, to insert the Nyūṅkha, (occurring in fut. pass. part. न्यूङ्खनीय and न्यूङ्ख्य); (A. -ते), to make a peculiar sound, to growl.
26625: न्यून न्य्-ऊन, अस्, आ, अम् (see ऊन), lessened, diminished, shortened, made smaller, less, inferior, deficient, defective, wanting, destitute, deprived of (e. g. अर्थ-न्यून, deprived of property, destitute of wealth); imperfect or defective in some organ (e. g. पाद-न्यून, having a defect in the feet); low, vile, wicked, despicable, blamable; (अम्), ind. less; (अम्), n. an euphemistic expression for the vulva. —न्यून-ता, f. or न्यून-त्व, अम्, n. inferiority, deficiency, incompleteness. —न्यून-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, deficient in intellect, ignorant, foolish. —न्यून-पञ्चाशद्-भाव, अस्, n. ‘having but forty-nine properties of human nature,’ an idiot. —न्यूनाक्षर (°न-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, defective in letters or syllables. —न्यू-नाङ्ग (°न-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, defective in a limb or organ, maimed, mutilated, imperfect. —न्यूनाधिक (°न-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, less or more, unequal. —न्यू-नाधिक-विभाग, अस्, m. unequal partition. —न्यू-नेन्द्रिय (°न-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wanting some organ or sense, deficient, imperfect (as blind, deaf, &c.).
26626: न्यूनय, Nom. P. न्यूनयति, -यितुम्, or न्यूनी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to lessen, diminish, make less.
26627: न्यूह् न्य्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 2. ऊह्], cl. 1. A. -ओहते or -ऊहते, Ved. to attend to, observe; (Sāy.) to bear up or support completely, (as if fr. rt. 1. ऊह्।)
26628: न्यृ न्य्-ऋ [cf. rt. 4. ऋ], cl. 5. P. -ऋणोति or -ऋण्वति, &c., Ved. to put or place in; to infuse: Caus. न्य्-अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to throw down, cast down, overthrow.
26629: न्यृञ्ज् न्य्-ऋञ्ज् [cf. rt. 2. ऋञ्ज्], cl. 6. A. -ऋञ्जते, &c., Ved. to reach, attain, gain, obtain, win; (Sāy.) to propitiate, befriend.
26630: न्यृष् न्य्-ऋष् [cf. rt. 2. ऋष्], cl. 6. P. -ऋषति, &c., Ved. to press down or under, suppress, hide, cover; to put in; (Sāy.) to attain to.
26631: न्य्-ऋष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed under; (Sāy.) attained to, gained, endowed.
26632: न्ये न्य्-ए (= न्य्-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. न्य्-ऐति, &c., Ved. to come or fall into.
26633: न्योकस् न्य्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. belonging to home or one's native country, domestic, home-bred; (Sāy.) dwelling in an eternal mansion, having an eternal abode.
26635: न्योजस् न्य्-ओजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, powerful.
26637: न्वै न्वै for नु-वै, ind., Ved. indeed, really, certainly.
26638: प 1. प, the twenty-first consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and the first letter of the fifth or labial class, having the sound of the English प्। —प-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound प. —प-वर्ग, अस्, m. ‘the प् series,’ the labial series of consonants.
26639: प 2. प, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पा), (at the end of a comp.), drinking; [cf. अनेक-प, आज्य-प, क्षीर-प, &c.]
26640: प 3. प, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 3. पा), (at the end of a comp.), guarding, protecting, ruling; (आ), f. guarding, protection.
26641: प 4. प, अस्, m. air, wind; a leaf; an egg.
26642: पंश् पंश् or पंस्, cl. 1. and 10. P. पंशति, पंसति, पंशयति, पंसयति, &c., to destroy.
26643: पकथ पकथ, अस्, m., N. of a man with the patronymic Saubhara.
26644: पक्कटी पक्कटी, f. the tree Thespesia Po-pulnea.
26645: पक्कण पक्कण, अस्, m. the hut of a Cāṇḍāla or of any outcast, the abode of a savage or barbarian; (incorrectly read पक्वण; cf. पक्वश।)
26646: पक्तपौड पक्तपौड, अस्, m. a species of plant (= पञ्च-कृत्य, पञ्च-रक्षक, वर्-धन; in Hindī = pakhauḍā).
26647: पक्तव्य पक्तव्य। See rt. 2. पच्, p. 521.
26648: पक्ति पक्ति, पक्व। See rt. 2. पच्, p. 521.
26649: पक्वश पक्वश, अस्, m., N. of a barbarous tribe; a Cāṇḍāla; [cf. पुक्कश, पुक्वस, पक्कण।]
26650: पक्वापक्वा पक्वापक्वा, an onomatopoetic word imitative of the cry of birds.
26651: पक्ष् पक्ष् [cf. rt. 2. पश्], cl. 1. 10. P. पक्षति, पक्षयति, &c., to take, seize, accept; to take a part or side; [cf. Zend paś, ‘to bind:’ Gr. πήγ-νυ-μι, ἐ-πάγ-η-ν, πῆγ-μα, πηγ-ό-ς, πάγ-ο-ς, πάχ-νη, πάγ-η, πάσσ-αλο-ς: Lat. pac-i-sc-or, pāx, pac-i-o, pang-o, pig-nus, pā-lu-s: Goth. fah-an, ‘to catch:’ Mod. Germ. fang-en: Old Germ. fuog-a, ga-fuogi, ‘apt;’ gafag-yan, ‘to satisfy;’ fah, ‘a shelf:’ Bohem. pás, ‘a girdle;’ pas-mo, ‘yarn.’]
26652: पक्ष, अस्, m. (probably connected with the pre-ceding, but by some regarded as an unreduplicated Desid. form of an unused rt. पज्, fr. which पाजस्, ‘strength,’ may be derived; in Uṇādi-s. III. 69. पक्-ष is derived fr. rt. 1. पण्), a wing, pinion, (in this sense also अम्, n.); symbolical expression for the number two; a feather, the feathers on both sides of an arrow; the flank or side (of a man &c.), the shoulder; the side of anything (as of a house, car-riage, the head, hair, &c.); the wing or flank of an army, &c.; the half of anything; the half of a lunar month, a fortnight comprising fifteen days, (the half from new moon to full moon was called पूर्व or आपूर्यमाण, later शुक्ल or शुद्ध; the other half was called अपर or अप-क्षीयमाण, later कृष्ण or तामिस्र; and every half month is divided into fifteen Tithis, named प्रथमा, द्वितीया, &c.); a side, party, faction, a partisan, adherent, follower; a class, multitude, host, set, troop, number of adherents or friends (e. g. शत्रु-पक्ष, the enemy's side or [as an adj.] being on the enemy's side; महा-पक्ष, one who has many adherents; देव-पक्ष-वराः, the most distinguished adherents of the gods; पक्ष-सम्मत, approved by a certain set of people); one of two cases, one side of an argument, an alternative, (पक्षे, on the other alternative, on the other hand); a case in general, a supposition, (पक्षान्तरे, in the other case, on the other supposition); a thesis, a point under investi-gation or discussion, a position advanced or argument to be maintained; (in logic) the subject of a syl-logism or conclusion or inference; place, position; supposition, view, notion, idea, opinion (e. g. मु-ख्यः पक्षः, an excellent idea); state, condition; (in algebra) a primary division or the side of an equation in a primary division. According to the lexicographers the word has also the following mean-ings: the wall of a house; a wall; an army; favour; contradiction, opposition, rejoinder, reply; the ash-pit of a fire-place, a royal elephant; a limb or member of the body; the feathers of the tail of a peacock, a tail; proximity, neighbourhood; a brace-let; purity, perfection. In composition with words signifying ‘hair,’ पक्ष is said to mean ‘quantity;’ see केश-पक्ष; [cf. पूर्व-प्°, उत्तर-प्°, एक-प्°, काक-प्°, कृष्ण-प्°, &c.: cf. probably Gr. παξ in ἅπαξ; Goth. fug-ls, ‘a bird;’ Mod. Germ. Vogel; Lith. panksh-tis; perhaps Lat. passer for paxer.] —पक्ष-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, moving with or by means of wings, flying. —पक्ष-गुप्त, अस्, m. ‘wing-protected,’ a species of bird. —पक्ष-ग्र-हण, अम्, n. choosing a party. —पक्ष-ग्राह, अस्, आ, अम्, or पक्ष-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who chooses a party. —पक्ष-घात = पक्षाघात, q. v. —पक्ष-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, a Tri-śālaka having no hall towards the west. —पक्षङ्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, moving by means of wings, flying. —पक्ष-चर, अस्, m. an elephant strayed from the herd; the moon; an attendant, a constant companion. —पक्ष-च्छिद्, त्, m. ‘cutter of the wings’ (of the mountains), an epithet of Indra. —पक्ष-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, or पक्ष-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, produced in a fortnight; (अस् or आ), m. the moon. —पक्ष-ता, f. or पक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. partisanship, alliance; adherence to a party; the being a part of; the taking up a side or argu-ment; maintaining or defending a thesis; the essential nature of a proposition; the being the subject of a syllogism. —पक्ष-द्वय, अम्, n. both sides of an argument, &c.; a month (two fortnights). —पक्-ष-द्वार, अम्, n. a side door, an inner or back door, a private entrance. —पक्ष-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, having a side or wing, winged; taking the side or adhering to the party of any one (gen.); belonging to any party or faction, siding with any one (gen.); (अस्), m. a bird; a partisan, adherent; the moon; an elephant that has strayed from the herd. —पक्ष-नाडी, f. a quill. —पक्ष-पात, अस्, m. ‘falling of the feathers,’ the moulting of birds (considered to proceed from fever); the act of taking the side or adhering to the party of any one (gen.); siding with any one (gen.); adopting a side or argument whether right or wrong, attachment to a party, partisanship, partiality for (with loc. or gen.); a partisan, adherent. —पक्षपात-कृत-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, manifesting party attachment, sympathising. —पक्षपाति-ता, f. or पक्षपाति-त्व, अम्, n. partisanship, adherence to a side or party, partiality, friendship, fellowship, faction, factiousness. —पक्ष-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking the side or adhering to the party (of any one), siding with, favouring a party; (ई), m. a partisan, friend, adherent, follower. —पक्-ष-पालि, इस्, m. a private or back door. —पक्ष-पुट, अस्, m. a wing. —पक्ष-पोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, fostering or favouring a party, factious. —पक्-ष-प्रद्योत, अम्, n., N. of a peculiar position of the hands in dancing. —पक्ष-बल, अम्, n. strength of wing. —पक्ष-भाग, अस्, m. the side or flank, especially the flank of an elephant. —पक्ष-भुक्ति, इस्, f. the course traversed by the sun in a fortnight. —पक्ष-भेद, अस्, m. distinction between two sides of an argument; the difference between the two halves of a lunar month. —पक्ष-मूल, अम्, n. the root or articulation of a wing. —पक्ष-रचना, f. forming a party or faction. —पक्ष-वञ्चितक, अस्, m. a peculiar position of the hands in dancing. —पक्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, winged; having flanks; having a side or party, firmly adhering to or having a predilection for any one; belonging to a good family, of good extraction (?). —पक्ष-वाद, अस्, m. expression of opinion, stating a case; ex parte statement. —पक्ष-वाहन, अस्, m. ‘whose vehicles are wings,’ a bird. —पक्ष-विन्दु, उस्, m., ‘wing-spot,’ a heron. —पक्ष-व्यापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, em-bracing the whole of an argument or thesis. —पक्-ष-शस्, ind. by or for half months or fortnights. —पक्ष-सुन्दर, अस्, m. a species of tree; [cf. लोध्र।] —पक्ष-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, paralysed on one side. —पक्ष-हर, अस्, m. a bird; (perhaps a wrong reading for पक्ष-धर, ‘possessing wings.’) —पक्ष-होम, अस्, m. (probably) an obla-tion to be offered every half month. —पक्षाकार (°ष-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wing-shaped. —पक्षा-घात (°ष-आघ्°), अस्, m. ‘side-stroke,’ paralysis or palsy of one side, hemiplegia; refutation of an argument or view. —पक्षान्त (°ष-अन्°), अस्, m. the fifteenth and last day of either half month, new or full moon; the end of the wings of an army arranged in the shape of a bird. —पक्षान्तर (°ष-अन्°), अम्, n. another side or part, another or different view of an argument, another supposition. —पक्षाभास (°ष-आभ्°), अस्, m. a seeming or fallacious argu-ment, a fallacy, a false plaint. —पक्षावसर (°ष-अव्°), अस्, m. the last day of either half month, day of new or full moon. —पक्षाहति (°ष-आह्°), इस्, f. a stroke with the wings. —पक्-षाहार (°ष-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who eats food only once in a half month. —पक्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make anything the subject of an argument or syllogism. —पक्षोद्-ग्राहिन् (°ष-उद्°), ई, इणी, इ, showing partiality, taking a side or adopting a party.
26653: पक्षक, अस्, m. a side door, a private or back door; a side; a sidesman; an associate, a confederate or partisan, (at the end of comps. used for पक्ष।)
26654: पक्षति, इस्, f. the root or insertion of a wing, the pit of a bird's wing; the first day of the half month.
26655: पक्षस्, अस्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पच्), a wing; the side part of a carriage; the leaf of a door; the wing of an army; a half, a division; a half month; the side or shore of a river; a side.
26656: पक्षालिका, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
26658: पक्षि, इस्, m. (curtailed form for पक्षिन्), a bird.
26659: पक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, winged, (figuratively) furnished with wings; taking the side or adhering to the party (of any one); siding with; (ई), m. a day with the two nights enclosing it; the bird Garuḍa as one of the eighteen attendants of the Sun; an arrow; an epithet of Śiva; (ई, इणी), m. f. a bird; (इणी), f. (with or without रात्रि) a night with the two days enclosing it; the day of full moon; N. of a Śākinī; [cf. Lith. pauksh-tis, ‘a bird;’ Goth. fug-ls, ‘a bird;’ Angl. Sax. fug-ul; Mod. Germ. Vogel; probably Lat. passer for paxer.] —पक्षि-कीट, अस्, m. ‘bird-insect,’ an insect-like bird, an insignificant species of bird. —पक्षि-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place. —पक्षि-पति, इस्, m. ‘the prince of birds,’ an epithet of Sampāti. —पक्षिपानीय-शालिका, f. a trough or reservoir for watering birds, cattle, &c. —पक्षि-पुङ्गव, अस्, m. ‘a bull among the birds,’ an epithet of Jaṭāyu. —पक्षि-प्रवर, अस्, m. ‘the most excellent among the birds,’ an epithet of Garuḍa. —पक्षि-बालक, अस्, m. a young bird. —पक्षि-मृग-ता, f. (fr. पक्षिन् and मृग), the form or condition of a bird or of a beast. —पक्षि-राज्, ट्, or पक्षि-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the birds,’ an epithet of Garuḍa or of Jaṭāyu. —पक्-षि-राज्य, अम्, n. the sovereignty of the feathered tribes. —पक्षि-शाला, f. ‘bird-house,’ an aviary, a nest. —पक्षि-शावक, अस्, m. a young bird. —पक्षि-सिंह, अस्, m. ‘lion among the birds,’ an epithet of Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of Viṣṇu. —पक्षि-स्वामिन्, ई, m. ‘lord or master of the birds,’ an epithet of Garuḍa. —पक्षीन्द्र (°षि-इन्°), अस्, m. ‘prince of the birds,’ an epithet of Garuḍa.
26660: पक्षिल, अस्, m. (with स्वामिन्) an epithet of the saint Vātsyāyana. —पक्षिल-स्वामिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Vātsyāyana who is identified with Cāṇakya.
26661: पक्षीय, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of a comp.), belonging to a side, siding with, taking the side or adhering to the party of any one.
26662: पक्ष्मन्, अ, n. an eyelash; the filament of a flower; the point of a thread, a thin thread; the leaf of a flower; a wing; a whisker. —पक्ष्म-कोप or पक्ष्म-प्रकोप, अस्, m. irritation pro-duced in the eye by the eyelashes turning inwards (Entropium). —पक्ष्माक्ष (°म-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, having an eyelash or eyelashes in the eye (suffering from Entropium).
26663: पक्ष्मल, अस्, आ, अम्, having strong or long eyelashes; having long or thick hair, hairy, shaggy.
26664: पक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. descended from Pakṣa (i. e. according to Sāy. the Sun); changing every half month; produced or occurring in a fortnight; be-longing to a side, siding with, taking part with; lateral.
26667: पङ्क पङ्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पच् or पञ्च्), mud, mire, dirt, clay; a slough, a quagmire; ointment, unguent; moral impurity, sin; [cf. निष्-पङ्क, नील-प्°।] —पङ्क-कर्वट, अस्, m. soft mud, especially such as is left by the retiring of floods or on the banks of a river, alluvium, a marsh, a quagmire. —पङ्क-कीर, अस्, m. an aquatic bird, a lap-wing. —पङ्क-क्रीड, अस्, आ, अम्, wallowing or sporting in mud; (अस्), m. a pig; (also पङ्क-क्रीडनक, अस्, m.) —पङ्क-गडक, अस्, m. or पङ्क-गति, इस्, f. a small fish, Macrognathus Pan-calus. —पङ्क-ग्राह, अस्, m. the marine monster Makara, q. v. —पङ्क-च्छिद्, त्, m. ‘mud-destroyer,’ Strychnos Potatorum (the fruit of which is used for purifying foul water). —पङ्क-ज, अम्, n. ‘mud-born,’ a species of lotus, Nelumbium Speciosum (or rather its flower which closes in the evening); (अस्), m. an epithet of Brahmā, (incorrect for पङ्कज-ज, ‘lotus-born’); (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā. —पङ्कज-जन्मन्, आ, m. ‘sprung from a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā. —पङ्कज-नाभ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having a lotus springing from his navel,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —पङ्क-जन्मन्, अ, n. = पङ्क-ज. —पङ्कज-पत्त्र, अम्, n. the leaf of a lotus. —पङ्कजपत्त्र-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes like lotus-leaves. —पङ्कजावली (°ज-आव्°), f. a particular metre; [cf. पङ्कावली।] —पङ्क-जित्, त्, m., N. of a son of Garuḍa. —पङ्कजिनी, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पच् or पञ्च्), N. of a warrior-tribe and their country in the north of India; (अस्), m. a prince of the Pañcālas; N. of a man brought by Viśvak-sena to the childless Gaṇḍūṣa; N. of a Nāga-rāja; a particular venomous insect; (अस्, अम्), m. n., N. of a metre consisting of twelve syllables; (ई), f. a doll, puppet; a style of singing; a chequered cloth for playing at draughts &c. —पञ्चाल-चण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a teacher. —पञ्चाल-पद-वृट्टि, इस्, f., N. of a particular rhythm. —पञ्चाल-राज, अस्, or पञ्चाल-राजन्, आ, m. a king of Pañcāla.
26740: पञ्चालक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the Pañcālas; (आस्), m. pl. the Pañcālas; (अस्), m. a species of venomous insect; (इका), f. a doll, a puppet; a kind of song.
26741: पञ्छीहिल पञ्छीहिल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
26742: पञ्ज् पञ्ज्, a Sautra root occurring in grammatical Sūtras only, but not in the Dhātu-pāṭha, said to have the sense of ‘enclosing,’ and artificially formed on account of पञ्जर below.

26744: पञ्जरक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a cage, an aviary; (इका), f. peculiar prayers and formularies, (see under पञ्जर।)
26745: पञ्जक पञ्जक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
26746: पञ्जल पञ्जल, अस्, m. a species of bulbous plant (= कोल-कन्द).
26747: पञ्जि पञ्जि, इस्, ई, f. the ball or roll of cotton from which the thread is spun; an almanac, calendar; a journal; (perhaps) a register. —पञ्जी-कर, अस्, m. a Kāyastha or scribe; an almanac-maker.

26749: पट् पट्, cl. 1. P. पटति, पटितुम्, to go, move: Caus. or cl. 10. 26750: पट, अस्, अम्, m. n. 26751: पटक, अस्, m. cotton cloth; a camp, encamp-ment; the half of a village, (for पाटक।)

26753: पटरक, अस्, m. a species of plant (= गुन्द्र).

26755: पटलक (gender doubtful), a heap, &c. See पटल above.
26756: पटि, इस्, f. (for पटी, cf. पट), a kind of cloth; a species of aquatic plant (= कुम्भिका).
26758: पटच्चर पटच्चर, अस्, m. (probably fr. पटत् + चर, पट् being an imitative sound, per-haps of creeping stealthily), a thief, a robber [cf. पातच्चर]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अम्), n. old or ragged clothes.
26759: पटत् पटत्, ind. the sound पटत्।
26760: पटत्ककन्थ पटत्क-कन्थ, अम्, n., N. of a town, (Pāṇ. VI. 2, 125.)
26761: पटपटा पट-पटा, ind. an imitative sound.
26762: पटभाक्ष पटभाक्ष, अस्, m. an instru-ment for looking (at any object), an optical instru-ment.
26763: पटह पटह, अस्, अम्, m. n. (but com-monly m.; probably fr. पट + ह, rt. पन्), a kettle-drum, drum, war-drum, tabor; (अस्), m. be-ginning, undertaking; hurting, injuring, killing. —पटह-घोषक, अस्, m. a crier who beats a drum before making a proclamation. —पटह-ता, f. the noise or function of a drum. —पटह-ध्वनि, इस्, m. the sound of a drum; (इस्, इस्, इ), sounding like a drum. —पटह-भ्रमण, अम्, n. going about with a drum to call people together.
26764: पटाक पटाक, अस्, m. a bird [cf. पैटाक]; (आ), f. a flag, banner (= पताका).
26765: पटालुका पटालुका, f. a leech; [cf. जलुका।]
26767: पटिष्ठ पटिष्ठ, पटीयस्। See पटु below.
26768: पटिस पटिस, अस्, m. (incorrect for पट्-टिश?), a sort of weapon.
26769: पटीर पटीर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पट्), a ball for playing with; the god of love; sandal-wood; (अम्), n. Catechu (= खदिर); the belly; anything that can be carried off or taken away (= हरणीय); a sieve; height; a radish; a field; a cloud; bamboo manna; rheumatism; catarrh.
26770: पटु पटु, उस्, उस् or वी, उ (said to be fr. rt. पट्), sharp, pointed (as a ray of light); clear, shrill, ringing, sharp-sounding, clear-sounding, crackling, rustling (said of sound); pungent, acid, hot; sharp, clever, smart, dexterous, skilful, crafty, sly, cunning; sensible, intellectual; busy, active, violent, strong, intense; harsh, hard, rough, fierce; hale, healthy; cruel, unmerciful, unfeeling; contumelious (as speech &c.); eloquent, loquacious, talkative [cf. वाक्-पटु]; blown, expanded; apt, disposed; (उस्), m. the tree Trichosanthes Diœca; the leaf of the Trichosanthes Diœca; the plant Momordica Charantia; a kind of perfume (= चोरक); N. of a man; (अवस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (उस्, उ), m. n. a mushroom; (उ), n. salt. —पटु-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, tolerably clever, pretty skilful. —पटु-जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, of a clever sort, pretty clever or skilful. —पटु-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more sharp, sharper, keener, clearer; more clever, &c. —पटु-ता, f. cleverness; elo-quence; [cf. वाक्-प्°।] —पटु-तृणक, अम्, n. a species of pungent grass. —पटु-त्व, अम्, n. sharp-ness, keenness (as of sight), cleverness, skilfulness, eloquence. —पटु-देशीय or पटु-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, tolerably sharp, almost clever, cleverish. —पटु-पत्त्रिका, f. a species of shrub (= क्षुद्र-चञ्चु)। —पटु-पर्णिका, f. a species of plant (= क्षीरिणी)। —पटु-पर्णी, f. Bryonia Grandis, a species of cucurbitaceous plant. —पटु-मत्, आन्, m., N. of a prince. —पटु-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince. —पटु-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, very clever.
26771: पटिमन्, आ, m. sharpness, &c. (Pāṇ. V. 1, 122, VI. 4, 155.)
26772: पटिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, very sharp or clever, sharpest, &c.
26773: पटीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, sharper, more clever.
26775: पटुश पटुश, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
26776: पटुस पटुस, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
26777: पटोल पटोल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पट्), a species of cucumber, commonly Palwal, Trichosanthes Diœca, = पटु; (अम्), n. the fruit of the above; a sort of cloth, a kind of chintz [cf. पट]; (ई), f. a small cucumber, either the same as above or another species, Luffa Acutangula (= कोशातकी).

26780: पट्ट पट्ट, अस्, m. 26782: पट्टि-कार, अस्, ई, m. f. a silk-weaver (?).
26784: पट्टिल, अस्, m. a species of plant (= पूतिक-रज), Cæsalpina Bonducella.

26787: पट्टन पट्टन, अम् and ई, n. f. a city; [cf. पत्तन; cf. also देव-पल्ली-प्°, धर्म-प्°।]
26788: पट्टला पट्टला, f. a district, a community.
26789: पट्टव पट्टव (probably for पट्ट-ज), a kind of cloth.
26790: पट्टार पट्टार, N. of a district.
26791: पट्टि पट्टि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (also spelt पत्ति।)
26792: पट्टिका पट्टिका। See under पट्टक above.
26793: पट्टिश पट्टिश, अस्, m. a sort of weapon, a kind of axe; a spear with a sharp edge.
26794: पट्टिशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a Paṭṭiśa.
26795: पट्टिस, अस्, m. a kind of weapon with three points.
26796: पट्टीश, अस्, m. (probably for पट्टिश), a kind of weapon used by Śiva; (in Hari-vaṃśa 10658, Śiva is called Triśūla-paṭṭīśa-dhara.)
26797: पट्टेरक पट्टेरक, the plant Cyperus Hex-astachyus Communis.
26798: पठ् पठ्, cl. 1. P. 26817: पण् 2. पण् (probably for original पर्ण् fr. rt. पर् or पॄ), cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) पणते, -ति, पेणे, पणिष्यते, अपणिष्ट, पणि-तुम्, to deal in, barter, purchase, buy; to negotiate, bargain, transact business (Ved.); to bet or stake at play (with gen. of the thing staked, e. g. शतस्य पणते, he stakes a hundred); to play for (with gen.); to stake anything or any person (acc.) on a game; to risk or hazard (a battle &c.); to win anything (inst.) from any one (acc.) at play; [cf. बणिज्: Gr. πέπνημι: Lith. pantas: Old Germ. feil; phant.]
26818: पण, अस्, m. play, gaming, playing with dice, playing for a stake; a game played for a stake, a bet, a wager, (पणं कृ, to make a bet); the thing staked or deposited; a sum played for; a compact, contract, agreement; stipulation, treaty; wages, hire; reward; expense of an expedition; a sum (reckoned in coins or shells); a weight of copper (Manu VII. 126); a particular coin (= twenty Māṣas = four Kākinīs); a particular measure; a handful of any-thing; a commodity for sale; price; wealth, pro-perty; business; a publican or distiller; a house, dwelling (?). —पण-काल, अस्, m. gaming-time, time for playing. —पण-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. a fair, market. —पण-ता, f. or पण-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of a pledge or stake; price, value. —पण-बन्ध, अस्, m. making a treaty, making peace, pacification. —पण-स्त्री, f. or पणाङ्गना (°ण-अङ्°), f. a venal woman, a prostitute, harlot. —पणार्पण (°ण-अर्°), अम्, n. making an agreement, engagement, contract. —पणार्ह (°ण-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be laid as a wager. —प-णास्थि (°ण-अस्°), इ, n. Cypræa Moneta, the small shell used as a die and as a coin, a cowrie.
26819: पणन, अम्, n. the act of bartering, purchasing; traffic; sale, selling; betting.
26820: पणनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laid as a wager, negotiable.
26821: पणस, अस्, m. a commodity, an article of sale or commerce (= पनस, q. v.).
26822: पणाया, f. (probably an incorrect form), business, affair, transaction, buying and selling, &c.; profits and receipts of trade; a market-place.
26823: पणि, इस्, m. (lit. ‘a negotiator or tradesman, one who barters and traffics’), a miser, a niggard; one who is sparing of sacrificial oblations; an impious man who gives nothing to the gods, a Śūdra sacrificing priest; N. of a class of envious demons watching over treasures, (they are defeated by the gods and the Aṅgirasas; sometimes the word पणि is only an epithet of the Asuras who are supposed to steal cows and hide them in mountain-caverns.)
26824: पणिक, अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of an adj. comp. (e. g. पञ्चाशत्-पणिक, [a fine] consisting of fifty Paṇas).
26825: पणित, अस्, आ, अम्, transacted as business; betted; (अम्), n. a bet, wager, stake.
26826: पणितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bought, vendible, fit or intended for sale; to be transacted, negotiable.
26827: पणितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who transacts business or traffics or sells; (ता), m. a trader, dealer.
26828: पण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sold, saleable, vendible; to be transacted as business; (अम्), n. an article of trade, a ware, commodity; trade, traffic, business; (आ), f. heart-pea, Cardiospermum Halicacabum; [cf. पिण्या।] —पण्य-ता, f. saleableness, the being an article of trade. —पण्यन्-ध or पण्यन्-धा, a species of grass, Panicum Verticillatum. —पण्य-पति, इस्, m. a possessor of many wares, a great merchant, large trader. —पण्यपति-त्व, अम्, n. the state or con-dition of a great merchant. —पण्य-फल-त्व, अम्, n. prosperity or profit in trade. —पण्य-भूमि, इस्, f. a place where goods are stored, a warehouse. —पण्य-मूल्य, अम्, n. the price of a commodity. —पण्य-योषित्, त्, f. a venal woman, prostitute, wanton woman, courtezan, harlot, whore. —पण्य-विक्रय-शाला, f. a place for buying and selling, a market-place, bazar. —पण्य-विक्रयिन्, ई, m. a seller of goods, a trader, merchant. —पण्य-विला-सिनी, f. a venal woman, a harlot; a kind of fragrant substance, the claw of an animal or something similar. —पण्य-वीथिका, f. or पण्य-वीथी, f. a place of sale, market; a stall, shop. —पण्य-शाला, f. a market, bazar, shop, a warehouse. —पण्य-स्त्री, f. or पण्याङ्गना (°य-अङ्°), f. a venal woman, harlot, courtezan, prostitute. —पण्याजिर (°य-अज्°), अम्, n. a market. —पण्याजीव (°य-आज्°), अस्, m. a trader, tradesman; (अम्), n. a market, fair (?). —पण्-याजीवक (°य-आज्°), अम्, n. a market; (also, accord-ing to some, पण्य-जीवक।) —पण्यान्-धा, f. = पण्यन्-धा, q. v. —पण्यार्ह (°य-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, fit for sale, saleable, vendible.
26829: पणफर पणफर, अम्, n. (fr. ἐπαναφορά), the house following upon a Kendra, q. v. (in astrol.).
26830: पणव पणव, अस्, m. (probably for प्र-णव), a sort of musical instrument, a small drum or tabor or a kind of cymbal, one used to accompany singing; also (आ), f. a kind of metre consisting of four lines of ten or five syllables each.
26831: पणविन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing a drum; (ई), m. an epithet of Śiva.
26832: पण्ड् पण्ड्, cl. 1. A. पण्डते, to go, move; cl. 10. P. पण्डयति, &c., to collect, heap together, pile up; cl. 1. P. पण्डति; cl. 10. P. पण्डयति, to destroy, annihilate.
26833: पण्ड, अस्, or पण्डु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. पण्), a eunuch, impotent man [cf. पण्ड्र, षण्ड]; (आ), f. wisdom, intelligence, understanding; science, learning. —पण्डापूर्व (°ड-अप्°), अम्, n. non-occurrence of the results of fate or destiny (?).
26834: पण्डक or पण्डग, अस्, m. (probably fr. पण्-ड्रक), a eunuch; N. of one of the sons of the third Manu Sāvarṇa.
26835: पण्डित, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. पण्डा], learned, wise; shrewd, skilled, clever, educated; (अस्), m. a scholar, learned or wise man, learned Brāhman, teacher, phi-losopher, Pandit; an adept, proficient; N. of a man; incense. —पण्डित-जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, somewhat clever, rather learned. —पण्डित-ता, f. or पण्डित-त्व, अम्, n. learning, knowledge, wisdom, skilful-ness, cleverness. —पण्डित-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, philo-sophically minded. —पण्डित-मण्डल, अम्, n. an assembly or circle of learned men. —पण्डित-मानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, or पण्डित-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or पण्डितम्-मन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fancying one's self learned or clever; an ignorant and conceited person, a pedant who thinks himself a Pandit. —पण्डि-तम्-मन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fancying one's self learned. —पण्डित-राज, अस्, m. ‘the prince of the learned,’ an epithet of a great scholar. —पण्डित-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, pretending to be wise. —पण्डित-सभा, f. an assembly of Pandits or literati.
26836: पण्डितक, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, learned; (अस्), m. a learned man; N. of one of the sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
26837: पण्डिताय, Nom. A. पण्डितायते, &c., to be-come learned or wise.
26838: पण्डितायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming wise or learned.
26839: पण्डितिमन्, आ, m. wisdom, learning, scholarship.
26840: पण्ड्र पण्ड्र or पण्ड्रक, अस्, m. a eunuch.
26841: पत् 1. पत्, cl. 4. A. पत्यते, &c., Ved. to share in, partake of (with loc.); to be master of; to rule, control, possess, be in possession of (with acc. or inst.); to be fit for, serve for (with dat.); [cf. Lat. potior.]
26842: पत् 2. पत्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) पतति, -ते, पपात (1st pl. पेतिम, Ved. पप्-तिम; 3rd pl. पेतुस्, Ved. पप्तुस्; part. पेतिवस्, Ved. पप्तिवस्; fem. पेतुषी), पतिता, पतिष्यति, अपप्तत्, पतितुम्, to fly, soar or move rapidly through the air; to go, move, move downwards, alight, sink down, throw one's self down, to throw or cast one's self at (rarely with acc. for loc., e. g. पपात चरनौ तस्याः, he threw himself at her feet); to sink or set (as the sun); to fall, fall down, fall off, fall away; come down, descend (with loc. or acc., e. g. पपात नरेन्द्राणाम् मध्ये, he de-scended in the midst of the princes; पत भूमिम् अवाक्-शिराः, fall headlong to the earth, Rāmāyaṇa I. 60, 17); to go down into hell (e. g. नरके पतन्त्य् एते जुह्वतः, such sacrificers go down into hell, Manu XI. 37); to fall (in a moral sense), lose one's caste, forfeit rank or position (e. g. पर-धर्मेण जीवन् सद्यः पतति जाति-तः, he who lives by the duties of another class immediately loses caste, Manu X. 97); to fall on, be directed to, light upon (e. g. प्रसाद-सौम्यानि सतां सुहृज्-जने पतन्ति चक्षूंषि, the eyes of the good soft with kindness are directed on a friendly person, Śakuntalā, verse 161); to fall upon, fall or devolve to one's lot or share; to fall in or into, be in, (see पतित); to fall out, happen, occur, come to pass: Caus. P. पतयति, &c., Ved. to fly or hasten away; A. पतयते, &c., Ved. to put to flight, throw down; P. A. पातयति, -ते, &c., to let fly, fling, hurl; to cause to fall, to fell, cause to sink down or alight, let fall, drop, throw or strike down (e. g. दण्डं दण्ड्येषु पातयेत्, let him cause punishment to fall on those who deserve it, i. e. let him inflict punishment on the guilty; वायुः पातयन् महा-द्रुमान्, a wind which throws down lofty trees); to overthrow, ruin; to pour out, shed; to dash out, knock out, strike out; to hew down, lay low (e. g. पातयिष्यामि राक्ष-सम्, I will lay the Rākṣasa low); to throw in, put in or into, cause to enter; to cause to fall (morally), cause to lose caste, cause to sin; (with पावकम्) to set on fire; (with चक्षुस्, दृष्टिम्, &c.) to cast or direct the eyes, look or glance upon; (with शाप, अ-यशस्, &c.) to lay a curse or reproach upon; (with स्थानात्) to cause any one to lose his rank or position, cause to fall, bring into misfortune; (with अर्घ-तस्) to depreciate, lower the value of anything; (with or without आत्मानम्) to throw one's self; (in arithmetic) to subtract; to set in motion, set on foot (? see Rāja-taraṅgiṇī V. 173): Desid. पिपतिषति, पित्सति, to wish or expect to fall, be about to fall (e. g. कूलम् पिपतिषति, the bank is about to fall in): Intens. पनीपत्यते, पनीपतीति, see Pāṇ. VII. 4, 84; [cf. Gr. πέτ-ο-μαι, ὠκυ-πέτ-ης, ποτά-ο-μαι, πτε-ρό-ν, πτέρυξ, πτ-ίλο-ν, πί-πτ-ω, πιτ-νέ-ω, πτῶ-μα, πτῶ-σι-ς, πότ-μο-ς, πέτα-λον, ποτή, ἵπταμαι: Lat. pet-o, im-pet-u-s, pen-na, acci-pit-er: Old Germ. fedara, fedah or fetah, ‘wing;’ find-an = Goth. finth-an: Slav. put-i-ca, ‘a bird;’ pe-ro, ‘a feather:’ Hib. faoth, faodh, ‘a fall:’ Cambro-Brit. pyd-u, ‘to fall.’]
26843: 3. पत्, त्, त्, त्, flying, falling; [cf. अक्षि-प्°।]
26844: पत, अस्, m. flying, flight; going, falling, alight-ing. —पत-ग, अस्, m. a winged or flying animal, a bird; N. of one of the five fires in the Svadhā-kāra. —पतङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, flying; (अस्), m. a bird; (according to Naigh. I. 14) a horse; a flying insect, a grasshopper, a butterfly or moth (especially one attracted by a light), a bee; the sun; N. of one of the seven suns; a ball for playing with; (according to Sāy.) a spark; (according to Mahī-dhara) a Piśāca; a species of rice; quicksilver; ‘the Flier,’ a N. of Kṛṣṇa; N. of a son of Prajā-pati; N. of a mountain; N. of a village, also called Pataṅga-grāma; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a caste in Plaksha-dvīpa; (ई), f., N. of one of the wives of Tārkṣa, and mother of the Patagas or flying ani-mals; (अम्), n. quicksilver; a species of sandal-wood. —पतङ्-गम, अस्, m. a small grasshopper; a butterfly; a bird. —पतङ्गर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bird-like, like a bird. —पतङ्ग-वत्, ind. like a bird. —पतङ्गिका, f. a small bird; a kind of small bee. —पतङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, m. f. a bird.
26845: पतक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what falls or de-scends, &c.; (अस्), m. an astronomical table.
26846: पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying, alighting, descending, coming down, falling, &c.; (अन्), m. a bird. —प-तद्-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘receiving what falls,’ a spittoon; the reserve of an army. —पतद्-ग्राह, अस्, m. a spittoon, spitting-pot. —पतद्-भीरु, उस्, m. ‘ter-rible to birds,’ a hawk, falcon.
26847: पतत्र, अम्, n. a wing, pinion; a feather; a vehicle; [cf. पत्त्र।]
26848: पतत्रि, इस्, m. (fr. पतत्रिन्), a bird; (Ved.) N. of a particular fire; N. of a warrior on the side of the Kurus. —पतत्रि-केतन, अस्, m. ‘characterized by a bird,’ Viṣṇu. —पतत्रि-राज, अस्, m. the king of the birds, Viṣṇu's bird Garuḍa.
26849: पतत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, winged, feathered, flying; (Ved.) an epithet of a particular form of fire, of the vehicle of the Aśvins, &c.; (ई), m. a bird; a horse; the horse in the Aśva-medha sacrifice (Rāmāyaṇa I. 13); an arrow; (इणी), n. du., Ved. day and night; [cf. पातत्रिण।]
26850: पतन, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what flies, falls, goes down, descends; falling, alighting, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of a Rākṣasa; (अम्), n. the act of flying down, falling, alighting, descending, falling down, throwing one's self down or into; setting (as the sun), going down (to hell), slackening, hanging down, becoming flaccid (said of the breasts); falling from dignity, virtue, &c.; neglect of the duties of caste, apostasy; ruin; death; (with गर्भस्य) miscarriage; (in arithmetic) subtraction; the latitude of a planet. —पतन-धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having the quality of or subject to the law of falling.
26851: पतनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पतन), leading to a fall, causing the loss of caste; (अम्), n. a degrading crime, a crime which causes loss of caste.
26852: पतन्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, epithet of a kind of Aśva-medha performed in a hurried manner.
26853: पतम, अस्, m. a bird; a grasshopper; the moon; [cf. पतस।]
26854: पतयालु, उस्, ऊ, उ, flying, falling, liable to fall.
26855: पतयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, or पतयिष्णुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. flying.
26856: पतर, अस्, आ, अम्, or पतरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. flying, fugitive.
26857: पतस, अस्, m. a bird; a grasshopper; the moon.
26858: पताक, अस्, m. (‘flying’), a flag or banner, (perhaps incorrect for पताका); a particular position of the hand or of the fingers of the hand; (आ), f. a flag, pennant, pennon, banner; a flag-staff; an emblem carried as an ensign or banner, a symbol, sign, mark; a particular high number; an episode or episodical incident in a drama; good fortune, auspi-ciousness. —पताक-ध्वज-मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, gar-landed with flags and banners. —पताकांशुक (°का-अं°), अम्, n. a flag. —पताका-स्थानक, अम्, n. (in dramatic language) intimation of an episodical incident.
26859: पताकिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a flag or banner, carrying a banner.
26860: पताकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a flag or banner, bearing a flag, adorned with flags; (ई), m. an ensign, a standard-bearer, colour-bearer; a figure used in divination, a scheme for casting a nativity; a flag; N. of a warrior on the side of the Kurus; (इनी), f. an army; N. of a particular divinity.
26861: पतापत, अस्, आ, अम्, going to fall, inclined to fall; going much or frequently.
26862: पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen, alighted; dropped, prostrate, sprung from; fallen (in a moral sense), wicked, abandoned, one who has committed a heinous sin; fallen in battle, defeated, overthrown; degraded, outcast; gone; fallen into, occurring in, being in (e. g. अवंश-पतित, being in a low family; मध्य-पतित, being between); (अम्), n. flying. —पतित-सावित्रीक, अस्, m. a man of the first three classes whose investiture with the thread or initiation into sacred knowledge (उप-नयन) has not been duly performed or not performed at all, (this can happen to a Brāhman after his sixteenth, to a Kṣatriya after his twenty-second, and to a Vaiśya after his twenty-fourth year.) —पतित-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, lying on the ground. —पतितेक्षित (°त-ईक्ष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, looked at by an outcast. —पतितोत्पन्न (°त-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from an outcast.
26863: पतितव्य, अम्, n. going down to hell.
26864: पतित्वा, ind. having flown; having fallen or fallen down or alighted.
26865: पतिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. flying most or best.
26866: पतीयस्, ind. (originally the neut. of a compara-tive of पत्), quickly, speedily.
26867: पतेर, अस्, आ, अम्, flying, falling; going, moving; (अस्), m. a bird; a hole, pit; a particular measure (= आढक).
26868: पत्त्र (sometimes spelt पत्र), अम्, n. (accord-ing to some also अस्, m.), the wing of a bird, pinion, feather, the feather of an arrow; a vehicle in general [cf. पतत्र], a chariot, car, cart, horse, camel, &c. (perhaps in these senses connected with 2. पद्); the leaf of a tree (regarded as its plumage), the leaf of a flower, the leaf of a particular fragrant plant or of a species of plant with fragrant leaves (= गन्ध-पत्त्र); the leaf of the Cassia (= तेज-पत्त्र); a leaf prepared for writing on, a leaf written on, paper (e. g. तत् पत्त्रम् आरोपयति, he commits that to paper); a letter, any written document, (in the latter sense also पत्त्री, f.); the leaf of a book; gold-leaf, &c., any thin leaf or plate of metal or gold-leaf [cf. पट्ट]; the blade of a sword, knife, &c. [cf. असि-प्°]; staining the person as a decoration, lines and figures painted on the face by means of musk and other fragrant sub-stances; a knife, dagger; [cf. अच्छिन्न-प्°, उक्थ-प्°, &c.: cf. also Gr. πτε-ρό-ν, πτέρυξ, πτ-ίλο-ν; Old Germ. fedara, fedah, ‘a wing;’ Angl. Sax. feher; Mod. Germ. feder; Eng. feather.] —पत्-त्र-काहला, f. the noise made by the flapping of wings or rustling of leaves. —पत्त्र-कृच्छ्र, अस्, m. a sort of penance, drinking an infusion of the leaves of various plants and Kuśa grass for a given time; [cf. पर्ण-कृच्छ्र।] —पत्त्र-गुप्त, अस्, m. a kind of bird [cf. पक्ष-गुप्त]; a species of plant (= त्रि-कण्ट). —पत्त्र-घना, f. a species of plant with full leaves, Acacia Rugata (= सातला)। —पत्त्र-च्छेदक, अस्, m. a leaf-cutter, a parti-cular trade. —पत्त्र-च्छेद्य, अम्, n. (perhaps) plucked feathers. —पत्त्र-झङ्कार, अस्, m. the current of a river (or the rustling of leaves?); other authorities read पुर-संस्कार and पत्त्र-सं-स्कार. —पत्त्र-तण्डुला, f. a woman; a species of barley; 26869: पत्त्रक, अस्, m. the plant Achyranthes Triandra the leaves of which are eaten as a vegetable; (इका), f. a leaf for writing upon, a leaf on which any-thing has been written; a letter, document, &c.; (अम्), n. a leaf; the leaf of the Laurus Cassia; painting lines or figures on the body by way of decoration; (at the end of a comp.) leaf, wing; [cf. अजिन-पत्त्रिका, अलि-प्°।] —पत्त्रिकाख्य (°का-आख्°), अस्, m. a species of camphor. —पत्त्रिका-प्रवेश, अस्, m. a festival on the seventh day of the month Aśvina.
26870: पत्त्रणा, f. feathering an arrow, putting feathers on an arrow, &c.

26874: पत्य, (at the end of a comp.) falling.
26875: पत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. flying; (अ), n. flying, flight; [cf. आशु-प्°, रघु-प्°।]
26876: पत्सल, अस्, m. a way, road.
26877: पत पत, अस्, आ, अम्, cherished, well fed, protected, (said to = पुष्ट।)
26878: पतञ्चल पतञ्चल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
26880: पतञ्जल पतञ्जल, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
26881: पतञ्जलि पतञ्जलि, इस्, m. (said to be de-rived fr. पत, falling, and अञ्जलि, the joined hands; Patañjali, according to a legend, having fallen from heaven in the shape of a small snake into the hands of the saint Pāṇini as he was joining his hands in reverence); N. of a saint or Muni teacher of the Yoga philosophy, (thence called Pātañjala); N. of the celebrated author of the Mahā-bhāṣya or great commentary on Pāṇini; a N. of the poet Vara-ruci.
26882: पति पति, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 3. पा, to protect, but connected with rt. 1. पत् and pro-bably for original पातन्), a master, owner, possessor, proprietor, lord, ruler, governor, sovereign; one who presides over, (often applied to tutelary deities or regents, e. g. ओषधीनाम् पतिः, the Moon as guardian or lord of medicinal plants; सरिताम् पतिः, the Ocean as lord of the rivers; वच-साम् पतिः, Bṛhas-pati as lord of speech; some-times at the end of a comp., cf. ओषधि-प्°, बृहस्-प्°, वाचस्-प्°, वनस्-प्°); a husband; a root; going, motion, flight ? (said to be fr. rt. 1. पत्; generally only at the end of a comp.), a path, way, road, course, reach; [cf. अ-पथ, अज-प्°, अदर्शन-प्°, &c.; cf. also Zend पथन्, ‘way;’ Gr. πάτο-ς, πατέ-ω, πόντο-ς; Lat. pon(t)-s, ponti-fex; Slav. patĭ, ‘way;’ Old Germ. pad, fad, phat; Angl. 26909: पथ्य, अस्, आ, अम् (lit. belonging to a road, suitable for the way or course of anything), proper, fit, suitable, salutary, wholesome, agreeing with, (often said in a medical sense of diet, regimen, &c.); according to rule, containing elements or leading forms; (अस्), m. 26912: पत्ति, इस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पद् or fr. 3. पद्, col. 3), a footman, foot-soldier, infantry; a pedestrian; a hero; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a people [cf. पट्टि]; (इस्), f. the smallest division of an army (= (1/3) of a सेना-मुख) or a company consisting of one chariot, one elephant, three horsemen and five foot-soldiers, (according to others = सेना-मुख = fifty-five foot-soldiers); going, moving, walking. —पत्ति-कर्मन्, अ, n. the business or operations of infantry. —पत्ति-काय, अस्, m. infantry. —पत्ति-गणक, अस्, m. an officer whose business is to number or muster the infantry. —पत्ति-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a line of infantry. —पत्ति-संहति, इस्, f. a body of infantry, an assemblage of foot-soldiers; infantry.
26913: पत्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, going on foot, pedestrian.
26914: पत्तिन्, ई, m. a foot-soldier, footman.
26915: 3. पद् or पाद्, पात्, m. a foot; a step; a fourth part, quarter; [cf. पाद।] —पच्-छब्द, अस्, m. (पद् + शब्द), the noise of feet or of footsteps. —पच्-छस्, ind. (पद् + affix शस्), Pāda by Pāda, stanza by stanza, foot by foot. —पच्-छौच, अम्, n. (पद् + शौच), cleansing or purifying the feet. —पज्-ज, अस्, m. (पद् + ज), ‘born from the feet (of Brahmā),’ a Śūdra. —पत्-काषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, rubbing the feet, scratching the feet; going on foot, pedestrian; (ई), m. a footman, foot-soldier. —पत्-तस्, ind., Ved. from the feet; on foot. —पत्-सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. sticking or adhering to the feet. —पत्-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasant to the feet. —पत्सुतः-शी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. lying at the feet. —पत्सु-तस्, ind. 26916: पद, अम्, n. a step, pace, stride (e. g. पदात् पदं चलितुम्, to move on a step from any position; पदे पदे, at every step, everywhere, on every occasion; मध्यमं वैष्णवम् पदम्, Viṣṇu's middle stride, i. e. the air); a footstep, footprint, footmark, trace, track, vestige, mark (e. g. विष्णोस् त्रीणि पदानि, the three footprints of Viṣṇu, said to mean the space between the eye-brows, but probably the N. of a constellation; विष्णोः पदम्, ‘Viṣṇu's footprint,’ N. of a place; कररुह-पद, the mark of finger-nails, cf. न-ख-प्°, दशन-प्°; पदम् अनुविधेयम् म-हताम्, the footsteps of the great are to be followed); a sign, token, characteristic; a particular measure of length (= 12 or 15 fingers' breadth, or (1/2) or (1/3) or (2/7) of a Pra-krama); a footing, stand-point, standing-place, position, station, site (e. g. भ्रामयित्वा पदात् पदम्, having caused to wander from place to place; पदम् आ-तन्, to spread or extend one's position); an abode, home; a place, post, office, rank, degree, dignity (e. g. श्लाघ्य-पदम् प्राप्य, having obtained an honourable position); a busi-ness, affair, matter, (पदं कृ, to have dealings with any one, with loc. or acc. of the person or with प्रति); an object, thing; occasion, cause, subject (e. g. सन्देह-पदेषु वस्तुषु, in mat-ters which are subjects of doubt; अष्टादश व्य-वहार-पदानि, eighteen titles of law or occasions of litigation); pretext (= अप-देश); a part, por-tion, division [cf. त्रि-पद]; a plot of ground; a square on a chess-board; a foot, (according to Hema-candra in this sense also अस्, m.; पदेन, on foot; पदं कृ, to set foot in or on; करिष्यसि पदम् पुनर् आश्रमे, thou shalt again set foot in the hermitage; मूर्ध्नि पदं कृ, to set the foot upon the head of any one, i. e. to conquer or overcome; हृदये or चित्ते पदं कृ, to take possession of any one's heart or mind; पदं कृ may also mean ‘to put confidence in’); a portion of a verse, quarter or line of a stanza, (वसिष्ठस्य पदं, N. of a Sāman); a word; (according to Pāṇini) a complete word, i. e. an inflected word or a प्रातिपदिक, q. v., with the case-terminations added, (also in Pāṇini's system) the base of a noun before all case-terminations beginning with consonants except those of the strong cases, and before all the Taddhita affixes beginning with consonants except य्; a mode of writing the Vedas in which the several words are detached from one another [cf. पद-पाठ]; (in arithmetic) any one in a set of numbers the sum of which is required; the last of a series, a period in an arithmetical progression; a square root; a quadrant; protection; (अस्), m. a ray of light.
