[cf. पुर-जित्।] —पुर-मथन, अस्, m. ‘crusher of Pura,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पुर-मार्ग, अस्, m. the street of a town. —पुर-मालिनी, f. ‘crowned with castles,’ N. of a river. —पुर-रक्ष, अस्, or पुर-रक्षिन्, ई, m. a watchman of a town, constable. —पुर-राष्ट्राणि, n. pl. cities and kingdoms. —पुर-रोध, अस्, m. the siege of a fortress or city. —पुर-वर, अम्, n. an excellent town. —पुर-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in a city or town; (ई), m. a city-dweller, inhabitant of a town, citizen, townsman. —पुर-वास्तु, उ, n. ground suit-able for the foundation of a city. —पुर-शासन, अस्, m. ‘chastiser of Pura,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पुर-हन्, आ, m. ‘slayer of Pura,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —पुर-हित, अम्, n. the welfare of a town or city. —पुराट्ट (°र-अट्°), अस्, m. a turret for defensive purposes on a city wall. —पुराधिप (°र-अध्°), अस्, m. the governor of a town, prefect of police. —पुराध्यक्ष (°र-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘fort-overseer,’ the commandant of a fortress, the governor of a city, prefect of police. —पुराराति (°र-अर्°), इस्, m. ‘foe of Pura,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पुरारि (°र-अरि°), इस्, m. ‘foe of Pura,’ an epithet of Śiva; an epithet of Viṣṇu. —पुरार्ध-विस्तर (°र-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, being of the extent of half a town; (अस्), m. part of a town, a suburb, ward, division. —पुरा-वती, f. ‘rich in castles,’ N. of a river. —पुरासुहृद् (°र-अस्°), त्, m. ‘enemy of Pura,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पुरी-दास, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Caitanya-candrodaya; (also called कवि-कर्ण-पूर।) —पुरी-मोह, अस्, m. the thorn-apple, Datura. —पुरोत्सव (°र-उत्°), अस्, m. ‘town-festival,’ a festival solemnized in a city. —पुरोद्भवा (°र-उद्°), f. ‘growing in towns,’ N. of a plant. —पुरोद्यान (°र-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘city-garden,’ a pleasure-garden belonging to a town, park. —पुरौकस् (°र-ओक्°), आस्, m. an inhabitant of a town, inhabitant of Tri-pura.

(poetically also पू-रुष; said to be fr. rt. 2. पुर्; probably connected with पूरु), man collectively or individually, man-kind, a man, human being, male; a person (पुमान् पुरुषः, a male person); a member or repre-sentative of a race or generation (e. g. सपिण्डता पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते, the relationship of men connected by the funeral cake ceases with the seventh person); an officer, official, functionary, agent, employé, attendant, servant, footman; the height or measure of a man, = 5 Aratnis (1 Aratni = 2 Padas, 1 Pada = 12 Aṅgulis; cf. अर्ध-प्°, द्वि-प्°); Punishment personified; (in gram.) a per-son (= प्रथमः प्°, the third person; मध्य-मः प्°, the second person; उत्तमः प्°, the first person); Man personified or identified with Nārā-yaṇa the son of Nara (regarded as the author of Vājasaneyi-Saṃhitā XXX. 31); the soul and original source of the universe (described in the Puruṣa-sūkta, q. v.); the personal and life-giving principle in men and other beings, the human soul or spirit, Soul (which according to the Sāṅkhya philosophy is neither a production nor productive: it is so called according to the Tattva-samāsa because it reposes in the body, पुरि शयनात्; 29572: पुर्व् पुर्व् [cf. rt. पॄ], cl. 1. P. पूर्वति, पूर्वितुम्, to fill; cl. 10. P. पूर्वयति or पूर्बयति, -यितुम्, to dwell or inhabit; to invite.
29573: पुल् पुल् [cf. rt. पॄ], cl. 1. 6. 10. P. पोलति, पुलति, पोलयति, &c., to be great or large; to be lofty or high; to be piled or heaped up.
29574: पुल, अस्, आ, अम्, extended, wide, vast, great, extensive; (अस्), m. erection of the hairs of the body (considered as a proof of exquisite delight); horripilation; N. of one of the attendants of Śiva; (आ), f. the soft palate or uvula.
29575: पुलक, अस्, m. erection or bristling of the hairs of the body (considered by the Hindūs to be occasioned by delight or desire rather than by fear), a thrill of joy or of fear, horripilation; a species of edible plant; a kind of stone or gem; flaw or defect in a gem; any kind of insect or vermin infesting animals; a ball of bread and sweetmeats with which elephants are fed; yellow orpiment; a Gandharva or heavenly chorister; a wine-goblet or glass; a species of mustard; (अम्), n. a species of earth (= कङ्कु-ष्ठ). —पुलकाकुलाकृति (°क-आक्°, °ल-आक्°), इस्, इस्, इ, ‘having the frame excited by horripilation,’ thrilled with joy. —पुलकाङ्ग (°क-अङ्°), अस्, m. the noose or cord of Varuṇa. —पुलकालय (°क-आल्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera. —पुलकी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs or down of the body erect, thrilled with delight. —पुलकीकृताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, whose body has its hairs erect, having the body thrilled with joy. —पुलकोद्गम (°क-उद्°), अस्, m. erection of the hairs of the body (through rapture), horripilation.
29576: पुलकय, Nom. P. पुलकयति, -यितुम्, to have or feel the hairs of the body erect (with rapture or desire).
29577: पुलकित, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs or down of the body erect or bristling up with joy, thrilled with joy, delighted, rejoiced, enraptured, joyful.
29578: पुलकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having the hairs or down of the body erect, thrilled, enraptured; (ई), m. a species of Kadamba tree (= धारा-कदम्ब).
29579: पुलस्ति, इस्, इस्, इ (perhaps fr. पुलस् for पुरस्, cf. पलस्ति fr. परस्, but said to be fr. पुल and rt. 3. अस्), wearing the hair straight or plain; (gender doubtful), the hair of the head; (इस्), m., N. of a man.
29580: पुलस्त्य, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पुल्; per-haps fr. पुलस् for पुरस्), N. of an ancient Ṛṣi, one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā (Manu 1. 35; also enumerated among the Prajā-patis and seven sages, and described as a lawgiver); an epithet of Śiva. —पुलस्त्य-स्मृति, इस्, f., N. of a work mentioned in the Śūdra-dharma-tattva.
29581: पुलह, अस्, m., N. of an ancient Ṛṣi, one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā enumerated among the Prajā-patis and the seven sages (Manu I. 35); an epithet of Śiva.
29582: पुलाक, अस्, अम्, m. n. shrivelled or blighted or empty grain, bad grain; a small lump of rice rolled into a ball, a lump of boiled rice; (according to par-ticular medical authorities) rice-water; brevity, abbre-viation, abridgement, compendium; smallness, a little; celerity, dispatch. —पुलाक-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, making haste, hastening.
29584: पुलानिका, f. (perhaps) induration of the skin.
29585: पुलायित, अम्, n. a horse's gallop; (a wrong reading for पलायित।)
29586: पुलिन, अस्, अम्, m. n. a sandbank, land deposited by alluvium on the bank of a river; an island of alluvial formation or one from which the water has recently withdrawn, a small island or bank left in the middle of a river by the subsiding of its waters, an islet; a sandy beach; (according to a Scholiast) = तीर, the bank of a river; (अस्), m., N. of a mythical being conquered by Garuḍa. —पुलिन-जघना, f. having sandbanks for hips (said of the Gambhīrā river personified as a female). —पुलिन-द्वीप-शोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with shoals and islands. —पुलिन-प्रदेश, अस्, m. island-site, situa-tion on an island. —पुलिन-मण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with sandbanks or islets. —पुलिन-वती, f. ‘possessing sandbanks,’ (probably) N. of a river.
29587: पुलिन्द, आस्, m. pl., N. of a barbarous tribe; (अस्), m. a man of this tribe, a king of the Pulindas; a barbarian, savage, Mleccha, mountaineer, one who uses an uncultivated and unintelligible dialect.
29588: पुलिन्दक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a barbarous tribe; (अस्), m., N. of a king of the Pulindas, Śavaras, and Bhillas; of a son of Ārdraka.
29589: पुलिक पुलिक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ), f. yellowish alum.
29590: पुलिमत् पुलिमत्, आन्, m., N. of a man.
29591: पुलिरिक पुलिरिक, अस्, m. a snake.
29592: पुलिश पुलिश, अस्, m. = Paulus (Alexan-drinus), N. of the author of a Siddhānta.
29593: पुलु पुलु = पुरु (in particular comps.). —पुलु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having many de-sires, covetous (Sāy.) = बहुकामना-वत्. —पुल्व्-अघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. doing much evil.
29594: पुलुष पुलुष, अस्, m., N. of a man.
29595: पुलोम पुलोम, अस्, m. = पुलोमन्, q. v.; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of the demon Vaiśvānara, (she was loved by the demon Puloman, but became the wife of Bhṛgu or Kaśyapa); the plant Acorus Calamus (= वचा).
29596: पुलोमन्, आ, m., N. of a demon (the father-in-law of Indra by whom he was destroyed). —पुलोम-जा, f. ‘daughter of Puloman,’ an epithet of the wife of Indra. —पुलोम-जित्, त्, or पुलोम-भिद्, त्, m. ‘conquerer or destroyer of Puloman,’ an epithet of Indra (who destroyed his father-in-law Puloman in order to avert his imprecation consequent on the violation of his daughter). —पुलोम-द्विष्, ट्, or पुलोमारि (°म-अरि), इस्, m. ‘foe of Puloman,’ an epithet of Indra. —पुलोमार्चिस् (°म-अर्°), इस्, m. ‘having the lustre of Puloman,’ N. of a prince.
29597: पुलोमत् पुलोमत्, आन्, m., N. of a prince; [cf. पुलिमत्।]
29599: पुल्कस पुल्कस, अस्, m., Ved. (according to the commentators) = पौल्कस।
29600: पुल्ल पुल्ल wrongly for फुल्ल, q. v.
29601: पुल्लक पुल्लक, अम् (?), n. = आश्चर्य, wonder.
29602: पुष् 1. पुष् (various reading for व्युष्, q. v.), cl. 4. P. पुष्यति, &c., to divide, distribute.
29603: पुष् 2. पुष्, cl. 1. P. पोषति, पुपोष, पोषिष्यति, अपोषीत्, पोषितुम्, cl. 4. P. पुष्यति, &c., to be nourished, thrive, prosper, in-crease (intrans.); to share, divide; cl. 4. P. later also 9. P. पुष्यति, पुष्णाति, &c., to nourish, nurture, cherish, foster, rear, bring up; to support, maintain, bear; to cause to thrive or prosper, cause to grow, unfold, develop; to increase (trans.), augment; to further, advance, promote, enhance, aggrandize; to magnify, exalt, extol; to increase in (with acc.), receive, get, possess, have, enjoy; to manage; to exhibit, show, display, evince, make to appear: Caus. पोषयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अपूपुषत्, to nourish, cherish, foster, rear, bring up; to cause to thrive or pros per, take care of, provide for; to cause to be fostered or brought up; to wear, put on: Desid. पुपोषिषति, पुपुषिषति, पुपुक्षति: Intens. पोपुष्यते, पोपोष्टि।
29605: पुष, अस्, आ, अम्, nourishing (in ग्रह-प्°, q. v.); (अस्), m., N. of a teacher of the Veda; (आ), f. a species of plant (= लाङ्गलिकी).
29606: पुषर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. well-nourished, thriving.
29607: पुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, nourished, nurtured (= पुष्ट).
29608: पुष्क, a word formed for the explanation of पुष्कल in Gaṇa to Pāṇ. V. 2, 97.
29609: पुष्कर, अम्, n. (probably an anomalous form-ation fr. an unused पुष + कर), a blue lotus-flower; a lotus, Nelumbium Speciosum or Nymphæa Nelumbo, (in Mahā-bh. in this sense also पुष्कराणि, n. pl.); a cage; union; a part; war, battle; intoxi-cation; the art of dancing; (अस्), m. a pond, tank, lake [cf. त्रि-प्°]; a kind of drum, a kettle-drum; a kind of serpent; (ई or इका), f. the plant Hibiscus Mutabilis. —पुष्कर-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a work. —पुष्कर-प्रिय, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), wax. —पुष्कर-बीज, अम्, n. lotus-seed. —पुष्कर-मालिन्, ई, m. ‘wearing a lotus-wreath,’ N. of a man. —पुष्कर-माहात्म्य, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the Padma-Purāṇa. —पुष्कर-मूल, अम्, n. the plant Costus Speci-osus or Arabicus. —पुष्करमूलक, अम्, n. the root of Costus Speciosus or Arabicus. —पुष्कर-व्याघ्र, अस्, m. ‘water-tiger,’ an alligator. —पुष्-कर-शायिका, f. a species of aquatic bird. —पुष्-कर-शिका or (according to others) पुष्कर-शिफा, f. the root of the lotus. —पुष्कर-सद्, त्, m., N. of a man; (दस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants; (in derivatives both members of this comp. are Vṛddhied; cf. पौष्करसादि।) —पुष्कर-सा-गर, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the plant Costus Speciosus or Arabicus. —पुष्कर-साद, अस्, m., Ved. a species of bird. —पुष्कर-सारिन्, ई, m., N. of a Brāhman. —पुष्कर-सारी, f. ‘having the essence of the lotus,’ a kind of writing (लिपि). —पुष्कर-स्थपति, इस्, m. ‘architect of the lotus,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पुष्कर-स्रज्, क्, f. a lotus-wreath, chaplet of lotuses; (जौ), m. du. an epithet of the two sons of Aśvinī and physicians of Svarga or paradise; (क्, क्, क्), wearing a garland of lotuses, crowned with lotuses. —पुष्कराक्ष (°र-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, lotus-eyed; (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of a man; of a prince. —पुष्क-राख्य (°र-आख्°), अस्, m. the Indian crane, Ardea Sibirica. —पुष्कराङ्घ्रिज (°र-अङ्°), अम्, n. the plant Costus Speciosus or C. 29610: पुष्कराय, Nom. A. पुष्करायते, -यितुम्, to act as or represent a drum.
29611: पुष्करिका, f. a kind of disease, formation of abscesses on the penis; N. of a woman.
29612: पुष्करिन्, ई, इणी, इ, abounding in lotuses; (ई), m. an elephant; N. of a prince; (इणी), f. a female elephant; a lotus-pool, pool in general, piece of water, lake, artificial pond, square or large pond; the plant Costus Speciosus or Arabicus; the plant Hibiscus Mutabilis; N. of a river; of the wife of Bhumanyu; of the wife of Cākṣuṣa and mother of Manu; of the mother of Manu Cākṣuṣa; of the wife of Vyuṣṭa and mother of Cakṣus and grandmother of Manu; of the wife of Ulmuka; of a Buddhist temple in Maru or Marwar.

IV. 1, 41; (अम्), n. a particular measure of capacity (= 8 Kuñcis = 64 handfuls; sometimes = four times a double handful); a particular weight of gold; alms to the extent of four mouthfuls of food; N. of a celebrated place of pilgrimage (= पुष्कर). —पुष्कल-मोचन, अम्, n., N. of the 78th chapter of the Pātāla-khaṇḍa of the Padma-Purāṇa. —पुष्कल-विजय, अस्, m., N. of the 68th and 69th chapters of the Pātāla-khaṇḍa of the Padma-Purāṇa. —पुष्कला-वती, f. = पुष्करा-वती, q. v. —पुष्कलावर्तक (°ल-आव्°), आस्, m. pl. epithet of a particular class of clouds (= पुष्करावर्तक, q. v.).
29614: पुष्कलक, अस्, m. the musk-deer; a post, wedge, pin, bolt; a Buddhist mendicant; (sometimes wrongly spelt पुष्यलक।)
29615: पुष्कलावत, अस्, m. (probably a wrong form for पौष्कलावत), an inhabitant of Puṣkalā-vatī.
29616: पुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, nourished, cherished, fed, well-fed; thriving, strong; tended, cared for; incubated, brooded over; abounding, abundant; rich, well-sup-plied, amply provided; eminent; full-sounding, loud; complete, perfect; burnt (for प्लुष्ट?); (अम्), n., Ved. increase, acquisition, gain, wealth, property. —पुष्ट-ता, f. or पुष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. the being well-fed, a prosperous or thriving condition. —पुष्-ट-पति, इस्, m., Ved. the lord of prosperity or welfare. —पुष्ट-विपुष्टौ, m. du. the well-fed and the ill-fed. —पुष्टाङ्ग (°ट-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, fat-limbed, fat in body, fattened, well-fed, fat. —पुष्-टार्थ (°ट-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a complete sense. —पुष्टा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. breeding or rearing (cattle; Sāy. = सम्भृत-घास).

on a for-mer day; at dawn, during the first part of the day; early, betimes, in the morning; during that portion of a day on which religious ceremonies are to be per-formed. —पूर्वेषुकामशमी (°व-इष्°), f., N. of a Grāma. —पूर्वोक्त (°व-उक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, said before, formerly stated, aforesaid, before-mentioned. —पूर्वोत्तर (°व-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, north-eastern; (ए), n. du. the antecedent and subsequent, the pre-ceding and following; (अम्, आ), n. f. the north-east. —पूर्वोत्पन्न (°व-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, previously produced, previously existent. —पूर्वोत्पन्न-त्व, अम्, n. former existence, condition of prior exist-ence. —पूर्वोदित (°व-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, aforesaid, before-mentioned.
29713: पूर्वक, अस्, इका, अम्, earlier, former, previous, prior, anterior, preceding, antecedent (often like पूर्व, q. v., at the end of a comp.; cf. स्त्री-प्°); first; preceded by, accompanied by, connected with, attended with (at the end of comps. = पूर्व, q. v.; cf. व्याहृति-प्°); (अस्), m. a forefather, ancestor; (अम्), ind. preceded by, with, according to, in con-formity with (at the end of comps.; cf. विधि-प्°, प्रीति-प्°).
29714: पूर्वतन, अस्, ई, अम्, former, earlier, older, more ancient.
29715: पूर्व-तस्, ind. in front of, before (with gen.); towards the east; first, in the first place.
29716: पूर्व-त्र, ind. in the former or preceding part (opposed to उत्तर-त्र, q. v.); पूर्वत्र जन्मनि, in a former birth.
29717: पूर्व-था, ind., Ved. at first, formerly, of old, aforetime; as of old; in front, towards the east (?).
29718: पूर्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in उपाधाय्य-प्°, having an edge or border (of red braid), trimmed, edged.
29719: पूर्वातिथ, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman (= पौर्-वातिथ).
29720: पूर्विक, अस्, आ, अम्, formerly or previously done; formerly invited; पूर्वक, previous; [cf. स्त्री-पूर्विक।]
29721: पूर्विणे-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing in the east (? probably a wrong reading).
29722: पूर्विन्, ई, इणी, इ, derived from ancestors or fore-fathers, observed by ancestors, ancestral; having for-merly, having formerly been (at the end of a comp.; cf. कृत-प्°, भुक्त-प्°, स्त्री-प्°).
29723: पूर्वीण, अस्, आ, अम्, derived from ancestors or forefathers, ancestral.
29724: पूर्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. former, previous, preceding, ancient, old (opposed to नवीयस्, नू-तन); first, next, nearest (Sāy. = नेदिष्ठ); ex-cellent; (according to a Scholiast) young; (अम्), ind. before, formerly, long since, hitherto, at first. —पूर्व्य-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. principal praise (Sāy. = मुख्या स्तुतिः).
29725: पूल् पूल्, cl. 1. 10. P. पूलति, पूलयति, यितुम्, to collect, gather, heap up, accu-mulate.
29726: पूल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), or पूलक, अस्, m. a bundle, pack.
29727: पूलिका पूलिका, f. a kind of pastry; [cf. पूरिका, पोलिका, पौलि।]
29728: पूल्य पूल्य, अम्, n. an empty or shrivelled grain of corn.
29729: पूष् पूष् (= rt. 2. पुष्), cl. 1. P. पू-षति, पूषितुम्, to nourish; to increase, grow.
29730: पूष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पुष्), a kind of mul-berry tree, Morus Indica; (आ), f. epithet of the third Kalā of the moon.
29731: पूषक, अस्, m. a kind of mulberry tree, Morus Indica.
29732: पूषण, अस्, m. = पूषन् below; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
29733: पूषन्, आ, m. (the अ of अन् is not lengthened in the nom. du. pl. and acc. sing. du., e. g. nom. du. पूषणौ, nom. pl. पूषणस्, acc. sing. पूष-णम्, acc. pl. पूष्णस्, or according to some also पूषस्, inst. sing. पूष्णा or पूषा, loc. sing. पूष्णि or पूषणि or पूषि, see Gram. 157), N. of a Vedic deity (regarded as the guardian of flocks and herds and of property in general, cf. पुष्टिम्-भर; in the character of a herdsman he is repre-sented as carrying an ox-goad and riding in a car drawn by goats, cf. अजाश्व; in that of a presiding deity of the sun he is all-seeing, the companion of travellers, guide of the soul on its way to the next world, and the lover of his sister Sūryā; he causes the alternation of day and night, and is associated with Soma or the Moon as protector of the universe; he is invoked together with various gods, but most frequently with Indra and Bhaga; his most remark-able epithets are आ-घृणि, कपर्दिन्, दस्र, द-स्म, दस्म-वर्चस्; in the Brāhmaṇas Pūṣan is represented as having lost his teeth and feeding on a kind of gruel, whence he is called करम्भाद्; in later times he is enumerated among the twelve Ādityas, and regent of the Nakṣatra Revatī or Pauṣṇa); N. of the sun. —पूषण्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. accompanied by Pūṣan; (Sāy.) = पुष्ट्या युक्त, filled with nutriment. —पूष-दन्त-हर, अस्, m. ‘taking away Pūṣan's teeth,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पूष-भासा, f. ‘sun-splendor,’ N. of the capital of Indra; (also spelt पूष-भाषा।) —पू-ष-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a man with the surname Gobhila. —पूष-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having Pūṣan as a giver, i. e. probably, among whom Pūṣan is the especial benefactor. —पूषात्मज (°ष-आत्°), अस्, m. ‘son of Pūṣan,’ an epithet of Indra. —पू-षासुहृद् (°ष-अस्°), त्, m. ‘enemy of Pūṣan,’ an epithet of Śiva.
29734: पूषध्र पूषध्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Manu; (probably a wrong reading for पृषध्र।)
29735: पूष्कर पूष्कर, a word formed for the ex-planation of पुष्कर (Śatapatha-b. VII. 4, 1, 13).
29736: पृ 1. पृ, cl. 3. P. पिपर्ति, पपार, प-रिष्यति, अपार्षीत् (mostly Ved.), to bring over, carry over or across, ferry over; to bring out of, deliver from (with abl.); to escort; to pro-tect, uphold, support, sustain, maintain; to bring forward, promote, advance; cl. 9. P. पृनाति, to protect: Caus. P. (ep. also A.) पारयति (-ते), -यितुम्, Aor. अपीपरत्, to ferry over or across, carry over, conduct through; to bring out, deliver, extricate, rescue, save, protect; to reach the other side of anything, to accomplish, achieve, perform, bring to a conclusion; to keep one's ground, withstand, oppose; to be able or capable; to live; [cf. Zend par, ‘to carry across:’ Gr. περά-ω, πόρο-ς, πορεύς, πορ-θ-μός, πορσύν-ω, πορεύ-ω, πορίζ-ω, ἄπορος, ἀπορέ-ω, ἔμ-πορο-ς, πεῖρ-α, πειρά-ω, παρών, πειράτης, πεπαρεῖν, πείρω, περόνη, πόρπη, πειρά, πηρό-ς: Lat. por-ta, por-tu-s, ex-per-i-o-r, peritus, perî-culu-m, par-a-re (?), parere, partus, portare: Goth. far-an, ‘to go;’ far-j-an, ‘to carry:’ Old Germ. ar-far-an, ‘to perceive;’ furt: Angl. Sax. fyrd.]
29737: पृ 2. पृ [cf. rt. पृण्], cl. 5. P. पृणोमि, पपार, परिष्यति, अपार्षीत्, पर्तुम्, to please, gratify, delight; to be pleased or delighted.
29738: पृ 3. पृ, cl. 6. A. प्रियते, पप्रे, परिष्-यते, अपृत, पर्तुम्, to be busy or active (in व्य्-आ-पृ, q. v.); [cf. Gr. περά-ω, πέρ-νη-μι, πι-πρά-σκ-ω, πρί-α-μαι, πρά-σι-ς, πρα-τία-ς, πόρ-νη, ἔμ-πορος, ἔμ-πολά-ω, πωλέω; Lat. prec-iu-m, prec-ari; Old Germ. feil, feili = Mod. Germ. feil, ‘cheap, venal.’]
29739: पृ 4. पृ = rt. पॄ, to fill, q. v.
29740: पृक्का पृक्का, f. a species of leguminous plant, Trigonella Corniculata; [cf. स्पृक्का।]
29741: पृक्त पृक्त, पृक्ति। See under rt. 1. पृच्।
29742: पृक्थ पृक्थ, अम्, n. possession, property, wealth; [cf. रिक्थ।]
29743: पृक्ष् पृक्ष्, f. (the nom. sing. does not occur; perhaps connected with rt. 1. पृच्), Ved. refreshment, food, nourishment, satiation. —पृक्षु-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (according to Sāy.) = पशु-पुरोडाशादिषु दाह-मध्ये धीयमानः, being placed in the midst of the burnt offerings of animals, ghee, &c., or = प्र-क्षोध्यः। = प्रकर्षेण बुभुक्षितः; (perhaps a corruption for प्र-क्षुध, ‘hungry, eager.’)
29744: पृक्ष पृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fleet, swift (? said of a horse); having food, (Sāy.) = घासाद्य्-अन्न-वत्, possessing grass and other food; (अस्), m. a swift horse, courser (an epithet especially of the horses of the Aśvins, Agni, and Indra); N. of a man; a battle. —पृक्ष-प्रयज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. (perhaps) hastening with swift horses; (Sāy.) in which oblations of food begin to be offered (said of the morning). —पृक्ष-याम, अस्, आ, अम्, driving swift horses; (Sāy.) = अन्नानां नियमनं यस्-मिन्, in which there is the offering of food; (अस्), m. a proper N. (?).
29745: पृच् 1. पृच्, cl. 7. P. पृणक्ति, पपर्च, पर्चिष्यति, अपर्चीत्, पर्चितुम्; cl. 2. A. पृक्ते or पृङ्क्ते (sometimes referred to a form पृञ्च्), पपृचे or पपृञ्चे, पर्चिता or पृञ्चिता, पर्चिष्यते, अपर्चिष्ट, पर्चितुम्; cl. 1. A. पर्चति, &c. (?), to mix, mingle; to bring into contact, connect, unite, join; to be in contact, touch; to fill, satisfy, sate, satiate; to give lavishly, grant bountifully, bestow anything (acc. or gen.) richly upon any one (dat.), lavish upon (Ved.); to increase, augment, multiply; (A.) to fill one's self (?); cl. 1. 10. P. पर्चति, पर्चयति, &c., to touch; to hin-der, restrain (?); [cf. Gr. πλέκ-ω, πλέγ-μα, πλοκή, πλόκαμο-ς, δί-πλαξ, perhaps πόρκο-ς, πόρκη-ς: Lat. plec-t-o, am-plec-t-or, plic-o, du-plex, Parca, plăg-a: Umbr. tribricu, ‘triplicity:’ Goth. flah-t-om, ‘with folds;’ fal-th-a, ‘I fold;’ flaht, flihtu, fluhtumês: Old Germ. flihtu, flahs = Mod. Germ. Flachs = Eng. flax; flehtan: Mod. Germ. flech-t-en: Angl. Sax. folg-ian: Slav. ple-t-a, ‘I plait.’]
29746: पृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed, mingled, combined; brought into contact, touched, united, being in com-bination with, touching [cf. मयूख-प्°]; filled, full (e. g. घृत-पृक्त, full of ghee); (अम्), n. possessions, property, wealth (in these senses a wrong reading for पृक्थ, q. v.).
29748: 2. पृच्, क्, f., Ved. refreshment; (Sāy.) = प्राप्-तुं कामयमान, desirous of attaining, or = भुज्, enjoying; [cf. घृत-प्°, मधु-प्°।]
29749: पृच्छक पृच्छक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रछ्), one who asks or inquires after (with gen.); inquiring; inquiring into the future; (अस्), m. an inquirer, querist, investigator, inquisitive person.
29751: पृच्छा, f. asking, questioning, a question, in-quiry; an inquiry into the future.
29752: पृच्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or inquired after.
29753: पृज् पृज्, पृञ्ज्, cl. 2. A. पृङ्क्ते, &c., various readings for rts. 1. पृच्, पृञ्च्, q. v.
29754: पृञ्च् पृञ्च्, cl. 2. A. पृङ्क्ते, &c. See rt. 1. पृच् above.
29755: पृड् पृड्, cl. 6. P. पृडति, &c. [cf. rt. पृण्], to gladden, delight.
29756: पृण् पृण् [cf. rts. 2. and 4. पृ], cl. 6. P. A. पृणति, -ते, &c., Ved. to fill; to please, gratify.
29757: पृत् पृत्, त्, f., Ved. (usually in loc. pl. पृत्सु, in Ṛg-veda I. 129, 4. पृत्सुषु, but according to native grammarians also in other cases, viz. पृतस्, पृता, पृद्भ्याम्), battle, contest, strife. —पृत्-सुति, इस्, f., Ved. a hostile attack; (Sāy.) a host. —पृत्सु-तुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, उर्, Ved. vic-torious; (Sāy.) = पृतनासु तरण-शील = शूर।
29758: पृतन, अम्, n. a hostile encounter (Ved.); an army (Ved.); (आ), f. a battle, encounter, fight, con-test, (in the earlier language only in acc. and loc. plur.); a hostile armament, army; a small army or division consisting of 243 elephants, as many chariots, 729 horse, and 1215 foot, = 3 Vāhinīs; (आस्), m. pl. men, mankind (?). —पृतनाज् (°ना-अज्°), क्, क्, क्, Ved. running or rushing in battle. —पृतनाजि (°ना-अजि°), इस्, इस्, इ, = पृतनाज् (Atharva-veda VII. 85, 1). —पृतना-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. victorious in battle; (त्), m., N. of an Ekāha. —पृतनाज्य (°ना-अज्°), अम्, n., Ved. ‘running-match,’ a fight, battle. —पृतना-नी, ईस्, or पृतना-पति, इस्, m., Ved. a leader in battle, commander, general. —पृ-तना-षह् or पृथना-षाह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. winning battles, victorious, (Sāy.) = अ-मर्त्य, immortal; (ट्), m. an epithet of Indra. —पृतना-षाह्य, अम्, n., Ved. victory in battle (Sāy. = परकीय-सेनाभि-भव). —पृतनाहव (°ना-आह्°), अस्, m., Ved. a challenge to fight; a fight, battle; (Sāy.) = सङ्ग्रा-मेषु रक्षणार्थम् आह्वानम्।
29759: पृतनायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. fighting together, engaged in combat, (according to Mahī-dhara = सङ्ग्राम-काम, eager for battle.)
29760: पृतनायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. hostile, inimical.
29761: पृतन्य, Nom. P. पृतन्यति, -यितुम्, Ved. to attack, assail, to fight against.
29763: पृतन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. attacking, hostile; (Sāy.) = युद्धम् इच्छत्।
29764: पृत्सुध, अस्, m. battle ?; (a various reading for पृत्सु in Naigh. II. 17.)
29765: पृथ् पृथ्, cl. 10. P. पर्थयति, -यितुम्, to extend (= rt. 1. प्रथ्); to throw, cast; to send, direct; [cf. rt. 2. प्रथ्।]
29766: पृथ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पृथ् as another form of rt. 1. प्रथ्), Ved. the flat or palm of the hand; a par-ticular measure, the length of the hand from the tip of the fingers to the knuckles, or = 13 Aṅgulis; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of Śūra and adopted daughter of Kunti and one of the wives of Pāṇḍu (she was the mother of Karṇa before her marriage and of Yudhi-ṣṭhira, Bhīma, and Arjuna after her marriage, see कुन्ति). —पृथ-हर, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —पृथा-ज, अस्, m. ‘son of Pṛthā,’ an epithet of Arjuna; the tree Pentaptera Arjuna. —पृथा-पति, इस्, m. ‘the husband of Pṛthā,’ an epithet of Pāṇḍu. —पृथारणि (°था-अर्°), इस्, f. ‘the Araṇi Pṛthā,’ a N. of Kuntī the wife of Pāṇḍu (as the mystical wood from which the Pāṇḍavas were struck out or generated; cf. पाण्डव-वह्नि). —पृथा-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Pṛthā,’ an epithet of Arjuna.
29767: पृथक्, ind. separately, singly, severally; apart from, besides, with exception of, except (with abl.); without (with abl., inst., or gen.); differently from (with abl.); पृथक् पृथक्, one by one, separately, with regular intervals; [cf. perhaps Gr. φάρ-σο-ς; Lat. par(t)s, prī-vus perhaps for prith-vus, pri-vare.] —पृथक्-करण, अम्, n. making separate, separating, distinguishing, setting apart. —पृथक्-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having different wishes, having various desires. —पृथक्-कार्य, अम्, n. a separate or private affair, the affair of an individual. —पृथक्-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a separate or different family. —पृथक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -क-रोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make separate, sever, sunder; to keep off, avert. —पृथक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, separated, severed, sundered, cut off; made distinct. —पृथक्-क्रिया, f. separation, disunion. —पृथक्-क्षेत्र, आस्, m. pl. children of one father by different wives or by wives of different classes. —पृथक्-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, going separately, walking alone. —पृथक्-त्व, अम्, n. separateness, separation, diversity, severalty; singleness, individu-ality; (एन), ind. singly, one by one. —पृथक्-त्वचा, f. ‘diverse-barked,’ a species of aloe com-monly called Mūrvā, Sanseviera Zeylanica. —पृथक्-पर्णी, f. ‘diverse-leaved,’ a species of plant, Hemio-nitis Cordifolia. —पृथक्-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a distant kinsman who offers the funeral cake by himself and not together with the other relations; (according to Kullūka = समानोदक।) —पृथक्-शब्द, अस्, m. a separate word, a distinct or independant word. —पृ-थक्-शय्या, f. sleeping apart. —पृथक्-श्रुति, इस्, इस्, इ, uttering a distinct sound, distinctly heard. —पृथक्-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, existing separately, separate. —पृथक्-स्थिति, इस्, f. separate existence, separation. —पृथग्-अभिमति, इस्, इस्, इ, regarding the world as separate (from God). —पृथग्-आत्मता, f. separateness, severalty; discrimination, judgment. —पृथग्-आत्मन्, आ, आ, अ, ‘having a distinct nature or essence,’ separate, distinct, individual; (आ), m. individualized spirit, that of an individual as detached from universal spirit or the soul of the universe. —पृथग्-आत्मिका, f. separate or individual existence, individuality. —पृथग्-ईश-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, regarding God as distinct from the universe; [cf. पृथग्-अभिमति।] —पृथग्-गण, अस्, m. a separate company. —पृथग्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing distinct properties. —पृथग्-जन, अस्, m. a man of the lower classes or of low caste, a man of low character or profession; (with Buddhists) a man in his natural state, one not yet illuminated; an ignorant man, fool, blockhead; a wicked or vicious man, sinner; the lower orders, low people, the mul-titude; (आस्), m. pl. children of one father by different mothers; the lower orders, populace. —पृथग्-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, beholding other objects (than those of sense). —पृथग्-बीज, अस्, m. the plant Semecarpus Ana-cardium (= भल्लातक). —पृथग्-भाव, अस्, m. separate state or existence, separateness, difference, individuality (= पृथक्-त्व, q. v.). —पृथग्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become separate, separated, dif-ferent. —पृथग्-योग, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) hav-ing a different lot. —पृथग्योग-करण, अम्, n. disuniting things connected with one another. —पृ-थग्-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, variously shaped, diverse, manifold, various, different, of different kinds. —पृ-थग्-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of different kinds, various, diversified, multiform, different from (with inst.).
29769: पृथिवी, f. (for पृथ्वी, f. of पृथु below), ‘the wide (world),’ the earth, Earth personified (as the mother of all beings, and often invoked together with the Sky; in the Veda there are three earths enumerated corresponding with the three heavens, that on which mankind lives being called भूमि; in the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa said to be the daughter of Pṛthu); land, ground, soil; earth regarded as one of the elements; (according to Naigh. I. 3) = अन्त-रिक्ष, sky; पृथिव्या व्रतम् or पृथिव्याः सं-सर्पम्, N. of a Sāman. [पृथिवी is sometimes shortened into पृथिवि, especially in comps.] —पृ-थिवि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of the earth. —पृ-थिवि-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. earth-giving. —पृथिवि-भाग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the earth as a share, one to whom the earth is allotted, entitled to the earth. —पृथिवि-लोक, अस्, m., Ved. the earth re-garded as a world, the terrestrial world. —पृथिवि-षद् or पृथिवि-सद्, त्, त्, त्, sitting on the ground. —पृथिवि-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing on the ground, stepping firmly (said of a horse; Sāy. = पृथिव्यां सु-प्रतिष्ठितः). —पृथिवी-कम्प, अस्, m. an earthquake. —पृथिवी-क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, dwelling on earth (Ved.); reigning over the earth; (त्), m. a prince, king, sovereign. —पृथिवी-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘earth-moon,’ N. of a prince of the Tri-gartas. —पृथिवीञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering the earth; (अस्), m. a prince, king, sovereign. —पृ-थिवी-तल, अम्, n. the surface of the earth, ground, bare ground, the very earth. —पृथिवी-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —पृथिवी-धरण, अम्, n. a prop or support of the earth. —पृथिवी-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a prince, king, sovereign; an epithet of Yama the regent of the dead; a kind of drug (= ऋषभ). —पृथिवी-परिपालक, अस्, m. ‘guardian of the earth,’ a prince, king, sovereign. —पृथिवी-पार्वतक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), rock-oil, petroleum (?). —पृथिवी-पाल, अस्, m. ‘guardian of the earth,’ a king, sovereign, ruler. —पृथिवी-भुज्, क्, m. ‘earth-enjoying,’ a prince, sovereign. —पृथिवी-मण्ड, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the scum of the earth. —पृथिवी-मण्डल, अस्, अम्, m. n. the circuit of the earth. —पृथिवी-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of earth, earthen. —पृ-थिवी-रस, अस्, m. the sap of the earth. —पृथिवी-राज्य, अम्, n. the sovereignty of the earth. —पृ-थिवी-रुह, अस्, m. ‘earth-growing,’ a plant, tree. —पृथिवी-लोक, अस्, m. the earth considered as a world, the terrestrial world; [cf. पृथिवि-लोक।] —पृथिवीश (°वि-ईश°), अस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a prince, king, sovereign. —पृथिवी-शक्र, अस्, m. ‘the Indra of the earth,’ a king. —पृथिव्य्-आपीड, अस्, m., N. of two princes of Kaśmīra.
29770: पृथु, उस्, उस्, or वी, उ, broad, wide, expansive, extensive, spacious; ample, abundant, luxuriant; large, great, gigantic; detailed; prolix; numerous; smart, clever; various; important; (उस्), m. a N. of Agni or fire; a particular measure of length (= पृथ); N. of a mythical personage (= पृथी, see col. 3); N. of a son of An-enas; of a Vṛṣṇi and son of Citraka; of a son of Citra-ratha; of a descendant of Ikṣvāku (son of An-araṇya and father of Tri-śaṅku); of a son of Pāra; of a son of Pra-stāra; of a son of Rucaka; of one of the Saptarṣis; of a son of one of the Manus; of a Dānava; of a monkey; (उस्), f. a pungent seed, Nigella Indica; a medicinal substance (commonly हिङ्गु-पत्त्री); opium; (वी), f. ‘the wide (world),’ earth; earth as an element; the pungent seed Nigella Indica; = हिङ्गु-पत्त्री; the plant Boerhavia Procumbens (= पुनर्-नव, q. v.); great cardamoms; a kind of metre consisting of four lines of seventeen syllables each; another metre containing eleven syllables in each line; N. of the mother of the seventh Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; [cf. rt. प्रथ्; प्रथ्-अस्, ‘breadh:’ Zend frath-anh, ‘breadth:’ Gr. πλατύ-ς, πλάτ-ος, πλάτ-η, πλάτ-ανο-ς, πλάθ-ανο-ς, πλαθ-άνη, πλάσσω, πλάσ-μα, πλασ-τό-ς, ἔμ-πλασ-τρο-ν: Lat. lăt-us for platus; Latium, ‘flat country;’ lat-er: Lith. platus: Goth. braid-s, ‘broad:’ Angl. Sax. brâd: Eng. broad: Mod. Germ. breit.] —पृथु-कर्-मन्, आ, m., N. of a son of Śaśa-vindu and grandson of Citra-ratha. —पृथु-कल्पिनी, f. a various reading for पथ-कल्पना, q. v. —पृथु-कीर्त्ति, इस्, m. ‘far-famed,’ N. of a son of Śaśa-vindu; (इस्), f., N. of a daughter of Śūra. —पृथु-कोल, अस्, m. a species of jujube. —पृथु-ग, आस्, m. pl. ‘far-going,’ N. of a class of deities under Manu Cākṣuṣa. —पृथु-गमन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. ‘broad-pathed,’ having a broad path; thick-set ?; (Sāy. = पृथु-भावम् प्राप्-नुवत्।) —पृथु-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘broad-necked,’ N. of a Rākṣasa. —पृथु-चार्व्-अञ्चितेक्षण (°त-ईक्ष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having large, beautiful, and curved eyes. —पृथु-च्छद, अस्, m. ‘broad-leaved,’ a species of plant (= हरिद्-गर्भ). —पृथु-ज-घन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘large-hipped,’ having broad hips. —पृथु-जय, अस्, m. ‘victorious far and wide,’ N. of a son of Śaśa-vindu. —पृथु-जमन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. ‘broad-pathed,’ having a broad path; [cf. पृथु-ग्मन्।] —पृथु-ज्रय, अस्, आ, अम्, or पृथु-ज्रयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, widely extended, spread-ing widely; of rapid or extended impetus (Sāy. = पृथु-जव = शीघ्र-गामिन् = प्रथित-वेग). —पृथु-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, broadest, widest, largest (= प्रथिष्ठ). —पृथु-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, broader, wider, larger, more spacious, very large or important (= प्रथीयस्). —पृथु-ता, f. or पृथु-त्व, अम्, n. breadth, width, largeness, greatness. —पृथु-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, far-seeing, far-sighted (in a meta-phorical sense). —पृथु-दान, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śaśa-vindu. —पृथु-दीर्घ-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, having broad and long arms, broad and long-armed. —पृथु-धरणि-धर, अस्, m. ‘supporting the broad earth,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 13444). —पृथु-धार, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘broad-edged,’ having a wide or broad edge. —पृथु-नितम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having broad hips, large-hipped. —पृ-थु-पक्षस्, अस्, n. (probably) a broad space at the side (of a chariot); (according to Sāy. an adj. आस्, आस्, अस्) = पृथु-पार्श्व-द्वय-युक्त, broad-flanked, having the two flanks broad (said of a horse). —पृ-थु-पत्त्र, अस्, m. ‘broad-leaved,’ a kind of garlic (= रक्त-लशुन). —पृथु-पर्शु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. armed with large sickles; (Sāy.) = विस्तीर्णाश्व-पर्शु-हस्त, holding large rib-bones of horses. —पृथु-पलाशिका, f. Curcuma Zedoaria (= शटी, पलाशिका). —पृथु-पाजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. far-shining, resplendent (said of Agni, of the horses of Uṣas, of the chariot of the Aśvins, and of Indra-Vāyu; Sāy. = पृथु-तेजस् or पृथु-वेगस्). —पृ-थु-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. broad-handed (said of Savitṛ; Sāy. = महत्-कर). —पृथु-प्रगाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a wide approach or access, approached by wide avenues; (Sāy.) = पृथु-गीति, much-lauded. —पृथु-प्रगामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. wide-striding, taking wide strides; moving fleetly (Sāy. = पृथु-प्रगमन). —पृथु-प्रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, far-famed, having a wide reputation. —पृ-थु-प्रोथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having broad or wide nostrils (said of a horse). —पृथु-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, broad-armed, having brawny arms. —पृथु-बुध्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broad-based, having a broad basis or foot, having a broad sole or under-part (Sāy. = स्थूल-मूल). —पृथु-भुवन, अम्, n. the wide world. —पृथु-मृद्वीका, f. ‘wide grape,’ (probably) a raisin. —पृथु-यशस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, far-famed, of wide renown; (आस्), m., N. of a son of Śaśa-vindu; of a son of Varāha-mihira. —पृथु-यामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. ‘broad-pathed,’ having a broad path (said of Uṣas); (Sāy.) = पृथु-रथ, a spacious chariot. —पृथु-रश्मि, इस्, m., Ved. ‘broad-rayed,’ N. of a Yati. —पृथु-रुक्म, अस्, or पृथु-रुक्मन्, आ, m., N. of a son of Parā-jit (or Parā-vṛt). —पृ-थु-रोमन्, आ, m. ‘having broad hairs or scales,’ a fish. —पृथुरोम-युग्म, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the sign of the zodiac Pisces. —पृथु-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, large-eyed, having large eyes. —पृथु-वक्त्रा, f. ‘wide-mouthed,’ N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda. —पृथु-वेग, अस्, m. ‘having excessive force or impetus,’ N. of a prince. —पृथु-शिम्ब, अस्, m. a species of Śyonāka. —पृथु-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. broad-headed, flat-headed. —पृथु-शेखर, अस्, m. ‘broad-crested,’ a mountain. —पृ-थु-श्रव, अस्, m., N. of a being attendant upon Skanda; (probably a wrong reading for पृथु-श्रवस्।) —पृथु-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, far-famed, of wide renown; (आस्), m., N. of a man; of a son of Śaśa-vindu; of a son of Raghu; of a son of the ninth Manu; of a serpent-demon. —पृथु-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, having great fortune, highly prosperous. —पृ-थु-श्रोणि, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘broad-hipped,’ having broad hips, having large buttocks. —पृथु-षेण (पृथु + सेना), अस्, m. ‘having an extensive army,’ N. of a son of Rucira (or Rucirāśva); of a son of Vibhu; (also read पृथु-सेन।) —पृथु-ष्ठु, उस्, उस्, उ, or पृथु-ष्ठुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (?), a species of the Aty-aṣṭi metre. —पृथ्वी-भुज्, क्, m. ‘earth-enjoyer,’ a prince, king. —पृथ्वी-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the earth,’ N. of a prince. —पृथ्वीश (°वी-ईश°), अस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a prince, king, sovereign. —पृथ्वी-हर, अस्, m., N. of a man.
29771: पृथुक, अस्, अम्, m. n. rice or grain flattened; rice scalded with hot water and then dried over a fire and ground in a mortar; (अस्), m. a child, boy, the young of any animal; (आ), f. a girl; a species of plant (= हिङ्गु-पत्त्री).
29772: पृथुल, अस्, आ, अम्, broad, large, great; (आ), f., N. of a medicinal substance (= हिङ्गु-पत्त्री). —पृथुलाक्ष (°ल-अक्°), अस्, m. ‘large-eyed,’ N. of a prince, a son of Catur-aṅga.
29773: पृथ्वीका, f. large cardamoms; small cardamoms; a small pungent seed, Nigella Indica.
29774: पृथवान पृथवान, अस्, m., N. of a man.
29775: पृथाश्व पृथाश्व, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
