29783: पृशनायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. clinging to, attached to; tender; (Sāy.) = स्पर्शन-काम, desirous of contact.
29784: पृश्नि पृश्नि, इस्, इस्, इ (said to be fr. rt. स्पृश्, the initial स् being elided, see Uṇādi-s. IV. 52), variegated, party-coloured, dappled, piebald, speckled, spotted (used in the Veda as a favourite epithet of cows); manifold, diverse, various, of many kinds (Ved.); dwarfish, stunted, short, thin, small; deli-cate, feeble; (इस्), f. (like all other words for ‘cow’ used in various figurative or mythical senses, viz.) earth, a cloud, milk, the spangled or starry sky, a ray of light; a kind of fruit; N. of the mother of the Maruts; of the wife of Savitṛ; of the wife of king Su-tapas (who in a former birth under the name of Devakī was mother of Kṛṣṇa); (ई), f. the plant Pistia Stratiotes; (इस्), m. a dwarf; N. of a prince the father of Śvaphalka; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a race of Ṛṣis; पृश्नि or भरद्वाजस्य पृश्नि, N. of a Sāman; [cf. rts. पृष् and स्पृश्; पृष्-अत, पृषत्, पृषटी: Gr. περκ-νό-ς, πέρκο-ς, περκαίνειν, πρακ-νό-ν, πρεκ-νό-ν, πρόξ, προκά-ς, πρώξ, πρόκ-νη: Lat. spurc-u-s, sparg-o: Old Germ. spreng-en: Mod. Germ. be-spreng-en = Eng. sprinkle.] —पृश्नि-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the variegated bosom or in the bosom of the varie-gated one (Sāy. = आदित्यस्य गर्भ-भूत or सप्तोज्ज्वल-वर्णाः सूर्य-रश्मयस् तेषां गर्-भ-भूत); (अस्), m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —पृश्नि-गु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. driving piebald horses (said of the Maruts; Sāy. = पृश्नि-वर्णा अश्वा येषां ते); (उस्), m., N. of a man. —पृश्नि-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. the being variegated or party-coloured, the being speckled or spotted. —पृश्नि-धर, अस्, m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —पृश्नि-निप्रेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sent down or hastening down to Pṛśni, i. e. to the earth (said of the Maruts); (Sāy.) = पृश्न्या मात्रा नितराम् प्रयताः, sent down by their mother Pṛśni. —पृश्नि-पर्णी, f. ‘having variegated leaves,’ N. of a plant, Hemionitis Cordi-folia. —पृश्नि-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having speckled arms, i. e. front legs (said of a frog); (उस्), m., N. of a mythical being. —पृश्नि-भद्र, अस्, m. ‘pro-pitious to Devakī,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —पृश्नि-मत् or पृश्नि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the word पृश्नि. —पृश्नि-मातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. ‘having Pṛśni for a mother,’ an epithet of the Maruts; ‘having the earth for a mother,’ an epithet of herbs. —पृश्नि-शृङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘having a small or a variegated crest,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu incarnate as Kṛṣṇa; of Gaṇeśa. —पृश्नि-सक्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having spotted thighs. —पृश्नि-हन्, आ, m., Ved. slaying the speckled (snake). —पृश्न्य्-आह्वया, f. = पृश्नि-पर्णी, q. v.
29785: पृश्निका, f. an aquatic plant, Pistia Stratiotes.
29786: पृष् पृष् (akin to rt. प्रुष्; cf. rts. स्पृश् and वृष्), cl. 1. P. पर्षति, प-पर्ष, पर्षिष्यति, अपर्षीत्, पर्षितुम्, to sprinkle; to weary; to vex; to hurt, injure; to give; cl. 1. A. पर्षते, पर्षितुम् (a various reading for rt. वृष्), to become wet: Caus. पर्षयति, यितुम्, Aor. अपपर्षत्, अपीपृशत्: Desid. पि-पर्षिषति: Intens. परीपृश्यते, परीपर्ष्टि: [cf. पृश्नि; Zend परेष्, ‘to sprinkle.’]
29787: पृषत्, अन्, अती, अत्, (Ved.) spotted, speckled, mottled, dappled, piebald, party-coloured, variegated; sprinkling (in this sense used as a part.); (अन्), m. the spotted antelope; the hog deer, porcine deer; पृषताम् पतिः, ‘lord of the spotted ante-lopes,’ a N. of the Wind; (अती), f. a spotted cow; epithet of the animals ridden by the Maruts (usually said by commentators to be spotted antelopes, ac-cording to Mahī-dhara piebald mares, and often apparently identified in the Ṛg-veda with the horses of the Maruts); the female spotted antelope, spotted doe; = पार्षती, the daughter of Pṛṣata; (अत्), n. a drop of water or of any other liquid. —पृषत्-ता, f. or पृषत्-त्व, अम्, n. the being spotted or variegated. —पृषद्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘having piebald horses,’ an epithet of the Maruts; (according to Sāy.) riding on spotted antelopes; (अस्), m. air, wind, the god of air or wind divinely personified; an epithet of Śiva; N. of a man; of a son of An-araṇya and father of Hary-aśva; of a son of Vi-rūpa; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the descendants of Pṛṣad-aśva. —पृषद्-आज्य, अम्, n. sprinkled or clotted butter, ghee mixed with coagulated milk forming an oblation. —पृषद्-आज्य-प्रणुत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. driven away from the oblation of ghee and curds. —पृषद्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. party-coloured, variegated. —पृषद्-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a spotted calf. —पृ-षद्-वरा, f. ‘the best among the variegated ante-lopes,’ N. of a wife of Ruru and daughter of a Vidhyā-dhara by Menakā (a sort of antelope). —पृषद्-वल, अस्, m. ‘piebald,’ N. of a horse of Vāyu or Wind; [cf. पृषद्-अश्व।] —पृषद्-वाण, अस्, m. ‘having variegated arrows,’ N. of a man. —पृ-षोदर, अस्, आ, अम् (पृष for पृषत् + उदर), Ved. ‘speckled-bellied,’ having the belly speckled, (see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 3, 109.)
29788: पृषत, अस्, आ, अम्, spotted, speckled, having white spots, variegated; (अस्), m. the spotted ante-lope, the porcine deer; a drop of water; a spot, mark; N. of the father of Dru-pada. —पृषताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m. air, wind (= पृषद्-अश्व).
29789: पृषत्क, अस्, m. an arrow (so called as being variegated or as being as swift as an antelope).
29790: पृषद्धर or पृषध्र, अस्, m. (probably a comp. fr. पृषत् + ध्र), N. of a man the son of Manu and author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 57 (= Vālakhilya 8).
29791: पृषध्रु, उस्, m., N. of a warrior on the side of the Pāṇḍavas.
29792: पृषन्ति, इस्, m. a drop of water (probably an error for पृषन्ति, n. pl. of पृषत्).
29793: पृषातक, अम्, n. a mixture of ghee and coagu-lated milk or some similar compound; (अस्), m. an epithet of Rudra; (ई), f. a kind of disease or N. of a female demon causing this disease.
29794: पृषोद्यान, अम्, n. (fr. पृष for पृषत् + उद्यान), a small garden or grove.
29795: 1. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. and 3. see below), sprinkled.
29796: पृषभाषा पृष-भाषा, f. = पूष-भासा, q. v.
29797: पृषाकरा पृषाकरा, f. a small stone used as a weight.
29798: पृष्ट 2. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for स्पृष्ट fr. rt. स्पृश्), Ved. cleaving or adhering to, in contact with (Sāy. = सं-स्पृष्ट, or = नि-षिक्त = नि-हित). —पृष्ट-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (perhaps) having devoted relatives or attendants; (Sāy.) = स्तो-तॄणाम् बन्धुः, a friend to those who praise him.
29799: पृष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. a rib (= पर्शु); touch; a ray of light. —पृष्टि-वह्, वाट्, m., Ved. carrying on the back (as a horse). —पृष्ट्य्-आमय, अस्, m., Ved. a pain in the side. —पृष्ट्य्-आमयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. feeling a pain in the side.
29800: पृष्ट 3. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रछ्), asked, inquired, questioned, interrogated, demanded. —पृष्टाभिधायिन् (°ट-अभ्°), ई, इनी, इ, Ved. an-swering that which is asked, answering an inquiry.
29801: पृष्ट्वा, ind. having asked or inquired, having questioned or interrogated.
29802: पृष्टहायन पृष्टहायन, अस्, m. an ele-phant; a species of grain.
29803: पृष्ठ पृष्ठ, अम्, n. (probably fr. प्र-स्थ or perhaps fr. परा-स्थ), the back of any animal (as standing out prominently), the back in general (e. g. अश्व-पृष्ठे सम्मतः, admired on horse-back, i. e. a good rider; पृष्ठं दा, to bend the back, make a low obeisance); the hinder part of anything, the rear [cf. सेना-प्°]; the upper side, uppermost part, surface, superficies (e. g. दिवः पृष्ठम्, Ved. the surface of the sky, vault of heaven; cf. घृत-प्°, तृ-प्°, नाक-प्°); the flat roof of a house; a terrace; a page of a book; N. of a particular arrangement of Sāmans employed at the midday oblation, and formed from the Rathan-tara, Bṛhat, Vairūpa, Vairāja, Śākvara, and Raivata Sāmans, (in this sense more usually written as a comp. पृष्ठ-स्तोत्र, q. v.); N. of various Sā-mans; (एन, ए), ind. at the back, behind, from behind. —पृष्ठ-गोप, अस्, m. one who guards or protects the rear of a warrior while fighting. —पृष्ठ-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘back-knot,’ a hump on the back. —पृष्ठ-घ्न, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पृष्ठ-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. ‘having eyes in the back,’ a crab. —पृष्ठ-ज, अस्, m. a form of Skanda; (also considered as a son of Skanda.) —पृष्ठ-जाह, अम्, n. = पृष्ठस्य मूलम्, ‘the root of the back,’ (probably) os coccygis; [cf. जाह।] —पृष्ठ-तल्पन, अम्, n. the exterior muscles on an elephant's back (= तल्पन). —पृष्-ठ-दृष्टि, इस्, m. ‘looking backwards,’ a bear. —पृष्ठ-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being behind the back of a person, following, observing, controlling. —पृष्ठ-फल, अम्, n. the superficial contents of a figure. —पृष्ठ-भङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘breaking or bending the back,’ epithet of a mode of fighting. —पृष्ठ-भाग, अस्, m. the hinder part, back. —पृष्ठ-मध्य, अस्, m. the middle of the back. —पृष्ठ-मांस, अम्, n. the flesh on the back; पृष्ठमांसं खाद् or भक्ष्, ‘to eat the flesh of a person's back,’ i. e. to speak ill of any one behind his back. —पृष्ठमांसाद (°स-अद°) or पृष्ठमांसादन (°स-अद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘eating the flesh of the back,’ backbiting, speaking ill of a person behind his back, a backbiter, tale-bearer, slanderer; (अम्), n. backbiting. —पृष्ठ-यज्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who sacrifices on high places (Sāy. = रथन्तर-बृहद्-आदिभिर् ईजान). —पृष्ठ-यान, अम्, n. ‘going on the back (of a horse &c.), riding; (अस्, आ, अम्), an animal for riding, riding horse. —पृष्ठ-रक्ष, अस्, m. one who covers the rear of a warrior while fighting; [cf. पृष्ठ-गोप।] —पृष्ठ-रक्षण, अम्, n. protection or defence of the back. —पृष्ठ-वंश, अस्, m. the back-bone. —पृष्ठ-वास्तु, उ, n. an upper story, the upper room of a building. —पृष्ठ-वाह्, ट्, m. (f. पृष्ठौही, see Gram. 182. c), a draught-ox, an ox employed for draught, (also read प्रष्ठ-वाह् and पष्ठ-वाह्); ‘borne on the back,’ riding. —पृष्ठ-वाह्य, अस्, m. a draught-ox, an ox carrying burdens. —पृष्ठ-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, lying or sleeping on the back. —पृष्ठ-शृङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘having horns over the back,’ a wild goat. —पृष्ठ-शृङ्गिन्, ई, m. a ram; a buffalo; a eunuch; an epithet of Bhīma-sena. —पृष्ठ-स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a particular arrangement of Sāmans (= पृष्ठ, q. v.). —पृष्-ठानुग (°ठ-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, or पृष्ठानु-गामिन् (°ठ-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, going behind, following (opposed to अग्र-ग). —पृष्ठास्थि (°ठ-अस्°), इ, n. the back-bone. —पृष्ठे-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face in the back. —पृष्ठोदय (°ठ-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘rising from behind,’ an epithet of the signs of the zodiac, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Sagittarius, and Capricorn.
29804: पृष्ठक, अम्, n. the back; पृष्ठके कृ, to place behind, postpone; to resign, renounce.
29805: पृष्ठ-तस्, ind. from the back, from behind, behind the back, at the back, behind (with gen.); to the back, backwards; on the back; behind the back, secretly, covertly; पृष्ठतः कृ, to place on the back (e. g. पर्वतम् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा, having placed the mountain on his back); to place behind the back, neglect, forsake, abandon; to re-sign, renounce, desist from; पृष्ठतो गम्, to go at the back, follow, pursue; पृष्ठतो भू, to be behind, i. e. to be disregarded, to be an object of indifference.
29806: पृष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to the back; belonging to or coming from the heights (Ved., e. g. पृष्ठ्यम् पयः, ‘milk from the heights,’ i. e. Soma, or according to Sāy. = धार-कम् पयः, sustaining milk); forming the Pṛṣṭha hymns (Ved.); having the Pṛṣṭha hymns (said of a particular period of six sacrificial days, Ved.); (अस्), m. with or without अश्व, a horse for riding or for draught, a pack-horse; (अस्, अम्), m. n. = पृष्ठा-नां समूहः [cf. Pāṇ. IV. 2, 42] = स्तोत्राणां समूहः (Ujjvala-datta on Uṇādi-s. II. 12); (आ), f. with or without अश्वा, a mare for riding or for draught; an edge or ridge along the back of the Vedi (Ved.). —पृष्ठ्य-स्तोम, अस्, m., Ved., N. of six Ekāhas or of a period of six sacrificial days. —पृष्ठ्यावलम्ब (°य-अव्°), अस्, m., Ved., scil. पञ्चाह, a period of five sacrificial days.
29807: पृष्णि पृष्णि, इस्, इस्, इ, small, short, or thin (= पृश्नि); (इस्), f. the heel (= पार्ष्णि); a ray of light (= पृश्नि).
29808: पृष्णिपर्णी पृष्णि-पर्णी, f. a wrong read-ing for पृश्नि-पर्णी, q. v.
29809: पृष्वा पृष्वा, incorrectly for प्रुष्वा, q. v.
29810: पॄ पॄ [cf. rts. 1. and 2. पृ, पृण्], cl. 9. and 3. P. (Ved. also A.) पृणाति (-णीते), पिपर्ति (3rd du. पिपृतस् or पिपूर्तस्, Vopa-deva X. 5), पपार (3rd du. पपरतुस् or पप्रतुस्, 3rd pl. पपरुस् or पप्रुस्, Pāṇ. VII. 4, 12), परिष्यति, परीष्यति, अपारीत्, Prec. पूर्यात्, प-रितुम्, परीतु (Ved. forms, Impf. 3rd sing. A. अपिप्रत, Impv. 2nd sing. पूर्धि, Aor. पर्षि, पर्षत्, पारिषत्; irregular Impv. 2nd sing. A. पिपीपृहि?), to fill, fill up; to fulfil; to sate, satisfy, refresh (e. g. पितॄन् अपारीत्, he satisfied or refreshed the Manes); to cherish, nourish, nurture, foster, rear, bring up; to protect; to bestow bounti-fully, grant abundantly, give plentifully, lavish (with acc. of the thing and dat. of the person, Ved.); to collect, accumulate; (A.) to fill or sate one's self; cl. 4. A. (properly Pass. but ep. also P.), पूर्यते (-ति), Aor. अपूरि, अपूरिष्ट, to be filled, become full, to be fulfilled; to be sated or satisfied; Caus. पारयति, -यितुम् [cf. Caus. of rt. 1. पृ], to fill, fulfil (Ved.); पूरयति, -ते, -यितुम् (sometimes regarded as derived fr. a separate rt. पूर्, q. v.), to fill, fill up, replenish; to fulfil (a wish, hope, promise, &c.); to make full, fill out, intensify, strengthen (a sound); to fill with wind, blow, wind (a conch-shell or other wind instrument); to draw (a bow, or an arrow to the ear); to cover completely, cover up, surround, envelop; to load or enrich (with gifts); to spend the whole (of a period of time): Desid. पिपरिषति, पिपरीषति, पुपूर्षति, पु-पूर्षते: Intens. पोपूर्यते, पापर्ति, पोपूर्ति; [cf. rt. 1. प्रा, 3. पुर्, पुर, पुरु, पुलु: Zend par, ‘fill;’ perena, ‘full:’ Gr. πί-μ-πλη-μι, πλή-θ-ω, πλέ-ω-ς, πλή-ρ-ης, πλη-θ-ύ-ς, πλῆ-θ-ος, πλοῦ-το-ς: Lat. im-ple-o, plē-nu-s, plē-be-s, pŏ-pul-u-s, multus said to be for pūrtas, am-plu-s: Goth. full-s, ‘full;’ fullo, ‘fulness;’ full-yan, ‘to fill:’ Old Germ. fol, folc: Angl. Sax. fyll-an: Mod. Germ. voll = Eng. full: Slav. plŭ-nŭ, ‘full;’ plŭ-kŭ, ‘people;’ ple-me, ‘a tribe:’ Lith. pil-ti, ‘to fill;’ pī1l-na-s, ‘full;’ pùl-ka-s, ‘crowd:’ Hib. pailt, ‘abundant, plentiful, copious.’]
29811: पेचक पेचक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पच्), an owl; the tip or the root of an elephant's tail; a couch, bed; a louse; a cloud; (इका), f. a kind of owl.
29812: पेचकिन्, ई, m. an elephant; (also read पिचकिन्।)
29814: पेचु पेचु, उ, n. or पेचुली, f. a species of bul-bous plant with esculent roots, Colocasia Antiquorum.
29815: पेज पेज in तिल-पेज, q. v.; (आ), f. = पेया।
29816: पेञ्जूष पेञ्जूष, अस्, m. the wax of the ear (= पिञ्जूष).
29817: पेट पेट, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, m. f. n. (said to be fr. rt. पिट्, q. v.), a basket, a large basket, bag; a chest; a multitude; a retinue; (अस्), m. the open hand with the fingers expanded (= प्र-हस्त).
29818: पेटक, अस्, इका, अम्, m. f. n. [cf. पिटक], a basket for holding clothes, books, &c.; (अम्), n. multitude, company, quantity; (इका), f. a species of plant (= कुलिङ्गाक्षी, कुवेराक्षी, कृष्ण-वृन्-तिका).
29820: पेडा, f. a basket, large basket (= पेटा, for which it is perhaps only a wrong reading).
29821: पेट्टिभट्ट पेट्टि-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a man the father of the commentator Viśveśvara.
29822: पेढाल पेढाल, अस्, m., N. of the eighth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
29823: पेण् पेण् [cf. rts. पैण्, प्रैण्, लैण्], cl. 1. P. पेणति, &c., to go; to send (?); to grind (?); to embrace.
29824: पेत्व पेत्व, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पा?), a ram, sheep (Ved.); a small part; (अम्), n. nectar, Amṛta; ghee or clarified butter.
29825: पेदु पेदु, उस्, m., Ved., N. of a man (under the especial protection of the Aśvins, by whom he was presented with a white horse that killed serpents).
29826: पेपीयमान पेपीयमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. In-tens. of rt. 1. पा), drinking repeatedly.
29827: पेब् पेब्, cl. 1. A. पेबते, a various reading for rt. सेव्, q. v.
29828: पेय पेय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पा), to be drunk or quaffed, fit to be drunk, drinkable, potable; tastable, sapid; (अस्), m., scil. यज्ञ-क्रतु, a drink offering, libation (Ved.); (आ), f. rice gruel; any drink with a small quantity of boiled rice; the decoction of anything after straining; a species of anise, = मिश्रेया; (अम्), n. a drink, beverage.
29829: 1. पेरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) drinking; (उस्), m. the sun; fire; the ocean; the golden mountain.
29830: पेयूष पेयूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (= पीयूष, q. v), the milk of a cow that has calved within seven days, biestings; fresh butter; nectar, Amṛta.
29831: पेरज पेरज, or पेरोज, अम्, n. a turquoise (= Pers. فيروزه).
29832: पेरा पेरा, f. a kind of musical instrument.
29833: पेरु 2. पेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. 1. पृ; for 1. पेरु see above), Ved. drawing through, carrying across; leading through, delivering, rescuing; (Sāy. = पूरक, as if fr. rt. पॄ।)
29834: पेरु 3. पेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. प्यै), Ved. swelling; causing to ferment; (Sāy. = सर्वस्य रक्षक, as if fr. rt. 3. पा); (उस्), m. a limb, member (?).
29835: पेरुक पेरुक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
29836: पेल् पेल्, cl. 1. 10. P. पेलति, पेलितुम्, पेलयति, -यितुम्, to go, move.
29837: पेल, अस्, m. going; a small part; (अम्), n. a testicle.
29839: पेलव, अस्, आ, अम्, delicate, fine, soft, tender; thin, slim, slender. —पेलव-पुष्प, अम्, n. a tender flower.
29840: पेलि, (perhaps) = पेलिन्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 86.
29841: पेलिन्, ई, m. a horse. —पेलि-शाला, f. a horse-stable.
29842: पेलोज पेलोज, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Śiva.
29843: पेव् पेव् [cf. rt. पेब्], cl. 1. A. पेवते, पेवितुम्, a various reading for rt. सेव्, q. v.
29844: पेश पेश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पिश्), Ved. = पेशस्, q. v.; [cf. पुरु-प्°।]
29845: पेशन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. well formed, well made; decorated, adorned.
29846: पेशल, अस्, आ, अम्, artificially formed, adorned, decorated; beautiful, charming, lovely, pleasant; soft, smooth, tender; skilful, dexterous, expert, clever, ingenious; fraudulent, deceitful, crafty; (अम्), n. beauty, loveliness; [cf. Gr. ποικ-ίλο-ς, ποικἰλλ-ω: Lat. ping-o, pic-tor, pic-tura: Old Germ. feh, ‘variegated:’ Slav. pĭstrŭ, ‘variegated;’ pis-ati, ‘to write:’ Lith. pisz-nu-s, ‘splendid.’] —पेशल-त्व, अम्, n. dexterity, skill. —पेशल-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, slender-waisted, having a delicate or slender waist.
29847: पेशस्, अस्, n., Ved. shape, form; an artificial figure, ornament, decoration, embroidery; variety of colour, brilliance; gold; [cf. अश्व-प्°, ऋत-प्°।] —पेशस्-कारी, f., Ved. a woman who weaves artistically or embroiders. —पेशस्-कृत्, त्, m. ‘the artist,’ an epi-thet of the hand; a species of insect, a kind of wasp. —पेशस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. decorated, adorned, ornamented.
29848: पेशि, इस्, m. a thunderbolt (for पेषि); (इस्), f. an egg; split pease.
29849: पेशिका, f. (fr. पेशी), rind, shell (of fruit).
29850: पेशितृ, ता, m., Ved. one who cuts in pieces or carves, a carver.
29851: पेशी, f. a piece of flesh or meat [cf. पिशित]; a ball or mass of flesh; the fetus shortly after con-ception; a muscle (of which there are said to be five hundred in the human body); the peel or rind (of fruit); a kind of drum; a sheath, scabbard; a shoe; the egg of a bird; spikenard, Valeriana Jatamansi; a blown bud; N. of a Piśācī; of a Rākṣasī; of a river. —पेशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to cut into pieces, to carve. —पेशी-कोश or पेशी-कोष, अस्, m. a bird's egg. —पेश्य्-अण्ड, अम्, n. a bird's egg; a piece of flesh; the fetus shortly after conception.
29852: पेश्वर, अस्, आ, अम् (? for पेष्वर fr. rt. पिष्), who or what grinds.
29853: पेष् पेष् [cf. rt. येष्], cl. 1. A. पेषते, पेषितुम्, to exert one's self or strive diligently.
29854: पेष पेष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पिष्), pounding, grinding; [cf. शिला-प्°।]
29855: पेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who pounds or grinds, a grinder, grinding, pounding, pulverizing, masti-cating.
29856: पेषण, अम्, n. pounding, grinding, crushing, triturating, pulverizing by means of a mill, (पेषणं या, to be ground); a threshing-floor; a hand-mill, a stone and muller, any apparatus for grinding or pounding; a plant, a species of Euphorbia with three lobes, Euphorbia Antiquorum (= शत-गुप्ता, Ben-gālī तेकाटोसिज). —पेषण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, a word formed for the explanation of पिपिष्वत्।
29857: पेषणि, इस्, ई, f. a stone slab on which condi-ments are ground, a muller, mill-stone, grind-stone.
29858: पेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ground or pounded, fit to be ground or pulverized.
29859: पेषाक, अस्, m. a small slab for grinding anything upon, a grind-stone.
29861: पेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who pounds or crushes, one who grinds, a grinder.
29862: पेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pounded or ground, to be triturated or pulverized.
29863: पेषल पेषल, अस्, आ, अम्, = पेशल, q. v.
29864: पेषी पेषी, f., Ved. (according to Sāy.) = हिंसिका, पिशाचिका, a malevolent spirit, female Pi-śāca; (perhaps) a nurse; spikenard (in this sense a various reading for पेशी, q. v.). —पेषी-कृ, a various reading for पेशी-कृ, q. v.
29865: पेष्ट्र पेष्ट्र, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. rt. 1. पिश्), Ved. a bone.
29866: पेस् पेस् (= rt. पिस्), cl. 1. P. पेसति, पेसितुम्, to go, move.
29867: पेसुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पिस्), Ved. spreading, extending.
29868: पेस्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving; destructive; splendid.
29870: पै पै, cl. 1. P. पायति, पायितुम्, to dry, wither.
29871: पैङ्ग पैङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिङ्ग), belong-ing or relating to a rat or mouse; derived from or composed by Paiṅgya (as a book); acknowledged by the Paiṅgins; (अम्), n., N. of a work; (अस्), m., N. of a teacher (in this sense perhaps a wrong reading for पैङ्ग्य). —पैङ्ग-राज, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of bird.
29872: पैङ्गि, इस्, m. (fr. पिङ्ग), a patronymic of Yāska.
29873: पैङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, derived from Paiṅgya; (ई), m. a follower of Paiṅgya.
29874: पैङ्ग्य, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. पिङ्ग), N. of a teacher; (अम्), n. the doctrine or the manual of Paiṅgya. —पैङ्गी-पुत्र, अस्, m. (fr. पैङ्गी, f. of पैङ्ग्य, + पुत्र), Ved., N. of a teacher.
29875: पैङ्गल पैङ्गल, आस्, m. pl. a patronymic from Piṅgala.
29876: पैङ्गलायन, अस्, or पैङ्गलायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Piṅgala.
29877: पैङ्गल्य, अम्, n. the treatise of Piṅgala; brown or tawny colour.
29878: पैच्छिल्य पैच्छिल्य, अम्, n. (fr. पिच्छिल), sliminess, mucilaginousness.
29879: पैजवन पैजवन, अस्, m. (fr. पिजवन), a patronymic of Su-dās.
29880: पैञ्जूष पैञ्जूष, अस्, m. the ear; [cf. पिञ्-जूष, पेञ्जूष।]
29881: पैटकिक पैटकिक or पैटाकिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पिटाकेन हरति, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 15.
29882: पैठर पैठर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिठर), cooked in a saucepan, boiled in a vessel or pot (as meat &c.).
29883: पैठीनसि पैठीनसि, इस्, or पैठीनस्, आस्, m. patronymic of an ancient teacher, a Muni and author of a system of laws.
29884: पैण् पैण् [cf. rts. पेण्, लैण्, प्रैण्], cl. 1. P. पैणति, पैणितुम्, to go, approach; to command, direct (an act); to send; to touch or embrace; to pound, grind.
29885: पैण्डपातिक पैण्डपातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिण्ड-पात), living on alms.
29886: पैण्डायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Piṇḍa.
29887: पैण्डिन्य, अम्, n. (fr. पिण्डिन्), living on alms, mendicity.
29888: पैतदारव पैतदारव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पीत-दारु), see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 154.
29889: पैतापुत्रीय पैतापुत्रीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-पुत्र), relating to father and son.
29890: पैतामह पैतामह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-मह), belonging or relating to a paternal grand-father; derived or inherited from a grandfather; belonging or relating to Brahmā, derived from Brahmā, governed or presided over by Brahmā; (अस्), m. a son of Brahmā, a patronymic of Manu; (आस्), m. pl. forefathers, ancestors. —पैतामह-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
29891: पैतामहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-मह), be-longing or relating to a grandfather.
29892: पैतृक पैतृक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belong-ing or relating to a father or to ancestors generally, coming or derived from a father, paternal, ancestral; belonging or relating to the Manes, sacred to the Manes; (अम्), n. a sacred rite or Śrāddha in honour of the Manes or deceased ancestors. —पैतृक-धन, अम्, n. ancestral property, patrimony. —पै-तृक-भूमि, इस्, f. the country of one's ancestors, fatherland; a paternal estate.
29893: पैतृमत्य, अस्, m. (fr. पितृ-मत्), sprung from one who has an illustrious father, the grandson of an illustrious man.
29894: पैतृयज्ञिक, Ved. or पैतृयज्ञीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ-यज्ञ), belonging or relating to a sacrifice to the Manes.
29895: पैतृष्वसेय or पैतृष्वस्रीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ-ष्वसृ), sprung from a father's sister or paternal aunt; (अस्), m. a father's sister's son, the son of a paternal aunt; (ई), f. a father's sister's daughter, the daughter of a paternal aunt (see Manu XI. 171).
29896: पैत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belonging or re-lating to a father or to ancestors generally, paternal, ancestral; belonging or relating to the Manes, sacred or consecrated to the Manes; (अम्), n. the part of the hand between the thumb and fore-finger, (ac-cording to others) the root of the fore-finger [cf. पितृ-तीर्थ]; a year or month or day of the Pitṛs. —पैत्राहोरात्र (°र-अह्°), अस्, m. a day and night of the Pitṛs or progenitors (= one month).
29897: पैत्रिक = पैतृक (for which it is probably an incorrect form).
29898: पैत्र्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belonging or re-lating to the Manes.
29899: पैत्त पैत्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पित्त), relating to the bilious humor, proceeding from bile, bilious.
29900: पैत्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bilious, of a bilious tem-perament.
29901: पैत्तल पैत्तल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पित्तल), made of brass, brazen.
29902: पैड्व पैद्व, अस्, m., Ved. scil. अश्व, the horse of Pedu said to be a serpent-killer (Ṛg-veda IX. 88, 4).
29903: पैनाक पैनाक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिनाकिन्), belonging to or coming from Rudra-Śiva; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Pināka.
29904: पैप्पल पैप्पल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिप्पल), made of the wood of the holy fig-tree.
29905: पैप्पलाद, अस्, ई, अम्, derived from Pippalāda; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a school.
29906: पैप्पलादक, अस्, ई, अम्, peculiar to or taught by Pippalāda or Paippalāda; (अम्), n. the treatise or text of Pippalāda.
29907: पैप्पलादि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pippa-lāda; N. of a teacher.
29908: पैयवन पैयवन, an incorrect form for पैजवन, q. v.
29909: पैयूष पैयूष, अम्, n. = पीयूष, q. v.
29910: पैल पैल, अस्, m. a metronymic from Pīlā; N. of a teacher (a sage and promulgator of the Ṛg-veda). —पैल-गर्ग, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पैल-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘offspring of Paila,’ N. of a man.
29911: पैलेय, अस्, m. a metronymic from Pīlā.
29912: पैलव पैलव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पीलु), made of the wood of the Pīlu tree (as the staff borne by a Vaiśya, Manu II. 45).
29913: पैशल्य पैशल्य, अम्, n. (fr. पेशल), kind-liness, graciousness, affability, mildness.
29914: पैशाच पैशाच, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or be-longing to a Piśāca or kind of demon, infernal, demoniacal; पैशाचो ग्रहः, demoniacal possession; (अस्), m. the eighth and lowest from of marriage, one of the eight forms of marriage according to Manu (described in Manu III. 34 as taking place when a lover secretly embraces a damsel either sleeping or intoxicated or disordered in her intellect); a Piśāca or kind of demon; (ई), f. a present made at a religious ceremony to secure friendly regard; a sort of gibberish spoken by demons on the stage [cf. पि-शाच-भाषा]; night; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
29915: पैशाचिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a Piśāca or kind of demon, infernal, demoniacal.
29916: पैशुन पैशुन or पैशुन्य, अम्, n. (fr. पि-शुन), the act of informing or giving information, tale-bearing, backbiting, calumny, espionage, report-ing evil of others, malignity, roguery, depravity, wickedness.
29917: पैष्ट पैष्ट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिष्ट), made of flour, ground or made up into a cake; (ई), f. spirituous liquor distilled from meal or extracted from bruised rice.
29918: पैष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिष्ट), made of meal or flour; (अम्), n. a quantity of cakes; spirituous liquor distilled from meal.
29919: पोगण्ड पोगण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, not full-grown or adult, young; deformed, deficient in a member; having a redundant member; (अस्), m. a boy, one from his fifth to his sixteenth year; [cf. अ-प्°।]
29920: पौगण्ड, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to a boy, boyish; (अम्), n. boyhood (a period lasting from the fifth to the tenth year).
29922: पोट पोट, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पुट्), the foundation of a house [cf. पोत]; putting to-gether, uniting, mixing; (आ), f. a woman with a beard; a hermaphrodite; a female servant or slave; (ई), f. the rectum; a large alligator. —पोट-गल, अस्, m. a species of reed, Arundo Tibialis; a kind of grass, Saccharum Spontaneum; a fish.
29924: पोटाय, Nom. A. पोटायते, &c., = पोटां कृ।
29925: पोटलक पोटलक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), or पोटलिका, f. a bundle or packet.
29927: पोटिक पोटिक, अस्, m. a boil.
29928: पोट्टिल पोट्टिल, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of the ninth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
29929: पोडु पोडु, उस्, m. the parietal bone, the bone forming the upper part of the skull.
29930: पोत पोत, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पू, but probably fr. a lost rt. पु, ‘to beget’), the young of any animal [cf. मृग-प्°]; a colt, foal; a young elephant ten years old; a young plant or tree, the young shoot of a plant; a fetus which has no enveloping mem-brane; cloth, a garment; the foundation of a house [cf. पोट]; the site of a house or dwelling; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a vessel, ship, boat; [cf. पुत्र, २। पुंस्; Gr. πῶλο-ς for ποϝ-λο-ς, πωλ-ίο-ν, πά-ϊ(δ)ς for παϝ-ι(δ)ς, πο-ία, πό-α, perhaps ποιέ-ω fr. a form ποιο as in παιδο-ποιό-ς; Lat. pullu-s, Marci-por, pu-er for pov-er, pu-era, pu-su-s, pusa, pū-pu-s, pū-pa, pūpilla, pu-tu-s, pūbes, pum-ilu-s, pumil-io, prœ-pu-tiu-m, pō-mu-m for pov-mu-m, pa-pav-er; Goth. fula (n), fula = Old Germ. folo = Eng. foal; Lith. pauta-s, ‘an egg.’] —पोत-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced or de-veloped from a fetus which has no enveloping mem-brane (said of elephants and certain other quadrupeds, as opposed to men, cattle, &c., which are called जरायु-ज). —पोत-धारिन्, ई, m. a ship-owner, master of a vessel. —पोत-प्लव, अस्, m., Ved. ‘floating in a ship,’ a seaman, mariner. —पोत-बणिज्, क्, m. ‘ship-merchant,’ a voyaging merchant, sea-faring trader. —पोत-भङ्ग, अस्, m. shipwreck. —पोत-रक्ष, अस्, m. ‘ship-governing,’ a large paddle used for a rudder, the rudder of a boat. —पोत-वाह, अस्, m. ‘boat-conductor,’ a rower, boatman, steersman, one of the crew who keeps watch at the mast-head. —पोताच्छादन (°त-आच्°), अम्, n. ‘cloth-covering,’ a tent. —पोता-धान (°त-आध्°), अम्, n. small fry, a shoal of young fish.
29931: पोतक, अस्, m. the young of any animal; a young plant or tree (e. g. चूत-पोतक, a young mango-tree); N. of a Nāga; the site or foundation of a house [cf. गृह-प्°]; (इका), f. a kind of vegetable, Basella Lucida or Rubra; Anethum Sowa, = शत-पुष्पा; (अकी), f. Basella Lucida or Rubra; a kind of bird, Turdus Macrourus (= श्यामा).
29932: पोतल, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a sea-port on the Indus (the Παράλα of the ancients); N. of the residence of the Dalai Lama in Lhassa (also called पोतरक).
29933: पोतलक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a moun-tain (= पोतल?). —पोतलक-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond of the mountain Potalaka,’ N. of a Buddha; of a Jina or deified teacher of the Jainas.
29934: पोतु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पू), = मानभाण्ड-शोधक।
29935: पोतृ, ता, m. ‘the purifier,’ an epithet of one of the sixteen officiating priests (ऋत्व्-इज्) at a sacrifice, the assistant of the Brahman, (Sāy. = पोतृ-नाम-कर्त्विज् or यज्ञस्य शोधयितृ); an epithet of Viṣṇu.
29936: पोत्या, f. = पोतानां समूहः, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 49.
29937: पोत्र, अम्, n. the Soma vessel of the Potṛ, the office of the Potṛ, (Sāy. = पोत्रा कृतं कर्म, पोतुर् यज्ञः); a ship, boat [cf. पोत]; the snout of a hog; a ploughshare; a dress, garment (?); a thunderbolt (?). —पोत्र-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘snout-orb,’ the round snout (of a hog &c.). —पोत्रा-युध (°र-आय्°), अस्, m. ‘armed with a snout,’ a hog, boar.
29938: पोत्रिन्, ई, m. a hog, boar. —पोत्रि-दंष्ट्रा-ज, अस्, m. ‘produced in the tusk of a boar,’ a kind of gem supposed to be found in the tusk of a boar. —पोत्रि-रथा, f. ‘hog-vehicled,’ (with Buddhists) an epithet of Māyā; (with Jainas) N. of a Śakti or female divinity.
29939: पोत्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating or belonging to the Potṛ.
29940: पोपुव, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. Intens. of rt. 1. पू), purifying or cleansing much or repeatedly.
29941: पौतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, connected with a boat (as a cargo &c.).
29942: पोताल पोताल, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman; a wrong reading for पोतल, p. 598, col. 3.
29943: पोतास पोतास, अस्, m. a species of camphor; [cf. Eng. potash.]
29944: पोतिमत्सक पोतिमत्सक, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
29945: पोथकी पोथकी, f. a kind of ulcer on the eyelids, red pimples on the eyelids.
29946: पोथिक पोथिक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), in अव-प्°, a machine for hurling down stones, fire-brands, and fiery darts upon the enemy, a kind of ballista (?); [cf. सोल्कालातावपोथिक।]
29947: पोयालदह पोयालदह, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a tank or pool.
29948: पोर पोर, अस्, m. in नील-प्°, q. v.
29949: पोल पोल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुल्), magnitude, bulk; a heap, quantity.
29950: पोलिका पोलिका, f. flat cakes made of barley or wheat, &c.; [cf. पूलिका, पौली, पूपाली।]
29951: पोली, f. a kind of cake.
29952: पोलिन्द पोलिन्द, अस्, m. the mast or the ribs of a ship or boat; [cf. पदार, पादारक, पादालिन्द।]
29953: पोविय पोविय, अस्, m., N. of the father of the commentator Gaṅga-dāsa.
29954: पोष पोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुष्), thriving, growth, increase; welfare, prosperity, plenty, abun-dance; nourishing, cherishing; maintaining, sup-porting.
29955: पोषक, अस्, m. one who feeds or nourishes; a nourisher, supporter, breeder, keeper.
29956: पोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, nourishing, cherishing [cf. पक्ष-प्°]; bringing up, breeding; (अम्), n. the act of nourishing, cherishing, fostering, supporting.
29957: पोषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cherished or pro-tected, to be nourished.
29958: पोषयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, nourishing, cherishing, one who breeds or rears.
29959: पोषयित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, causing to grow, nourish-ing, cherishing (Ved.); (उस्), m. (according to a Scholiast) the Koïl or Kokila or Indian cuckoo; (probably) a crow.
29960: पोषयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. causing to thrive, nourishing, causing prosperity or welfare, advan-tageous.
29961: पोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, nourished, cherished, fostered, supported.
29962: पोषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cherished or pro-tected.
29963: पोषितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, nourishing, feeding; one who breeds or rears.
29964: पोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, nourishing, bringing up, rearing.
29965: पोषुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. prospering, growing.
29966: पोष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a nourisher, cherisher, one who brings up; (टा), m. a protector, nourisher, cherisher; grey bonduc. —पोष्टृ-वर, अस्, आ, अम्, the best of nourishers, nourishing best.
29967: पोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, well-fed, thriving; causing welfare or prosperity, prosperous; to be nourished or cherished, to be taken care of, to be fed, to be brought up; copious. —पोष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being one who is to be cherished; being taken care of. —पोष्य-पुत्र or पोष्य-पुत्रक, अस्, m. ‘a son to be brought up,’ an adopted son. —पोष्यपुत्र-करण, अम्, n. adoption. —पोष्य-वर्ग, अस्, m. a class of persons or objects to be cherished, as parents, children, guests, and the sacred fire; a family, house-hold. —पोष्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. causing pros-perity; (Sāy. = बहु-पोष्य-जन-युक्त।)
29968: पोषध पोषध, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) renewal of religious vows.
29969: पोषधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) one who renews religious vows.
29970: पौंश्चलीय पौंश्चलीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुंश्-चली), belonging or relating to harlots, meretricious.
29971: पौंश्चलेय, अस्, m., Ved. the son of a harlot.
29972: पौंश्चल्य, अम्, n. female incontinency, harlotry.
29973: पौंसवन पौंसवन, अम्, n. (fr. पुं-स-वन), one of the Saṃskāras or essential ceremonies of the Hindū religion; a religious observance held when signs of a living conception take place (in order to obtain male offspring).
29974: पौंस्न पौंस्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. पुंस्), worthy of or fit for a man; relating to or good for man; manly, virile; human; (अम्), n. manhood, manly strength.
29975: पौंस्य, अम्, n., Ved. manhood, virility, manly power; the courage or virtue of a man, a manly deed (Sāy. = बल); (अस्, &c.), masculine.
29977: पौञ्जिष्ठ पौञ्जिष्ठ or पौञ्जिष्ट (?), अस्, m., Ved. (= पुञ्जिष्ठ), a fisherman; (आस्), m. pl. a patronymic.
29978: पौण्डरीक पौण्डरीक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुण्ड-रीक), consisting of lotus-flowers; (अस्), m. a kind of Soma sacrifice lasting twelve days (Ved.); a pa-tronymic of Kṣema-dhṛtvan; (अम्), n., scil. कुष्-ठ, a kind of leprosy; a species of plant (= प्र-पौण्डरीक). —पौण्डरीक-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a ritual work containing the prayers used at the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.
29979: पौण्डर्य पौण्डर्य, अम्, n. a kind of drug used as a remedy for diseased eyes (= पुण्डर्य, q. v.).
29980: पौण्ड्र पौण्ड्र, अस्, m. (fr. पुण्ड्र), a species of sugar-cane of a pale straw colour; N. of a country (said to include part of South Behar and Bengal); N. of a king of this country (regarded as a son of Vasu-deva); N. of the conch-shell of Bhīṣma; a mark, sectarial mark; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, the inhabitants of the Pauṇḍra country.
29981: पौण्ड्रक, अस्, ई, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) = पौण्ड्र; (अस्), m. the pale straw-coloured species of sugar-cane; epithet of a particular mixed caste of hereditary sugar-boilers, (the son of a Vaiśya by a woman of the distiller class; regarded as one of the degraded races of Kṣatriyas, Manu X. 44); a king of the Pauṇḍras; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, the Pauṇḍras.
29982: पौण्ड्रनागर, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 3, 24.
29983: पौण्ड्रमात्स्यक, अस्, m. (probably) a king of the Puṇḍras and Matsyas.
29984: पौण्ड्रवत्स, आस्, m. pl. (fr. पुण्ड्र + वत्स), N. of a school.
29985: पौण्ड्रवर्धन, अम्, n., N. of a city, = पुण्ड्र-वर्धन; (अस्), m., N. of a country, one of the divisions of central India, Behar.
29986: पौण्ड्रिक, अस्, m. a pale straw-coloured variety of the sugar-cane; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
29987: पौण्य पौण्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुण्य), up-right, righteous, virtuous, deserving good treatment.
29988: पौतन पौतन (perhaps fr. पूतना), N. of a country or people.
29989: पौतव पौतव, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पू), a measure; (also spelt यौतव।)
29991: पौतिकी पौतिकी, f. = पूतिका, a kind of vegetable.
29992: पौतिनासिक्य पौतिनासिक्य, अम्, n. (fr. पूति-नासिका), fetor of the nostrils.
29993: पौतिमाषीपुत्र पौतिमाषी-पुत्र, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a teacher.
29994: पौतिमाष्य, अस्, m., Ved. (a patronymic fr. पूति-माष), N. of a teacher.
29995: पौतिमाष्यायण, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Pautimāṣya.
29996: पौत्तिक पौत्तिक, अम्, n. (fr. पुत्तिका), scil. मधु, the honey of the small bee called पुत्तिका; pale-coloured honey.
29997: पौत्र 1. पौत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुत्र), de-rived from a son or from children, belonging or relating to a son or to children; (अस्), m. a son's son, grandson; (ई), f. a granddaughter (either in the male or female line, though more usually implying a son's daughter); an epithet of Durgā.
29998: पौत्रजीविक, अम्, n. (fr. पुत्र-जीव), an amulet made of the nuts of the tree Putranjiva Roxburghii.
29999: पौत्राघ (°र-अघ°), अम्, n., Ved. any injury or evil happening to children.
30000: पौत्राद्य, perhaps a wrong reading for the pre-ceding.
30001: पौत्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pautra.
30002: पौत्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुत्र or 1. पौत्र), belonging to a son or grandson; (अस्), m. the son of a Putrikā (?); a patronymic from Putrika (?).
30003: पौत्रिकेय, अस्, m. (fr. पुत्रिका), the son of a daughter appointed to raise issue for her father. —पौत्रिकेय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having for a grand-son the son of a daughter appointed to raise issue.
30004: पौत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. 1. पौत्र), having a grandson.
30005: पौत्र 2. पौत्र, अम्, n. (fr. पोतृ, q. v.), Ved. the office of the Potṛ.
30006: पौदन्य पौदन्य, अम्, n., N. of a city.
30007: पौनःपुनिक पौनःपुनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनः-पुनः), frequently reiterated, repeated again and again.
30008: पौनःपुन्य, अम्, n. frequent reiteration, con-stant repetition; (एन), ind. again and again, re-peatedly.
30009: पौनराधेयिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-आधेय), Ved. relating to the rite of replacing or renewing the sacrificial fire; [cf. पुनर्-आधेयिक।]
30010: पौनरुक्त, अम्, n. (fr. पुनर्-उक्त), repe-tition, tautology.
30011: पौनरुक्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa Ukthādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 60.
30013: पौनर्नव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-नवा), relat-ing or belonging to the plant Boerhavia Procumbens.
30014: पौनर्भव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पुनर्-भू), re-peated, additional; relating or belonging to a widow who has married a second husband; (अस्), m. the son of a widow remarried, the offspring of a twice-married woman by her second husband, one of the sons or heirs admitted by the old Hindū law; पौ-नर्भवो भर्ता, a woman's second husband.
30015: पौनर्भविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-भव), relating to regeneration.
30016: पौम्पा पौम्पा, f., N. of a sacred lake.
30017: पौर 1. पौर, अस्, m. (fr. 1. पुर् or fr. rt. पॄ?), Ved. ‘filling, sating,’ an epithet of Soma (Sāy. = उदर-पूरक); ‘filler, increaser,’ an epithet of the Aśvins; an epithet of Indra (Sāy. = पूरयितृ); N. of a Ṛṣi the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 73, 74; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a dynasty.
30018: पौर 2. पौर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुर, see 3. पुर्), belonging to a town or city, produced in a town or city; (अस्), m. a townsman, burgher, citizen (op-posed to जानपद); = नागर, a term for a prince engaged in war under certain circumstances and (in astrology) applied to a planet in a state of opposition to other planets; (ई), f. the language or conversation of the servants in a palace; (अम्), n. a species of fragrant grass (= रौहिष). —पौर-जन, अस्, m. a person belonging to the town, townsman, citizen. —पौर-जानपद, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to town and country; (आस्), m. pl. citizens and rustics, towns-men and country people. —पौर-योषित्, त्, or पौर-स्त्री or पौराङ्गना (°र-अङ्°), f. a woman living in a town or city. —पौर-लोक, आस्, m. pl. city people, citizens. —पौर-वृद्ध, अस्, m. a distinguished or eminent citizen, alderman. —पौर-सख्य, अम्, n. fellow-citizenship, connection or equality with others formed by inhabiting the same city for ten years.
30019: पौरक, अस्, m. a garden in the neighbourhood of a city; a garden round a house.
30020: पौरञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung or descended from Purañ-jana and Purañ-janī.
30021: पौरन्दर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरन्-दर), be-longing or relating to Indra, derived or coming from Indra, sacred to Indra; (अम्), n. the Nakṣatra Jyeṣṭhā.
30022: पौरिक, अस्, m. (fr. पुर), a townsman, citizen; a governor of a city; N. of a prince of the city of Purikā; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
30023: पौरेय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to a town or city, civic.
30024: पौरव पौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूरु), be-longing to or descended from Pūru, of the race of Pūru; (अस्), m. a descendant of Pūru; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants or the race of Pūru; N. of a people in the north or north-east of India; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Vasu-deva; of the wife of Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
30025: पौरवक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
30026: पौरवतन्तव, अस्, m. (probably fr. पूरु + तन्तु), in पर-प्°, q. v.
30027: पौरवीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूरु), devoted to Paurava.
30028: पौरस्त्य पौरस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पुरस्), situated in front, foremost; eastern; previous, pre-ceding, former, prior, first, initial.
30029: पौराण पौराण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुराण), belonging or relating to the past, of the past, of ancient occurrence, derived from or belonging to past ages, primeval, ancient; belonging to former times, former, previous; relating to the Purāṇas.
30030: पौराणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the past or to past ages; familiar with the events and legends of the past; relating or belonging to the Purāṇas, Paurānic; worth a Purāṇa, of the value of one Purāṇa; (अस्), m. a Brāhman well-read in the Purāṇas or a public expounder of them; a mythologist.
30032: पौरुकुत्स पुरुकुत्स, अस्, or पौरुकुत्सि, इस्, or पौरुकुत्स्य, अस्, m. (fr. पुरु-कुत्स), a patronymic of Trasa-dasyu.
30033: पौरुमड्ग पौरुमद्ग, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
30034: पौरुमह्न पौरुमह्न, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-मह्न), N. of various Sāmans.
30035: पौरुमीढ पौरुमीढ or पौरुमीऌह, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-मीढ), N. of various Sāmans.
30036: पौरुशिष्टि पौरुशिष्टि, इस्, m. (fr. पुरु + शिष्ट), Ved., N. of a teacher.
30037: पौरुष पौरुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुष), belonging or relating to a man or to man in general, manly, virile, human; relating or belonging to Pu-rusha, sacred to Puruṣa; being of the length of a man with both arms elevated and the fingers ex-tended; (अस्), m. (according to Kullūka) = पुरुष-वाह्य-भार, a weight or load which can be carried by one man; (ई), f. a woman; (अम्), n. manhood, manliness, manly strength or courage, heroism, strength, power, vigour; human action, action of men, man's work, action; effort, exertion; the measure of a man, the height to which he reaches with both arms elevated and the fingers extended; generation; semen virile; the penis; a sun-dial. —पौरुष-ता, f. or पौरुष-त्व, अम्, n. man-hood, manly strength or spirit.
30038: पौरुषमेधिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुष-मेध), Ved. relating or belonging to a human sacrifice.
30039: पौरुषविधिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पुरुष-विध, man-like, resembling man, human.
30040: पौरुषांसकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the school of Pu-ruṣāṃsaka.
30041: पौरुषाद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुषाद), relating or belonging to man-eaters or cannibals.
30042: पौरुषिक, अस्, m. a worshipper of Puruṣa.
30043: पौरुषेय, अस्, ई, अम्, derived from or relating to man, incidental to man, made by man, human, manly, male, virile; coming from the soul, spiritual; (अस्), m. a hireling, day-labourer; a crowd or num-ber of men (?); manslaughter, murder; law as affecting persons; (अम्), n. human action, the work of man. —पौरुषेय-त्व, अम्, n. humanity, human origin, the human element (in sacred writings).
30044: पौरुष्य, अस्, -षी, अम्, relating to Puruṣa; (अम्), n. manliness, manly strength or courage.
30045: पौरुहन्मन पौरुहन्मन, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-हन्मन्), N. of various Sāmans.
30046: पौरुहूत पौरुहूत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरु-हूत), belonging to Indra.
30047: पौरूरवस पौरूरवस, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Purū-ravas; (अस्), m. a patronymic.
30049: पौरोगव पौरोगव, अस्, m. (fr. पुरो-गव), an overseer or superintendent of a royal household, especially the inspector of the royal kitchen.
30050: पौरोडाश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरो-डाश), see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 62; (अस्), m. a Mantra recited upon making an oblation of clarified butter.
30051: पौरोडाशिक, अस्, m. (fr. पुरो-डाश), a priest who recites the Mantra used in offering an oblation of clarified butter.
30052: पौरोधस, अस्, m. a patronymic from Puro-dhas; (अम्), n. the office or function of a family priest.
30053: पौरोभाग्य, अम्, n. (fr. पुरो-भागिन्), envy, jealousy, malevolence, ill-will, censoriousness; ob-trusiveness.
30054: पौरोहित, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरो-हित), belonging to a Puro-hita, coming or proceeding from a family priest.
30055: पौरोहित्य, अस्, -ती, अम्, belonging to the family of a Puro-hita; (अम्), n. the character or office of a family priest.
30056: पौर्णदर्व पौर्णदर्व, अम्, n. = पूर्ण-दर्व, q. v.
30057: पौर्णमास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्ण-मास), re-lating or belonging to the full moon, usual or cus-tomary at full moon, having the full moon; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a ceremony performed at the full moon by persons maintaining a perpetual fire; a patro-nymic; N. of a son of Marīci and Sambhūti; of a prince of the Āndhra dynasty; (अम्), n. a day of full moon; (ई), f. a day or night of full moon.
30058: पौर्णमासायन, अम्, n. (fr. the preceding), Ved. a kind of sacrifice offered at the full moon.
30059: पौर्णमासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पौर्णमास), used for the sacrifice offered at the full moon.
30060: पौर्णमास्य, अम्, n., scil. कर्मन्, a sacrifice offered at the full moon.
30061: पौर्णमी, f. a day of full moon (= पूर्णिमा).
30062: पौर्णिम, अस्, m. (fr. पूर्णिमा), an ascetic; (आ), f. a day of full moon.
30063: पौर्त पौर्त, अम्, n. (fr. पूर्त), scil. कर्-मन्, a meritorious work (= पूर्त).
30064: पौर्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a meritorious work (as the feeding of a Brāhman &c.).
30065: पौर्व पौर्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व), relating or belonging to the past; relating to the east, eastern.
30066: पौर्वदेहिक or पौर्वदैहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-देह), belonging or relating to a former body, belonging or relating to a former life or existence; derived from a former existence, done in a former life.
30067: पौर्वपञ्चालक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-पञ्-चाल), = पूर्वः पञ्चालानाम्।
30068: पौर्वपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-पद), relating to the first member of a compound; (pro-bably) pronouncing the first member of a compound (in teaching).
30069: पौर्ववर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पूर्वासु वर्-षासु भवः, Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 3, 11.

30071: पौर्वातिथ, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Pūrvātithi; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
30072: पौर्वापर्य, अम्, n. (fr. पूर्वापर), priority and posteriority, the relation of prior and posterior, succession, continuity.
30073: पौर्वार्ध or पौर्वार्धिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्वार्ध), living or situated on the eastern side of (with gen.).
30074: पौर्वाह्णिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्वाह्ण), be-longing or relating to the morning, produced in the forenoon, matutinal; (often wrongly spelt पौर्वाह्-निक।)
30075: पौर्विक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व), former, pre-vious, prior, primary; ancient, old; ancestral; (ई), f. an ancestress.
30076: पौलस्त्य पौलस्त्य, अस्, -स्ती, अम्, relating to or descended from Pulasti or Pulastya; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Pulasti or Pulastya; an epithet of Kuvera; of Rāvaṇa; of Vibhīṣaṇa; of the moon; N. of an astronomer; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the brothers of Dur-yodhana; (पौलस्ती), f. a patro-nymic of Śūrpa-ṇakhā the sister of Rāvaṇa.
30077: पौलि पौलि, इस्, ई, m. f. grain half dressed or scorched or fried with ghee and made into a sort of cake.
30078: पौलिका, f. a kind of cake (= पौलि; perhaps an error for पोलिका).
30079: पौलिश पौलिश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुलिश), de-rived from or composed by Puliśa. —पौलिश-सिद्-धान्त, अस्, m., N. of an astronomical work.
30080: पौलुषि पौलुषि, इस्, m. (fr. पुलुष), Ved. a patronymic of Satya-yajña.
30081: पौलोम पौलोम, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or treating of Pulomā, an epithet of Adhyāyas 4-12 of the Ādi-parva of the Mahā-bhārata; relating to Puloman or Pulomā or Paulomī; descended from Puloman or Pulomā; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of demons; (ई), f. the daughter of Puloman, an epithet of the wife of Indra; (अस्), m. an epithet of Indra; a Muni. —पौलोमी-मङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, as for-tunate or happy as Paulomī. —पौलोमी-सम्भव, अस्, m. born from Paulomī, son of Paulomī (an epithet of Jayanta, q. v.).
30082: पौल्कस पौल्कस, अस्, m., Ved. (= पुल्कस, said to be) the son of a Niṣāda or of a Śūdra father and of a Kṣatriyā mother.
30083: पौष पौष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्य), relating to or occurring at the time when the moon is in the asterism Puṣya; (अस्), m., N. of a month, the month Pauṣa (December-January, when the full moon is in the asterism Puṣya); N. of the third year in the twelve years' cycle of Jupiter; (ई), f. the night or day of full moon in the month Pauṣa; (अम्), n. a festival or a particular festival; a fight, combat; N. of various Sāmans; [cf. पौष्य।]
30084: पौष्कर पौष्कर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्कर), relating to the blue lotus-flower, made or consisting of blue lotuses, treating of the blue lotus; (with प्रादुर्-भाव) the appearance of Viṣṇu in the form of a lotus-flower; belonging to or derived from Costus Speciosus or C. Arabicus; (अम्), n. the root or fruit of the plant Costus Speciosus or C. Arabicus.
30085: पौष्करक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the blue lotus-flower, consisting of blue lotuses; (with प्रा-दुर्-भाव) the appearance of Viṣṇu in the form of a lotus-flower.
30086: पौष्करसादि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. पुष्-कर-सद्), N. of a grammarian.
30087: पौष्करिणी, f. = पुष्करिणी, a lotus-pool, a large pond or reservoir.
30088: पौष्करेयक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 95.
30089: पौष्कल पौष्कल, अस्, m. (fr. पुष्कल), a species of grain; (अम्), n., N. of various Sāmans.
30090: पौष्कलावति, इस्, m. (fr. पुष्कला-वती), N. of a physician.
30091: पौष्कल्य, अम्, n. full growth, maturity, com-plete development.
30092: पौष्टिक पौष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्टि), relating to or promoting growth or welfare; nutri-tious, nourishing, nutritive, fattening, invigorating; preservative, protective; (अम्), n. a cloth worn dur-ing the ceremony of tonsure.
30093: पौष्टी, f. (probably fr. पुष्ट), N. of the wife of Pūru.
30094: पौष्ण पौष्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Pūṣan, sacred to Pūṣan; relating to the sun; (अम्), n. the last of the twenty-eight lunar asterisms; the Nakṣatra Revatī.
30095: पौष्प पौष्प, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्प), re-lating or belonging to flowers, coming from flowers, made of flowers, flowery, floral; (ई), f. the city of Pāṭali-putra (= पुष्प-पुर).
30096: पौष्पक, अम्, n. oxide of brass considered as a collyrium, green vitriol.
30097: पौष्पिञ्जि पौष्पिञ्जि, इस्, m. a patronymic; N. of a teacher; (also read पौष्यिञ्जि।)
30098: पौष्पिण्ड्य पौष्पिण्ड्य, अस्, m., N. of an ancient teacher.
30099: पौष्य पौष्य, अस्, -षी (?) , अम् (fr. पुष्य), relating to the asterism Puṣya; (fr. पौष्य), re-lating to or treating of king Pauṣya, an epithet of the third Adhyāya of the Ādi-parva of the Mahā-bhārata; (अस्), m., N. of a prince the son of Pūṣan and king of Karavīra-pura.
30100: प्ना प्ना, f. the braided hair of Śiva.
30101: प्याट् प्याट्, ind. a particle used in calling, ho! holla!
30102: प्याय् प्याय्। See rt. प्यै below.
30103: प्युक्ष्ण प्युक्ष्ण, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a covering for a bow (made of sinews or of the skin of a serpent, see Kātyāyana's Śrauta-s. XV. 3, 31).
30104: प्युष् प्युष्, cl. 4. 10. P. प्युष्यति, प्यो-षयति, &c., a various reading for rt. व्युष्, q. v.
30105: प्युस् प्युस्, cl. 4. P. प्युस्यति, &c., a various reading for rt. व्युष्, q. v.
30106: प्यै प्यै or प्याय् (developed out of a Vedic rt. पी; cf. rt. पिन्व्), cl. 1. A. प्या-यते (Ved. पयते), पिप्ये (Ved. पीपाय), प्यास्-यते, प्यायिष्यते, अप्यास्त, अप्यायिष्ट, अप्यायि, प्यातुम्, प्यायितुम्, to swell, become swollen or distended; to be exuberant; to become full; to increase, grow; to overflow; to cause to swell, distend; to fill to excess, overfill, surcharge, cause to run over or overflow: Caus. प्याययति, -यितुम्, (with आ, see आ-प्यै।)
30107: प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, swollen, grown fat, = पीन, q. v.
30108: प्यायन, अस्, ई, अम्, promoting growth or in-crease (according to a Scholiast = वृद्धि-हेतु), causing to thrive; invigorating; (अम्), n. growth, increase.
30109: प्यायित, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, grown fat; increased; strengthened, refreshed; = पीन, q. v.
30110: प्र 1. प्र (as a preposition or prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns, expressing) before, forward, in advance, in front, onward, forth, away (e. g. प्र-गम्, to go forward, proceed; प्र-स्था, to set out; प्र-स्थान, going away, departure; प्र-क्रम्, to walk onwards, to begin, commence).
30111: प्र is also used in the Veda as a separable adverb, and the verb of motion is then sometimes to be supplied, e. g. प्र चक्रियेव रोदसी मरुद्भ्यः, heaven and earth (have been caused) by the Maruts (to roll) onward like two wheels.
30112: प्र is also compounded with nouns not imme-diately connected with verbs in the sense of ‘forth,’ ‘away;’ and before adjectives in the sense of ‘pre-eminently,’ ‘excessively,’ ‘very,’ ‘much;’ [cf. प्र-पौत्र।] According to native lexicographers the senses in which प्र may be used are expressed by the follow-ing Sanskrit words, गति, आ-रम्भ, उत्-कर्ष, सर्वतो-भाव, प्राथम्य, ख्याति, उत्-पत्ति, व्य्-अवहार; [cf. प्र-तरम्, प्र-नप्तृ, प्रथम, परा, पूर्व, प्रातर्: Zend fra-, frā, ‘before, away:’ Gr. πρό, πρό-τερος, πρῶ-το-ς (Dor. πρᾶ-το-ς), πρό-μο-ς, πρύ-τανι-ς (Æol. πρό-τανι-ς), πρίν  for προ-ιν, πρω-ΐ, πρῴην (Dor. πράν), πρόσσω, πρό-σω, πόρ-σω, πόῥῥω: Lat. prō-d, prō, prŏ- in prŏ-nepos, prœ for prai, prīmu-s for pro-imus, pri-or, pris- = prius for pro-ios, pris-tinu-s, pris-cu-s, pran-diu-m, porro, perhaps pru-īna for provīna: Umbr. pru = pro; pre = prœ; perne, ‘in front;’ pernaio, ‘ancient;’ per, ‘for (?):’ Goth. fru-ma, ‘first;’ frum-ist, ‘at first;’ fairra, ‘far:’ Old Germ. fur-iro, ‘former;’ furisto, ‘a prince;’ fruo, ‘early;’ fer, ‘far:’ Angl. Sax. form: Slav. pra-, pro-, ‘before;’ prĭ-vy, ‘first:’ Lith. pra-, ‘before;’ pro, ‘through, for;’ pir-ma-s, ‘first;’ pirm, ‘before:’ Hib. fur, ‘for;’ foir, ‘before;’ perhaps fri, ‘with, by, through, on.’]
30113: प्र 2. प्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पॄ), filling, fulfilling (at the end of a comp., cf. आकूति-प्र, कक्ष्य-प्र, काम-प्र); like, resembling (in इक्षु-प्र, क्षुर-प्र, q. v.).
30114: प्रउग प्र-üग, अम्, n. (according to the commentators fr. प्र-युग), Ved. the forepart of the pole or shafts of a chariot (Sāy. = ईषयोर् अग्रं युग-बन्धन-स्थानम्); उभयतः-प्रüग, having the foreparts of the shafts on both sides; (अस्, अम्), m. n., N. of the second Śastra or hymn at the morning libation. —प्रüग-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. arranged in the form of the forepart of a chariot-pole.
30115: प्रकङ्कत प्र-कङ्कत, अस्, m., Ved. a veno-mous species of reptile; (Sāy.) = प्रकृष्ट-विषो (or प्रकृष्ट-गामी) महोरगः।
30116: प्रकच प्र-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) having the hair erect; [cf. उत्-क्°, वि-क्°।]
30117: प्रकट 1. प्र-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, evident, clear, manifest, apparent, displayed, unfolded, open; public, commonly known, undisguised; visible; प्रकटः सो ऽस्तु, let him show himself; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (अम्), ind. evidently, clearly, manifestly, visibly; openly, undisguisedly, in public; अ-प्र-कटम्, unobservedly; [cf. अव-कट, उत्-क्°, नि-क्°, वि-क्°, सङ्-क्°।] —प्रकट-प्रीति-वर्धन, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —प्रकटी-करण, अम्, n. making visible or apparent, displaying, manifesting. —प्रकटी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to manifest, bring to light, unfold, display. —प्रकटी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested, brought to light, unfolded, displayed. —प्रकटी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become manifest, appear. —प्रकटी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested, manifest.
30118: 2. प्रकट, Nom. P. प्रकटति, प्रकटितुम्, to appear, become manifest.
30119: प्रकटन, अम्, n. manifesting, bringing to light.
30120: प्रकटय, Nom. P. प्रकटयति, -यितुम्, to manifest, make manifest, bring to light; to disclose, evince, display.
30121: प्रकटाय, Nom. P. प्रकटायति, -यितुम्, to manifest, reveal, promulgate, proclaim.
30122: प्रकटित, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested; evident, ap-parent; unfolded, displayed, opened, expanded; publicly proclaimed or exhibited. —प्रकटित-ह-ताशेष-तमस् (°त-अश्°), अस्, ind. having openly destroyed utter darkness.
30123: प्रकण्व प्र-कण्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) freed from evil (said of a place, Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 153).
30124: प्रकथ् प्र-कथ्, cl. 10. P. -कथयति, -यि-तुम्, to announce, proclaim.
30125: प्र-कथन, अम्, n. announcing, proclaiming, relating, communicating.
30126: प्रकम्प् प्र-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -कम्-पितुम्, to tremble, shake, quake, quiver, shudder; to become lax or loose, to be loosened; to vibrate (said of sound): Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble; to swing, wave, brandish, shake.
30127: प्र-कम्प, अस्, m. trembling, quivering, shaking, quaking, staggering, violent motion.
30128: प्र-कम्पन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to tremble; (अस्), m. wind, air; N. of a hell; of an Asura; (अम्), n. great trembling, shaking, swaying to and fro, violent or excessive motion.
30129: प्र-कम्पनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to tremble.
30130: प्र-कम्पमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling violently, shaking, quaking, quivering; becoming lax or loose.
30131: प्र-कम्पयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to tremble, shaking, agitating.
30132: प्र-कम्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling, shaking, mov-ing to and fro.
30133: प्र-कम्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to tremble, to be made to shake; [cf. दुष्-प्°।]
30134: प्रकर 1. and 2. प्र-कर। See under प्र-कृ, p. 602, and प्र-कॄ, p. 603.
30135: प्रकरण प्र-करण, प्र-कर्तव्य, प्र-कर्तृ। See प्र-कृ, p. 602, col. 3.
30137: प्रकर्ष प्र-कर्ष, प्र-कर्षण, &c. See प्र-कृष्, p. 603.
30138: प्रकल् प्र-कल् (see rt. 2. कल्), cl. 10. P. -कालयति, -यितुम्, to drive onwards, chase, pursue; to urge on, incite.
30139: प्र-कालन, अस्, आ, अम्, driving, driving on, chasing, pursuing; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga of the race of Vāsuki.
30140: प्रकला प्र-कला, f. part of a part, a minute portion. —प्रकल-विद्, त्, m., Ved. (according to the Nirukta) ‘knowing, i. e. calculating the smallest particles or sums,’ a merchant; (according to Sāy.) = अ-जानत्, ‘not knowing,’ knowing very little, desti-tute of knowledge, ignorant.
30142: प्रकल्याण प्र-कल्याण, अस्, आ, अम्, very excellent.
30143: प्रकश प्र-कश, अस्, m., Ved. the thong or lash of a whip; hurting, killing.
30144: प्रकस् प्र-कस्, Caus. P. -कासयति, -यितुम्, to drive away, repel, repulse; to cause to bloom.
30145: प्रकाङ्क्ष् प्र-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. -काङ्क्षति, काङ्क्षितुम्, to wish for, desire.
30146: प्रकाण्ड प्र-काण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. the stem or trunk of a tree from the root to the branches; a branch, a shoot; (अस्), m. the upper part of the arm [cf. प्र-गण्ड]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. anything excellent of its kind (at the end of a comp.; cf. गो-प्°, मन्त्रि-प्°).
30147: प्रकाण्डक, अस्, m. = प्र-काण्ड (at the end of a comp.; cf. रक्षः-प्°).
30149: प्रकाम प्र-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, amorous; (अस्), m. desire, delight, pleasure, luxury; (अम्), ind. according to wish or desire, with great pleasure, to the heart's content; voluntarily, willingly; sufficiently; very much; indeed. —प्रकाम-तस्, ind. willingly, with great pleasure or delight, to the heart's content; at will, according to the will. —प्रकाम-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, eating till satisfied, eating enough. —प्रकाम-विस्तार, अस्, m. great expansiveness (according to Malli-nātha = अत्यन्त-विशालता). —प्रकामालोक-नीय-ता (°म-आल्°), f. the being an object that may be viewed at pleasure. —प्रकामोद्य (°म-उद्°), अम्, n., Ved. talking to the heart's content, talkative-ness, garrulity.
30151: प्रकाश् प्र-काश्, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) -काशते (-ति), -काशितुम्, to become visible, come to light, come in sight, appear; to shine, gleam, glitter; to become evident or manifest: Caus. 30318: प्र-गर्जन, अम्, n. roaring, roar; [cf. सिंह-प्°।]
30319: प्र-गर्जित, अम्, n. a roar, noise, din.
30320: प्रगर्धिन् प्र-गर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. गृध् with प्र), Ved. pressing onwards, pressing forwards; eager (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेणाभिकाङ्क्षन्).
30321: प्रगल्भ् प्र-गल्भ्, cl. 1. A. -गल्भते, -गल्-भितुम्, to act with spirit or resolution, behave resolutely, act in a determined manner, be deter-mined; to be arrogant or proud; to be ready or able to (with inf.).
30322: प्र-गल्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, bold, confident; resolute, energetic; prompt, ready; spirited, courageous, brave, intrepid, daring; audacious, proud, arrogant; impudent, shameless; strong, able; eminent, illustrious; mature (as age); (अस्), m. an epithet of the fire employed at the Jāta-karman; N. of a philosophical writer; (आ), f. a bold or confident woman, a woman who courts her husband's caresses, a wanton woman; a scolding woman, shrew; an epithet of Durgā; (अम्), n. in a spirited or determined manner, resolutely. —प्र-गल्भ-कुलाल, अस्, m. a skilful potter. —प्रगल्-भ-ता, f. or प्रगल्भ-त्व, अम्, n. boldness, con-fidence; energy, resolution, resoluteness; audacity, arrogance; power, eminence, consequence; per-verseness, wilfulness.
30323: प्र-गल्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered proud, arro-gant; eminent, conspicuous.
30324: प्रगा प्र-गा, cl. 2. 3. P. -गाति, -जिगाति, गातुम्, to go forwards, proceed, go away, move.
30325: 1. प्र-गाण, अम्, n. (for 2. see under प्र-गै, col. 3), access, approach; [cf. पृथु-प्°।]
30326: प्रगाह् प्र-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्, गाढुम्, Ved. to dive into, enter, penetrate, pervade.
30327: प्र-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, dipped into, steeped, soaked, impregnated [cf. लवण-प्°]; much, exces-sive; hard, difficult; hard, firm; (अम्), n. pain, privation, penance; (अम्), ind. much, exceedingly; earnestly, forcibly; tightly, firmly; in due propor-tion. —प्रगाढ-ता, f. or प्रगाढ-त्व, अम्, n. abundance, excessiveness; hardness.
30328: प्र-गाहन, अम्, n., Ved. dipping or plunging into.
30329: प्रगुण प्र-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having excel-lent qualities, being in a good state or condition, being in the right state or order, straight; honest, upright. —प्रगुणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make straight, put in order, arrange, place in rank and file, array; to spread, make smooth or even.
30331: प्रगुणय, Nom. P. प्रगुणयति, -यितुम्, to make straight.
30332: प्र-गुणित, अस्, आ, अम्, made straight or even, made smooth, smoothed.
30333: प्र-गुणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, straightened, made smooth or even, smoothed.
30334: प्र-गुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having excellent qualities, excellent; more, exceeding.
30335: प्रगुप् प्र-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपयति, -यितुम्, to seek to protect, to guard.
30336: प्र-गोपन, अम्, n. protection, preservation, salvation.
30337: प्रगुर् प्र-गुर्, cl. 6. P. -गुरति, -गुरितुम्, Ved. to cry aloud, exclaim loudly; to make great efforts, make strenuous exertions (Sāy. = अत्यर्थम् उद्युज्).
30338: प्रगॄ प्र-गॄ (see rt. 1. गॄ), cl. 9. P. A. -गृणाति, -गृणीते, -गरितुम्, -गरीतुम्, to announce, praise, extol, celebrate.
30339: प्रगे प्र-गे। See under प्र-गम्, col. 1.
30340: प्रगै प्र-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to begin to sing, sing of, sing, celebrate; to sound, resound.
30341: 2. प्र-गाण, अम्, n. (for 1. see under प्र-गा, col. 2), singing, song.
30342: प्र-गातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a singer, excellent singer.
30343: प्र-गाथ, अस्, m. a strophe, a combination of two verses (viz. of a Bṛhatī or Kakubh followed by a Sato-bṛhatī which by an intermixture of the several Pādas is changed into a triplet); (अस्), m., N. of a man with the patronymics Kāṇva and Ghaura, the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda VIII. 1, 2, 10, 48, 51-54; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the hymns of the eighth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda.
30344: प्र-गायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, singing, beginning to sing.
30345: प्र-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung; one who has begun to sing, singing; resonant with singing, vocal; (अम्), n. song; a sing-song or drawling recitation (regarded as a fault).
30346: प्र-गीति, इस्, f. a kind of metre, containing 30 + 29 syllabic instants.
30347: प्रग्रथन प्र-ग्रथन, अम्, n. the act of connecting or stringing together, intertwining.
30348: प्रग्रस् प्र-ग्रस्, cl. 1. P. A. -ग्रसति, -ते, -ग्रसितुम्, to eat up, devour, swallow, swallow up; to eclipse.
30349: प्रग्रह् प्र-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to hold forth, hold out, stretch forth; to offer; to seize, grasp, clutch, take hold of, take; to receive, accept; to draw up, stop; to draw towards one's self, unite with; to give a friendly reception to, act in a friendly manner towards, favour; to keep separate or isolated (as words &c. not subjected to the rules of Sandhi): Caus. -ग्रा-हयति, -यितुम्, to receive, accept.
30350: प्र-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, held in front, held out; received, accepted, admitted; pronounced separately without observing the usual rules of Sandhi [cf. 1. प्र-गृह्य]; collected, strung together (?). —प्रगृहीत-पद, अस्, m., scil. सन्धि, a suspension of Sandhi in which the vowels remain unaltered.
30351: 1. प्र-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or accepted, to be admitted; (in grammar) to be taken or pro-nounced separately, not subject to the rules of Sandhi or euphony (as the final ई, ऊ, and ए of the dual terminations whether of nouns, pronouns, or verbs, e. g. कवी एतौ, ‘these two poets;’ बन्धू एतौ, ‘these two relations’).
30352: 2. प्र-गृह्य, ind. having taken or grasped, car-rying away with; with.
30353: प्र-गृह्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being taken or seized.
30354: प्र-ग्रह, अस्, m. holding in front, holding forth, holding out, stretching forth; taking, taking or laying hold of, grasping, clutching, seizing (e. g. अङ्ग-प्°, the seizing of the limbs [by a demon], pain in the limbs); the seizing or grasping of the sun or moon, beginning of an eclipse [cf. ग्रह]; kind or friendly reception, kindness, favour; a rein, bridle, rope or halter for horses, lash, thong, whip, scourge; the cord or string suspending a balance; a guide, leader, ruler; a ray of light; a prisoner, captive, either man or beast in confinement; bind-ing; taming, breaking (a horse); the arm; a species of plant, Cassia Fistula; (in grammar) a vowel not subject to the rules of Sandhi; epithet of a particular sacrificial rite (more fully written प्रग्रह-होम); an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa. —प्रग्रह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, (at the end of a comp.) having seized, holding; giving a friendly reception, receiving kindly, obliging, kind.
30355: प्र-ग्रहण, अम्, n. taking, seizing, holding, assuming; shutting up, confining; the seizure of sun and moon, i. e. the commencement of an eclipse; offering; a rein, bridle; a check, restraint; the being a leader or guide.
30356: प्र-ग्राह, अस्, m. seizing, taking, taking up, bearing, carrying; a rein; the string of a balance. —प्रग्राह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the string of a balance.
30357: प्रग्रीव प्र-ग्रीव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a window, lattice, balcony (‘projecting like a neck,’ cf. ग्रीवा); a summer-house, pleasure-house; a building on the top of a palace, a painted turret; a wooden balus-trade or fence round a building; a stable; the top of a tree.
30358: प्रग्लै प्र-ग्लै, cl. 1. P. -ग्लायति, -ग्लातुम्, to fade or wither away: Caus. -ग्लापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fade or wither away.
30359: प्र-ग्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearied, fatigued, exhausted.
30360: प्रघट् प्र-घट्, cl. 1. A. -घटते, -घटितुम्, to exert one's self, to apply or devote one's self to; to begin, commence.
30362: प्र-घटा, f. (perhaps) the rudiments or first elements of a science. —प्रघटा-विद्, त्, m. ‘know-ing the rudiments,’ a general reader but not a pro-found one.
30363: प्रघट्टक प्र-घट्टक, अस् or अम् (fr. rt. घट्ट् with प्र), a precept, rule, doctrine.
30364: प्रघण प्र-घण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with प्र), a porch before the door of a house, a terrace be-fore a house; an iron mace or crowbar; a copper pot.
30365: प्र-घन, अस्, m. a covered terrace before a house; a species of bean, Phaseolus Mungo (a wrong reading for प्रथन).
30366: प्र-घाण, अस्, m. a covered terrace or small portico before the door of a house; an iron mace or hand-spike; a copper pot; the trunk of a tree.
30367: प्र-घात, अस्, m. a combat, battle; the edging of a garment.
30368: प्र-घान, अस्, m. a covered terrace before the door of a house, porch, portico.
30369: प्रघस प्र-घस, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. घस् with प्र), voracious; an epithet of false gods; (अस्), m., N. of a Rakṣas; N. of a monkey fol-lower of Rāma; a Daitya, demon; eating much, voracity; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
30370: प्र-घासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or प्र-घास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. voracious (an epithet of the Maruts, ac-cording to Mahī-dhara = पुरोडाश-भक्षण-शील).
30371: प्रघुण प्रघुण, अस्, m. a guest, visitor; (a wrong form for प्राघुण।)
30372: प्रघुष् प्र-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घो-षितुम्, to sound forth, sound: Caus. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sound forth, cause to announce aloud, proclaim.
30374: प्र-घोषिन्, ई, m., Ved. ‘roaring,’ an epithet of one of the nine classes of the Maruts.
30375: प्रघूर्ण प्र-घूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, turning round or rolling violently; wandering, roaming; (अस्), m. a guest, a visitor (in this sense a wrong form for प्राघूर्णक).
30376: प्रघृष् प्र-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, -घर्-षितुम्, to rub to pieces; to rub into, anoint.
30377: प्र-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed in, embrocated, anointed.
30378: प्रचकित प्र-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, shuddering, terrified, startled.
30379: प्रचक्र प्र-चक्र, अम्, n. an army in motion; a foraging army.
30380: प्रचक्ष् प्र-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्-टुम्, to tell, relate, recount, inform; to suppose, consider as, regard as, deem; to call, name: Caus. -चक्षयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to irradiate, illumine.
30381: प्र-चक्षण, see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27, 57.
30382: प्र-चक्षस्, आस्, m. the regent of the planet Jupiter, Bṛhas-pati.
30383: प्रचण्ड प्र-चण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively violent, vehement, impetuous, passionate, furious, enraged, wrathful; very hot or burning; intolerable, insupportable; terrible, terrific; bold, confident, pre-suming; (अस्), m. a species of oleander with white flowers; N. of a Dānava; of a goblin; of a son of Vatsa-prī and Su-nanda; (आ), f. a species of Dūrvā with white flowers; a form or Śakti of Durgā. —प्रचण्ड-घोण, अस्, आ, अम्, large-nosed, hav-ing a large or prominent nose. —प्रचण्ड-ता, f. violence, vehemence; boldness. —प्रचण्ड-पाण्-डव, अम्, n. ‘the wrathful sons of Pāṇḍu,’ N. of a comedy by Rāja-śekhara (= बाल-भारत)। —प्रचण्ड-मूर्ति, इस्, f. ‘oleander-formed,’ a species of tree, Tapia Cratæva. —प्रचण्ड-वर्-मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince (a younger brother of Caṇḍa-varman). —प्रचण्ड-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing a hot or burning sun —प्रचण्ड-सेन, अस्, m. ‘having a formidable army,’ N. of a prince of Tāmra-liptikā. —प्रचण्डातप (°ड-आत्°), अस्, m. fierce or stifling heat.
30384: प्रचत् प्र-चत्, Caus. A. -चातयते, -यितुम्, Ved. to drive away, frighten or scare away; (ac-cording to Sāy.) to destroy utterly, consume.
30385: प्र-चता, ind., Ved. secretly, in secret, clandestinely.
30386: प्रचय प्र-चय, &c. See under प्र-चि, col. 3.
30387: प्रचर् प्र-चर्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -च-रति (-ते), -चरितुम्, to come forth, issue forth, appear; to proceed towards, arrive at, reach, attain; to visit; to roam, wander; to circulate, become current (as a story); to undertake, perform, discharge (especially sacred functions, with inst. of the object or of the means employed); to proceed, behave, act in a particular manner (e. g. भृत्य-वत् प्र-चर्, to act like a servant); to treat (e. g. मिथ्या प्र-चर्, to treat wrongly or unskilfully); to be busied about, to be occupied or engaged in (with loc.); to do, perform, fulfil, practise; to succeed, thrive, prosper: Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to allow to roam, cause to graze, turn out to graze; to make public.
30388: प्र-चर, अस्, m. a road, way, path; usage, cus-tom, currency; going well or widely; N. of a people (in this sense also read प्रच्चर, प्रस्तर).
30389: प्र-चरण, अम्, n. going, proceeding; circu-lating, being current; proceeding with, beginning, undertaking; employing, using; (ई), f., Ved., scil. स्रुच्, a wooden ladle employed for want of a better at a sacrifice.
30390: प्र-चरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be used, being in actual use.
30391: प्र-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forth, going well or quickly, going widely, being current, circulating.
30392: प्र-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, going; pursued, practised (as a profession).
30393: प्र-चरितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proceeded with or undertaken, to be performed.
30394: प्र-चार, अस्, m. coming forth, going forth, ap-pearing, becoming manifest, showing one's self; being in actual use, currency; appearance, manifesta-tion; proceeding, taking place, being used or ap-plied; going, wandering; conduct, behaviour; pre-valence, currency, custom, usage; a play-ground, place of exercise; pasture ground, pasture, pasturage.
30395: प्र-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, allowed to wander or roam about; made public or manifest.
30396: प्र-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming forth, appearing, manifesting one's self; going about, wandering; pro-ceeding with, behaving.
30397: प्रचल् प्र-चल्, cl. 1. P. -चलति, -चलितुम्, to be set in motion, shake, quake, totter, tremble; to move forth, move on, advance; to start up, spring up; to start, set out, set forth, depart; to become troubled or confused, to be perplexed or bewildered, to be excited; to swerve, deviate from (with abl.): Caus. -चलयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, move, jog, wag; -चालयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shake or tremble; to stir up, stir round.
30398: प्र-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, being in motion, trembling, shaking; going well or widely; current, circulating, customary.
30399: प्र-चलक, अस्, m. a venomous species of reptile; [cf. प्र-चलाक।]
30401: प्र-चलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, moving, trembling, shak-ing; going or proceeding far; circulating, being cur-rent or customary; prevailing, being recognised (as authority or law).
30402: प्र-चलन, अम्, n. trembling, shaking, rocking, swaying, tottering; retiring, retreating, fleeing, flight; moving to and fro; going well or widely; circu-lating, being current or customary.
30403: प्र-चलाक, अस्, m. shooting with arrows, archery; a peacock's tail; a snake; another poisonous animal; (आ), f., Ved. a violent shower of rain, a sudden fall of rain in torrents.
30404: प्रचलाकिन्, ई, m. a peacock; a snake; (also spelt प्रचलकिन्।)
30405: प्रचलाय, Nom. P. प्रचलायति, -यितुम्, to move to and fro, to nod the head.
30406: प्रचलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling about, tossing, tumbling, rolled or tossed about (as in a ship); nodding the head (while asleep in a sitting posture); (अम्), n. nodding the head.
30407: प्र-चलित, अस्, आ, अम्, set in motion, moved, shaken; swinging to and fro; rolling (as the eye); gone far or wide, wandering, roving; having set out or moved forwards, having proceeded; current, cus-tomary, circulating; prevailing, recognised, received (as authority or law).
30408: प्र-चालक, अस्, इका, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) causing to tremble, trembling with.
30409: प्र-चालन, अम्, n. stirring, stir; making a noise (?).
30410: प्रचषाल प्र-चषाल, अम्, n. a particular ornament on a sacrificial post.
30411: प्रचाय प्र-चाय। See under प्र-चि below.
30412: प्रचाल प्र-चाल, अस्, m. the neck of the Vīṇā or Indian lute; (a wrong reading for प्र-बाल।)
30413: प्रचि प्र-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to collect, gather, pluck; to cut down, cut to pieces; to increase, augment, enhance: Pass. -चीयते, to be gathered or collected; to grow.
30414: प्र-चय, अस्, m. collecting, gathering (as fruit or flowers, but especially by means of a stick or other implement); a heap, quantity, number; slight union or aggregation; the neutral accentless tone (also called एक-श्रुति); the common increase or difference of the terms in a progression (in algebra). —प्रचय-स्वर, अस्, m. (in Ved. gram.) ‘the most usual tone,’ the accentless or neutral tone neither raised nor depressed (= प्र-चय, प्र-चित, प्रचित-स्वर).
30416: प्र-चाय, अस्, m. or प्र-चायिका, f. gathering (with the hand), plucking, collecting.
30417: प्र-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, gathered, collected, plucked; accumulated, amassed; covered, filled; accentless or An-udātta, = प्र-चय; (अस्), m. a kind of Daṇḍaka metre (also called प्रचितक). —प्रचित-स्वर = प्रचय-स्वर, q. v.
30418: प्र-चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, gathering, collecting, plucking; (अन्), m., N. of a son of Janam-ejaya.
30420: प्रचित् प्र-चित्, cl. 3. P. A. -चिकेत्ति, -चि-कित्ते, -चेतितुम्, Ved. to know; to make known, announce, proclaim; to become visible or percep-tible, appear: Caus. P. -चेतयति, -यितुम्, to make known, cause to appear; to observe, notice, remark, perceive; (A.) to appear: Desid. -चिकित्सति, to show, point out.
30421: प्र-चिकित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. familiar or conver-sant with.
30422: प्र-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, attentive, observant, con-versant or familiar with, clever, wise, intelligent (mostly Ved. as an epithet of the gods and especially of Agni and the Ādityas); happy, delighted; (आस्), m. an epithet of Varuṇa regent of the waters; N. of a Prajā-pati (an ancient sage and law-giver, Manu 1. 35); of a prince (son of Duduha); of a son of Dur-yāman; of a son of Dur-mada; (असस्), m. pl. the ten sons of Prācīna-barhis by a daughter of Varuṇa (they are the progenitors of Dakṣa; in this sense also written प्र-चेतस).
30423: प्र-चेतुन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. affording a wide view or prospect; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण फल-भोग-ज्ञापक, notifying in a high degree the experience of results (of actions).
30424: प्रचिन्त् प्र-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति, -यि-तुम्, to think upon, reflect, muse, meditate, con-sider; to find out, devise, contrive.
30425: 1. प्र-चिन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reflected or medi-tated upon.
30426: 2. प्र-चिन्त्य, ind. having reflected or considered.
30427: प्रचीबल प्रचीबल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a species of plant.

30456: प्रच्छाय प्र-च्छाय, अम्, n. a shadowy place, dense shadow, shade.
30457: प्रच्छिद् 1. प्र-च्छिद् (प्र-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut off, rend away; to cut to pieces, cut through, pierce, split, cleave; to take away, withdraw: Caus. -च्छेदयति, -यितुम्, to cause to cut off, to order to be lopped off.
