30476: प्रछ् प्रछ्, cl. 6. P. (in poetry also A.) पृच्छति (-ते), पप्रच्छ (Ved. प-पृक्षे), प्रष्टा, प्रक्ष्यति, अप्राक्षीत् (Ved. अप्राट्), Cond. अप्रक्ष्यत् (anomalous 2nd sing. अप्राक्ष्यस्), प्रष्टुम्, to ask, question, interro-gate, inquire of, ascertain, learn by inquiry; to ask or interrogate any one (acc.) about anything (with acc. or loc. or with प्रति or अधि-कृत्य); to seek, seek for; to entreat, supplicate, solicit, importune (Ved.): Caus. प्रच्छयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अप-प्रच्छत्: Desid. पिपृच्छिषति: Intens. परी-पृच्छ्यते; [cf. Zend pĕrĕs, ‘to inquire;’ frāś, ‘a question:’ Lat. prec-ari, prex, proc-u-s, procax, probably posco for prosco and rogo for progo, pos-tulare, perhaps suf-frag-ari, flag-it-are: Goth. frah, fraihna, frag-an, fraihn-an: Angl. Sax. fregnan: Mod. Germ. Frage: Russ. pros'u, ‘I ask, pray:’ Lith. pers'u, ‘I woo;’ pras'au, ‘I ask, pray:’ Hib. fiafrach, ‘inquisitive;’ fiafraighe, ‘a question;’ fiafruighim, ‘I inquire, ask;’ perhaps friscim, ‘I hope,’ and friscart, ‘an answer.’]

A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be born, be produced, come into existence, spring up; to become an embryo; to be born again; to propagate offspring (with inst.), beget, generate, cause to conceive; to bring forth, be delivered of, bear: Caus. -जनयति, -यितुम्, to cause any one (acc.) to propagate offspring (inst., Ved., Sāy. = प्रोद्भूतं कृ); to cause to be born; to beget, generate; to bring forth, bear; to produce, cause, occasion: Desid. -जिजनिषते, to wish to be born: Desid. of Caus. -जिजनयिषति, to wish to cause to be conceived.
30481: प्र-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, bearing (in अ-प्°, q. v.); (अस्), m. a husband; (आ), f. progeny, offspring, brood, children and children's children, posterity, descendants, race, family; a creature, created being; man, mankind, people, subjects; seed, semen; birth, generation, propagation. —प्र-जा-कर, अस्, m. a symbolical expression for ‘a sword;’ (perhaps an error for प्रज्ञा-कर।) —प्रजा-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of offspring, wishing for children. —प्रजा-कार, अस्, m. the maker of created beings, author of creation. —प्र-जा-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. killing offspring, destroying progeny. —प्रजा-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘a moon to his subjects,’ epithet of a prince. —प्रजा-तन्तु, उस्, m. a line of descendants, a race. —प्रजा-द, अस्, आ, अम्, granting offspring; removing barrenness (as a medicine &c.); (आ), f. a species of shrub (= गर्-भ-दात्री). —प्रजा-दान, अम्, n. ‘people's gift,’ silver. —प्रजा-द्वार, अम्, n. ‘a gate or means of obtaining progeny,’ epithet of the sun. —प्रजा-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty of children or of subjects. —प्रजाध्यक्ष (°जा-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘the super-intendent or leader of created beings,’ an epithet of the sun; of Kardama; of Dakṣa; [cf. प्रजा-पति।] —प्रजा-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘protector or lord of created beings,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Manu; of Dakṣa; a protector of subjects, a king, prince. —प्रजा-निषेक, अस्, m. ‘infusion of offspring,’ impregnation; the infused germ itself, offspring. —प्रजान्तक (°जा-अन्°), अस्, m. the god of death. —प्रजा-प, अस्, m. ‘protector of subjects,’ a king, prince. —प्रजा-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of creatures,’ an epithet in the Veda originally applied to Savitṛ, Soma, Tvaṣṭṛ, Hiraṇya-garbha, Indra, and Agni, afterwards the name of a separate god presiding over procreation [cf. Manu XII. 121] and the be-stower of progeny and cattle, sometimes invoked as the ‘Creator’ and sometimes invoked only as one of the thirty-three deities, (in more recent hymns and Brāhmaṇas sometimes identified with the uni-verse, and described like Brahma as the original self-existent Being or source out of which the uni-verse was evolved); an epithet of the ten lords of created beings first created by Brahmā (according to Manu I. 34; their names are Marīci, Atri, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Vasiṣṭha, Pra-cetas or Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and Nārada; some authorities make these Prajā-patis only seven in number, counting only the first seven in the above list, others reduce them to the last three, viz. Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and Nārada); an epithet of Śiva; ‘lord of the people,’ a king, sovereign, prince; a daughter's husband, son-in-law; a creator, procreator, father (as generator); a kind of insect; the fifth (or thirty-ninth) year in a sixty years' cycle of Jupiter; a particular star, ò Aurigæ; (in astrol.) = 2. काल-नर, q. v.; the sun; fire; N. of a man; of a Ṛṣi; (ई), f., N. of Śākya-muni's aunt and nurse with the patronymic Gautamī (the first woman who assented to the doctrines of Buddha; cf. महा-प्रजापती, महा-प्रजावती). —प्रजापति-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. created by Prajā-pati (according to Mahī-dhara = प्रजापति-सृष्ट). —प्रजापति-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the lords of created beings,’ an epithet of Dakṣa. —प्र-जापति-भक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eaten by Prajā-pati. —प्रजापति-यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘the sacrifice per-formed to Prajā-pati (as the deity presiding over procreation of offspring),’ the procreation of children enjoined by law. —प्रजापति-लोक, अस्, m. the world of Prajā-pati situated between the sphere of Brahmā and that of the Gandharvas. —प्रजापति-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —प्रजापति-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, created by Prajā-pati. —प्रजापति-हृदय, अम्, n., Ved. ‘Prajāpati's heart,’ N. of a Sāman (also called प्रजापतेर् हृदयम्). —प्र-जापत्य, an incorrect form for प्राजापत्य, q. v. —प्रजा-पाल or प्रजा-पालक, अस्, m. ‘protector of created beings,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; a protector of subjects, a king, sovereign; N. of a prince. —प्रजा-पालन, अम्, n. the protection of subjects. —प्रजा-पालि, इस्, m. an epithet of Śiva; [cf. गो-पालि।] —प्रजापाल्य, अम्, n. the office of protector of the people, royal office. —प्रजामृतत्व (°जा-अम्°), अम्, n., Ved. perpetuity of posterity. —प्र-जार्थम् or प्रजार्थे (°जा-अर्°), ind. for the sake of offspring. —प्रजा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accompanied by progeny, having offspring or children, abounding in progeny, prolific; pregnant; having subjects; (अती), f. a brother's wife; the wife of an elder brother; a mother, matron; N. of a tutelary deity of the Su-mantus; of the wife of Priya-vrata. —प्रजा-विद्, त्, त्, त्, or प्रजा-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. bestowing or granting progeny. —प्रजा-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase of progeny. —प्रजा-सृज्, ट्, m. ‘the creator of beings,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Kaśyapa. —प्रजा-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, favourable to or good for children or subjects, kind or useful to children or subjects; (अम्), n. water. —प्रजेप्सु (°जा-ईप्°), उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obtain offspring, desirous of progeny. —प्रजेश (°जा-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of created beings,’ an epithet of the god presiding over the procreation of offspring; ‘lord of the people,’ a prince, king, sovereign. —प्रजेश्वर (°जा-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of the people,’ a sovereign, king. —प्रजोत्पत्ति (°जा-उत्°), इस्, f. or प्रजोत्पादन (°जा-उत्°), अम्, n. the raising up of progeny.

30501: प्र-जल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, talked, chattered; one who has begun to talk; (अम्), n. spoken words, talk.
30502: प्रजव प्र-जव। See under प्र-जू, col. 3.
30503: प्रजागृ प्र-जागृ, cl. 2. P. -जागर्ति, -जागरि-तुम्, to watch, keep watch, watch over (with loc.); to lie in wait for (with gen.): Caus. -जागरयति, -यितुम्, to wake (trans.).
30504: प्र-जागर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who wakes, waking, an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अस्), m. a guardian; the act of waking or watching, lying awake at night, sleep-lessness, being awake, being roused, awaking; taking care; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras.
30505: प्र-जागरण, अम्, n. being awake, sleeplessness.
30506: प्रजानि प्र-जानि, इस्, m., N. of a prince; (a various reading for प्र-जाति।)
30507: प्रजि प्र-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to win, conquer, overpower, subdue.
30508: प्र-जय, अस्, m., Ved. victory, conquest.
30509: प्र-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering, defeating.
30510: प्रजित प्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged on; (probably a wrong form for प्राजित fr. rt. अज् with प्र।)
30511: प्रजिन प्रजिन, अस्, m. wind, air; (also read प्रजीन।)
30512: प्रजिन्व् प्र-जिन्व्, cl. 1. P. -जिन्वति, -जिन्वि-तुम्, Ved. to refresh, animate; to promote, help, assist.
30513: प्रजिहीर्षु प्र-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. हृ with प्र), being about to strike or hit, wishing to strike.
30514: प्रजीवन प्र-जीवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जीव् with प्र), livelihood, subsistence.
30515: प्र-जीविन्, ई, m., N. of a minister of Megha-varṇa the king of the crows.
30516: प्रजुष्ट प्र-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जुष् with प्र), strongly attached to, devoted to, intent on (= प्र-सक्त, Manu II. 96).
30517: प्रजू प्र-जू, cl. 1. P. A. -जवति, -ते, &c., to hasten forwards; to set in rapid motion, push or drive on; to urge on, incite: Caus. -जावयति, -यितुम्, to set in rapid motion, let fly, dart, shoot.
30518: प्र-जव, अस्, m., Ved. haste, rapidity; (अम्), ind. hastily, rapidly.
30519: प्र-जवित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven on, impelled; in-cited, urged on.
30520: प्र-जविन्, ई, इनी, इ, hastening, rapid, swift, speedy; (ई), m. a runner, courier, express.
30521: प्रजृम्भ् प्र-जृम्भ्, cl. 1. A. -जृम्भते, जृम्भितुम्, to begin to yawn.
30522: प्रजॄ प्र-जॄ, cl. 4. P. -जीर्यति, -जरितुम्, -जरीतुम्, to be digested.
30523: प्रज्जटिक प्रज्जटिक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a kind of Prākṛt metre (= Prākṛt पज्जलिआ).
30524: प्रज्जि प्रज्जि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
30525: प्रज्ञ 1. प्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-ज्ञु, q. v.
30526: प्रज्ञा 1. प्र-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जा-नीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to know, understand (especially said of knowing a way or mode of action); to distinguish, discern, discriminate; to know of, know about, be acquainted with; to become aware of, to find out, discover: Caus. -ज्ञपयति, -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्, to show or point out (the way); to discover, betray; to summon, invite.
30527: 2. प्र-जज्ञि, इस्, इस्, इ (for 1. see col. 2), Ved. conversant with.
30528: 2. प्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, intelligent, learned; (at the end of a comp.) knowing, conversant with; (आ), f. a clever or sensible woman; intelligence, un-derstanding, intellect, wisdom, knowledge; discern-ment, discrimination, judgment; device, design, de-termination; Wisdom personified as the goddess of arts and eloquence, Sarasvatī; (with Buddhists) the energy of the Ādi-buddha. —प्रज्ञ-ता, f., Ved. knowledge. —प्रज्ञा-कर, अस्, m., N. of the author of a commentary on the Nalodaya. —प्रज्ञा-काय, अस्, m. an epithet of Mañju-śrī a Buddhist saint. —प्रज्ञा-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —प्रज्ञा-गुप्त-शरीर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the body protected by understanding. —प्रज्ञा-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, ‘mind-eyed,’ ‘having the understanding or wisdom as the only eyes,’ blind; (उस्), m. an epithet of the blind king Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —प्रज्ञा-ढ्य (°ञा-आढ्°), अस्, m. ‘rich in wisdom,’ N. of a man. —प्रज्ञादित्य (°ञा-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘sun of wisdom,’ N. of a man. —प्रज्ञा-पारमिता, f. (with Buddhists) one of the six perfections, perfection in wisdom, (the other five are दान-प्°, शील-प्°, क्षान्-ति-प्°, वीर्य-प्°, and ध्यान-प्°); N. of a Buddhist work. —प्रज्ञा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consist-ing of wisdom. —प्रज्ञा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing wisdom, wise, knowing, intelligent. —प्रज्ञा-वर्-मन्, आ, m. ‘having wisdom for armour,’ N. of a man. —प्रज्ञा-वाद, अस्, m. a wise speech, wise saying. —प्रज्ञा-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, old in wisdom or knowledge. —प्रज्ञा-सहाय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘hav-ing wisdom for a companion,’ wise, intelligent. —प्रज्ञा-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of wisdom, ignorant, silly, unwise.
30529: प्र-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. teaching, informing, doctrine, communication; an appointment, agreement, en-gagement; (with Jainas) a particular magical art per-sonified as one of the Vidyā-devīs (also प्र-ज्ञप्ती). —प्रज्ञप्ति-कौशिक, अस्, m., N. of a teacher acquainted with the magical art called Pra-jñapti. —प्रज्ञप्ति-वादिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a Buddhist sect. —प्रज्ञप्ति-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work.
30530: प्र-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, known, understood; dis-tinguished, discriminated, discerned, discernible, dis-tinct, clear; renowned, famous, notorious.
30531: प्र-ज्ञाति, इस्, f., Ved. knowing the way (to any place), knowing the right way.
30532: प्र-ज्ञातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who knows the right way, a skilful guide, conductor.
30533: प्र-ज्ञात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in अ-प्°, losing or missing the way.
30534: प्र-ज्ञान, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, prudent, wise, clever, learned; easily known (Ved.); (अम्), n. knowledge, knowing one's duty, wisdom, intelligence; discrimina-tion; a mark, sign, token, memorial. —प्रज्ञान-सन्तति, इस्, f. a train of thought.
30535: प्र-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, betrayed, disclosed, dis-covered.
30536: प्रज्ञाल, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, prudent.
30537: प्रज्ञिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wise, prudent; (ई), m. a wise or learned man, sage, scholar.
30538: प्रज्ञिल, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, prudent, clever.
30539: प्रज्ञु प्र-ज्ञु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the knees far apart, bandy-legged, bow-legged; (also written प्र-ज्ञ।)
30540: प्रज्वल् प्र-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -ज्वलति (-ते), -ज्वलितुम्, to catch fire, begin to burn or blaze, be in flames, flame, blaze up; to blaze brightly, shine, gleam; to be inflamed or incensed, become wrathful, to be kindled (e. g. तेषां क्रो-धः प्रजज्वाल, their wrath was kindled): Caus. -ज्वलयति, -ज्वालयति, -यितुम्, to set on fire, light, kindle, inflame; (with Buddhists) to explain, illus-trate.
30541: प्र-ज्वलन, अम्, n. blazing up, flaming, burn-ing, taking fire, kindling.
30542: प्र-ज्वलनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set on fire, inflammable.
30543: प्र-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in flames, flaming, burning, blazing, shining, bright, radiant; blazed forth, burnt; (अम्), n. flaming up, blazing, burning.
30544: प्र-ज्वालित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted, kindled, set on fire.
30545: प्रज्वार प्र-ज्वार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ज्वर् with प्र), the heat of fever (sometimes personified).
30546: प्रडी प्र-डी, cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते, -डीयते, -डयितुम्, to fly forward, fly away, fly up.
30547: प्र-डीन, अम्, n. flying rapidly, flying in every direction; taking flight, beginning to fly; the act of flying; flying forward.
30548: प्रण प्रण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. प्र), ancient, old (see Vārttika 3. to Pāṇ. V. 4, 30).
30549: प्रणख प्र-णख, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the point of the nails.
30550: प्रणद् प्र-णद्, cl. 1. P. -णदति, -णदितुम्, to resound, begin to sound, begin to roar or cry.
30552: प्र-णदित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, sounding; buzzing, humming (as a bee).
30553: प्र-णाद, अस्, m. a loud sound, clangour, noise, shout, cry; any loud noise, especially one expressing approbation or delight, huzza; neighing, braying, bray; roar, roaring; a cry for help; a low sound expressive of great pleasure, a murmur or sigh of rapture; a disease of the ear, a noise or buzzing in the ear from thickening of the membranes &c.; N. of a Cakra-vartin.
30554: प्र-णादक, अस्, इका, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 16.
30555: प्रणपात् प्र-णपात्, त्, m., Ved. a great-grandson; [cf. Lat. pro-nepo-(t)-s.]
30556: प्रणभ् प्र-णभ्, cl. 1. A. -णभते, &c., Ved. to burst, split, cleave (intrans.).
30557: प्रणम् प्र-णम्, cl. 1. P. A. -णमति, -ते, -णन्तुम्, to bend or bow down before, make obei-sance to (with dat., gen., loc., or acc.): Caus. -णम-यति, -यितुम्, to cause any one (acc.) to bow before another (dat.); to bend, incline; to do anything reverentially.
30558: प्र-णत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent forwards, crooked; bowed, bowing to (with gen. or acc.); bending, stooping, stooped; inclined; humble; skilful, clever. —प्रणत-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head or top bent down or bowed; inclined, stooping. —प्र-णताशेष-सामन्त (°त-अश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one before whom all (his) neighbours bow, receiving homage from all the neighbouring princes.
30559: प्र-णतवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having bent, bowed, bowing, bent.
30560: प्र-णति, इस्, f. bending, bowing, inclination, salutation, reverence, obeisance, courtesy.
30561: प्र-णमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bowing to, saluting with reverence or respect.
30562: प्र-णमित, अस्, आ, अम्, bending, bowing.
30563: प्र-णम्य, ind. having bowed, having done homage or made obeisance.
30564: प्र-णाम, अस्, m. bending, bowing, a bow; respectful or reverential salutation, prostration, obei-sance (especially to a Brāhman or to a deity). —प्र-णामाञ्जलि (°म-अञ्°), इस्, m. reverential salutation with the hands opened and hollowed. —प्रणामा-दर (°म-आद्°), अस्, m. reverential salutation.
30565: प्र-णामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bending, bowing before, sa-luting, honouring, worshipping, prostrating one's self.
30566: प्रणय प्र-णय। See 1. प्र-णी, p. 610, col. 1.
30567: प्रणव प्र-णव। See प्र-णु, p. 610, col. 3.
30568: प्रणश् 1. प्र-णश् (see rt. 1. नश्), cl. 1. P. A. -णशति, -ते, &c., Ved. to reach, attain.
30569: प्रणश् 2. प्र-णश् (see rt. 2. नश्), cl. 1. 4. P. -णशति, -णश्यति, -णशितुम्, -नंष्टुम्, -नष्-टुम् (the न् of the rt. is not changed to ण् when श् passes into ष् or is otherwise changed, e. g. प्र-नष्ट, प्र-नङ्क्ष्यति), to be lost, disappear, vanish; to escape: Caus. -णाशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to disappear or perish; to allow to be lost, i. e. to leave unrewarded.
30570: प्र-णश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, perishing, falling away; endeavouring to escape.
30571: प्र-णाश, अस्, m. vanishing, disappearance, cessa-tion, loss [cf. लब्ध-प्°]; death, destruction, per-dition, decay.
30572: प्र-णाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, (at end of comps.) causing to disappear or cease, removing, destroying, annihilat-ing; (अम्), n. destroying, destruction, annihilation.
30573: प्र-णाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing to disappear or cease, removing, destroying.
30574: प्र-नष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (often incorrectly written प्र-णष्ट), lost, disappeared, vanished, not to be seen; departed, escaped; perished, destroyed, ruined, decayed, annihilated. —प्रनष्ट-ज्ञानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose knowledge is destroyed,’ without know-ledge. —प्रनष्ट-विनय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose politeness has vanished,’ lost to propriety, uncivil, uncomplaisant, rude.
30575: प्रणस प्र-णस, अस्, आ, अम्, having a pro-minent nose.
30576: प्रणाडी प्र-णाडी, f., Ved. a channel from a pond, a water-course, waste-pipe, drain; interven-tion, interposition; (ड्या), ind. mediately, indirectly.
30577: प्र-णाल, अस्, ई, m. f. or प्र-णालिका, f. a channel from a pond, gutter, drain, water-course; प्रणा-लिकया, through a particular channel, through the medium of, mediately.
30578: प्रणिंसित प्र-णिंसित or प्र-निंसित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. निंस् with प्र), kissed.
30579: प्र-णिंसितव्य or प्र-निंसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kissed, what may or ought to be kissed.
30580: प्रणिगद् प्र-णि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -ग-दितुम्, to begin to address.
30581: प्रणिघ्नत् प्र-णिघ्नत्। See प्र-णि-हन्, p. 610, col. 1.
30582: प्रणिज् प्र-णिज्, cl. 3. P. A. -णेनेक्ति, -णे-निक्ते, -णेक्तुम्, Ved. to wash away, cleanse.
30583: प्र-णेजन, अस्, ई, अम्, washing away, wiping away; (अम्), n. washing away, wiping away, bathing; water for washing.
30584: प्रणिज्ञा प्र-णि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to consider, recollect.
30585: प्रणिधा प्र-णि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to set in front, place in advance, cause to precede; to lay down, deposit; to lay on, impose, apply; to place in, lay in, bring into, infix, enchase; to include, inclose; to stretch out, stretch forth (the hand); to touch; to turn or direct (the eyes or thoughts) upon; (with मनस्) to concentrate the thoughts upon, give the whole attention to; to re-solve; to think; to send out or employ (a spy or emissary), spy.
30586: प्र-णिधान, अम्, n. laying on, imposing, ap-plying, employing, application, employment, use; access, entrance; respectful conduct or behaviour towards, attention paid to (with loc.); profound re-ligious meditation; great effort, stress, energy; (with Buddhists) prayer, entreaty, supplication.
30587: प्र-णिधि, इस्, m. observing, scrutinizing, spying out; sending out (spies or emissaries); a spy, secret agent, emissary; an attendant, a follower; care, attention; asking, solicitation, request; N. of a son of Bṛhad-ratha.
30588: प्र-णिधेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be applied or injected (as a clyster); to be sent out (as a spy); (अम्), n. employing; sending out (of emissaries).
30589: प्र-णिहित, अस्, आ, अम्, laid on, applied, imposed; deposited; outstretched, stretched forth; delivered, entrusted, consigned; having the attention fixed, having the thoughts concentrated on one point, intent (= सम्-आहित); resolved, determined, de-cided; prudent, advised, careful, wary, cautious; discovered by spies, spied out; obtained, attained, received, acquired; acknowledged, previously agreed to or admitted.
30590: प्रणिध्यै प्र-णि-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्यातुम्, to give the attention to (with acc.).
30591: प्रणिनद् प्र-णि-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति, -न-दितुम्, to sound loudly, thunder.
30592: प्र-णिनदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding deep or like thunder.
30593: प्र-णिनाद, अस्, m. a deep sound, that of thunder or the like.
30594: प्रणिन्द् प्र-णिन्द् or प्र-निन्द्, cl. 1. P. -णिन्दति, -णिन्दितुम्, to blame, censure, upbraid.
30595: प्र-णिन्दन or प्र-निन्दन, अम्, n. censuring, upbraiding.
30596: प्र-णिन्द्य or प्र-निन्द्य, ind. having censured or upbraided.
30597: प्रणिपत् प्र-णि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पति-तुम्, to throw one's self down before, fall prostrate before, bow down before, bow respectfully to (with acc. and sometimes with dat. or loc.): Caus. -पात-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to bow down, induce or cause to fall prostrate.
30598: प्र-णिपतन, अम्, n. falling down before, throw-ing one's self down at any one's feet, prostration; bowing or doing homage to, saluting.
30599: प्र-णिपतित, अस्, आ, अम्, bowed down in reverence, saluting.
30600: प्र-णिपत्य, ind. having bowed down or in reverence, having saluted respectfully, having done homage to.
30601: प्र-णिपात, अस्, m. falling at any one's feet, pros-tration, humble submission to (with gen.); saluta-tion, reverence, obeisance. —प्रणिपात-पुरः-सरम्, ind. preceded by prostration, with an obei-sance. —प्रणिपात-प्रतीकार, अस्, आ, अम्, having submission for a remedy, counteracted by submission. —प्रणिपात-रस, अस्, m. ‘taking pleasure in sub-mission,’ a magical formula pronounced over weapons.
30602: प्र-णिपातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, throwing one's self down or falling at the feet of, submitting, submissive.
30603: प्रणिमा 1. प्र-णि-मा, cl. 3. A. -मिमीते, मातुम् (fr. rt. 2. मा), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 17.
30604: प्रणिमा 2. प्र-णि-मा, cl. 2. P., 3. A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मातुम् (fr. rt. 4. मा), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 17, Vopa-deva VIII. 22, IX. 16.
30605: प्रणिमि प्र-णि-मि, cl. 5. P. A. -मिनोति, -मिनुते, &c., see Vopa-deva XXVI. 212.
30606: प्रणिया प्र-णि-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to advance, proceed.
30607: प्रणिशम् प्र-णि-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमितुम्, to become calm, be pacified or appeased; to hear.
30608: प्रणिहन् प्र-णि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्-तुम्, to slay, to kill (with gen.).
30609: प्र-णिघ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, preparing or threatening to strike.
30610: प्रणिहित प्र-णिहित। See under प्र-णि-धा, p. 609, col. 3.

30612: प्र-णय, अस्, m. a leader (Scholiast on Pāṇ. 30681: प्रति 1. प्रति (an indeclinable particle and prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns; some-times प्रती in composition), towards, in the direc-tion of, to, unto, near to; against, in opposition to, counter; back, back again, again, in return; down upon, upon, on.
30682: प्रति is also prefixed to nouns not immediately connected with verbs, to express equality, likeness, resemblance, or comparison; [cf. प्रति-चक्र, प्रति-चन्द्र।] (As a separable preposition with acc. and usu-ally but not invariably following its substantive), towards, to, unto, in the direction of (e. g. शब्दम् प्रति, in the direction of the sound, towards the place whence the sound came); down upon, upon; against, in opposition to, counter (e. g. यायाद् रिपुम् प्रति, he should march against the enemy; पाहि नस् त्वम् प्रति रीषतः, defend thou us against the enemy); over against, opposite, contra; in the presence of, before; in comparison with, in propor-tion to, on a par with (e. g. त्वं सहस्राणि प्रति, thou art on a par with, i. e. equivalent to, thousands); in the vicinity of, near, beside, by, at, on (e. g. गङ्गाम् प्रति, at or on the Ganges; आयोधनम् प्रति, on the field of battle); on the side of, in favour of; (distributively) in each, at or in every, according to each, severally (e. g. यज्ञम् प्रति, at every sacrifice; वर्षम् प्रति, every year, annually; in this sense प्रति is frequently used at the beginning of adv. comps., cf. प्रति-क्षणम्, प्रति-गृहम्); about, at the time of, during (e. g. फाल्गुनम् मासम् प्रति, about the month Phālguna; चिरम् प्रति, for a long time); in relation to, with refer-ence to, with regard to (e. g. धर्मम् प्रति, with regard to justice); concerning; on account of; according to (e. g. माम् प्रति, according to me, i. e. in my opinion), in conformity with, in pursuance of; a little (at the end of a comp., e. g. सूप-प्रति, a little broth, see Pāṇ. II. 1, 9). (As a separable preposition, with abl.), on a par with, on an equality with (also with adverbs ending with the affix तस्, e. g. नारायणतः प्रति, on an equality with Nārāyaṇa); in return for, as compen-sation for (e. g. उक्षा कपोतात् प्रति, an ox in return for a dove); in the place of, in lieu of, instead of. Native lexicographers explain the senses of प्रति by the following Sanskrit words: प्र-धान, क्षेप, निश्-चय, व्य्-आवृत्ति, प्र-शस्ति, वि-रोध, सम्-आधि: [cf. Zend paiti: Old Pers. pati-sh, ‘against:’ Gr. προ-τί, πα-τί, πρός for πρότ, πρόσ-θε-(ν): Lat. red- as in red-dere, red-ire; re- as in re-ferre; prœ for prai; por, pol, pos for port in the forms por-rigo, pol-liceor, pol-lus, pos-sides: Old Slav. proti: Lith. prësz, ‘against:’ Bohem. proti: Hib. frith, frioth, as in frithbeart, ‘I object, oppose;’ frithbuille, ‘a back-stroke;’ frithshearc, ‘a return of love, mutual regard;’ frithcuirim, ‘I oppose, obstruct;’ frithbharamhuil, ‘a paradox.’]

30841: प्रतिजिह्वा प्रति-जिह्वा or प्रति-जिह्विका, f. the uvula or soft palate.
30842: प्रतिजीवन प्रति-जीवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जीव् with प्रति), returning to life, resuscitation.

30844: प्रतिजूतिवर्पस् प्रतिजूति-वर्पस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. victorious over enemies (Sāy. = प्रतिपक्षा-भिभवन-शील-तेजो-युक्त).

30846: प्रतिज्ञा 1. प्रति-ज्ञा, cl. 9. A. (ep. also P.) -जानीते, -जानाति, -ज्ञातुम्, to admit, own, acknow-ledge, recognise, allow, take in good part; to ap-prove, consent; to promise (with gen., dat., or loc. of the person, and acc. or dat. of the thing); to maintain, uphold, assert, affirm, allege; to bring forward or introduce (a topic); to perceive, observe, learn, discern, become aware of; (A.) to confirm, assent, answer in the affirmative; to propose; (P. A.) to remember with regret, remember sorrowfully.
30847: 2. प्रति-ज्ञा, f. admission, acknowledgment; as-sent; a solemn declaration, agreement, engagement, promise, vow; a statement, assertion, affirmation, declaration, allegation; (in logic) a proposition, the assertion to be proved, the first member or अवयव of the five-membered Nyāya syllogism (in the usual standing example = ‘this hill is fiery’); (in law) a plaint, complaint, indictment; (अया), ind. by ex-press rule; in the manner laid down. —प्रतिज्ञान्-तर (°ज्ञा-अन्°), अम्, n. (in logic) a subsequent proposition on failure of the first. —प्रतिज्ञा-पत्त्र or प्रतिज्ञा-पत्त्रक, अम्, n. a promissory note, a written contract, bond. —प्रतिज्ञा-परि-शिष्ट, अम्, n., N. of a treatise by Kātyāyana. —प्रतिज्ञा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking or breach of a promise. —प्रतिज्ञाभङ्ग-भीरु, उस्, उस्, उ, fearful or apprehensive of breaking a promise. —प्र-तिज्ञा-विरोध, अस्, m. acting contrary to promise or agreement; denial of a logical proposition. —प्र-तिज्ञा-विवाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, promised in marriage, betrothed. —प्रतिज्ञा-सन्न्यास, अस्, m. breaking a promise; abandonment of the original proposition (in logic). —प्रतिज्ञा-हानि, इस्, f. giving up the pro-position or argument.
30848: प्रति-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, asserted, propounded, declared, stated, proposed, deposed, alleged; admitted, acknowledged; promised, agreed; agreeable, desira-ble; (अम्), n. anything promised, a promise. —प्र-तिज्ञातार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. a statement, averment.
30849: प्रति-ज्ञातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be assented to, to be promised, &c.

30851: प्रति-ज्ञान, अम्, n. admission, assent, agreement, engagement, promise; asserting, assertion; bringing forward or introducing (a topic).
30852: प्रति-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, betrayed; (a various reading for प्र-ज्ञापित।)
30853: प्रति-ज्ञाय, ind. having admitted or acknow-ledged; having promised; having maintained or asserted.
30854: प्रति-ज्ञेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be promised or assented to; (अस्), m. the reciter or pronouncer of a pane-gyric, a proclaimer of rank and titles, herald, bard, panegyrist.
30855: प्रतिज्वल् प्रति-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति, -ज्व-लितुम्, to flame, blaze, shine.

30857: प्रतितत्त्वसिद्धान्त प्रति-तत्त्व-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m. a conclusion adopted by each disputant.

30859: प्रतितप् प्रति-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, to throw out heat towards; to heat, warm, foment.
30860: प्रतितर प्रति-तर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तॄ with प्रति), a sailor, oarsman, ferryman.

30862: प्रतितरु प्रति-तरु, ind. at each tree.

30865: प्रतित्र्यहम् प्रति-त्र्यहम्, ind. for three days at a time.
30866: प्रतिथि प्र-तिथि, इस्, m., N. of a teacher with the epithet Deva-ratha.
30867: प्रतिदण्ड प्रति-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. re-fractory, disobedient, obstinate.

30870: प्रतिदा प्रति-दा, cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, दातुम्, to give in return, give as a reward, give back, return, restore; to retort; to give: Caus. -दापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be given back, cause to be restored.

30875: प्रतिदारण प्रति-दारण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. दॄ with प्रति), battle, fighting, fierce conflict.
30876: प्रतिदिनम् प्रति-दिनम्, ind. day by day, daily, every day.
30877: प्रतिदिवन् प्रति-दिवन्, आ, m. (fr. rt. 2. दिव् with प्रति), the sun; a day.
30878: प्रति-दीवन्, आ, m. an adversary at play (Ved.); the sun.
30879: प्रतिदिवसम् प्रति-दिवसम्, ind. day after day, daily, day by day.
30880: प्रतिदिश् प्रति-दिश्, Caus. P. -देशयति, -यि-तुम्, to point towards, point out; to enjoin, teach; to direct; to confess.

30884: प्रतिदूत प्रति-दूत, अस्, m. a messenger or ambassador sent in return.

30894: प्रतिदेहम् प्रति-देहम्, ind. in each body, in every body.

30908: प्रतिधाव् प्रति-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run back; to rush upon, assail, attack.

30920: प्रति-नाद, अस्, m. echo, resonance, reverberation.
30921: प्रति-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to resound, resonant, resounding, echoing, echoed.
30922: प्रति-निनद, अस्, m. an echo, a reverberation.

30926: प्रतिनम् प्रति-नम्, cl. 1. P. -नमति, -नन्-तुम्, Ved. to bow or incline towards.

30931: प्रतिनाडी प्रति-नाडी, f. a branch vein.

31422: प्रति-सङ्क्रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, angry with, wroth against.

31427: प्रतिसङ्ग्रह् प्रति-सङ्-ग्रह् (-सम्-ग्रह्), cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to re-ceive, accept.
31428: प्रतिसञ्चर् प्रति-सञ्-चर् (-सम्-चर्), cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to come together, come towards, meet with, meet.
31429: प्रति-सञ्चर, अस्, m. going or moving back-wards; reabsorption or resolution (back again into Prakṛti); that into which anything is reabsorbed or resolved; a place of resort, haunt.
31430: प्रतिसञ्जन् प्रति-सञ्-जन् (-सम्-जन्), cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be born again, to be born or produced; to spring up, arise, appear.
31431: प्रतिसञ्जीव् प्रति-सञ्-जीव् (-सम्-जीव्), cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -जीवति (-ते), -जीवितुम्, to come to life again, return to life, revive.
31432: प्रतिसञ्ज्ञा प्रति-सञ्-ज्ञा (-सम्-ज्ञा), cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, Ved. to be friendly towards, to be kindly disposed towards.
31433: प्रतिसदृक्ष प्रति-सदृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, or प्रति-सदृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. similar.
31434: प्रतिसन्दिश् प्रति-सन्-दिश् (-सम्-दिश्), cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to give an errand or commis-sion in return; to send back a message to (with gen.); to order, command.
31435: प्रति-सन्देश, अस्, m. a message given in return, tidings in return, an answer to a message.
31436: प्रतिसन्धा प्रति-सन्-धा (-सम्-धा), cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put together again, readjust; to put on, fasten; to aim at, direct against; to give back, replace, restore; to grasp men-tally, conceive, comprehend, understand; (A.) to com-pose one's self; to fit an arrow to the bow-string.
31437: प्रति-संहित, अस्, आ, अम्, aimed at, directed against.
31438: प्रति-सन्धान, अम्, n. putting together again, joining together; a juncture, the period of transition between two ages; a remedy; self-command, sup-pression of feeling; praise, panegyric.
31439: प्रति-सन्धि, इस्, m. reunion; entering into the womb [cf. भव-प्°]; a juncture, the period of transition between two ages.
31440: प्रति-सन्धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed, re-sistible; अ-प्रतिसन्धेय, irresistible.
31441: प्रतिसान्धानिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-सन्धान), a bard, a panegyrist.
31442: प्रतिसम प्रति-सम, अस्, आ, अम्, equal to, a match for.
31443: प्रतिसमन्तम् प्रति-समन्तम्, ind., Ved. on every side, everywhere.
31444: प्रतिसमादिश् प्रति-सम्-आ-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दि-शति, -देष्टुम्, to return an answer, reply, answer; to direct in return; to order, command.
31445: प्रति-समादिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, enjoined, directed, ordered.
31446: प्रतिसमाधा प्रति-सम्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put back again, replace, affix again; to rearrange, readjust; to re-dress, remedy; to fit an arrow to the bow-string.
31448: प्रतिसमास् प्रति-सम्-आस् (see rt. 4. आस्), cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to be a match for, cope with; to withstand, resist.
31449: प्रति-समासन, अम्, n. the being a match for, coping with (with gen.); withstanding, resisting.
31450: प्रतिसमिन्ध् प्रति-सम्-इन्ध्, cl. 7. A. -इन्द्-धे, -इन्धितुम्, to kindle again, rekindle.
31451: प्रतिसमीक्षण प्रति-समीक्षण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ईक्ष् with प्रति-सम्), looking at again, return-ing a glance.
31452: प्रतिसमुच् प्रति-सम्-उच् (?) , cl. 4. A. -उच्यते, उचितुम्, Ved. to deserve, be worthy of.
31453: प्रतिसम्बुध् प्रति-सम्-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A., 4. A. -बोधति, -ते, -बुध्यते, -बोधितुम्, to become conscious again, recover consciousness.
31454: प्रति-सम्बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, become conscious again, restored to consciousness, recovered.
31455: प्रतिसम्भू प्रति-सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to apply or give one's self to (with acc.).
31457: प्रतिसर्ग प्रति-सर्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृज् with प्रति), continued creation out of primitive matter; secondary creation or the creation of the world by the agency of Brahmā and other divinities regarded as the agents of one supreme being; disso-lution; the portion of a Purāṇa which treats of the destruction and renovation of the world.
31459: प्रति-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, dispatched; given; celebrated.
31460: प्रतिसव्य प्रति-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, in inverted order, inverted, reverse.
31461: प्रतिसह् प्रति-सह्, cl. 1. A. -सहते, -सहि-तुम्, -सोढुम्, to sustain, uphold, support.
31462: प्रतिसान्धानिक प्रतिसान्धानिक। See under प्रति-सन्-धा above.
31463: प्रतिसाम प्रति-साम, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) unkind, unfriendly.
31464: प्रतिसामन्त प्रति-सामन्त, अस्, m. ‘an ad-verse neighbour,’ an enemy, adversary.
31466: प्रतिसीरा प्रति-सीरा, f. a curtain, a screen or wall of cloth, an outer tent.
31467: प्रतिसूर्य प्रति-सूर्य, अस्, m. a mock sun, parhelion; a kind of lizard, a chameleon (which lies or basks in the sun); (अम्), ind. opposite to the sun, in the sun. —प्रतिसूर्य-शयानक, अस्, m. ‘lying or basking in the sun,’ a kind of lizard, a chameleon.
31469: प्रतिसृ प्रति-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to go towards, go back, [only used in Caus.]: Caus. P. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go back; to remove, replace.
31470: प्रति-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, going towards; dependent, subject; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a cord or ribbon used as an amulet worn round the neck or wrist at nup-tials &c.; an ornament, adorning; a watch, guard, ward; the junction of an elephant's frontal sinuses (?); (अस्), m. a follower, servant; a bracelet; a wreath, garland; a form of magic or incantation; the rear of an army; day-break; cicatrizing or healing (as a sore); (आ), f. a female servant; a thread, fillet, ribbon.
31471: प्रति-सरण, अम्, n. leaning on, resting upon.
31472: प्रति-सर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) present in the cord used as an amulet, present at an incantation.
31473: प्रति-सारण, अम्, n. dressing or anointing the edges of a wound; an instrument used for anointing a wound.
31474: प्रति-सारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be dressed or anointed (as a wound).
31475: प्रति-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, repelled, repulsed; re-moved; dressed (as a wound).
31476: प्रति-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going round, going from one to another.
31478: प्रतिसेना प्रति-सेना, f. an opposing or hos-tile army.
31479: प्रतिसोमा प्रति-सोमा, f. a kind of plant (= महिष-वल्ली).
31480: प्रतिस्कन्ध प्रति-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. every shoulder; N. of an attendant of Skanda; (अम्), ind. upon the shoulders.
31481: प्रतिस्कॄ प्रति-स्-कॄ (प्रति-कॄ with स् in-serted), cl. 6. P. A. -किरति, -ते, -करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to hurt, injure; [cf. प्रति-कॄ।]
31482: प्रति-स्-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, hurt, injured.
31483: प्रतिस्तब्ध प्रति-स्तब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopped, restrained; stupefied; propped up, stayed, supported; [cf. प्रति-ष्टब्ध।]
31484: प्रतिस्त्री प्रति-स्त्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. lying on a woman.
31485: प्रतिस्थानम् प्रति-स्थानम्, ind. in every place, everywhere.
31486: प्रतिस्नात प्रति-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्ना with प्रति), bathed, washed; [cf. प्रति-ष्णात।]
31487: प्रतिस्नेह प्रति-स्नेह, अस्, m. love in return, requital of love, mutual love.
31488: प्रतिस्पन्दन प्रति-स्पन्दन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. स्पन्द् with प्रति), throbbing, vibration.
31489: प्रतिस्पर्धा प्रति-स्पर्धा, f. (fr. rt. स्पर्ध् with प्रति), emulation, rivalry, the wish or effort to excel or overcome.
31490: प्रति-स्पर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, emulous, a rival, en-vious; refractory, rebellious.
31491: प्रतिस्पश प्रति-स्पश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. पश् with प्रति), Ved. spying, watching, lying in wait.

31493: प्रतिस्मृ प्रति-स्मृ, cl. 1. P. -स्मरति, -स्मर्-तुम्, to remember again, recall to memory, remem-ber, recollect.
31494: प्रति-स्मृति, इस्, f. recollection; epithet of a par-ticular kind of magic.
31495: प्रतिस्याय प्रति-स्याय, a wrong form for प्रति-श्याय, q. v.
31496: प्रतिस्रोतस् प्रति-स्रोतस्, ind. against the stream, up the stream; (sometimes wrongly spelt प्रति-श्रोतस्।)
31497: प्रतिस्वर प्रति-स्वर, अस्, m. a reverberated sound, echo, reverberation; a focus.
31498: प्रतिहन् प्रति-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to strike in return, strike back, ward off, keep off; to drive back, repel; to remove; to oppose, resist; to prevent; to disown.
31499: प्रति-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck in return, struck back, beaten back, knocked back, hurt, killed; repulsed, repelled; opposed, obstructed; averted; reflected; fallen, overthrown; hated, disliked; dis-appointed; sent, dispatched; tied, bound. —प्रति-हत-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, hostile-minded, having hostile intentions. —प्रतिहत-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, adverse-minded, averse from, hating, disliking.
31500: प्रति-हति, इस्, f. beating back, beating again; repulse, recoil, rebound; disappointment.
31501: प्रति-हनन, अम्, n. striking back, hitting again, striking in return, returning a blow.
31502: प्रति-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed or resisted, opposable, resistible.
31503: प्रति-हन्तृ, ता, m. one who strikes in return, a revenger, avenger.
31504: प्रति-हन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being struck back or hit again; being foiled or disappointed.
31505: प्रतिहरण प्रति-हरण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. हृ with प्रति), throwing back, striking back, repelling (Ved.); avoiding, shunning.
31506: प्रति-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who draws back, drawing in, absorbing; dissolving, destroying; one who keeps or wards off, an averter; epithet of one of the sixteen priests, the assistant of the Ud-gātṛ [cf. ऋत्व्-इज्, प्रति-हार]; N. of a prince, son of Prati-hāra or of Pratīha.
31507: प्रति-हार, अस्, m. striking against, striking back, pushing or thrusting back; (in grammar) the hard contact of the tongue with the edge of the teeth in the pronunciation of the dental letters; an epithet of particular syllables in the Sāma hymns with which the Prati-hartṛ begins to join in the singing (gene-rally at the beginning of the last Pada of a verse); N. of a particular magical formula; (that which keeps back) a door, gate; a door-keeper, porter; a juggler; juggling, trick, disguise; N. of a prince, son of Parameṣṭhin; N. of a particular form of alliance; (ई), f. a female door-keeper, portress; (औ), m. du. two door-keepers, i. e. two statues at the entrance of a temple; (in several of the above senses this word is also spelt प्रती-हार।) —प्रतिहार-प, अस्, m. a door-keeper, porter. —प्रतिहार-भूमि, इस्, f. ‘door-place,’ a threshold. —प्रतिहार-रक्षी, f. a female door-keeper, portress.
31509: प्रति-हारण, अम्, n. entrance, permission to enter a door.
31510: प्रति-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pushed or thrust back, to be repelled, resistible; (अम्), n. juggling, jugglery.
31511: प्रतिहर्य् प्रति-हर्य्, cl. 1. P. -हर्यति, -हर्-यितुम्, Ved. to desire, love (Sāy. = कम् or प्रत्य्-एकं कम्).
31512: प्रतिहर्षण प्रति-हर्षण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. हृष् with प्रति), causing joy in return.
31513: प्रतिहस्त प्रति-हस्त or प्रति-हस्तक, अस्, m. a deputy, substitute, proxy.
31514: प्रति-हस्तिन्, ई, m. the keeper of a house of ill fame.
31515: प्रतिहस्ति प्रति-हस्ति, ind. towards the ele-phants, in the direction of the elephants.
31516: प्रतिहास प्रति-हास or प्रती-हास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हस् with प्रति), returning a laugh, laughing with or at; fragrant oleander, Nerium Odorum.
31517: प्रतिहिंस् प्रति-हिंस्, cl. 7. 1. P. -हिनस्ति, -हिंसति, -हिंसितुम्, to injure in return, retaliate.
31519: प्रति-हिंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, injured in return or by way of revenge; (अम्), n. requital of an injury.
31520: प्रतिहित प्रति-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रति-धा), put close to, placed in, fitted to (the bow-string as an arrow). —प्रतिहितेषु (°त-इषु), उस्, उस्, उ, one who has fitted an arrow to (the bow-string).
31521: प्रतिहितायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. one who has fitted an arrow to (the bow-string; cf. आततायिन्).
31522: प्रति-हिति, इस्, f. fitting an arrow to (the bow-string).
31523: प्रतिहृदयम् प्रति-हृदयम्, ind. in every heart.
31524: प्रतिह्रास प्रति-ह्रास, अस्, m. (rt. ह्रस्), Ved. shortening, abbreviation, abridgment.
31525: प्रतिह्वर प्रति-ह्वर, अस्, m., Ved. the rising slope or vault (of the sky), a sloping side; (Sāy. प्रतिह्वरे = समीपे।)
31526: प्रती प्रती (प्रति-इ; see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. प्रत्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to go towards, come towards, go to; to go back, come back, return; to approach, turn to, betake one's self to; to fall to the lot or share of; to reach, attain; to observe, learn exactly, convince one's self (of the truth of anything); to be con-vinced, become certain of, give credence to, believe: Pass. प्रतीयते, to be observed or recognised; to follow from anything (as a necessary result); to be proved, turn out to be true: Caus. प्रत्य्-आययति, -यितुम्, to cause to go towards; to convince (any one of the truth of anything), produce confidence, cause to believe; to cause to think of or observe, bring to mind; to show anything in its true light, make clear, prove; to cause to recognise or acknow-ledge: Desid. प्रतीषिषति, to wish or try to understand.
31527: प्रतीत, अस्, आ, अम्, set forth, started, gone away; gone by, gone, past; acknowledged, proved, esta-blished, true; believed, trusted; experienced, known, well-known, famous, celebrated, renowned; called, (श्याम इति प्रतीतः, known by the name of Ś.); convinced (of the truth of anything), having a firm conviction; firmly resolved, fully determined; trusting, believing; satisfied, glad, pleased, delighted; respect-ful; clever, wise; (अस्), m. a divinity enumerated among the Viśve Devāḥ. —प्रतीत-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince. —प्रतीताक्षरा (°त-अक्°), f. ‘having trustworthy expressions,’ N. of a commentary on the Mitākṣarā. —प्रतीतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a recognised or acknowledged meaning.
31528: प्रतीति, इस्, f. going towards, approaching, drawing near; clear apprehension or insight into anything, definite perception, clear notion, distinct conception; complete understanding or ascertainment, knowledge, experience; conviction; faith, belief; trust, credit; fame, notoriety; respect; delight.
31529: प्रतीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being trusted or be-lieved, admitted.
31530: प्रतीयिवस्, वान्, -युषी, वत्, one who has come back, returned.
31531: प्रत्य्-अय, अस्, m. belief, firm conviction, trust, faith, reliance, assurance, confidence (प्रत्ययं गम्, to acquire confidence, repose confidence in; अस्त्य् अत्र प्रत्ययो मम, that is my conviction; कः प्रत्ययो ऽत्र, what assurance is there of that?); certainty, ascertainment; knowledge, expe-rience; apprehension, understanding, intellect (in the Sāṅkhya phil. = बुद्धि); acceptation, idea, notion, conception; ground, motive; (with Buddhists) a co-operating cause, the concurrent occasion of an event as distinguished from its proximate cause; an instrument, means of agency; an assistant, associate; celebrity, fame; analysis (?); definition (?); (in Ved. gram.) a subsequent or following letter; (according to native lexi-cographers) an oath, ordeal; a dependent, a subject; usage, custom, practice; religious contemplation; a householder who keeps a sacred fire; a hole. —प्र-त्यय-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, producing assurance, awakening confidence. —प्रत्यय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing confidence; (इणी), f. ‘producing assurance,’ a seal, signet. —प्रत्यय-त्व, अम्, n. the being a cause, causality. —प्रत्यय-सर्ग, अस्, m. (in the Sāṅkhya phil.) the intellectual creation.

31533: प्रत्ययिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) resting or depending upon.
31534: प्रत्य्-अयित, अस्, आ, अम्, confided in, relied upon, trusted, trusty, confidential.

31536: प्रत्य्-आय, अस्, m. revenue, tax, toll, tribute.
31537: प्रत्य्-आयक, अस्, इका, अम्, producing assurance, proving, making intelligible or clear, explaining, elucidating.
31538: 2. प्रत्य्-आयन, अम्, n. (for 2. see under प्रत्य्-ए), leading home (a wife), marrying (?); (अम्, आ), n. f. producing assurance, proving, demonstrating, making clear or intelligible, analyzing, explaining, expounding.
31539: प्रत्य्-आयित, अस्, m. a confidential agent, com-missioned servant, commissioner.
31540: प्रत्य्-आयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proved, to be made clear or intelligible.
31541: प्रत्य्-एतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acknowledged or admitted; to be relied on or believed.
31542: प्रत्य्-एतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, believing, trusting, having confidence, a believer.
31543: प्रतीक प्रतीक। See under प्रत्य्-अञ्च्, p. 625, col. 1.
31544: प्रतीकार प्रती-कार, अस्, m. = प्रति-कार, q. v.

31546: प्रतीकाश प्रती-काश (also wrongly spelt प्रती-कास)= प्रति-काश, q. v.
31547: प्रतीक्ष् प्रतीक्ष् (प्रति-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look towards, look at, ob-serve; to look forward to, look out for, expect; to wait, await, wait for; to look at with indifference, wink at, bear with, tolerate.
31548: प्रतीक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, looking forward to, ex-pecting, expectant, waiting for; having regard to, paying attention to; (आ), f. looking to, looking at, regard, consideration, attention, respect; waiting for, expectation, hope.
31549: प्रतीक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at; looking forward to, looking out for, expecting, waiting for.

31551: प्रतीक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to be had in view, to be considered or regarded; to be looked out for, to be waited for or expected.
31552: प्रतीक्षम्, ind. having expected (at the end of comps.; cf. शरत्-प्°).
31553: प्रतीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked for, looked out for, waited for, expected, hoped; contemplated, con-sidered, regarded; respected, honoured.
31554: प्रतीक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, looking or waiting for, ex-pecting, awaiting.
31555: 1. प्रतीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to be considered or regarded, worthy of consideration; respectable, venerable; to be looked forward to or expected, to be waited for; to be upheld or main-tained, to be fulfilled.
31556: 2. प्रतीक्ष्य, ind. having looked at, having con-sidered, having expected.
31557: प्रतीक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at, being an object of observation.
31558: प्रतीघात प्रती-घात, अस्, आ, अम्, warding off, parrying (= प्रति-घात, q. v.).
31559: प्रती-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, presenting obstacles, hin-dering; अ-प्रतीघातिन्, unhindered, unimpeded.
31560: प्रतीची प्रतीची, प्रतीचीन, &c. See under प्रत्य्-अञ्च्, p. 625, cols. 1, 2.
31562: प्रतीड् प्रतीड् (प्रति-ईड्), cl. 2. A. -ईट्टे, ईडितुम्, Ved. to praise.
31563: प्रतीत प्रतीत, &c. See under प्रती, col. 1.
31564: प्रतीतोद प्रती-तोद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. तुद् with प्रति), a term applied to particular initial forms of Padas in hymns.
31565: प्रतीत्त प्रती-त्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रति-दा, q. v.), given back, in अ-प्°, q. v.
31566: प्रतीदर्श प्रती-दर्श, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-दृश्; cf. प्रति-दर्श), Ved., N. of a man.
31567: प्रतीनाह प्रती-नाह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. नह् with प्रति), Ved. obstruction [cf. कर्ण-प्°, नासा-प्°]; a flag, banner.
31568: प्रतीन्धक प्रतीन्धक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. इन्ध् with प्रति), N. of a prince of Videha.
31569: प्रतीन्व् प्रतीन्व् (प्रति-इन्व्), cl. 1. P. -इन्वति, -इन्वितुम्, Ved. to promote, advance; to present, offer.
31570: प्रतीप प्रतीप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रति + अप्; cf. अनूप, द्वीप, समीप), ‘against the stream,’ ‘against the grain,’ going in an opposite direction, adverse, contrary, opposite, opposed, contradictory, reverse; inverted, disordered, out of order; dis-pleasing, offensive, disagreeable; resisting, perverse, refractory, disobedient, cross, obstinate; impeding, hindering; meeting, encountering; backward, retro-grade, going back; turned away, averted; (अस्), m., N. of a prince the father of Śāntanu and grand-father of Bhīṣma; (अम्), n. inverse comparison as a figure of speech (e. g. ‘the lotus resembles thine eyes,’ or ‘the moon resembles thy face,’ instead of the usual comparison — ‘thine eyes resemble the lotus,’ ‘thy face resembles the moon;’ five forms are enu-merated); N. of a grammatical work; (अम्), ind. against the stream, backwards; against; in inverted order; [cf. Russ. protiv, ‘against;’ protivnüi, ‘con-trary.’] —प्रतीप-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going against, flow-ing backwards. —प्रतीप-गति, इस्, f. or प्रतीप-ग-मन, अम्, n. a retrograde movement. —प्रतीप-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going against, acting in contravention to. —प्रतीप-तरण, अम्, n. sailing against the stream, crossing over (against) the stream. —प्रतीप-दर्शिनी, f. ‘looking in an opposite direction,’ ‘turning away the face,’ a woman; (also spelt प्रतीप-दर्-शनी।) —प्रतीप-वचन, अम्, n. contradicting, con-tradiction; a perverse or evasive manner, speaking to a third person without answering a previous speaker. —प्रतीपाश्व (°प-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a prince; (also read प्रतीकाश्व, q. v.)
31571: प्रतीपक, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed to, hindering, hostile; (अस्), m., N. of a prince.
31572: प्रतीपय, Nom. P. प्रतीपयति, -यितुम्, to oppose one's self to, to be against or hostile to (with loc.); to cause to turn back, cause to return, to bring back.
31573: प्रतीपाय, Nom. A. प्रतीपायते, -यितुम्, to oppose one's self to, to be against a person (with gen.); to be unfavourable to, dislike.
31574: प्रतीपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, unfavourable, to, unkind towards.
31575: प्रतीबोध प्रती-बोध, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-बुध्), Ved. watchfulness, vigilance.
31576: प्रतीमान प्रती-मान, अम्, n. a measure of capacity (= प्रति-मान, q. v.).
31578: प्रतीर् प्रतीर् (प्रति-ईर्), Caus. P. -ईरयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to put on, fix on (Sāy. = प्रति-धा).
31579: प्रतीर प्र-तीर, अस्, m., N. of one of the sons of Manu Bhautya; (अम्), n. a shore, bank.
31581: प्रतीवर्त प्रती-वर्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रति-वृत्), Ved. circular.
31582: प्रतीवाप प्रती-वाप, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-वप्), inserting (as an ingredient); adding to (especially in mixing medicines); throwing into; calcining or fluxing metals; an epidemic disease, pestilence, plague.
31583: प्रतीवाह प्रती-वाह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वह् with प्रति), Ved. harnessed or yoked at the side (?).
31584: प्रतीवी प्रती-वी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. receiving, accepting with pleasure; (ईस्), m. f. acceptance; (Sāy.) = यज्ञ।
31585: प्रतीवेश प्रती-वेश, अस्, m. = प्रति-वेश, q. v.
31586: प्रती-वेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, = प्रति-वेशिन्, q. v.
31587: प्रतीष् 1. प्रतीष् (प्रति-इष्; see rt. 3. इष्), cl. 6. P. प्रतीच्छति, प्रत्य्-एषितुम्, प्रत्य्-एष्टुम्, to strive after, seek (Ved.); to receive; to receive (a command), follow, attend to, observe, obey.
31588: प्रतीच्छक, अस्, m. one who receives, a receiver.
31589: प्रतीष्य, ind., Ved. striving after, seeking.
31590: प्रतीष् 2. प्रतीष् (प्रति-ईष्, see rt. ईष्), cl. 1. A. प्रतीषते, प्रतीषितुम्, to stretch out towards.
31591: प्रतीह प्रतीह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ईह् with प्रति), N. of a prince, a son of Parameṣṭhin; (also read प्रति-हार।)
31592: प्रतीहार प्रती-हार, अस्, m. = प्रति-हार, q. v. —प्रतीहार-ता, f. or प्रतीहार-त्व, अम्, n. the office of porter, duty of gate-keeper.
31593: प्रतीहास प्रती-हास, अस्, m. fragrant ole-ander, Nerium Odorum (= प्रति-हास).
31594: प्रतुद् प्र-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते, -तोत्तुम्, to strike at, strike, cut, pierce: Caus. -तो-दयति, -यितुम्, to pierce; to push on, instigate.
31595: प्र-तुद, अस्, m. ‘pecker,’ epithet of a class of birds (including the falcon, hawk, owl, parrot, crow, raven, peacock, &c.); an instrument for pricking.
31596: प्र-तोद, अस्, m. a goad; a long whip; an in-strument of torment; अङ्गिरसाम् प्रतोदः and कश्यपस्य प्रतोदः, N. of two Sāmans.
31597: प्र-तोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking; piercing.
31598: प्रतुष् प्र-तुष्, cl. 4. P. -तुष्यति, -तोष्टुम्, to delight in, take pleasure in (with inst.): Caus. P. -तोषयति, -यितुम्, to give pleasure, gratify.
31599: प्र-तुष्टि, इस्, f. gratifying, satisfying, satisfaction. —प्रतुष्टि-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving satisfaction.
31600: प्र-तोष, अस्, m. ‘gratification,’ N. of one of the twelve sons of Manu Svāyambhuva.
31602: प्रतूणी प्र-तूणी, f. a kind of nervous disease (in which pain is felt to extend itself from the rectum and organs of generation towards the bowels; in the disease called तूणी the pain takes an opposite direction, whence perhaps प्र-तूणी is an incorrect form for प्रति-तूणी).
31603: प्रतूर्ण प्र-तूर्ण, प्र-तूर्त, &c. See under प्र-त्वर्, p. 629, col. 1.
31604: प्रतृद् 1. प्र-तृद्, cl. 7. P. A. -तृणत्ति, तृन्त्ते, -तर्दितुम्, Ved. to thrust through with a spit, spit, pierce.
31605: 2. प्र-तृद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. splitting up, piercing; (त्), m. an expression substituted for the name of Tṛtsu.
31606: प्रतृप् प्र-तृप्, Caus. P. -तर्पयति, -यि-तुम्, to satisfy, sate, satiate; to refresh, invigorate, strengthen.
31607: प्रतॄ प्र-तॄ, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.), 6. P. -तरति (-ते), -तिरति, -तरितुम्, -तरीतुम्, to cross over, pass over, be ferried across; to come for-wards, advance, thrive, prosper (Ved.); to lead for-wards, lead, conduct; to promote, further, cause to thrive or prosper; to augment, aggrandize, enhance, raise, elevate; to lengthen, prolong, extend (fre-quently with आयुस्, in the sense of ‘prolonging life’); (A. with आयुस्), to live longer: Caus. -तार-यति, -यितुम्, to lengthen, spread, extend; to mis-lead, misguide, cheat, deceive; to lead astray, seduce; to induce, persuade.
31608: प्र-तार, अस्, m. ferrying over or across, carrying over; crossing over; deception, deceit, fraud.
31609: प्र-तारक, अस्, इका, अम्, deceiving, deceitful, cheating, imposing upon, insidious, perfidious; a deceiver, cheat, impostor.
31610: प्र-तारण, अम्, n. ferrying over or across, car-rying over, crossing over; deceiving, cheating, over-reaching, deception, deceit, fraud, trick.
31611: प्र-तारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deceived or mis-led, to be cheated (= वञ्चनीय), deceivable.
31612: प्र-तारित, अस्, आ, अम्, deceived, misled, cheated, imposed upon.
31613: प्रतोद प्र-तोद। See under प्र-तुद्, col. 1.
31614: प्रतोली प्र-तोली, f. a broad way, high street, principal road through a town or village; a kind of bandage applied to the neck and to the penis.
31616: प्रतोलीक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) having a high street.
31617: प्रत्त प्र-त्त, &c. See under प्र-दा, p. 630.
31618: प्रत्न प्रत्न, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. प्र), former, preceding, anterior; old, primeval, ancient; hitherto prevalent, traditional, customary; (अम्), n. a kind of metre. —प्रत्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the word प्रत्न; (वत्), ind. as formerly, in the usual manner.
31619: प्रत्न-था, ind., Ved. as formerly, as of old, in the usual manner.
31620: प्रत्यंशु प्रत्य्-अंशु, उस्, m., see Scholiast to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 193.
31621: प्रत्यक् प्रत्यक्। See under प्रत्य्-अञ्च्, p. 625, col. 1.
31622: प्रत्यक्ष प्रत्य्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, perceptible to the eye, being present before the eyes, in sight, perceptible, sensible, cognizable by any of the organs of sense (opposed to परोऽक्ष, q. v.); clear, dis-tinct, evident, undoubted, express, explicit, actual, real; corporeal; immediate; having before the eyes, keeping in view, discerning; (अम्), n. perceptibility, ocular evidence, clearness, distinctness, explicitness; superintendence; (in philosophy) apprehension by the senses, sensation, perception, intuition; (in rhetoric) a kind of style descriptive of impressions derived from the senses; (अम्, आत्, एण), ind. before the eyes, in the sight of; with direct personal knowledge, dis-tinctly, clearly; in the face of, in the presence of, before; publicly; immediately, directly, explicitly, really; literally; personally; at first sight, at sight; (ए), ind. in the sight of, before the eyes of. —प्रत्य्-अक्ष-कृता, f., Ved., scil. ऋक्, a hymn or verse in which a deity is addressed directly or in the second person (e. g. O Indra, thou &c.). —प्रत्यक्ष-खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n., N. of the first part of the Tattva-cintā-maṇi a Nyāya work by Gaṅgeśa. —प्र-त्यक्ष-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge obtained by per-ception. —प्रत्यक्ष-तमाम् or प्रत्यक्ष-त-मात्, ind., Ved. most perceptibly; most directly; most evidently. —प्रत्यक्ष-तस्, ind. before the eyes, in presence of, visibly, perceptibly, (प्रत्यक्षतः श्रुतम्, heard perceptibly or with the ears); evi-dently, clearly, plainly. —प्रत्यक्ष-ता, f. or प्र-त्यक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. visibility, perceptibility, per-ception by the senses, ocular demonstration; the standing face to face; explicitness; addressing in the second person (Ved.); प्रत्यक्षतया, visibly. —प्रत्यक्ष-दर्शन, अम्, n. seeing with one's own eyes, witnessing or seeing in person; the power of discerning the godhead present (in the sacrifice); (अस्), m. an eye-witness, witness. —प्रत्यक्ष-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing with one's own eyes, one who has seen with his own eyes, an eye-witness. —प्रत्य्-अक्ष-दर्शिवस्, आन्, m. one who has seen anything with his own eyes, an eye-witness; seeing anything clearly as if before the eyes. —प्रत्यक्ष-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, seeing distinctly, one who sees anything clearly as if before the eyes. —प्रत्यक्ष-दृश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen with the eyes, visible, per-ceptible. —प्रत्यक्ष-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seen with the eyes. —प्रत्यक्ष-परीक्षण, अम्, n. real observation or examination. —प्रत्यक्ष-प्रमा, f. correct or certain knowledge obtained through the senses. —प्रत्यक्ष-प्रमाण, अम्, n. ocular or visible proof, the evidence of the senses; an organ or faculty of perception. —प्रत्यक्ष-फल, अम्, n. a visible consequence. —प्रत्यक्ष-बृहती, f., Ved. a real or original Bṛhatī, an evident Bṛhatī. —प्रत्यक्ष-भक्ष, अस्, m., Ved. real or actual eating. —प्रत्यक्ष-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become visible, manifested. —प्रत्यक्ष-भोग, अस्, m. enjoyment or use of anything in the presence of or with the knowledge of the owner. —प्रत्यक्ष-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘asserting percep-tion by the senses,’ one who admits of no other evidence than perception by the senses; (ई), m. a Buddhist. —प्रत्यक्ष-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, expressly enjoined. —प्रत्यक्ष-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, having a form which is visible to the eye; composed clearly or intelligibly. —प्रत्यक्ष-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, determined by the evidence of the senses. —प्रत्य्-अक्षी-करण, अम्, n. looking at, viewing; making manifest or apparent. —प्रत्यक्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make visible or evident; to inspect, look at with one's own eyes, see. —प्रत्य्-अक्षी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, seen with the eyes; made present or visible; manifested, displayed.
31623: प्रत्यक्षय, Nom. P. प्रत्यक्षयति, -यितुम्, to make visible or perceptible, manifest, display.
31624: प्रत्यक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seeing or perceiving with one's own eyes, perceiving by the senses, witnessing in person; (ई), m. an eye-witness.
31625: प्रत्यक्षरम् प्रत्य्-अक्षरम्, ind. at each syl-lable, syllable by syllable, letter by letter, literally.
31626: प्रत्यग्नि प्रत्य्-अग्नि, ind. towards the fire; at or near or in every fire.
31627: प्रत्यग्र प्रत्य्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, fresh, recent, new, young; repeated, reiterated; pure (अस्), m., N. of a son of Vasu Upari-cara and prince of the Cedis. —प्रत्यग्र-क्षरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fresh-flowing, flowing freshly. —प्रत्यग्र-गन्धा, f. a species of shrub, Rhinacanthus Communis. —प्रत्यग्र-ता, f. or प्रत्यग्र-त्व, अम्, n. new-ness, freshness. —प्रत्यग्र-प्रसवा, f. recently delivered, having lately brought forth. —प्रत्यग्र-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, young in age, youthful, young; (अस्), n. youth. —प्रत्यग्र-शोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, recently purified, pure.
31628: प्रत्यग्रह प्रत्यग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu and king of the Cedis (= प्रत्य्-अग्र; probably a contracted form for प्रत्यग्-ग्रह).
31629: प्रत्यङ्क प्रत्य्-अङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, recently marked.
31630: प्रत्यङ्ग प्रत्य्-अङ्ग, अम्, n. a minor or se-condary member of the body (as the forehead, nose, chin, fingers, ears, &c.; the six aṅgas or chief mem-bers being the trunk, head, arms, and legs); a division, section, part, subdivision (of a science &c.); a weapon; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (अम्), ind. on every part or member of the body, on every limb, on the limbs severally; for every part or subdivision (of a sacrifice &c.); in each base (in grammar). —प्रत्यङ्ग-दक्षिणा, f. a fee for each part (of a sacrifice).
31631: प्रत्यङ्गिरस् प्रत्य्-अङ्गिरस्, आस्, m., N. of a mythical personage (who like Aṅgiras married a number of the daughters of Dakṣa).
31632: प्रत्य्-अङ्गिरस, अस्, m., N. of a mythical per-sonage regarded as the father of certain Ṛcas.
31633: प्रत्य्-अङ्गिरा, f. a form of Durgā, one of the goddesses of the Tāntrikas.
31634: प्रत्यजिर प्रत्य्-अजिर, अम्, n., see Gaṇa Aṃśv-ādi to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 193.
31635: प्रत्यञ्च् प्रत्य्-अञ्च्, प्रत्यङ्, प्रतीची (accord-ing to Vopa-deva IV. 12. also प्रत्यञ्ची), प्रत्यक् (fr. rt. 1. अञ्च् with प्रति), turned towards, directed towards, proceeding to (with acc.); being behind, coming from behind; subsequent, following (in time or place); turning the back upon, turning back, turning away, turned away, averted, taking an oppo-site direction; western, occidental, westerly, west, turned or directed towards the west, to the west of (with abl.); turned inwards, inner, interior; equal to, a match for; uniform, unmixed (?); (प्रतीची), f. (with or without दिश्), the western quarter, the west; (प्रत्यक्), ind. backwards, back, in an opposite direction; behind; against; to the west, westwards, to the west of (with abl.); in the interior, inwardly; in former times. —प्रतीचीश, अस्, m. ‘lord of the west,’ an epithet of Varuṇa. —प्रत्यक्-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose thoughts are turned inwards or upon himself; rightly intelligent. —प्रत्यक्-तत्त्व-दीपिका, f., N. of a work confuting the Nyāya philo-sophy upon the basis of the Vedānta. —प्रत्यक्-तत्त्व-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a philosophical work. —प्रत्यक्-त्व, अम्, n. backward direction, direc-tion towards one's self. —प्रत्यक्-पर्णी, f. a species of plant, Achyranthes Aspera (= अपामार्ग); the plant Anthericum Tuberosum (= द्रवन्ती). —प्र-त्यक्-पुष्पी, f. a species of plant, Achyranthes Aspera; (according to Vārttika I. to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 64. the correct form would be प्रत्यक्-पुष्पा।) —प्र-त्यक्-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head turned towards the west. —प्रत्यक्-श्रेणी, f., N. of various plants, Anthericum Tuberosum; Croton Polyandrum or Croton Tiglium; Salvinia Cucullata (commonly called इन्दुरकानी दन्ती). —प्रत्यक्-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, flowing towards the west; (often wrongly spelt प्रत्यक्-श्रोतस्।) —प्रत्यग्-अक्ष, अम्, n. an inner organ, internal faculty; (अस्, आ, अम्), having inner organs. —प्रत्यगक्ष-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, dis-cerned by the internal faculties, visible to the eye of the soul. —प्रत्यग्-आत्म-त्व, अम्, n. universal permeation of spirit. —प्रत्यग्-आत्मन्, आ, m. the individual soul. —प्रत्यग्-आनन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, inwardly rejoicing, internally joyful. —प्रत्यग्-आशा-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the western quarter,’ an epithet of Varuṇa. —प्रत्यग्-उदक्, ind. towards the north-west. —प्रत्यग्-दक्षिणतस्, ind. towards the south-west. —प्रत्यग्-दक्षिणा, ind., Ved. towards the south-west. —प्रत्यग्-दृश्, क्, f. an inward glance, glance directed inwards. —प्रत्यग्-धामन्, आ, आ, अ, radiant within, internally illuminated. —प्र-त्यग्-रथ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe (also called अहि-च्छत्त्र; cf. प्रात्यग्रथि). —प्रत्यङ्-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face turned away, having the face averted, facing the west.
31636: प्रतीक, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards, directed towards; adverse, contrary; inverted, reversed, in-verse, contrary to the natural order or condition; (अम्), n. an outer or upper part, exterior, surface (Ved.); outward form or shape, look, appearance (Ved.; cf. घृत-प्°, चारु-प्°, त्वेष-प्°); an image, symbol; the face; the front; the mouth; the first part (of a verse), first word; (अस्), m. a part, portion, particular point or item; a limb, mem-ber; N. of a son of Vasu and father of Ogha-vat; [cf. अनूक, अपाक, अभीक।] —प्रतीक-वत्, आन्, m., Ved. ‘having a face or mouth,’ an epithet of Agni. —प्रतीकाश्व (°क-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a prince. —प्रतीकोपासन (°क-उप्°), अम्, n. image worship, the service of idols.
31637: प्रतीचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going or coming towards, turned or directed towards; turned away from, turning the back upon, turning back; being behind, coming from behind; turning westward, situated towards the west, western, westerly; follow-ing, subsequent, future; (अम्), ind. back to one's self; backwards, behind. —प्रतीचीन-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the fruit turned backwards. —प्रतीचीनेड (°न-इडा), अम्, n., Ved., with का-शीतम्, N. of various Sāmans.
31638: प्रतीच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being or living in the west, western, westerly; (आ), f., N. of the wife of Pu-lastya; (अम्), n. a designation of anything remote or concealed (Naighaṇṭuka III. 25).
31640: प्रत्यञ्ज् प्रत्य्-अञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -अनक्ति, -अञ्जितुम्, अङ्क्तुम्, Ved. to smear over, besmear; to decorate.
31641: प्रत्य्-अञ्जन, अम्, n. smearing over, smearing, anointing.
31642: प्रत्यदन प्रत्य्-अदन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. अद्), eating; food.
31643: प्रत्यधी प्रत्य्-अधी (प्रति-अधि-इ), cl. 2. P. -अध्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to read through or study severally.
31644: प्रत्यनन्तर प्रत्य्-अनन्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the immediate neighbourhood (of a person or thing), closely connected with, immediately follow-ing; standing nearest (as an heir); (अम्), ind. immediately after (with abl.); next in succession.
31645: प्रत्यनिलम् प्रत्य्-अनिलम्, ind. against the wind.
31646: प्रत्यनीक प्रत्य्-अनीक, अस्, आ, अम्, hostile, opposed, opposite; withstanding, resisting; (अस्), m. an enemy; (अम्), n. a hostile army; hostility, enmity, a hostile relation, hostile position; injuring the relatives of an enemy who cannot be injured himself; injuring one who cannot retaliate (?). —प्र-त्यनीक-त्व, अम्, n. the state of an enemy, hostility.
31647: प्रत्यनुज्ञा प्रत्य्-अनु-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to disallow, refuse, reject; to spurn.
31648: प्रत्यनुतप् प्रत्य्-अनु-तप्, Pass. -तप्यते, &c., to feel subsequent remorse, repent, regret.
31649: प्रत्यनुनी प्रत्य्-अनु-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to bring to submission, induce to yield; to declare against, protest against; to disagree; to deny.
31650: प्रत्यनुभू प्रत्य्-अनु-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to enjoy singly or severally.
31651: प्रत्यनुमान प्रत्य्-अनुमान, अम्, n. a con-trary deduction, opposite conclusion.
31652: प्रत्यन्त प्रत्य्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bordering on, bordering, adjacent or contiguous to, skirting; (अस्), m. a border, frontier; a bordering country, i. e. a country occupied by barbarians, the country of the Mlecchas or savages; (आस्), m. pl. barbarous tribes; (आत्), ind., Ved. to the end. —प्रत्यन्त-देश, अस्, m. a neighbouring country, a country bordering upon another. —प्रत्यन्त-पर्वत, अस्, m. an adjacent hill, a small hill near a mountain.
31653: प्रत्यपकार प्रत्य्-अपकार, अस्, m. offending or injuring in return, retaliation.
31654: प्रत्यब्दम् प्रत्य्-अब्दम्, ind. every year, year by year, yearly.
31655: प्रत्यभिघृ प्रत्य्-अभि-घृ, Caus. P. -घार-यति, -यितुम्, Ved. to sprinkle over repeatedly.
31656: प्रत्य्-अभिघारण, अम्, n., Ved. sprinkling over afresh.
31657: प्रत्यभिचर् प्रत्य्-अभि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरितुम्, Ved. to use spells or charms against, employ incantations against.
31658: प्रत्य्-अभिचरण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. using spells or charms against, employing incantations against.
31659: प्रत्यभिज्ञा 1. प्रत्य्-अभि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to recognise again; to come to one's self, recover one's consciousness.
31660: 2. प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञा, f. recognising again, recogni-tion; N. of a philosophical work.
31661: प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, recognised again, recognised, known.
31662: प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञान, अम्, n. recognising again, re-cognising, recognition, knowing; a token of recog-nition (which a messenger brings back to prove that he has duly accomplished his mission). —प्रत्यभि-ज्ञान-रत्न, अम्, n. jewel of recognition, a jewel given as a token of recognition.
31663: प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञाय, ind. having recognised again, having recognised.
31664: प्रत्यभिधा प्रत्य्-अभि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place back, bring or draw back, reabsorb; to reply, answer; to give con-sent.
31665: प्रत्यभिधाव् प्रत्य्-अभि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. -धा-वति, -धावितुम्, to run or hasten towards.
31666: प्रत्यभिनन्द् प्रत्य्-अभि-नन्द्, cl. 1. P. -नन्-दति, -नन्दितुम्, to greet or salute in return, return a salutation; to bid welcome.
31667: प्रत्य्-अभिनन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, receiving or accept-ing with thanks.
31668: प्रत्यभिप्रस्था प्रत्य्-अभि-प्र-स्था, cl. 1. A. -तिष्ठते, -स्थातुम्, to set out towards, set out for, depart; to march towards.
31669: प्रत्यभिभाषिन् प्रत्य्-अभिभाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking to, addressing.
31670: प्रत्यभिभूत प्रत्य्-अभिभूत, अस्, आ, अम्, over-powered, overcome, conquered.
31671: प्रत्यभिमिथ् प्रत्य्-अभि-मिथ्, cl. 1. 6. P. -मेथति, -मिथति, &c., Ved. to answer scornfully or abusively.
31672: प्रत्य्-अभिमेथन, अम्, n., Ved. a scornful reply.
31673: प्रत्यभिमृश् प्रत्य्-अभि-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृ-शति, -मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to stroke over, stroke down, touch; to lay hold of.
31674: प्रत्य्-अभिमर्श, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-अभिमर्-शन, अम्, n., Ved. rubbing, touching (with the hand).
31675: प्रत्यभियुक्त प्रत्य्-अभियुक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. युज् with प्रत्य्-अभि), accused in return, charged by a counter plaint.
31676: प्रत्य्-अभियोग, अस्, m. a counter plaint or charge, a counter accusation, an accusation brought against the accuser or plaintiff, recrimination.
31677: प्रत्यभिवद् प्रत्य्-अभि-वद्, Caus. A. -वाद-यते, -यितुम्, to return a salute, greet in return.
31678: प्रत्य्-अभिवाद, अस्, m. returning a salutation or greeting; acknowledging a benediction.
31679: प्रत्य्-अभिवादक, अस्, इका, अम्, returning a salutation or greeting.
31680: प्रत्य्-अभिवादन, अम्, n. returning a salutation or greeting (Manu II. 126).
31681: प्रत्य्-अभिवादयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who re-turns a salutation or greeting.
31682: प्रत्यभिस्कन्दन प्रत्य्-अभिस्कन्दन, अम्, n. a counter plaint or charge, an accusation brought against the accuser or plaintiff; [cf. प्रत्य्-अभियोग।]
31683: प्रत्यभ्यनुज्ञा 1. प्रत्य्-अभ्य्-अनु-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to dismiss any one when taking leave.
31685: प्रत्य्-अभ्यनुज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, dismissed on taking leave, allowed to depart.
31686: प्रत्यमित्र प्रत्य्-अमित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed as an enemy, hostile; (अस्), m. an enemy, oppo-nent, adversary.
31688: प्रत्ययनस्त्व प्रत्ययनस्त्व, अम्, n., Ved. obtaining again, reobtaining, recovery.
31689: प्रत्यरा प्रत्य्-अरा, f., Ved. an intermediate spoke of a wheel.
31690: प्रत्यरि प्रत्य्-अरि, इस्, m. a well-matched opponent, equally powerful enemy.
31691: प्रत्यर्क प्रत्य्-अर्क, अस्, m. a mock sun, parhelion.
31692: प्रत्यर्च् प्रत्य्-अर्च्, cl. 1. P. -अर्चति, -अर्चितुम्, to shine towards, shine upon (Ved.): Caus. -अर्च-यति, -यितुम्, to return a salutation (with acc.); to salute one by one.
31693: प्रत्य्-अर्चन, अम्, n. returning a salutation or obeisance.
31694: प्रत्यर्थ् प्रत्य्-अर्थ्, cl. 10. P. -अर्थयति, -यितुम्, to seek (any one) as an opponent, challenge (to combat).
31695: प्रत्य्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, useful, expedient; (अम्), n. a reply, answer, counter representation; opposi-tion, hostility; (अम्), ind. at every object, in every case.
31696: प्रत्यर्थक, अस्, m. an opponent, adversary.
31697: प्रत्यर्थिक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्रत्य्-अर्थिन्, an opponent (at the end of a comp.; cf. बहु-प्°).
31698: प्रत्य्-अर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hostile, inimical; opposing, contradicting, rejecting; emulating; (ई), m. an enemy, opponent, adversary, rival; (in law) a de-fendant. —प्रत्यर्थि-ता, f. or प्रत्यर्थि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of a defendant at law. —प्रत्य्-अर्थ्य्-आवेदन, अम्, n. (in a lawsuit) the verbal information or deposition of the defendant which is written down by the officers of the court.
31699: प्रत्यर्द् प्रत्य्-अर्द्, Caus. P. A. -अर्दयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to oppress or press hard in return, assault in return, return an attack.
31700: प्रत्यर्धि प्रत्य्-अर्धि, इस्, इस्, इ (connected with अर्ध), Ved. possessing half of (with gen.)?; having equal claims, equal.
31701: प्रत्यर्पण प्रत्य्-अर्पण, प्रत्य्-अर्पणीय। See under प्रत्य्-ऋ, p. 629, col. 1.
31702: प्रत्यर्ष प्रत्य्-अर्ष, अस्, m. (rt. ऋष्), Ved. (perhaps) the slope or side (of a hill).
31703: प्रत्यर्हम् प्रत्य्-अर्हम् in यथा-प्°, q. v.

31705: प्रत्यवगम् प्रत्य्-अव-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्-छति, -गन्तुम्, to know one by one, recognise severally.
31706: प्रत्यवग्रह् प्रत्य्-अव-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to draw back, withdraw, resume, retract, revoke, recall.
31707: प्रत्यवधा प्रत्य्-अव-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, Ved. to apply again.
31708: प्रत्यवनेजन प्रत्य्-अवनेजन, अम्, n., Ved. washing off again.
31709: प्रत्यवभुज् प्रत्य्-अव-भुज् (see rt. 1. भुज्), cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्तुम्, to bend back.
31710: प्रत्यवमर्श प्रत्य्-अवमर्श, अस्, m. inner contemplation, profound meditation; counsel, advice, injunction; a counter conclusion; recollection [cf. स्मृति-प्°]; (sometimes less correctly spelt प्रत्य्-अवमर्ष।) —प्रत्यवमर्श-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, absorbed in thought or reflection, meditative.
31711: प्रत्य्-अवमर्शन, अम्, n. contemplation, re-flection, pondering (according to a Scholiast = युक्-तायुक्त-विचार).
31712: प्रत्यवमृष् प्रत्य्-अव-मृष्, cl. 4. 1. P. A. -मृष्यति, -ते, -मर्षति, -ते, -मर्षितुम्, to endure reluctantly, suffer beyond endurance.
31713: प्रत्यवयवम् प्रत्य्-अवयवम्, ind. in every part or particular, in detail. —प्रत्यवयव-वर्-णन, अम्, आ, n. f. a detailed or minute description, description of every part.
31714: प्रत्यवर प्रत्य्-अवर, अस्, आ, अम्, lower, more insignificant, less honoured.

31716: प्रत्य्-अवरूढि, इस्, f., Ved. descending towards.
31717: प्रत्य्-अवरोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to descend from; deprived, bereft of.
31718: प्रत्य्-अवरोह, अस्, m., Ved. descending towards; a descending series.
31719: प्रत्य्-अवरोहण, अम्, n., Ved. descending towards; N. of a particular Gṛhya festival in the month Mārgaśīrṣa.
31720: प्रत्य्-अवरोहणीय, अस्, m., Ved. a particular Ekāha sacrifice forming part of the Vājapeya.
31721: प्रत्य्-अवरोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. descending, mov-ing downwards; moving or rising from a seat.
31722: प्रत्यवरोधन प्रत्य्-अवरोधन, अम्, n. ob-struction, interruption.
31723: प्रत्यवसान प्रत्य्-अवसान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सो with प्रत्य्-अव), consuming, consumption, eating.
31724: प्रत्य्-अवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, consumed, eaten.
31725: प्रत्यवस्कन्द प्रत्य्-अवस्कन्द, अस्, m. or प्र-त्य्-अवस्कन्दन, अम्, n. a special plea at law, admitting a fact but qualifying or explaining it so as not to allow it to be matter of accusation.
