32159: प्रपच् प्र-पच्, cl. 1. P. A. -पचति, -ते, -पक्-तुम्, to begin to cook; to be accustomed to cook.
32160: प्र-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (in medicine) inflamed.
32161: प्र-पाक, अस्, m. ripening (of a boil &c.); in-flammation.
32162: प्रपञ्च प्र-पञ्च, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पच् or पञ्च् with प्र), spreading out, development, dif-fusion, display, amplification, expansion; expanse, ex-tent; (in philosophy) the expansion of the universe, the world as the scene of manifold action, the visible world or universe; prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness (in style or composition); heap, abundance, quantity; manifoldness, diversity; phenomenon, appearance; illusion, delusion, deceit, trick, fraud, error; reci-procal false praise; reverse, opposition, reversion, inversion; analysis; (in grammar) the repetition of an obscure rule in a clearer form; a joke, jest (?); (as an enclitic after a finite verb) see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27, 57; प्रपञ्चेन or प्रपञ्च-तस्, ind. diffusely, in detail. —प्रपञ्च-निर्माण, अम्, n. the creation of the visible world. —प्रपञ्च-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, deceitful-minded, artful, cunning; (इस्), m., N. of a man. —प्रपञ्च-वचन, अम्, n. a diffuse or prolix discourse. —प्रपञ्च-विवेक and प्रपञ्च-सार, अस्, m., N. of two works.
32163: प्र-पञ्चक, अस्, इका, अम्, developing, displaying; explaining, copiously expounding.
32164: प्र-पञ्चन, अम्, n. development, display, diffu-sion; copious explanation or exposition, explication.
32165: प्रपञ्चय, Nom. P. प्रपञ्चयति, -यितुम्, to develop, amplify; to display, explain in detail, analyze; to dwell upon a note (in music); to cause to appear in a false light.
32166: प्रपञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Nom.), amplified, expanded, extended, diffused; declared fully, ex-plained, expatiated upon, treated at length; caused to appear in a false light; mistaken, erring; tricked, deceived, beguiled.
32167: प्रपठ् प्र-पठ्, cl. 1. P. -पठति, -पठितुम्, to recite aloud: Caus. -पाठयति, -यितुम्, to teach, lecture, expound.
32168: प्र-पाठक, अस्, m. a lesson, lecture, a division, chapter or subdivision of a book (sometimes read प्र-पाठ).
32169: प्रपण प्र-पण, अस्, m., Ved. (fr. rt. 2. पण् with प्र), exchange, barter.
32170: प्रपत् प्र-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fly forwards, fly along, fly forth, fly away; to hasten forwards, hasten away; to fly down, rush or dart down; to fall down, fall; to fall into; to come to; to fall from, be deprived of, lose (with abl.): Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fly away, put to flight; to chase, pursue: Desid. -पिपतिषति, Ved. to wish to hurry away: Intens. -पापतीति, Ved. to shoot forth; (Sāy.) = पुनः पुनः पत्, to fall again and again, descend repeatedly.
32171: प्र-पतन, अम्, n. flying forwards, flying forth, flying away; falling, falling down or into, precipi-tating one's self from; alighting; dying, death, destruction; a steep rock, precipice.
32172: प्र-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown forwards, flown away, flown; fallen, come down; decayed, dead.
32173: प्र-पात, अस्, m. a particular mode of flying; starting off, hastening away, going away, departure; springing forth, sudden attack, facing an enemy; falling down or into, a fall; precipitating one's self down from a rock; falling out, (दन्त-केश-प्रपात, the falling out or loss of the teeth and hair); discharge, emission, flux [cf. वीर्य-प्°]; a steep rock, cliff, precipice; a steep bank or shore; a cascade, water-fall. —प्रपाताभिमुख (°त-अभ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, inclined to precipitate one's self from a rock. —प्रपाताम्बु (°त-अम्°), उ, n. falling water, water falling from a rock.
32174: प्र-पातन, अम्, n. the causing to fall, throwing down, throwing on the ground; अक्ष-प्रपातन, throwing dice.
32175: प्र-पातिन्, ई, m. a precipitous mountain, moun-tain, rock, cliff.
32176: प्र-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to de-scend or alight, wishing to fall or throw one's self down.
32177: प्रपथ प्र-पथ, अस्, m., Ved. a long way or journey, a journey to a distant place; a remote place; a broad road or street; (अस्, आ, अम्), loose, relaxed, languid, enervated.
32178: प्रपथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. roaming on distant paths (Sāy. = प्रकृष्ट-मार्ग); (ई), m., N. of a man (?).
32179: प्रपथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the streets or on the road (Mahī-dhara = बहु-सेवितो मार्गस् तत्र भवः, being in a much frequented road); an epithet of Pūṣan, the tutelary deity of travellers.
32180: प्रपाथ, अस्, m. a road, way.
32181: प्रपद् 1. प्र-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-तुम्, to go forwards, set out for, betake one's self to, resort to; to attain to, arrive at, reach; to take refuge with, flee to for safety, fly to for succour; to enter upon, enter into, set foot on; to come to a par-ticular state, arrive at a condition; to become (with adv. ending in सात्, e. g. सर्प-सात् प्रपद्, to become a serpent); to attain, obtain, gain, partake of, share in; to perceive; to come on, draw near, approach, appear (said of periods of time); to be going on, to proceed; to take effect, prosper; to deal with, act towards, behave towards; to allow, admit, assent, agree to; to throw one's self down, fall down (at another's feet); to fall upon, attack, assault, assail (Ved.); अध्वानम् प्रपद्, to set forth on the way, begin a journey; जिन-शाशनम् प्रपद्, to embrace the doctrines of Jina: Caus. P. A. -पादयति, -ते, -यि-तुम्, to cause to enter, introduce: Desid. P. A. -पित्सति, -ते, to wish to enter; to desire to obtain; to be going to undertake.
32182: 2. प्र-पद्, त्, f., Ved. a way; N. of particular sacred texts; (fr. प्र + 3. पद्), the fore part of the foot.
32183: प्र-पद, अम्, n. (fr. प्र + पद), the fore part of the foot; the point of the foot, tip of the toes; (ऐस्), ind. on tiptoe.
32185: प्रपदम्, ind. a term applied to a particular mode of recitation (in which the Vedic verses are divided, without reference to the sense and construction, into parts of an equal number of syllables, and between these parts particular formulas inserted containing the word प्र-पद्ये).
32186: प्रपदीन, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the fore part of the foot; extending to it, (wrongly for आप्रप-दीन, q. v.)
32187: प्र-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, arriving at, reaching; seeking, adhering to; one who seeks for protection or takes refuge, a suppliant; attained, obtained; pos-sessed of, furnished with, provided with; promised, assented to; effecting, producing; poor, distressed. —प्रपन्न-पाल, अस्, m. ‘the protector of sup-pliants or of those who seek protection,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —प्रपन्नामृत (°न-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar for suppliants,’ N. of a work. —प्रपन्-नार्ति-हर (°न-आर्°), अस्, ई, अम्, relieving or re-liever of the distress of suppliants.
32188: प्र-पाद, अस्, m., Ved. premature delivery, mis-carriage.
32189: प्र-पादुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going off, coming forth.
32190: प्र-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of attaining, de-sirous of entering upon.
32193: प्रपर्ण प्र-पर्ण, अस्, m. a fallen leaf.
32194: प्रपलाय प्र-पलाय, cl. 1. A. -पलायते, -यितुम्, to run away, flee away, escape.
32195: प्र-पलायन, अम्, n. running away, flight, rout.
32196: प्र-पलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, run away; routed, defeated.
32197: प्र-पलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, running away, flying, escaping; a fugitive, one who deserts his cause.
32198: प्रपवण प्र-पवण or प्र-पवन, अम्, n. (rt. 1. पू), purifying, straining (Soma juice).
32199: प्र-पवणीय or प्र-पवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cleansed or purified.
32201: प्रपा 1. प्र-पा (see rt. 1. पा), cl. 1. P. -पिबति (Ved. -पाति), -पातुम्, to begin to drink, drink, quaff, sip; (with चक्षुषा) to drink in with the eyes, feast the eyes upon.
32202: 2. प्र-पा, f. (according to the usual rule the nom. sing. would be प्र-पास्), a place for watering cattle, a shed on the road-side for accommodating travellers with water, place where water is distributed, cistern, (according to Kullūka = पानीय-दान-गृह); a draught; a supply of water. —प्रपा-पूरण, अम्, n. filling a place for watering cattle, furnishing a cistern with water. —प्रपापूरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, serving to fill a cistern. —प्रपा-वन, अम्, n. ‘cistern-grove,’ a pleasure-garden, a cool grove.
32203: प्र-पाणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drunk, drinkable, potable.
32204: प्र-पान, अम्, n. drinking, sipping; the under part of a horse's upper lip (which he uses in drinking).
32205: प्रपानक, अम्, n. (probably) a draught, beverage.
32206: 1. प्र-पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, drinking, one who drinks.
32207: प्रपा 3. प्र-पा (see rt. 3. पा), cl. 2. P. -पाति, -पातुम्, to protect, defend from (with abl.): Caus. -पालयति, -यितुम्, to guard, screen, defend, protect.
32209: प्र-पालन, अम्, n. guarding, protecting, pro-tection.
32210: प्र-पालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, guarding, protecting; (ई), m. an epithet of Bala-rāma.
32213: प्रपाणि प्र-पाणि, इस्, m. the flat or palm of the hand.
32214: प्रपाण्डु प्र-पाण्डु, उस्, उस्, उ, very white, of a dazzling white colour.
32216: प्रपादिक प्रपादिक, अस्, m. a peacock; (also read प्रपादीक।)
32218: प्रपितामह प्र-पितामह, अस्, m. a paternal great-grandfather; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (regarded as great-grandfather of the three worlds); an epithet of Brahmā; (ई), f. a paternal great-grandmother; (आस्), m. pl. great-grandfathers, ancestors in general.
32219: प्र-पितृव्य, अस्, m. a paternal grand-uncle.
32220: प्रपित्व प्र-पित्व, अम्, n., Ved. going towards, going to meet, meeting with, encountering (Sāy. = सङ्ग्राम, combat); the coming on or ap-proach of day, day-break (Sāy. = प्र-क्रम); [cf. अप-पित्व, अभि-पित्व।]
32222: प्रपिन्व् प्र-पिन्व्, cl. 1. P. A. -पिन्वति, -ते, -पिन्वितुम्, Ved. to swell, be full of, be rich, flow over.
32223: प्रपिष् प्र-पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, -पेष्-टुम्, to crush, pound: Caus. -पेषयति, -यितुम्, to pound, grind or crush to pieces.
32224: प्र-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded, ground or crushed to pieces.
32225: प्रपीड् प्र-पीड्, Caus. -पीडयति, -यितुम्, to press hard, press, squeeze; to check, suppress; to oppress, molest, injure, pain, torment, torture.
32226: प्र-पीडन, अम्, n. pressing, squeezing; (in medicine) an astringent.
32227: प्र-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed, oppressed; pained, tortured.
32229: प्रपुत्र प्र-पुत्र, अस्, m. a grandson, de-scendant.
32230: प्रपुनाट प्रपुनाट, or प्रपुनाड, or प्र-पुन्नड, or प्रपुन्नाट, or प्रपुन्नाड, or प्रपुन्नाल, अस्, m. a species of tree, Cassia Tora; the ringworm shrub, Cassia Alata.
32231: प्रपुष् प्र-पुष्, cl. 4. 9. P. -पुष्यति, -पुष्णाति, -पोषितुम्, to nourish, feed, support, maintain.
32232: प्रपुष्पित प्र-पुष्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, flowering, in blossom, blooming.
32233: प्रपूज् प्र-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यितुम्, to show respect or honour to, praise, esteem, honour.
32234: प्रपृ प्र-पृ (see rt. 1. पृ), Caus. P. -पा-रयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to carry across, bring over, transport, ferry over; to bring out of, to deliver from (with abl.), rescue, protect (Sāy. = पालयति).
32235: प्रपृच् प्र-पृच्, cl. 7. P. -पृणक्ति, -पर्चि-तुम्, Ved. to come in contact with (with acc.).
32236: प्रपृथक् प्र-पृथक्, ind., Ved. singly, one by one.
32237: प्रपृष्ठ प्र-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a prominent or protuberant back.
32238: प्रपॄ प्र-पॄ, cl. 9. P. -पृणाति, -परितुम्, -परीतुम्, to fill up, complete: Pass. -पूर्यते, to be filled, become full, become satiated; to be com-pleted, be fulfilled: Caus. -पूरयति, -यितुम्, to fill up, complete; to make rich, enrich.
32239: प्र-पूरक, अस्, इका, अम्, filling up, fulfilling, satisfying, satiating; (इका), f. the plant Solanum Jacquini.
32240: प्र-पूरण, अस्, ई, अम्, filling, fulfilling, satisfying; (अम्), n. the act of filling up, filling; injecting, injec-tion, inserting; affixing, attaching to; satiating, satis-fying; (with धनुषः) bending a bow, i. e. the drawing or filling out of a bow-string for the purpose of shooting.
32241: प्र-पूरित, अस्, आ, अम्, filled up, completed.
32242: प्रपौण्डरीक प्रपौण्डरीक, अम्, n. a small herbaceous plant (= पौण्डरीक, commonly पुण्-डरिया, used as a remedy for ulcers and bad eyes and as a perfume); = स्थल-पद्म, Hibiscus Mu-tabilis.
32243: प्रपौत्र प्र-पौत्र or प्र-पौत्रक, अस्, m. the son of a son's son, a great-grandson; (ई), f. the daughter of a son's son, a great-granddaughter.
32244: प्रप्यै प्र-प्यै, cl. 1. A. -प्यायते, -प्यायि-तुम्, -प्यातुम्, to swell out, swell up, be distended: Caus. -प्याययति, -यितुम्, to cause to swell out, swell, distend.
32245: प्र-पीत or प्र-पीन, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen out, swollen up, distended.
32246: प्र-प्यात or प्र-प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen out, distended, fat, bulky.
32247: प्र-प्यायन, अम्, n. causing to swell out, swelling.
32248: प्र-प्यायनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to swell out, to be swollen.
32249: प्र-प्याययितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. causing to swell out, distending.
32250: प्रप्रोथ प्र-प्रोथ, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a particular plant (sometimes used as a substi-tute for the Soma plant).
32251: प्रप्लु प्र-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, Ved. to swim towards, to float or sail away: Caus. -प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to float or sail away; to pour water upon, wash or flood with water.
32252: प्र-प्लावन, अम्, n., Ved. flooding with water, extinguishing (a fire) with water.
32253: प्र-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dipped in water.
32254: प्रफर्वी प्रफर्वी, f., Ved. a wanton or lascivious girl.
32255: प्रफुल्त प्र-फुल्त, अस्, आ, अम्, blown, blos-somed, blooming (= प्र-फुल्ल, Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 4, 89).
32257: प्र-फुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, blooming forth, blooming, blossoming, flowering, blossomed, blown (as a flower), covered with blossoms; expanded like a blown flower; shining; smiling; glad, gay, cheerful, pleased. —प्रफुल्ल-नयन or प्रफुल्ल-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having full or sparkling eyes, having eyes ex-panded with joy. —प्रफुल्ल-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, having the face expanded with joy, having a cheerful or smiling countenance, looking gay or happy.
32258: प्रबन्ध् प्र-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्धुम्, to bind on, bind, fasten, connect; to suppress, check, stop.
32259: प्र-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound on, bound, fas-tened, fettered; connected; suppressed, checked, stopped. —प्रबद्ध-मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering from retention of urine or ischury.
32260: प्र-बन्द्धृ, धा, m. one who connects toge-ther, an author.
32261: प्र-बन्ध, अस्, m. a connection, a bond, tie, (गर्भ-नाडी-प्रबन्ध, the umbilical cord); an uninterrupted connection, continuous series; uninter-ruptedness, continuance, continuous application or action; a continued discourse or narration, connected discussion or narrative; a composition, any literary composition, especially a poetical production. —प्र-बन्ध-कल्पना, f. a feigned story, a work of imagination (whether founded on fact or not). —प्र-बन्ध-वर्ष, अस्, m. incessant rain, rain without intermission. —प्रबन्धाध्याय (°ध-अध्°), अस्, m., N. of the fourth chapter of the Saṅgīta-darpaṇa; of the fourth book of the Saṅgīta-ratnākara.
32262: प्र-बन्धन, अम्, n. connection, bond, tie; [cf. सन्धि-प्°।]
32263: प्रबभ्र प्र-बभ्र, अस्, m. an epithet of Indra.
32264: प्रबर्ह प्र-बर्ह or प्र-वर्ह, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. बृह् or वृह् with प्र), the best, most excellent.
32265: प्रबल 1. प्र-बल, अस्, आ, अम् (see बल), prevailing, predominant; strong, powerful, mighty, great; violent (as pain); important, significant; abounding with; dangerous, pernicious; (अस्), m., N. of an attendant of Viṣṇu; of a Daitya; a sprout, shoot (= प्र-बाल); (आ), f. a kind of plant (= प्र-सारिणी); (अम्), ind. strongly, exceedingly, much. —प्रबल-ता, f. or प्रबल-त्व, अम्, n. strength, power, might, mightiness, validity. —प्र-बल-तोय, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in water. —प्र-बल-रुदित, अम्, n. strong crying, excessive weeping. —प्रबल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, strong, mighty.
32266: 2. प्रबल, Nom. P. प्रबलति, &c., to become strong or powerful.
32267: प्र-बाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (sometimes spelt प्र-वाल), a young shoot, sprout, new leaf or branch; coral (in this sense also written प्र-वाड); the neck of the Indian lute; (अस्), m. an animal; a pupil; a kind of vegetable; [cf. प्रबालिक।] —प्र-बाल-पद्म, अम्, n. a red lotus-flower. —प्रबाल-फल, अम्, n. red sandal-wood. —प्रबाल-भस्मन्, अ, n. calx or ashes of coral (used medicinally). —प्र-बाल-मणि-शृङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having horns of coral and gems. —प्रबाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having new leaves or shoots. —प्रबालाश्मन्तक (°ल-अश्°), (probably) coral.
32268: प्रबालक, अस्, m., N. of a Yakṣa; (इका), f., N. of a female.
32269: प्रबालिक, अस्, m. a kind of vegetable.
32270: प्रबली प्रबली, f. a class, division of a community, (supposed to be used in this sense in a particular inscription.)
32271: प्रबह्निका प्रबह्लिका = प्रवह्लिका or प्र-वल्हिका, q. v.

32558: प्रयज् 1. प्र-यज्, cl. 1. P. A. -यजति, -ते, -यष्टुम्, Ved. to sacrifice to, offer sacrifices, worship.
32559: 2. प्र-यज्, क्, f., Ved. an offering, oblation; [cf. पृक्ष-प्°।]
32560: प्र-यज्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. to be worshipped or honoured (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण पूज्यः); striving forwards, pressing onwards, rushing on (? cf. इयक्ष्; especially used as an epithet of the Maruts and of Vāyu, but also said of Indra and Agni).
32561: प्र-याग, अस्, m. a sacrifice, an oblation; the place of sacrifice ἐξοχήν, a celebrated place of pilgrimage (now called Allahabad) at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā with the supposed sub-terranean Sarasvatī (cf. त्रि-वेणी; प्रयाग in com-position is applied to four other sacred places situated at the confluence of two rivers, viz. Deva-p°, Rudra-p°, Karṇa-p°, and Nanda-p°, in the Himālaya moun-tains); a horse [cf. प्र-योग]; a N. of Indra [cf. प्रयाग-भय]; N. of a man (in this sense also प्रयागक); (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of Pra-yāga. —प्रयाग-भय, अस्, m. ‘fearing sacrifice,’ an epithet of Indra (who is liable to be dethroned by the performance of a hundred Aśva-medhas or horse sacrifices). —प्रयाग-सेतु, उस्, m., N. of a work.
32562: प्र-याज, अस्, m., Ved., N. of particular sacri-ficial texts or invocations and of the Ājya oblations or libations at which they are employed (they form part of the Prāyaṇīya or introductory ceremony in a Soma sacrifice and are generally five in number, viz. Samidh, Tanū-napāt, Iḍā, Barhis, Svāhā-kāra; at animal sacrifices their number is eleven, correspond-ing to the eleven Āpris, cf. आ-प्री); a principal ceremony or sacrifice. —प्रयाज-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. accompanied with Prayājas.
32563: प्रयत् प्र-यत्, cl. 1. A. -यतते, -यतितुम्, to strive, endeavour, make effort; to apply one's self to (with loc.).
32564: प्र-यतितव्य or प्र-यत्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be striven or endeavoured.
32565: प्र-यत्न, अस्, m. persevering effort, continued exertion or endeavour, exertion bestowed on anything (with the object in the loc., or as the first member of a comp.; cf. कृत-प्°); activity of will; activity, action, act; great care, caution, care; difficulty; (in philosophy) active effort of three kinds, viz. engaging in any act, prosecuting it, and completing it; (in grammar) effort in uttering, effort or movement of the mouth or breath in the production of articulate utterance, mode of articulation, (also आस्य-प्र-यत्न; distinguished into आभ्यन्तर-प्°, inter-nal effort, and वाह्य-प्°, external effort); प्रयत्-नेन, प्रयत्नात्, प्रयत्नैस्, प्रयत्न-तस्, ind. with especial effort, with particular care or pains, diligently, carefully, earnestly, zealously, with all one's might; particularly, especially; with difficulty, hardly, scarcely. —प्रयत्न-प्रेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen with an effort, hardly visible. —प्रयत्न-मुक्तासन, अस्, आ, अम्, quitting a seat with difficulty, rising with difficulty from a seat. —प्रयत्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who endeavours or makes effort, one who directs his whole attention and care towards anything, assiduous, enterprising, persevering.
32566: प्रयम् प्र-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्, to hold out towards, offer; to present, bestow, grant, give (with dat., loc., or gen. of the person and acc. of the thing; in Ṛg-veda VII. 75, 2, with acc. of the person and dat. of the thing); to give in mar-riage; to give up, deliver, restore, return; to pay, discharge (a debt); to restrain, check, control.
32567: प्र-यच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, presenting, giving, bestowing.
32568: प्र-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained, well governed, self-subdued, keeping the organs of sense under con-trol; submissive; careful, prudent; zealous, intent (on devotion); pure; (अस्), m. a holy or pious person, one purified by austerity and mortification. —प्रयत-त्व, अम्, n. self-control, purity, holiness. —प्रयत-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who has made presents (to the priests officiating at a sa-crifice; Sāy. = येन ऋत्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणा दत्ताः). —प्रयत-परिग्रह-द्वितीय, अस्, m. accompa-nied by a pious or chaste wife. —प्रयतात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, restrained in mind, pious-minded, devout in spirit, pious, ascetic.
32569: प्र-यति, इस्, f., Ved. offering, presenting; a gift, oblation; effort, exertion, endeavour; will, intention.
32570: प्र-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who offers or presents, a giver, bringer.
32571: प्र-याम, अस्, m. checking, restraining; dearth, scarcity, dearness; competition of buyers in conse-quence of scarcity; length (either of space or time).
32572: प्र-याम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be checked or con-trolled.
32573: प्रयस् 1. प्र-यस्, cl. 4. 1. P. -यस्यति, -य-सति, -यसितुम्, to endeavour, labour, strive after (with dat.).
32574: प्र-यास, अस्, m. effort, exertion, labour, pains, endeavour; प्रयासेन, with effort, diligently; अ-प्रयासेन, without any exertion, without effort or difficulty. —प्रयास-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, capable of exer-tion or fatigue, active, energetic.
32575: प्रयस् 2. प्रयस्, अस्, n. (fr. rt. 1. प्री), Ved. pleasure, enjoyment, delight; an object of enjoy-ment, delicate or dainty food, refreshing draught or beverage; a sacrifice; प्रयांसि नदीनाम्, the re-freshing waters of rivers (Sāy. = नदीनाम् प्रीणयि-त्रीणि जलानि); (आस्, आस्, अस्), valuable, precious (?). —प्रयस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having or bestow-ing pleasant food, offering refreshing food (Sāy. = हविर्-लक्षणान्न-वत्); (अत्), n., N. of a Sā-man; प्रयस्वन्तो ऽत्रयः, N. of the authors of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 20. —१। प्रयो-ग, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. प्र-योग see p. 640, col. 1), Ved. coming to a meal; (अस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi with the patronymic Bhārgava, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 91.
32576: प्रयस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (probably connected with 2. प्रयस्), seasoned, dressed with sauces and condiments.
32577: प्रया 1. प्र-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go forwards, proceed onwards, advance, progress; to go forth, go away, depart: Caus. -यापयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to proceed: Desid. -यियासति, to wish to advance.
32578: 2. प्र-या, आस्, f. (or m. ?), Ved. rushing upon, assailing, an attack, assault; (Sāy.) an attacking or assailing force.
32579: प्र-याण, अम्, n. setting out, departing, setting forth, starting (on a journey); going forth, going to a distance, journey, march; the march of an army, attack, invasion; going, motion, progress; departure, death [cf. प्राण-प्°]; beginning, commencement; the hind part or haunch of a horse or other animal, the crupper (?) ; the back of a horse, the rider's seat. —प्रयाण-काल, अस्, m. time of departure, death. —प्रयाण-पुरी, f., N. of a town. —प्रयाण-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking or suspending of a journey, a halt. —प्रयाणार्ह (°ण-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, worthy of death, deserving death.
32580: प्रयाणक, अम्, n. a journey, march; going, motion; अ-प्रयाणक, the suspension of a journey, halting, a halt.
32581: प्र-याणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone forward or advanced.
32582: प्र-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone towards, advanced; gone away, gone to a distance, gone, removed, departed; deceased, dead; (अस्), m. an invasion, attack; a steep rock, precipice; (wrongly for प्र-पात।)
32583: प्र-यातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone forward or advanced, to be marched or proceeded; to be attacked.
32584: प्र-यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who goes forward, going, able to go or fly.
32585: प्र-यापण or प्र-यापन, अम्, n. causing to go forwards, sending; expelling, driving away.
32586: प्र-यापणीय or प्र-यापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to go forwards, to be sent away, to be sent.
32587: प्र-यापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to go forwards, driven or sent away, made to go or pass away.
32588: प्र-यापिन्, ई, इणी or इनी, इ, causing to go for-wards, sending forwards, causing to go, sending, sending away.
32589: प्र-याप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to go for-wards, to be sent away.
32590: प्र-याप्यमाण or प्र-याप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being caused to go forwards, being sent or made to go, being caused to pass away.
32591: प्र-यामन्, अ, n., Ved. going forwards, setting out (Sāy. = प्र-गमन).
32592: प्र-यायिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going forwards, advancing, marching, going, driving, riding.
32593: प्र-यास्यत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, about to go forwards, about to go or depart, going.
32594: प्र-यियासत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to go forth, desirous of setting out.
32595: प्र-यियु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. used for driving (as a horse).
32597: प्रयाच् प्र-याच्, cl. 1. P. A. -याचति, -ते, याचितुम्, to ask for, beg, solicit, request.
32598: प्र-याचक, अस्, इका, अम्, asking, requesting, begging, imploring.
32599: प्र-याचन, अम्, n. asking, requesting, begging, imploring.
32603: प्रयु प्र-यु, cl. 2. P., 9. P. A. -यौति, -यु-नाति, -युनीते, -यवितुम्, to disjoin, sever, separate.
32604: प्र-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, joined, combined, united; disjoined, separated; (अस्), m., N. of a Deva-gan-dharva; (अम्), n. a million. —प्रयुतेश्वर-तीर्थ (°त-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
32605: प्र-युति, इस्, f., Ved. separation from, absence; thoughtlessness.
32606: प्र-योतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who disjoins or separates, severing, separating.
32607: प्रयुज् 1. प्र-युज्, cl. 7. A. -युङ्क्ते, -योक्-तुम्, to join to, harness, yoke; to make use of, use, employ; to apply; to bestow, grant, give, lend; to impose, inflict on (with loc. or gen. of the person); to put in front; to appoint, invest (in an office), install; to instigate, impel, direct towards; to cast, hurl, throw (a missile); to conduct; to perform, practise; to befit, become, be fitting or appropriate: Caus. -योजयति, -यितुम्, to use, employ; exact (interest, Manu III. 112); to perform, practise.
32608: प्र-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, joined to, harnessed, yoked; used, employed; applied; inflicted upon; appointed, nominated; associated or connected with; endowed with, possessing (as an attribute &c.); resulting from, consequent on, produced by, arising from, occasioned by; compact, closely united; abstracted, lost in meditation; lent (as money); asleep?; (अम्), n. a cause. —प्रयुक्त-संस्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, to which polish has been applied, polished (as a gem).
32609: प्र-युक्ति, इस्, f. use, employment, application; activity, inclination; impulse, instigation, incitement; cause, motive, main object or end, occasion, conse-quence, result.
32610: प्र-युग, अम्, n. regarded as the original form of प्रüग, q. v.
32611: 2. प्र-युज्, क्, क्, क्, joining, connected with (literally or figuratively, as a cause, motive, &c.); (क्), f., Ved. a team of horses; impulse, motive, cause; acquiring, acquisition; प्रयुजां हवींषि or प्र-युग्-घवींषि, Ved., N. of twelve oblations, one of which is to be offered in each month.
32612: प्र-युज्य, ind. having used or employed; having applied; having connected; having acted or behaved to or towards.
32613: प्र-युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being used or em-ployed, being applied, &c.; being united or con-nected with.
32614: प्र-युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, joining, adding; em-ploying, using; appointing, deputing; performing, doing.
32615: प्र-योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be used or employed; to be applied, applicable, suitable; to be exhibited or represented (as a drama); to be hurled or thrown (as a missile); to be uttered or pronounced.
32616: प्र-योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who employs or applies, one who makes use of, one who uses, using, employing; one who performs or directs, an exe-cuter; one who stirs up or excites; an instigator; the agent of an action; lending, a money-lender; one who exhibits or represents (a drama); one who shoots or sends (an arrow); one who recites, a reciter.
32617: 2. प्र-योग, अस्, m. (for. 1. प्रयो-ग see under 2. प्रयस्), joining together, combination, connec-tion; adding, addition; application, employment; reducing to practice, use, usage, practice [cf. भूरि-प्°, सम्यक्-प्°]; ceremonial form, course of pro-ceeding; act, action, effort; (in gram.) a form com-monly employed, form usually occurring, usual form; a general precept; employment of drugs; application of charms or magic, magic, magical rites; offering, presenting; employment of money, investment, lending money on usury; principal, loan bearing interest, profits of usury or trade; appointing, ap-pointment; hurling, throwing, casting, sending (a missile); undertaking, beginning, commencement; a design, device, plan, contrivance; means, instru-ment; exhibition (of a dance), performance, repre-sentation (of a drama); recitation, delivery; a for-mula to be recited, sacred text, authority; fascinating, subduing (?); cause, motive, occasion, object; con-sequence, result; an example, comparison; a horse [cf. प्र-याग]; प्रयोगैस्, ind. by use of means. —प्रयोग-तस्, ind. by the use of, through the em-ployment of; in consequence of; according to; in action, actually. —प्रयोग-दीप, अस्, m., N. of a work. —प्रयोग-निपुण, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful in practice, practically experienced. —प्रयोग-पद्-धति, इस्, f., N. of a work by Śiva-rāma on ritual. —प्रयोग-पारिजात, अस्, m. and प्रयोग-मुक्ता-वली, f., N. of two works. —प्रयोग-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a commentary by Varadādhīśa-yajvan. —प्र-योग-वैजयन्ती, f., N. of a commentary by Mahā-deva on the Hiraṇya-keśi-kalpa-sūtra. —प्रयोग-सार, अस्, m., N. of a section of the Saṃskāra-tattva. —प्रयोगातिशय (°ग-अत्°), अस्, m. (in dramatic language) ‘excess in representation,’ bringing a cha-racter on the stage the moment that his name is pronounced. —प्रयोगार्थ (°ग-अर्°), अस्, m. an act tending to a main object?; (अस्, आ, अम्), having the sense of प्र-योग।
32618: प्र-योगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, being employed or used, usual; having some object in view, striving for an object, calculated for a particular purpose; using, applying; causing, stimulating. —प्रयोगि-त्व, अम्, n. the being used or employed, usefulness.
32619: प्रयोगीय, अस्, आ, अम्, treating of the application (of medicines &c.).
32620: प्र-योग्य, अस्, m., Ved. an animal harnessed to a carriage, an animal used for draught.
32621: प्र-योजक, अस्, इका, अम्, occasioning, effecting, conducing to, causing or inducing any act, leading to anything; instigating, occasioning, prompting, arousing, stimulating, exciting; an original instigator; deputing, appointing; (अस्), m. a founder or insti-tutor (of any ceremony); a law-giver, legislator; an author, composer; a money-lender, creditor. —प्र-योजक-कर्तृत्व, अम्, n. acting as an instigator or promoter.
32622: प्र-योजन, अम्, n. application, employment, use, use of (with inst., e. g. तरुणा किम् प्रयोज-नम्, what is the use of the tree? मम न किञ्चिद् अर्थेन प्रयोजनम्, to me there is no use in money, money is of no use to me); need of, neces-sity for (with inst.); cause, occasion, motive, origin; purpose, object, aim, intention, design; profit, in-terest; means of attaining (Manu VII. 100); प्र-योजनेन, ind. with a particular motive or inten-tion; केन प्रयोजनेन, from what cause? from what motive? —प्रयोजन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a particular use or aim or purpose, done with a particular aim or design, selfish; serving for a par-ticular purpose, serviceable; having a cause, caused, produced.
32623: प्र-योजयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, combining; behaving to, acting towards; showing, displaying.
32624: प्र-योज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be used or employed, to be practised; to be occasioned or produced; to be set to work; to be appointed or directed; to be thrown, to be cast (as a missile); (अस्), m. a servant, slave; (अम्), n. capital, principal, (properly, that which is put out to interest.) —प्रयोज्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being used or employed.
32625: प्रयुत प्र-युत। See under प्र-यु, p. 639.
32626: प्रयुध् 1. प्र-युध्, Desid. A. -युयुत्सते, to wish to fight.
32627: प्र-युत्सु, उस्, m. a warrior; a ram; an ascetic; air, wind; a N. of Indra; (for प्र-युयुत्सु।)
32628: प्र-युद्ध, अम्, n. war, battle. —प्रयुद्धार्-थ (°ध-अर्°), अस्, m. war, battle, going to war or battle (= प्रत्य्-उत्क्रम); (अस्, आ, अम्), having the sense of प्र-युद्ध।
32629: 2. प्र-युध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. attacking, assailing (Sāy. = प्र-योद्धृ).
32630: प्र-योद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who fights, a combatant.
32632: प्रयोतृ प्र-योतृ। See under प्र-यु, p. 639.
32633: प्रय्यमेध प्रय्यमेध, a patronymic from Priya-medha, = प्रैय्यमेध।
32634: प्ररक्ष् प्र-रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -रक्षति, -रक्-षितुम्, to protect against, protect, defend.
32635: प्र-रक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one from whom any one is protected.
32637: प्र-रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, protected against, pro-tected, defended.
32638: प्ररथम् प्र-रथम्, ind., see Gaṇa Tish-ṭhadgv-ādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 17.
32639: प्ररम् प्र-रम्, Caus. P. -रमयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to delight or gladden greatly, exhilarate; to excite, arouse (?) .
32640: प्रराधस् प्र-राधस्, आस्, m. (fr. rt. राध् with प्र), N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras.
32641: प्र-राध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satisfied or made content.
32642: प्ररिच् प्र-रिच्, Pass. -रिच्यते, to excel, surpass, be superior to (with abl.).
32643: प्र-रिक्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. reaching beyond, surpassing, excelling.
32644: प्र-रेक, अस्, m., Ved. abundance, plenty, afflu-ence; (Sāy.) = दान, bounty, liberality.
32645: प्र-रेचन, अम्, n., Ved. superabundance, super-fluity (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेणाधिकं धनम्).
32646: प्ररुच् प्र-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते, -रोचितुम्, to shine forth, shine, be brilliant.
32647: प्र-रोचन, अस्, ई, अम्, exciting or inciting to love (as a spell), seducing; (अम्), n. stimulating, exciting; seduction; illustration, explanation; (अम्, आ), n. f. praising an author in the prologue of a drama, favourable description of that which is to follow in a play.
32648: प्ररुज् प्र-रुज्, cl. 6. P. -रुजति, -रोक्तुम्, Ved. to break down, break (Sāy. = प्र-भञ्ज्).
32649: प्र-रुज, अस्, m., N. of a mythical being con-quered by Garuḍa; N. of a Rākṣasa.
32650: प्ररुद् प्र-रुद्, cl. 2. P. -रोदिति, -रोदितुम्, to burst into tears, begin to weep, weep, cry.
32651: प्र-रुदित, अस्, आ, अम्, beginning to weep, wept, weeping.
32652: प्ररुध् प्र-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to keep back, hold back.
32653: प्ररुह् 1. प्र-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to grow up, shoot forth, shoot up, grow; to heal up (as a wound).
32654: 2. प्र-रुह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shooting forth, growing up like a plant; (ट्), f., Ved. a shoot, a new branch.
32655: प्र-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, grown up, full-grown; grown, increased; growing or proceeding from a root, rooted, fastened; born, produced. —प्ररूढ-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘long-haired,’ one whose hair has grown long, having long hair. —प्ररूढ-शालि, इस्, m. full-grown rice.
32656: प्र-रूढि, इस्, f. growing up, growth, increase.
32657: प्र-रोधन, अम्, n., Ved. rising, ascending.
32658: प्र-रोह, अस्, m. growing or shooting forth [cf. दृढ-प्°]; germinating, germination, sprouting, budding; a bud, shoot, sprout, twig, spray, sprig; a shoot of light [cf. प्रभा-प्°]; a new leaf or branch; an excrescence. —प्ररोह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pos-sessing vegetation, covered with vegetation.
32659: प्र-रोहण, अम्, n. growing or shooting forth, growing, growth; germinating, germination, bud-ding, sprouting; a bud, twig, spray, shoot, sprig.
32660: प्र-रोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, growing or shooting up, growing, propagated (Manu I. 46). —प्ररोहि-शाखिन्, ई, m. a tree whose branches grow again, (perhaps rather) a tree still growing or still alive.
32661: प्ररेज् प्र-रेज्, cl. 1. A. -रेजते, &c., Ved. to tremble at (with acc.; Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण कम्प्).
32662: प्रर्क्षीय प्रर्क्षीय (fr. 1. प्र + ऋक्ष), Nom. P. प्रर्क्षीयति, &c., see Vopa-deva II. 4; (also प्रार्क्षीय।)
32663: प्रर्षभीय प्रर्षभीय (fr. 1. प्र + ऋष-भ), Nom. P. प्रर्षभीयति, &c., see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 92; (also प्रार्षभीय।)
32664: प्रलप् प्र-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, -लपितुम्, to speak forth, speak; to prattle, prate, talk idly or incoherently, jabber, chatter; to cry, lament, bewail; to call upon, invoke: Caus. -लापयति, -यितुम्, to cause or incite to speak.
32665: प्र-लपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking, talking; call-ing upon, invoking.
32666: प्र-लपन, अम्, n. prattling, prating; speaking, talking.
32667: प्र-लपित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken forth, declared, spoken, uttered, said.
32668: प्र-लाप, अस्, m. talk, talking, conversation, dis-course; talking in an unmeaning or childish manner, incoherent or delirious speech, prattling, prattle, prate, chattering; आर्त-प्रलाप, ‘the utterance or cry of one in pain,’ lamentation, wailing. —प्रलाप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, speaking confusedly. —प्रलाप-हन्, आ, m. a kind of collyrium. —प्रलापैक-मय (°प-एक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘consisting of lamen-tation only,’ doing nothing but lament.
32669: प्र-लापन, अम्, n. causing or teaching to speak.
32670: प्र-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, talking much or unmean-ingly, chattering, a prater; speaking to, conversing with; lamenting, wailing. —प्रलापि-ता, f. amorous conversation, loving prattle.
32671: प्रलभ् प्र-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते (ep. also -लम्भते), -लब्धुम्, to overreach, cheat, deceive.
32672: प्र-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, overreached, cheated, deceived.
32673: प्र-लब्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cheated or deceived.
32674: प्र-लम्भ, अस्, m. receiving, obtaining, attain-ing, gaining; overreaching, cheating, deceiving, fool-ing, fraud.
32675: प्र-लम्भन, अम्, n. deceiving, cheating, fool-ing, fraud.
32676: प्रलम्ब प्र-लम्ब, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लम्ब् with प्र), hanging down, depending, pendulous (generally in comps., cf. प्रलम्ब-केश below); prominent; slow, dilatory; (अस्), m. hanging on or from, depending; a branch; a shoot of the vine-palm; a garland of flowers worn round the neck; a kind of necklace of pearls; a cucumber; the female breast; N. of a Daitya slain by Bala-rāma; N. of a mountainous district; tin?; (आ), f., N. of a Rākṣasī. —प्र-लम्ब-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose hair hangs down. —प्रलम्ब-घ्न, अस्, or प्रलम्ब-हन्, आ, m. ‘the slayer of the Daitya Pralamba,’ epithet of Bala-rāma (also of Kṛṣṇa?). —प्रलम्ब-भिद्, त्, or प्रलम्ब-मथन, अस्, m. ‘the cleaver or crusher of Pralamba,’ epithet of Bala-rāma (also of Kṛṣṇa?). —प्रलम्बाण्ड (°ब-अण्°), अस्, m. a man with hanging testicles. —प्रलम्बोज्ज्वल-चारु-घोण (°ब-उज्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a prominent, bright, and handsome nose.
32677: प्र-लम्बक, अस्, m. fragrant Rohisha grass.
32678: प्र-लम्बन, अम्, n. hanging down, depending.
32679: प्र-लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, suspended, hanging down, pendulous.
32680: प्र-लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging down, depending; त्रि-प्रलम्बिन्, having three pendent limbs or mem-bers of the body.
32681: प्रलम्बी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make to hang down, suspend.
32684: प्रललाट प्र-ललाट, अस्, आ, अम्, having a prominent forehead.
32685: प्रलव प्र-लव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लू with प्र), a part cut off, a chip, fragment (as of a reed &c.); the sheath of a leaf.
32686: प्र-लवन, अम्, n., Ved. cutting off.
32687: प्र-लवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who cuts off, cut-ting off.
32688: प्र-लवित्र, अम्, n. an instrument for cutting off.
32689: प्र-लून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off; (अस्), m. a kind of insect.
32690: प्रलिख् प्र-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखि-तुम्, to draw lines along (the ground); to scratch.
32691: प्रलिप प्र-लिप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लिप् with प्र), one who smears or plasters, smearing, plas-tering.
32692: प्र-लेप, अस्, m. an unguent, ointment, plaster, salve.
32693: प्र-लेपक, अस्, इका, अम्, anointing, smearing, plastering; (अस्), m. a plasterer, an anointer; a par-ticular marine substance, lime made of calcined shells (?); a hectic or slow fever.
32694: प्र-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of anointing or smearing.
32695: प्र-लेप्य, अस्, m. clean or well-trimmed hair; (perhaps incorrectly for a form प्र-लेभ्य।)
32696: प्रली प्र-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम्, -ला-तुम्, to become dissolved or reabsorbed, dissolve, melt away; to disappear, vanish; to die, perish.
32697: प्र-लय, अस्, m. dissolution, destruction, annihi-lation, reabsorption; the destruction of the whole world at the end of a Kalpa or period of 432, 000, 000 years [cf. कल्प]; any extensive destruction or de-vastation; death, dying; fainting, syncope, loss of sense or consciousness; an epithet of the mystic syllable ॐ. —प्रलय-काल, अस्, m. the period of the destruction of the world at the end of a Kalpa, the time of universal destruction. —प्रलय-जल-धर-ध्वान, अस्, m. the rumbling or muttering of clouds at the dissolution of the world. —प्रलय-ता, f. or प्रलय-त्व, अम्, n. dissolution. —प्र-लय-दहन, अम्, n. the fire at the destruction of the world. —प्रलय-स्थिति-सर्ग, आस्, m. pl. de-struction, preservation, and creation (of the world). —प्रलयोदय (°य-उद्°), औ, m. du. dissolution and creation.
32698: प्र-लयन, अम्, n., Ved. a place of rest or repose, a bed.
32699: प्र-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolved, melted away; de-stroyed, annihilated; unconscious, insensible. —प्र-लीन-ता, f. or प्रलीन-त्व, अम्, n. dissolution, de-struction, annihilation, the end of the universe; unconsciousness, loss of sense, fainting. —प्रलीन-भूपाल, अस्, आ, अम्, whose monarchs have been destroyed.
32700: प्रलुठ् प्र-लुठ्, cl. 1. P. -लोठति, -लोठितुम्, to roll forwards, roll along the ground, roll round, turn round; to be agitated, heave, toss.
32701: प्र-लोठन, अम्, n. rolling forwards, rolling on the ground; heaving, tossing (as of the ocean).
32702: प्र-लोठित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling forwards, rolling; heaving, tossing.
32703: प्रलुप् प्र-लुप्, Pass. -लुप्यते, to be in-terrupted; to be destroyed; to be violated; to be disturbed.
32704: प्रलुभ् प्र-लुभ्, cl. 4. P. A. -लुभ्यति, -ते, -लोब्धुम्, to be lustful, follow one's lusts, lust after; to pollute (through lust); to allure, entice, seduce: Caus. -लोभयति, -यितुम्, to cause to lust, allure, entice, seduce.
32705: प्र-लोभ, अस्, m. allurement, seduction; desire, covetousness, cupidity, greediness.
32706: प्र-लोभक, अस्, m. ‘allurer,’ N. of a jackal.
32707: प्र-लोभन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to lust after, alluring, seducing; (अम्), n. seducing, attracting, attraction; allurement, inducement; that which allures, a lure, bait; (ई), f. gravel, sand.
32708: प्र-लोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, enticed, seduced.
32709: प्र-लोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lusting after, desiring; alluring, seducing.
32710: प्र-लोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lusted after or desired, desirable, attractive, alluring.
32711: प्रलून प्र-लून। See under प्र-लव, col. 1.
32712: प्रलेह प्र-लेह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिह् with प्र), a kind of broth.
32713: प्र-लेहन, अम्, n. the act of licking.
32714: प्रलोल प्र-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, being in violent motion, agitated.
32715: प्रलोलुप प्र-लोलुप, अस्, m., N. of Kunti (a descendant of Garuḍa).
32716: प्रल्कारीय प्रल्कारीय, Nom. (fr. प्र + ऌ-कार), प्रल्कारीयति, -यितुम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 92; (also प्राल्कारीय।)
32717: प्रव प्रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रु), Ved. fluttering, hovering; (Sāy.) = गच्छत्. —प्रव-ग, अस्, m. = प्लव-ग, a monkey. —प्रवङ्-ग, अस्, m. = प्लवङ्-ग, a monkey; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —प्रवङ्-गम, अस्, m. = प्लवङ्-गम, a monkey.
32718: प्रवक, अस्, आ, अम्, going, one who goes.
32719: प्रवच् प्र-वच्, cl. 2. P. -वक्ति, -वक्तुम्, to speak forth, begin to speak, declare, announce, relate, tell (with acc. of the thing and gen. or dat. of the person); to speak to, address; to speak, say; to explain; to recite; to celebrate.
32720: प्र-वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared or announced; to be imparted or taught; to be ex-pounded or explained.
32721: प्र-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who speaks or de-clares, one who announces or informs, a speaker, declarer, announcer, informer; a propounder, teacher, expounder (Manu VII. 20); a fine speaker, good orator, eloquent man. —प्रवक्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. the being an expounder or teacher.
32722: प्र-वचन, अम्, n. speaking, talking; declara-tion, announcement, proclamation; recitation, oral instruction, teaching, expounding, exposition, inter-pretation [cf. साङ्ख्य-प्रवचन-भाष्य]; ex-cellent speech or language, eloquence; an expression, term; a system of doctrines propounded in a treatise or dissertation; sacred writings, especially the Brāh-maṇas; the fundamental doctrine of Buddhists; the sacred writings of the Jainas; प्र-वचन is also said to be used as an enclitic after a simple verb, see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27. —प्रवचन-पटु, उस्, उस्, उ, skilled in speaking, eloquent.
32723: प्र-वचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared; to be taught or propounded; to be well or elegantly spoken; a good speaker; a propounder, teacher.
32724: प्र-वाक, अस्, m. proclaiming, announcing, a pro-claimer, announcer.
32725: प्र-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, eloquent, oratorical, speaking, a speaker.
32726: प्र-वाचक, अस्, इका, अम्, declaratory, explana-tory; speaking well, eloquent.
32727: प्र-वाचन, अम्, n. a proclamation, promulgation; a designation; द्वि-प्रवाचन, having a twofold designation.
32728: प्र-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proclaimed aloud; praiseworthy, glorious (Ved., Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण वक्तव्य); to be spoken to or addressed; (अम्), n. a literary production.
32729: प्रवट प्र-वट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वट् with प्र), wheat.
32730: प्रवण प्रवण, अम्, n. (probably fr. 1. प्र; but according to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 5, said to be fr. 1. प्र + वन, a forest), the side of a hill, a declivity, steep descent, precipice, an abyss, depth, (in the earlier language used only in loc. sing.; Sāy. = निम्न-प्रदेश); (अस्), m. a place where four roads meet; (ए), ind. in a precipitous course, pre-cipitously, precipitately, suddenly, hurriedly, hastily; (अस्, आ, अम्), declining, bent, bowed, sloping down, shelving, flowing down (often in comps., e. g. निम्न-प्°, flowing downwards; cf. उदक्-प्°, दक्षिणा-प्°); precipitous, inclining downwards, steep, abrupt; curved, crooked; inclining, inclined to, directed towards, disposed to, tending to [cf. वञ्चन-प्°]; ready, willing; applying one's self to, devoted to, attached or adhering to, addicted, prone [cf. वि-षय-प्°]; filled with, possessed of, endowed with; generous; humble, modest; waning or fading away, wasted, decayed, disappeared. —प्रवण-ता, f. pre-cipitousness, inclination, proclivity, propensity, pro-pension, attachment, devotion. —प्रवण-प्रहर्-ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose joy has faded away, whose happiness has disappeared. —प्रवण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a steep descent or declivity, having a downward course, downward, precipitous.
32731: प्रवणाय, Nom. P. प्रवणायति, -यितुम्, to feel inclined or disposed towards.
32732: प्रवणायित, अम्, n. inclination, propensity, bias.
32733: प्रवत्, त्, f. (fr. 1. प्र), Ved. the side of a moun-tain, a declivity, precipice; an elevation, height, the heavenly height; a sloping path, easy course, rapid pro-gress; प्रवतो नपात्, ‘son of the heavenly height,’ an epithet of lightning; प्रवतस्, pl. the heavenly heights (sometimes said to be three, sometimes seven in number; Sāy. = आपस्); flowing down declivities (said of rivers; Sāy. = प्रवण-देशे गच्-छत्); (आन्, अती, अत्), directed forwards or towards; containing the syllable प्र or पृ; (in the preceding adj. senses fr. 1. प्र + वत्); प्रवता or प्रवद्भिः, ind. down hill, downwards (Sāy. = प्रवणवता मार्गेण); precipitately, rapidly, swiftly. —प्रवत्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a downward course, de-scending; precipitous, headlong, rapid; affording a downward path, suited for rapid motion; hilly. —प्र-वद्-भार्गव, N. of a Sāman. —प्रवद्-यामन्, आ, m., Ved. having a downward path, rapid in its course (as a chariot; Sāy. = शीघ्र-गामिन्).
32735: प्रवद् प्र-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -वदितुम्, to speak forth, speak out, pronounce, utter; to proclaim, declare; to speak to, address; to say, speak, tell; to converse with; to explain: Caus. -वादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to speak or sound forth, to play (a musical instrument).
32736: प्र-वद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sounding forth, sound-ing (as a drum).
32737: प्र-वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking forth, speaking to or with, conversing, addressing; speaking much or well; arguing, a disputant.
32738: प्र-वदन, अम्, n., Ved. a proclamation, an-nouncement.
32739: प्र-वदितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who speaks forth or speaks out, speaking out.
32740: प्र-वाद, अस्, m. speaking forth, uttering a word or sound; expressing, naming, mentioning; declar-ing, declaration [cf. वेद-प्°]; discourse, conversa-tion; a saying, popular talk, rumour, report; spread-ing a report, (द्यूत-प्°, report of gambling); a fable, myth; mutual defiance, the conversation of antagonists prior to combat; litigious language; (in Ved. gram.) a base or crude form (opposed to a word with a case termination &c.); (आ), f., Ved. in गन्ध-प्रवादास्, f. pl. all that is called perfume (?) .
32741: प्र-वादक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to sound forth, playing on (a musical instrument).
32742: प्र-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, giving forth a sound, uttering a cry; speaking, speaking of, reporting; (in Ved. gram.) being in the crude form.
32743: प्र-वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken; to be proclaimed.
32744: प्रवध्य प्र-वध्य, ind. (fr. rt. वध् with प्र), having killed or slain.
32745: प्रवन्द् प्र-वन्द्, cl. 1. A. -वन्दते, -वन्-दितुम्, Ved. to praise highly, extol.
32746: प्रवप् प्र-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to scatter forth, scatter, strew; to throw, cast, shoot.
32747: प्र-वप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + वपा), having much fat, very fat.
32748: प्र-वपण, अम्, n., Ved. scattering forth, sow-ing; shaving off (of the beard &c.).
32749: प्र-वापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who scatters forth or pours out, scattering forth, pouring out.
32750: प्र-वापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who sows seed, sowing, a sower.
32751: प्रवयण 1. प्र-वयण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वी = rt. अज्; for 2. see under प्र-वे, p. 645, col. 1), a goad; [cf. प्राजन।]
32752: प्र-वयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be driven forwards (?) .
32753: प्रवय्या, f., Ved. (a cow) to be driven on with a goad (?) .
32754: प्रवयस् प्र-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, (Ved.) strong, vigorous, in the prime of life; advanced in age, aged, ancient; (Sāy.) = प्रवृद्धान्न or पुरातन।
32755: प्रवर प्र-वर। See प्र-वृ, p. 644, col. 1.
32756: प्रवर्ग प्र-वर्ग, प्र-वर्ग्य, प्र-वर्जन। See under प्र-वृज्, p. 644, col. 2.
32758: प्रवर्धक प्र-वर्धक, प्र-वर्धन। See under प्र-वृध्, p. 644, col. 3.
32759: प्रवर्ष प्र-वर्ष, प्र-वर्षण, प्र-वर्-षिन्। See under प्र-वृष्, p. 645, col. 1.
32760: प्रवर्ह प्र-वर्ह। See प्र-वृह्, p. 645, col. 1.
32761: प्रवलाकिन् प्रवलाकिन्, ई, m. a peacock; a snake; (incorrectly for प्रचलाकिन्।)
32762: प्रवल्ह प्र-वल्ह, अस्, m., Ved. a riddle, enigma.

32903: प्रवीण प्र-वीण, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. वीणा], skilful, clever, proficient, conversant with, skilled in, versed in, an adept; (अस्), m., N. of a son of the fourteenth Manu. —प्रवीण-ता, f. or प्रवीण-त्व, अम्, n. skill, proficiency.

a line of ancestors (so named in the preceding invocation to Agni); one of the forty-nine Gotras, as opposed to the eight original Gotras; a member of a line of ancestors, an ancestor; a Muni who contributes to the credit of a particular Gotra or family; family, race, lineage, kindred; offspring, descendants; a covering, cover, screen; an upper garment; a black variety of Phaseolus Mungo, Oppuntia Dillenii; N. of a messenger of the gods and friend of Indra; of a Dānava; (आ), f., N. of a river which falls into the Go-dāvarī near Tokā, and is celebrated for the sweetness of its water; (अम्), n. aloe wood; a particular high number; (अस्, आ, अम्), most excellent, chief, principal, best [cf. शङ्ख-प्°]; 32908: प्र-वार, अस्, m. a covering, cover, clothing, woollen cloth.

32913: प्रवृज् प्र-वृज्, cl. 2. A. -वृक्ते, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to purify; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण छिद्, to cut or strew in abundance; = प्र-भृ, q. v.

32919: प्रवृञ्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. used at the Pra-vargya ceremony (said of the महा-वीर, q. v.).
32920: प्रवृत् 1. प्र-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut., Cond., and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to go or roll forwards, roll on, flow onwards, proceed, make progress, go on well; to come forth, come into being, arise, be produced; to become, exist; to happen, take place, come to pass; to begin, com-mence (with acc. or inf.); to engage in, enter upon, be occupied in (with loc.); to behave, conduct one's self; to hold good: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to proceed; to cause to flow onwards; to set in motion or action, instigate, urge, excite; to throw, cast; to produce, create; to devise, invent.
32921: प्र-वर्त, अस्, m. engaging in, undertaking; ex-citement, stimulus; (Ved.) a round ornament.
32922: प्र-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, setting in motion or action, setting on foot; advancing, promoting, forward-ing; producing, causing, effecting, inducing, inciting, prompting, instigating, stimulating, urging; (अस्), m. the original instigator of any act, originator, author, principal, founder; an arbiter, judge; (अम्), n. (in dramatic language) the entrance of a character on the stage.

32924: प्र-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set in motion, to be instigated; to be used or employed.
32925: प्र-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, moving on, rolling on, proceeding, going forth; engaging in, practising, being occupied with, doing; being used or employed.

32927: प्र-वर्तयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sets in motion or action, exciting activity, instigating to action; establishing, erecting, a builder, founder; applying or inflicting, one who applies or inflicts.
32928: प्र-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to roll on or for-wards, caused to turn, going round, revolving; set in motion, set on foot; set up, established; stimu-lated, excited, incited, instigated; lighted, kindled; caused, made, rendered; informed, apprized; made pure (= पवित्री-कृत, Manu XI. 196).
32929: प्र-वर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proceeded, to be acted, to be practised.
32930: प्र-वर्तितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes or effects; one who establishes or determines.
32931: प्र-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving forwards, proceeding, advancing, moving, flowing; coming forth, flowing forth, streaming; being active; causing to flow; setting in motion or action, causing, effecting, pro-ducing; spreading, introducing; using, employing; अ-प्रवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, immovable, unchangeable, unalterable, invariable.
32932: प्र-वर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excited to activity, to be instigated or stimulated.

32935: प्रवृत्तक, अम्, n. the entrance of a character on the stage (= प्र-वर्तक); a kind of metre.
32936: प्र-वृत्ति, इस्, f. continuous flow onwards, pro-gress, advance, advancement; success; coming forth, appearing, appearance, manifestation; rise, source, origin, beginning; activity, effort, employment, oc-cupation; active life (as opposed to नि-वृत्ति, q. v., and to contemplative devotion, and defined as con-sisting of the wish to act, knowledge of the means, and accomplishment of the object); giving or apply-ing one's self to, devoting one's self to (with loc.); course or tendency towards, addiction to, inclination or predilection for; application, use, employment; continued application, perseverance; practice, conduct, behaviour; currency, continuance, continuity, pre-valence, permanence, endurance; the applicableness or validity of a rule; fate, lot, destiny; news, tidings, intelligence [cf. दुष्-प्°]; cognition, (विषयवती प्रवृत्तिः, a sensuous immediate cognition); the juice that exudes from the temples of an elephant in rut; N. of Avantī or Oujein or any holy place; (in arithmetic) the multiplier. —प्रवृत्ति-ज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘knowing the news,’ an emissary, agent, spy. —प्र-वृत्ति-निमित्त, अम्, n. the reason for the use of any term in the particular significations which it bears. —प्रवृत्ति-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, dis-inclined to give tidings. —प्रवृत्ति-मार्ग, अस्, m. active or worldly life, occupancy about the business and pleasures of the world or with the rites and works of religion.

32948: प्र-वर्ह, अस्, आ, अम्, chief, principal, first.
