33005: प्रशँय्युवाक प्रशंय्यु-वाक, अस्, m., see Vārttika 1. to Pāṇ. II. 4, 29.
33006: प्रशंस् प्र-शंस्, cl. 1. P. -शंसति, -शंसि-तुम् (anomalous 3rd sing. Pot. प्र-शंसीयात्), to praise forth, praise, eulogize, laud, extol, commend, recommend; to approve; to esteem, value; to de-clare; (with न) to disapprove, blame, censure.
33007: प्र-शंसक, अस्, इका, अम्, praising, commending, eulogizing, laudatory, flattering; a praiser.
33008: प्र-शंसन, अम्, n. praising, eulogizing; (some-times incorrectly spelt प्र-शंशन।)
33009: प्र-शंसनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-worthy, laudable, commendable.
33010: प्र-शंसा, f. praise, commendation, panegyric, eulogy, applause, flattery; fame, reputation, glory [cf. स्त्री-प्°]; अप्रस्तुत-प्रशंसा, indirect de-scription, a description of anything implied by the description of a similar or contrary object; (some-times incorrectly spelt प्र-शंशा।) —प्रशंसा-मुखर, अस्, आ, अम्, loud with praise, praising loudly. —प्रशंसामुखरानन (°र-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one whose mouth is loud with praise,’ speaking loudly in praise (of anything). —प्रशंसो-पमा (°सा-उप्°), f. laudatory comparison, comparing to anything superior.
33011: प्र-शंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended, eulogized, extolled, applauded.
33012: प्र-शंसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or commended, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable.
33013: प्र-शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, praising, commending, eulogizing.
33014: प्र-शंस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-worthy, laudable; [cf. प्र-शस्तव्य।]
33015: प्र-शंस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, com-mendable, praiseworthy, laudable; preferable, better; [cf. 1. प्र-शस्य।]
33016: प्र-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended; eulogized, extolled; laudable, commendable, admir-able, excellent, good, best; happy; well; right; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a river. —प्रशस्त-कर, अस्, m., N. of an author (per-haps the writer of a work entitled Pra-śasta). —प्र-शस्त-कलश, अस्, m., N. of a man. —प्रशस्त-ता, f. or प्रशस्त-त्व, अम्, n. excellence, goodness. —प्रशस्त-पाद, अस्, m., N. of an author. —प्र-शस्ताद्रि (°त-अद्°), इस्, m., N. of a mountain to the west of Madhya-deśa.
33017: प्र-शस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-worthy; [cf. प्र-शंस्तव्य।]
33018: प्र-शस्ति, इस्, f. praise, eulogy, fame; glorification, benediction; excellence, eminence; instruction, con-duct, guidance; an edict (?) ; प्रशस्तिं धा, to bestow praise upon, speak highly of, value highly (with loc.). —प्रशस्ति-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. bestowing praise, prais-ing. —प्रशस्ति-प्रकाशिका, f., N. of a work. —प्र-शस्ति-रत्नावली, f., N. of a poem by Viśva-nātha.
33019: 1. प्र-शस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or com-mended, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable; ex-cellent, eminent, distinguished; to be called happy, to be congratulated; [cf. प्र-शंस्य।] —प्रशस्य-ता, f. excellence, eminence.
33020: 2. प्र-शस्य, ind. having praised or recommended.
33022: प्रशद् प्र-शद्, Caus. P. -शातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall down, break off, pluck, gather.
33023: प्र-शत्त्वन्, आ, m. the ocean; (अरी), f. a river.
33024: प्रशम् प्र-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमि-तुम्, to become calm or tranquil, to be still or unmoved; to be appeased or pacified, be soothed; to be laid or made to settle down (as dust); to be restrained; to become extinguished; to cease; to fade away: Caus. -शमयति, -यितुम्, to tranquillize, make calm or tranquil, pacify, soothe, appease; to extinguish, quench, allay; to kill, destroy; -शाम-यति, -यितुम्, to make subject, make obedient, subdue, conquer, tranquillize.
33025: प्र-शम, अस्, m. becoming calm or tranquil, rest, quiet, quiescence, calmness, tranquillity, peace, composure (e. g. प्रशमम् उपैहि, go to com-posure, i. e. compose yourself); assuagement, ap-peasement, tranquillizing, removing; becoming ex-tinguished, extinction (of flames &c.), abatement; N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-devā; (ई), f., N. of an Apsaras. —प्रशमङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing the cessation of. —प्रशम-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a state of quiescence. —प्रशमायन (°म-अय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, walking in tranquillity.
33026: प्र-शमन, अस्, ई, अम्, tranquillizing, pacifying, calming; suppressing, curing, healing; (अम्), n. reposing, repose, quiescence; tranquillizing, pacifying, calming; mitigating, assuaging, allaying, composing; soothing (fever &c.); curing, healing; extinguish-ing, quenching, suppressing; abatement, cessation; killing, destroying, slaughter; (scil. अस्त्रम्), N. of a magic weapon; bestowing aptly or fitly (Manu VII. 56, = सत्-पात्रे प्रतिपादनम्); securing, keeping safe; लब्धस्य प्रशमनम्, the se-curing of what has been acquired or bestowing it on fit objects; [cf. लब्ध-प्°।]
33027: प्र-शमय्य, ind. having appeased or tranquil-lized.
33028: प्र-शमित, अस्, आ, अम्, tranquillized, appeased, relieved; quelled, quenched, allayed. —प्रशमितो-पद्रव (°त-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having all calamities or hinderances quelled (= प्रशान्त-बाध).
33029: प्र-शम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being tranquillized or pacified, being appeased; being flattered.
33030: प्र-शान्, ind., see Gaṇa Svar-ādi to Pāṇ. I. 1, 37; [cf. प्र-शाम्।]
33031: प्र-शान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, tranquillized, composed, quieted, calmed, calm; tamed; subdued; abated, ended, ceased, discontinued (as active effort); dead, deceased; relieved; (अस्), m., N. of a divinity. —प्रशान्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desires are calmed, content. —प्रशान्त-चारित्र-मति, इस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —प्रशान्त-चारिन्, इणस्, m. pl. walking tranquilly, (perhaps) an epithet of a class of deities. —प्रशान्त-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose efforts have ceased, resting. —प्रशान्त-ता, f. tranquillity (of mind). —प्रशान्त-बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, having all calamities or hinderances quelled (= प्रशमितोपद्रव). —प्रशान्तात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, ‘tranquil-souled,’ composed in mind, peace-ful, calm. —प्रशान्तोर्ज (°त-ऊर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose strength has ceased, weakened, prostrated. —प्रशान्तौजस् (°त-ओज्°), आस्, आस्, अस्, = प्रशान्-तोर्ज above.
33032: प्रशान्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-शान्त above.
33033: प्र-शान्ति, इस्, f. becoming calm or tranquil, tran-quillization, tranquillity of mind, calm, quiet, pacifi-cation, composure; ceasing, cessation, rest; allaying, quenching, extinguishing, extinction. —प्रशान्ति-दूती, f. the harbinger of rest, forerunner of repose, an epithet of old age.
33034: प्र-शाम्, न्, न्, न्, tranquil, quiet.
33035: प्र-शाम, अस्, m. tranquillity, quiescence; paci-fying; laying, suppressing.
33036: प्रशर्ध प्र-शर्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शृध् with प्र), Ved. valiant (said of Indra; Sāy. = प्र-कर्षेणाभिभविता).
33037: प्रशल प्रशल, a various reading for प्र-सल, q. v.
33038: प्रशस् प्र-शस्, अस्, f. (fr. rt. शस् with प्र), Ved. a hatchet, axe, knife; (according to others) = प्र-शस्त, प्रशस्त-च्छेदन।
33040: प्रशाख प्र-शाख, अस्, आ, अम्, having great branches (as a tree); an epithet of the fifth stage in the formation of an embryo (in which the hands and feet are formed, in this sense also written प्र-शक); (आ), f. a branch, small branch or twig; (probably) the extremities of the body. —प्रशाख-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having many branches.
33041: प्रशाखिका, f. a branch; a small branch or twig.
33043: प्रशास् प्र-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, to rule over, reign over, rule, reign, govern, com-mand, enjoin; to teach, instruct; to chastise, punish.
33044: प्र-शासन, अम्, n. governing, ruling; dominion, government; enjoining, enacting.
33045: प्र-शासित, अस्, आ, अम्, ruled over, reigned over, governed, ruled; enjoined, enacted.
33046: प्र-शासितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, governing, ruling, a governor, ruler.
33047: प्र-शास्तृ, ता, m. ‘director,’ title of a priest also called Maitrāvaruṇa, the first assistant of the Hotṛ (Ved.); a king.
33048: प्र-शास्त्र, अम्, n., Ved. the office of Praśāstṛ; the Soma vessel of the Praśāstṛ; (Sāy.) = प्रशास्तुर् यागः।
33049: प्र-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ruled over, reigned, governed, commanded.
33050: प्र-शिष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. injunction, command, order.
33051: प्र-शिस्, ईस्, f., Ved. injunction, command, order; [cf. 1. आ-शिस्।]
33052: प्रशिथिल प्र-शिथिल, अस्, आ, अम्, very loose, relaxed, lax. —प्रशिथिली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered very loose, greatly loosened. —प्रशिथिली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become loose or lax.
33053: प्रशिष प्रशिष, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
33054: प्रशिष्य प्र-शिष्य, अस्, m. the disciple of a disciple, scholar of a scholar, pupil of a pupil. —प्रशिष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being the disciple of a disciple, the condition of a pupil's pupil.
33055: प्रशुक्रीय प्रशुक्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. be-ginning with the words प्र शुक्रा (said of the hymn Ṛg-veda VII. 34, 1).
33056: प्रशुद्धि प्र-शुद्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. शुध् with प्र), purity, clearness.
33057: प्रशुम्भ् प्र-शुम्भ्, cl. 6. A. -शुम्भते, -शुम्भितुम्, Ved. to decorate or adorn one's self highly; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण स्वकीयम् अङ्गम् अलङ्-कृ।
33058: प्रशुश्रुक प्र-शुश्रुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince (a son of Maru; cf. प्र-सुश्रुत).
33059: प्रशोचन प्र-शोचन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शुच् with प्र), Ved. burning on, continuing to burn.
33060: प्रशोष प्र-शोष, अस्, m. (rt. शुष्), drying up, becoming dry, exsiccating, aridity.
33061: प्र-शोषण, अस्, m. ‘drying up,’ epithet of a kind of phantom.
33062: प्रश्रुत् प्र-श्चुत् or प्र-श्च्युत्, cl. 1. A. -श्चो-तति, -श्च्योतति, -श्चोतितुम्, -श्च्योतितुम्, to pour forth, shed, distil, sprinkle; to drip, fall in drops.
33063: प्र-श्चोतत् or प्र-श्च्योतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pouring forth, sprinkling; dripping, falling in drops.
33064: प्रश्न 1. प्रश्न, अस्, m. basket-work, a plaited basket.
33065: प्रश्न 2. प्रश्न, अस्, m. (fr. rt. प्रछ्), a question, demand, inquiry, interrogation, query [cf. कुशुल-प्°]; judicial inquiry or examination [cf. साक्षि-प्°]; a controverted question, point at issue, subject of inquiry, controversy, (प्रश्नम् प्र-ब्रू, to decide a controverted point; प्रश्नम् इ, to lay a question before any one (acc.) for decision; प्रश्-नस् तव पितरि, the point at issue is before thy father, i. e. it is submitted to him to decide); a problem for calculation; inquiry into the future (in astrology; cf. दिव्य-प्°, देव-प्°, दैव-प्°); a par-ticular number of verses of the Veda repeated from memory by a pupil to his Guru, a task, lesson, repeti-tion; a term applied to short sections in various works. —प्रश्न-कोष्ठी, f., N. of a work on divination. —प्रश्न-दूती, f. a riddle, enigma, perplexing or enigmatical question. —प्रश्न-विवाक, अस्, m., Ved. one who decides controversies, an arbitrator. —प्रश्-न-विवाद, अस्, m. a controverted question, contro-versy. —प्रश्न-वैष्णव, अम्, n., N. of an astrological work. —प्रश्न-व्याकरण, अम्, n., N. of the tenth of the twelve sacred books of the Jainas. —प्रश्नार्णव (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘ocean of questions,’ N. of a work on astrology (= वैष्णव-शास्त्र). —प्रश्नोत्तर (°न-उत्°), अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a particular Śabdālaṅkāra or figure of speech. —प्रश्नोत्तर-मणि-माला or प्रश्नोत्तर-माला, f., N. of a work. —प्रश्नोत्तर-रत्न-माला, f., N. of a work. —प्रश्नोपनिषद् (°न-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad (consisting of six questions and six answers).
33066: प्रश्नय, Nom. P. प्रश्नयति, -यितुम्, to inquire after, ask about (with two acc.).
33067: प्रश्निन्, ई, m., Ved. an inquirer, one who inquires into the future (Mahī-dhara = शकुनादि-प्रष्टृ).
33068: प्रष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or questioned about (with acc.); deserving to be consulted; proper to be inquired into.
33069: प्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, asking, demanding, an asker, inquirer, questioner, interrogator, querist.
33070: प्रश्नि प्रश्नि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a race of Ṛṣis; (incorrectly for पृश्नि, q. v.)
33071: प्रश्नी, f. incorrectly for पृश्नी, q. v.
33072: प्रश्रथ प्र-श्रथ, अस्, m. or प्र-श्रन्थन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. श्रन्थ् with प्र), laxity, relaxation, flaccidity.
33073: प्रश्रब्धि प्र-श्रब्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. श्रम्भ् with प्र), trust, confidence.
33074: प्रश्रय प्र-श्रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with प्र), respectful demeanour, affection, regard, solicit-ation, affection, respect, courtesy, civility, modesty; Modesty personified as a son of Dharma and Hrī. —प्रश्रय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = प्रश्रयिन् below.
33075: प्र-श्रयण, अम्, n. respectful demeanour, civi-lity, modesty.
33076: प्रश्रयिन्, ई, इणी, इ, behaving respectfully, cour-teous, civil; modest. —प्रश्रयि-ता, f. respectful demeanour, courtesy, civility, modesty.
33077: प्र-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, modest, humble, well-behaved; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-devā.
33078: प्रश्रवण प्र-श्रवण, an incorrect form for प्र-स्रवण, q. v.
33079: प्रश्रवस् प्र-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. ‘loud-sounding,’ an epithet of the Maruts; (Sāy.) = प्र-कृष्टान्न, having or bestowing excellent food.
33080: प्रश्लथ प्र-श्लथ, अस्, आ, अम्, very loose, greatly relaxed, languid, flaccid; unnerved.
33081: प्रश्लित प्र-श्लित, अस्, m. (for प्र-श्रित), a term applied to the rule of Sandhi according to which अस् before a soft letter is changed into ओ।
33082: प्रश्लिष्ट प्र-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्लिष् with प्र), twisted, entwined; (अस्), m. a term applied to the Sandhi of the vowel अ with a following vowel and of other vowels with homogeneous vowels; also to the vowel resulting from this Sandhi and of the accent with which such a vowel is pronounced; (अस्), m., N. of a man (?) .
33083: प्र-श्लेष, अस्, m. close contact, pressing against; euphonic coalition of vowels.
33084: प्रश्वसितव्य प्र-श्वसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्वस् with प्र), Ved. to be caused to recover the breath.
33085: प्र-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing in, inhaling, breath, respiration.
33087: प्रष्टि प्रष्टि, इस्, m. (connected with पृष्टि, q. v.), Ved. a horse harnessed at the side, a side-horse or one harnessed outside the shafts by the side of the other yoke-horses [cf. दक्षिणा-प्°]; (perhaps) a horse in front of those harnessed to the yoke or to the chariot-pole [cf. अधि-प्रष्टि-युग]; (according to Sāy.) = वाहन-त्रय-मध्य-वर्ती युग-विशेषः, a sort of yoke in the middle of three horses; a bystander, companion (Sāy. = पार्श्व-स्थ). —प्रष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having side-horses (as a chariot). —प्रष्टि-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, or प्रष्टि-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. (a chariot) drawn by side-horses (and thus having at least three horses).
33088: प्रष्ठ प्र-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्था with प्र), standing in front, preceding, prior; chief, prin-cipal, best [cf. रथ-प्°]; a leader, conductor; (अस्), m. a species of plant; (ई), f. the wife of a leader or chief. —प्रष्ठ-वाह्, ट्, m. a young bull or steer training for the plough; प्रष्ठौही, f. a cow for the first time with calf; [cf. पष्ठ-वाह्।]
33089: प्रष्ठिवाहिन् प्रष्ठि-वाहिन्, a wrong read-ing for प्रष्टि-वाहिन्, q. v.
33090: प्रष्णवैष्णव प्रष्ण-वैष्णव, an incorrect form for प्रश्न-वैष्णव, q. v.
33091: प्रस् प्रस्, cl. 1. A. प्रसते, प्रसितुम्, to extend, expand, spread, diffuse; to bring forth young.
33092: प्रसक्त प्र-सक्त, प्र-सक्ति। See under प्र-सञ्ज् below.
33094: प्रसङ्ख्या 1. प्र-सङ्-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्यातुम्, to count or reckon up, number, enume-rate, calculate.
33095: 2. प्र-सङ्ख्या, f. total number, sum; reflection.
33096: प्र-सङ्ख्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, meditating (? as an epithet of an order of ascetics); (अस्), m. payment, liquidation; a sum of money; (अम्), n. enumerat-ing, enumeration; reflection, meditation; reputation, renown. —प्रसङ्ख्यान-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, en-grossed or absorbed in meditation.
33098: प्रसङ्घ प्र-सङ्घ, अस्, m. a great multitude.
33099: प्रसञ्चक्ष् प्र-सञ्-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, &c. (see rt. चक्ष्), to reckon up, recount, enumerate.
33100: प्रसञ्ज् प्र-सञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सङ्क्तुम्, to become attached to, feel affection for: Pass. -सज्-यते, to cleave to, adhere or cling to, become fixed upon or attached to, become strongly addicted to (with loc.); to be relevant or applicable, to apply.
33101: प्र-सक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to, in contact with, united to, connected with; cleaving to, adher-ing to, fixed upon (with loc.); devoted to; accom-panying; engaged in, applied to, used, employed; attained, obtained, gained; continual, constant, eter-nal; opened, expanded; (अम्), ind. continually, in-cessantly, eternally, ever.
33102: प्र-सक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached to.
33103: प्र-सक्ति, इस्, f. adherence or attachment to, ad-hesion, devotion to, addiction to, engagedness, the being occupied with; bearing upon, applicability, application (especially of a rule in grammar; अति-प्रसक्ति, too wide applicability; प्रसक्तिम् प्र-या, to become attached); connection, union, association; inference, conclusion, deduction; a topic or subject of conversation; occurrence of a possibility; perse-verance, energy; acquiring, acquisition.
33104: प्र-सङ्ग, अस्, m. adherence or attachment to, devotion to, devotedness; addiction to [cf. सुरत-प्°]; occupation [cf. विरत-प्°, विरुद्ध-प्°]; con-nection, union, association, intercourse [cf. स्त्री-प्°]; illicit intercourse; connected reasoning or argument; connected language or style; subject, topic, the case as stated; occurrence of a possibility, contingency, case, event (e. g. एचः प्लुत-प्रसङ्गे, in the event of a diphthong being prolated); conjuncture, occa-sion, circumstances, time; introduction, insertion; mention of parents; conjoint result (?); revealing a secret (?); second or subsidiary incident (?); N. of a Bud-dhist school; of a man; प्रसङ्गेन or प्रसङ्गात्, ind. through connection with or relation to; with all the heart, heartily, earnestly; on the occasion of, in consequence of, on account of, because of (lit. from its happening); when the occasion presents itself, occasionally, incidentally; in the course of (e. g. कथा-प्रसङ्गेन, in course of conversation). —प्रसङ्ग-तस्, ind. out of attachment to or respect for; = प्रसङ्गेन, प्रसङ्गात्. —प्र-सङ्ग-निवारण, अम्, n. the prevention of (similar) cases, obviation of (like future) contingencies. —प्र-सङ्ग-रत्नावली, f., N. of a work. —प्रसङ्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, occasional, incidental, casual. —प्र-सङ्ग-वशात्, ind. according to the time, as occasion may demand, by the force of circumstances. —प्र-सङ्ग-विनिवृत्ति, इस्, f. the non-recurrence of a case. —प्रसङ्ग-सम, अस्, m. a particular Jāti [q. v.] in logic. —प्रसङ्गाभरण (°ग-आभ्°), अम्, n., N. of a modern poetical anthology.
33105: प्रसङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attached to, devoted to; dependent on, contingent, additional; occasional, incidental; secondary, subordinate, non-essential. —प्रसङ्गि-ता, f. attachment, addiction to, con-nection, intercourse with.
33106: प्र-सज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached to, to be connected with; applicable. —प्रसज्य-प्रतिषे-ध, अस्, m. a particular kind of negation, negation of a possible case (distinguished from पर्य्-उदास, q. v.), a simple prohibition of the particular matter specified without enjoining what is different.
33107: प्र-सञ्जन, अम्, n. the act of attaching or con-necting, combining, uniting; applying, employing, bringing into use, bringing to bear.
33108: प्रसद् प्र-सद्, cl. 1. 6. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्, to settle down, become clear, become placid or tranquil, become calm, be calm, be soothed; to be content or satisfied; to be glad; to be gracious or propitious, to be favourable, favour (with gen.); to vouchsafe, be pleased to (with inf.): Caus. -सा-दयति, -यितुम्, to render calm, soothe, appease, propitiate; to beg pardon of (with acc.); (A.) to cause to be gracious, pray for grace or favour: Pass. of Caus. -साद्यते, to be rendered calm, to be soothed or appeased.
33109: प्र-सत्ति, इस्, f. transparency, brightness, clearness, cleanness, purity; complacency, graciousness, favour.
33110: प्र-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, settled down, tranquil; clear, bright, pellucid, limpid, pure, clean; soothed, propitiated, pleased, delighted; gracious, propitious, kind, kindly disposed towards, favourable, compla-cent; true; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (आ), f. pro-pitiating, pleasing; spirituous or vinous liquor. —प्र-सन्न-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, almost quiet, tolerably calm. —प्रसन्न-ता, f. or प्रसन्न-त्व, अम्, n. brightness, pellucidness, clearness, purity; favour, kindness, propitiousness, good humour. —प्रसन्न-पाद, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?) , N. of a work by Dharma-kīrtti. —प्रसन्न-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘placid-countenanced,’ having a pleased or approv-ing countenance, agreeable-looking, looking pleased, smiling. —प्रसन्न-राघव, अम्, n., N. of a drama by Jaya-deva. —प्रसन्न-वेङ्कटेश्वर-माहात्म्य (°ट-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a legend in the Bhaviṣyottara-Purāṇa. —प्रसन्न-सलिल, अस्, आ, अम्, having clear or limpid water. —प्रसन्नात्मन् (°न-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, gracious-minded, propitious. —प्रसन्नेरा (°न-ईरा), f. spirituous liquor.
33111: 1. प्र-साद, अस्, m. clearness, brightness, pellucid-ness, transparentness, limpidness, purity, cleanness [cf. अम्बु-प्°]; clearness of style, perspicuity; calm-ness, tranquillity, absence of excitement, repose, composure; serenity of disposition, good humour, good temper; graciousness, propitiousness, favour, kindness, kind behaviour [cf. दुष्-प्°, दृक्-प्°]; approbation; Kindness personified as a son of Dharma and Maitrī; a propitiatory offering or gift, food offered to a god (= प्रसाद-द्रव्य, प्रसादान्न); the remnants of food presented to an idol or left by a spiritual teacher (both of which any one may freely appropriate to his own use); free gift, gratuity; well-being, welfare; N. of a commentary on the Prakriyā-kaumudī; प्रसादात्, abl. c. through the kindness of, by the favour of. —प्रसाद-दान, अम्, n. a propitiatory gift, a gift in token of favour, gift of food by a superior. —प्रसाद-पट्ट, अस्, m. a turban of honour (worn as a token of royal favour). —प्रसाद-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, not caring for any one's favour; withdrawing favour from any one (with gen.). —प्रसाद-पात्र, अम्, n. an object of favour. —प्रसाद-पुरग, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined to favour, favourably inclined. —प्र-साद-प्रतिलब्ध, अस्, m., N. of a demon. —प्र-साद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pleased, delighted; gracious, favourable. —प्रसाद-वित्तक, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps an incorrect form for प्रसाद-वित्तम), best ac-quainted with the favour (of another), preferred to all others. —प्रसाद-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, abiding in serenity, kind, propitious; happy. —प्रसादान्तर (°द-अन्°), अम्, n. another (mark of) favour. —प्र-सादी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to bestow as a mark of favour, bestow graciously, present.
33112: 2. प्रसाद, Nom. P. प्रसादति, प्रसादितुम्, to be clear or bright.
33113: प्र-सादक, अस्, इका, अम्, clearing, purifying, rendering clear or pellucid; gladdening, cheering, exhilarating; propitiating, courting favour, wishing to win any one's favour.
33114: प्र-सादन, अस्, ई, अम्, rendering clear, purifying [cf. अम्बु-प्°, तोय-प्°]; calming, tranquillizing; soothing, cheering, gratifying; (अस्), m. a royal tent; (आ), f. service, worship; (अम्), n. cleaning, freeing from soil or impurities; the act of calming, tranquillizing, composing, soothing (e. g. नेत्र-प्°, administering soothing remedies to the eyes); cheer-ing, gratifying [cf. श्रुति-प्°]; rendering gracious, propitiating, pleasing, (त्वत्-प्रसादनात्, for the sake of propitiating thee); boiled rice.
33115: प्र-सादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious, to be propitiated.
33116: प्र-सादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to be gracious, propitiating, gratifying, pleasing.
33117: प्र-सादयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious, to be propitiated.
33118: प्र-सादित, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed; pleased, conciliated, propitiated, appeased, reconciled; wor-shipped.
33119: प्र-सादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, calming, tranquillizing, soothing, cheering, gladdening; showing favour, treating with kindness; clear, serene, bright.
33120: प्र-साद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious, to be propitiated, to be conciliated, placable.
33121: प्र-सेदिवस्, वान्, दुषी, वत्, one who has be-come pleased or propitiated, favourable.
33122: प्रसन्धा प्र-सन्-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to fix or fit (an arrow) to (the bow-string).
33123: प्र-सन्धान, अम्, n. combination (e. g. of words in the Krama, q. v.).
33124: प्र-सन्धि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Manu.
33126: प्रसमीक्ष् प्र-सम्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look at, look upon, observe, perceive, see; to reflect upon, consider, deliberate; to ac-knowledge, recognise as, regard as.
33127: प्र-समीक्षण, अम्, n. considering, deliberat-ing, discussing.
33129: प्र-समीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, looked upon, observed; reflected upon, considered; regarded as, declared.
33130: 1. प्र-समीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be considered or weighed or discussed.
33131: 2. प्र-समीक्ष्य, ind. having looked at; having reflected upon, having considered.
33132: प्रसमीडित प्र-समीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, celebrated.
33133: प्रसयन प्र-सयन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सि with प्र), binding, fastening.
33134: प्र-सित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound to, bound, fastened; adhering to or engaged in, diligent, attentive, zealous; attached or devoted to, engrossed by; (अम्), n. pus, matter.
33135: 1. प्र-सिति, इस्, f. (for 2. see p. 648, col. 2), a ligament, binding, tie, fetter.
33137: प्रसर्ग प्र-सर्ग, प्र-सर्जन। See under प्र-सृज्, p. 649, col. 2.
33139: प्रसल प्रसल, अस्, m. the cold season, winter (= हेमन्त; also read प्रशल).
33140: प्रसलवि प्र-सलवि, ind., Ved. towards the right side, (opposed to अप-सलवि; also incor-rectly written प्रसवि।)
33141: प्रसव 1. 2. and 3. प्र-सव। See under 1. and 2. प्र-सु, col. 2, and 2. प्र-सू, p. 649.
33142: प्रसव्य प्र-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards the left, (opposed to प्र-दक्षिण); contrary, reverse, reverted, inverted; favourable; (अम्), ind. towards the left, to the left side.
33143: प्रसह् 1. प्र-सह्, cl. 1. A. -सहते, -सहि-तुम्, -सोढुम्, to bear up against, be able to with-stand, sustain, endure; to overpower, conquer, de-feat; to make an effort; to be able (with inf.).
33144: प्र-सक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. overpowering, de-feating, victorious (Sāy. = शत्रूणाम् प्रसहन-शीलः).
33145: प्र-सभम्, ind. (an ind. past part. of a form सभ् = सह्, cf. 2. प्र-सह्य), by force, forcibly, violently; importunately; exceedingly, much; N. of a variety of the Triṣṭubh metre. —प्रसभ-द-मन, अम्, n. forcible taming (of wild animals; according to a Scholiast = बलात्कारेण मर्दनम्). —प्रसभ-हरण, अम्, n. carrying off by force, violent seizure. —प्रसभोद्धृत (°भ-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, torn up by force, forcibly uprooted. —प्र-सभोद्धृतारि (°त-अरि), इस्, इस्, इ, one who has forcibly uprooted his enemies.
33146: 2. प्र-सह् or प्र-साह्, -साट्, m. (acc. प्र-साहम्), overpowering; an epithet of Indra, (Sāy. = शत्रूणाम् अभिभविता, the overcomer of foes); force, violence.
33147: प्र-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing up against, with-standing; (अस्), m. a beast or bird of prey; endur-ance, resistance (in दुष्-प्°, q. v.); (आ), f. a kind of Solanum (= वृहतिका).
33148: प्र-सहन, अस्, m. a beast or bird of prey; (अम्), n. withstanding, resisting; overcoming, de-feating; defeat; bearing, enduring; embracing, an embrace.
33149: 1. प्र-सह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be resisted, to be conquered or defeated; अ-प्रसह्य, not to be resisted, irresistible.
33150: 2. प्र-सह्य, ind. having withstood, having sus-tained; having overpowered or conquered; forcibly, violently, by violence, by force; exceedingly. —प्र-सह्य-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting violently, violent in action. —प्रसह्य-चौर, अस्, m. ‘a violent thief,’ a robber, plunderer. —प्रसह्य-हरण, अम्, n. taking away by force, robbing, plundering; [cf. प्र-सभ-हरण।]
33151: प्र-सह्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. overpowering, defeat-ing; an epithet of Indra.
33153: प्र-साह, अस्, m. overpowering, defeating; con-trolling one's self; अ-प्रसाह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. com-pletely master of one's self, not subject to passion.
33154: प्रसातिका प्रसातिका, f. a kind of rice with small grains (= अणु-व्रीहि; cf. प्र-साधिका).
33156: प्रसाध् प्र-साध्, Caus. P. -साधयति, -यि-तुम्, to accomplish, effect; to promote, advance, further; to make one's own, acquire, (according to Kullūka on Manu VII. 103 = आत्मसात्-कृ); to subdue; to dress.
33157: प्र-साधक, अस्, इका, अम्, accomplishing, per-fecting, one who accomplishes or perfects; cleansing, purifying; decorating, adorning, ornamenting; (अस्), m. an attendant who dresses his master, a valet de chambre; (इका), f. a female attendant who dresses her mistress, lady's maid; wild rice; [cf. प्रसा-तिका।]
33158: प्र-साधन, अस्, ई, अम्, accomplishing, effecting; one who accomplishes or effects (Ved.); (अस्), m. a comb; (ई), f. a drug, commonly called सिद्धि; a comb, (केश-प्°, a comb for the hair); (अम्), n. bringing about, accomplishing, effecting; arranging; setting in order; decorating, decoration, embellish-ment, ornament, dress, toilet; a comb. —प्रसा-धन-विधि, इस्, m. a mode of decoration or em-bellishment. —प्रसाधन-विशेष, अस्, m. the highest decoration, most excellent ornament.
33159: प्र-साधित, अस्, आ, अम्, accomplished, finished, completed, done; proved; ornamented, decorated. —प्रसाधिताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having the limbs ornamented or decorated.
33160: प्र-साध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accomplished or effected, practicable; to be destroyed; to be defeated.
33163: प्रसिच् प्र-सिच्, Pass. -सिच्यते, to be poured out or flow forth, to be scattered; to be lost.
33164: प्र-सेक, अस्, m. flowing forth, flowing, dropping, oozing; sprinkling, wetting; emission, discharge; running or watering of the mouth or nose, flow of saliva in vomiting, vomiting, sickness, nausea; the bowl of a spoon or ladle. —प्रसेक-ता, f. flow of saliva in nausea or vomiting.
33165: प्रसेकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, discharging a fluid; suffering from morbid flow of saliva.
33167: प्रसिति 2. प्र-सिति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. सो with प्र; for 1. see प्र-सयन, p. 647), Ved. a track, path, course (as of fire &c.); an attack, assault; a throw, cast, shot; stretch, reach, extent, compass; duration, series, succession (e. g. दीर्घाम् अनु प्र-सितिम्, in long succession); dominion, power, autho-rity, influence; (Sāy.) = ज्वाला, a flame; = बन्धन, confinement.
33168: प्रसिध् प्र-सिध्, cl. 4. P. -सिध्यति, -सेद्-धुम्, to be accomplished or effected, to succeed; to be gained or obtained; to be established; to be made known or certified.
33169: प्र-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, well known, notorious, renowned, famous, celebrated; adorned, ornamented. —प्रसिद्ध-क्षत्रिय-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, con-sisting for the most part of renowned Kṣatriyas. —प्रसिद्ध-ता, f. or प्रसिद्ध-त्व, अम्, n. celebrity, the being well known, notoriety.
33170: प्रसिद्धक, अस्, m., N. of a prince descended from Janaka (a son of Maru and father of Kṛtti-ratha).
33171: प्र-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment, success, attain-ment; the being generally known or admitted, celebrity, fame, notoriety; ornament, decoration. —प्रसिद्धि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, generally known, notorious, famous.
33172: प्रसीदिका प्रसीदिका, f. a small garden; (also read प्रसेदिका, q. v.)
33173: प्रसु 1. प्र-सु, cl. 5. P. A. -सुनोति, -सुनुते, -सोतुम्, Ved. to press or squeeze out Soma juice, extract the juice of the Soma plant (Sāy. = सोमा-भिषवं कृ).
33174: 1. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सु below), Ved. pressing out Soma juice.
33175: प्र-सुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. flowing forth (as Soma from the Soma press).
33176: प्र-सुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. squeezing out or extracting Soma juice.
33177: प्र-सुव, अस्, m., Ved. pressing out Soma juice, extraction of the juice of the Soma plant.
33178: प्रसु 2. प्र-सु (sometimes written प्र-सू), cl. 1. P., 2. 4. A. -सवति, -सूते, -सूयते (properly a kind of reflexive passive form), -सोतुम्, -सवितुम्, to procreate, beget, generate, engender; to bring forth, be delivered of, bear: Pass. -सूयते (ep. also P. -ति), to be begotten by (with abl.); to be brought forth by, be born of (with loc.).
33179: 2. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 3. see under 2. प्र-सू, p. 649), procreating, generating, procreation, genera-tion; the production of young, bringing forth or bearing young, childbirth, parturition, delivery, travail, labour; conception; birthplace, source, origin; offspring, young, progeny, posterity, (अन्तः-प्°, containing offspring, pregnant; किसलय-प्°, the offspring of a twig, a young shoot); a flower, blossom [cf. कनक-प्°, पीत-प्°]; fruit. —प्रसव-गृह, अम्, n. a lying-in chamber. —प्रसव-धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, charac-terized by production, productive, prolific. —प्र-सव-बन्धन, अम्, n. the foot-stalk of a leaf or flower, the leaf-stalk or peduncle. —प्रसव-वि-कार, अस्, m., Ved. a prodigy happening at the birth of a child. —प्रसव-वेदना, f. the pangs of childbirth, throes. —प्रसव-स्थली, f. ‘birthplace,’ a mother. —प्रसव-स्थान, अम्, n. a receptacle for young, a nest. —प्रसवोत्थान (°व-उत्°), अम्, n., N. of the seventeenth Pari-śiṣṭa of the Yajur-veda. —प्रसवोन्मुख (°व-उन्°), ई, f. expecting child-birth, about to be delivered (according to Malli-nātha = आसन्न-प्रसवा).
33180: प्रसवक, अस्, m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia (= पियाल).
33181: प्र-सवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing forth, bearing; (अन्ती), f. a woman in labour.
33182: प्र-सवन, अम्, n. bringing forth, bearing children, fecundity.
33183: 1. प्र-सवितृ, ता, m. (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सू, p. 649), a procreator, generator, father; (त्री), f. bringing forth, a mother.
33184: 1. प्र-सविन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सू, p. 649), bringing forth, having or bearing young, producing.

33186: 1. प्र-सू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (for 2. see p. 649), bringing forth, bearing [cf. पितृ-प्°, पुत्रिका-प्°, स्त्री-प्°]; fruitful, productive; (ऊस्), f. a mother; a mare; a young shoot, tender grass or herbs, sacrificial grass, (Sāy. = प्रसवित्र्य् ओषधी); a spreading creeper, the plantain. —प्रसू-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or प्रसू-वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. furnished with flowers.
33188: प्र-सूत, अस्, आ, अम्, procreated, begotten, en-gendered; brought forth, born, produced, grown; begetting, engendering; one who has brought forth, delivered; (अस्), m., N. of a class of deities under Manu Cākṣuṣa; (अम्), n. a flower; any productive source; (आ), f. a woman who has brought forth a child, a woman recently delivered.

33190: प्रसूतिका, f. a woman who has had a child, a woman recently delivered; = 1. प्र-सूति (at the end of a comp., cf. नश्यत्-प्°, सकृत्-प्°).

33199: प्रसुह्म प्र-सुह्म, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

33208: प्र-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, moving forwards, proceeding, projecting; (अम्), n. going forwards, unimpeded motion, free course [cf. विच्छिन्न-धूम-प्°]; spreading, extending, extension, extent, dimension, diffusion, dispersion; expansion; a stream, flow, flood, torrent; (in medicine) morbid displacement of the humors of the body; multitude, assemblage; a fight, combat, battle, war; an iron arrow; speed, velocity; affectionate solicitation; (आ), f. the plant Pæderia Fœtida. —प्रसर-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, pos-sessing extension, extensive.
33209: प्र-सरण, अम्, n. going forth, running forth, running away, escaping; going round; spreading abroad, spreading over the country to forage; sur-rounding an enemy; morbid displacement of the humors of the body; complaisance, amiability.
33210: प्र-सरणि, इस्, or प्र-सरणी, f. surrounding an enemy.
33211: प्र-सरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forwards, proceed-ing, projecting; spreading out, spreading, expanding; bursting.
33212: प्र-सार, अस्, m. going forth, going about, spread-ing, extending, extension, expansion; stretching out [cf. बाहु-प्°]; opening (the mouth); going out to forage, spreading over the country for grass and fuel.
33213: प्र-सारण, अम्, n. causing to go forwards, stretching out, extending, spreading, spreading abroad, diffusing, diffusion, expanding, expansion, increase; displaying, unfolding; going about; surrounding an enemy; dispersion of an army by detachments for collecting forage, &c.; changing a semivowel into a vowel [cf. सम्-प्रसारण]; (ई), f. surround-ing an enemy; a species of creeper, Pæderia Fœtida.
33214: प्रसारणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, containing a semivowel liable to be changed into a vowel.
33215: प्र-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved forwards, held out; stretched out, expanded, extended, spread, dif-fused; laid out, exhibited, exposed (for sale).
33216: प्र-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming forth, flowing forth, moving on; going along gently, gliding, flowing, creeping; stretching, extending; spreading forth, spreading, expanding, expanded, unfolded; spread-ing round; (इणी), f. the plant Pæderia Fœtida.
33217: 1. प्र-सार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be changed into a vowel.
33218: 2. प्र-सार्य, ind. having stretched forth, having put forth, having held out.
33219: प्र-सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forwards, gone; stretched out, stretched, extended; diffused, spread abroad, dispersed; lengthened, long; swift, quick; modest, humble; attached to, engaged in, appointed; (अस्), m. the palm of the hand stretched out and hol-lowed as if to hold liquids; a handful (as a measure, = two Palas); (आ), f. the leg; (अम्), n. a measure equal to two Palas; (प्र-सृत is sometimes incor-rectly written for प्र-श्रित and even for प्र-सित, q. q. v. v.) —प्रसृत-ज, आस्, m. pl. an epithet of a particular class of sons (Mahā-bh. 33220: प्र-सृति, इस्, f. progress, advance; streaming, flowing; the palm of the hand hollowed, a handful; a measure equal to two Palas.
33221: प्र-सृमर, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing forth, dropping, distilling.
33222: प्रसृज् प्र-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to pour away; to lay aside, dismiss; to quit, leave, abandon; to hurt, injure.
33223: प्र-सर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. pouring forth, flowing forth, efflux (Sāy. = वर्षण); emission, discharge.
33224: प्र-सर्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) throwing or casting forth.
33225: प्र-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, poured away, laid aside, dismissed; hurt, injured; (आ), f. (probably) a par-ticular movement in fighting.
33226: प्रसृप् प्र-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to creep or crawl forth, creep on; to go on, proceed.
33227: प्र-सर्प, अस्, m. going to the part of the sacrificial enclosure called the Sadas; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
33228: प्र-सर्पक, अस्, m., Ved. an assistant who is under the superintendance of the Ṛtvij at a sacrifice or a mere spectator at a sacrifice (so designated from entering the part of the sacrificial enclosure called Sadas; cf. प्र-सृप्त); an uninvited guest, an intruder (?) .
33229: प्र-सर्पण, अम्, n. going forwards, progressing, entering (with loc.); entering the part of the sacri-ficial ground called Sadas; refuge, shelter (Ved.; Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण सर्पण-साधनम्).
33230: प्र-सर्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, advancing, proceeding.
33231: प्र-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creeping or crawling forth, gliding away; coming forth, issuing; going to the part of the sacrificial enclosure called Sadas.
33232: प्र-सृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, crept or crawled forth, crept away, come forth; entered into the part of the sacrificial ground called Sadas; (अस्), m. = प्र-सर्-पक, q. v.
33235: प्रसेक प्र-सेक, प्रसेकिन्। See under प्र-सिच्, p. 648, col. 2.
33236: प्रसेदिका प्रसेदिका, f. a various reading for प्रसीदिका, q. v.
33238: प्रसेन प्र-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince (a son of Nighna or Nimna); N. of a king of Ujjayinī succeeded by Vikramārka or Vikramāditya. —प्र-सेन-जित्, त्, m., N. of several princes, especially of a sovereign of Śrāvastī contemporary with Śākya-muni.
33239: प्रसेव प्र-सेव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सिव् with प्र), a sack, a leathern bottle; a small instrument of wood covered with leather and placed under the neck of an Indian lute to render the sound deeper.
33240: प्रसेवक, अस्, m. a sack [cf. चर्म-प्°]; a particular part of a lute (= प्र-सेव); a crooked piece of wood at the end of a lute.
33241: प्रस्कण्व प्र-स्-कण्व, अस्, m., N. of a Vedic Ṛṣi with the patronymic Kāṇva (according to the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa, a grandson of Kaṇva), author of the hymns Ṛg-veda I. 44-50, IX. 95, Vālakhilya 3, 2, and 6, 8; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the descendants of Praskaṇva.
33242: प्रस्कन्द् प्र-स्कन्द्, cl. 1. P. -स्कन्दति, -स्कन्-तुम्, to spring forward, spring forth; to spring down, leap down, alight: Caus. -स्कन्दयति, -यितुम्, to overleap, spring over, leap across, cross (a river).
33243: प्र-स्कन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, springing forward, springing forth.

33246: प्र-स्कन्दिन्, ई, m., N. of a man possessed of extraordinary strength.
33247: प्र-स्कन्द्य, ind. having sprung forwards, having leaped down, having quickly alighted.
33248: प्र-स्कन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung forward, sprung forth; dropped, fallen; defeated in battle; (अस्), m. a transgressor, sinner; one who has violated the usages of his caste or order, an outcast.
33249: प्रस्कुन्द प्र-स्कुन्द, अस्, m. an altar or ele-vated floor of a circular shape (= चक्राकारा वेदिका).
33250: प्रस्खल् प्र-स्खल्, cl. 1. P. -स्खलति, -स्ख-लितुम्, to stagger forwards, stagger, reel, totter, tumble.
33251: प्र-स्खलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, staggering forwards, reeling, tumbling.
33252: प्र-स्खलन, अम्, n. the act of staggering, stumbling, tumbling, falling.
33253: प्रस्तर प्र-स्तर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्तृ with प्र), anything strewed about, a couch of leaves and flowers; a bed or couch in general; a flat surface, flat top, level, a plain [cf. प्रासाद-प्°]; a stone, rock; a precious stone, gem, jewel; a paragraph, section of a work; (in prosody) a tabular represen-tation of the long and short vowels of a metre (?) ; musical notation (?) . —प्रस्तर-घटनोपकरण (°न-उप्°), अम्, n. an instrument for breaking or splitting stones. —प्रस्तरे-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. स्था), Ved. being on a couch or bed.
33254: प्र-स्तरण, अस्, आ, m. f. a couch, bed; a seat.
33255: प्र-स्तरिणी, f. a species of small shrub (= गो-लोमिका).
33256: प्र-स्तार, अस्, m. strewing about, spreading out, scattering, spreading, covering with; a process in pre-paring minerals; a bed made with blossoms and leaves; a bed or couch in general; a flower-bed; a jungle, a thicket or wood overgrown with grass; a flat surface, level, plain; a representation or enumeration of all the possible combinations of certain given numbers (see Colebrooke's Algebra, p. 125); N. of a prince (a son of Ud-gītha; in this sense incorrectly for प्र-स्ताव). —प्रस्तार-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a kind of metre consisting of 12 + 12 + 8 + 8 syllables.
33257: प्र-स्तारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, extending, spreading; (scil. अर्मन्) a particular disease of the white of the eye.
33258: प्र-स्तिर, अस्, m. a bed or couch made of flowers and leaves (= प्र-स्तर).
33259: प्र-स्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thrust forward, protruded (as the tip of the tongue in pronouncing the dentals).
33260: प्र-स्तृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread out, spread, ex-tended; disappeared.
33261: प्रस्तीत प्र-स्तीत or प्र-स्तीम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्त्यै with प्र), crowded together, clustering, swarming; sounded, making a noise.
33262: प्रस्तु प्र-स्तु, cl. 2. P. A. -स्तौति, -स्तवीति, -स्तुते, -स्तुवीते, -स्तोतुम्, to praise before (anything else), praise first, praise; to begin, commence; to speak, say, report, relate, propound: Caus. -स्ताव-यति, -यितुम्, to begin, commence.
33263: प्र-तुष्टुषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to begin, desirous of commencing.
33264: प्र-स्तव, अस्, m. a hymn of praise; = प्र-स्ताव, a favourable moment, &c.
33265: प्र-स्ताव, अस्, m. an introductory eulogy, intro-duction; the prelude or introductory words of a Sāman (sung by the Pra-stotṛ, Ved.); the prologue of a drama (= प्र-स्तावना); beginning, commenc-ing, commencement; introducing a topic, mention-ing, mention; the occasion of a conversation, a subject, topic; occasion, opportunity, time, season; convenience, (तव प्रस्तावेन, at your conveni-ence); N. of a prince (a son of Ud-gītha); = हेला, q. v.; (ए), ind. on a suitable occasion, oppor-tunely; (एन), ind. on the occasion of, occasionally, opportunely; suitably. —प्रस्ताव-चिन्तामणि, इस्, m., N. of a work. —प्रस्ताव-तस्, ind. on the occasion of; कथा-प्°, in course of conversation. —प्रस्ताव-यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘the sacrifice to a topic of discussion,’ a conversation to which each inter-locutor contributes his share (and therefore compared with a sacrifice at which each person present offers a contribution). —प्रस्ताव-रत्नाकर, अस्, m., N. of a work. —प्रस्ताव-सदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, suited to the occasion, appropriate, seasonable.

33267: प्र-स्तावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, beginning, com-mencing.
33268: प्र-स्तावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be told or related; mentioned.
33269: प्र-स्ताव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be preluded or introduced with a Pra-stāva (as a Sāman).
33270: प्र-स्तुत, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, eulogized, pane-gyrised; proposed, propounded, declared, under dis-cussion, revealed; said; expected, desired; ready, prepared; accomplished, done; happened, come to pass; made or consisting of; approached, proximate; done with effort or energy; (अम्), n. that which is propounded, any object under discussion, a proposi-tion. —प्रस्तुत-यज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared for a sacrifice. —प्रस्तुताङ्कुर (°त-अङ्°), अस्, m. a kind of metaphorical expression, allusion by the mention of any passing circumstance to something latent in the hearer's mind (as, for instance, if a girl walking in a garden with an inconstant lover were to ask a bee, Why go to the thorny plantain when you can have the jasmine flower?).
33271: प्र-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. praise, eulogium.
33272: प्र-स्तुत्य, ind. having told or related, having rehearsed.
33273: प्र-स्तोतृ, ता, m., Ved. the Ud-gātṛ's assistant who sings the Pra-stāva (q. v.).
33274: प्रस्तोत्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the Pra-stotṛ.
33275: प्रस्तूत प्र-स्तूत, अस्, m., N. of a class of deities under Manu Cākṣuṣa; (an incorrect form for प्र-भूत or प्र-सूत।)
33276: प्रस्तोक प्र-स्तोक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a son of Sṛñjaya; कुत्सस्य प्रस्तोकः, N. of a Sāman.
33277: प्रस्तोभ प्र-स्तोभ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्तुभ् with प्र), allusion to, reference to (with gen.); रयेर् आङ्गिरसस्य प्रस्तोभः, N. of a Sāman.
33278: प्रस्थल प्र-स्थल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
33279: प्रस्था प्र-स्था, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) -तिष्ठते (-ति), -स्थातुम्, to set out, depart; to proceed, advance, march towards (with acc. or dat. or with प्रति); (P., Ved.) to place before, set before, deposit: Caus. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to set forth, cause to depart, induce to retire; to send forth, send out, dispatch, send away, dismiss; to send into exile, banish; to urge forwards, push on: Desid. -तिष्ठासति, -ते, to wish to advance.
33280: प्र-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, going on a march or journey, going to, visiting, abiding in [cf. वन-प्°]; stable, firm, solid; expanding, spread; (अस्, अम्), m. n. table-land on the top of a mountain; a level expanse, (at the end of names of towns and villages, cf. इन्द्र-प्°, ओषधि-प्°, करीर-प्°; see Pāṇ. 33282: प्रस्थानिक, belonging or relating to a de-parture, to a course, sect, &c.

33318: प्र-स्यन्दमान, अस्, आ, अम्, moving rapidly, darting, flying.
33319: प्र-स्यन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flowing forth, trickling down.
33320: प्रस्रंस प्र-स्रंस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्रंस् with प्र), Ved. falling down, falling asunder.

33333: प्रस्वप् प्र-स्वप्, cl. 2. P. -स्वपिति, -स्वप्-तुम्, to fall asleep, go to sleep.

33335: प्र-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen into deep or sound sleep, fast asleep, asleep, sleeping, slumbering. —प्र-सुप्त-ता, f. sleepiness.
33336: प्र-सुप्ति, इस्, f. sleepiness, somnolence; paralysis.
33337: प्र-स्वाप, अस्, m. falling asleep, sleep; a dream; (अस्, आ, अम्), causing sleep, sending to sleep.

33339: प्र-स्वापन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing sleep, sending to sleep; (अम्), n. the act of sending to sleep.

33341: प्रस्वादस् प्र-स्वादस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. agree-able, pleasant.

33343: प्रस्विन्न प्र-स्विन्न, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्विद् with प्र), covered with perspiration, sweated, heated, perspired.

33346: प्र-स्वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, covered with perspiration, sweating.

33348: प्रहन् 1. प्र-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to kill, slay.

33353: प्र-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, striking down, slaying, a slayer.
33356: प्रहस् प्र-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -हसितुम्, to break out into laughter, laugh heartily, laugh at, laugh; to mock, deride, ridicule.
33357: प्र-हस, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
33358: प्र-हसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, laughing heartily, laugh-ing, smiling; (अन्ती), f. Arabian jasmine (= यूथी, वासन्ती); a large chafing-dish or fire-pan.
33359: प्र-हसन, अम्, n. laughing loudly, violent or hearty laughter, laughing, mirth, merriment; laugh-ing at, mocking, deriding, ridicule, irony, mockery; sarcasm, satire (as a branch of rhetorical composi-tion); a kind of comedy, a farce.
33360: प्र-हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, laughing, cheerful; (अम्), n. laughter, mirth. —प्रहसित-नेत्र, अस्, m. ‘laughing-eyed,’ N. of a Buddha.
33361: प्र-हसित्वा, ind. an anomalous form for प्र-हस्य below.
33362: प्र-हस्य, ind. having smiled or laughed.
33363: प्र-हास, अस्, m. loud laughter, violent or hearty laughter, laughing, laughter; ridicule, mocking, de-rision; satire, irony; an actor, a dancer; N. of Śiva; of an attendant of Śiva; of a son of Varuṇa; of a Nāga; of a place of pilgrimage (= सोम-तीर्थ); भरद्-वाजस्य प्रहासम्, N. of a Sāman.

33365: प्र-हासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to laugh.
33366: प्र-हासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, laughing aloud, causing laughter, diverting, joking, jesting; satirical; (ई), m. the buffoon of a drama (= वि-दूषक, q. v.).

33371: प्र-हाण, अम्, n. relinquishing, abandoning, omitting, avoiding.
33372: प्र-हाणि, इस्, f. relinquishing, abandoning; want, deficiency.
33373: प्र-हापण, अम्, n. driving away, forced aban-donment or departure.

33376: प्रहि 1. प्र-हि, cl. 5. P. -हिणोति, -हेतुम्, to send forth, dispatch, send to (with dat. or gen. or acc. of the person and acc. of the thing); to shoot (an arrow from a bow), send, cast, throw, discharge; (Ved.) to rouse up, urge on (?); to propitiate (?).

33388: प्र-होष, अस्, m., Ved. an oblation, sacrifice (?).

33392: प्रहरक, अस्, m. striking the hours; a watch.
