33629: प्रादेश प्रादेश, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-देश), the span of the thumb and forefinger, the space measured by the span of the thumb and forefinger; place, country (?). —प्रादेश-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, only a span long; प्रादेशमात्रम् भूमेः, a mere span of land.
33630: प्रादेशन, अम्, n. = प्र-देशन, a gift, &c.
33631: प्रादेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-देश), authorized by precedents or examples, precedented; significant, indicatory of the original meaning; local, limited, relating to a part; प्रादेशिको गुणः, the property of a word indicatory of its original or etymological meaning; (अस्), m. a small landed proprietor, the owner or chief of a district. —प्रादेशिकेश्वर (°क-ईश्°), अस्, m. the owner or chief of a district, a small landed proprietor, (opposed to सार्वभौम।)
33632: प्रादेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. प्रादेश), a span long; (इनी), f. the forefinger, (in this sense probably an error for प्र-देशिनी।)
33633: प्रादोष प्रादोष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-दोष), belonging or relating to the evening, vespertine.
33635: प्रादोहनि प्रादोहनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-dohana.
33636: प्राद्युम्नि प्राद्युम्नि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-dyumna.
33637: प्राद्योति प्राद्योति, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-dyota.
33638: प्राद्रु प्रा-द्रु (प्र-आ-द्रु), cl. 1. P. -द्र-वति, -द्रोतुम्, to run away from, flee from; to escape to, escape.
33639: प्राधनिक प्राधनिक, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-धन), an implement of war, a destructive weapon.
33640: प्राधा प्राधा, f., N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and mother of several Apsarasas and Gan-dharvas; [cf. प्र-धा।]
33641: प्राधेय, अस्, ई, अम्, descended from Prādhā.
33642: प्राधानिक प्राधानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-धान), pre-eminent, most eminent or distinguished, best, most excellent, superior; predominant; derived from or relating to Pradhāna or primary matter (in the Sāṅkhya phil.).
33643: प्राधान्य, अम्, n. predominance, preponder-ance, prevalence, ascendancy, pre-eminence, superi-ority, supremacy; the being the highest object; a principal cause; प्राधान्येन or प्राधान्यात् or प्राधान्य-तस्, ind. in regard to the highest object, with reference to the chief purpose; in the highest degree, chiefly, principally, especially. —प्राधान्य-स्तुति, इस्, इस्, इ, receiving especial praise, chiefly praised, especially celebrated.
33644: प्राधीत प्राधीत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. 5. इ with प्र-अधि), well-read, highly educated, learned (said of Brāhmans).
33645: प्राध्ययन, अम्, n. reciting, reading, studying.
33646: प्राध्येषण प्राध्य्-एषण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 3. इष् with प्र-अधि), Ved. incitement, exhortation (to study).
33647: प्राध्व प्राध्व (प्र-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, being on a road or journey, distant, remote, long, a long way off; bent, bowed, inclined; favourable, conform-able; (अस्), m. a car, carriage; (अम्), ind. favourably, conformably, agreeably; crookedly, in a contrary way (?). —प्राध्वं-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make conformable, to bend conform-ably, to join together (as the hands) in token of good-will. —प्राध्वं-कृत्य, ind. making conformable.
33648: प्राध्वन (प्र-अध्°), अस्, m., Ved. the bed of a river or stream.
33649: प्राध्वंसन प्राध्वंसन, अस्, m. a patro-nymic from Pra-dhvaṃsana.
33650: प्राध्वर प्राध्वर, अस्, ई, अम्, an epithet of a branch of a tree; (probably an incorrect form.)
33651: प्रान् प्रान्। See 1. प्राण्, p. 654, col. 3.
33652: प्रानाडी प्रानाडी, perhaps incorrectly for प्र-णाडी = प्र-णाली।
33653: प्रान्त प्रान्त (प्र-अन्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. edge, margin, verge, border, (ओष्ठ-प्रान्तौ, the corners of the mouth); boundary, bound, extremity, extreme verge, end [cf. यौवन-प्°]; back part; a point, tip (of a blade of grass); (अस्), m., N. of a man. —प्रान्त-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling near the boun-daries, living close by. —प्रान्त-तस्, ind. along the edge or border (of anything), marginally, along or upon the extremity. —प्रान्त-दुर्ग, अम्, n. ‘bor-der-stronghold,’ a suburb or collection of houses outside the walls of the town, a Petta or town con-tiguous to a fort and separately fortified. —प्रान्त-पुष्पा, f. a kind of plant (having flowers along the edge of the stem ?). —प्रान्त-विरस, अस्, आ, अम्, finally or ultimately insipid, tasteless in the end. —प्रान्त-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, inhabiting the borders.
33654: प्रान्तायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prānta.
33655: प्रान्तर प्रान्तर (प्र-अन्°), अम्, n. a long desolate road, a lonesome way or lane, a solitary path; an intervening long tract of country between two vil-lages; a forest; the hollow of a tree. —प्रान्तर-शून्-य, अम्, n. a long tiresome road (also प्रान्त-शून्य).
33656: प्राप् 1. प्राप् (प्र-आप्), cl. 5. P. A. प्राप्-नोति, प्राप्नुते, प्राप्तुम्, to attain to, reach, arrive at; to extend, stretch; to come upon, light upon, meet with, find; to obtain, get, gain, win; to obtain as a husband or wife; to bring upon one's self, contract, incur (e. g. दण्डम् प्राप्, to incur a fine); to suffer, endure (e. g. वधम् प्राप्, to suffer capital punishment); to flee to (e. g. दिशः प्रापन्, they fled to the various quarters, i. e. they fled in all directions); to pass or be changed into (in gram.), to follow (a grammatical rule); to be present, be at hand (Ved.): Caus. प्रापयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to attain to, cause to reach or arrive at, cause to occupy; to lead to, bring to; to promote or advance to, appoint to (an office); to drive to; to cause to obtain or gain, cause to possess, give anything to any one (with two acc.); to tell, announce (Rāmāyaṇa VII. 103, 10): Desid. प्रेप्-सति, to try to attain or get at, strive to reach.
33657: 2. प्राप्, प्, प्, प्, (at the end of a comp.) obtaining.
33658: 1. प्राप, अस्, m. (for 2. see p. 658), arriving at, reaching, attaining, obtaining; [cf. दुष्-प्°।]
33659: प्रापक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to arrive at, leading to (with gen.), conveying, bringing; causing to obtain, providing with, procuring; a procurer; establishing, making valid; obtaining, one who obtains.
33660: प्रापण, अम्, n. attaining to, attainment, reach-ing, extending, (बाह्वोः प्रापणान्ते, as far as the arms reach); obtaining, receiving, acquisition; bring-ing to, leading to, conveying; procuring [cf. दुष्-प्रापण]; reference to.
33661: प्रापणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained to, to be reached, attainable; to be caused to attain, to be made to arrive at; to be provided with; to be pro-cured, procurable, obtainable.
33663: प्रापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to attain to, made to arrive at; caused to occupy, placed upon; led or conducted to, brought to, conveyed; promoted or advanced to, appointed to; caused to obtain or gain, caused to possess; procured.
33664: प्रापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attaining to, reaching, coming to; obtaining, getting, gaining, receiving.
33665: प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attained to, reached, arrived at [cf. कर-प्°, हस्त-प्°]; come upon, lighted upon, met with, found; obtained, got, gained, acquired, procured, won; incurred, contracted; suf-fered, endured; one who has attained to or arrived at; arrived, come, present; come to a close, com-pleted, arrived at maturity; (in gram.) obtained from a rule, following from a rule, valid in conse-quence of a rule (e. g. इति प्राप्ते, because it so follows from a preceding rule); (in medicine) de-scribed (as a symptom); fixed, placed; proper, right; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —प्राप्त-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing what is fit or proper. —प्राप्त-काल, अस्, m. a time or moment arrived, a favourable moment, a fit time, proper season; (अस्, आ, अम्), one whose time has come (e. g. प्राप्त-कालो देही, a mortal whose time, i. e. whose last hour, is come); opportune, seasonable, suitable; arrived at maturity, marriageable; fated, destined; (अम्), ind. at the right time, opportunely. —प्राप्तकाल-त्व, अम्, n. the being a favourable moment, timeliness, season-ableness; (त्वात्), ind. because it is the proper season. —प्राप्त-जीवन, अस्, आ, अम्, restored to life. —प्राप्त-दोष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has incurred guilt, one who has committed an offence. —प्राप्त-पञ्चत्व, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived at dissolution into the five elements, deceased, dead. —प्राप्त-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, possessed of understanding, enlightened, instructed, intelligent; regaining consciousness, be-coming conscious (after fainting), recovering. —प्राप्-त-भार, अस्, m. a draught-ox or beast of burden. —प्राप्त-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has attained to any state or condition, of a good disposition; (अस्), m. a young bullock, an ox, (? for प्राप्त-भार।) —प्राप्त-मनोरथ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained his wish. —प्राप्त-यौवन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has attained the age of puberty, being in the bloom of youth. —प्राप्त-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, of a proper form, fit, proper, suitable; handsome, pleas-ing, beautiful; learned, wise, educated. —प्राप्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has attained to or arrived at; one who has obtained or gained. —प्राप्त-वर, अस्, आ, अम्, fraught with blessings. —प्राप्त-व्यवहार, अस्, m. a young man come of age, an adult, one able to conduct his own affairs and respon-sible for his conduct. —प्राप्त-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having the sun (vertical). —प्राप्तानुज्ञ (°त-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has received permission to with-draw, allowed to depart. —प्राप्तापराध (°त-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has committed an offence, guilty of an offence. —प्राप्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose object is attained, successful; (अस्), m. an object attained, an advantage gained. —प्राप्-तार्थाग्रहण (°थ-अग्°), अम्, n. the not securing of advantages gained. —प्राप्तावसर (°त-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, taking or finding occasion, opportune, seasonable; (अस्), m. a proper time, suitable occasion. —प्राप्तोदय (°त-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has attained exaltation, fortunate.
33666: प्राप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained to, to be reached, attainable; to be met with or found; to be gained or obtained, obtainable, procurable; a fanciful name given to a man in the Pañca-tantra (who, whenever asked his name, replied प्राप्तव्यम् अर्-थं लभते मनुष्यः, a man takes anything that is to be got, see Pañca-tantra, p. 128. 17).
33667: प्राप्ति, इस्, f. attaining to, attainment, reaching, arriving at, arrival, coming; coming or lighting upon, meeting with, finding; obtaining, getting, gaining, acquisition, profit, gain, advantage; reach, range; the power of obtaining everything, one of the eight superhuman faculties; obtaining by actions done in a former existence; discovering by percep-tion, guessing, conjecture; the being valid, holding good (of a rule); lot, share, portion, fortune, luck, good luck; (in dramatic language) happy denoue-ment, successful termination of a plot; (in astrology) N. of the eleventh lunar mansion (= आय, लाभ); Prāpti personified as wife of Śama (associated with Asti as a daughter of Jarā-sandha); a collection, assemblage, quantity. —प्राप्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has attained to or reached. —प्राप्ति-सम, अस्, m. a particular जाति (q. v.) in logic. —प्राप्त्य्-आशा, f. the hope of obtaining (an object).
33668: 1. प्राप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained, to be arrived at, attainable, obtainable, acquirable, pro-curable [cf. सुख-प्°]; proper, fitting, suitable.
33669: 2. प्राप्य, ind. having attained to or arrived at; having come upon or met with; having obtained or gained; having incurred; having suffered or endured.
33670: प्राप्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being attained to or ar-rived at; taking place (according to a rule in gram.).
33671: प्राप 2. प्राप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + अप्), abounding with water, watery (?).
33672: प्रापणिक प्रापणिक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पण् with प्र; according to Malli-nātha fr. प्र-पण), a trader, dealer, retail dealer; [cf. आपणिक।]
33673: प्रापेय प्रापेय for प्राधेय, q. v.
33674: प्राबन्ध प्राबन्ध in केसर-प्राबन्धा, q. v.
33675: प्राबल्य प्राबल्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-बल), superiority of force, superior force, predominance, as-cendancy; powerfulness, power, vigour, might, force.
33676: प्राबालिक प्राबालिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-बाल), a vender of coral, coral merchant.
33677: प्राबोधक प्राबोधक, अस्, m. (= प्र-बो-धक), a minstrel employed to wake the king in the morning; (a various reading for प्राबोधिक।)
33678: प्राबोधिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-बोध), dawn, day-break.
33679: प्राभञ्जन प्राभञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भञ्जन), presided over by the god of wind; (अम्), n., scil. नक्षत्र or भ, the Nakṣatra Svāti.
33680: प्राभव प्राभव, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भु), pre-eminence, superiority, supremacy.
33681: प्राभवत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भवत्), superi-ority, power, authority, ascendancy.
33682: प्राभूतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भूत), see Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 1.
33683: प्राभाकर प्राभाकर, अस्, m. (fr. प्रभा-कर), a follower of Prabhā-kara, the designation of a particular philosophical sect (a branch of the Mīmāṃsā school).
33684: प्राभातिक प्राभातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भात), belonging or relating to the morning, matu-tinal.
33685: प्राभासिक प्राभासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the place Pra-bhāsa, q. v.
33686: प्राभृत प्राभृत, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भृति), a present, gift, offering of ceremony; an offering to a deity or sovereign; a bribe; a term applied to the chapters of the Sūrya-prajñapti. —प्राभृती-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, given as a present, offered.
33687: प्राभृतक, अम्, n. a present, an offering.
33688: प्रामति प्रामति, इस्, m., N. of one of the seven sages in the tenth Manv-antara; (also read प्राप्तति; cf. प्र-मति।)
33689: प्रामाणिक प्रामाणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-माण), forming or being a measure; established by proof, resting or founded on an authority, pro-ceeding from evidence or authority, being of authority, authoritative; authentic, credible; true; (अस्), m. one who accepts proof or rests his arguments on authority; a president, the chief or head of a trade. —प्रामाणिक-त्व, अम्, n. = प्रामाण्य below.
33690: प्रामाण्य, अम्, n. the being established by proof, the resting upon authority; the being an authority; the being a rule, the being a proof; proof, evidence, authority; authenticity, credibility, genuineness (= प्रमाण-ता). —प्रामाण्य-वाद, अस्, m., N. of a Nyāya work by Raghu-nātha. —प्रामाण्य-वादिन्, ई, m. one who affirms or believes in proof.
33691: प्रामादिक प्रामादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-माद), arising from carelessness or negligence, blundering, faulty, erroneous, incorrect, wrong; प्रा-मादिकः पाठः, a wrong reading. —प्रामादिक-त्व, अम्, n. erroneousness, incorrectness.
33692: प्रामाद्य, अस्, m. a species of plant, Gendarussa (= अटरूष) Adhadota or Vulgaris; (अम्), n. madness, frenzy, fury; intoxication.
33694: प्रामोदक प्रामोदक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-मोद), charming, transporting, enchanting.
33695: प्राय प्राय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with प्र), setting out or starting (for a battle, Ved.; Sāy. = प्र-वेश, entering, or = युद्ध, battle); going away, departure, departure from life, seeking death by fasting, sitting down and fasting to death (as a religious or penitentiary act, or, like the practice of sitting in Dharnā, to enforce compliance with a de-mand; often used in connection with rt. 4. आस् or with उप-विश्, e. g. प्रायम् आस्महे, we sit down seeking death by fasting; but in such examples प्रायम् may perhaps be regarded as the indeclinable participle of rt. 5. इ with प्र; cf. प्रयोपवेश); principal part, largest portion, plurality, majority, majority of cases, general rule, abundance, plenty, excess, (when used at the end of adj. comps. often translatable by ‘in most cases,’ ‘for the most part,’ ‘as a general rule,’ ‘generally,’ ‘well nigh,’ ‘almost,’ ‘nearly,’ e. g. दण्ड-प्°, one who generally inflicts punishment; जित-प्°, almost conquered; cf. आर्य-प्°, गत-प्°, दुःख-प्°, संस्तुत-प्°, सिद्ध-प्°: or translatable by ‘abounding in,’ ‘much,’ ‘exceed-ing,’ ‘abundant,’ e. g. शालि-प्°, abounding in rice; cf. हिंसा-प्°: or by ‘like,’ ‘resembling,’ e. g. अमृत-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, like nectar); a stage or condition of life (as youth, age, &c.); (अम्), n. sin (?); प्रा-येण, ind. for the most part, in most cases, mostly, commonly, as a rule; in all probability, probably, likely; much more, much rather. —प्राय-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, near departure from life, nigh unto death. —प्राय-चित्त, प्राय-चित्ति, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 157, and cf. प्रायश्-चित्त, &c. —प्राय-दर्शन, अम्, n. a common or ordinary pheno-menon. —प्राय-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, being com-monly the case, usually met with. —प्राय-विधा-यिन्, ई, इनी, इ, resolved to die of starvation. —प्रा-यश्-चित्त, अम्, n. (प्राय + चित्त with श् euphonically inserted), an expiation, expiatory act, atonement, penance, satisfaction, compensation, indemnification, amends; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to or included in an expiation or atonement, expiatory. —प्रायश्चित्त-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a work by Raghu-nandana. —प्रायश्चित्त-दीपिका, f., N. of a work on ritual by Vara-da. —प्रायश्चित्त-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a work by Kāma-deva. —प्रायश्चित्त-रत्न, अम्, n., N. of a work by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa. —प्रायश्-चित्त-विधि, इस्, m. a prescribed rule of penance or expiation. —प्रायश्चित्त-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a work by Śūla-pāṇi on expiatory ceremonies. —प्रा-यश्-चित्ति, इस्, इस्, इ (प्राय + चित्ति with श् euphoni-cally inserted), expiating, atoning; (इस्), f. expiation, atonement, penance. —प्रायश्चित्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, expiating, expiatory, performing penance (?); expi-able. —प्रायश्चित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who does penance or has to make expiation. —प्रायश्चित्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, making atonement, expiating, performing penance. —१। प्रायश्चित्तीय, Nom. A. प्रायश्चित्तीयते, -यितुम्, to have to expiate, to be obliged to perform penance. —२। प्रायश्चित्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to expiation or penance, expia-tory. —प्रायश्चित्तीय-ता, f. obligation to make an atonement. —प्रायश्चित्तेन्दु-शेखर (°त-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of a work by Kāśī-nātha on expiatory ceremonies. —प्रायोपगमन (°य-उप्°), अम्, n. going to meet death, seeking death (by abstaining from food). —प्रायोपविष्ट (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, or प्रायोपवेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who sits down in expectation of death, one who calmly awaits the approach of death (by abstaining from food), one who sits in Dharnā to compel compliance with a demand; [cf. प्रायोपवेश।] —प्रायोप-वेश (°य-उप्°), अस्, m. or प्रायोपवेशन, अम्, n. or प्रायोपवेशनिका, f. abstaining from food and awaiting in a sitting posture the approach of death, (this corresponds with the practice prevalent in some parts of India of sitting in Dharnā at the door of a house to extort a boon or gain a point which cannot be accomplished by other means; the person so sitting observes a strict fast till his object is obtained, and if he dies in the process the sin falls on the householder who refuses compliance with his de-mand.) —प्रायोपेत (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, prepared to die, resolved to die (by abstaining from food).
33696: प्रायण, अस्, आ, अम्, going away, going, going well (Ved.); (अम्), n. entrance, beginning, com-mencement; the course or path of life; going for protection, taking refuge; departure from life, death, voluntary death, (प्रायणं कृ, to court death); a kind of food prepared with milk. —प्रायणान्त (°ण-अन्°), अस्, m. the end of life; (अम्), ind. till death, unto death.
33697: प्रायणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the entrance or commencement, introductory, ini-tiatory; (अस्), m., scil. याग or कर्म-विशेष, an introductory libation at a Soma sacrifice; scil. अति-रात्र, the first day of a Soma sacrifice lasting for several days; (अम्), n., scil. अहन्, the first day of a Soma sacrifice lasting for several days.
33698: प्राय-शस्, ind. for the most part, mostly, almost, in all probability, always, commonly, generally, usually; (sometimes wrongly spelt प्राय-सस्।)
33699: प्रायस्, ind. for the most part, mostly; commonly, usually, frequently, oftentimes, generally, nearly; in all probability, most likely, abundantly, largely. —प्रायो-देवता, f. the most usually worshipped deity.
33700: प्रायिक, अस्, आ, अम्, common, usual, general. —प्रायिक-त्व, अम्, n. likelihood, probability; usage, custom.
33701: प्रायत्य प्रायत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-यत), purity, cleanliness.
33703: प्रायाणिक प्रायाणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-याण), necessary for a march, suitable for a journey.
33704: प्रायात्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-यात्रा), = प्रा-याणिक।
33705: प्रायास प्रा-यास, अस्, m., Ved. another form for प्र-यास, q. v.
33707: प्रायुद्धेषिन् प्रायुद्धेषिन्, ई, m. a horse, (probably an incorrect form; also spelt प्रायुधे-षिन्; cf. rt. हेष्, to neigh.)
33708: प्रायुध् प्रा-युध् (प्र-आ-), cl. 4. A. -युध्-यते, -योद्धुम्, to fight.
33709: प्रायेण प्रायेण। See under प्राय, p. 658.
33710: प्रायोग प्रायोग, अस्, m., Ved. perhaps a wrong reading for प्र-योग, q. v.
33711: प्रायोगिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-योग), applied, used, applicable; a kind of sternutatory.
33712: प्रायोज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र-योज्य), belonging or relating to things requisite or necessary.
33713: प्रार् प्रार् (प्र-ऋ), cl. 3. P. प्रेयर्ति, &c., Ved. to go forth, go, move; to set in motion, pro-duce: Caus. प्रार्पयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, stir up, animate.
33714: प्रार्पण, अस्, m., Ved. one who stirs up or animates.
33715: प्रारभ् प्रा-रभ् (प्र-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रभते, -रब्धुम्, to begin, commence, undertake.
33716: प्रा-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, begun, commenced, beginning; (अम्), n. an undertaking.
33717: प्रा-रब्धि, इस्, f. beginning, commencement; the post to which an elephant is fastened.
33718: प्रा-रम्भ, अस्, m. beginning, commencement; an undertaking, enterprise.
33720: प्रारुह् प्रा-रुह् (प्र-आ-), cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to ascend, rise.
33721: प्रारोह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-रोह), one who is used to rise or ascend; (अस्), m. a shoot, sprout, a new branch or leaf (= प्र-रोह).
33722: प्रार्क्षीय प्रार्क्षीय (fr. प्र + ऋक्ष), Nom. P. प्रार्क्षीयति = प्रर्क्षीयति, q. v.
33723: प्रार्च् प्रार्च् (प्र-अर्च्), cl. 1. P. प्रार्चति, प्रार्चितुम्, to praise, celebrate in hymns (Sāy. = स्तुति-रूपाभिर् वाग्भिः पूज्); to honour, worship: Caus. प्रार्चयति, -यितुम्, to praise, honour.
33724: प्रार्ज् प्रार्ज् (प्र-अर्ज्), Caus. P. प्रार्जयति, यितुम्, to cause to acquire; to grant, bestow.
33725: प्रार्जयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who grants or bestows; (used to explain पर्जन्य, Nirukta X. 10.)
33726: प्रार्जुन प्रार्जुन (प्र-अर्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
33727: प्रार्ण प्रार्ण (प्र-ऋण), अम्, n. a chief or principal debt.
33728: प्रार्थ् प्रार्थ् (प्र-अर्थ्), cl. 10. A. (rarely also P. and according to some grammarians regarded as a Nom. fr. अर्थ with प्र), प्रार्थयते (-ति), -यितुम्, to wish for, desire, require, want; to ask for, beg for, pray for, request, solicit, ask any one for anything (with two acc.); to wish or want to do anything (with inf.); to pray, prefer a suit or peti-tion, make a request.
33729: प्रार्थ (प्र-अर्°), अस्, m., Ved. (perhaps) fur-niture, gear, harness, apparatus, equipment.
33730: प्रार्थक, अस्, इका, अम्, wishing for, asking, desiring, soliciting, begging, an asker, solicitor; a suitor, petitioner, candidate; अ-प्रार्थक-वर, a bridegroom who has not been a suitor [cf. Kullūka on Manu III. 27].
33731: प्रार्थन, अम्, आ, n. f. desire, wish; longing desire for; requesting, asking, begging; supplication, suit; prayer, entreaty, request, application, petition (the object may be expressed by the loc., e. g. रुक्-मिण्याम् अस्य प्रार्थना, his petition or suit for Rukmiṇī; or precedes प्रार्थन in a comp., cf. अनुज्ञा-प्°); प्रार्थनया, ind. at the request or petition of (any one). —प्रार्थना-भङ्ग, अस्, m. refusal of a request, asking in vain. —प्रार्थना-भाव (°न-अभ्°), अस्, m. absence of solicitation. —प्रार्थना-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment of a desire, fulfilment of wishes.
33732: प्रार्थनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for; to be asked or begged; to be prayed for; worthy of desire, desirable, proper to be solicited; (अम्), n. the third or Dvāpara age of the world.
33733: प्रार्थयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for, worthy of desire, desirable; असुलभ-प्रार्थयितव्य, one the object of whose desire is difficult of attainment.
33734: प्रार्थयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who wishes for or asks or solicits, an asker, inquirer, solicitor, impor-tuner, beggar; a lover, wooer, suitor.
33735: प्रार्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished for, desired, wished, required, wanted; requested, solicited, asked for, prayed for; killed, hurt; obstructed or opposed by an enemy; attacked. —प्रार्थित-दुर्लभ, अस्, आ, अम्, desired but hard to obtain. —प्रार्थित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has asked or begged; asking, begging.
33736: प्रार्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing, desiring, desirous of, ambitious for; attacking, assailing, assaulting.
33737: प्रार्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for by any one (inst. or gen.); desirable; to be suppli-cated, implored, petitioned, &c.
33738: प्रार्द् प्रार्द् (प्र-अर्द्), Caus. P. प्रार्दयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to exert beyond measure, overwork; to cause to flow away.
33739: प्रार्दक, अस्, इका, अम्, making efforts.
33740: प्रार्ध प्रार्ध (प्र-अर्°) in परि-प्रार्ध, q. v.
33741: प्रार्पण प्रार्पण। See under प्रार्, col. 1.
33742: प्रार्ष् प्रार्ष् (प्र-ऋष्), cl. 1. P. प्रार्षति, प्रार्षितुम्, to flow forth.
33743: प्रार्षभीय प्रार्षभीय (fr. प्र + ऋषभ), Nom. P. प्रार्षभीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रर्षभीय, q. v.
33744: प्रार्ह् प्रार्ह् (प्र-अर्ह्), cl. 1. A. प्रार्हते, प्रार्हितुम्, Ved. to distinguish or signalize one's self.
33745: प्रालम्ब प्रालम्ब, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-लम्ब), hanging down, suspended, pendent; (अस्), m. a kind of pearl ornament; the female breast; a species of gourd; (अम्), n. a garland hanging round the neck and reaching to the breast; [cf. मुक्ता-प्°।]
33746: प्रालम्बक, अम्, n. a garland hanging round the neck and reaching to the breast; (इका), f. a kind of golden necklace.
33747: प्रालेपिक प्रालेपिक, अस्, ई, अम्, an adj. de-rived from प्र-लेपिका।
33748: प्रालेय 1. प्रालेय, अस्, ई (?), अम् (anoma-lously fr. प्र-लय), produced by melting; (अम्), n. (according to some also अस्, m.), hail, snow, frost, hoar-frost (so called as being easily dissolved), dew. —प्रालेय-रश्मि, इस्, or प्रालेयांशु (°य-अं°), उस्, m. the moon (said to have cold or frosty rays). —प्रा-लेय-लेश, अस्, m. a hailstone. —प्रालेय-शैल, अस्, or प्रालेयाद्रि (°य-अद्°), इस्, m. the snowy moun-tain, Hima-vat. —प्रालेयाश्र (°य-अश्°), अम्, n. a cold or chilly tear.
33749: 2. प्रालेय, Nom. P. प्रालेयति, -यितुम्, to re-semble hail.
33750: प्राल्कारीय प्राल्कारीय (fr. प्र + ऌकार), Nom. P. प्राल्कारीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रल्कारीय, q. v.
33751: प्राव् प्राव् (प्र-अव्), cl. 1. P. प्रावति, प्रा-वितुम्, Ved. to attend to, observe; to take interest in, assist, encourage, animate; to protect, defend, (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण रक्ष्, to defend strenuously, to protect exceedingly); to sate, satisfy, content.
33752: प्रावितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a protector, bene-factor, guardian, (Sāy. = रक्षक।)
33753: प्रावित्र, अम्, n., Ved. protection, guardianship.
33754: प्रावी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. attentive, taking care of.
33755: प्रावट प्रावट, अस्, m. barley; [cf. प्र-वट, प्र-वेट।]
33756: प्रावण प्रावण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to Sāy.) a spade, shovel; (either a lengthened form for प्र-वण or a derivative from it.)
33757: प्रावणि प्रावणि, see Ujjvala-datta on Uṇādi-sūtras II. 103.
33758: प्रावन् प्रावन् (fr. rt. 1. प्रा) in क्रतु-प्°, q. v.
33759: प्रावनिज् प्राव-निज् (प्र-अव-), cl. 3. P. A. -नेनेक्ति, -नेनिक्ते, -नेक्तुम्, Ved. to wash away.
33760: प्रावर प्रा-वर। See under प्रा-वृ, p. 660.
33761: प्रावरेय प्रावरेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-vara.
33762: प्रावर्ग प्रावर्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वर्ग), Ved. distinguished, eminent; (Sāy.) pre-eminently a scatterer of enemies (= प्रकर्षेण शत्रूणां वर्जयिता).
33763: प्रावर्तक प्रा-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम् (for प्र-वर्तक), bringing to light, manifesting; stirring up, inciting; founding, a founder.
33764: प्रावर्षिन् प्रा-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. वृष् with प्र), Ved. raining.
33765: प्रावहणि प्रावहणि for प्रावाहणि, q. v.
33767: प्रावास प्रावास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वास), see Gaṇa Vyuṣṭādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 97.
33768: प्रावासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa Guḍādi to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 103, and Gaṇa Santāpādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 101.
33769: प्रावाहणि प्रावाहणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-vāhaṇa; (also wrongly written प्राहणि, प्रावहणि।)
33770: प्रावाहणेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-vāhaṇa.
33771: प्रावाहणेयक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. प्रावाहणेय), = प्रवाहणेयक।
33772: प्रावाहणेयि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Prāvā-haṇeya.
33773: प्रावितृ प्रावितृ। See under प्राव्, p. 659.
33774: प्रावीण्य प्रावीण्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-वीण), cleverness, dexterity, skilfulness, proficiency, accurate knowledge, conversancy, skill.
33775: प्रावृ प्रा-वृ (प्र-आ-), cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम्, to put on, dress one's self in (with acc.).
33776: प्रा-वर, अस्, m. an inclosure, a fence, hedge; [cf. मही-प्°।]
33777: प्रा-वरक, अस्, m., N. of a district (= प्रा-वार).
33778: प्रा-वरण, अम्, n. a covering, cover, an upper or outer garment, cloak, mantle [cf. कर्ण-प्°, कु-प्°]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; चीर-प्रावरण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
33779: प्रावरणीय, अम्, n. a covering, upper garment.
33780: प्रा-वार, अस्, m. an upper or outer garment, cloak, mantle; (अस्), m. = प्रा-वरक, N. of a district; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to, found in outer garments or cloaks. —प्रावार-कर्ण, अस्, m. ‘cloak-eared,’ N. of an owl. —प्रावार-कीट, अस्, m. ‘clothes-insect,’ a large kind of white ant.
33781: प्रा-वारक, अस्, m. an upper or outer garment, cloak.
33782: प्रावारिक, अस्, m. a maker of upper garments or cloaks.
33783: प्रावारीय, Nom. P. प्रावारीयति, -यितुम्, to use as an upper garment or cloak.
33784: प्रा-वुवूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to wear.
33785: प्रा-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, enclosed, encom-passed, screened, sheltered; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a veil, mantle, cloak, wrapper.
33786: प्रा-वृति, इस्, f. an inclosure, fence, hedge; spiritual darkness, one of the four consequences of Māyā.
33787: प्रा-वृत्य, ind. having put on, having dressed one's self in.
33788: प्रावृत्तिक प्रावृत्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वृत्ति), secondary, derived, derivative, (opposed to मुख्य); informed of what is passing, well-informed.
33789: प्रावृष् प्रा-वृष्, ट्, f. (fr. प्र-वृष्), the rainy season, wet season, rains; the months Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa (comprising the first half of the rainy season which lasts in some parts from the middle of June till the middle of October). —प्रावृट्-काल, अस्, m. the period of the rains, rainy season. —प्रा-वृट्काल-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing only in the rainy season; (opposed to सदाकाल-वह।) —प्रा-वृड्-अत्यय, अस्, m. the time following the rainy season, autumn. —प्रावृषि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the rainy season, occurring during the rains.
33790: प्रा-वृष, अस्, आ, m. f. the rainy season, the rains.
33791: प्रावृषायणी, f. (fr. प्रा-वृष्), a kind of weed which grows most luxuriantly during the rains, Bœrhavia Procumbens; Mucuna Pruritus.
33792: प्रावृषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the rainy season, born or produced in the rainy season; (अस्), m. a peacock (as delighting in the rains).
33793: प्रावृषीण, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the rainy season, rainy.
33794: प्रावृषेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the rainy season; coming in showers, abundant, numerous, much; (अस्), m. the Cadamba tree, Nauclea Cadamba [cf. कदम्ब]; Wrightia Anti-dysenterica; (आ), f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus; a species of Punar-navā with red flowers.
33795: प्रावृषेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
33796: प्रावृष्य, अस्, m. a species of Cadamba, Wrightia Antidysenterica; Hedysarum Alhagi; (अम्), n. lapis lazuli.
33797: प्रावेण्य प्रावेण्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-वेणि or प्र-वेणी), a fine woollen covering.
33798: प्रावेप प्रावेप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वेप), Ved. revolving easily, rolling easily, (Sāy. = कम्-पन-शील।)
33799: प्रावेशन प्रावेशन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वे-शन), given on entering, to be done on entering, (see Gaṇa Vyuṣṭādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 97); (अम्), n. a manufactory, workshop.
33800: प्रावेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वेश), relating to entrance (into a house or upon the stage); connected with entry; in the habit of entering; प्रावेशिक्य् आक्षिप्तिका, a particular air or song called Ā-kṣiptikā sung by a person on entering the stage.
33801: प्राव्रज्य प्राव्रज्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-व्रज्या), wandering as a religious mendicant.
33802: प्राव्राज्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-व्राज्), the life of a wandering religious mendicant; vagrancy.
33803: प्राश् 1. प्राश् (प्र-अश्, see rt. 1. अश्), cl. 5. P. A. प्राश्नोति, प्राश्नुते, प्राशितुम्, Ved. to arrive at, reach, (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण व्य्-आप्); to fall to the lot or share of any one (with acc.).
33804: प्राष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived at, attained, gained. —प्राष्ट-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्रिश्नि (Nirukta X. 39).
33805: प्राश् 2. प्राश् (प्र-अश्, see rt. 2. अश्), cl. 9. P. A. प्राश्नाति, प्राश्नीते, प्राशितुम्, to begin to eat, begin eating; to take into the mouth; taste (Manu II. 62); to eat, consume, devour; (A.) to drink; to enjoy, sport with, dally with (with inst.): Pass. प्राश्यते, to be fed: Caus. प्राशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to eat or devour, give to eat, feed.
33806: 3. प्राश्, ट्, f., Ved. food, provisions.
33807: प्राश, अस्, m. eating, consuming, feeding upon, tasting [cf. घृत-प्°, धूम-प्°]; food, victuals [cf. चातुष्प्राश्य]; (occasionally incorrect) for प्रा-स, q. v.
33808: प्राशक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who eats, an eater.
33809: प्राशन, अम्, n. the act of eating, feeding upon, tasting; causing to eat or taste [cf. अन्न-प्°]; feeding (especially applied in Manu II. 29 to the cere-mony of making an infant taste, for the first time, a little honey and clarified butter); food, victuals; अमृत-प्राशन, अस्, m. having nectar for food, feeding on ambrosia, an immortal.
33810: प्राशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, eatable, edible, esculent, serving for food; (अम्), n. food, victuals.
33811: प्राशव्य, आस्, m. pl. (fr. 3. प्राश् or प्राश), Ved. food, provisions; (Sāy.) = साध्व्-अन्नादि, हितम् अन्नादि, good or wholesome food, &c.
33812: प्राशित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken into the mouth, tasted; eaten, devoured, swallowed, well eaten; (अम्), n. an offering of rice or water to the Manes of progenitors, obsequies to deceased ancestors (Manu III. 74, = पितृ-यज्ञाख्यं नित्य-श्राद्धम्).
33813: प्राशितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, eatable, edible, esculent, allowed to be eaten.
33814: प्राशितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who eats, an eater, eating.
33815: प्राशित्र, अम्, n., Ved. the portion of Havis eaten by the Brahman at a sacrifice; the vessel in which the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed; anything edible. —प्राशित्र-हरण, अम्, n., Ved. a vessel in which the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed.
33816: प्राशित्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in अ-प्राशित्रिय, not fit for the Prāśitra.
33817: प्राशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) eating, feeding upon; अमृत-प्राशिन्, ई, m. eating nectar, a god.
33818: प्राश्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, eating, consuming, de-vouring.
33819: 1. प्राश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, eatable, edible.

33837: प्रासन, अम्, n. throwing forth, casting away; throwing, casting; throwing down.

33839: प्रास्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away, thrown off; thrown into, thrown, cast, hurled, discharged; ex-pelled, turned out, banished.
33840: प्रासङ्ग प्रासङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-सङ्ग), a kind of yoke for cattle.

33842: प्रासङ्ग्य, अस्, गी (?), अम्, harnessed with a yoke, yoked; (अस्), m. any animal used for draught, a draught-ox or one yoked.
33843: प्रासच प्रासच, अस्, m., Ved. a sudden and violent shower of rain?; (ई), f. a flood of water produced by sudden and violent showers of rain.

33847: प्रा-साह, अस्, आ, अम्, overpowering, subduing; ज-गत्-प्रासाह, (in which) the Jagatīmetre predominates.
33848: प्रासाद प्रासाद, अस्, m. 33849: प्रासादिक, अस्, आ (?), अम् (fr. प्र-साद), kind, amiable, friendly, favourable; given by way of blessing, given as a favour; beautiful.

33851: 2. प्रासादीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a palace, palatial.
33852: प्रासिक प्रासिक। See under 2. प्रास्, p. 660.

33854: प्रासेनजिती प्रासेनजिती, f. a patronymic from Prasena-jit.
33855: प्रासेव प्रा-सेव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सिव् with प्र), Ved. a rope (forming part of a horse's harness).
33856: प्रास्कण्व प्रास्कण्व, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Pra-skaṇva; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
33857: प्रास्तारिक प्रास्तारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्तार), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 4, 72.
33858: प्रास्ताविक प्रास्ताविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्ताव), forming a commencement or introduction; having a prelude (as a hymn, Ved.); useful on occasion, suiting the subject under treatment; op-portune.
33859: प्रास्तुत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-स्तुत), the being pro-pounded or discussed, the being under discussion.
33860: प्रास्थानिक प्रास्थानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्थान), relating to departure; favourable or auspi-cious to a departure; [cf. महा-प्°।]
33861: प्रास्थिक प्रास्थिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्थ), containing a Prastha, weighing a Prastha, bought for a Prastha; (अम्), n., scil. क्षेत्रम्, a field sown with a Prastha of grain.
33862: प्रास्रवण प्रास्रवण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्रवण), coming or derived from a spring or fountain (as water); (अस्), m. a patronymic from Pra-sravaṇa; प्लक्षः प्रास्रवणः, N. of a place, the source of the Sarasvatī or the spot where the Sarasvatī reappears [cf. सरस्-वती]; (also spelt प्राश्रवण।)

33866: प्राहारिक प्राहारिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-हार), a police officer, constable (?).
33867: प्राहृतायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-hṛta.
33868: प्राहुण प्राहुण, अस्, ई, m. f. a guest (= प्राघुण).
33871: प्राह्ण प्राह्ण (fr. प्र + अह्न), अस्, m. the early part of the day, forenoon, morning; (अम्, ए), ind. in the forenoon, in the morning. —प्राह्णे-तमाम्, ind. very early in the forenoon. —प्राह्णे-तराम्, ind. earlier in the forenoon, very early in the morning.

33873: प्राह्राद प्राह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-ह्राद), a patronymic of Vi-rocana.

33877: प्री 1. प्री, cl. 9. (and 1 ?). P. A. प्रीणाति, प्रीणीते, प्रयति (?), -ते (?), पिप्राय, पि-प्रिये, प्रेष्यति, -ते, अप्रैषीत्, अप्रेष्ट, प्रेतुम् (Vedic forms are प्रीणाहि = प्रीणीहि, पिप्रीहि, अपि-प्रेस्, अपिप्रयत्, पिप्रयस्व), (P.) to please, de-light, gladden, cheer, regale; to act kindly to, show kindness to, show grace or favour to any one (with acc.); to take pleasure in, delight in (with gen. or loc.); to love; (A.) to be pleased or gratified, be glad or cheerful: Pass. प्रीयते (by some regarded as cl. 4. 33915: प्रेत, अस्, आ, अम्, departed, deceased, dead, de-funct, a dead person; (अस्), m. the spirit of a de-parted person, departed spirit, spirit abiding in the lower world, the spirit before obsequial rites are performed; (according to Kullūka = दह्यमान-शव-धूम।) —प्रेत-नदी, f. the river of the dead (= वैतरणी, q. v.). —प्रेत-नर, अस्, m. a dead man, a corpse, a ghost. —प्रेत-निर्यातक or प्रेत-निर्हारक, अस्, m. a man employed to carry forth dead bodies; = पितृ-पक्ष). —प्रेत-पटह, अस्, m. ‘drum of the dead,’ a drum beaten at a funeral. —प्रेत-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord or ruler of the dead,’ an epithet of Yama. —प्रेत-पात्र, अम्, n. ‘vessel of the dead,’ a vessel used in obsequial presentations. —प्रेत-पुर, अम्, n. the city of the dead, the abode of Yama. —प्रेत-प्रसाधन, अम्, n. the laying out of a corpse. —प्रेत-भक्षिणी, f., N. of a goddess. —प्रेत-भाव, अस्, m. the state of the departed, the being dead; 33917: प्रेतिक, अस्, m. the soul of a deceased person, a spirit, ghost.

34110: प्रोल्लाघित प्रोल्-लाघित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लाघ् with प्र-उद्), recovered from sickness, con-valescent, strong, robust.
34111: प्रोल्लिखत् प्रोल्-लिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत् (fr. rt. लिख् with प्र-उद्), making lines or scratches, marking.
34112: प्रोल्-लेखन, अम्, n. drawing marks or lines, scratching, marking.
34113: प्रोष प्रोष। See rt. 1. प्रुष्, p. 663.
34114: प्रोषक प्रोषक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people (Mahā-bh. Bhīṣma-p. 376).
34115: प्रोषित प्रोषित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 6. वस् with प्र), sojourning abroad or in a foreign country, away from home, absent, abroad. —प्रोषित-त्रास, अस्, m. fear of one who is absent. —प्रोषित-भर्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, whose husband is abroad. —प्रोषित-मरण, अम्, n. dying abroad or in a foreign country. —प्रोषित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sojourn-ing away from home, strange, a stranger.
34116: प्रोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moving to distant places, flowing onwards (as water; perhaps connected with rt. 1. प्रुष्). —प्रोष्य-पापीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, become worse by sojourning in a foreign country, deteriorated by living abroad.
34117: प्रोष्ठ प्रोष्ठ, अस्, m. (perhaps a contrac-tion for a form प्राव-स्थ fr. rt. स्था with प्र-अव), a bench, stool; a bull, an ox; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अस्, ई), m. f. a sort of carp, Cyprinus Pausius (= शफरी). —प्रोष्ठ-पद, अस्, आ, m. f. (also ए, f. du., आस्, pl.), ‘the foot of a stool,’ N. of a double Nakṣatra or of the third and fourth lunar mansions, the month Bhādra or August-September; (also called पूर्व-भाद्रपदा and उत्तर-भाद्रपदा; cf. नक्षत्र, भाद्र-पदा।) —प्रोष्ठ-पाद, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose feet rest on a bench; born under the Nakṣatra Proṣṭha-padā. —प्रोष्ठे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sleeping on a couch; (Sāy.) = प्राङ्गणे शयानः, sleeping or lying in a court-yard.
34118: प्रोष्ठिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
34119: प्रोष्ण प्रोष्ण (प्र-उष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ex-ceedingly hot, burning hot, scorching.
34120: प्रोष्य प्रोष्य। See under प्रोषित above.
34121: प्रोह् प्रोह् (प्र-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. प्रोहति, प्रोहितुम्, Ved. to push forward, push away, (according to Mahī-dhara = निर्-आकृ); to throw down; (प्रोहति = पातयति।)
34122: 1. प्रोह in प्रोह-करटा, f. (प्रोह, 2nd sing. Impv. of प्रोह्), a various reading for प्रेहि-कटा, q. v. —प्रोह-कर्दमा, f. a ceremony at which impurity is cleared away (see Gaṇa Mayūra-vyaṃsa-kādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 72).
34123: प्रोहण, अम्, n. the act of pushing away (?).
34124: प्रोह्य-पदि, ind. (perhaps) by or in pushing away the foot (Gaṇa Dvidaṇḍy-ādi to Pāṇ. V. 4, 128).
34125: प्रोह 2. प्रोह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with प्र), logical reasoning; an elephant's foot; the ankle of an elephant; a joint, a knot; (अस्, आ, अम्), skilful, clever; reasoning logically, a reasoner, disputant.
34126: प्रोहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reasoned or argued.
34127: प्रौह, अस्, ई, अम्, clever, skilful; (अस्), m. con-sideration, reflection; a good argument; the foot of an elephant; a joint.
34128: प्रौक्त प्रौक्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रोक्त), having the sense of ‘proclaimed by’ (said of a suffix).
34129: प्रौघीय प्रौघीय (fr. प्र + ओघ), Nom. P. प्रौघीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रोघीय, see Vopa-deva II. 4.
34130: प्रौढ प्रौढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वह् with प्र), grown up, full-grown, fully developed, matured, perfected; mature, adult, old; married; luxuriant (as a plant); great, grand, mighty, strong; impulsive, impetuous, violent; thick, dense (as darkness); full (as the moon); filled with, full of, (at the end of comps.; cf. मृदु-प्°); confident, bold, arrogant, audacious, impudent; forward; raised up, lifted up; controverted; an epithet of one of the seven Ullāsas in the Kulārṇava-tantra; (in music) an epithet of one of the seven Rūpakas; प्रौढम् ब्राह्म-णम्, the great Brāhmaṇa; (आ), f. a married woman from thirty to fifty-five years of age; a violent or impetuous woman (described as a Nāyikā who stands in no awe of her lover or husband). —प्रौ-ढ-चरित-नामन्, आनि, n. pl., N. of a work by Vallabha Ācārya on the titles of Kṛṣṇa derived from one hundred and twenty-eight of his exploits during adolescence. —प्रौढ-त्व, अम्, n. confi-dence, arrogance. —प्रौढ-पाद, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose feet are raised on a bench; [cf. प्रोष्ठ-पाद।] —प्रौढ-पुष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having blossoms full-grown (as a tree). —प्रौढ-प्रताप, अस्, आ, अम्, of mighty prowess, renowned in arms. —प्रौ-ढप्रताप-मार्तण्ड, N. of a work attributed to Pratāpa-rudra Gaja-pati on the appropriate seasons for the worship of Viṣṇu. —प्रौढ-प्रिया, f. a bold or confident mistress; (according to Malli-nātha = प्रगल्भ-कान्ता।) —प्रौढ-मनोरमा, f., N. of a commentary by Bhaṭṭoji-dīkṣita on his own work the Siddhānta-Kaumudī. —प्रौढ-यौवन, अस्, आ, अम्, in the prime or bloom of youth. —प्रौ-ढ-वाद, अस्, m. an arrogant expression. —प्रौ-ढाङ्गना (°ढ-अङ्°), f. a bold or impulsive woman. —प्रौढान्त (°ढ-अन्°), N. of one of the seven Ullāsas in the Kulārṇava-tantra. —प्रौ-ढोक्ति (°ढ-उक्°), इस्, f. a bold expression or speech.
34131: प्रौढि, इस्, f. growth, increase; maturity, per-fect state (of body or mind); full development, elevation, greatness, grandeur; sense of power, self-confidence, feeling of security, arrogance; audacity, boldness; zeal, enterprise, exertion; investigation, controversy, discussion. —प्रौढि-वाद, अस्, m. a bold assertion, confident affirmation; a pompous speech.
34132: प्रौढी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to grow up, increase, come to maturity. —प्रौढी-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, growing up, coming to matu-rity. —प्रौढी-भविष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to arrive at maturity.
34133: प्रौण प्रौण, अस्, आ, अम्, clever, learned, skilful; [cf. प्रौह, प्रोह।]
34134: प्रौष्ठ प्रौष्ठ, अस्, m. a patronymic from Proṣṭha.
34135: प्रौष्ठपद, अस्, m. (fr. प्रोष्ठ-पद), scil. मास, the month Bhādra (August-September); N. of one of Kuvera's treasure-keepers; N. of a Pari-śiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda; (ई), f., scil. पौर्ण-मासी, full moon in the month Bhādra.
34136: प्रौष्ठपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रोष्ठ-पदा), see Pāṇ. IV. 2, 35.
34137: प्रौष्ठिक, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prosh-ṭhika.
34138: प्रौह प्रौह। See under 2. प्रोह, col. 2.
34139: प्लक प्लक, अस्, m., Ved. in कश-प्लकौ, pudenda muliebria.
34140: प्लक्ष् प्लक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A. प्लक्षति, -ते, &c., to eat, consume; (a various reading for भक्ष्।)
34141: प्लक्ष प्लक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. प्लुष्, to burn), the waved-leaf fig-tree or Ficus Infec-toria (a large and beautiful tree with small white fruit); the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa; the tree Hibiscus Populneoides, Thespesia Populneoides; a side door, private or back door; the space at the side of a door; one of the seven Dvīpas or continents into which the world is divided; N. of a man; (आ), f. a N. of the river Sarasvatī. —प्लक्ष-जाता, f. ‘rising near the fig-tree,’ an epithet of the Sarasvatī. —प्लक्ष-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pil-grimage. —प्लक्ष-प्रस्रवण, अम्, n. ‘the fig-tree source,’ N. of the place where the Sarasvatī takes its rise. —प्लक्ष-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the fig-trees,’ N. of the place where the Sarasvatī becomes visible. —प्लक्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, surrounded by fig-trees (Ficus Infectoria); (अती), f., N. of a river (perhaps the Sarasvatī). —प्लक्ष-समुद्र-वा-चका, f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī. —प्लक्ष-स्रवण, अम्, n., N. of the place where the Saras-vatī becomes visible; [cf. प्लक्ष-प्रस्रवण।] —प्लक्षावतरण (°ष-अव्°), अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
34142: प्लक्षकीय, see Gaṇa Naḍādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 91.
34143: प्लाक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the waved-leaf fig-tree (Ficus Infectoria); (अम्), n. the fruit of the waved-leaf fig-tree and of the various trees called Plaksha; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Plākṣi.
34144: प्लाक्षकि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Plaksha.
34145: प्लाक्षायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Plākṣi.
34146: प्लाक्षि, इस्, ई, m. f. a patronymic from Plaksha.
34147: प्लति प्लति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
34148: प्लात, अस्, m. a patronymic from Plati.
34149: प्लब् प्लब् or प्लव्, cl. 1. A. प्लबते, प्ल-वते, &c., to float, = rt. प्लु, q. v.
34150: प्लयोग प्लयोग (= प्र-योग?), अस्, m., N. of a man.
34151: प्लायोगि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Āsaṅga.
34154: प्लाय प्लाय। See under प्ले, col. 3.
34156: प्लाशि प्लाशि, इस्, m., Ved. a particular part of the intestines; (according to Mahī-dhara = शिश्न or शिश्न-मूल-नाड्यः।)
34157: प्लाशुक प्लाशुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्लाशु = प्राशु), Ved. growing rapidly; (according to the Scholiasts) growing again, springing up again.
34158: प्लाशुचित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. quick, speedy; [cf. प्राशु।]
34159: प्लिह् प्लिह्, cl. 1. A. प्लेहते, पिप्लिहे, प्ले-हितुम्, to go, move.
34161: प्लीहन्, आ, m. the spleen (which with the liver is regarded by the Hindūs as the part of the body from which the blood flows); disease of the spleen (said to be equally applied to enlargement of the mesenteric glands, &c.); [cf. Gr. σπλήν, σπλάγχ-νο-ν; Lat. lien; Bohem. slez-ina; Lith. bluz-ni-s; Eng. spleen.] —प्लीह-घ्न, अस्, or प्लीह-शत्रु, उस्, m. ‘destroying spleen’ or ‘enemy to spleen,’ N. of a medicinal plant, Amoora Rohitaka (commonly Rohera or Rohinī). —प्लीहा-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) suffering from a particular disease of the ear called प्लीहन्. —प्लीहारि (°ह-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy to spleen,’ the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa. —प्लीहोदर (°ह-उद्°), अम्, n. enlargement of the spleen, disease of the spleen. —प्लीहोदरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, affected with enlargement or disease of the spleen, splenetic.
34163: प्ली प्ली, cl. 9. P. प्लिनाति, &c., to go, move.
34164: प्लु प्लु, cl. 1. A. (in poetry sometimes also P.) प्लवते (-ति), पुप्लुवे, प्लोष्यते, अप्लोष्ट (2nd pl. अप्लोढ्वम्), प्लोषीष्ट, प्लो-तुम्, to float, swim; to go in a boat, cross in a boat, navigate; to bathe; to sway to and fro, vibrate, hover, soar, fly; to fly away, haste away; to blow (as the wind); to fade away, disappear; to leap, jump, spring, (in these senses originally प्रु); to hop, skip, dance; to spring over, jump over, leap across, spring upon, spring down; to be length-ened or prolated (as a vowel): Caus. P. प्लावयति, यितुम्, Aor. अपुप्लवत्, अपिप्लवत्, to cause to float or swim, flood, deluge, inundate, submerge; to pour water upon, sprinkle, bathe, wash; to wash away, remove; to cause to leap; to cause to stagger; to lengthen, prolate (a vowel): Pass. of Caus. प्लाव्-यते, to be deluged, to be overflowed, to be inun-dated: Desid. of Caus. पिप्लावयिषति, पुप्लावयि-षति: Desid. पुप्लूषते: Intens. पोप्लूयते, पोप्लोति, to float about, swim about; to swim rapidly; [cf. Gr. πλέ-ω, πλεύ-σομαι, πλό-ο-ς, πλω-τό-ς, πλώ-τη-ς, πλύν-ω, πλῦ-μα, πλυ-τό-ς, πλυν-τήρ, πύελος; perhaps λού-ω for πλού-ω: Lat. plu-i-t, pluv-ia, flu-o, fle-o, plôra-re, linter; perhaps fund-o for plund-o; perhaps pluma; probably lav-o for plav-o: Old Lat. per-plov-ere: Umbr. pre-plo-tutu, ‘overflowed:’ Goth. flô-du-s, ‘a river:’ Old Germ. flew-iu, ‘float;’ fliu-z-u, ‘flow;’ fluz, perhaps flug: Angl. Sax. fleot, fleowan, flod, fleogan, fliogan, fleón, flión, aet-flowan, fleotan; Iceland. flut: Old Slav. plov-a, plou-ti, ‘to sail;’ plu-ti, ‘to swim:’ Russ. plavaju, ‘I swim:’ Lith. pláu-j-u, plau-ti, ‘to wash off;’ plaú-t-is; plú-sti, ‘to swim:’ Hib. plod, ‘a fleet;’ plodaim, ‘I float;’ perhaps lua = Gaelic lu, ‘water;’ luathaim, ‘I hasten, I move;’ falcaim, ‘I bathe;’ luan, ‘a woman's breast:’ Gaelic plucas, ‘a flux, ventris fluxio.’]
34165: प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, swimming, floating; leaping, jumping, one who goes by leaps or jumps, a tumbler; superior, excellent (Ved.); (अस्), m. the act of swimming, floating, diving, bathing [cf. जल-प्°, धरणी-प्°]; flooding, a flood, the swelling of a river; suffusion, (नयन-प्°, suffusion or swimming of the eyes); jumping, leaping, plunging, going by leaps or plunges; a float, raft, boat, canoe, small ship; a snare or basket of wicker-work for catching fish (= पलव); a kind of aquatic bird, Pelicanus Fusicollis (= गात्र-सम्प्लव); a kind of duck (= कारण्डव); = जल-वायस; = जल-काक; = जल-कुक्कुट; a frog; a monkey; a sheep; a man of low or degraded tribe, a Cāṇḍāla; an enemy; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria (= प्लक्ष); a kind of weapon; the thirty-fifth (or ninth) year in a cycle of Jupiter; N. of various Sāmans; the prolated utterance of a vowel; protracting a sentence through three or more Ślokas (= कुलक); a kind of metre; a declivity, slope, shelving ground; proclivity, incli-nation; returning, return; urging on, inciting; (अम्), n. a species of grass, Cyperus Rotundus; a kind of fragrant grass (= गन्ध-तृण); [cf. Gr. πλόος, πλοῖον; Hib. falc, ‘a flood.’] —प्लव-ग, अस्, m. ‘going by leaps,’ a frog; an ape, monkey; a sort of aquatic bird, the diver; the plant Acacia Sirissa (= शिरीष); N. of the charioteer of the Sun; of a son of the Sun; (आ), f. the sign of the zodiac Virgo. —प्लव-गति, इस्, f. going by leaps and jumps; (इस्), m. a frog. —प्लवङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘going by leaps,’ an epithet of fire as flickering; (अस्), m. an ape, baboon, monkey; a deer; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria; N. of the forty-first (or fifteenth) year in a sixty years' cycle of Jupiter. —प्लवङ्-गम, अस्, m. ‘going by leaps,’ a frog; an ape, monkey; (आ), f. a kind of metre. —प्लवङ्-गमेन्दु (°म-इन्°), उस्, m. ‘moon among the apes,’ an epithet of Hanumat. —प्लव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing a ship, owner of a boat.
34166: प्लवक, अस्, m. a frog; a tumbler, a dancer, a man who walks on the edge of a sword, a rope-dancer, &c.; an outcast, a Cāṇḍāla; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria.
34167: प्लवन, अम्, n. swimming, plunging into, bathing; a deluge, inundation; jumping, leaping, plunging; capering, one of a horse's paces; flying; declivity, inclination; (अस्, आ, अम्), inclined, stooping down, (at the end of comps.; cf. प्राग्-उदक्-प्°।)
34168: प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, floating, swimming; going in a boat, crossing in a boat; bathing; hover-ing, soaring; blowing (as the wind); fading away, disappearing; leaping, springing, bounding.
34169: प्लवाका, f. a boat, a raft.
34170: प्लविक, अस्, आ, अम्, ferrying over in a boat, a ferryman.
34171: प्लवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, leaping, springing, a leaper.
34172: प्लाव, अस्, m. flowing over; filling a vessel till it overflows; submersion; jumping.
34173: प्लावन, अम्, n. bathing, immersion, ablution; filling a vessel till it overflows, flooding, deluging; inundation, flood, deluge; [cf. जल-प्°।]
34174: प्लावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to float, flooding, inundating.
34175: प्लावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes to swim, causing to cross or go in a boat.
34176: प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to float, made to swim; made to overflow; overflowed, deluged, inundated, flooded; moistened, soaked; covered with; [cf. रुधिर-प्°।]
34177: प्लाविन्, ई, m. spreading, promulgating; (ई), m. a bird.
34178: 1. प्लाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be submerged or inun-dated; to be steeped or soaked in anything (with inst.); to be jumped or leaped.
34179: 2. प्लाव्य, ind. having caused to float or swim; having immersed or flooded; having washed away.
34180: प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, floated, floating or swimming in [cf. उद-प्°]; bathed in; inundated, submerged, overflowed, wet; covered with, filled with [cf. म-धु-प्°, रजः-प्°]; flown; jumped, leaped, one who has leaped, gone by leaps or jumps; protracted, prolated, continuous or lengthened to three Mātrās or prosodial instants (as a vowel in pronunciation, cf. मात्रा); (अम्), n. leaping, jumping, tumbling; bounding, vaulting; capering, one of a horse's paces. —प्लुत-गति, इस्, f. going by jumps or leaps; a bounding motion, galloping, a gallop; (इस्), m. a hare.
34181: प्लुतवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has leaped or jumped.
34182: प्लुति, इस्, f. overflowing, a flood; a leap, jump, skip, hop; bounding, capering, curvet, one of a horse's paces; prolation (of a vowel).
34183: प्लुष् प्लुष् [cf. rt. 1. प्रुष्], cl. 1. 4. 9. P. प्लोषति, प्लुष्यति, प्लुष्णाति, पुप्लो-ष, प्लोषितुम्, to burn, scorch, singe; cl. 9. P. to sprinkle; to anoint, embrocate; to fill.
34184: प्लुक्षि, इस्, m. fire; the god of fire (?); the burning of a house; oil.
34186: प्लुषि, इस्, m., Ved. a species of noxious insect; (according to Mahī-dhara = पुत्तिका; according to another Scholiast = वक्र-तुण्ड।)
34187: प्लुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burned, scorched, singed.

34294: फाण्टक, अस्, m. an infusion, decoction (= फाण्ट).
34295: फाण्ड, अम्, n. the belly (= फण्ड).
34296: फाण्डिन्, ई, m., N. of a serpent-demon.
34298: फारिव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) = आयुध-वत्।
34300: फालखेला फालखेला, f. a quail; (also read फणिखेल, फलखेल or फलखेला।)

34315: फुप्फु फुप्फु, ind. an onomatopoetic word. —फुप्फु-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, panting, gasping.

34317: फुम्फुआ फुम्फुआ, ind. imitation of the sound made by the crackling of fire.
34318: फुलिङ्ग फुलिङ्ग, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), syphilis; [cf. फिरङ्ग।]

34322: फुल्लरीक फुल्लरीक, अस्, m. a district, place; a snake, serpent.

34324: फेञ्चक फेञ्चक, अस्, m. a kind of bird.

34327: फेण्ट फेण्ट, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
34328: फेत् फेत्, ind. an onomatopoetic word. —फेत्-कार, अस्, m. howling (of the wind or of animals). —फेत्-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, howling; (इणी), f., N. of a Tantra. —फेत्कारीय, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —फेत्-कृत, अम्, n. howling, a howl.
34329: फेन फेन or फेण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. फे, substituted for rt. स्फाय्, Uṇādi-s. III. 3; by some derived fr. rt. फण्), foam, froth, spume; scum [cf. दुग्ध-फ्°, पयः-फेनी]; foam of the mouth, moisture of the lips, saliva [cf. वृषली-फेन-पीत, फणि-फ्°]; (अस्), m. white cuttle-fish bone, os sepiæ, supposed to be indurated foam of the sea [cf. अब्धि-कफ, अब्धि-फ्°, समुद्र-फ्°]; N. of a son of Ushad-ratha and father of Su-tapas; (आ), f. a species of shrub, = सातला; (ई), f. a kind of food; [cf. Lat. spūma; Angl. Sax. fam, fœman; Slav. pêna, ‘foam.’] —फेन-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain near the mouth of the Indus; (also written फेण-गिरि।) —फेन-ता, f. frothiness, vapour. —फेन-दुग्धा, f. a kind of small shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी). —फे-न-प, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘froth-drinking, foam-quaffing,’ feeding on foam; (according to a Scholiast = स्वयम् पतितैः फलादिभिर् जीवन्; also spelt फेण-प।) —फेन-पिण्ड, अस्, m. ‘a mass of foam,’ a mere bubble, any mere fancy, empty idea, nonentity, nonsense. —फेन-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, foam-like, resembling foam. —फेन-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dis-charging frothy urine. —फेन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, frothy, foaming, bubbling. —फेन-वाहिन्, ई, m. ‘carrying off the scum,’ a filtering cloth; ‘foam-bearing,’ (perhaps) the thunderbolt of Indra (Indra having used the foam of the sea for his thunderbolt to kill the demon Vṛtra); (perhaps rather) an epi-thet of Indra; [cf. फेनाशनि।] —फेनाग्र (°न-अग्°), अम्, n. ‘surface of foam,’ a bubble on the water. —फेनाशनि (°न-अश्°), इस्, m. ‘having foam for a thunderbolt,’ an epithet of Indra. —फेनाहार (°न-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, living on foam, feeding on froth. —फेनोपम (°न-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, foam-like, resembling foam (said of life).
34330: फेनक, अस्, m. white cuttle-fish bone, os sepiæ; (अस्, आ), m. f. a kind of pastry; ground rice boiled in water; the soap-berry?; (इका), f. a kind of pre-pared food; froth.
34331: फेनल, अस्, आ, अम्, frothy, foamy; [cf. फेनिल।]

34354: बकुर बकुर, अस्, m., Ved. (according to native authorities), a thunderbolt, lightning, anything shining; perhaps ‘a horn, trumpet, or other wind instrument used in battle;’ [cf. बाकुर, बेकुरा।]
34355: बगदाद बगदाद, N. of a city, Bagdad.

34359: बङ्गाल, अस्, m. (?), N. of the country Bengal.

34361: बट् बट्, ind. (perhaps connected with वाढम्, q. v.), Ved. (a particle of affirmation), in truth, certainly (Sāy. = सत्यम्); [cf. Zend bāṭ, bā.]
34362: बठ् बठ् = rt. वठ्, q. v.
34363: बडपिला बडपिला, f., N. of a village.

34365: बडा बडा or बऌआ, ind., Ved. = बट्, q. v.
34366: बडाह बडाह, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
34367: बण् बण् = rt. वण्, q. v.

34369: बणिज्य, अम्, आ, n. f. (for बाणिज्य), trade, traffic.

34386: बध्योग बध्योग, अस्, m., N. of a man.

34389: बन्दिआरयु बन्दिआरयु, N. of a place men-tioned in the Romaka-siddhānta.
34390: बन्ध् बन्ध् [cf. rt. बुन्ध्], cl. 9. P. (ep. also A.) बध्नाति (बध्नीते), Impv. 2nd sing. बधान, बबन्ध (Ved. 3rd pl. बेधुस्, 2nd sing. A. बेधिषे), भन्त्स्यति (ep. also बन्-धिष्यति, -ते), अभान्त्सीत्, बन्द्धुम् (ep. also बन्-धितुम्), to bind, tie, fix, fasten; to chain, enchain, fetter; to fasten or tie round, bind round, put on (e. g. चीरम् बध्नन्ति मुनयः, the ascetics put on clothing made of strips of bark); (A.) to bind on one's self, put on; to ensnare; to catch (e. g. मत्-स्यान् बन्ध्, to catch fish), take captive, take prisoner; to shut up, confine, imprison; to inflict punishment, punish, chastise; to bind a sacrificial victim, offer, sacrifice (with dat. of the deity to whom the victim is presented, Ved.); to fix, direct, fasten (the eyes or mind) upon (with loc.); to shut, close, stop, stop up, preclude; to arrest, hold back, check, suppress; to overpower, oppress, violate; to bind together, put together, fasten together, join, com-bine, connect, conglomerate, unite; to construct, build; to construct verses, compose; to bring to pass, effect, produce, evoke, result in, be followed by (with acc.); to form fruit (as a plant), to set; to strike (root); to take up (an abode); to manifest, exhibit, evince, display, show (e. g. धृतिम् ब-धान, show thy resolution); to entertain, cherish, foster, possess, have, contract, form; अञ्जलिम् बन्ध्, to place the two hands hollowed side by side; मुष्टिम् बन्ध्, to clench the fist; सेतुम् बन्ध्, to construct a dam, build a bridge, (बन्धिष्ये सेतुना गङ्गाम्, I will span the Gaṅgā with a bridge); गोलम् बन्ध्, to form or construct a globe; भ्रु-कुटिम् बन्ध्, to knit the brows, frown; सौहृद्यम् or सख्यम् or अजर्यम् बन्ध् to contract friendship; वैरम् बन्ध्, to contract enmity: Pass. बध्यते, Aor. अबधि (?), to be bound; to bind on one's self, put on: Caus. बन्-धयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबबन्धत्, to cause to bind, cause to be bound; to order to be imprisoned; to cause to be joined together or constructed, cause to be built, cause to be embanked; (according to the Dhātu-pāṭha) to bind, (in this last sense also बाधयति): Desid. बिभत्सति, to wish to bind: Intens. बाबध्यते, बाबन्द्धि, to bind fast, tie firmly; [cf. Zend band, banda, baś-ta, ‘bound;’ Gr. πείθω, πεῖσ-μα for πενθ-μα, πενθερός; Lat. pat-ibulum, pendo, pendeo, fī-lum for fid-lum, fū-nis for fud-nis, fīd-es, fīd-o for feido = πείθω, fœd-us; Slav. vjazati, ‘to bind;’ Goth. bind-an, fastan; Old Germ. fasti; Angl. Sax. bindan, bonda, bœnd, bœst, fœst; Iceland. fas-t.]
34391: बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound, tied, fixed, fastened; chained, enchained, fettered; fastened or tied round, bound on, put on, girt on, dressed; caught, captured, confined, imprisoned; shut, stopped, closed, pre-cluded; arrested, held back, checked, restrained, suppressed, withheld; joined, connected, combined, united; formed, constructed, built, embanked; inlaid, studded [cf. रीति-ब्°, लोह-ब्°]; composed (as verses); effected, produced; directed towards; formed, set (as fruit); struck (as a root); firmly rooted, firm; placed side by side (as the hollowed hands); clenched (as the fist); knit (as the brows); contracted (as friend-ship or enmity); 34404: बन्ध, अस्, m. binding, tying, a bond, tie, chain, fetter, knot, halter, tether [cf. पाद-ब्°]; a ligature, bandage; laying snares; catching, capturing, capture; binding in fetters, fettering, confining, imprisoning, confinement, imprisonment, custody [cf. राज-ब्°]; fixing, directing (the mind towards anything); bind-ing together, joining, uniting [cf. पाणि-ब्°]; joining the hollowed hands; forming, constructing, construc-tion, building, erecting (e. g. सेतोर् बन्धः, the construction of an embankment or bridge; cf. सेतु-ब्°); embanking, an embankment, throwing a bridge across (a river); contracting or knitting the brows [cf. भ्रुकुटि-ब्°]; joining the hands or feet in particular positions, any posture or position of the limbs or body generally, a position, posture (e. g. आसन-ब्°, a sitting posture); a particular position of the hands and feet [cf. महा-ब्°, मूल-ब्°]; a par-ticular position in coitus; connection, intercourse, society; agreement, union; manifestation, exhibition, display [cf. राग-ब्°]; consequence, result (e. g. अरिष्ट-ब्°, having welfare as a consequence, causing welfare); a sinew, tendon; a pledge, deposit, (per-haps rather) pledging [cf. बन्धक]; that with which anything is bound together or bordered, border, framework, inclosure; (in philosophy) bon-dage, (opposed to मुक्ति, मोक्ष, and regarded in the Sāṅkhya system as threefold, viz. प्रकृति-ब्°, वैकारिक-ब्°, दक्षिणा-ब्°; cf. कर्म-ब्°, दक्-षिणा-ब्°); (in rhetoric) combination of sounds, con-struction of words; a disease in which the eyelids cannot be wholly closed; (in comp. with numerals) a part [cf. दश-ब्°, पञ्च-ब्°; cf. also Lat. pondus; Lith. bandà, ‘a herd of cattle;’ Angl. 34412: बन्धु, उस्, m. connection, conjunction, relation-ship, association; relation, reference, respect (e. g. केन बन्धुना, in what respect ?); one who is connected with or belongs to (any profession or tribe, especially if only nominally so connected; cf. क्ष-त्र-ब्°, द्विज-ब्°, ब्रह्म-ब्°); a kinsman, relation, relative, connection, kindred in general [cf. मातृ-ब्°]; (in law) a cognate kinsman in a remote degree, one subsequent in right of inheritance to the Sa-gotra, (three kinds of these are enumerated, personal, pater-nal, and maternal: the first are sons of the deceased father's sister, of his mother's sister, and of his ma-ternal uncle: the second are the sons of his father's paternal aunt, of his father's maternal aunt, and of his father's maternal uncle: the third are the sons of his mother's paternal aunt, of his mother's ma-ternal aunt, and of his mother's maternal uncle); a friend [cf. अ-ब्°, अमृत-ब्°, ऋषि-ब्°]; a husband; a brother; N. of a flower (= बन्धूक); N. of a metre; (in astron.) Hib. badh, ‘love, friendship.’] —बन्धु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, loving relations, affectionate towards relations and friends. —बन्धु-कृत्य, अम्, n. the duty of a kinsman or of a friend, a friendly office, friendly service. —बन्धु-क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. dwelling among rela-tions; (Sāy.) having the quality or condition of kin-dred; (according to some this word may be the N. of a person or family.) —बन्धु-जन, अस्, m. a kinsman, relation, friend; kinsfolk, relations. —बन्-धु-जीव or बन्धु-जीवक, अस्, m. ‘living in associ-ation or groups,’ Pentapetes Phœnicea, (a plant with a red flower which opens at midday and withers away the next morning at sunrise); (अम्), n. its flower; (कस्), m., N. of a Cakra-vartin. —बन्धुजीव-पुष्प, अम्, n. the flower of Pentapetes Phœnicea. —बन्धुजीवाभि-ताम्र (°व-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deep red like the blossom of Pentapetes Phœnicea. —बन्धु-ता, f. relations collectively, kindred, kin (= बन्धूनां समूहः); 34417: बन्धुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, inclined, depressed.

34505: बलि बलि, इस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 2. बल्), tax, impost, tribute, royal revenue; an oblation, a gift or religious offering in general; the offering of a portion of the daily meal of ghee, grain, rice &c. to all creatures of every description, i. e. to gods, semi-divine beings, men, animals, and even trees &c., inanimate objects, but especially to those beings called गृह-देवताः or ‘household spirits,’ which were supposed to hover round and protect households, (this बलि, also called भूत-यज्ञ, q. v., was one of the five great sacrifices or religious rites, some-times called ‘sacraments,’ which Manu enjoins on every householder; cf. ब्रह्म-यज्ञ, देव-यज्ञ, पितृ-यज्ञ, मनुष्य-यज्ञ: it was performed by throwing up into the air, generally at the door of the house, the remains of the morning and evening meal, uttering at the same time a Mantra or prayer to some of the inferior deities, either to Indra and the Maruts or to Kuvera and his followers, the Guhyakas &c., or to the spirits of trees, waters &c.; the real consumers of the offering being the birds, dogs, insects &c. in the neighbourhood of the house; see Manu III. 67, 91, IV. 21); any oblation or act of worship not being a real sacrifice; fragments of food left at an oblation or a meal; a victim, any victim offered to Durgā; the handle of a chowrie or fly-flapper; three folds of skin at the end of the rectum; N. of a celebrated Daitya, a son of Virocana, and also called Mahā-bali, (he was the sovereign of Mahābali-pura, and so extended his empire as to acquire dominion over the three worlds; having omitted however in his arrogance to make the usual offerings to the deities, Viṣṇu resolved to mortify his pride, and assumed the form of a Vāmana or dwarf, as the son of Kaśyapa and Aditi and younger brother of Indra, in which shape he appeared before Bali and asked as much land as he could pace in three steps; this Bali granted, and Viṣṇu expanding himself deprived him in two steps of heaven and earth, but in consideration of his virtues left Pātāla or the lower regions still in his dominion; cf. त्रि-विक्रम); N. of Indra in the eighth Manv-antara; N. of a Muni; of a king; of a son of Su-tapas; (इस्, ई), f. a wrinkle, skin shrivelled by old age; the fold of skin in stout persons (especially females) upon the upper part of the belly or between the ensiform cartilage and the navel; 34582: बाधक, अस्, इका, अम्, oppressing, harassing, paining [cf. शत्रु-ब्°]; one who hinders or opposes, a hinderer; suspending, setting aside (as a rule in grammar); invalidating, annulling, neutralizing; (अस्), m. a particular disease of women; a species of tree (= गिरि-माल, राज-वृक्ष); (अस्, ई, अम्), be-longing to or derived from the preceding tree. —बाधक-ता, f. or बाधक-त्व, अम्, n. the being a hinderer, hinderance.
34583: बाधन, अस्, ई, अम्, pressing hard, harassing, opposing; refuting; (आ), f. uneasiness, uncomfort-ableness, trouble, pain; (अम्), n. oppression, the act of harassing, annoying, paining, pain; opposing, hindering; precluding; suspending, removing, setting aside (a rule), annulling, abolishing; refutation.
34584: बाधमान, अस्, आ, अम्, oppressing, harassing, paining, annoying.
34585: बाधित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed hard, oppressed, harassed, pained, tormented; resisted, opposed, ob-structed, hindered, impeded, thwarted, checked; self-refuted, refuted; set aside, suspended (as a rule), abolished; (in logic) contradictory, absurd, false, in-compatible. —बाधित-त्व, अम्, n. the being sus-pended or set aside (as a rule), suspension, abolition; the state of being refuted or contradicted.
34586: बाधितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pressed hard, to be harassed or annoyed, to be pained; to be suspended or set aside, to be annulled; to be removed.

34589: बाध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pressed hard or harassed or distressed, to be pained [cf. स्त्री-ब्°]; one who is harassed or pained; to be hindered or resisted, to be objected to or opposed, objectionable, exceptionable; to be suspended or annulled; preventable; suppressed, obstructed. —बाध्य-बाधक-ता, f. the condition of oppressed and oppressor. —बाध्य-रेतस्, आस्, m. one whose generative power is obstructed, impotent.
34590: बाध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pressed hard or oppressed, being harassed or beset, being tormented. —बाध्यमान-त्व, अम्, n. the being suspended or set aside, suspension, annulment.
34591: बाधिरक बाधिरक (fr. बधिर), see Gaṇa Arīhaṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
34592: बाधिरिक, अस्, m. a metronymic from Badhirikā.
34594: बाध्योग बाध्योग, अस्, m. a patronymic from Badhyoga.
34595: बाध्योगायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bā-dhyoga.
34596: बान्धकिनेय बान्धकिनेय, अस्, m. (fr. बन्-धकी), the son of an unmarried woman, a bastard.

(fr. बन्धु), a relation (near or remote and including wives and chil-dren), relative, kinsman [cf. पितृ-ब्°]; a maternal relation; a friend [cf. पिक-ब्°]; (ई), f. a female rela-tion. —बान्धव-कर, अस्, m. an epithet of Lallā-dīkṣita, a commentator on the Mṛc-chakaṭī. —बान्-धव-त्याग, अस्, m. abandoning a kinsman, for-saking a relation. —बान्धवाक्रोशिन् (°व-आक्°), ई, इनी, इ, calling out to or bewailing a kinsman.

34599: बान्धव्य, अम्, n. connection by blood, relation-ship, consanguinity.
34600: बान्धुक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बन्धुक), belonging to or derived from the Bandhuka tree.

34612: बाभ्रुक, अस्, ई, अम्, like an ichneumon, (i. e. probably) brown, brownish.

34615: बारेज्य बारेज्य, N. of a town.

34620: बार्हत्सामा, f. (fr. बृहत्-सामन्), Ved., N. or epithet of a woman.
34621: बार्हदग्न, आस्, m. pl. (fr. बृहद्-अग्नि), the descendants of Bṛhad-agni.

34628: बार्हद्रथि, इस्, m. (fr. बृहद्-रथ), a patro-nymic of Jarā-sandha.

34630: बार्हस्पत, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to Bṛhas-pati, descended from Bṛhas-pati, sacred to Bṛhas-pati.
34631: बार्हस्पत्य, अस्, ती, अम्, relating to or coming from Bṛhas-pati; (अस्), m. a pupil of Bṛhas-pati; an infidel, a materialist; an epithet of Śamyu; of Agni; of Tapur-mūrdhan; of Bharad-vāja; (अम्), n., scil. भ or नक्षत्र, the constellation Puṣya; the Artha-śāstra of Bṛhas-pati, ethics, morality; बार्हस्पत्यम् मानम्, ‘Jupiter's measure of time,’ a method of reckoning time. —बार्हस्पत्य-ज्योतिर्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m., N. of a work mentioned in Raghu-nandana's Saṃskāra-tattva. —बार्हस्प-त्य-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra mentioned in the Ānanda-laharī.
34632: बार्हिषद बार्हिषद, अस्, m. a patronymic from Barhiṣad.
34633: बाल् बाल्, ind., Ved. an interjection imi-tative of the sound of a falling body.

Zend bâzu, ‘the arm;’ Gr. πῆχυ-ς, βραχίων; Lat. brachium; Old Norse bôg-r = Old Germ. buoc, ‘a bow, bend.’] —बाहु-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, working with the hands. —बाहु-कुण्ठ or बाहु-कुब्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, crippled in the arms. —बाहु-कुन्थ, अस्, m. a wing. —बाहु-क्षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. offering the fore-legs (i. e. the inferior parts) of an animal (said of a parsimonious sacrificer; according to Sāy. = बाहुभिर् यजमा-नः). —बाहु-चाप, अस्, m. ‘arm-bow,’ the dis-tance measured by the extended arms, a fathom. —बाहु-च्युत्, त्, त्, त्, in Atharva-veda XVIII. 3, 25, perhaps for बाहु-ता. —बाहु-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fallen from the arm, dropped out of the hand; (Sāy. = बाहुभ्याम् प्रच्युतः।) —बा-हु-ज, अस्, m. ‘arm-born,’ a Kṣatriya or man of the military class (as sprung from the arm of Brahmā, Manu I. 31); a parrot; sesamum growing wild or spontaneously. —बाहु-जूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. swift with the arms; (Sāy. = बाहुः प्रेरकः शत्रूणां यस्य तादृशः, repelling the enemy with the arms.) —बाहु-ज्या, f. the cord of an arc, sine. —बाहु-ता, ind., Ved. in the arms; [cf. देव-ता, 2. पुरुष-ता।] —बाहु-त्राण, अम्, n. ‘arm-fence,’ armour for the arms, vantbrass. —बाहु-दण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘arm-staff,’ an arm like a staff, the arm compared to a staff; a blow or punishment inflicted with the arm or fist; [cf. भुज-दण्ड।] —बाहु-दा, f. ‘arm-giver,’ an epithet of Suyaśā (a wife of Parīkṣit, Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 3795); N. of a river said to rise in the Himālaya and probably identical with the Vitastā or classical Hydaspes and modern Jhelum, (into this river Gaurī the wife of Prasena-jit is said to have been transformed; and its name is accounted for by a legend that a saint recovered his lost arms by bathing in the stream.) —बाहु-पाश, अस्, m. ‘crossing or intertwining the arms,’ a particular atti-tude in fighting. —बाहु-प्रतिबाहु, ऊ, m. du. (in geometry) the opposite sides of a figure. —बाहु-प्रसार, अस्, m. the act of stretching out the arms, embracing. —बाहु-प्रहरण, अस्, m. ‘striking with the arms,’ a striker, boxer; (अम्), n. boxing, wrestling. —बाहु-फल, अम्, n. (in geometry) the result from the base sine; the sine of an arc of a circle of position contained between the sun and the prime vertical. —बाहु-बल, अम्, n. power or strength of arm; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (अस्, आ, अम्), strong in the arm. —बाहु-बलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, strong in the arm. —बाहु-बाध, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (also read बाहु-बाध्य, बहु-रद।) —बाहु-भङ्गि, इस्, f. bending or twisting the arms. —बाहु-भूषण, अम्, n. or बाहु-भूषा, f. ‘arm-ornament,’ an armlet, an ornament worn on the upper part of the arm. —बाहु-भेदिन्, ई, m. ‘arm-breaker,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —बाहु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has (strong) arms; (आन्), m. an epithet of Indra; (अती), f., N. of a river. —बाहु-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or done with the arms. —बाहु-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. as long as the arm. —बाहु-मूल, अम्, n. the root or juncture of the arm, armpit, extremity of the upper part of the arm, shoulder-balde, the region of the shoulder. —बाहुमूल-विभूषण, अम्, n. an ornament worn on the extremity of the upper part of the arm. —बाहु-युद्ध, अम्, n. ‘arm-fight,’ a close fight, personal struggle, pugilistic encounter, boxing, wrest-ling, pugilism. —बाहु-योध, अस्, or बाहु-योधिन्, ई, m. ‘fighting with the arms,’ a wrestler, a boxer. —बा-हु-लता, f. ‘arm-creeper,’ an arm (lithe) as a creeper or climbing plant. —बाहुलतान्तर (°ता-अन्°), अम्, n. the space between creeper-like arms, the breast, bosom. —बाहु-लतिका, f. an arm like a young creeper or climbing plant. —बाहु-विक्षेप, अस्, m. the act of throwing the arms apart, moving the arms; swimming. —बाहु-वीर्य, अम्, n. strength of arm, personal prowess. —बाहु-वृक्त, अस्, m., Ved. N. of a descendant of Atri and author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 71, 72. —बाहु-व्यायाम, अस्, m. ‘arm-exercise,’ gymnastic or athletic exercise. —बा-हु-शक्ति, इस्, m., N. of a king. —बाहु-शर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. ‘relying on (his) arms,’ mighty in arm or prowess; an epithet of Indra. —बाहु-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing (strong) arms; (ई), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of a Dānava; of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of Bhīma; of a prince. —बाहु-शिखर, ‘the upper part of the arm,’ the shoulder. —बाहु-सम्भव, अस्, m. ‘arm-born,’ ‘sprung from the arms (of Brahmā),’ a Kṣatriya or man of the military class. —बाहु-सहस्र-भृत्, त्, m. ‘having a thousand arms,’ an epithet of king Arjuna Kārtavīrya killed by Paraśu-rāma. —बाहूत्क्षेपम् (°हु-उत्°), ind. having lifted up the arms, having raised the hands. —बाहू-बा-हवि, ind. arm against arm, arm to arm, hand to hand or mutually grappling (in close combat, = बाहा-बाहवि). —बाह्व्-अङ्क, अस्, m., Ved. bending the arm. —बाह्व्-ओजस्, अस्, n., Ved. strength of arm; (आस्, आस्, अस्), strong in the arm; strong in the fore-legs (said of a horse; Sāy. = बाहुषु प्र-कृष्ट-बलवान्).

[cf. ह्रस्व-ब्°]; a monkey; N. of a Nāga; of a prince; of a son of Vṛka (= 1. बाहु); N. assumed by Nala after his transformation into a dwarf by the serpent-demon Karkoṭaka and upon his becoming charioteer to king Ṛtu-parṇa, (with this meaning also written वाहुक); (आ), f., N. of a river.
34695: 1. बाहुल, अम्, n. (for 2. see p. 684, col. 1), mail or armour for the arms; N. of a place in Dakṣiṇā-patha.
34696: बाहु 2. बाहु (fr. बहु, p. 677, col. 2), oc-curring at the beginning of compounds as follow. (For 1. बाहु see col. 1.)

34699: बाहुगर्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बहु + गर्त), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 2, 137.
34700: बाहुगुण्य, अम्, n. possession of numerous ex-cellences, great advantageousness; excess; (एन), ind. exceedingly.
34701: बाहुदन्तक [cf. बाहुदन्तिन्], belonging to Indra, (said of a treatise on moral duties abridged by Indra, Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 2204.)

34726: बिड् बिड् (or विड्) = बिट्, q. v.
