41758: वागर, अस्, m. a sage, holy man, one desirous of final emancipation; a scholar, Paṇḍit, learned Brāh-man; a hero, brave man, intrepid or fearless person; certainty, ascertainment; a whetstone; an obstacle, impediment, obstruction; submarine fire; a wolf.
41759: वागारु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. वाच्, compounded with आरु fr. rt. 4. ऋ, q. v.), breaking promise or faith, disappointing, a disappointer, deceiver.
41761: वाग्मिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking much, loquacious, talka-tive, verbose, wordy; speaking well, eloquent; (ई), m., N. of Vṛhas-pati (preceptor of the gods). —वाग्मि-ता, f. or वाग्मि-त्व, अम्, n. loquacity, eloquence.
41762: वाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking little, speaking cau-tiously or humbly (perhaps fr. वाच् + य fr. rt. यम्; cf. वाग्-यत); speaking truly; (अस्), m. modesty, humility, self-disparagement; doubt, alternative (?). —वाग्य-तस्, ind. silently.
41763: वाचक, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, declaratory, expla-natory, expressive of, significant, expressing, signifying; verbal, expressed by words; (अस्), m. a speaker, reader; a significant sound, word; a messenger. —वाचक-ता, f. or वाचक-त्व, अम्, n. expressiveness, signifi-cance. —वाचक-पद, अम्, n. an expressive or sig-nificant word, explicit term.
41764: वाचन, अम्, n. the act of reciting or reading, recitation; the act of relating or declaring, procla-mation, declaration; [cf. स्वस्ति-व्°।]
41765: वाचनक, अम्, n. an enigma, riddle.
41766: वाचनिक, अस्, ई, अम्, verbal, expressed by words, textual.
41767: वाचा, f. speech; a holy word, sacred text; an oath.
41768: वाचाट, अस्, आ, अम्, talkative, talking much or idly.
41769: वाचाल, अस्, आ, अम्, talkative, chattering, talking much or idly; boasting.
41770: वाचिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, verbal, oral; communicated by speech or by word of mouth, (पारुष्ये दण्ड-वाचिके, the two violences, whether by blows or speech, i. e. assault and slander); (अम्), n. news, tidings, intel-ligence. —वाचिक-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a letter, dispatch; a newspaper, gazette. —वाचिक-हारक, अस्, m. ‘news-conveyer,’ a letter, epistle; a messenger, courier.
41771: वाचिन् in जाति-वाचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, expressing genus, generic; [cf. जाति-वाचक।]
41772: वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken or said, proper to be said; to be spoken against or gainsaid, blamable, censurable, vile, bad, contemptible, low, outcast; to be predicated (of anything), attributive, adjective, declinable as an adjective, taking three genders; (अस्), m. a patronymic of the Ṛṣi Prajā-pati; (अम्), n. that which may be said of anything; blame, censure; (in gram.) a predicate; the voice of a verb (e. g. कर्तरि-वाच्यम्, the active voice; कर्मणि-वा-च्यम्, the passive voice). —वाच्य-चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, fanciful in sense (as poetry). —वाच्य-ता, f. or वाच्य-त्व, अम्, n. blamableness, blame, reproach; ill repute, infamy; the quality of being predicable; conjugation. —वाच्य-वज्र, अम्, n. ‘thunder of words,’ boisterous or severe language; [cf. वाग्-वज्र।] —वाच्यार्थ (°य-अर्°), अस्, m. expressed meaning (in rhetoric).
41773: वाच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being made to speak; being read aloud.
41774: वाच वाच, अस्, m. a plant. See मदन।
41775: वाज वाज, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वज्), strength, vigour, energy (Ved.); food, sacrificial food (Ved.); wealth (Ved.); speed; a month, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 27, 1. वाजाः = मासाः); battle, conflict, contest, (according to Naigh. II. 17; वाजे वाजे, in every con-flict); a wing; a feather, the feather of an arrow [cf. गृध्र-व्°, चित्र-व्°, पत्त्र-व्°]; sound; N. of a Muni; of one of the Ṛbhus or sons of Su-dhanvan, see ऋभु; (आस्), m. pl., N. of certain semi-divine or deified personages of the family of Vāja and closely connected or identified with the Ṛbhus, see ऋभु; (अम्), n. ghee or clarified butter; an oblation of rice offered at a Śrāddha or obsequial ceremony; rice or food in general; water; an acetous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment; a Mantra or prayer concluding a sacrifice; [cf. perhaps Eng. wing.] —वाज-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. performing mighty works. —वाज-गन्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the smell of strength, i. e. having a little strength. —वाज-दावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. granting food, (Sāy. = अन्न-प्रद।) —वाज-द्रविणस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. possessing strength or food. —वाज-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of strength or food, &c. —वाज-पस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in whose house there is food, having a house abounding in food or overflowing with plenty. —वाज-पेय, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. वाज, ‘an acetous mixture of meal and water,’ + पेय, ‘to be drunk’ by the gods), a particular sacrifice; N. of the sixth book of the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa. —वाज-प्रमह, अस्, आ, अम्, famous or illustrious for wealth, (Sāy. = धनैर् प्रकृष्टम् महस् तेजो यस्य or धनैर् प्रमहनीय।) —वाज-प्रसूत, आ, आ, अ, Ved. bearing food or strength. —वाज-भो-जिन्, ई, m., Ved. a particular sacrifice; see वाज-पेय. —वाजम्-भर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bearing food or oblations; a patronymic of Sapti, (in this case written वाजम्भर।) —वाज-रत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, rich in food, &c.; having agreeable food, &c. —वाज-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. bestower of food (said of Agni). —वाज-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, or वाज-सा, आस्, आस्, अम् (see rt. सन्), Ved. granting food or strength. —वाज-सातम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. a liberal dispenser of food. —वाज-साति, इस्, f., Ved. the granting of strength or food; gaining food; a sacrifice; war, battle (as yielding spoil); (इस्, इस्, इ), granting food or strength. —वाजी-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, strength-ening, stimulating, aphrodisiac. —वाजी-करण, अम्, n. the act of strengthening or stimulating, excitement of amorous desires by aphrodisiacs, &c.
41776: वाजय [cf. rt. वज्, cl. 10], Nom. P., Ved. वाज-यति, -यितुम्, to desire or ask for strength or food; to worship, (according to Naigh. III. 14 = अर्चति।)
41777: वाजयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring food or strength, (Sāy. = अन्नम् इच्छत्।)
41778: वाजयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring or asking for strength or food.
41779: वाजसनेय, अस्, m. (according to the Śabda-k.), N. of a Vedic work compiled by Janam-ejaya, after-wards destroyed through the curse of Vaiśampāyana, (according to the Matsya-Purāṇa a dispute arose between Janam-ejaya and Vaiśampāyana in conse-quence of the former's patronage of the Vājasaneyin branch of the Yajur-veda founded by Yājñavalkya in opposition to Vaiśampāyana, the author of the Black or Taittirīya branch); a follower of the sect of the Vāja-saneyins. —वाजसनेय-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n. a Brāh-maṇa of the Vājasaneyin branch of the Yajur-veda.
41780: वाजसनेयक, अस्, m. a Vājasaneyin; (अम्), n. a text of the Vājasaneyi-saṃhitā.
41781: वाजसनेयिन्, ई, m. a member of the sect of the Vā-jasaneyins, a follower of the White Yajur-veda; a N. of Yājñavalkya. —वाजसनेयि-शाखा, f. the branch or sect of the Vājasaneyins. —वाजसनेयि-संहिता, f. ‘the collection of the Vājasaneyins,’ (i. e. the collection of hymns of the White Yajur-veda ascribed to the Ṛṣi Yājñavalkya and called ‘white’ or शुक्ल to distinguish it from the Black or Dark Yajur-veda, which was the name given to the oldest collection or Taittirīya-saṃhitā [q. v.] of the Yajur-veda, because in this last, the separation between the Saṃhitā or collection of Mantras and the Brāhmaṇa portion is greatly obscured, and the two are blended together; whereas the White Saṃhitā is clearly distinguished from the Brāhmaṇa; it is divided into 40 Adhyāyas with 303 Anuvākas, comprising 1975 sections or Kaṇ-ḍikās; the legend relates that the Yajus in its ori-ginal form was taught by the Ṛṣi Vaiśampāyana to his pupil Yājñavalkya, but that the latter having incurred his teacher's anger was made to disgorge all the texts he had learnt, which were then picked up by Vaiśampāyana's other disciples in the form of partridges [see तैत्तिरीय-संहिता]; Yājñavalkya then hymned the Sun, who gratified by his homage, appeared in the form of a वाजिन् or horse, and consented to give him fresh Yajus texts, which were not known to his former master; those who studied these texts were called Vājins from the shape assumed by the Sun.)
41782: वाजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. possessing strength, possessed of food or sacrificial food, possessing wings; swift, powerful, strong, impetuous, quick; hastening (to aid others); epithet of the horse in general and of the representations of the Sun in the shape of a horse (see Dadhi-krā, Dadhi-krāvan, Tārkṣya); of Indra; of Bṛhas-pati and other gods; (ई), m. a horse; a follower of the Vājasaneyin branch of the Yajur-veda; an arrow; a bird; a plant, Justicia Adhe-natoda; (इनस्), m. pl., N. of the Ṛbhus (Ṛg-veda IV. 37, 4); (इनी), f. food (Ved.); a mare; N. of Uṣas (goddess of the dawn); of the mother of Bharad-vāja. —वाजि-गन्ध, अस्, m. the plant Phy-salis Flexuosa, (also written वाजिगन्धक।) —वाजि-ता, f. or वाजि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having strength or food or wings; the state or nature of a horse. —वाजि-दन्त or वाजिदन्तक, अस्, m. the plant Justicia Adhe-natoda. —वाजिनी-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of Vā-jinī, i. e. of food, &c. (the adj. being used for the sub-stantive), yielding nutriment; possessed of sacrifices; abounding in worship or prayers (which are offered at dawn), highly honoured; (अती), f. epithet of Uṣas (goddess of the dawn); of Sarasvatī (goddess of speech or eloquence). —वाजिनी-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. lord of wealth; (Sāy.) abiding in the sacrificial rite; rich in food (said of Indra, Agni, Vāyu, and the Aśvins). —वाजिन्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very strong or vigorous. —वाजि-पृष्ठ, अस्, m. the globe-amaranth. —वाजि-भक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a plant, chick-pea. —वाजि-भूमि, इस्, f. a place where horses are bred or a spot abounding in or suitable for horses. —वाजि-भोजन, अस्, m. ‘affording food to horses,’ a sort of kidney-bean (= मुद्ग). —वाजि-मत्, आन्, m. a kind of cucumber, (see पटोल।) —वाजि-मेध, अस्, m. the horse sacrifice; [cf. अश्व-मेध।] —वाजि-शाला, f. ‘horse-house,’ a stable.
41783: वाजिन, अम्, n. impetuosity, prowess, a heroic act, heroism (Ved.); a conflict, contest (Ved.); the scum of curdled milk; curd of two-milk whey or whey from which the curds have been separated.
41784: वाजिनेय, अस्, m., Ved. the son of Vājinī, i. e. Bharad-vāja.
41785: वाञ्छ् वाञ्छ् [cf. rt. वाङ्क्ष्], cl. 1. P. (sometimes also A.) वाञ्छति (-ते), ववाञ्छ, अवाञ्छीत्, वाञ्छितुम्, to desire, wish; to wish for, ask for, seek after, pursue: Pass. वाञ्छ्-यते, Aor. अवाञ्छि, to be wished, &c.: Caus. वाञ्-छयति, -ते, Aor. अववाञ्छत्, to cause to wish, &c.; [cf. Old Germ. wunsc, ‘wish;’ wunskian, ‘to wish;’ Angl. Sax. wiscan: Eng. wish.]
41786: वाञ्छक, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing, desiring; a wisher, &c.
41787: वाञ्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing, desiring.
41788: वाञ्छन, अम्, n. the act of desiring, wishing.
41789: वाञ्छनीय, to be wished for, desirable.
41790: वाञ्छा, f. wish, desire; desire for (with loc., Kirāt. IV. 25). —वाञ्छा-सिद्धि, इस्, f. the accom-plishment of a wish.
41791: वाञ्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired, longed for; wishing, desiring; (अम्), n. wish, desire.
41792: वाञ्छितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished or desired, desirable, &c.
41793: वाञ्छित्वा, ind. having wished, having desired.
41794: वाञ्छिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing, desirous; lustful; (इनी), f. a libidinous woman; a wanton.
41795: वाञ्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = वाञ्छनीय, p. 901, col. 3.
41796: वाञ्छ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being wished or de-sired.
41797: वाट् वाट्, ind. an exclamation on making an oblation of butter, &c.
41798: वाट वाट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वट), made or consisting of the Indian fig-tree or its wood, &c.; (अस्, ई, अम्), m. f. n. an enclosure, piece of enclosed ground, court-yard; a garden, park, orchard, planta-tion; the enclosure of a town or village, fence, wall, hedge, &c.; a road; a sort of grain, Panicum Spi-catum; the groin; (ई), f. the site of a house or building; a house, dwelling; a kind of plant (= वाट्यालक). —वाट-धान, अस्, m. the descendant of an outcast Brāhman by a Brāhman female; N. of a degraded tribe. —वाट-शृङ्खला, f. the chain of an enclosure, a sort of fence (?). —वाटी-दीर्घ, अस्, m. a sort of grass or reed (= इक्कट).
41799: वाटिका, f. the site of a house; a garden, orchard; the plant Sida Cordifolia.
41801: वाट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a house or garden; (अस्), m., see Nirukta II. 1; (आ), f. the plant Sida Cor-difolia. —वाट्य-पुष्प, अम्, n. sandal; saffron; (ई), f. the plant Sida Cordifolia, (also called Atibalā.)
41802: वाट्याल, अस्, ई, m. f. a herbaceous shrub, Sida Cordifolia.
41803: वाट्यालक, अस्, m. the plant Sida Cordifolia (com-monly called Bariyāla).
41804: वाट्टक वाट्टक, अम्, n. fried barley.
41805: वाड् वाड् (more properly written बाड्, q. v.), cl. 1. A. वाडते, वाडितुम्, to bathe; to dive and emerge.
41806: वाडव वाडव, अस्, m. submarine fire (see under वडवा, बडवा); a Brāhman; (अम्), n. a stud, a collection of mares. —वाडवाग्नि (°व-अग्°), इस्, m. the fire of the lower regions, hell; see वड-वाग्नि।
41807: वाडवेय, अस्, m. a bull; (औ), m. du. the two Aśvins as the sons of Vaḍavā or Aśvinī (see अश्विनी).
41808: वाडव्य, अम्, n. a number of Brāhmans.
41809: वाढ वाढ, अस्, आ, अम् (probably the origi-nal form of ऊढ, past part. of rt. 1. वह्; compar. साधीयस्, superl. साधिष्ठ, q. q. v. v.; cf. बहु, वहल), hard, firm; much, abundant, excessive, ex-ceeding; (अम्), ind. much, excessively; indeed, truly; very well, very good, well, yes, indeed, truly, surely, positively; consequently. —वाढ-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, of excessive prowess, powerful, very strong, mighty.
41810: वाण 1. वाण, अस्, आ, अम् (often written बाण, q. v.; fr. rt. वण्, ‘to sound’), sounding (Kirāt. XV. 10), making a sound; (अस्), m. a reed, reed-shaft, shaft, arrow, (in this and some other senses said to be also अम्, n.); a symbolical expression for the number five (from the five arrows of Kāma-deva, cf. पञ्च-वाण); a particular kind of reed or cane; a pipe, flute, lute, (in Ṛg-veda I. 85, 10. the Maruts are described as वाणम् धमन्तः, ‘blowing on their pipe’ or ‘playing on their lute,’ वाण being explained by Sāy. as ‘a kind of lute with a hundred strings’); a sound, voice; a word spoken, agreement (Ved., Sāy. = वचन); a mark for arrows, aim; the udder of a cow; alone, solitary (= केवल); N. of an Asura (a son of Bali, an enemy of Viṣṇu, and favourite of Śiva); of one of Skanda's attendants; of a king; of a poet (the author of the Kādambarī, of the Harṣa-carita, and perhaps also of the Ratnā-valī); of a person (mentioned in Rāja-taraṅginī VI. 318); fire (?), lightning (?); (अस्, आ), m. f. a blue-flowering Barleria; the hind part or feathered end of an arrow; (ई), f. sound, speech, (कठोरा वाणी, a harsh speech); voice; praise, laudation; a literary production; N. of Sarasvatī (the goddess of speech and eloquence); (अम्), n. the flower of Barleria; the body. —वाण-गङ्गा, f. ‘arrow Ganges,’ N. of a river flowing past Someśa (and said to have been produced by Rāvaṇa by cleaving a mountain with an arrow). —वाण-गोचर, अस्, m. the range of an arrow. —वाण-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of the Asura Vāṇa,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —वाण-तूण, अस्, m. ‘arrow-quiver,’ a quiver. —वाणतूणी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made into a quiver. —वाण-धि, इस्, m. ‘arrow-receptacle,’ a quiver. —वाण-नाशा, f., N. of a river. —वाण-निकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced or wounded by an arrow. —वाण-पञ्चानन, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —वाण-पथ, अस्, m. ‘arrow-path,’ the range of an arrow, a bow-shot. —वाणपथातीत (°थ-अत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, passed beyond the range of an arrow. —वाण-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘arrow-handed,’ having arrows in the hand, armed with arrows. —वाण-पात, अस्, m. arrow-fall, an arrow-shot (as a measure of distance), the range of an arrow. —वा-णपात-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being within the range of an arrow. —वाण-पुङ्खा, f. the feathered end of an arrow or that part of an arrow which includes the feathers and shaft. —वाण-पुर्, ऊर्, f. or वाण-पुर, अम्, n. the capital of Vāṇa-rāja. —वाण-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of an author. —वाण-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of arrows, arrowy. —वाण-मुक्ति, इस्, f. or वाण-मोक्षण, अम्, n. discharge of an arrow, shooting an arrow. —वाण-योजन, अम्, n. ‘arrow-union,’ a quiver. —वाण-राज, अस्, m. ‘king-Vāṇa,’ epithet of the Asura. —वाण-रेखा, f. a long wound made by an arrow. —वाण-लिङ्ग, अम्, n., N. of a Liṅga on the bank of the Narma-dā river. —वाण-वर्षण, अम्, n. or वाण-वृष्टि, इस्, f. showering down arrows or darts. —वाण-वर्षिन्, ई, इणि, इ, showering arrows. —वाण-वार, अस्, m. ‘arrow-defender,’ a breastplate, cuirass, armour. —वा-ण-सन्धान, अम्, n. the fitting of an arrow to the bow-string. —वाण-सिद्धि, इस्, f. the hitting of a mark by an arrow. —वाण-सुता, f. ‘daughter of Vāṇa,’ epithet of Uṣā or the Dawn (wife of Ani-ruddha, see Uṣā). —वाण-हन्, आ, or वाणारि (°ण-अरि°), इस्, m. ‘killer or enemy of Vāṇa,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —वाणावली (°ण-आव्°), f. a series of five Ślokas (containing only one sentence). —वाणाश्रय (°ण-आश्°), अस्, m. ‘arrow-receptacle,’ a quiver. —वाणासन (°ण-अस्°), अम्, n. ‘arrow-discharger,’ a bow. —वाणेश्वर (°ण-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a temple.

he is rarely connected with the Maruts, although in 1. 134, 4. he is said to have begotten them from the rivers of heaven; he is regent of the north-west quarter, see लोक-पाल); the air of the body, a vital air (of which five are reckoned, viz. प्राण, अपान, समान, उदान, and व्यान); 42123: वि 1. वि, ind. (thought by some to be for an original द्वि, meaning ‘in two parts;’ as a prepo-sition or prefix to verbs it is opposed to सम्, q. v., and expresses) apart, apart from, asunder, in different directions, to and fro, about, away, away from, off, &c. (e. g. वि-युज्, to disjoin, separate; वि-दॄ, to tear asunder; वि-कॄ, to scatter in different direc-tions; वि-चल्, to move to and fro; वि-च्छिद्, to cut away, cut off); when prefixed to some roots, वि gives a meaning opposite to the idea contained in the simple rt. (e. g. क्री, to buy; वि-क्री, to sell; स्मृ, to remember; वि-स्मृ, to forget); in other cases it appears either not to affect or simply to intensify that idea [cf. नश्, वि-नश्, हिंस्, वि-हिंस्]. वि may also be used with verbs or nouns, and other parts of speech derived from verbs, to express ‘division’ [cf. वि-भिद्, वि-भेद, वि-भज्, वि-भाग]; ‘distinction’ [cf. वि-शिष्, वि-शेष, वि-विच्, वि-वेक]; ‘discrimi-nation’ [cf. व्य्-अवच्छिद्, व्य्-अवच्छेद]; ‘distri-bution,’ ‘arrangement,’ ‘order’ [cf. वि-धा, वि-धान]; ‘opposition’ [cf. वि-रुध्, वि-रोध]; ‘discussion,’ ‘deliberation’ [cf. वि-चर्, वि-चार]; ‘privation’ [cf. वि-नी, वि-नयन]. वि may also be used with nouns, adjective or substantive, not immediately connected with verbs, to express ‘difference’ [cf. वि-लक्षण]; ‘variety’ [cf. वि-चित्र]; ‘distinction’ [cf. वि-शेष]; ‘intensity,’ ‘greatness,’ ‘largeness’ [cf. वि-कराल]; ‘change’ [cf. वि-कार]; ‘manifoldness’ [cf. वि-विध]; ‘con-trariety’ [cf. वि-लोम]; ‘impropriety,’ ‘deviation from right’ [cf. वि-जन्मन्, वि-कर्मिक]; ‘nega-tion’ or ‘privation’ (e. g. वि-जन, devoid of men; in this sense वि is used like निस्, q. v., and like 3. अ, q. v.); in this latter signification the use of वि often corresponds to that of the Latin dis, se, and the English prefixes a, ex, de, dis, in, un, &c.; [cf. Old Germ. wi-dar, ‘against;’ Pers. بى bī, ‘without;’ perhaps Lat. vê, in words like ve-cors, ve-sanus, vi in di-vi-dere; Lith. be, ‘without;’ Slav. beζ (perhaps = वहिस्).]

A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make different, form variously, give a different shape to anything, transform, alter, change, convert, cause to alter; to cause any one to change his state or opinions; to cause to change for the worse, distort, deprave, pervert, deform, render de-formed, spoil; to display; to form or produce variously (as sound, A.); to be changed, undergo a change, change for the worse, deteriorate, change one's state or opinions (A.); to rejoice (A.); to feel aversion (A.); to act in various ways (A.); to decorate in various manners; to move to and fro, become restless (A.); to put into practice, exercise; to distribute; to ex-tend; to destroy, annihilate; to act in a hostile or un-friendly way towards (with gen. or loc. of the person); to contend together: Pass. वि-क्रियते, &c., to be changed, undergo a change; to act as a substitute for, act in place of (with acc., Ved.): Caus. -कारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to change or be changed.
42205: वि-कर, अस्, m. sickness, disease, loss of health.
42206: वि-करण, अस्, m., scil. प्रत्यय, (in grammar) a term for the affix or conjugational characteristic which is placed between the root and terminations, the inserted conjugational affix; (according to Pāṇini these affixes are शप्, शपो लुक्, श्लु, श्यन्, श्नु, श, श्नम्, उ, यक्, and च्लि with its substitutes तासि, स्य, and सिप्, the first eight of which are added in the Present, Imperfect, Imperative, and Potential, and before a Kṛt which contains a mute palatal श्, when these affixes denote the Kartṛ or Agent, i. e. the Active; when, however, they denote the Karman or Bhāva, i. e. the Passive or Neuter, then यक् is added; च्लि is added in the Aorist, तासि in the Ist Future, स्य in the 2nd Future and Conditional, and सिप् before Leṭ.)
42207: 1. वि-कर्मन्, अ, n. various business or duty; pro-hibited or unlawful act, fraud; retiring from business; (आ, आ, अ), acting variously; acting wrongly. —वि-कर्म-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, acting in various ways, acting wrongly or illegally, one who does forbidden acts. —विकर्म-क्रिया, f. an illegal or immoral act, vicious conduct. —विकर्म-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, doing what is illegal or immoral, addicted to vice, engaged in prohibited acts; engaged in various business.
42208: 2. वि-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, not acting, free from action.
42209: विकर्मिक, अस्, ई, अम्, transacting various affairs; doing forbidden acts; acting wrongly; (अस्), m. a clerk or superintendant of markets or fairs.

42214: वि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, altered, changed, modified, trans-formed, changed in form or feeling; changed for the worse, sick, diseased, mutilated, maimed, deformed, disfigured; unnatural; imperfect, unfinished, incom-plete; affected by passion, overcome by emotion; enter-taining feelings of disgust or aversion, averse, estranged; strange, extraordinary; (अम्), n. change, alteration; change for the worse, a diseased state; disgust, aver-sion. —विकृत-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, changed in appearance. —विकृत-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, changed in mind, estranged, made unfriendly or ill-disposed. —विकृत-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having excited eyes. —विकृत-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a distorted face, ugly-faced. —विकृताकार (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, changed in form or appearance, misshaped, distorted in form. —विकृताकृति (°त-आक्°), इस्, इस्, इ, having a deformed shape or aspect. —विकृताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, changed in form, having mis-shaped limbs, deformed. —विकृतानन (°त-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a distorted countenance, ugly-faced.

C.; he is said to have driven out the Śakas or Scythians and to have esta-blished his dominion over almost the whole of Northern India; he was one of the wisest of Hindū kings and a great patron of literature; nine cele-brated men of letters flourished at his court [see नव-रत्न], and innumerable legends are related of him [cf. विक्रम-चरित, सिंहासन-द्वात्रिंशत्-पुत्रिका-वार्त्ता] all teeming with exaggerations and absurdities; according to some he fell in a battle with his rival Śāli-vāhana, king of the south country or Deccan, and the legendary date given for his death is Kali Yuga 3044; there are, however, other kings called Vikramāditya, and the name has been applied to king Bhoja and even to Śāli-vāhana). —विक्र-मादित्य-कोष, N. of a work. —विक्रमार्क (°म-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of king Vikramāditya. —वि-क्रमार्जित (°म-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, acquired or con-quered by valour. —विक्रमोर्वशी (°म-उर्°), f. ‘valour-[won] Urvaśī,’ N. of one of the three cele-brated dramas of Kālidāsa.

42719: विद् 1. विद्, cl. 2. P. वेत्ति (ep. also A. वित्ते, 3rd pl. A. अविदत or अविद्रत), Pot. विद्यात्, Impv. वेत्तु or विदां-करोतु (3rd pl. A. विदताम् or वि-द्रताम्), विवेद (according to Vopa-deva also वि-दाम्-बभूव), वेदिष्यति (sometimes वेत्स्यति), अवेदीत्, वेदितुम् (originally ‘to see,’ = Lat. video); to perceive, understand, know, learn, ascertain, find out, experience, feel; to consider, regard, look upon, value, take for, name, call (especially in the 3rd pl. विदुः of वेद above, used with a present significa-tion, e. g. तं स्थविरं विदुः, they consider or call him aged; राजर्षिर् इति मां विदुः, they consider me a Rājarṣi); to notice, take notice of (with gen.; Ved.); to convey, bestow, grant (Ved.); cl. 6. P. A. विन्दति, -ते (in Ṛg-veda I. 7, 7. विन्-धे = 1st sing. A. विन्दे, 3rd pl. ep. विन्दते), Pot. विन्देत् (ep. विन्द्यात्, Ved. 1st sing. P. विदेयम्, A. विदेय), विवेद (3rd sing. Ved. विविदत् = लब्-ध-वान् in Ṛg-veda VII. 21, 6), विविदे (2nd sing. विविदिषे, Ved. विवित्से; 3rd pl. Ved. विद्रे = लब्-ध-वन्तः, Ṛg-veda I. 87, 6), वेदिष्यति, -ते (or according to others वेत्स्यति, -ते), अविदत्, अविदत, वेदितुम् (or वेत्तुम्), to find, discover, meet with; to obtain, gain, get, acquire, possess; to take in mar-riage, choose a husband or wife, marry, (in this sense generally A.); to convey, cause to obtain, grant (Ved., in Ṛg-veda I. 86, 8. विदा = विद, which according to Sāy. is for 2nd pl. Impv. = लम्भयत); cl. 7. A. (ep. also P.) विन्त्ते (विनत्ति), विविदे, वेत्स्यते, अवित्त, वेत्तुम्, to perceive, understand, know; to consider, regard, value, take for; to find, meet with, obtain; to reason, reflect: Pass. or cl. 4. A. विद्यते, विविदे, वेत्स्यते, Aor. अवेदि, to be known; to be found or obtained; to happen; to be or exist: Caus. वेदयति, -यते, -यितुम्, Aor. अवीविदत्, to cause to know, make known, announce, report, in-form of, apprise, tell, narrate, teach (sometimes with loc. of person); to cause to find or discover; to know; to perceive, feel; to be perceived or felt (A., Manu XII. 13); to dwell, inhabit (?): Desid. विवि-दिषति, -ते, विवित्सति, -ते, to desire to know, strive to know; to wish to find or discover: Intens. वेविद्-यते, वेवेत्ति; [cf. Gr. ἴδ-ο-ν, εἶδ-ο-ν (i. e. ἔϝιδον), εἴδ-ο-μαι, οἶδ-α (= वेद), εἶδ-ος. εἴδ-ωλο-ν, ἴνδαλμα, ἀ-ειδ-ής, ἀ-ίδη-ς, ἄ-ῐστ-ο-ς, είδ-ώς, ἴδ-μην, ἴστωρ, ἰστορ-έ-ω, ἴδ-ρι-ς, ἰνδ-άλλομαι, ὕδνης, ὕδω, ὑδέω, ἀείδω: Lat. vid-eo, visu-s (Umbr. virs-e-to), vis-o, vi-tru-m: Goth. vait, un-vit-i, ‘igno-rance;’ vit-an, far-veit-l, vitôth, in-veitan, veit-vods: Old Germ. wizan, gi-wizo, wîzago, wîza-gôn: Angl. Sax. witan, wita, ge-wit, ge-wittig, wisian, ge-wis, wite, ‘punishment;’ witnian, ‘to punish:’ Slav. vid-e-ti, ‘to see;’ ved-e-ti, ‘to know:’ Lith. veid-a-s, vyzd-i-s, veizd-mi: Hib. fêth, ‘science, instruction;’ (perhaps) feidhim, ‘I mani-fest, relate;’ feidir, ‘power;’ (perhaps also) aithnim, aithnighim, ‘I know;’ aithne, ‘known;’ ‘know-ledge;’ fios, ‘knowledge;’ fiosach, ‘knowing.’]

42721: वित्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, known, famous.

42723: वित्त्वा, ind. having found or met with, having obtained; having married.

42821: 2. वि-द्युत्, त्, f. lightning; a thunderbolt (a weapon of the Maruts); a species of the Atijagatī metre; (त्), m., N. of an Asura. —विद्युज्-जिह्व, अस्, m. ‘lightning-tongued,’ a kind of Rākṣasa. —वि-द्युज्-ज्वाला, f. the flashing of lightning; N. of a particular plant (= कलि-कारी). —विद्युत्-केश, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa (son of Heti and father of Su-keśa). —विद्युत्-केशिन्, ई, m., N. of a king of the Rākṣasas. —विद्युत्-पताक, अस्, m. ‘having light-ning for its banner,’ epithet of one of the seven kinds of cloud at the destruction of the world; [cf. वला-हक।] —विद्युत्-पात, अस्, m. the falling or darting of lightning, a stroke of lightning. —विद्युत्-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the splendor of lightning, flashing like lightning. —विद्युत्-प्रिय, अम्, n. ‘lightning-loved,’ bell-metal. —विद्युत्-वत् or विद्युन्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having or containing lightning, electrical (a cloud &c.). —विद्युद्-उन्मेष, अस्, m. a flash of lightning. —विद्युद्-दामन्, अ, n. ‘a garland or mass of lightning,’ a flash or streak of zigzag light-ning. —विद्युद्-द्योत, अस्, m. the brightness or brilliance of lightning. —विद्युद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having lightning for a vehicle (said of the Maruts). —विद्युन्-महस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. brilliant or radiant with lightning (said of the Maruts; Sāy. = विद्योतमान-तेजस्). —विद्युन्-माला, f. ‘gar-land of lightning,’ N. of a metre in Sanskrit prosody. —विद्युन्-मालिन्, ई, m. ‘garlanded with lightning,’ N. of an Asura. —विद्युल्-लता, f. ‘lightning-creeper,’ forked or zigzag lightning. —विद्युल्-लेखा, f. a streak of lightning, flash of lightning, forked lightning.
42822: 3. वि-द्युत्, त्, त्, त्, devoid of splendor, lustreless.
42823: विद्युतय, Nom. A. विद्युतयते, -यितुम्, Ved. to flash or gleam (like lightning), be radiant.
42824: वि-द्योतन, अस्, ई, अम्, irradiating, illuminating, enlightening; illustrating.
42825: वि-द्योतमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, blazing, flashing, lightening, (विद्योतमाने, ind. when the lightning flashes, when it lightens.)
42826: विद्र विद्र, अम्, n. (probably fr. वि-दॄ or connected with rt. व्यध्), tearing, splitting, pierc-ing, perforating; a fissure, hole, chasm.
42827: विद्रध, अस्, आ, अम् (probably connected with rt. व्यध्), Ved. divided, (according to Yāska = विद्ध, according to Durga = विकुषिताधोभाग; see Nirukta IV. 15.)
42828: विद्रधि, इस्, m. an abscess (especially when deep-seated or internal). —विद्रधि-नाशन, अस्, m. ‘abscess-destroyer,’ the tree Hyperanthera Morunga (= शोभाञ्जन, q. v.).
42829: विद्रा वि-द्रा or वि-द्रै, cl. 2. 1. (or 4.) P. -द्राति, -द्रायति, -द्रातुम्, (probably) to awake out of sleep.
42830: वि-द्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened out of sleep, awaking.
42831: विद्रु वि-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run in different directions, disperse, escape; to part asunder, become divided, burst asunder; to flow asunder, melt, become melted, liquefy: Caus. -द्रा-वयति, -यितुम्, to cause to disperse, drive away, put to flight, frighten away, scare, chase away.
42832: वि-द्रव, अस्, m. running in different directions, running away, flight, panic, agitation; retreat, escape; flowing out, oozing; flowing asunder, melting, lique-faction; censure, abuse, reproach; intellect, under-standing.
42833: वि-द्राव, अस्, m. running away, flight, panic, retreat; liquefaction.
42834: वि-द्रावक, अस्, इका, अम्, driving away; causing to flow or melt, liquefying.
42835: वि-द्रावण, अम्, n. the act of driving away, chasing, defeating; causing to flow or melt, lique-fying.
42836: वि-द्रावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to disperse, driven away, put to flight; liquefied, fused.
42837: वि-द्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flown, fled; running hither and thither, going fast; agitated, alarmed; liquefied, liquid, fluid (as an oily or metallic substance when heated).
42838: विद्रुम वि-द्रुम, अस्, m. a tree bearing precious gems; coral; a young sprout or shoot. —विद्रुम-तट, अस्, आ, अम्, having banks of coral. —विद्रुम-देहली, f. a threshold of coral. —वि-द्रुम-लता, f. a branch of coral; a sort of vegetable perfume. —विद्रुम-लतिका, f. a kind of perfume (= नलिका).
42839: विद्रै वि-द्रै (see वि-द्रा), cl. 1. P. -द्रा-यति, -द्रातुम्, to awake from one's sleep.
42841: विद्विष् 1. वि-द्विष्, cl. 2. P. A. -द्वेष्टि, -द्विष्टे, -द्वेष्टुम्, to dislike, hate, be hostile to; (A.) to hate each other mutually, dislike one another: Caus. -द्वेषयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dislike or hate, make hostile, render an enemy, make hostile towards one another.
42842: 2. वि-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, hostile, inimical; an enemy, foe.
42843: वि-द्विष, अस्, आ, अम्, hating, inimical, adverse; (अस्), m. an enemy.
42844: वि-द्विषत्, अन्, अती, अत्, hating, hostile; an enemy, foe.
42845: वि-द्विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, hated, disliked, odious. —विद्विष्ट-ता, f. hatred, dislike, hostility.
42846: वि-द्वेष, अस्, m. enmity, hatred, contempt. —वि-द्वेष-वीर, अस्, m., N. of a chief of the Śaivas.
42847: वि-द्वेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, hating, hostile; a hater, enemy.
42848: वि-द्वेषण, अस्, m. one who hates, a hater; (ई), f. a woman of a resentful disposition; (अम्), n. caus-ing abhorrence, hatred, enmity.
42849: वि-द्वेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, hating, hostile, inimical; (ई), m. an enemy. —विद्वेषि-प्रभव, अस्, आ, अम्, proceeding from an enemy.
42850: वि-द्वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who hates, an enemy; hating, hostile, inimical, adverse.
42851: विध् 1. विध् (= rt. विथ्), cl. 1. A. वे-धते, वेधितुम्, to ask, beg.
42852: विध् 2. विध् (thought by some to have been developed out of वि-धा and rt. व्यध्), cl. 6. P. विधति, विवेध, वेधिष्यति, अवेधीत्, वेधितुम्, to dispose (Ved.); to perform (Ved.); to administer, govern, rule, command; to wor-ship, honour, sacrifice; to pierce, (in this sense for rt. व्यध्): Caus. वेधयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अवीविधत्: Desid. विविधिषति and विवेधिषति: Intens. वे-विध्यते, वेविधीति, वेवेद्धि।
42853: 1. विध, अस्, आ, m. f. (more properly fr. rt. व्यध्), piercing, penetrating, penetration. (For 2. वि-ध see under वि-धा, col. 2.)
42854: विधत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. worshipping, honouring.
42855: विधन वि-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of wealth, having no riches, poor. —विधन-ता, f. destitution, poverty.
42856: विधर्तृ वि-धर्तृ, वि-धर्मन्, &c. See under वि-धृ, p. 922, col. 2.
42858: विधवा वि-धवा, f. (see 2. धव), a hus-bandless woman, a widow; [cf. Lat. vidua, vi-duus; Goth. viduvo; Angl. Sax. wuduwe, wu-duwa; Slav. vidova; Hib. feadhb; perhaps Gr. ἠΐθεος.] —विधवा-गामिन्, ई, m. one who has in-tercourse with a widow. —विधवा-धर्म, अस्, m. ‘the duty of widows,’ N. of a section of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva. —विधवावेदन (°वा-आव्°), अम्, n. marrying a widow.
42859: विधा वि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to distribute, apportion, bestow, grant; to procure, furnish; to give out, diffuse; to extend (Ved.); to put in order, arrange, regulate, dispose, make ready, prepare, attend to; to prescribe, ordain, direct, enjoin, settle, fix; to appoint, commission, depute; to place on, put on or in, put down, lay down, lay aside; to place, put, lay (in general); to hold, possess, assume, take; to form, build, create; to perform, effect, accomplish, produce, establish, cause, occasion, render, make, do, act, act towards, treat as, (these senses may be almost endlessly modified by using वि-धा, like कृ, in connection with various nouns, e. g. सिं-हत्वं विधा, to change into a lion; कामं वि-धा, to fulfil a wish; वृत्तिं विधा, to fix a liveli-hood or maintenance; हृदये विधा, to lay to heart; शस्त्राणि विधा, to lay down arms; मन्त्रं विधा, to hold a consultation; राज्यं विधा, to carry on a government, rule; पूजां विधा, to do honour to, show respect to, worship; शौचं विधा, to perform purification; लज्जां विधा, to display bashfulness; मैत्र्यं विधा, to make friendship; सन्धिं विधा, to conclude peace; कलहं विधा, to pick a quarrel; वैरं विधा, to declare war; को-लाहलं विधा, to raise a clamour; तं नृपं विदधुः, they made him king): Pass. -धीयते, to be distributed or apportioned; to be arranged or attended to; to be prescribed or settled, &c.; to be taken or reckoned for, &c.: Caus. -धापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to put in order or arrange or fix; to cause to put, cause to be laid: Desid. -धित्सति, -ते, to wish to distribute or bestow, to wish to arrange, try to fix; to wish or intend to do or perform or accomplish or effect; to wish to render, &c.
42860: वि-दधत्, अत्, अती, अत्, distributing, granting, pro-curing, arranging, prescribing, fixing, performing, &c.; holding, having, assuming, wearing.
42861: 2. वि-ध, अस्, m. form, manner, measure, kind, sort (often at the end of comps., see एवं-व्°, तथा-व्°, द्वि-व्°, बहु-व्°, &c.); fold (at the end of comps., especially after numerals, see अष्ट-व्°, सप्त-व्°); the food of elephants; prosperity; (आ), f. form, formula, rule; manner, kind, sort; act, action; doing well, prosperity, affluence; wages, hire; fodder, the food of elephants, horses, &c.; [cf. Old Pruss. wida-s, wid-s, sta-wida-s, sta-wids, ‘of such sort;’ ka-wid-s (fem. ka-wida), ‘of which kind;’ kitta-widin, kitte-widei, ‘in any way.’]
42862: वि-धस्, आस्, m., N. of Brahmā; [cf. वेधस्।]
42863: वि-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done according to rule, to be observed (as a rite or ceremony); to be prescribed or regulated; to be done or performed or effected.
42864: वि-धातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, arranging, disposing, mak-ing, creating; = मेधाविन् (according to Naigh. III. 15); (ता), m. an arranger, disposer, maker, creator; N. of Brahmā (as creator of the world); N. of Viśva-karman; fate, destiny; N. of Kāma (god of love); of a son of Bhṛgu; of a son of Viṣṇu and Lakṣmī; spirituous liquor; (त्री), f. long pepper. —विधातृ-भू, ऊस्, m. ‘son of Brahmā,’ epithet of Nārada, (see नारद।) —विधातृ-वशात्, ind. from the will of Brahmā; through the power of fate or destiny. —विधात्रायुस् (°तृ-आय्°), उस्, m. the sunflower; sunshine, (according to Śabda-k. = सूर्य-शोभा।)
42865: वि-धान, अम्, n. the act of arranging, disposing, prescribing, enjoining, ordering, performing, making; arrangement, disposition, creation; act, action, (espe-cially) the performance of prescribed acts or rites; rule, precept, ordinance, injunction, regulation, sacred text; act of worship, rite, ceremony; form, formula, mode, method, manner, (तथा-व्°, following such a mode or method); means, expedient; gaining, obtaining, taking, possessing; wealth; act of hostility; conflict of opposite feelings; an elephant's fodder; (in gram-mar) affixing, prefixing, taking as an affix, &c.; (अस्, आ, अम्), acting, performing, possessing, assuming, wearing, having. —विधान-ग, अस्, m. ‘rule-goer,’ a Paṇḍit, a wise or learned man, teacher. —विधान-ज्ञ, अस्, m. one who knows rules or rites, a Paṇḍit, wise man. —विधान-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeable to rule, conformable to sacred precept.
42866: वि-धानक, अस्, आ, अम्, disposing, arranging, one who knows how to arrange; (अम्), n. affliction, distress, pain (= व्यथा).
42867: वि-धाय, ind. having disposed or arranged, having placed or put on; having taken or assumed, &c.; having formed or created; having rendered.
42868: वि-धायक, अस्, इका, अम्, disposing, arranging, performing; consigning, delivering, one who entrusts or deposits anything or causes it to be fixed or secure. —विधायक-त्व, अम्, n. consignment or delivery of anything, making anything firm or secure.
42869: वि-धायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, disposing, arranging; mak-ing, forming, building; causing, occasioning; placing, fixing, securing; delivering, entrusting; establishing a rule or law.
42870: वि-धास्यत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, wishing or pur-posing to arrange; intending to direct or enjoin or prescribe, wishing to make or do or perform, &c.
42871: वि-धि, इस्, m. a rule, form, formula, sacred pre-cept, injunction, rubric, sacred text or scripture, text prescribing any act or observance, order, command, ordinance, statute, law, direction for the performance of a rite as given in the Brāhmaṇa portion of the Veda, (according to Sāy. the Brāhmaṇa consists of two parts, 1. Vidhi or commandment, e. g. यजेत, he ought to sacrifice; कुर्यात्, he ought to perform; 2. Artha-vāda or explanatory statements as to the origin of rites and use of the Mantras, mixed up with legends and illustrations), any prescribed act or rite or ceremony, an act or action in general, behaviour, con-duct, mode of life, method, manner, way, means; combining for any act or rite. —विधि-र-सायन, N. of a work by Appayya Dīkṣita (con-futing the Mīmāṃsā as expounded by Bhaṭṭa Kumā-rila). —विधि-वत्, ind. agreeably to rule, according to law, in due form, conformably to established ordinances. —विधि-वधू, ऊस्, f. ‘wife of Brahmā,’ epithet of Sarasvatī. —विधि-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, established by rule, prescribed by law. —विधि-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of rule, unauthorised, irregular.
42872: वि-धित्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, = वि-धित्समान below.
42873: वि-धित्समान, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to bestow; desiring to fix or place; wishing to perform; having certain intentions, following certain aims.
42874: वि-धित्सा, f. the wish to arrange; desire to do or make; design, purpose, desire.
42875: वि-धित्सित, अम्, n. design, purpose, intention.
42876: वि-धित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to arrange; intending to make; purposing to perform.
42877: वि-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being arranged, being enjoined, being defined, &c.
42878: वि-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be arranged or prescribed; to be enjoined (as a rule &c.); to be performed or practised or done; liable to be ruled or governed or influenced by, governable, subject to; compliant, sub-missive, tractable. —विधेय-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing what ought to be done. —विधेय-ता, f. or विधेय-त्व, अम्, n. fitness to be prescribed or enjoined; fitness for enactment (as a rule or law), necessary or proper act or conduct; tractableness, docility, submission. —विधेय-पद, अम्, n. an object to be accom-plished. —विधेय-मार्ग, अस्, m. the seeking to do a necessary act. —विधेयात्मन् (°य-आत्°), आ, m. ‘having a well-governed nature,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.
42879: वि-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, arranged, settled, &c. See s. v.

42881: वि-धावत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running away, running through.

42883: वि-धौत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed by washing.
42884: विधु 1. विधु, उस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. 43423: वि-भज्य, ind. having divided or parted, having portioned or distributed, having allotted.

43431: वि-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken asunder, broken to pieces, shattered, crushed.

43437: वि-भात्, आन्, आती, or आन्ती, आत्, shining, splendid; (आती), f. epithet of the dawn.

43448: वि-भासा, f. shining brightly, light, lustre.
43449: वि-भासित, अस्, आ, अम्, made bright, lighted, illu-minated, shining.

43464: वि-भीषण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, terrifying, intimi-dating, terrific, fearful, terrible, formidable, horrible; bullying or blustering (as language); (अम्, आ), n. f. the act of terrifying, the property of exciting fear, a means of terrifying, terror; (अस्), m., N. of a brother of Rāvaṇa, (his other brothers were Kuvera [by a different mother] and Kumbha-karṇa; both Rāvaṇa and Vibhīṣaṇa are said to have propitiated Brahmā by their penances, so that the god granted them both boons, and the boon chosen by Vibhīṣaṇa was that he should never, even in the greatest cala-mity, stoop to any mean or wicked action; hence he is represented in the Rāmāyaṇa as opposing and endeavouring to counteract the malice of his brother Rāvaṇa, in consequence of which he was so ill-treated and insulted by Rāvaṇa that, leaving Laṅkā, he joined the side of Rāma, by whom, after the death of Rāvaṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa was placed on the throne of Laṅkā); N. of several kings, (in later times Vibhīṣaṇa appears to have been used as a general name of the kings of Laṅkā.) —विभीषण-वाक्य, अम्, n. ‘speech of Vibhīṣaṇa,’ N. of several chapters in the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa. —विभीषणाभिषेक (°ण-अभ्°), अस्, m. ‘inau-guration of Vibhīṣaṇa,’ N. of the ninety-first chapter of the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa (according to one recension).
43465: वि-भीषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, terrifying, causing terror or alarm.
43466: विभीदक विभीदक, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of tree (from the nuts of which dice are made; cf. वि-भीतक); dice, gambling, (Sāy. = अक्ष।)
43467: विभुग्न वि-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. भुज्), bent, bowed, crooked.
43468: विभू 1. वि-भू, cl. 1. P. A. -भवति, -ते, -भवितुम्, to arise, be produced, become developed, be manifested, expand, appear; to pervade; to be equal to, suffice for; to prevail, have power, be capable of, be able to (with inf.): Caus. -भावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to arise, cause to be developed or expand, make manifest, develop, cause to appear clearly, manifest, reveal, show forth, display; to cause to be apart, separate; to perceive distinctly, find out, trace out, discover, ascertain, detect, ob-serve, know, feel; to recognise; to suppose, fancy, imagine; to suppose anything (acc.) of or about any one (loc.); to think about, reflect upon; to make clear, establish, prove, decide; to convict, con-vince: Pass. of Caus. -भाव्यते, to be considered or regarded as, to appear, seem.
43469: वि-बोभुवत्, अत्, अती, अत् (fr. the Intens.), Ved. spreading in every direction.

43471: वि-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pervading, prevailing.
43472: वि-भाव, अस्, m. any condition which excites or develops a particular state of mind or body, (in dramatic composition one of the three divisions of Bhāvas, the other two being Anu-bhāvas and Sāt-tvika-bhāvas, see भाव); any causative or exciting property (as dress, perfumes, &c. causing amorous desire, extravagant gesture causing mirth, distress causing tenderness, arms and tumult causing wrath or heroism); a friend, acquaintance.
43473: वि-भावक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to appear clearly, manifesting, showing, illustrating; discussing.
43474: वि-भावन, अम्, आ, n. f. the causing to appear distinctly, clear perception, distinguishing or perceiv-ing distinctly, conception, imagination, examination, discrimination, judgment, clear ascertainment; dis-cussion; (in rhetoric) description of effects not arising from the usual causes, peculiar causation; or, according to some, description by negatives, bring-ing out the qualities of any object more clearly than by positive description. —विभावनालङ्कार (°ना-अल्°), अस्, m. (in rhetoric) the rhetorical figure de-scribed above.
43475: वि-भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguishable, ascer-tainable, to be judged or determined.

43477: विभाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, filled with amorous sentiments, exciting emotion of love, (see वि-भाव, col. 1.)
43478: वि-भाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguishable, to be clearly perceived or seen or observed; remarkable; to be conceived or imagined.
43479: वि-भु, उस्, उस्, or वी, उ (in Ved. the fem. is always विभ्वी, Pāṇ. 43480: 2. वि-भू, ऊस्, &c., Ved. expanding, pervading, epithet of a particular Prāṇa.
43481: वि-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, arisen, produced, developed, manifested, appeared, displayed; great, mighty. —विभूत-द्युम्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abounding in glory or in food, (Sāy. = प्रभूत-यशस् or प्रभूतान्न।) —विभूत-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. mak-ing great gifts.
43482: वि-भूति, इस्, m. great power, might, dominion, supremacy, dignity; great success, prosperity, wel-fare; superhuman power (consisting of eight facul-ties, especially attributed to Śiva, but supposed also to be attainable by human beings through a course of austere worship in honour of that deity, viz. अणि-मन्, the power of becoming as minute as an atom; लघिमन्, extreme lightness; प्राप्ति, the power of attaining or reaching anything, as illustrated by the power of touching the moon with the tip of the finger; प्राकाम्य, irresistible will; महिमन्, illimitable bulk; ईशिता, supreme dominion; वशिता, the power of subjugating by magic; and कामाव-सायिता, the power of suppressing all desires); the ashes of cow-dung &c. (with which Śiva is said to smear his body, and hence used in imitation of him by devotees); (इस्, इस्, इ), Ved. very powerful, mighty. —विभूति-द्वादशी, f., N. of a particular Vrata or religious observance. —विभूति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, powerful, possessed of excellence or dignity, super-human; smeared with ashes. —विभूति-योग, अस्, m., N. of the sixth canto of the Śiva-gītā.
43483: वि-भ्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. displayed, developed, dif-fused; great, mighty; (आ), m., N. of a son of Su-dhanvan (brother of Ṛbhu, q. v., regarded as one of the three Ṛbhus). —विभ्व-तष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. cut out or fashioned by Vibhvan (said of the rivers which were supposed to be carved out by him, as the artificer of Varuṇa); modelled by Vi-bhvan, very perfect or handsome (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 58, 4). —विभ्वा-सह् (विभ्वा for विभ्व), Ved. conquering or overcoming the mighty, (Sāy. = महतो-ऽभिभवितृ।)
43484: विभूष् वि-भूष्, cl. 1. 10. P. -भूषति, -भूषयति, -भूषितुम्, -भूषयितुम्, to deco-rate, adorn; to shine forth, appear, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 112, 4. विभूषति may = व्य्-आप्तो भवति, the rt. भूष् being sometimes used in the Veda as another form of rt. 1. भू, in the sense of ‘to obtain, attain.’)
43485: वि-भूषण, अम्, n. decoration, ornament. —वि-भूषणोद्भासिन् (°ण-उद्°), ई, इनी, इ, glittering with ornaments.
43486: वि-भूषा, f. ornament, decoration; light, lustre, splendor, beauty.
43487: वि-भूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned, decorated, orna-mented. —विभूषिताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, decorated about the body.
43488: वि-भूषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, adorning, decorating; adorned, decorated.
43489: वि-भूष्य, ind. having adorned or decorated.
43490: विभृ वि-भृ, cl. 1. P. A. -भरति, -ते, cl. 3. P. A. -बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, &c., -भर्तुम्, to support; to bear or carry in different directions, spread out; to distribute, diffuse (A.): Intens. (for Intensive forms see under rt. भृ), to move to and fro, wave about, brandish, toss about; to roam or sport about, (according to Sāy. in this sense for वि-हृ; cf. वि-भृत्र।)
43491: वि-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, upheld, supported, main-tained, held, retained.
43492: वि-भृत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. borne in various direc-tions, (Sāy. = नाना-स्थानेषु विहृत); employed in various sacred rites, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 71, 3. वि-भृत्राः = अग्नि-होत्रादि-कर्मणि विहरन्त्यः।)
43493: वि-भृत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who bears or sup-ports.
43494: विभ्रंश् वि-भ्रंश् (sometimes written वि-भ्रंस्), cl. 4. P., 1. A. -भ्रश्यति, -भ्रंशते, -भ्रंशितुम्, to fall down, fall, go to ruin, decay; to fall away, fall off; to disappear, vanish; to be unfortunate, fail; to fall away from, stray from, be separated from (with abl.); to be deprived of, lose: Caus. -भ्रंशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall off, strike or knock off, break off, to cause to fall, lead astray, seduce; to cause to disappear or vanish, destroy, annihilate, ruin; to divert from (with abl.), deprive of.
43495: वि-भ्रंश, अस्, m. falling away, &c.; a precipice.
43496: वि-भ्रंशित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to fall away; struck off, broken off; led astray, seduced; made to disappear, destroyed; deprived of. —विभ्रंशित-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of reason or consciousness. —विभ्रंशित-पुष्प-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the flowers and leaves knocked off.
43497: वि-भ्रंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling away, falling off; dropping, falling, fallen.
43498: वि-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen away or off, broken off or from, separated from, gone astray; fallen, de-cayed, failed, ruined, lost, disappeared, vanished. —विभ्रष्ट-तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम्, whose darkness has vanished or disappeared (said of the sky). —वि-भ्रष्ट-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from or deprived of joy.
43499: विभ्रम् वि-भ्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -भ्रमति, -भ्राम्यति, -भ्रमितुम्, to wander or roam about, roam through or over; to flit or hover about; to move to and fro, roll about; to disperse, scatter, scare or frighten away; to fall into disorder or confusion, become disarranged or bewildered: Caus. -भ्रम-यति, -भ्रामयति, -यितुम्, to confuse, perplex.
43500: वि-भ्रम, अस्, m. roaming or wandering about, whirling round, whirling or rolling about, going round, any whirling motion; error, mistake, blunder, erroneous use or application; hurry, confusion, agita-tion, perturbation, flurry (one of the classes of femi-nine action proceeding from love, as when a woman through flurry puts on her ornaments in the wrong places); amorous action of any kind; caprice, whim; beauty, grace; play (of the eyes); rapture; doubt, apprehension; (आ), f. old age. —विभ्रम-तन्त्र or विभ्रम-सूत्र, N. of a treatise on grammar (attributed to Hema-candra).
43501: वि-भ्रमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaming about, roaming through, whirling round.
43502: वि-भ्रमित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having whirled or frightened away.
43503: वि-भ्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, whirled about, agitated, bewildered, hurried, flurried, confused (through pre-cipitation &c.). —विभ्रान्त-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, having rolling eyes. —विभ्रान्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, bewildered or confused in mind. —विभ्रान्त-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, confused in mind or disposition; drunk, intoxicated, insane; (अस्), m. a monkey; the disk of the sun or moon.
43504: वि-भ्रान्ति, इस्, f. whirling round, going round, error, confusion; hurry, flurry, precipitation.
43505: विभ्राज् 1. वि-भ्राज्, cl. 1. A. -भ्राजते, -भ्रा-जितुम् (Ved. inf. विभ्राजम्), to shine forth, shine, glitter, gleam, be bright or radiant; to shine through: Caus. -भ्राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to radiate or beam or shine.
43506: 2. वि-भ्राज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining, splendid, luminous; elegant, richly dressed or decorated; (ट्), m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 170 (having the patronymic Saurya).
43507: वि-भ्राजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining, glittering.
43508: वि-भ्राजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, resplendent, glittering, shining, dazzling, radiant, bright.
43509: वि-भ्राजित, अस्, आ, अम्, made splendid or bright, caused to shine.
43510: वि-भ्राष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. radiance, flame, blaze.
43512: विमंह् वि-मंह्, cl. 1. A. -मंहते, &c., Ved. to distribute, bestow.
43513: वि-मंहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. distributing, giving.
43514: विमज्ज् वि-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, &c., to plunge or dive in, enter into, (probably wrongly for नि-मज्ज्): Caus. -मज्जयति, &c., to submerge, cause to plunge into or enter in.
43515: विमत वि-मत, वि-मति। See under वि-मन्।
43516: विमत्सर वि-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from envy or jealousy, unenvious, unambitious.
43517: विमथ् वि-मथ् or वि-मन्थ्, cl. 1. 9. P. -म-थति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति (Ved. generally A. -मथ्नीते), &c., -मथितुम्, -मन्थितुम्, to crush or dash to pieces, rend asunder, bruise (Ved. A.); to cut to pieces, annihilate, destroy, disperse, scatter; to confuse, perplex, bewilder, embarrass.
43518: वि-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or dashed to pieces, rent asunder, bruised, destroyed, annihilated.
43519: वि-मथ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, dashing to pieces, crush-ing, destroying.
43520: वि-मथ्य, ind. having crushed completely, having destroyed.
43521: वि-माथ, अस्, m. the act of crushing or destroy-ing utterly.
43522: वि-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or dashing to pieces, destroying.
43523: विमद् वि-मद्, cl. 4. P. -माद्यति (Ved. also -मदति), &c., -मदितुम्, to become perplexed or confused, be disconcerted; to confound, embarrass, disturb: Caus. -मादयति, &c., -यितुम्, to cause to be perplexed, to confuse, embarrass; to intoxicate.
43524: वि-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, intoxicated; being in rut, ruttish.
43525: वि-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, free from intoxication; joyless; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda X. 20-26 (having the patronymic Aindra or Prājāpatya; Vasu-kṛt Vāsukra is also regarded as the author of these hymns).
43526: वि-मदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), = वि-मत्त।
43527: विमध्य वि-मध्य, Ved. an unfathomable depth, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 51, 3. explains तमसो विमध्ये by अत्यन्त-गाढान्धकारे, ‘in un-fathomable darkness.’)
43528: विमन् वि-मन्, cl. 8. 4. A., 1. P. -मनुते, -मन्यते, -मनति, &c., -मन्तुम्, to distinguish (?, Ved.); to dishonour, offend: Caus. -मानयति, -यितुम्, to dishonour, slight, treat with disrespect.
43529: वि-मत, अस्, आ, अम्, disagreed, disagreeing, dis-senting, disapproving; at variance, inconsistent, averse, hostile to; slighted, despised, offended, displeased; of a different mind or disposition; (अस्), m. an enemy.
43530: वि-मति, इस्, f. difference of mind or opinion, dissent, disagreement; dislike, aversion; stupidity. —विमति-ता, f. difference of opinion, want of mind, stupidity.
43531: 1. वि-मान, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 2. see under 2. वि-मा), disrespect, dishonour.
43533: वि-मानित, अस्, आ, अम्, dishonoured, slighted, treated with disrespect.
43534: विमनस् वि-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, changed in mind or feeling; averse, displeased; out of one's mind, distraught, depressed in mind or spirit, sad, distressed, discomposed; heart-broken; absent in mind, thinking of something else; perplexed, dis-ordered, bewildered.
43535: वि-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, out of one's mind, de-pressed in spirit, heart-broken, sad, melancholy, be-wildered.
43536: विमनी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, altered in mind or feeling; displeased, offended; depressed in mind, sad, sorrowful.
43537: विमनी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become changed in mind or feeling; brought into a melancholy frame of mind.
43539: विमन्यु वि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from anger or passion, free from grief.
43540: विमय वि-मय, अस्, m. (see rt. मे), change, exchange, barter.
43544: विमल वि-मल, अस्, आ, अम्, stainless, free from dirt or impurity, spotless, pure, clean; white, transparent, beautiful; (अस्), m. an Arhat or Jaina deified sage; N. of the father of Padma-pāda; of a son of Su-dyumna; (आ), f. a particular plant, = सप्तला, (commonly called Charmaghās); a sort of soil; N. of Dākṣāyaṇī; (अम्), n. silver gilt; talc. —विमल-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —विमल-ता, f. or विमल-त्व, अम्, n. stainlessness, cleanliness, purity, clearness. —विमल-दान, अम्, n. a gift or offering to a deity. —विमल-नाथ-पुराण, N. of a Jaina work by Kṛṣṇa-dāsa. —विमल-प्रभा, f., N. of one of the wives of Narendrāditya. —विमल-मणि, इस्, m. ‘clear-gem,’ crystal. —विमलात्मक (°ल-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, pure-minded, clean, pure. —वि-मलात्मन् (°ल-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, pure-souled, unde-filed, pure. —विमलादित्य (°ल-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘clear-sun,’ a particular form of the sun. —विमलाद्रि (°ल-अद्°), इस्, m. ‘pure mountain,’ N. of the mountain Vimala or Girnar in Gujarāt, (this mountain is cele-brated for its inscriptions; it is also called Śatruñ-jaya, q. v.) —विमलार्थक (°ल-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of pure purpose, pure-minded; pure, clean, clear. —विम-लाश्व (°ल-अश्°), N. of a country in Kaśmīra. —विमली-करण, अम्, n. the act of making pure. —विमली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make clean or pure. —विमलेश्वर-तीर्थ (°ल-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a chapter in the Śiva-Purāṇa.
43545: विमलोग्य-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.
43546: विमस्तकित वि-मस्तकित, अस्, आ, अम्, be-headed, decapitated.
43547: विमहत् वि-महत्, आन्, अती, अत्, very great, immense.
43548: वि-महस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of various or excellent might or splendor, very vigorous, very brilliant or resplendent.
43549: वि-महि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. very large or great, (Sāy. = विशेषेण महत्।)
43550: विमा 1. वि-मा, cl. 3. A. -मिमीते, &c. (see rt. 2. मा), Ved. to bellow, roar, cry (?).
43551: विमा 2. वि-मा (see rt. 3. मा), cl. 2. P., 3. 4. A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मायते, -मातुम्, (Ved.) to measure out, to traverse, pass over (a course); (Ved.) to set in order, set right, prepare; to count, count over; to measure; to pervade; to make in various ways.
43552: 2. वि-मान, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 1. वि-मान see under वि-मन्), a measure; a car or chariot of the gods (sometimes serving as a seat or throne, sometimes self-moving and carrying its occupant through the skies; other descriptions make the Vimāna more like a house or palace, and one kind is said to be seven stories high; that of Rāvaṇa was called पुष्पक, q. v.); any car or vehicle; a horse; a palace, the palace of an emperor or supreme monarch. —विमान-गमन, अम्, n. ‘going in a car,’ N. of the fifty-second chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa. —विमान-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, travelling in a celestial car. —विमान-ता, f. the state or condition of a chariot. —विमान-प्रभुता, f. the ownership or possession of a celestial chariot. —विमान-यान, अस्, आ, अम्, going or driving in a car. —विमान-राज, अस्, m. the driver of a chariot of the gods. —विमान-वत्, ind. like a self-moving car, (Kirāt. VII. 4.) —वि-मान-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing on a divine chariot.
43553: वि-मिमान, अस्, आ, अम्, measuring out, preparing, making; measured, conceived, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 155, 6 = विविधम् मिमान।)
43554: विमांस वि-मांस, अस्, अम्, m. n. unclean meat (as the flesh of dogs &c.).
43555: विमातृ वि-मातृ, ता, f. a stepmother, a fa-ther's wife. —विमातृ-ज, अस्, m. a stepmother's son.
43557: विमाय वि-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of magic, free from illusion.
43558: विमार्ग वि-मार्ग, अस्, m. a bad road, by-road; a wrong road (literally or figuratively); evil conduct, immorality; a broom, brush; [cf. rt. मार्ग्।] —विमार्ग-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a wrong road, following an evil course.
43559: वि-मार्गण, अम्, n. the act of searching or seek-ing for.
43560: विमि वि-मि (see rt. 1. मि), cl. 5. P. A. -मि-नोति, -मिनुते, -मातुम्, Ved. to fix, build, erect.
43561: वि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed, built; (अम्), n., Ved. a square shed or large building resting on four posts.
43562: वि-मिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, fixing; (Sāy.) separating and fixing (= परि-च्छिन्दत् स्थापयत्, Ṛg-veda IV. 56. 1).
43563: विमिश्र् वि-मिश्र्, cl. 10. P. -मिश्रयति, -यि-तुम्, to mix or mingle together.
43564: वि-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed or mingled together, commingled.
43565: वि-मिश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed together, mingled; mixed with, attended or accompanied by.
43567: विमुख वि-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face turned away or cast down, averted; disinclined, op-posed. —विमुख-ता, f. or विमुख-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having the face averted, turning away; dis-inclination, opposition; disappearance, departure.
43568: विमुखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having the face averted, turned away; averse from, hostile. —विमुखि-ता, f. or वि-मुखि-त्व, अम्, n. a state of aversion, enmity; opposition; departure.
43569: विमुखी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make the face averted, turn away the face, turn away from, leave. —विमुखी-करण, अम्, n. the act of turning away or averting the face, leaving. —विमुखी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away from, averted, departed.
43570: विमुग्ध वि-मुग्ध। See under वि-मुह् below.
43571: विमुच् 1. वि-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to unloose, loosen, unharness, un-fasten, untie, release, set free, liberate; to take off (clothes), undress; to free from (with abl.); to leave off, stop, cease; to become loose (A.); to yield, re-linquish, quit, give up, lose; to emit, pour forth, shed, send forth; to assume, take: Pass. -मुच्यते, to be loosened, become detached; to be freed from (with abl. or inst.); to escape; to be deprived of (with inst.): Caus. -मोचयति, -यितुम्, to loosen, set free, unfasten, liberate: Desid. -मुमुक्षति, -ते, to wish to set free, &c.
43572: वि-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed, let loose, liberated; freed from (with inst. or abl., e. g. पाशैः or पाशे-भ्यो विमुक्तः, freed from fetters); quitted, aban-doned; issued from, given vent to; hurled, thrown, discharged. —विमुक्त-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a loosened throat or voice, raising a loud cry. —वि-मुक्त-प्रग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, having loosened reins.
43573: वि-मुक्ति, इस्, f. liberation, release, remission; escape, salvation, final emancipation (from all future existence); separation, parting. —विमुक्ति-पथ, अस्, m. the path or way of final emancipation.

43672: वि-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, discoloured, changed in colour; changed in disposition, disaffected, estranged, averse, indifferent; displeased; free from passion or affection, void of attachment to worldly objects, (in these senses वि appears to be privative); impassioned, feeling excessive passion, (in these senses वि only intensifies the root.) —विरक्त-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, disaffected at heart, estranged. —विरक्त-प्रकृति, इस्, इस्, इ, whose chiefs or principal officers are disaf-fected. —विरक्त-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, having the heart or affections estranged, disinclined to, disliking.
43673: वि-रक्ति, इस्, f. change of disposition or feeling, estrangement, alienation of mind, aversion, disincli-nation, dissatisfaction; absence of affection or attach-ment, freedom from passion, weanedness from the world, (in these senses वि appears to be privative.)
43674: वि-राग, अस्, m. change of colour or feeling, change of nature, (applied in Vedic grammar to the change in consonants which mutually affect each other); absence of desire or passion, indifference, disinclina-tion; disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in this world or the next; stoicism. —विराग-विष-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, cherishing the poison of dislike, har-bouring the poison of aversion. —विरागार्ह (°ग-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, qualified for freedom from passion.
43675: विरागिन्, ई, इणी, इ, changed in feeling, estranged; void of passion or desire.
43676: विरट विरट, अस्, m. a kind of black Agal-lochum; N. of a king.
43677: विरण् वि-रण्, Caus. -रणयति, -यितुम्, to make to sound forth, cause to sound, play upon (a musical instrument).
43678: विरण विरण, अम्, n. a fragrant grass used in certain religious ceremonies, Andropogon Aroma-ticum or Muricatum; [cf. वीरण।]
43679: विरथ वि-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having no car or chariot, chariotless.
43680: विरद् वि-रद्, cl. 1. P. -रदति, &c., Ved. to divide, separate, sever, cut through, open; to conduct, convey; to bestow.
43681: विरप्श् वि-रप्श् (according to some रप्श् may be fr. an old Desid. form of rt. रप् or रभ्, according to Sāy. रप्श् is fr. rt. रप् = लप्), cl. 1. A. -रप्शते, &c., Ved. to be full to overflowing, be ready to burst, to be distended or inflated; to have too much of (inst.); to be praised or hymned, (Sāy. = विविधं स्तूयते); to shine forth variously, (Sāy. = विविधं राजते); to sound forth, utter a murmuring sound.
43682: वि-रप्श, अम्, n., Ved. sound, voice, utterance, (Sāy. विरप्शम् = वाक्यम्; but in Ṛg-veda IV. 50, 3. विरप्शम् = विशेषेण शब्देन स्तोत्रं यथा भवति तथा।)
43683: वि-रप्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. copious, abundant, great, powerful, mighty, (according to Nirukta III. 3 = महत्); singing, sounding forth, loud-sounding, uttering various sounds of praise, having various sounds or utterances, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 20. विरप्शी = बहु-विध-शब्दवान्; in Ṛg-veda I. 8, 8. विरप्शी = विविध-वाक्य-युक्ता, and appears to be used for विरप्शिनी); shaking, tossing, rocking.
43684: विरम् वि-रम्, cl. 1. P. -रमति (rarely also A. -रमते), -रन्तुम्, to cease or desist from, rest from (with abl.); to leave off or discontinue anything (especially applied to discontinuing a speech, e. g. विरराम or even वचनं विरराम, he ceased speaking), stop, pause, end, come to an end (e. g. रात्रिर् व्यरंसीत्, the night ended): Caus. -रमयति, -रामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to leave off or discontinue, make to cease or desist from; to bring to an end, finish.
43685: वि-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, ceased from, desisting from (with abl., e. g. पापाद् विरतः, ceased from sin), stopped, ceased (e. g. विरतेषु मुनिषु, when the Munis had ceased speaking); rested, ended, con-cluded. —विरत-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has left off a habit or practice, one whose occupation has ceased, having no occupation. —विरताशय (°त-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desires have ceased, one who has resigned worldly intentions.
43686: वि-रति, इस्, f. cessation, discontinuance, stop, rest, pause, end, term; indifference.
43687: वि-रम, अस्, m. ceasing, desisting, cessation; sunset.
43688: वि-रमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, ceasing, desisting, resting, stopping; sporting or playing about.
43689: वि-रमित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made to cease, stopped.
43690: वि-रम्य, ind. having ceased or desisted.
43691: वि-राम, अस्, m. leaving off, cessation, rest, repose, discontinuance (of working, speaking, &c.); stop-page, stop, pause, pause of the voice, stoppage of sound; (in gram.) ‘the stop,’ N. of a small oblique stroke placed under a consonant to denote that it is quiescent, i. e. that it has no vowel inherent or other-wise pronounced after it, (this mark is sometimes used in the middle of conjunctions of consonants; but its proper use, according to native grammarians, is only as a stop at the end of a sentence ending in a conso-nant); end, conclusion, term; N. of Viṣṇu.
43692: विरल विरल, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps for विल-ल, possessing holes), having interstices, separated by intervals (whether of space or time); not close or compact, open in texture, not thick or dense, fine, thin, delicate; loose, relaxed, wide apart; rare, un-frequent; single; remote; little, few; (अम्), ind. rarely, seldom, unfrequently; (अम्), n. sour curds, coagulated milk (= दधि). —विरल-जानुक, अस्, m. ‘having knees wide apart,’ a bandy-legged man. —विरल-द्रवा, f. gruel made of rice or other grain with the addition of ghee, &c. (= श्लक्ष्ण-यवागू)। —विरलागत (°ल-आग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, happening rarely, of unfrequent occurrence, rare. —विरली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make rare, lessen, diminish. —विरलेतर (°ल-इत्°), अस्, &c., ‘other than wide apart,’ dense, thick, compact, close.
43693: विरलित, अस्, आ, अम्, not compacted, not dense, (अ-वि-रलित-कपोलम्, ind. with closely-united cheeks.)
43694: विरस् वि-रस्, cl. 1. P. -रसति, -रसितुम्, to cry out, cry aloud, scream, shriek.
43695: विरस वि-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, juiceless, sapless, flavourless, tasteless, insipid; painful; (अस्), m. pain.
43696: विरह् वि-रह्, cl. 1. 10. P. -रहति, -रहयति, -रहितुम्, &c., to abandon, desert, relinquish, leave.
43697: वि-रह, अस्, m. separation, parting, absence, (espe-cially) the separation of lovers; separation from (with inst.); loneliness, distance; want; abandonment, de-sertion, cessation, relinquishment. —विरह-गुणित, अस्, आ, अम्, increased by separation. —विरह-ज or विरह-जनित, अस्, आ, अम्, arising from or produced by separation. —विरह-ज्वर, अस्, m. the anguish of separation. —विरह-व्यापद्, त्, त्, त्, impaired or decreased by absence. —विरह-शयन, अम्, n. a solitary couch or bed, i. e. one slept on alone. —वि-रहाधिगम (°ह-अध्°), अस्, m. experiencing the absence of any one, (according to Malli-nātha = विरह-ज्ञान।) —विरहानल (°ह-अन्°), अस्, m. the fire of separation. —विरहार्त (°ह-आर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, pained by the absence of a lover. —विरहा-वस्था (°ह-अव्°), f. a state of separation or absence. —विरहोत्कण्ठिता (°ह-उत्°), f. a woman who longs after her absent lover or husband, one distressed by the absence of her husband (said to be one of the incidental characters in a drama).
43698: वि-रहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, abandoning, relinquish-ing, deserting.
43699: वि-रहय्य, ind. having abandoned, having for-saken, leaving.
43700: वि-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, deserted, for-saken, relinquished, left, left alone, solitary, lonely, retired or withdrawn from company, separated; de-void of, exempt from, bereft of, destitute of, free from (with inst. or at the end of a comp., and sometimes even with gen.).
43701: विरहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, being separated from, absent (from another), apart from; lonely, solitary; (इणी), f. a woman separated from her husband or suffering the pangs of absence from her lover; wages, hire.
43703: विराज् 1. वि-राज्, cl. 1. P. A. -राजति (in Ved. only P.), -ते, -राजितुम्, to reign over, rule, govern (Ved. P.); to be illustrious or eminent, be conspicuous, appear to advantage, shine forth, shine out, shine, glitter; to appear as: Caus. -राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine forth, make to glitter, fill with bright-ness, give radiance or lustre, brighten, illuminate.
43704: 2. वि-राज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining, radiant; (ट्), m. splendor, beauty; a man of the regal or military class; the first progeny of Brahmā, (according to Manu I. 32, &c., Brahmā having divided his own substance into male and female, produced from the female the male power Virāj, who then produced the first Manu or Manu Svāyambhuva, who then created the ten Prajā-patis; the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa states that the male half of Brahmā was Manu, and the other half Śata-rūpā, and does not allude to the intervention of Virāj; other Purāṇas describe the union of Śata-rūpā with Virāj or Puruṣa in the first instance, and with Manu in the second; as a sort of secondary creator, Virāj is sometimes called Prajā-pati, while in Ṛg-veda X. 90, 5. he is represented as born from Puruṣa, and Puruṣa from him; in the Atharva-veda VIII. 10, 24, XI. 8, 30, Virāj is spoken of as a female, and regarded as a cow, being elsewhere, however, identi-fied with Prāṇa); ‘ruler of the various forms of bodies,’ N. of Intellect located in and ruling over the collective aggregate of bodies, the consciousness which perceives collections or aggregates (in the Vedānta phil.); the body; N. of a son of Rādhā; of a district; (ट्), f. a particular Vedic metre consisting of four Pādas of ten syllables each, (in Ṛg-veda X. 130, 5. this metre is represented as attaching itself to Mitra and Varuṇa, and in Aitareya-Br. I. 4. Virāj is mystically regarded as ‘food,’ and invocations are directed to be made in this metre when food is the especial object of prayer.) —विराट्-कामा, f. a Vedic form of the Sammā metre. —विराट्-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a district. —विराट्-पूर्वा, f. a Vedic form of the Tri-ṣṭubh metre. —विराट्-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Virāj,’ epithet of a class of Pitṛs called Soma-sads (Manu III. 195). —विराट्-स्थाना, f. a Vedic form of the Tri-ṣṭubh metre. —विराट्-स्वरूप, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of Virāj, (applied to the Supreme Being.) —विराड्-देह, अस्, m. ‘having the body of Virāj,’ a term for the universe. —विराड्-रूपा, f. a Vedic form of the Tri-ṣṭubh metre (3 × 11 + 8 or rather + 7, giving forty syllables in all).
43706: वि-राजत्, अन्, अन्ती (ep. also अती), अत्, shining, splendid; handsome.
43707: वि-राजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, brilliant, splen-did, handsome, gorgeous.
43708: वि-राजयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shine, giving radiance or lustre to, brightening.
43709: वि-राजित, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminated, irradiated, splen-did; made visible, manifested.
43710: विराट विराट, अस्, m., N. of one of the midland or north-west districts of India (perhaps Berar); N. of an ancient king of a particular district in India, (the Pāṇḍavas being obliged to live in con-cealment during the thirteenth year of their exile, journied to the court of this king and entered his service in various disguises.) —विराट-ज, अस्, m. = राज-पट्ट, a sort of inferior diamond (said to be found in the country Virāṭa). —विराट-पर्वन्, अ, n., N. of the fourth book of the Mahā-bhārata (describ-ing the adventures of the Pāṇḍu princes when living in the service of king Virāṭa).
43711: विराटक, अस्, m. a diamond of inferior quality.
43712: विराणिन् वि-राणिन्, ई, m. (probably fr. rt. रण् with वि), an elephant.
43713: विराध् वि-राध्, cl. 4. P. -राध्यति, &c., -राद्धुम्, to lose or be deprived of anything (inst., Ved.); to hurt, offend, injure, do an injury: Caus. -राधयति, -यितुम्, to oppose, thwart, be at vari-ance, disagree.
43714: वि-राद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed, thwarted; injured, hurt, offended, treated with disrespect, reviled, abused.
43715: वि-राद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, opposing, thwarting; offending, injuring; abusive, calumnious.
43716: वि-राध, अस्, m. opposition, prevention; vexa-tion, annoyance; a kind of Rākṣasa.
43717: वि-राधन, अम्, n. the act of opposing, injuring, hurting; pain, agony, anguish.
43718: वि-राधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, opposing, being at variance, disagreeing with.
43720: वि-राध्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, opposing, thwarting; offending, annoying, injuring, being at variance.
43721: विराल विराल, अस्, m. = विडाल, a cat, q. v.
43723: विरि वि-रि or वि-री (see rts. 1. रि, री), cl. 9. P. A. -रिणाति, -रिणीते, -रेतुम्, Ved. to cleave asunder, separate, cut to pieces, kill, destroy, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 19, 3. वि-रिणाः = व्य्-अरिणाः = विशेषेण हतवान् असि।)
43724: विरिच् वि-रिच्, cl. 7. P. A. -रिणक्ति, -रिङ्क्ते, -रेक्तुम्, to empty, make empty, evacuate: Pass. -रिच्यते, to extend or be extended, reach out, sur-pass, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 16, 5. वि-रेचि = अति-रिरिचे, अधिको बभूव); to be emptied or purged: Caus. -रेचयति, -यितुम्, to cause purg-ing, purge, empty, make empty, cleanse, purify.
43725: वि-रिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, evacuated, emptied, purged.
43726: वि-रेक, अस्, m. purging, evacuation of the bowels; a purgative, cathartic.
43727: वि-रेचन, अम्, n. purging, evacuation of the bowels; a purgative. —विरेचन-द्रव्य, अम्, n. any purging substance or medicine.
43728: वि-रेचित, अस्, आ, अम्, purged, emptied, evacuated.
43729: वि-रेच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be purged or emptied.
43730: विरिञ्च वि-रिञ्च or वि-रिञ्चन, अस्, m. a N. of Brahmā.
43731: वि-रिञ्चि, इस्, m., N. of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva.
43732: विरिफित वि-रिफित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. de-prived of the sound of र्; pronounced or uttered with great effort.
43733: विरिब्ध वि-रिब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. रिभ् with वि), sounded; (अस्), m. a note, tone, sound (= स्वर).
43734: वि-रिभित, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 2, 18.
43735: वि-रेभित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, uttered.
43736: विरिश् वि-रिश् or वि-लिश् (see rt. रिश्), cl. 6. A. -रिशते, &c., Ved. to be dragged or rent apart, to be disarranged or disordered; to be torn off, break off, become rent or torn.
43737: वि-रिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. rent asunder, broken off, out of due order; (अम्), n. a defect in a sacri-fice, (also written वि-लिष्ट।)
43739: विरु वि-रु, cl. 2. P. -रौति, -रवीति, -रवितुम्, to roar aloud, scream or shout out, cry, buzz, hum, yell, bray; to sound, jingle, rattle; to lament, weep, appeal to with lamentations, call on, invoke: Caus. -रावयति, -यितुम्, to roar or scream aloud, fill with noise or clamour; to make to sound or resound.
43740: वि-रव, अस्, m., Ved. outcry, clamour, sound, noise.
43741: वि-राव, अस्, m. crying or shouting out, clamour, sound, noise.
43742: वि-राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, shouting or roaring out, re-sounding, crying, singing; lamenting; (इणी), f. weep-ing, crying; a broom; N. of a river.
43743: वि-रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, roared aloud, screamed; re-sounded, resounding, filled with cries, (मयूर-विरुत, filled with the cries of peacocks); (अम्), n. shrieking, howling, crying, singing, humming (of bees), chirping; clamour, noise, din, howling (of the wind &c.), sound, tone.
43744: वि-रुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, howling, crying, shrieking, &c.
43745: विरुच् वि-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते (Ved. also P. -रोचति, in Raghu-v. VI. 5. and in one or two other later works the Aor. P. व्य्-अरुचत् is found), -रोचितुम्, to shine forth, glitter, be bright or radiant; to be conspicuous, become visible, appear; to become eminent or famous; to cause to shine, illuminate, make bright (P.); to please, delight: Caus. -रोच-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine, illuminate, brighten; to find pleasure in, delight in; to sport with.
43746: विरुक्मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. shining, brilliant, splendid; (आन्), m. a bright weapon.
43747: वि-रोक, अस्, m. a ray of light; (अम्), n. a hole, chasm.
43748: वि-रोकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. shining, glowing, gleam-ing, bright.
43749: वि-रोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, illuminating; (अस्), m. the sun; the moon; fire; N. of the son of Prahlāda or Prahrāda; (अम्), n. (?), light, lustre. —विरोचन-वध, अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa. —विरोचन-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Virocana,’ epithet of Bali (sovereign of Mahābali-pura).
43750: वि-रोचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, glittering, radiant.
43751: वि-रोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shine, mak-ing bright.
43752: वि-रोचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, shining; illuminating, making visible.
43753: विरुज् वि-रुज्, cl. 6. P. -रुजति, -रोक्तुम्, to break to pieces, tear asunder; to destroy.
43754: वि-रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (less correctly written वि-रुग्न), broken to pieces, torn asunder; bent; blunted; destroyed.
43755: वि-रुज्य, ind. having broken to pieces, having torn asunder.
43756: विरुद् वि-रुद्, cl. 2. P. -रोदिति, -रोदितुम्, to weep or cry aloud, sob, lament, bewail.
43757: वि-रुद, अस्, m. crying; proclaiming; a laudatory poem, panegyric. —विरुदावली (°द-आव्°), f., N. of a poem by Raghu-deva celebrating the praises of a certain king of Mithilā.
43758: वि-रुदित, अम्, n. loud lamentation, intense grief, bewailing.
43759: विरुध् 1. वि-रुध् (= वि-रुह्), cl. 1. P. -रो-धति, &c., Ved. to grow or sprout out, shoot forth.
43760: विरुध् 2. वि-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to hinder, obstruct; to en-counter opposition (A., Ved.): Pass. -रुध्यते (ep. also P. -ति), to be impeded or checked or kept back or withheld; to be opposed to, contend with, com-bat (with inst., or with inst. and सह, or with gen., or with loc., or with acc. and प्रति); to be at variance, disagree, be inconsistent; to fail: Caus. -रोधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to hinder or obstruct, to render hostile, set at variance; to oppose, en-counter, fight against, contend with: Pass. of Caus. -रोध्यते, to be impeded or kept back; to be ren-dered hostile or set at variance: Desid. -रुरुत्सति, to wish to oppose, intend commencing hostility.

43762: वि-रोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed, to be obstructed, &c.

(in rhetoric) ‘the ornament of contradiction,’ a particular figure of speech or mode of writing. —विरोधोक्ति (°ध-उक्°), इस्, f. adverse or contradictory speech, quarrel, dispute, mutual contradiction.
43764: वि-रोधक, अस्, इका, अम्, opposing, contradicting, incongruous.
43765: वि-रोधन, अम्, n. the act of opposing, hinder-ing, obstructing, preventing, blockading, besieging, encountering, defying; opposition, resistance, con-tradiction; incongruity, inconsistency.
43766: वि-रोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed, contended against, fought with, rendered hostile, set at variance.

43768: 1. वि-रोध्य, ind. having opposed, having con-tended with.
43769: 2. वि-रोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed or con-tended against.

43771: वि-रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, very angry, very much irri-tated.
43772: वि-रुष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being very angry at (with gen.).
43773: वि-रोष, अस्, आ, अम्, very angry, wrathful.
