45657: व्य्-आपन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen into misfortune, miscarried, failed; dead, deceased, expired, killed, perished; diseased; deranged, disordered; hurt, injured; changed, altered, substituted (as one letter or symbol for another, especially applied to the change of the Visarjanīya or Visarga to its corres-ponding sibilants; when this symbol remains un-changed it is called विक्रान्त).
45658: व्य्-आपाद, अस्, m. destroying, destruction, ruin, injury, evil design, the wish or project to injure another.
45659: व्यापादक, अस्, इका, अम्, destructive, murderous.
45660: व्य्-आपादन, अम्, n. the act of destroying, de-struction, killing, slaying; malice.
45661: व्य्-आपादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed, liable to death, worthy of death or destruction. —व्यापाद-नीय-ता, f. the necessity of being killed.
45662: व्य्-आपादयितव्य or व्य्-आपाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed, to be put to death.
45663: व्य्-आपादित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, killed, slain; hurt, injured. —व्यापादित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has killed or destroyed.
45664: व्यापृ व्य्-आ-पृ (वि-आ-), cl. 6. A. -प्रियते, -पर्तुम्, to be occupied or engaged in (with loc.); to be busy or occupied about anything (with अर्थम् or हेतोः at the end of a comp.), be employed or placed in any office: Caus. -पारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be employed, set to work, set in motion or action; to occupy with, engage upon (with loc., rarely with inst.); to employ, use, apply to any use or purpose, entrust with, charge, commission, place (in any office); to place, set, fix (e. g. व्यापारया-मास करम्, he placed his hand; व्यापारयामास विलोचनानि, he fixed his eyes).
45665: व्य्-आपार, अस्, m. occupation, employment, busi-ness, trade, profession; exercise, practice, exertion, activity; work, affair, operation, action, act, trans-action, doing, performance. —व्यापारावेश (°र-आव्°), अस्, m. the arising of a determination or resolve (in phil.).
45666: व्य्-आपारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, setting to work, em-ploying; busying, exercising; placing; moving.
45667: व्य्-आपारित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to be busy, set to work, engaged, occupied, employed.
45668: व्यापारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, occupied, busy; transacting business; engaged in trade, a dealer, trader, agent; exercising, practising; causing action or motion, moving, motive.
45669: व्य्-आपृत, अस्, आ, अम्, occupied, engaged or occu-pied in (with loc.), engaged, employed, busy, ap-pointed to any office; (अस्), m. a minister, employé, chargé d'affaires (= कर्म-सचिव).
45670: व्य्-आप्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being occupied or engaged in (with loc.).
45672: व्याभञ्ज् व्य्-आ-भञ्ज् (वि-आ-), cl. 7. P. -भ-नक्ति, -भङ्क्तुम्, to break to pieces, shatter.
45673: व्य्-आभग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, ṣat-tered.
45674: व्याभाष् व्य्-आ-भाष् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. A. -भा-षते, -भाषितुम्, to speak to, address; to profess, declare.
45675: व्य्-आभाषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking to, ad-dressing.
45676: व्य्-आभाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken to, addressed; spoken, pronounced [cf. दुःख-व्°]; (अम्), n. a speech.
45677: व्याभुज् व्य्-आ-भुज् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्तुम्, to bend.
45679: व्याभ्युक्षी व्य्-आभ्य्-उक्षी, f. (probably fr. rt. 1. उक्ष् with अभि, आ, and वि, cf. व्य्-आत्य्-उक्षी), gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure.
45680: व्याम व्याम, अस्, m. (probably for व्य्-आयाम, q. v.), a fathom or the space between the tips of the fingers of either hand when the arms are extended; disregard, disrespect (?); smoke (?).
45682: व्यामर्ष 1. व्य्-आमर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. मृष् with आ and वि), impatience.
45683: व्यामर्ष 2. व्य्-आमर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. मृश् with आ and वि), rubbing out, erasure.
45684: 1. व्य्-आमृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed out, effaced, rubbed.
45685: व्यामिश्र व्य्-आ-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, intermixed, blended together, mingled, confused.
45686: व्यामील्य व्य्-आ-मील्य, ind. (fr. rt. मील् with आ and वि), having closed and opened, having twinkled, &c.
45687: व्यामुच् व्य्-आ-मुच् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्-चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to emit, discharge.
45688: व्य्-आमोक, अस्, m. release or freeing from, getting rid of.
45689: व्यामुह् व्य्-आ-मुह् (वि-आ-), cl. 4. P. -मुह्यति, &c., to become stupified or bewildered, to be infatu-ated: Caus. -मोहयति, -यितुम्, to stupify, bewilder, perplex, infatuate.
45690: व्य्-आमूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely stupified, thoroughly infatuated or bewildered, bewitched.
45691: व्य्-आमोह, अस्, m. bewilderment, embarrassment, error, foolishness.
45692: व्य्-आमोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, infatuated.
45693: व्यामृज् व्य्-आ-मृज् (वि-आ-), cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि, &c., to rub off.
45694: 2. व्य्-आमृष्ट, rubbed off. —व्यामृष्ट-ति-लक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has the Tilaka mark rubbed off.
45695: व्यायम् व्य्-आ-यम् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -यच्छति (Ved. and ep. also A. -ते), -यन्तुम्, -यमितुम्, to draw apart or asunder, stretch or draw out, extend; to drag or tear off (P.); to struggle or contend about (loc.), fight together (usually A.); to make efforts, strive, endeavour; to sport, dally: Caus. -यमयति or -यामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stretch out or struggle, make great effort or exertion, take exercise.
45696: व्य्-आयच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, struggling or contend-ing about.
45697: व्य्-आयच्छमान, अस्, आ, अम्, struggling or con-tending together; fighting, quarrelling.
45698: व्य्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn asunder, separated, drawn out, extended, long, tall; expanded, wide open; exercised, disciplined; busy, engaged, occupied; hard, firm; mighty, powerful, strong, intense, deep, much, excessive; (अम्), ind. excessively. —व्यायत-त्व, अम्, n. firmness. —व्यायत-पात, अस्, m. a strong or intense blow, a deep stroke (= अवगाढ).
45699: व्य्-आयाम, अस्, m. drawing or stretching out; a particular measure of length (= a fathom measured by the two extended arms, cf. व्याम); struggling, struggle, contention; fatigue, labour; exercise, exer-tion, manliness, manly effort, athletic or gymnastic exercise (e. g. playing with heavy clubs, drawing a bow with a chain in place of a string, alternate rising and falling at full length on the ground, &c.); busi-ness, occupation; a difficult passage or impassable defile, any difficulty. —व्यायाम-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, accustomed to exertion or exercise, fond of taking exercise, active, robust, athletic.
45700: व्यायामिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to exercise or exertion, gymnastic, athletic.
45701: व्यायामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking exercise, undergoing fatigue, active, athletic.
45702: व्य्-आयाम्य, ind. having made exertion or effort, having taken exercise, having practised gymnastics, having made to undergo exercise or exertion.
45703: व्यायुज् व्य्-आ-युज् (वि-आ-), cl. 7. P. A. -यु-नक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to disunite, separate, part, become disunited.
45704: व्य्-आयुज्य, ind. having disjoined or separated.
45705: व्य्-आयोग, अस्, m. a kind of dramatic representa-tion or composition in one act (belonging to the Prakaraṇa class, and describing some military or heroic exploit in which no part of the interest is derived from female participation, the sentiment of love being thereby excluded).
45706: व्यारब्ध व्य्-आ-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. रभ् with आ and वि), Ved. held on every side, upheld, maintained, properly carried into effect.
45707: व्याल व्याल, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with व्याड, q. v.), wicked, villainous, bad; cruel, fierce; vicious; (अस्), m. a villain, cheat, rogue; a snake; a beast of prey; a tiger; a hunting leopard; a vicious elephant; a king; N. of Viṣṇu; a species of the Daṇḍaka metre; (ई), f. a female snake; [cf. Old Germ. and Angl. Sax. al.] —व्याल-खड्ग, अस्, m. = व्याल-नख below. —व्याल-गन्धा, f. the ichneumon plant (= नाकुली). —व्याल-ग्राह, अस्, m. a snake-catcher. —व्याल-ग्राहिन्, ई, m. a snake-catcher, one who lives by catching and exhi-biting snakes. —व्याल-जिह्वा, f. a kind of plant (= महा-समङ्गा). —व्याल-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, very fierce or cruel. —व्याल-दंष्ट्र, अस्, m. a kind of plant (= गो-क्षुर). —व्याल-नख, अस्, m. a kind of medicinal herb with a fragrant root (in Hindī called बघ्नहा = व्याघ्र-नख). —व्याल-पत्त्रा, f. a kind of cucumber (= एर्वारु). —व्याल-पाणि-ज, अस्, m. = व्याल-नख. —व्याल-बल, अस्, m. = व्याल-नख. —व्याल-मृग, अस्, m. a fierce animal, wild stag; a hunting leopard. —व्याल-रूप, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva. —व्याल-वत्, ind. like a serpent; like a beast of prey. —व्यालायुध (°ल-आय्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. a sort of vegetable perfume (= व्याल-नख, नखी, व्याडायुध).
45708: व्यालक, अस्, m. a vicious elephant.
45709: व्यालम्ब् व्य्-आ-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, -लम्-बितुम्, to hang down; to stay behind, linger, delay.
45710: व्य्-आलम्ब, अस्, m. the red Ricinus or castor-oil plant.
45711: व्यालिख् व्य्-आ-लिख् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखितुम्, to scratch or scrape against, rub against, touch, graze; to make an incision, scratch, draw lines, write.
45712: व्य्-आलिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scratching, scrap-ing, piercing; touching, grazing, extending to; draw-ing lines, delineating.
45713: व्यालीन व्य्-आलीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ली with आ and वि), clinging or sticking close together, cluster-ing, dense, thick.
45714: व्यालुड् व्य्-आ-लुड्, Caus. -लोडयति, -यितुम्, to stir about, agitate.
45715: व्य्-आलोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, = मथित, stirred about, agitated.
45716: व्यालुप् व्य्-आ-लुप् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -लुम्पति, -लोप्तुम्, to take away, carry off, remove: Pass. -लुप्यते, to be broken asunder or destroyed, be divided, be removed, to disappear.
45717: व्यालू व्य्-आ-लू (वि-आ-), cl. 9. P. A. -लुनाति, -लुनीते, -लवितुम्, to cut off, cut away.
45718: व्य्-आलून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off. —व्यालून-मूर्-धज, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has the hair cut off.
45719: व्यालोल व्य्-आलोल, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling about, quivering, tremulous, shaking, waving. —व्यालोल-कुन्तल-कलाप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having dishevelled locks of hair.
45721: व्यावकलन व्य्-आवकलन, अम्, n. = व्य्-अव-कलन, subtraction (in arithmetic).
45723: व्यावक्रोशी व्य्-आवक्रोशी, f. (fr. rt. क्रुश् with अव, आ, and वि), mutual abuse or imprecation.
45724: व्यावप् व्य्-आ-वप् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -व-पति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to sow, scatter, strew, (according to some the Ved. व्यावपाति, Pāṇ. III. 1, 34, is for व्यावयाति।)
45725: व्यावभाषी व्य्-आवभाषी, f. (fr. rt. भाष् with अव, आ, and वि), mutual abuse or imprecation; [cf. व्य्-आवक्रोशी above.]
45726: व्यावर्ण् व्य्-आ-वर्ण् (वि-आ-), cl. 10. P. -वर्-णयति, -यितुम्, to enumerate, describe, narrate.
45727: व्य्-आवर्ण्य, ind. having narrated in detail.
45729: व्यावल्ग् व्य्-आ-वल्ग् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -वल्-गति, &c., to jump, skip, leap; to gallop; to move quickly about, quiver, throb, be agitated.
45730: व्य्-आवल्गत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, jumping, leaping, &c.; throbbing, being agitated.
45731: व्य्-आवल्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, jumped, moved, agitated.
45732: व्यावहारिक व्यावहारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. व्य्-अवहार), relating to business or practice or action, practical, active; belonging to judicial procedure, judicial, legal; what has to be dealt with or is practised or intended for use, practicable, customary, usual, cur-rent; (अस्), m. a counsellor, minister; (अम्), n. use. —व्यावहारिक-त्व, अम्, n. practicalness; the state of belonging to the period of action.
45733: व्यावहारी व्य्-आवहारी, f. (fr. rt. हृ with अव, आ, and वि), mutual seizing or taking (Vopa-deva XXVI. 177).
45734: व्यावहासी व्य्-आवहासी, f. (fr. rt. हस् with अव, आ, and वि), mutual derision, reciprocal laughter.
45735: व्याविध व्य्-आ-विध, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. वि-ध), of various kinds, multifarious, omnigenous.
45736: व्यावृ व्य्-आ-वृ (वि-आ-), cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम्, to cover over, conceal; to obstruct, stop; to choose, select; to open, (but forms like व्य्-आवर् in Ved. are referred to वि-वृ, q. v.)
45737: व्य्-आवृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing or hiding one's self.
45738: व्य्-आवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, screened; obstructed; excluded, excepted, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृत्त); uncovered, opened, (in this sense वि is rather privative.)
45739: व्य्-आवृति, इस्, f. covering, screening; exclusion; [cf. व्य्-आवृत्ति।]
45740: 1. व्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having covered over; having obstructed or stopped.
45741: व्यावृज् व्य्-आ-वृज् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -वर्जति, &c., -वर्जितुम्, to exclude from; to divide or sepa-rate into parts.
45742: व्य्-आवृज्य, ind. having separated or divided.
45743: व्यावृत् व्य्-आ-वृत् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. A. (in cer-tain tenses also P., see rt. 1. वृत्), -वर्तते, -वर्ति-तुम्, to become separated or singled out from (with inst.); to become separate or distinct, keep apart; to be split asunder or opened; to turn away from, become averted, go away, depart; to roll or turn back, return; to turn round, go round, revolve; to go down, set (said of the sun); to come to an end, cease, perish: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to separate from (with inst. or abl.); to turn away, turn out, set aside, exclude, put aside, lay down, remove, take away, destroy, overrule, annul; to throw down, throw about, strew; to turn about or round, cause to revolve; to retract; to exchange, substitute one for another, to contrive (?) : Pass. of Caus. -वर्त्यते, to be excluded, &c.: Desid. -वृत्सते, to wish to separate from, &c.
45744: व्य्-आवर्त, अस्, m. separating from, selecting, revo-lution, going round; encompassing, surrounding, en-closing; ruptured navel, umbilical hernia (= नाभि-कण्टक).
45745: व्य्-आवर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, separating from, ex-cluding, excepting; turning away from; turning round; encircling, encompassing. —व्यावर्तक-ता, f. state of excluding, exclusion.
45746: व्य्-आवर्तन, अम्, n. the act of turning round or away, rolling round, revolving; a volute, fold, band; encompassing, surrounding.
45747: व्य्-आवर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming separated from, keeping apart from; turning away; desisting, ceasing; turning back.
45748: व्य्-आवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to turn away, made to desist, made to revolve; exchanged.
45749: व्य्-आवर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded or excepted.
45750: व्य्-आवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated or singled out from; excluded, excepted, free from (with inst.); opened, split asunder; turned away from, turned back, returned, desisted, desisting, ceased; turned round, re-volved; encompassed, surrounded; fenced, screened, (probably for व्य्-आवृत); praised, hymned (?). —व्या-वृत्त-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, turned back from a course, desisting from any course of action. —व्यावृत्त-त्व, अम्, n. the being separated or excluded from, &c.; the being non-extensive, (defined to be अल्प-देश-वृत्तित्वम्, the existing in few places, i. e. comprising but few individuals, said of a species in relation to its genus; opposed to अधिक-देश-वृत्तित्वम्, the characteristic of a genus viewed in relation to the species it contains.) —व्यावृत्त-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, having the body severed or split asunder. —व्यावृत्त-बुद्धि, इस्, f. ‘limited conception,’ the conception of a class denoting few individuals, i. e. of a class contained in a higher class. —व्यावृत्त-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head turned round.
45751: व्य्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. separation from, selecting, selec-tion, choice, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृति); exception, ex-clusion, rejection; turning away; rolling back; roll-ing round, surrounding; screening, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृति); praise, eulogium.
45752: 2. व्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having separated from, having parted with (with inst.), having turned or rolled away, having turned back.
45753: व्याव्यध् व्य्-आ-व्यध् (वि-आ-), cl. 4. P. -विध्-यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to throw about; to brandish, wave about.
45754: व्य्-आविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or tossed about, dishevelled; glancing or darting in all directions; interlaced.
45755: व्य्-आविध्य, ind. having brandished or waved about.
45757: व्यासञ्ज् व्य्-आ-सञ्ज् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सङ्क्तुम्, to attach firmly to, fasten on; to adhere separately or severally.
45758: व्य्-आसक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, firmly attached to or con-nected with, adhering closely to (any one or any-thing), devoted to, intent on, occupied with; inher-ing separately; detached, disjoined, (in this sense वि is privative); bewildered, confused.
45759: व्य्-आसङ्ग, अस्, m. excessive attachment, close adherence, devotion or addiction to, resting or sitting on; close attachment (of the thoughts), attention, assiduous application, diligent study; addition; de-tachment, separation, (in this sense वि is privative); perplexity, confusion.
45760: व्यासङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attaching one's self or apply-ing closely to (anything).

45770: व्य्-आहरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, uttering, pronouncing, speaking; uttering a cry (as an animal).
45771: व्य्-आहर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be told or declared or mentioned.
45772: व्य्-आहार, अस्, m. utterance, speech, voice; a word, articulate sound, language; jest, joke, humorous speech, facetious allusion (a particular Alaṅkāra or figure in rhetoric).
45773: व्य्-आहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking, saying.
45774: व्य्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, uttered, pronounced, said, declared. —व्याहृत-सन्देश, अस्, आ, अम्, one who tells news or communicates information.
45775: व्य्-आहृति, इस्, f. utterance, speech, voice; an utter-ance, articulate sound, word; a mystical word pro-nounced after ॐ by every Brāhman in commencing his daily prayers, (cf. Manu II. 76; भूर्, भुवः, स्वर् are the three great Vyāhṛtis, and महर्, q. v., is said to be a fourth mystical word, cf. महा-व्याहृति।) —व्याहृति-त्रय, अम्, n. the three Vyā-hṛtis or mystical words (described above). —व्याहृति-पूर्वक, अस्, इका, अम्, preceded by the three mystical words भूर्, भुवः, स्वर्।
45776: व्य्-आहृत्य, ind. having uttered, having spoken.
45777: व्याह्वे व्य्-आ-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, &c., to call separately or distinctly.
45778: व्य्-आहाव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a separate or distinct call.
45779: व्यु व्य्-उ (वि-उ), cl. 5. P. -उनोति, Ved. to urge on, drive forward; to incite, animate, (Sāy. = प्रेरयति, Ṛg-veda V. 31, 1.)
45780: व्युक्ष् व्य्-उक्ष् (वि-उक्ष्, see rt. 1. उक्ष्), cl. 6. P. A. -उक्षति, -ते, -उक्षितुम्, Ved. to sprinkle or pour out; to drip or flow or trickle over (A.).
45781: व्युच्चर् व्य्-उच्-चर् (वि-उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to go forth in different direc-tions; to go out of the right path; to transgress or offend against, be faithless or disloyal towards (with acc.); to commit adultery with (with inst.).
45782: व्य्-उच्चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, offending against, being faithless towards (with acc.); committing adultery.
45783: व्य्-उच्चरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, offending against, being faithless towards (with acc.).
45785: व्युच्छिद् व्य्-उच्-छिद् (वि-उद्-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut entirely off, extirpate, cut up, destroy: Pass. -छिद्यते (ep. also P. -छिद्यति), to be entirely cut off, be extirpated; to be interrupted, come to an end, become extinct, cease, fail.
45786: व्य्-उच्छित्ति, इस्, f. cutting off, cutting away, cutting short, destruction, rooting up, extirpation.
45787: व्य्-उच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, extirpated, com-pletely destroyed, interrupted, come to an end, ceased.
45788: व्य्-उच्छेत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what cuts off or destroys, a destroyer.
45789: व्य्-उच्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off, cutting short, de-struction.
45790: व्युत व्य्-उत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वे), inter-woven, woven, sewn; separated, (Sāy. = विविक्त); stretched out, expanded, (according to Sāy. in this sense fr. rt. व्ये।)
45791: व्य्-उति, इस्, f. interweaving, weaving, sewing.
45792: व्य्-ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, interwoven, &c. = व्य्-उत above.
45794: व्युत्क्रम् व्य्-उत्-क्रम् (वि-उद्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go apart or in different directions, go in a wrong direction, go astray; to go or pass by, go beyond, overstep, deviate, go out of the right way, transgress; to dis-regard, neglect; to go away, depart, leave.
45795: व्य्-उत्क्रम, अस्, m. going astray or out of the right course, going or passing beyond, transgression, inverted order, reverse or irregular arrangement, de-rangement, disorder, confusion, contrariety.
45796: व्य्-उत्क्रम्य, ind. having gone forth, having left; having passed by or gone beyond.
45797: व्य्-उत्क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone asunder, gone forth, departed, left; passed by, gone beyond, over-stepped, transgressed, disregarded, neglected; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —व्युत्क्रान्त-धर्म, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has overstepped his duty, neg-lectful of duty. —व्युत्क्रान्त-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one whose impurity has gone away, free from passion. —व्युत्क्रान्त-वर्त्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one who has gone beyond the right path.
45798: व्य्-उत्क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going asunder, going forth.
45799: व्युत्था व्य्-उत्-था (वि-उद्-स्था), Caus. -था-पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rise up, stir up, excite greatly, rouse, instigate, incite, irritate.
45800: व्य्-उत्थान, अम्, n. ‘excessive rising up,’ great activity; a kind of dancing or gesticulation; rising up against, opposition, contradiction, doing anything prohibited, obstruction, hindering; separate or indi-vidual exertion, independent action, following one's own inclination; the completion of a religious act or vow (as of contemplation or abstraction).
45801: व्य्-उत्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to rise up, roused, brought up.
45802: व्युत्पद् व्य्-उत्-पद् (वि-उद्-पद्), cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to arise or originate clearly or in any well ascertained manner, to be produced from or out of; to originate; (in grammar) to be derived (from a root &c.); to have an etymology; to be an accomplished scholar, become perfectly proficient in or conversant with: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to issue out of, produce, cause; (in gram-mar) to derive, trace back to a root &c.
45803: व्य्-उत्पत्ति, इस्, f. production, origin, derivation (especially of words from roots &c.), etymology; per-fection, completion, perfect conversancy with or pro-ficiency in (literature or science); scholarship, learn-ing. —व्युत्पत्ति-पक्षे, ind. on the side of deri-vation or etymology (an expression used by Vedic commentators when the accentuation is settled by the affixes and not according to the meaning of the words).
45804: व्य्-उत्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, generated, begotten; derived (from a root &c.; अ-व्युत्पन्-नम्, an underived or primitive word); formed (as a derivative word); completed, perfected, finished, ac-complished; quite conversant with or proficient in (literature &c.); learned.
45805: व्य्-उत्पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, giving rise to, pro-ducing, originating, productive; tracing or forming (words).
45806: व्य्-उत्पाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, derivable, deducible, capable of being formed &c.
45807: व्य्-उत्पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), desirous of making proficiency (in any science).
45808: व्युत्सद् व्य्-उत्-सद् (वि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्, to be unsettled; to be upset or overthrown.
45809: व्युद् व्य्-उद् or व्य्-उन्द् (वि-उद्, &c.), cl. 7. P. -उनत्ति, -उन्दितुम्, Ved. to spring or gush forth; to wet or sprinkle thoroughly, water, drench.
45810: व्य्-उत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well sprinkled or wetted, drenched.
45811: व्य्-उन्दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. wetting thoroughly, sprinkling.
45812: व्य्-उन्दन, अम्, n. the act of well moistening or wetting.
45813: व्युदस् व्य्-उद्-अस् (वि-उद्-), cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to throw or scatter about, cast in every direction; to throw off, cast off, reject, lay aside, give up, abandon, exclude.
45814: व्य्-उदस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or scattered about, cast off, put off, thrown aside.
45815: व्य्-उदस्य, ind. having thrown or scattered in all directions, having thrown off or put away, having thrown aside or abandoned.
45816: व्य्-उदास, अस्, m. throwing or scattering in dif-ferent directions, throwing away or aside, rejection, exclusion (in grammar); prohibition; disregard for, indifference to.
45817: व्युदित व्य्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वद् with वि), disputed, debated, discussed, contested.
45818: व्युदूह् व्य्-उद्-ऊह् (वि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to push apart or asunder, move away, move out, remove; to sweep out or away.
45819: व्य्-उदूह्य, ind. having moved or placed asunder, having removed.
45820: व्युपदेश व्य्-उपदेश, अस्, m. pretext, pre-tence, plausible but false plea, deception.
45821: व्युपनी व्य्-उप-नी (वि-उप-), cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, Ved. to lead or bring sepa-rately or one by one.
45822: व्युपयुज् व्य्-उप-युज् (वि-उप-), cl. 7. A. -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to become closely attached, be concerned about.
45823: व्युपरम् व्य्-उप-रम् (वि-उप-), cl. 1. A. -र-मते (ep. also P. -ति), -रन्तुम्, to leave off or pause variously; to be at rest, be tranquil, have repose; to cease, desist from (with abl.).
45824: व्य्-उपरत, अस्, आ, अम्, paused, rested, stopped, interrupted, ceased, desisted; calmed, tranquillized, tranquil.
45825: व्य्-उपरम, अस्, m. pause, cessation, interruption.
45826: व्य्-उपरमम्, ind., Ved. leaving off or pausing variously.
45827: व्य्-उपरम्य, ind. having ceased or desisted from (with abl.), having stopped.
45828: व्युपशम व्य्-उपशम, अस्, m. non-cessation, not ceasing or desisting; inquietude.
45829: व्युपारम् व्य्-उपा-रम् (वि-उप-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रमते (ep. P. -ति), -रन्तुम्, to desist from, leave off, cease.
45830: व्युपास् व्य्-उपास् (वि-उप-अस्), cl. 4. P. -उपास्-यति, -उपासितुम्, to throw about, distribute.
45831: व्युप्त व्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वप्), scat-tered about, disordered, dishevelled. —व्युप्त-केश, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having dishevelled hair; (अस्), m. epi-thet of Rudra and Fire (as identified with Rudra).
45832: व्युब्ज् व्य्-उब्ज् (वि-उब्ज्), cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, -उब्जितुम्, Ved. to uncover, open, display.
45833: व्युष् 1. व्युष् (also read प्युष्), cl. 4. P. व्युष्यति, &c., to burn, (in this sense perhaps for rt. 1. उष् with वि); to divide, distribute, (in this sense also written प्युस्, पुष्, ब्युस्, बुस्); cl. 10. P. व्योषयति, -यितुम्, to reject, discharge, emit, (in this sense also written पुस्।)
45834: 1. व्युष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, (perhaps to be written व्य्-उष्ट, see above.)
45835: व्युष् 2. व्य्-उष् (for 1. वि-वस्, q. v., cf. 2. उष्), cl. 6. P. -उच्छति, &c., Ved. to shine forth, shine, dawn, arise.
45836: व्य्-उच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. shining forth, dawning, (according to Sāy. व्युच्छन्ती = तमो वर्जयन्ती, Ṛg-veda I. 49, 4.)
45837: व्य्-उच्छन, अम्, n. shining forth, opening, mani-festation.
45838: 3. व्य्-उष्, f., Ved. shining forth, dawning, (ac-cording to Sāy. व्युषि = व्युच्छने सति, Ṛg-veda V. 45, 8, = विवासने or प्रकाशने सति, Ṛg-veda VII. 81, 2.)
45839: 1. व्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = 2. व्य्-उष्ट below.
45840: 2. व्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dawned, become day-light or dawn; become bright or clear; (अम्), n. dawn, day-break (personified as a son of Kalpa, in which case to be regarded as masc.), day; fruit, result, consequence.
45841: व्य्-उष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. the rising or breaking of dawn, dawn; increase, prosperity, felicity; fruit, consequence; a hymn, praise.
45842: व्युषित 2. व्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 3. वि-वस्), lived away, dwelling abroad; dwelt, lodged, passed (e. g. व्य्-उषितो रात्रिम्, he lodged for a night, i. e. he passed or spent a night). —व्युषि-ताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a king descended from Daśa-ratha.
45843: 3. व्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelt, lodged; passed; one who has passed a night or lodged for a night.
45844: व्य्-उष्य, ind. having dwelt, having lodged, hav-ing passed or spent (e. g. रात्रिं व्य्-उष्य, having spent a night).
45846: व्यूढ 1. व्य्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वह्), married. (For 2. व्य्-ऊढ see under व्य्-ऊह्।)
45847: व्यूत व्य्-ऊत, व्य्-ऊति। See under व्य्-उत।
45848: व्यूर्णु व्य्-ऊर्णु (वि-ऊर्णु), cl. 2. P. A. -ऊर्णोति or -ऊर्णौति, -ऊर्णुते, -ऊर्णवितुम् or -ऊर्णुवितुम्, Ved. to uncover, open out, open; to display.
45849: व्य्-ऊर्ण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. uncovering, dis-playing, revealing.
45850: व्यूह् व्य्-ऊह् (वि-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, to push or move apart, place asunder, separate, divide, distribute; to separate, resolve (vowels, syllables, &c. in Vedic grammar); to dispose, arrange, place in order; to array, to place in battle-array, arrange in order of battle; to move from the proper place, change the position, trans-pose, alter, disarrange.
45851: 2. व्य्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, placed or moved apart, widely separated, expanded, developed, wide, broad; large, great, firm, compact; placed in order or array, arrayed, marshalled, arranged; placed out of order, disarranged, transposed, altered. —व्यूढ-कङ्कट, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has arranged or put on armour, equipped in mail, accoutred, mailed, armed. —व्यू-ढ-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having the metres disarranged or out of order. —व्यूढोरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or व्यूढोरस्क (°ढ-उर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having an expanded chest, broad-chested, (व्यूढ = विपुल, comm.)
45852: व्य्-ऊढि, इस्, f. orderly arrangement or disposition, distribution in various positions, array.
45853: व्य्-ऊह, अस्, m. placing apart, separation, distribu-tion; separation or resolution (of vowels, syllables, &c. in Vedic grammar); orderly arrangement, dis-position, array (e. g. चरण-व्यूह, array of Vedic schools), military array, (various forms of array are enumerated in Manu VII. 187 and elsewhere, e. g. दण्ड, that like ‘a staff;’ शकट, ‘a cart;’ व-राह, ‘a boar;’ मकर, ‘a sea-monster;’ सूचि, ‘a needle;’ गरुड, ‘the bird of Viṣṇu;’ वज्र, ‘a thunderbolt;’ भोग, ‘a snake,’ i. e. in column; मण्डल, ‘a circle;’ असंहत, ‘mixed order;’ पताक, ‘a flag,’ &c.); an army, host, squadron; a flock, multitude; (in phil.) arrangement or peculiar distribution (of the senses); formation, structure, manu-facture; the body; reasoning, logic, (in this sense rather to be derived fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with वि); breathing (according to the Nyāya-sūtras III. 31). —व्यूह-पार्ष्णि, इस्, m. the rear of an army (= प्रत्य्-आसार). —व्यूह-भङ्ग or व्यूह-भेद, अस्, m. breaking an array, throwing into disorder. —व्यूह-रचना, f. arrangement of troops. —व्यूह-राज, अस्, m. the chief or best form of military array. —व्यूहान्तर (°ह-अन्°), अस्, m. a different ar-rangement or position.
45854: व्य्-ऊहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, separating, dividing; dis-posing, arranging, putting in military array.
45855: व्य्-ऊहन, अम्, n. the act of disposing in order, arrangement, arraying, array (of an army); dispo-sition or structure of the members of the body.
45856: व्य्-ऊह्य, ind. having disposed in order, having arranged or arrayed, having placed in battle-array.
45857: व्यृ व्य्-ऋ (वि-ऋ), cl. 5. 3. P. -ऋणोति or -ऋण्-वति, -इयर्ति, &c. (see rt. 4. ऋ), Ved. to go apart or asunder, open out, be divided; to open, throw open, spread abroad, display.
45858: व्यृछ् व्य्-ऋछ् (वि-ऋछ्), cl. 6. P. -ऋच्छति, -अर्च्छितुम्, Ved. to go apart or asunder.
45859: व्यृध् व्य्-ऋध् (वि-ऋध्), Pass. -ऋध्यते, Ved. to be unfortunate or unsuccessful; to be ex-cluded or deprived of (with inst.): Caus. -अर्ध-यति, -यितुम्, to exclude from, deprive of (with inst.): Pass. of Caus. -अर्ध्यते, to be excluded from or deprived of: Desid. वीर्त्सति (Part. वीर्त्सत्), to wish to nullify or render vain.
45860: व्य्-ऋद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of prosperity, deprived of, separated or excluded from; nullified; imperfect, defective, unfit.
45861: व्य्-ऋद्धि, इस्, f. (probably fr. वि privative + ऋद्-धि), non-prosperity, absence or loss of prosperity, misfortune, ill luck.
45862: व्यृष् 1. व्य्-ऋष् (वि-ऋष्), cl. 1. P. -अर्षति, -अर्षितुम्, Ved. to flow through.
45863: व्यृष् 2. व्य्-ऋष् (वि-ऋष्), cl. 6. P. -ऋषति, -अर्षितुम्, to pierce, penetrate.

45866: व्येत व्य्-एत, अस्, -एनी, अम्, Ved. very bright, very white, (Sāy. व्येनी = विशेषेण श्वेता, Ṛg-veda V. 80, 4.)
45867: व्येनस् व्य्-एनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. exempt from sin, free from misfortune.
45868: व्योकार व्यो-कार, अस्, m. (probably onoma-topoetic), ‘making the sound व्यो,’ a blacksmith.
45869: व्योमन् व्योमन्, अ, n. (according to Uṇā-di-s. IV. 150. fr. rt. व्ये above; according to others fr. ओ for अव् with वि, cf. ओमन्, or connected with rt. 2. दिव्), sky, heaven, atmosphere, ether; water; a temple sacred to the sun, a place where the sun is especially worshipped; talc, mica; (आ), m., N. of a king. —व्योम-केश, अस्, or व्योम-केशिन्, ई, m. ‘sky-haired,’ an epithet of Śiva. —व्यो-म-गङ्गा, f. the heavenly Ganges. —व्योम-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘sky-going,’ passing through the air. —व्योम-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sky-going; (ई), m. ‘air-goer,’ ‘sky-goer;’ a god; a bird; a saint; a Brāhman. —व्योमचारि-पुर, अम्, n. ‘sky-floating city,’ the city of Hari-ścandra (supposed to be sus-pended between heaven and earth). —व्योम-देव, अस्, m., N. of Śiva —व्योम-धूम, अस्, m. ‘sky-smoke,’ a cloud. —व्योम-नासिका, f. a sort of quail. —व्योम-पञ्चक, अम्, n. an aggregate of five Vyomans (?) . —व्योम-मञ्जर, अम्, n. ‘sky-cluster,’ a flag, banner. —व्योम-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘sky-circle,’ a flag, banner. —व्योम-मध्ये, ind. in the middle of the sky, in mid-air. —व्योम-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘sky-measuring,’ reaching to the sky, high as the heaven. —व्योम-मुद्गर, अस्, m. ‘sky-hammer,’ a gust of wind. —व्योम-यान, अम्, n. ‘sky-vehicle,’ a celestial car, chariot of the gods. —व्योम-वर्त्-मन्, अ, n. the path of the sky, (व्योम-वर्त्मना, inst. c. through the air or sky.) —व्योम-विस्तृत, अम्, n. the expanse of heaven, the sky, firmament. —व्योम-सद्, त्, m. ‘sky-dweller,’ a deity, divinity; a Gandharva; a spirit. —व्योम-स्थली, f. ‘ground or base of the sky,’ the earth. —व्योम-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, ‘sky-touching,’ ‘sky-reaching,’ lofty. —व्योमाभ (°म-आभ), अस्, m. ‘heaven-like,’ a Buddha or a Jaina deified saint. —व्योमोदक (°म-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘sky-water,’ rain-water, dew (= दिव्योदक).
45870: व्योम्निक in परम-व्योम्निक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the highest ether.
45871: व्योष व्योष, अम्, n. (probably fr. rt. 1. व्युष् or fr. rt. 1. उष् with वि), the aggregate of three spices (black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger).
45872: व्रज् व्रज्, cl. 1. P. P. व्राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go, send; to go; to prepare, decorate: Desid. विव्रजिषति: Intens. वाव्रज्यते, वाव्रक्ति, to go crookedly; [cf. Gr. ϝέργον; Goth. vrikan, vrakja, waurkjau; Angl. 45873: व्रज, अस्, m. a road; a flock, herd, multitude, collection of anything; a station of cowherds, cow-pen, cattle-shed, stall, stable; a resting-place, abode; a cloud (= मेघ according to Naigh. 45874: व्रजक, अस्, m. a religious ascetic who wanders about (in quest of alms &c.).
45875: व्रजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, proceeding, travel-ling; roaming.
45876: व्रजन, अम्, n. the act of going or proceeding, travelling, roaming; exile; a road, way, street (Ved.); (अस्), m., N. of a brother of Jahnu (considered as one of the ancestors of the Kuśikas).
45877: व्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, proceeded; (अम्), n. going, roaming.
45878: व्रजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. herded or grouped together, collected into a mass, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 45, 1. व्रजिनीः = तमः-पुञ्जवतीः, clustered gloom, i. e. nights.)
45879: व्रज्या, f. travelling or wandering about (either as a religious act or in quest of alms); march, attack, invasion; a flock, tribe, class; a theatre (= रङ्ग). —व्रज्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, wandering, roaming; going gracefully.
45880: व्रण् 1. व्रण् (also written ब्रण्), cl. 1. P. व्रणति, वव्राण, व्रणितुम्, to sound.
45881: व्रण् 2. व्रण् (perhaps rather to be re-garded as a Nom. fr. व्रण below), cl. 10. P. व्रणयति, -यितुम्, to wound.
45882: व्रण, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wound, sore, ulcer, boil, bruise, tumor; a fracture, scar, rent (see अ-व्°, cf. Manu II. 47); [cf. Gr. οὐλή (i. e. ϝολνη), ἄπ-ελος; Lat. vulnus.] —व्रण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, making a sore, wounding, ulcerating; corroding; (त्), m. the mark-ing-nut plant, Semecarpus Anacardium. —व्रण-केतु-घ्नी, f. a kind of small shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी). —व्रण-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, ‘hostile to sores,’ healing sores; (ट्), m. the plant Siphonanthus Indica (= ब्राह्मण-यष्टिका). —व्रण-धूपन, अम्, n. fumigating a sore. —व्रण-वस्तु, n. a part liable to ulcerate (as skin, flesh, &c.). —व्रण-वेदना, f. the pain of a wound or sore. —व्रण-शोधन, अम्, n. the cleansing or cicatrising of a sore. —व्र-ण-ह, अस्, m. ‘destroying sores,’ the castor-oil tree; (आ), f. a sort of creeper or shrub (= गुडूची). —व्र-ण-हृत्, त्, m. ‘sore-removing,’ a particular plant (= कलि-कारी). —व्रणारि (°ण-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of sores,’ the plant Sesbana Grandiflora (= अगस्त्य-वृक्ष); gum-myrrh (= वोल).
45883: व्रणित, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded, ulcerated, bruised, scarred. —व्रणित-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, heart-stricken, bruised or wounded at heart.
45884: व्रणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a sore or wound, afflicted with boils or ulcers.
45885: व्रत व्रत, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably an old past pass. participle fr. rt. वृ), anything enclosed, an enclosed place, enclosure, realm, sphere, sway (Ved.); anything fenced off or settled, a law, ordinance, com-mand, rule, (अनु-व्रतम्, according to law or ordi-nance); rite, observance, practice [cf. अर्क-व्°, यम-व्°]; any religious act or obligation enjoined by the gods; a sacrifice; a self-chosen or voluntary act, any meritorious act of devotion or austerity, fasting, continence, vowed observance, solemn pur-pose, vow, (असि-धारा-व्रत or आसिधारं व्र-तम्, a vow to stand on the edge of a sword or a vow as difficult as standing on the edge of a sword); (अस्), m. a religious student. —व्रत-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. vow-performing, fulfilling or performing vows. —व्रत-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva. —व्रत-निमित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by a vow. —व्रत-पति, इस्, m., Ved. ‘lord of vows,’ epithet of Agni. —व्रत-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. upholding ordinances, protecting sacred rites. —व्रत-पारण, अम्, आ, n. f. conclusion of a fast, eating or drinking after a fast. —व्रत-प्र-काश, अस्, m. ‘illustration of vows,’ N. of a work by Viśva-nātha on the subject of vows (compiled from the Purāṇas and other more ancient sources). —व्र-त-प्रतिष्ठा, f. the performance of a religious act voluntarily undertaken. —व्रत-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the interruption of an act of devotion, breach of a vow. —व्रत-भिक्षा, f. soliciting alms (as one of the ceremonies accompanying investiture). —व्रत-भृत्, त्, m., Ved. ‘bearer of sacrifices,’ epithet of Agni. —व्रत-राज, अस्, m. = व्रत-प्रकाश above. —व्रत-लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has broken a vow (of fasting &c.). —व्रत-लोपन, अम्, n. the breaking of a vow (of fasting, chastity, &c.), violat-ing any religious vow or obligation. —व्रत-वै-कल्य, अम्, n. imperfection or incompletion of a vow or religious observance. —व्रत-शेष, अस्, m. the remainder of a religious vow. —व्रत-संर-क्षण, अम्, n. the keeping of a vow, observing penance. —व्रत-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. undertaking any act of devotion, taking on one's self any voluntary religious obligation (= दीक्षा). —व्रत-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in religious austerities or in a vow of any kind, performing penance. —व्रत-स्नातक, अस्, m. a Brāhman who has completed his term of studentship, (see स्नातक।) —व्रताचरण (°त-आच्°), अम्, n. the act of observing a vow or religious obligation (especially that of continence, as the duty of a religious student; 45886: व्रतय, Nom. P. व्रतयति, -यितुम्, to observe a vow; to fast or practise any abstinence in conse-quence of a vow; to eat together.
45887: व्रतिक in वक-व्रतिक, वैडाल-व्°, &c., q. q. v. v.
45888: व्रतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, observing a vow (of continence, fasting, &c.), relating to a vow, practising any penance or religious observance, engaged in a sacrifice, devout, pious; (ई), m. an ascetic, devotee; a religious student; one who institutes a sacrifice and employs priests (= यजमान); N. of a Muni.
45889: व्रतेयु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
45890: व्रत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = व्रतिन् (Ṛg-v. VIII. 48, 8).
45891: व्रतति व्रतति, इस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. वृत्, according to Yāska fr. rts. वृ and 3. तन्), expansion, extension, spreading; a creeper. —व्रतति-वलय, अस्, अम्, m. n. a creeper winding round like a bracelet.
45893: व्रध्न व्रध्न, अस्, m. (also written ब्रध्न, q. v.), the sun; the root of a tree.
45894: व्रन्द् व्रन्द् or व्रद् (a Vedic root said to be allied to rts. म्रद् and 1. मृड्, ‘to rub, press, crush,’ &c.), cl. 1. P. A. व्रन्दति, -ते, &c., (probably) to soften; to become soft, (अव्र-दन्त वीलितेत्य् अपि निगमो भवति, Nirukta V. 16); [cf. Gr. βραδύ.]
45895: व्रन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. reduced to a state of softness or mildness; tamed, subdued, (or according to Sāy. connected with वृन्द, ‘a multitude;’ व्रन्-दिनः = मृदु-भावं प्राप्तान् or समूह-व-तः, Ṛg-veda I. 54, 4; see Nirukta V. 15.)
45896: व्रयस् व्रयस्। See under rt. व्री, col. 3.
45897: व्रश्च् व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P. वृश्चति (Ved. वृ-णक्ति, Naigh. II. 19), वव्रश्च, व्र-श्चिष्यति or व्रक्ष्यति, अव्रश्चीत् or अव्राक्षीत्, व्रश्चितुम् or व्रष्टुम्, to cut, cut up, cut asunder, tear, lacerate, divide with an edged tool; to wound: Caus. व्रश्चयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्रश्चत्: Desid. विव्रश्चिषति and विव्रक्षति: Intens. वरीवृ-श्च्यते, वरीवृश्चीति; [cf. Gr. ἔλκος, ῥάκος, λακίς, λακερός; Lat. lacerare, ulcus.]
45898: वृक्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, torn, &c. See s. v.
45899: वृश्चत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, cutting, lacerating, wounding. —वृश्चद्-वन, अस्, m., Ved. ‘consumer or destroyer of forests,’ epithet of Agni (Ṛg-v. VI. 6, 1).
45900: व्रश्चन, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what cuts, cutting; (अस्), m. a small saw or chisel; a fine file or saw used by goldsmiths, &c.; the juice flowing from an incision in a tree; (अम्), n. cutting, wounding; a cut, incision. —व्रश्चन-प्रभव, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing from an incision (in a tree, as juices &c.).
45901: व्रह्मन् व्रह्मन्, अ, n. = ब्रह्मन्, q. v.
45902: व्रा व्रा, f. (fr. rt. वृ), Ved. night; dawn, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 121, 2 = तमसा सर्वम् आच्छादयतीति व्रा रात्रिः or प्रकाशेन वृणोतीति व्रा उषाः); a multitude, troop, (see Nirukta V. 3.)
45903: व्राचड व्राचड, अस्, m. a kind of corrupt dialect.
45904: व्राज व्राज, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्रज्), going, movement, motion; a troop, multitude (Ved.). —व्राज-बाहू, m. du., Ved. the spreading or out-stretched arms of death.
45905: व्राजि, इस्, f. a gale of wind, whirlwind, wind.
45906: व्रात व्रात, अस्, m. (fr. व्रत or connected with rt. वृ), a multitude, flock, assemblage, troop, (व्रातं-व्रातम्, in companies, in troops, Ṛg-veda V. 53, 11); = मनुष्य (according to Naigh. 45907: व्रातीन, अस्, m. one living by the profession of a Vrāta, a hired labourer, porter, cooly; one having no fixed employment; one living by violence.

45910: व्रिश् व्रिश्, शस्, f. pl., Ved. the fingers (according to Naigh. II. 5; according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 144, 5. व्रिशः = विशः = परस्पर-विश्लिष्टाः, mutually separated).
45911: व्री व्री (connected with rts. वृ, व्ली), cl. 9. P. व्रीणाति or व्रिणाति, विव्राय, व्रेष्यति, अव्रैषीत्, व्रेतुम्, to choose, elect; cl. 4. 45912: व्रयस्, Ved. abandoning, abandonment, (accord-ing to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda II. 23, 16. वि व्रयस् = विशेषेण वर्जनम्।)
45913: व्रीण, अस्, आ, अम्, chosen, elected.
45914: व्रीड् व्रीड्, cl. 4. P. व्रीड्यति (ep. cl. 1. A. व्रीडते, see below), विव्रीड, व्रीडिष्-यति, अव्रीडीत्, व्रीडितुम्, to be ashamed, feel shame, to be modest or bashful; to throw, hurl, send; (ac-cording to Nirukta V. 16. व्रीडयति = वीडयति।)
45915: व्रीड, अस्, आ, m. f. shame, modesty, bashfulness. —व्रीडानत (°डा-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, bowed down with shame, hanging down the head with shame, ashamed. —व्रीडान्वित (°डा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, bashful, modest. —व्रीडा-युज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing shame, ashamed.
45916: व्रीडन, अम्, n. shame, bashfulness, modesty; lowering, depression (= नीचैर्-भाव).
45917: व्रीडमान, अस्, आ, अम् (an epic form), being ashamed, blushing.
45918: व्रीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed, modest; (अम्), n. shame.
45920: व्रीस् व्रीस् (= rt. व्रूस्), cl. 1. 10. P. व्री-सति, व्रीसयति, to hurt, injure; to kill, wound.
45921: व्रीहि व्रीहि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. व्री), rice, (eight principal sorts are enumerated by native authorities; rice is not mentioned in the Ṛg-veda, but is named in the Atharva-veda together with यव, माष, and तिल); a grain of rice, (व्रीहीन् प्रोक्षति, he sprinkles or scatters grains of rice); rice ripening in the rainy season; (अयस्), m. pl. grains of rice. —व्रीहि-काञ्चन, अस्, m. a sort of pulse, Ervum Lens or Hirsutum (= मशूर). —व्री-हि-पर्णी, f. a particular shrub (= शाल-पर्णी)। —व्रीहि-भेद, अस्, m. a species of rice; a sort of grain, Panicum Miliaceum (= अणु). —व्रीहि-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of rice; (अस्), m. a rice-cake made with ghee (offered as an oblation). —व्रीहि-राजिक, अस्, m. panic seed, Panicum Itali-cum (= कङ्गु); another species, Panicum Milia-ceum. —व्रीहि-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. a kind of rice (= शालि-धान्य). —व्रीह्य्-अगार, अम्, n. ‘rice-house,’ a shed where rice or other grain is stored, granary.
45922: व्रीहिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having rice, bearing rice, &c.
45923: व्रीहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having or bearing rice (a field &c.).
45924: व्रैह, अस्, ई, अम्, made of rice, composed of rice.
45925: व्रैहेय, अस्, ई, अम्, fit for rice, sown with rice (as a field &c.), made or consisting of rice; (अम्), n. a field of rice.
45926: व्रुड् व्रुड्, cl. 6. P. व्रुडति, to cover; to heap; to sink.
45927: व्रूस् व्रूस् (also written व्रूष् or ब्रूष्; cf. rts. व्रीस्, कष्), cl. 1. 10. P. व्रूसति, व्रूसयति, &c., to hurt, injure, wound, kill.
45928: व्ली व्ली (also written ब्ली; according to some fr. वि-ली, but cf. rt. व्री), cl. 9. P. व्लि-नाति (Ved. व्लीनाति), विव्लाय, व्लेष्यति, अव्लैषीत्, व्लेतुम्, to go, move; to choose, select, (in this sense for rts. वृ, व्री); to hold, maintain, support: Caus. व्लेपयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्लिपत्: Desid. विव्ली-षति: Intens. वेव्लीयते, वेव्लयीति or वेव्लेति।
45929: व्लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; held, supported.
45930: व्लेक्ष् व्लेक्ष् (also written वेक्ष्, q. v.), cl. 10. P. व्लेक्षयति, व्लेक्षापयति, यितुम्, to see.
45931: श 1. श, the thirtieth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and first of the three sibilants; it belongs to the palatal class, and in sound often cor-responds to ष्, though in some words pronounced more like स्. —श-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound श. —श-वर्ग, अस्, m. the sibilating class of letters, i. e. the three sibilants and the letter ह्।
45932: श 2. श, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शो), a cutter, de-stroyer (Kirāt. XV. 45); a weapon; N. of Śiva, (in this sense probably connected with 2. शम्); (अम्), n. or ind. happiness, &c., see 2. शम्, p. 993.
45933: शंयु शंयु, शंय्य, &c. See under 2. शम्, p. 993.
45935: शंवर शंवर, शंवल। See शम्बर, शम्बल, p. 993.
45936: शंस् शंस् [cf. rts. शश्, 1. शास्], cl. 1. P. शंसति (ep. also A. -ते), शशंस, शं-सिष्यति, अशंसीत्, Prec. शस्यात्, शंसितुम्, to recite, repeat, (in Vedic ritual शोंसाव, शोंसाम, ‘let us recite’); to relate, say, tell, report, declare, announce, communicate to (with dat. or gen. of the person); to praise, celebrate; to approve, wish, desire [cf. आ-शंस्]; to wish well or ill to; to calumniate, revile; to hurt, injure [cf. rt. 1. शस्]; to be unhappy (?): Pass. शस्यते, to be recited or uttered; to be praised or approved: Caus. शंसयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अशशंसत्, to cause to repeat or recite: Desid. शिशंसिषति: Intens. शाशस्यते, शाशंस्ति; [cf. Lat. censeo, cano, Cas-menœ, Ca-menœ, carmen, con-cinn-us: Old Germ. sagen: Angl. Sax. sagan, sœgan: Goth. hazjan, hana: Mod. Germ. Hahn: Slav. san-ti: (perhaps also) Lith. sakau: Hib. sant, ‘greediness, lust;’ santaighim, ‘I desire, covet.’]
45937: शंस, अस्, m., Ved. recitation, invocation; praise, prayer, (Sāy. = स्तुति); wishing well or ill to; a spell (for good or evil); a blessing; a curse; calumny; = नराशंस (Ved.); (आ), f. speech; praise, flattery, eulogium; wish, desire; (अस्, आ, अम्), reciting; praising; wishing; [cf. दुः-श्°।]
45938: शंसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reciting, relating; praising.
45939: शंसन, अम्, n. the act of reciting or repeating, recitation; praising.
45940: शंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, said, told, declared; praised, extolled, celebrated; wished, desired, longed for [cf. आ-शंसित]; calumniated, falsely accused; ascertained, established, effected, (in these senses for सं-शित under सं-शो।) —शंसित-व्रत for संशित-व्रत, see सं-शो।
45941: शंसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a reciter, reciting, relating; a praiser; [cf. शंस्तृ।]
45942: शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, saying, relating, announcing, foretelling, indicating, showing; praising.
45943: शंस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be repeated or recited.
45944: शंस्तृ, ता, m. a reciter of Śastras or hymns of praise, one of the officiating priests at a sacrifice (identified with the Pra-śāstṛ and mentioned along with five others in Ṛg-veda 1. 162, 5; his sacrificial duties correspond with those of the Maitrāvaruṇa of the later ritual); a praiser, encomiast, panegyrist.
45945: शंस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praiseworthy, meritorious; to be wished, desirable.
45947: शस, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. reciting, repeating.
45949: 1. शस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. शस्त see under rt. 1. शस्), recited, repeated; praised, eulogized; best, excellent; auspicious, happy, well, right; (अम्), n. happiness, excellence; the body. —शस्त-केशक, अस्, ई, अम्, having excellent hair.
45950: शस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be recited or repeated; to be praised, &c.
45951: शस्ति, इस्, f., Ved. a hymn of praise.
45952: 1. शस्त्र, अम्, n. (for 2. शस्त्र see under rt. 1. शस्), Ved. a hymn (recited either audibly or inaudibly, as opposed to स्तोम, which is sung), a recitative, recita-tion; a hymn of praise (generally).
45953: शस्त्वा, ind. having recited; having praised, &c.
45954: शस्मन्, अ, n., Ved. praise, a hymn.
45955: 1. शस्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. शस्य see under rt. 1. शस्), = शंस्य, to be praised, praiseworthy; to be wished, desirable, excellent, best; (अम्), n. a good quality, merit.
45956: शस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being recited, (op-posed to गीयमान, being sung); being hymned or praised.
45957: शंस्त् शंस्त्, a Vedic root, = rt. 2. शस् or सस्।
45958: शक् 1. शक्, cl. 5. P. शक्नोति, cl. 4. P. A. शक्यति, -ते (in the A. not to be dis-tinguished from the Pass., see below; Ved. forms, Impv. शग्धि, Pot. शकेयम्, शकेम), शशाक, शेके, शक्ष्यति, -ते, अशकत् (or if used in cl. 4. the following are said by some to be substituted, 2nd Fut. शकिष्यति, -ते, Aor. अशकीत् or असाकीत्, अश-किष्ट), शक्तुम् (शकितुम्, Ved. शक्तवे), to be able, to be able to effect, to be competent for (with inf., e. g. वीक्षितुं न शक्नोति, he is not able to look; मर्तुं न शक्यामि, I am not able to die; or even with part., e. g. पूरयन् न शक्-नोति, he is not able to fill); to be powerful; to bear, endure; to give, present (Ved.); to aid (Ved.); to know (Ved.): Pass. शक्यते, Aor. अशाकि, to be able, be capable, be possible, be practicable (giving a passive sense to a following inf., e. g. तच् छेत्तुं शक्यते, that is able to be cut, that can be cut; तत् कर्तुं शक्यते, that can be done; न शक्-यन्ते त्यक्तुम्, they cannot be abandoned; some-times used with a participle, e. g. न शक्यते वार्-यमाणः, he cannot be restrained; or used imper-sonally, e. g. यदि त्वया शक्यते, if it can be done by thee): Caus. शाकयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अशीशकत्: Intens. शाशक्यते, शाशकीति or शाशक्ति: Desid. शिक्षति, -ते [cf. शिक्ष्, s. v.], to wish to be able or to be able to effect; to learn; to give, bestow, enrich (Ved.); to aid, assist (Ved.); to instruct (Ved.): Caus. of Desid. शिक्षयति, -यितुम्, to teach, in-struct (with two acc., e. g. तं रण-शिक्षाम् अशि-क्षयत्, he instructed him in the art of war); [cf. Lat. queo (for quec-jo), ne-queo, conari: Old Norse hagr, ‘the right hand;’ hagna, ‘to be of service.’]
45959: 2. शक्, क्, क्, क्, able, powerful (at the end of a comp., e. g. सर्व-शक्, q. v.).
45960: शक, अस्, m., N. of a king (especially applied to Śāli-vāhana); an era, epoch (especially that of the monarch Śāli-vāhana, commencing seventy-eight years after the Christian; cf. शाक); N. of a country; of a particular tribe or race of people, (usually आस्, pl.; in the legends which relate the contests between Vasiṣṭha and Viśvā-mitra the Śakas are fabled to have been produced by the Cow of Vasiṣṭha, from her sweat, for the destruction of Viśvā-mitra's army; in Manu X. 44. they are mentioned together with the Pauṇḍrakas, Oḍras, Draviḍas, Kāmbojas, Javanas or Yavanas, Pāradas, Pahlavas, Cīnas, Kirātas, Da-radas, and Khaśas, who are all described by Kullūka as degraded tribes of Kṣatriyas, called after the dis-tricts in which they reside: according to the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa IV. 3. the great king Sagara made an effort to rid his kingdom of these tribes, who appear to have overrun the western districts of India; the Śakas who were not destroyed were deprived of their social position and were compelled to shave the fore part of their heads: they are sometimes regarded as the followers of Śaka or Śāli-vāhana, and probably to be identified with the Tartars or Scythians [Lat. Sacœ] who overran India before the Āryans, and were supposed to have been exterminated by the great Vikramāditya, king of Oujein and rival of Śāli-vāhana); (अम्), n., Ved. water (= उदक, Naigh. I. 12; cf. शक-पूत, शक-मय, under शकन्). —शक-कर्तृ, ता, m. the founder or establisher of an era. —शक-देश, अस्, m., N. of a country. —शक-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a poet. —शक-वृद्धि, इस्, m., N. of a poet. —शकाधिप-राज-धानी (°क-अध्°), f. the capital of the king of the Śakas, i. e. Ḍillī. —शकान्तक (°क-अन्°), अस्, m. ‘destroyer of the Śakas,’ epithet of king Vikramā-ditya. —शकाब्द (°क-अब्°), अम्, n. a year of the Śaka era, (see above.) —शकारि (°क-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the Śakas,’ epithet of king Vikramāditya.
45961: शकच, perhaps for शक-ज, ‘Scythian-born,’ in Rāja-taraṅgiṇī V. 176.
45962: शकित, अस्, आ, अम्, able, capable, (giving a passive sense to the inf., e. g. न शकितं छेत्तुम्, it could not be cut.)
45963: शक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, able, capable, competent (with inf. or with loc. in the sense of an inf., e. g. शक्तः परि-रक्षितुम् or शक्तः परि-रक्षणे, able to preserve); strong, mighty, powerful; one who has the power of giving, opulent, rich (Manu XI. 9); significant, expressive; speaking kindly or pleasantly (= प्रियं-वद); clever, diligent, attentive, in-tent. —शक्त-ता, f. or शक्त-त्व, अम्, n. ability, power, capacity. —शक्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a potential sense.
45964: शक्ति, इस्, f. ability, power, capacity, capability, faculty, strength, energy, prowess; regal power (hav-ing three parts or constituent elements, viz. 1. प्र-भु-त्व, the majesty or pre-eminence of the king himself; 2. मन्त्र, the power of good counsel; 3. उत्साह, the force of energy); the energy or active power of a deity personified as his wife and worshipped under various names, (sometimes only eight Śakti goddesses are enumerated, as follow, In-drāṇī, Vaiṣṇavī, Śāntā, Brahmāṇī, Kaumārī, Nāra-siṃhī, Vārāhī, and Māheśvarī, but some substitute Cāmuṇḍā and Caṇḍikā for the third and sixth of these: according to another reckoning there are nine, viz. Vaiṣṇavī, Brahmāṇī, Raudrī, Māheśvarī, Nāra-siṃhī, Vārāhī, Indrāṇī, Kārttikī, and Pradhānā: others reckon fifty different forms of the Śakti of Viṣṇu besides Lakṣmī, some of these are Kīrtti, Kānti, Tuṣṭi, Puṣṭā, Dhṛti, Śānti, Kriyā, Dayā, Medhā, &c.; and fifty forms of the Śakti of Śiva or Rudra besides Durgā or Gaurī, some of whom are Guṇo-darī, Virajā, Śālmalī, Lolākṣī, Vartulākṣī, Dīrgha-ghoṇā, Sudīrgha-mukhī, Go-mukhī, Dīrgha-jihvā, Kuṇḍodarī, Ardha-keśī, Vikṛta-mukhī, Jvālā-mukhī, Ulkā-mukhī, &c.; Sarasvatī is also named as a Śakti, both of Viṣṇu and Rudra: according to the Vāyu-Purāṇa the female nature of Rudra became twofold, one half असित or white, and the other सित or black, each of these again becoming manifold, those of the white or mild nature included Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Gaurī, Umā, &c.; those of the dark and fierce nature, Durgā, Kālī, &c.); the female organ (as the counter-part of the phallic representation of Śiva, and wor-shipped either literally or figuratively by a sect of Hindūs termed Śāktas, see शाक्त); the power or signification (of a word), force or meaning of a term (defined in the Nyāya as the relation of the term to the thing designated पदस्य पदार्थे सम्बन्-धः); an iron spear, lance, pike, dart [cf. शाक्-तीक]; a sword; a kind of implement or instrument used in gambling; allaying or appeasing opposition; (इस्), m., N. of a Muni or sage (the eldest of Va-siṣṭha's hundred sons; according to Viṣṇu-Purāṇa I. 1. he was father of Parāśara, and was devoured by king Kalmāṣa-pāda, when changed to a man-eating Rākṣasa, in consequence of a curse pronounced upon him by the sage; he is represented as having over-come the power and speech of Viśvā-mitra at the sacrifice of king Saudāsa, and is regarded as the Ṛṣi of Ṛg-veda VII. 32, 26, IX. 97, 19 — 21, IX. 108, 3, 14 — 16; Śakti is also identified with one of the Vyāsas, and elsewhere with the sage Jātūkarṇa). —शक्ति-कुण्ठन, अम्, n. (in phil.) the deadening of a capacity. —शक्ति-कुमार, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —शक्ति-गण, अस्, m. the company or assem-blage of the Śaktis, (see under शक्ति above.) —शक्ति-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, taking hold of the force or mean-ing (of a word or sentence); apprehending the meaning (in any particular sense), acceptation (of a word &c.); holding or bearing a spear or lance, armed with a spear; (अस्), m. perception or appre-hension of the force or sense (of a word); a spear-man, lancer; epithet of Śiva; of Kārttikeya. —शक्ति-ग्राहक, अस्, इका, अम्, who or what causes to ap-prehend the force or signification (of a word or phrase), determining or establishing the meaning of words (as a dictionary, grammar, &c.); taking hold of the force (of a word &c.); holding a spear, &c. —शक्ति-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from Śakti; (अस्), m. son of Śakti. —शक्ति-तस्, ind. according to power, to the best of one's ability. —शक्ति-ता, f. power, capacity, faculty. —शक्ति-त्रय, अम्, n. the three constituents of regal power (viz. king, minister, and energy; see शक्ति). —शक्ति-धर, अस्, m. a spear-man, lancer; epithet of Kārttikeya. —शक्ति-धृक् (see धृक्, p. 459), bearing a spear. —शक्ति-पर्ण, अस्, m. the tree Echites Scholaris (= सप्त-पर्ण)। —शक्ति-पाणि, इस्, m. ‘spear-handed,’ armed with a spear or lance, a spearman; epithet of Kārttikeya. —शक्ति-पात, अस्, m. prostration of strength. —शक्-ति-पूजक, अस्, m. a Śakti-worshipper, a Śākta, (see शक्ति, शाक्त।) —शक्ति-पूजा, f. Śakti-worship, (see above.) —शक्ति-पूर्व, अस्, m. ‘having Śakti for a forefather,’ epithet of Parāśara (as son of Śakti). —शक्ति-प्रकर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing superior capacity or extraordinary power. —शक्ति-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, bearing a spear, armed with a spear; (त्), m. a spearman, lancer; epithet of Kārttikeya. —शक्ति-भेद, अस्, m. difference of power; a special capacity. —शक्ति-भैरव-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —शक्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of ability, powerful, mighty, able; possessing a competence, one who has gained a fortune. —शक्ति-यामल, N. of a work. —शक्ति-रत्नाकर (°न-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘jewel-mine of Śakti,’ N. of a work on the mystical worship of Śakti or Durgā, (it contains five chapters compiled from the Tantras and Purāṇas.) —शक्ति-वाद or शक्ति-विचार, अस्, m., N. of a philosophical work by Gadādhara-bhaṭṭācārya. —शक्ति-वादिन्, ई, m. one who asserts or believes in Śakti-worship. —शक्ति-वैकल्य, अम्, n. deficiency of power, impairment of strength, incapacity, debility. —शक्ति-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, powerless, impotent. —शक्ति-हे-तिक, अस्, m. one who has a spear for a weapon, a spearman, lancer, soldier armed with a lance. —शक्-त्य्-अपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having regard or reference to ability, according to power or capacity. —शक्त्य्-अर्ध, अस्, m. perspiring and panting with exertion or fatigue, (according to Śabda-k. = श्रम-द्वारा कुक्षि-ललाट-ग्रीवासूत्पन्नो घर्मो दीर्घ-नि-श्वासश्-च।) —शक्त्य्-अवर, अस्, आ, अम्, junior to Śakti.
45965: शक्ती, f. = शक्ति, see Vopa-deva IV. 27.
45966: शक्त्रि, इस्, m., N. of the eldest of the hundred sons of Vasiṣṭha (= शक्ति).
45967: शक्त्रिन्, ई, m. a proper N., = शक्त्रि above.
45968: शक्न, अस्, आ, अम्, = शक्नु below.
45969: शक्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, speaking kindly or pleasingly; [cf. rt. शच्।]
45970: शक्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, having power, being able, (तत् सोढुम् अ-शक्नुवानः, not being able to bear that.)
45971: शक्मन्, अ, n., Ved. power, strength; energy, action; (आ), m., Ved., N. of Indra.
45972: शक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, able, possible, capable, prac-ticable, able to be effected or done, easy to be ac-complished (frequently with inf. in passive sense, e. g. न सा शक्या नेतुम् बलात्, she cannot be con-ducted by force; तन् मया शक्यम् प्रतिपत्तुम्, that is able to be acquired by me); that may be conveyed or expressed (as sense or meaning by any particular word &c.). —शक्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most possible, very possible or practicable, (तन् न शक्यतमं कर्तुं, that is not at all possible to be done.) —शक्य-ता, f. or शक्य-त्व, अम्, n. possibility, practicability, capacity, capability. —शक्-यतावच्छेदक (°ता-अव्°), अम्, n. (according to Śabda-k.) = शक्यांशे भासमान-धर्मः. —शक्-य-प्रतीकार, अस्, m. a possible remedy or counter-agent; (अस्, आ, अम्), capable of being counteracted, remediable. —शक्यार्थ (°य-अर्°), अस्, m. admis-sible meaning, the meaning conveyed by a word.
45973: शक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, powerful, mighty (Ved.); (अस्), m. ‘the powerful one,’ N. of the god Indra, (see इन्द्र); of one of the twelve Ādityas; of Śiva; the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica (or Nerium Anti-dysentericum); the tree Pentaptera Arjuna. —शक्र-क्रीडाचल (°डा-आच्°), अस्, m. ‘Indra's pleasure-moun-tain,’ epithet of the mountain Meru. —शक्र-गोप, अस्, m. a particular red insect, the coccinella or a lady-bird of various species (= इन्द्र-गोप). —श-क्र-ज or शक्र-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, Indra-born; (अस्), m. a crow. —शक्र-जित्, त्, m. ‘conquerer of Indra,’ epithet of the son of Rāvaṇa, (his first name was Megha-nāda, but after his victory over Indra, described in the Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa XXXIV, his name was changed by Brahmā to Indra-jit, q. v.; 45974: शक्राणी, f., N. of Sacī (wife of Indra).
45975: शक्रि, इस्, m. a cloud; a thunderbolt; an elephant; a mountain.
45976: शक्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking pleasingly or kindly, affable; [cf. rt. शच्।]
45977: शक्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. powerful, able, mighty; (आ), m. an elephant; (अरी), f. a kind of river, &c. See under शक्वर below.
45978: शक्वर, अस्, m. a bull, an ox [cf. शक्कर]; (ई), f. a kind of river (= नदी-विशेष, नदी-भेद); a finger, (according to some, a finger-ring); a zone, girdle; a particular metre, (a stanza of four Pādas of fourteen syllables each, comprising at least twenty varieties, of which one of the commonest is called Vasanta-tilaka; cf. शक्करी, शर्करी); an arm (Ved.); a cow; (the fem. शक्वरी may equally be referred to शक्वन् above.)
45979: शग्म, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. able, powerful, mighty [cf. तुवि-श्°]; prosperous, happy, causing happiness (= सुख-कर or सुख, and according to Sāy. de-rived fr. शम् + rt. गम्).
45980: शग्मन्, अ, n., Ved. a various reading for शक्मन् in Naigh. II. 1.
45981: शग्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. powerful, mighty; prosperous, happy; [cf. शग्म।]
45983: शकट शकट, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 81. fr. rt. 1. शक्), a cart, waggon, (said to be also ई, f.); (अस्), m. the figure of a cart formed by the five stars composing the lunar asterism Rohiṇī; a form of military array resembling a wedge, (सूच्य्-आकाराग्रः पश्चात्-पृथुलः, Manu VII. 187); a cart-load (= 2000 Palas); an implement for preparing grain; N. of a demon slain by the infant Kṛṣṇa; a particular tree (= तिनिश); N. of a place. —शकट-भेद, अस्, m. division of the Śa-kaṭa asterism by the moon or a planet passing through it. —शकट-विल, अस्, m. a kind of water-hen, gal-linule. —शकट-हन्, हा, m. ‘destroyer of the demon Śakaṭa,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —शकटाक्ष (°ट-अक्°), अस्, m. the axle of a cart. —शकटारि (°ट-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of Śakaṭa,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —शकटासुर (°ट-अस्°), अस्, m. the demon Śakaṭa (killed by the infant Kṛṣṇa). —शकटाह्वा (°ट-आह्°), f. ‘cart-named,’ the asterism Rohiṇī, (the five stars of which are figured as a cart.) —शकटोच्चा-टन (°ट-उच्°), अम्, n. the upsetting or overturning of a cart.
45984: शकटार, अस्, m. a bird of prey, (perhaps a kind of vulture); N. of a minister of king Nanda, (in revenge for ill-treatment he conspired with the Brāhman Cāṇakya to effect his master's death); N. of an ape. —शकटारोपाख्यान (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. story of (the ape) Śakaṭāra.
45985: शकटाल, अस्, m. = शकटार, the minister of king Nanda or (according to some) of Śūdraka.
45986: शकटिका, f. a small cart, a child's cart, toy-cart; [cf. मृच्-छकटिका।]
45987: शकन् शकन्, n. a defective word option-ally substituted for शकृत् in certain cases, see col. 2. —शक-धूम, अस्, m., Ved. the smoke of burnt or burning (cow-) dung. —शक-पूत, अस्, m. ‘purified with cow-dung’ (or ‘purified with water;’ cf. शक); N. of the author of Ṛg-veda X. 132 (having the patronymic Nārmedha). —शक-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. consisting of dung, arising from cow-dung, (Sāy. = शुष्क-गोमय-सम्भूत, Ṛg-veda 1. 164, 43.) —शक-लोट (for शक-लोष्ट), अस्, m., Ved. a lump or ball of cow-dung (= शकृत्-पिण्ड).
45988: शकल शकल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to Uṇādi-s. I. 111. fr. rt. 1. शक्; more probably con-nected with शर्करा, q. v.; cf. शल्क), a part, portion, piece, fragment; a potsherd; (अस्), m. a proper N.; (अम्), n. skin, bark; the scales of a fish [cf. शल्क, शल्-कल]; a kind of black pigment or die. —शकली-क-रण, अम्, n. the act of cutting or breaking in pieces. —शकली-कृ, cl. 8. 45989: शकलित, अस्, आ, अम्, reduced to fragments, mashed, bruised.
45990: शकलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having scales, scaled; (ई), m. a fish.
45991: शकल्येषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, in Atharva-veda I. 25, 2, according to Atharva-veda Prātiśākhya III. 52. for शकल्य-एषिन्, said to mean ‘desiring fragments of wood’ (as a flame of fire).
45992: शकव शकव, अस्, m. (doubtful), a goose.
45993: शकशकायत् शकशकायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (part. of an onomatopoetic verb formed fr. the imitative sound शक), making a rustling noise, rustling (as the leaves of a tree in the wind).
45994: शकार शकार, अस्, m. the brother of a king's concubine, a king's brother-in-law by one of his wives not regularly married (represented in the drama as a foolish, frivolous, proud, low, and cruel man).
45995: शकुन शकुन, अस्, m. (according to Uṇā-di-s. III. 49. fr. rt. 1. शक्), a bird (in general); a particular kind of bird, (perhaps = गृध्र, a vulture, or = चिल्ल, the common kite, or perhaps the Pondi-cherry eagle); a kind of Brāhman (= विप्र-भेद); a sort of hymn or song (sung at festivals to secure good fortune); (अस्, आ or ई?, अम्), indicating good luck, auspicious; (ई), f. a kind of bird (= श्यामा); a hen-sparrow; the form assumed by Pūtanā, (see Hari-vaṃśa 3423); (अम्), n. any auspicious object or lucky omen, a prognostic or omen (in general, but rarely applied to anything inauspicious). —श-कुन-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing omens; (आ), f. a small house-lizard. —शकुन-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ‘omen-knowledge,’ N. of a chapter in the Śārṅga-dhara-paddhati. —शकुन-दीपिका, f. ‘omen-light,’ N. of a work on good and evil omens by Gaṇeśa. —शकुन-शास्त्र, अम्, n. ‘omen-book,’ N. of a work.
45996: शकुनि, इस्, m. a bird; a vulture, kite, eagle; (according to some) a cock; N. of the brother of queen Gāndhārī (and therefore the brother-in-law of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra and the Mātula or maternal uncle of the Kuru princes; as son of Su-bala, king of Gāndhāra, he is called Saubala; he often acted as counsellor of Duryodhana, and hence this name is sometimes applied to an old officious relative whose counsels tend to ruin); N. of one of the astronomical periods called invariable Karaṇas; N. of a son of Duḥ-saha; of a son of Vikukṣi; (ई), m. du., N. of the Aśvins; (इस्), f., N. of a demon causing a particular sickness of children; a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa; [cf. 46013: शङ्क् शङ्क्, cl. 1. 46023: शङ्कर शङ्-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (i. e. 2. श or 2. शम् + 1. कर), causing happiness, conferring good fortune or prosperity, auspicious, propitious, well-disposed; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of a celebrated teacher of the Vedānta philosophy, (see शङ्कराचार्य below); C., and was a native of Kerala or Malabar; all accounts describe him as having led an erratic controversial life; his learning and sanctity were in such repute that he was held to have worked various miracles [amongst others, animating the dead body of a king Amaru so as to be able to argue with the wife of Mandana], and to have been an incarnation of the god Śiva, whose worship he enjoined; a N. given to the president of a Maṭha or college founded by Śaṅkarācārya. —शङ्कराचार्य-विजय-दिण्डिम, N. of a commentary by Dhana-pati on the Saṅkṣepa-śaṅkara-jaya. —शङ्करानन्द (°र-आन्°), अस्, m., N. of a commentary on the Muṇḍakopaniṣad. —शङ्कराभरण (°र-आभ्°), अस्, m. a particular Rāga or musical mode. —शङ्करावास (°र-आव्°), अस्, m. the abode of Śiva, Kailāsa;
