47423: श्रवक, अस्, m. one who hears, a hearer.
47424: 1. श्रवण, अम्, n. the act of hearing; that which is heard, i. e. Śruti or the Veda, (इति श्रवणात्, since it is so said in the Veda, because of or according to such a Vedic text); studying; (according to the Vedānta-sāra) the determining by means of the six Liṅgas the import of the whole Vedānta in regard to the Real and only existing Being; fame, glory; wealth; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the ear; the hypothenuse of a triangle; (अस्, आ), m. f., N. of one of the lunar asterisms (placed either twenty-second or twenty-third in the common list, and presided over by Viṣṇu, whence it is represented by three footsteps contain-ing three stars, अ, α, β, and γ Aquilæ; cf. त्रि-विक्रम); (अस्), m. a sort of disease, = श्रोण; (आ), f. a species of plant, = मुण्डीरिका; (अस्, आ, अम्), produced in or under Śravaṇā. —श्रवण-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —श्रवण-द्वादशी, f. a particular Tithi or lunar day (when certain religious ceremonies of great efficacy are observed; it is said to fall on the twelfth of the light half of Bhādra, when that month is connected with the asterism Śravaṇā). —श्र-वण-पथ, अस्, m. ‘hearing-path,’ the ear. —श्र-वण-परुष, अस्, आ, अम्, hard or cruel to the ear, hard to be listened to. —श्रवण-पालि, इस्, f. the tip of the ear. —श्रवण-विधि, इस्, m. a method or rule of hearing or studying. —श्रवण-विधि-विचार, अस्, m., N. of a treatise on the study of the Upani-shads. —श्रवण-विषय-प्रापिन्, reaching the range of the ear. —श्रवण-शीर्षिका, f. a kind of plant (= श्रावणी). —श्रवणाधिकारिन् (°ण-अध्°), ई, m. ‘one who rules or influences the ears (of others),’ a speaker, addresser. —श्रवणेन्द्रिय (°ण-इन्°), अम्, n. the organ of hearing, the ear. —श्रवणोत्पल (°ण-उत्°), अम्, n. ‘ear-lotus,’ a lotus fastened in the ear (as an ornament). —श्र-वणोदर (°ण-उद्°), अम्, n. the hollow of the outer ear.
47425: श्रवणस्य, अस्, m. a proper N.
47426: श्रवणिका-व्रत, अम्, n. epithet of a particular religious observance.
47427: श्रवणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be heard, &c.; to be celebrated, praiseworthy.
47428: श्रवयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. making famous or celebrated, celebrating.
47429: श्रवस्, अस्, n. the ear; fame, renown, glory [cf. Gr. κλέος]; wealth; a hymn, eulogy; anything deserving praise, a praiseworthy action, (in the latter senses chiefly Ved.); food, (Sāy. = अन्न।)
47430: 1. श्रवस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worthy of praise, praiseworthy, to be celebrated, (Sāy. = श्रवणीय); (अम्), n. anything praiseworthy, fame, glory, renown.
47431: 2. श्रवस्य, Nom. P. श्रवस्यति, &c., to desire fame or glory; to desire a sacrifice or oblation.
47432: श्रवस्या, f., Ved. desire of fame or glory; desire of food.
47433: श्रवस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desirous of fame or that which deserves praise, eager for glory, desiring wealth or treasures; desirous of food or of an obla-tion.
47434: श्रवाप्य, अस्, m. an animal fit for sacrifice, sacri-ficial animal.
47435: श्रवाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be praised, noto-rious, well-known, (Sāy. = श्रवणीय); (अस्), m. an animal fit for sacrifice; [cf. श्रवाप्य।]
47436: श्रविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, most famous; (आ), f., N. of a lunar asterism (placed twenty-fourth in the com-mon list; it is also called Dhaniṣṭhā, q. v., and corresponds to the four principal stars in the head of the Dolphin); (अस्, आ, अम्), produced in or under Śraviṣṭhā. —श्रविष्ठा-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born under Śraviṣṭhā; (अस्), m. the planet Mercury.
47437: श्रविष्ठक, अस्, m., N. of a Muni, (see श्र-विष्ठ।)
47438: श्रव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be heard, worthy of being listened to.
47440: श्रावक, अस्, इका, अम्, hearing, a hearer; (अस्), m. a pupil, disciple; a particular class of Buddhist saints or ascetics, (properly one who by adhering to the teaching of the Buddha and practising the four great truths becomes eventually qualified to be ranked as an Arhat and to be addressed as Āyuṣ-mat; eighty of the disciples of the great Buddha are called Mahā-śrāvakas or Great Śrāvakas); a Bauddha or Buddhist votary (in general); a heretic; a crow. —श्रावक-व्रत, N. of a Jaina treatise.
47441: श्रावण, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the ear or hearing, audible; belonging to or produced under the asterism Śravaṇā; (अस्), m. the month Śrāvaṇa (July-August); a heretic, impostor [cf. श्रावक]; N. of a Muni; (अम्), n. the act of causing to be heard; knowledge derived from hearing; (आ), f. a kind of plant (com-monly called Kaṭukī); (ई), f. the day of full moon in the month Śrāvaṇa; N. of one of the domestic sacrifices; a species of plant (= भिक्षु). —श्रा-वण-कृष्ण-चतुर्थी, f. the fourth day in the dark half of the month Śrāvaṇa. —श्रावण-द्वा-दशी, f. the twelfth day of Śrāvaṇa. —श्रावणद्वा-दशी-व्रत, अम्, n. a religious observance on the above day. —श्रावण-विधि, इस्, m., N. of a Pari-śiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda. —श्रावण-शुक्ल-चतुर्थी, f. the fourth day in the light half of the month Śrāvaṇa. —श्रावण-शुक्ल-तृतीया, the third day in the light half of the month Śrāvaṇa.
47442: श्रावणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or produced in the month Śrāvaṇa; (अस्), m. the month Śrāvaṇa.
47443: श्रावणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to be heard, to be declared or pronounced.
47444: श्रावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to be heard, making famous, conferring honour. —श्रावयत्-पति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. causing the mighty to hear, i. e. gaining the ear of the mighty gods; (Sāy.) conferring honour on fathers, making ancestors celebrated.
47445: श्रावयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to be heard, to be declared or made known.
47446: श्रावयित्वा, ind. having caused to hear, having made to be heard.
47447: श्रावष्ठीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to the asterism Śravaṇā or (according to some) to Śraviṣṭhā, produced in or under this asterism.
47448: श्रावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be heard, spoken, told, related, narrated, read.
47449: श्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, hearing, a hearer.
47450: श्राव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to be heard, to be told or related or read; to be heard.
47451: श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, heard, listened to; reported, heard of; ascertained, understood; called; (अस्), m., N. of an enemy of Indra (Ved.); of a son of Dharma; of a son of Bhagīratha; of a son of Upagu; of a son of Kṛṣṇa; (अम्), n. the object of hearing; that which was heard from the beginning, the Veda, revelation, sacred knowledge, holy writ, &c. —श्रुत-ऋषि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. one by whom the Ṛṣis have been heard, (Sāy. = श्रुता ऋषयो येन; cf. श्रु-तर्षि।) —श्रुत-कक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a Vedic Ṛṣi (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 81). —श्रुत-कर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a son of Saha-deva. —श्रुत-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f. ‘Veda-renown,’ fame of divine science; (इस्, इस्, इ), having renowned fame, cele-brated, famous; (इस्), m. epithet of various persons; a divine sage; a generous man, benefactor, donor; (इस्), f. a river; N. of the wife of Śatru-ghna; of other women. —श्रुत-केवलिन्, इनस्, m. pl. epithet of a class of Jaina Arhats (of whom six are enume-rated). —श्रुतञ्-जय, अस्, m., N. of a king. —श्रु-त-देवा, f., N. of a daughter of Śūra and wife of Vṛddha-śarman. —श्रुत-देवी, f. ‘goddess of learn-ing,’ epithet of Sarasvatī. —श्रुत-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, recollecting or remembering what has been heard, having or observing the Vedas; (अस्), m., N. of a poet; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people (inhabiting a division of Plaksha-dvīpa). —श्रुत-प्रकास, अस्, आ, अम्, renowned for knowledge of the Vedas. —श्रुत-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of the author of several hymns in the Ṛg-veda. —श्रुत-बोध, अस्, m., N. of a treatise on the most common Sanskrit metres by a certain Kālidāsa. —श्रुतर्षि (°त-ऋषि), इस्, m. a kind of secondary Ṛṣi, one by whom the Vedic Ṛṣis have been heard; the son of a Ṛṣi; a Ṛṣi of a particular order (as the author of the Su-śruta). —१। श्रुत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has heard, hearing. —२। श्रुत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing or knowing the Veda, instructed in sacred learning, pious; (आन्), m., N. of a king. —श्रुत-विद्, त्, m. ‘knowing sacred revelation,’ N. of an Ātreya (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 62). —श्रुत-शील, अस्, m. a proper N. —श्रुत-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a king; (आस्), f., N. of a daughter of Śūra. —श्रुतश्रवो-ऽनुज (°वस्-अन्°), अस्, m. ‘born after Śruta-śravas,’ the planet Saturn (said to be one of the sons of Sūrya). —श्रुत-श्रोणी, f. a kind of plant (= द्रवन्ती). —श्रुत-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a son of Parīkṣit. —श्रुत-सोम, अस्, m., N. of a son of Bhīma. —श्रुतादान (°त-आद्°), अम्, n. ‘Veda-acceptation,’ citing the Vedas. —श्रुताध्य-यन-सम्पन्न (°त-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, well read in sacred science, conversant with the Vedas. —श्रु-तान्वित (°त-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with or conforming to the Vedas. —श्रुता-मघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having renowned treasures. —श्रुतायु or श्रुतायुस् (°त-आय्°), उस्, m., N. of a king of the solar race descended from Kuśa, son of Rāma; of a son of Purū-ravas; of another king: —श्रुतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘heard-matter,’ any matter ascer-tained by hearing, a fact verbally or orally communi-cated.
47452: श्रुतर्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man (protected by the Aśvins).
47453: श्रुतर्वन्, आ, m. a proper N.
47454: श्रुति, इस्, f. ‘audition,’ hearing; an ear; anything heard, sound, oral account, report, rumour, intelli-gence, news; that which was heard or revealed from the beginning, revelation, the Veda (i. e. sound eternally heard and so differing from स्मृति or what is only remembered and handed down by human authors, see Manu II. 10; properly applied to works considered to have been revealed by a deity, and therefore only to the Mantra and Brāhmaṇa portion of the Vedas, but often applied also to the Upaniṣads and other Vedic works); any Vedic or sacred text, (इति श्रुतेः, according to or because of such a श्रुति or Vedic text); the hearing of a sound, a sound; the diagonal of a tetragon or hypothenuse of a triangle; (in music) a particular division of the octave, a quarter tone or interval, (twenty-two of these are enumerated, four constituting a major tone, three a minor, and two a semitone; they are said to be personified as nymphs); the constellation Śra-vaṇā. —श्रुति-कट, अस्, m. penance, expiation; a snake; (according to Śabda-k.) = प्राञ्चल्लोह। —श्रुति-कटु, उस्, उस्, उ, harsh to the ear, unme-lodious; (उस्), m. a harsh or unmelodious sound, cacophony (a fault in rhetoric). —श्रुति-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned in the Veda, taught or prescribed by the Vedas. —श्रुति-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f., N. of a work. —श्रुति-चोदन, अम्, n. ‘Veda-precept,’ holy pre-cept or injunction, the doctrine of the Vedas. —श्रुति-जीविका, f. a law-book or code of laws. —श्रुति-तत्-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, intent on hearing; intent on studying the Veda. —श्रुति-द्वैध, अम्, n. dis-agreement or contradiction of any two passages in the Vedas or of two Vedas. —श्रुति-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, ascertaining or perceiving by the ear, hearing; holding or observing the Vedas; (अस्), m., N. of a poet; [cf. श्रुत-धर।] —श्रुति-निदर्शन, अम्, n. the evidence of revelation, testimony of the Veda. —श्रुति-प्रसादन, अस्, ई, अम्, gratifying the ear, grateful to the ear. —श्रुति-प्रामाण्यतस्, ind. on the authority of the Veda, with the sanction of the Veda. —श्रुति-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘ear-circle,’ the outer ear. —श्रुति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of ears, capable of hearing. —श्रुति-मूल, अम्, n. the root of the ear; the text of the Vedas. —श्रुति-मूलक, अस्, आ, अम्, founded on the Veda, springing from the Veda. —श्रुति-मृग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought by hearing or by the Vedas (not by sight). —श्रुति-वर्-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of hearing, deaf; ignorant or unread in the Vedas. —श्रुति-विप्रतिपन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, dissenting from revelation, disregarding the doctrine of the Veda. —श्रुति-विषय, अस्, m. the object of hearing (i. e. sound, see विषय); subject-matter or doctrine of the Veda, any sacred matter or ordinance; (अस्, आ, अम्), conversant with sacred matters, familiar with the Veda. —श्रुति-विषय-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having the quality [sound] which is the object of hearing or which is perceptible by the ear,’ epithet of ether. —श्रुति-वेध, अस्, m. the piercing or boring of the ear. —श्रुति-स्फोटा, f. a kind of creeper (= कर्ण-स्फोटा). —श्रुति-स्मृति, ई, f. du. the Veda and legal tradition, the Veda and institutes of law. —श्रुति-स्मृति-विरुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed to the Vedas and to tra-dition or law. —श्रुति-स्मृति-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, enjoined by the Vedas and the law. —श्रुति-स्मृत्य्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम्, declared or enjoined by the Veda and law. —श्रुत्य्-अनुप्रास, अस्, m. repetition of sound, alliteration. —श्रुत्य्-उक्त or श्रुत्य्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम्, said or enjoined by the Vedas.
47455: श्रुतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hearing; obeying, observing; having or possessing the Veda, following the Veda.
47457: श्रुत्-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who has hearing ears, quick-hearing.
47458: श्रुत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be heard, famous, glorious.
47459: श्रुत्वा, ind. having heard or listened to, &c.
47460: श्रुश्रुतवत्, आन्, अती, अत् (doubtful; said to be a reduplicated form), one who has heard.
47461: श्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to some) heard, handed down, (श्रुष्टे, according to tradition or ordinance.)
47462: श्रुष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. hearing, listening to, audience; help, assistance; a boon; prosperity, happiness, abundance, (Sāy. = यज्ञ-फल-रूपं सुखम्, Ṛg-veda I. 69, 4.) —श्रुष्टि-गु, उस्, m., N. of the author of one of the Vālakhilya hymns. —श्रुष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing happiness, pros-perous, happy, (Sāy. = सुख-वत्।)
47463: श्रुष्टी, ind. (according to some an old inst. or dat. for श्रुष्ट्यै), Ved. having heard, having listened to, (Sāy. = श्रुत्वा, Ṛg-veda VIII. 23, 14); ‘as soon as heard,’ readily, quickly, in a moment, (Sāy. = क्षिप्रम्; in Ṛg-veda II. 3, 9. श्रुष्टी is regarded as a nom. c. masc. and explained by क्षि-प्र-गुणः।)
47464: श्रुष्टी-वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. possessing happiness, granting prosperity, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 45, 2. ex-plains श्रुष्टीवानः by श्रुष्टिः फलस्य दानं तद्-भाजः; in Ṛg-veda I. 119, 1. श्रुष्टीवानम् = क्षिप्रं सम्भजमानम् or सुखवन्तम्; श्रुष्टीवरीः = सुखवत्यः, Ṛg-veda X. 30, 11); listening to, helping (according to some).
47465: श्रूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being heard, heard. —श्रूयमाण-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of being heard.
47466: श्रोतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be heard or listened to.
47467: 1. श्रोतस्, अस्, n. the ear; an organ of sense; the trunk of an elephant (as his special organ). —श्रोत-आपन्न, अस्, m., N. of one of the four orders of Buddhist Āryas. —श्रोतो-रन्ध्र, अम्, n. an aper-ture of the proboscis, a nostril.
47468: श्रोतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. hearing, a hearer; re-nowned. —श्रोतु-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having re-nowned wealth or gifts.
47469: श्रोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who hears, hearing, a hearer; (ता), m. a pupil.
47470: श्रोत्र, अम्, n. the organ of hearing, ear; con-versancy with the Veda or sacred revelation; the Veda; [cf. Angl. Sax. hleodhor.] —श्रोत्र-पदा-नुग, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeable to the ear. —श्रोत्र-पेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be imbibed by the ear, i. e. to be heard respectfully. —श्रोत्र-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, splitting the ears. —श्रोत्र-मूल, अम्, n. the root of the ear. —श्रोत्र-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding agreeably, melodious, musical. —श्रोत्रादि (°र-आदि), इ, n. ‘the ear and the other senses,’ i. e. the five senses, (see इन्द्रिय।)
47471: श्रोत्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, learned in the Veda, con-versant with sacred revelation, teachable, docile, well-behaved; (अस्), m. a Brāhman versed in the study of the Vedas, a theologian, divine; a Brāhman fol-lowing a particular branch or school of the Vedas. —श्रोत्रिय-ता, f. conversancy with the Vedas, the being a learned Brāhman. —श्रोत्रिय-स्व, अम्, n. the property of a learned Brāhman, (Manu VIII. 149.)
47472: श्रोमत (according to Sāy. to be connected with rt. 1. श्रु), Ved. fame, renown, (Sāy. श्रोमताय = कीर्त्तिमत्त्वाय, Ṛg-veda I. 182, 7; श्रोमतेभिः = श्रोतव्यैर् यशोभिः, Ṛg-veda VI. 19, 10; श्रो-मतेन = श्रवणीयेन पुंस्त्वेन, Ṛg-veda VIII. 66, 9.)
47473: श्रोषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hearing, listening.

47558: श्लोक् श्लोक् (probably rather a Nom. fr. श्लोक below), cl. 1. A. श्लोकते, श्लोकि-तुम्, to versify, compose or make verses, hymn or praise in verse; to be put together or composed; to acquire; to relinquish, abandon.

47563: श्लोण् श्लोण् (also written श्रोण्), cl. 1. P. श्लोणति, श्लोणितुम्, to accumulate, col-lect, assemble, heap together: Caus. श्लोणयति, -यि-तुम्, Aor. अशुश्लोणत्।

47567: श्वङ्ग् श्वङ्ग् (also written श्रङ्ग्, स्वङ्ग्, &c.; cf. rt. श्वङ्क्), cl. 1. P. श्वङ्गति, श्वङ्गितुम्, to go, move.
47568: श्वच् श्वच् or श्वञ्च् (= rts. शञ्च्, श्वज्), cl. 1. A. श्वचते, श्वञ्चते, &c., (Ved. form श्वञ्चयः, Ṛg-veda X. 138, 2; शश्वचै, see s. v.), to go, move; to gape, open, be opened, be split.
47569: श्वज् श्वज् or श्वञ्ज् (= rts. श्वच्, शञ्च्), cl. 1. A. श्वजते, श्वञ्जते, &c., to go, move.

47571: श्वठ् 1. श्वठ् (= rt. 2. शठ्), cl. 10. P. श्वठयति, -यितुम्, to speak ill; (ac-cording to some) to speak well or correctly; to be accurate or true.

47600: श्वस् 2. श्वस्, ind. (according to some con-nected with a lost rt. श्वि in श्वित्, ‘to be white,’ and originally denoting ‘the morrow's dawn’), to-morrow; future, (at the beginning of a comp.); future happiness or fortune, (apparently used in this sense at the beginning of certain comps.); a particle implying auspiciousness; [cf. 47601: श्वस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the morrow, what will be to-morrow, future; (अम्), n. the future [cf. Lat. crastinus]; (ई), f., scil. विभक्ति, a gram-matical term for the personal terminations of the first future.
47602: श्वस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the morrow, what will be to-morrow, future.

47892: सं-वनन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, subduing by charms, adorable, (Sāy. = स्तोतृभिः सम्यक् सम्भज-नीय); (अम्, आ), n. f. causing mutual fondness; sub-duing by magical drugs or charms [cf. सं-वदन]; charming, fascination; means of securing love, a charm; fondness, love; (अस्), m., N. of an Āṅgirasa (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 191).
47893: संवन्द् सं-वन्द्, cl. 1. A. -वन्दते, -वन्-दितुम्, to salute respectfully.
47894: संवप् सं-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to throw together, mix, pour in, put in; to scatter, sow.
47897: संवर्ण् सं-वर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -वर्णयति, -यि-तुम्, to communicate, relate, narrate, tell; to praise.
47900: संवर्मय संवर्मय (fr. वर्मन् with सम्), Nom. P. A. संवर्मयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to put on armour, arm one's self fully.
47901: संवर्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully armed, completely mailed.
47904: संवलित सं-वलित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वल् with सम्), met together, mixed, mingled; con-nected or associated with; united; encompassed, surrounded; possessed of; broken, diversified (= चूर्णित, Kirāt. VI. 4, Schol.).
47905: संवल्गित सं-वल्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, overrun.
47906: संववृत्वस् सं-ववृत्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत् (fr. rt. 1. वृत् with सम्, but apparently connected with rt. वृ), one who has enveloped, enveloping, (ac-cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 31, 3. सं-ववृत्वत् = संवरण-शीलम्।)
47907: संवस् 1. सं-वस् (see rt. 5. वस्), cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to wear (clothes), be clad in, be dressed with.
47908: सं-वस्त्रय (fr. सम् + वस्त्र), Nom. P. -वस्-त्रयति, -यितुम्, to put on clothes, dress.
47909: सं-वस्त्र्य, ind. having put on clothes, having dressed in.
47910: संवस् 2. सं-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P. A. -वसति, -ते, -वस्तुम्, to dwell together, live with, to have intercourse or dealings with (some-times with acc. of person); to cohabit with (with acc.); to stay, abide, dwell; to spend, pass (time): Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dwell together, bring together; to furnish with lodging, lodge.
47911: सं-वसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dwelling together, &c.
47912: सं-वसथ, अस्, m. a place where people live together, village, inhabited place.
47913: सं-वसन, अम्, n. residing together, dwelling.
47914: सं-वसान, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling with, residing amongst.
47915: सं-वसु, उस्, m., Ved. one who dwells along with, living with, (Sāy. सं-वसुः = संवसति, Ṛg-veda VIII. 39, 7.)
47916: सं-वास, अस्, m. dwelling along with, cohabita-tion, domestic intercourse; a dwelling, residence, house; an open space for meeting or recreation (either within or without a town, = सन्-निवेश); association, company, society.
47917: सम्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelt or lived together, stayed with; passed, spent (as time).
47918: संवह् सं-वह् [cf. सम्-ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to bear or carry together, convey together; to carry or bear along, take along, draw, drag, bear away; to convey; to bring near; to take a wife, marry; to carry the hand along the body, rub down, press together, shampoo, stroke, soothe; to manifest, display, express: Pass. -उह्यते, to be carried by, ride on (with inst.): Caus. -वाह-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to be carried together; to bring together, assemble, collect; to drive (a car-riage &c.), guide, conduct, lead, lead or conduct to (one's home), take a wife, marry; to carry the hand along the body, stroke, shampoo: Pass. of Caus. -वाह्यते, to be carried away, be driven along, &c.
47919: सं-वह, अस्, m. bearing or carrying along; N. of the wind of the third of the seven Mārgas or paths of the sky, (viz. that which impels the moon; the other six are called आ-वह, प्र-व्°, उद्-व्°, वि-व्°, परि-व्°, नि-व्°, the Saṃ-vaha coming above the Ud-vaha wind.)
47920: सं-वाह, अस्, m. bearing or carrying along, pressing together; rubbing the body, shampooing; an attendant employed to rub and shampoo the body; N. of one of the winds, (see सं-वह above.)
47921: सं-वाहक, अस्, m. an attendant who rubs and shampooes the limbs, a shampooer.
47922: सं-वाहन, अम्, n. rubbing the person, sham-pooing; bearing (a burden), carrying.
47923: सं-वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought together; to be borne or carried along; to be rubbed, to be shampooed; (अस्), m., scil. अग्नि, a kind of sacrificial fire; [cf. 1. सम्-ऊह्य।]
47924: सम्-उह्य, ind. having brought together, having arranged or put in order; [cf. 2. सम्-ऊह्य।]
47925: सम्-उह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being borne or carried along; being carried by, riding on (with inst.).
47926: 1. सम्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see under सम्-ऊह्), borne or conveyed together, carried or borne along, borne away; led, conducted; married.
47927: संवा सं-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, to blow at the same time, blow.
47928: सं-वात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, blowing together, blowing (as wind).
47929: संवाञ्छ् सं-वाञ्छ्, cl. 1. P. -वाञ्छति, वाञ्छितुम्, to long for, wish, desire, be eager for.
47930: संवाटिका संवाटिका, f. the aquatic plant Trapa Bispinosa.
47932: संवाश् सं-वाश्, cl. 4. A. -वाश्यते (Ved. and ep. also P. -वाश्यति, and cl. 1. P. A. -वाशति, -ते), -वाशितुम्, to roar or cry at the same time, bellow or low together, bleat: Caus. -वाशयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to cry or low together.
47933: सं-वावशान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. roaring at the same time, bellowing together.
47934: संवासित सं-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, made fra-grant, perfumed; made fetid, having an offensive smell (said of the breath).
47935: संवाह् सं-वाह् [cf. सं-वह्, to which the forms and senses given to this verb are perhaps more properly referred], cl. 1. A. -वाहते, &c. (see rt. 1. वाह्), to rub together, shampoo, knead (the limbs), stroke: Caus. -वाहयति, &c., to rub to-gether, shampoo.
47937: संविच् सं-विच्, cl. 3. P. -वेवेक्ति, &c., Ved. to keep entirely separate or distinct.
47938: सं-विक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely separated or dis-tinct; (अम्), n. that which is separated or individual-ized.
47939: संविचि सं-वि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to separate entirely, keep quite apart.
47940: सं-विचेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entirely sepa-rated, to be kept quite apart; to be removed.
47941: संविचिन्त् सं-वि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति, -यितुम्, to consider fully, meditate or reflect upon.
47942: संविज् सं-विज्, cl. 7. P., 6. A. -विनक्ति, -विजते, &c., -विजितुम्, to tremble violently, shake, be agitated; to start with fear, start up, run away: Caus. -वेजयति, -यितुम्, to startle, frighten, terrify.
47943: सं-विग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, flurried, startled, alarmed, frightened, terrified, distracted. —सं-विग्न-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated or distracted in mind.
47944: सं-वेग, अस्, m. agitation, flurry; excessive im-petus or impetuosity, vehemence, haste proceeding from terror; hurry, haste, speed.
47945: संविज्ञा सं-वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to recommend, advise (with gen. of person): Caus. -ज्ञापयति, -ज्ञपयति, -यितुम्, to make known; to recite, repeat.
47946: सं-विज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, universally known or recognised, generally allowed.
47947: संवितर्क् सं-वि-तर्क्, cl. 10. P. -तर्कयति, -यितुम्, to deliberate about, reflect upon.
47948: संविद् 1. सं-विद्, cl. 2. P. A. (see Vārtt. to Pāṇ. I. 3, 29), -वेत्ति, -वित्ते (3rd pl. -विदते or -विद्रते), &c., to know together, know thoroughly, know, recognise; to investigate, explore, examine; to perceive, feel, taste; to come to an understanding, agree together; to admonish, advise, teach; to meditate; cl. 6. P. A. -विन्दति, -ते, &c., to find, meet with, obtain, acquire, gain; to meet together (with inst.): Pass. -विद्यते, to be found or ob-tained; to be, exist: Caus. -वेदयति, -यितुम्, to cause to know or perceive, &c.; to make known, inform, announce, instruct; to know, perceive, ob-serve, recognise: Pass. of Caus. -वेद्यते, to be informed, &c.; to be perceived.
47949: सं-वित्ति, इस्, f. perception, ascertainment, know-ledge, consciousness, feeling; intellect, understanding; recognition, recollection; mutual reconciliation, ac-commodation of disputes, harmony.
47950: 2. सं-विद्, त्, f. knowledge, intellect, understand-ing; = महत् (in philosophy); a mutual understand-ing, agreement, contract, covenant, engagement; consent, assent, promise; prescribed custom, esta-blished usage; an alliance, marriage (Ved.); a watch-word, war-cry; war, battle; a name, appellation; a sign, signal; participation, sympathy; pleasing, delighting (= तोषण); meditation (= समाधि); hemp. —संविद्-व्यतिक्रम, अस्, m. breach of promise, violation of contract.
47951: सं-विदान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being found with or together with; connected, united; agreeing with, harmonious.
47952: सं-विदित, अस्, आ, अम्, known, recognised, under-stood; well-known; explored; agreed upon, assented to; admonished, advised; (अम्), n. agreement.
47953: सं-विद्वस्, आन्, m. one who has known or knows.
47954: सं-वेद, अस्, m. perception, consciousness, know-ledge, understanding.
47955: सं-वेदन, अम्, n. the act of perceiving; per-ception, sensation, feeling, suffering.
47956: सं-वेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, made known, informed, instructed, &c.
47957: सं-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be known or under-stood; to be made known; (अस्), m. the junction of two rivers.
47958: सं-वेविदान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.), Ved. = सं-विदान above.
47959: संविधा 1. सं-वि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to dispose, arrange, fix, settle; to direct, order; to carry on, perform, accomplish, conduct, manage, do, act, render, make, attend to, mind; to use, employ; to set, lay, place, put, (मा-नसं सं-विधा, to keep the mind fixed or composed): Pass. -धीयते, to be arranged or fixed; to be performed, &c.
47960: 2. सं-विधा, f. arrangement, plan, preparation; mode of life.
47961: सं-विधातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be disposed or arranged, &c.
47962: सं-विधान, अम्, n. disposition, arrangement; performance; plan, mode, rite.
47963: संविधानक, अम्, n. a strange act, unusual occurrence.
47964: सं-विधाय, ind. having disposed or arranged, hav-ing appointed or fixed; having directed or ordered; having performed; having used or employed, &c.
47966: संविनी सं-वि-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to take entirely away, remove, suppress.
47967: सं-विनीय, ind. having removed entirely, having suppressed.
47969: संविभज् सं-वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, to divide, separate; to share with; to give a share to, distribute, apportion (with dat. or gen.); to furnish or provide any one (acc.) with anything (inst.), bestow upon, give to: Caus. -भा-जयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be divided.
47970: सं-विभक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, divided, parted, sepa-rated, shared with, conferred upon, bestowed, given.
47971: सं-विभज्य, ind. having divided or distributed.
47972: सं-विभाग, अस्, m. a dividing together, distribut-ing, apportioning, partition; part, portion, share.
47973: सं-विभागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sharing in; (ई), m. a sharer, co-partner. —संविभागि-ता, f. or संवि-भागि-त्व, अम्, n. participation, co-partnership.
47974: संविभा सं-वि-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भा-तुम्, to long for, be desirous of; to meditate on (= सङ्कल्पयति).
47975: संविभाष् सं-वि-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -भाषितुम्, to speak to, address.
47977: संविमृश् सं-वि-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, &c., to reflect upon, consider.
47978: सं-विमृश्य, ind. having reflected or considered.
47979: संविराज् सं-वि-राज्, cl. 1. P. A. -राजति, -ते, &c., to shine forth, be very illustrious.
47980: संविलङ्घ् सं-वि-लङ्घ्, cl. 10. P. or Caus. -लङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to leap over, pass by, trans-gress, neglect.
47981: संविवृध् सं-वि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -वर्धितुम्, to grow, increase, prosper.
47983: संविश् सं-विश्, cl. 6. P. -विशति (ep. also A. -ते), -वेष्टुम्, to enter together; to lie together; to enter; to lie down, rest, repose; to lie or cohabit with (with acc.); to sit down with; to engage in: Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to enter, cause to lie down, cause to rest on, place, lay.
47984: 1. सं-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, entered together; entered; lying down, resting on, reposing; seated together.
47985: सं-वेश, अस्, m. sleep, sleeping; lying together, cohabitation, copulation; dreaming, a dream; a seat, chair, stool.
47987: सं-वेशन, अस्, m., Ved. one who enters; one who introduces; (अम्), n. the act of causing to enter or causing to lie down; sexual union, coition.
47988: सं-वेशयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making to lie down.
47989: संविष् सं-विष्, cl. 3. P. A. -वेवेष्टि, -वे-विष्टे, &c., to procure; to clothe, dress.
47990: 2. सं-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, clothed, dressed.
47991: संविषा सं-विषा, f. the plant Aconitum Ferox (= अति-विषा).
47992: संविहस् सं-वि-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, &c., to laugh at, laugh.
47993: संवीक्ष् सं-वीक्ष् (-वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -वीक्-षते, -वीक्षितुम्, to look about; to look at atten-tively, look into thoroughly; to perceive.
47994: सं-वीक्षण, अम्, n. looking about in all direc-tions, looking for (anything lost), search, inquiry; looking or gazing attentively.
47995: सं-वीक्ष्य, ind. having looked at or into, hav-ing searched for; having perceived.
47997: संवृ सं-वृ or सं-वॄ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम् (ep. also -वर्तुम्), to cover over, cover, enclose, hide, conceal; to secure; to keep together, close, shut up, compress, contract; to put or place together, arrange, put in order; to keep or ward off, avert, restrain, keep back, stop; to refuse, reject; to select, choose: Caus. -वारयति, -यितुम्, to cover; to restrain; to keep back, ward off, avert.
47998: सं-वर, अस्, m. (sometimes written and con-founded with सम्बर), covering; comprehending, comprehension, collection; closing, contraction, com-pression; a causeway, dam, mound, bridge; a kind of deer (= शम्बर); a sort of fish (= शम्बर); N. of a demon, = शम्बर; (अम्), n. covering, con-cealment; restraint, self-control, forbearance; a parti-cular religious observance (with Buddhists); water.
47999: सं-वरण, अम्, n. the act of covering or screening, concealing, enclosing, concealment; a secret; a disguise, pretext; the act of closing, shut-ting; an enclosure; a sanctuary, house, (in Ṛg-veda IX. 107, 9. according to Sāy. संवरणानि = सम्-भजनीयानि रस-रूपाण्य् अन्नानि; according to some, used as an epithet of rivers enclosed in beds); (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 33, 34 (having the patronymic Prājāpatya); N. of a king mentioned in the Mahā-bhārata, (the father of Kuru.)
48000: सं-वार, अस्, m. covering, concealing, closing up; compression or contraction of the throat &c. (in pronunciation), obtuse articulation (opposed to वि-वार or acute articulation, and regarded as one of the Vāhya-prayatnas); diminution.
48001: 1. सं-वार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered or con-cealed; to be secured, &c.
48002: 2. सं-वार्य, ind. having kept off, having warded off or averted, having repelled.
48003: सं-वुवूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to cover or conceal or disguise, &c.
48004: सं-वृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, hiding, concealing; compressing.
48005: सं-वृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, hiding, &c.
48006: सं-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered up, covered, en-closed, enveloped, surrounded; concealed, hidden, kept secret, secured; retired, secluded; closed, shut, shut up, secured, put away, kept in safety; contracted, compressed (as the throat &c.); restrained, sup-pressed; sequestered, confiscated; filled with, full of; furnished or attended with, accompanied by; (अम्), n. a secret place; (in grammar) a particular mode of pronunciation, (one of the Ābhyantara-prayatnas.) —संवृत-संवार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who con-ceals what ought to be concealed, securing what ought to be secured. —संवृताकार (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who conceals all signs of feeling.
48007: सं-वृति, इस्, f. covering up, concealment, com-pression, suppression; secret purpose.
48008: सं-वृत्य, ind. having concealed; having closed or compressed.
48009: संवृंह् सं-वृंह् (see rt. वृंह्, also written बृंह्), cl. 1. P. -वृंहति, -वृंहितुम्, to join firmly together (Ved.): Caus. -वृंहयति (Ved. -वर्हयति), &c., to cause to be joined together, to unite (Ved.); to make strong, strengthen, invigorate; to incite, stimulate, encourage, animate, urge, (Sāy. सं-वर्हय = उत्साहय, Ṛg-veda VII. 31, 12.)
48010: संवृज् 1. सं-वृज्, cl. 7. P. A. -वृणक्ति, वृङ्क्ते, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to bend or attract or appropriate to one's self, carry off, despoil; to devour, consume, (Sāy. = खादति): Desid. -विवृक्षते, to wish to appropriate.
48011: सं-वर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. plunder, spoils, (Sāy. = सम्यग् वृष्टेर् वर्जयिता, discharger of rain, Ṛg-veda X. 43, 5); (perhaps) food, (Sāy. संवर्-गम् = शत्रुभ्यः सहाच्छिद्यमानम्, Ṛg-veda VIII. 75, 12); epithet of Agni (‘the consumer’). —संवर्ग-जित्, त्, m., N. of a preceptor.
48012: सं-वर्ग्य, अस्, m., N. of a sage.
48013: सं-वर्जन, अम्, n. the act of bending or appro-priating to one's self; devouring, consuming.
48014: सं-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, consumed, devoured, de-stroyed. —संवृक्त-धृष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has cut off or destroyed valiant (enemies; Sāy. सञ्छिन्ना धर्षण-शीला शत्रवो येन).
48015: 2. सं-वृज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. one who carries off, a spoiler; one who consumes or destroys.
48016: सं-वृज्य, ind. = सं-हृत्य, having carried off, &c.
48017: संवृत् सं-वृत्, cl. 1. any faculty, capacity, instinct; operation, influence; preparation, making ready, preparation of food, &c., cooking, dressing, compounding; decoration, embellishment, ornament, elegance; making sacred, hallowing, con-secration, dedication; consecration of a king, &c.; making pure, purification, purity; a sanctifying or purificatory rite or essential ceremony (enjoined on all the first three or twice-born classes; the following are the twelve purificatory rites given in Manu II. 27, but of these ten only are enjoined according to some authorities, the tenth and eleventh being omitted: 1. गर्भाधान, ‘embryo-reception,’ on the first sigh of conception, sometimes on a woman's attain-ing maturity: 2. पुं-सवन, ‘male-production,’ on the first signs of vitality in the embryo: 3. सी-मन्तोन्नयन, ‘parting the hair’ of a pregnant woman in the fourth, sixth, or eighth month of her first pregnancy: 4. जात-कर्मन्, ‘birth-ceremony,’ i. e. giving the infant butter out of a golden spoon before cutting the navel-string: 5. नाम-कर्मन् or नाम-करण, ‘naming-rite’ on the tenth or twelfth day after birth: 6. निष्क्रमण, ‘taking out’ the child when three months old to see the sun or, according to some, to look at the moon: 7. अन्-न-प्राशन, ‘feeding with boiled rice’ in the sixth month after birth: 8. चूडा-कर्मन् or चूडा-क-रण, ‘tonsure-rite,’ i. e. shaving the head all but the चूडा or one lock in the first or third year after birth: 9. उप-नय or उप-नयन, ‘investiture’ with the sacrificial thread, see उप-नय; this is the most important of all the Saṃskāras: 10. के-शान्त, ‘cutting off the hair:’ 11. सम्-आवर्तन, ‘returning,’ a rite performed on the student's return home after completing his studies: 12. विवाह, ‘marriage:’ other Saṃskāras are mentioned as peculiar to various parts of India, e. g. अन्-अवलोभन, per-formed by a pregnant woman to prevent disappointment or miscarriage; विष्णु-बलि, an offering to Viṣṇu on the seventh month of pregnancy; स्वर्गारोहण, सूर्य-विलोकन, कर्ण-वेध, q. q. v. v.); any rite or ceremony; funeral obsequies; a polishing stone. —संस्कार-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by purificatory rites. —संस्कार-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of part of Raghu-nandana's Smṛti-tattva. —संस्कार-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered pure by sacred rites, purified by refinement. —संस्कार-भास्कर, अस्, m., N. of a work on the Saṃskāras by Saṅkara. —संस्कार-रहित or संस्कार-वर्जित = संस्का-र-हीन below. —संस्कार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possess-ing refinement, cultivated. —संस्कारवत्-त्व, अम्, n. the being possessed of refinement. —संस्कार-विधि, इस्, m. the rules of Saṃskāra, the law concern-ing purificatory rites. —संस्कार-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of purificatory rites; 48232: संस्फुट सं-स्फुट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्फुट् with सम्), bursting open, blossomed, blown.
48235: संस्फेट सं-स्फेट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्फिट् with सम्), war, battle.
48236: संस्मि सं-स्मि, cl. 1. A. -स्मयते, -स्मेतुम्, to laugh at, deride: Desid. -सिस्मयिषते, to wish to laugh at or deride.
48237: सं-सिस्मयिषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to ridicule, desirous of laughing at.
48238: संस्मृ सं-स्मृ, cl. 1. P. -स्मरति, -स्मर्तुम्, to remember fully, recollect (with acc. or gen.); Caus. -स्मारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to remember, remind of.
48239: सं-स्मरण, अम्, n. the act of remembering, calling to mind, recollecting.
48240: सं-स्मरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fully remembering, recollecting well.
48241: सं-स्मर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be remembered; to be thought upon.
48242: सं-स्मार्य, ind. having caused to remember, having reminded of.
48243: सं-स्मृत, अस्, आ, अम्, remembered, recollected, called to mind.
48244: सं-स्मृति, इस्, f. remembering, remembrance, recollection.
48245: सं-स्मृत्य, ind. having remembered or called to mind.
48246: संस्रव सं-स्रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्रु with सम्), flowing, oozing out; that which flows, a stream; anything flowing off or remaining; the droppings or remains of a libation; a kind of offer-ing or libation.
48247: सं-स्राव, अस्, m. flowing, oozing out; a kind of offering or libation.
48249: संस्वप् सं-स्वप्, cl. 2. P. -स्वपिति, &c., to sleep soundly, sleep.
48250: सं-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, soundly asleep, fast asleep, asleep, sleeping.
48251: संस्वृ सं-स्वृ, cl. 1. A. -स्वरते, -स्वर्तुम्, -स्वरितुम्, to hymn, praise (Ved.); to pain, afflict, torment, cause pain.
48252: संहन् सं-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to strike together, join or unite closely, put together, close (the hands &c.), shut; to contract, diminish; to bring together, heap, accumulate, collect; to fight together, clash; to strike, kill, destroy completely: Caus. -घातयति, -यितुम्, to strike together, kill, destroy utterly.
48254: सं-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck together, closely joined or united, closed, shut; well knit or com-pacted together, firmly united, compact, close, firm, solid; closely allied; combined, joined, connected, acting or making effort together, keeping together; collected, assembled, accumulated; struck, hurt, wounded, killed. —संहत-जानु, उस्, उस्, उ, or संहत-जानुक, अस्, ई, अम्, knock-kneed. —सं-हत-तल, अस्, m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together. —संहत-ता, f. or संहत-त्व, अम्, n. compactness, close combina-tion; close contact or approximation, conjunction; union, agreement. —संहत-भ्रू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, knitting the brows. —संहत-स्तनी, f. (a woman) whose breasts are very close to each other. —सं-हताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a king.
48255: सं-हति, इस्, f. the state of being brought into close contact, firm or close combination, firm union or alliance, junction, joint effort, agreement, com-pactness, firmness, solidity, bulk, mass, assemblage, collection, heap, number, host, multitude.
48256: सं-हत्य, ind. having struck together, having closed or joined.
48257: सं-हनन, अस्, ई, अम्, striking together; kill-ing, destroying, a destroyer, conqueror; (अम्), n. the act of striking together, compactness, inflexi-bility; strength, muscularity; rubbing the limbs; the body (as having the limbs well compacted).
48258: सं-हनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. destructive, deadly.
48259: सङ्-घ, अस्, m. close contact or combination; any collection or assemblage, heap, multitude, quantity, crowd, host, band, number, group, flock, shoal; any number of people or inhabitants living together. —सङ्घ-गुप्त, अस्, m. a proper N., (also read सिंह-गुप्त।) —सङ्घ-चारिन्, ई, m. ‘going in shoals,’ a fish. —सङ्घ-जीविन्, ई, m. ‘living by multitudes of people,’ a hired labourer, porter, cooly. —सङ्घ-तल, अस्, m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together. —सङ्घ-पुष्पी, f. a particular plant (= धातकी). —सङ्घ-वृत्ति, इस्, f. a state of close combination. —सङ्घवृत्ति-ता, f. combined action. —सङ्घ-शस्, ind. collec-tively, all together; by troops, in flocks, in shoals, in companies.
48260: सङ्-घात, अस्, m. close combination, union, association, connection, confederacy; a collection, quantity, assemblage, multitude, heap, cluster, band; a collection of mucus, phlegm [cf. सङ्-घाणक]; composition of words, formation of compounds; striking, killing, hurting; a particular gait or mode of walking (in the drama); N. of a division of the infernal regions; [cf. सं-हात।] —सङ्घात-क-ठिन, अस्, आ, अम्, compactly or solidly hard, hard from solidity or compactness. —सङ्घात-पत्त्रिका, f. a sort of fennel (= शत-पुष्पा). —सङ्घात-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having close union, possessing a heap or multitude, closely compacted or combined.
48262: संहर्ष 1. सं-हर्ष, अस्, m. (for सङ्-घर्-ष, q. v.; for 2. see under सं-हृष्), rubbing, grinding, trituration; envy, emulation; air, wind.
48263: संहवन सं-हवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. हु with सम्), the act of sacrificing or offering oblations toge-ther; sacrificing in a proper manner; a quadrangle, group of four houses; [cf. सञ्-जवन।]
48264: संहा सं-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, &c., to go together, proceed; to obtain.
48265: सञ्-जिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving.
48266: संहात संहात, अस्, m. (probably for सङ्-घात, q. v.), one of the twenty-one hells (mentioned in Manu IV. 89).
48268: संहि सं-हि, cl. 5. P. -हिनोति, &c., to send forth, utter.
48271: संहृ सं-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-तुम्, to bring or draw together; to contract, abridge, compress; to close, clench (the fists &c.); to crush together, crumple up, destroy, annihilate, (opposed to सृज्); to bring together, collect, accumulate; to draw together, unite, bind by obligations; to draw aside (a curtain &c.), withdraw, withhold, hold back, take back; to restrain, suppress, curb; to lay hold of, seize, subtract, take: Pass. -ह्रियते, to be drawn together, be contracted or abridged; to be destroyed; to be finished or concluded; to be restrained, &c.: Desid. -जिहीर्षति, to wish to draw together or destroy or annihilate.
48272: सं-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, drawing together, bringing together; contracting; destroying, &c. —संह-राख्य (°र-आख्°), अस्, m. ‘called Saṃhara,’ the fire Pāvaka.
48273: सं-हरण, अम्, n. the act of drawing or bring-ing together; contracting; crumpling together, de-stroying, destruction, ruin; collecting, accumulating; withdrawing; restraining, checking; seizing, taking.
48274: सं-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who draws together or contracts, &c.; destroying, a destroyer.
48275: सं-हार, अस्, m. drawing together, contraction, abridgement, comprehensive description, abbrevia-tion, compression; a fault in pronunciation, (opposed to वि-हार); close, end, conclusion, (काव्य-सं-हार, अस्, m. ‘the close of a poem,’ epithet of the benediction at the conclusion of a drama); destruc-tion, loss; the periodical destruction of the universe at the end of a Kalpa; collection, assemblage, accu-mulation; withdrawing, withholding, restraining, suppressing; a charm or spell for restraining magical weapons or bringing them back after discharging them; seizing, laying hold of, taking [cf. वेणी-स्°]; a division of the infernal regions; practice, skill. —संहार-भैरव, अस्, m. one of the eight forms of Bhairava, q. v. —संहार-मुद्रा, f., N. of a particular posture in the Tantra worship (= विसर्जन-मुद्रा).
48276: सं-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, drawing together, compressing, closing; destructive, ruinous; a de-stroyer.
48277: सं-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drawn together or contracted, to be abridged; to be destroyed, &c.; to be restrained or curbed or suppressed.
48278: सं-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn together; contracted, compressed, abridged; closed; destroyed, scattered; collected, assembled; withdrawn, withheld; restrained, curbed; seized, laid hold of.
48279: सं-हृति, इस्, f. contraction, compression, abridge-ment; destruction, loss, disappearance; collection; restraint; taking, seizure.
48280: सं-हृत्य, ind. having drawn together or con-tracted, having abridged; having closed or clenched (the fist); having destroyed.
48281: संहृष् सं-हृष्, cl. 4. P. -हृष्यति, -हर्-षितुम्, to bristle, stand erect (as the hair of the body from joy or fright); to thrill with delight, be glad, rejoice.
48282: 2. सं-हर्ष, अस्, m. bristling or erection of the hair of the body (either from rapture or terror), thrill of delight, joy, pleasure; ardour, emulation, (perhaps for सङ्-घर्ष); air, wind; trituration, rubbing together, (for सङ्-घर्ष।) —संहर्ष-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing joy, enraptured.
48283: सं-हृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, thrilled, enraptured, rejoiced, delighted, glad; bristling, shuddering; fired with ardour or emulation. —संहृष्ट-रोमन्, आ, आ, अ, or संहृष्ट-रोमाङ्ग (°म-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the hair of the body bristling (with joy or fright), thrilling with joy.
48284: संहोत्र सं-होत्र, Ved. = समीचीन-यज्ञ, Ṛg-veda X. 86, 10.
48285: संह्राद सं-ह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्रद् with सम्), a loud noise, uproar, sound, noise.
48286: सं-ह्रादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding together, making a noise, tumultuous, noisy. —संह्रादि-कण्ठ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a sounding throat.
48287: संह्री सं-ह्री, cl. 3. P. -जिह्रेति, &c., to be quite ashamed.
48288: सं-ह्रीण, अस्, आ, अम्, altogether ashamed; bash-ful, modest.
48289: संह्लाद सं-ह्लाद, अस्, m., N. of a son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu (and brother of Pra-hlāda, q. v.).
48290: संह्वे सं-ह्वे, cl. 1. A. -ह्वयते, -ह्वातुम् (Ved. Inf. -ह्वयितवै), to call out loudly, shout together; to call out, tell, relate, make known.
48291: सं-हूति, इस्, f. shouting or calling out together, general shout or clamour, exclamation, tumultuous exultation.
48292: सक सक, अस्, m. (a diminutive fr. स, the base of nom. sing. of तद्), he, that man; (आ), f. she, (Ṛg-veda I. 191, 11.)
48293: सकट स-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, bad, vile; (अस्), m. the small tree Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट)। —सकटान्न (°ट-अन्°), अम्, n. impure food (ac-cording to some).
48294: सकण्टक स-कण्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, having thorns, thorny, prickly; troublesome, perilous; (अस्), m. the aquatic plant Vallisneria (= शैवाल); a kind of Karañja.
48295: सकपटम् स-कपटम्, ind. with fraud or dissimulation, fraudulently.
48296: सकमल स-कमल, अस्, आ, अम्, having lotuses, abounding in lotuses.
48297: सकम्प स-कम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having tremor, tremulous.
48298: स-कम्पन, अस्, आ, अम्, having tremor, trem-bling; accompanied with earthquakes; (according to Nīla-kaṇṭha) = स-विद्युत्।
48299: सकर 1. स-कर, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कर), having hands; possessing a trunk (as an elephant).
48300: सकर 2. स-कर, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. कर), having rays, full of rays; having or bearing tax, bringing in toll, liable to pay taxes.
48301: सकरुण स-करुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having pity, tender, compassionate; (अम्), ind. compassionately, tenderly.
48302: सकर्ण स-कर्ण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having ears; hearing, listening; accompanied by Karṇa.
48303: सकर्तृक स-कर्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, having an agent.
48304: स-कर्मक, अस्, m. having or performing any act; (in grammar) ‘having an object,’ the transitive or active verb.
48305: स-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, performing any act or rite; following similar business.
48306: स-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a cause, originating from a cause.
48307: सकल 1. स-कल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. स and कला), together with parts or portions; all, whole, entire; (अम्), n. everything; the whole; [cf. Lith. cźiela-s; Russ. zielyï; Slav. ziel; Pol. saly, salki; perhaps Goth. hail-s; Old Norse heil; Angl. Sax. hal.] —सकल-सिद्धि-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving all perfection. —१। सकल-हंस-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing entire or unbroken flocks of geese. —सकलार्-थ-शास्त्र-सार (°ल-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, containing the essence of precepts about all things. —सकलेन्दु (°ल-इन्°), उस्, m. the full moon. —सकलेन्दु-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having a face like the full moon.
48308: सकल 2. स-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a soft or low sound.
48309: सकलङ्क स-कलङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having spots or stains, stained, contaminated.
48310: सकलत्र स-कलत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by a wife.
48311: सकलह स-कलह, अस्, आ, अम्, having quar-rels, quarrelsome, quarrelling.
48312: सकलहंसगण 2. स-कलहंस-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, having flocks of Kala-haṃsas.
48313: सकल्प स-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having the ritual or ceremonial part of the Veda, along with the ritual, (Manu II. 140); having rites or ceremonies; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva.
48314: सकवच स-कवच, अस्, आ, अम्, having armour or mail, clad in armour, mailed.
48315: सकाकोल स-काकोल, अस्, m. one of the twenty-one hells (mentioned in Manu IV. 89).
48316: सकातर स-कातर, अस्, आ, अम्, cowardly, dastardly; (अम्), ind. with cowardice, in a cowardly manner.
48317: सकाम स-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, having love or affection, full of love, loving, a lover; one who has obtained his wish, contented, satisfied, humoured, gratified; (अम्), ind. with pleasure; contentedly, assuredly, indeed. —सकामारि (°म-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of lovers,’ epithet of Śiva.
48319: सकार्मुक स-कार्मुक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bow, armed with a bow.
48320: सकाल स-काल, अस्, आ, अम्, seasonable; (अम्), ind. seasonably, betimes, early in the morning.
48321: सकाली सकाली, f., N. of a place. —सकाली-समुद्र, N. of a place.
48322: सकाश स-काश, अस्, आ, अम्, having appear-ance or visibility, visible, present, near; (अस्), m. presence, propinquity, vicinity, nearness; (अम्, ए), ind. in the presence of, near; (आत्), ind. from the presence of, from.
48323: सकिरीटकौस्तुभ स-किरीट-कौस्तुभ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a diadem and breast-jewel.
48324: सकुक्षि स-कुक्षि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the same womb, born from the same mother (as a brother or other relation of whole blood).
48325: सकुण्डल स-कुण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, having ear-rings, decorated with ear-rings.
48326: सकुरुण्ड सकुरुण्ड, अस्, m. yellow Ama-ranth or Barleria (= साकुरुण्ड, कुरुण्ट).
48327: सकुल स-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a family; belonging to a noble family, &c.; belonging to the same family; (अस्), m. a kinsman; (अस्, ई), m. f. a sort of fish (= शकुल).
48328: सकुल्य, अस्, m. one of the same family and name (= स-गोत्र); a distant relation, remote kins-man (said to be one who shares a divided oblation, e. g. the grandson's grandson or even other descendants as far as three degrees or more from him; sometimes extended to the tenth descendant).
48329: सकृच्छ्र स-कृच्छ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having trouble or distress, attended with pain, painful, dis-tressing.
48330: सकृत् 1. स-कृत्, ind. (connected with rt. 1. कृ), once, on one occasion only [cf. अ-स्°]; at one time; at once, together; together with, with; always; [with the former part of this word cf. Lat. se, si, sim, of the words se-mel, si-mul, sim-plex, and Gr. ἁ of ἁ-πλοῦς; with the latter part cf. Lith. kartas.] —सकृत्-प्रज, अस्, m. ‘having offspring once,’ a crow. —सकृत्-प्रयोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. being employed only once. —सकृत्-प्रसूतिका, f. one who has borne one child; (a cow) that has calved once. —सकृत्-फला, f. ‘bearing fruit once,’ the plantain tree (= कदली). —सकृत्-सू, ऊस्, f., Ved. one who bears a child only once. —सकृद्-आगामिन्, ई, m., N. of one of the four orders of Bud-dhist Āryas. —सकृद्-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘having only one conception,’ a mule, = खेसर; (आ), f. a woman who is pregnant only once. —सकृद्-वीर, अस्, m. a kind of plant (= एक-वीर).
48331: सकृत् 2. सकृत्, त्, m. (more usually written शकृत्, q. v.), excrement, feces, ordure.
48332: सकृप स-कृप, अस्, आ, अम्, having pity, com-passionate; with Kṛpa, accompanied by Kṛpa.
48333: स-कृपण, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiable, miserable, wretched.
48334: सकेश स-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, having hair, hairy.
48335: सकैतव स-कैतव, अस्, आ, अम्, having fraud, fraudulent; (अस्), m. a deceiver, cheat, impostor; (अम्), ind. fraudulently.
48336: सकोप स-कोप, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, full of anger, angry, displeased; (अम्), ind. with anger, angrily.
48337: सकौतुक स-कौतुक, अस्, आ, अम्, full of ex-pectation, eagerly expectant; (अम्), ind. expectantly.
48338: सक्त सक्त, सक्ति। See under rt. सञ्ज्।
48339: सक्तु सक्तु, उस्, उ, m. n. (also written शक्तु, q. v.; according to Uṇādi-s. I. 70. fr. rt. सच्; ac-cording to some only masc. pl.), the flour of barley (fried before ground); barley-meal. —सक्तु-प्रस्-थ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a Prastha or particular measure of flour. —सक्तुप्रस्थीय, अम्, n., N. of an episode in the Mahā-bhārata. —सक्तु-फला or सक्तु-फली, f. ‘having fruit resembling flour,’ the Śamī tree, Mimosa Suma.
48340: सक्तुक, अस्, m. = सक्तु above; a species of poison.
48341: सक्तुल, अस्, आ, अम्, containing flour.
48342: सक्थि सक्थि, इ, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 154. fr. rt. सञ्ज्, because the body ‘is attached to’ or ‘rests on’ the thigh; according to Yāska fr. rt. सच्; the base of some cases is सक्थन्, see below; in Ṛg-veda X. 86, 16. सक्थ्या = सक्थिनी, n. du., occurs), the thigh; a bone; the pole or shafts of a cart; a part of the frame of a cart.
48343: सक्थ at the end of a comp. = सक्थि।
48344: सक्थन्, a form of base substituted for सक्थि above, in the weakest cases (e. g. inst. sing. सक्थ्ना, dat. सक्थ्ने, abl. gen. सक्थ्नस्, loc. सक्थ्नि or सक्थनि, gen. pl. सक्थ्नाम्, Ved. acc. pl. सक्-थानि).
48345: सक्म सक्म, सक्म्य। See under rt. सच्।
48346: सक्रिय स-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, having action, active, mutable, movable, migratory; one who ob-serves his religious duties.
48347: सक्रोध स-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, full of anger, angry; (अम्), ind. with anger, angrily.
48349: सक्षण स-क्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a leisure moment, being at leisure.
48350: सक्षणि सक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (according to some fr. rt. क्षन्, perhaps fr. rt. 1. सह्; according to Sāy. fr. rt. सच्), Ved. overpowering, destroying; honouring, obeying; to be honoured; (Sāy. = स-चमान, Ṛg-veda VIII. 70, 8; = सचनीय-शील, VIII. 22, 15.)
48351: सक्षत्रम् स-क्षत्रम्, ind. suitably to the state of a Kṣatriya.
48352: सक्षित् स-क्षित्, त्, त्, त् (see 2. क्षित्), Ved. dwelling along with, associated together, going to-gether.
48353: सखड्ग स-खड्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, armed with a sword, sword in hand.
48354: सखि सखि, आ, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 136. fr. स for समान + rt. ख्या; according to others fr. 4. स and rt. 2. क्षि, and meaning ‘living together’), a friend, (किं-स्°, a bad friend); an associate, companion; [cf. Lat. socius.] —सखि-ता, f. or सखि-त्व, अम्, n. friendship, intimacy. —सखि-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has been formerly a friend; (अम्), n. the being formerly a friend. —सखि-वत्, ind. like a friend, as a friend. —सखि-विग्रह, अस्, m. war of friends, civil war.
48355: सख, अस्, m. a friend, (frequently used at the end of comps. for सखि above; cf. नर-स्°, व-सन्त-स्°); the tree Mimosa Catechu.
48356: सखी, f. a female friend or companion, a woman's confidante, (कु-सखी, a bad female friend.) —स-खी-कदम्बक, अम्, n. a number of female friends. —सखी-गण, अस्, m. a number of female friends. —सखीगण-समावृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded by a company of female friends. —सखी-जन, अस्, m. a female friend, confidante. —सखी-सहित, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by female friends.
48357: सखीय, Nom. P. सखीयति, &c., to wish for a friend.
48358: सखीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring friends, desirous of friendship.
48359: सख्य, अम्, n. friendship, intimacy; equality; (अस्), m. a friend.
48360: सखेद स-खेद, अस्, आ, अम्, having grief or sorrow; (अम्), ind. with grief, sorrowfully.
48361: सखेलम् स-खेलम्, ind. with a gentle motion, moving gently.
48362: सग् सग्, cl. 1. P. सगति, ससाग, असगीत्, सगितुम्, to cover: Caus. सगयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to cover.
48363: सगजारोह स-गजारोह, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-panied by an elephant-rider, attended by men riding on elephants.
48364: सगण स-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, having troops or flocks, accompanied by a troop, attended by a body of followers; attended or accompanied by (with inst.); (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva.
48365: सगद्गदम् स-गद्गदम्, ind. with stammer-ing, in a faltering voice.
48366: सगन्ध स-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, having a smell, odoriferous, fragrant, sweet-smelling; (अस्), m. a relation, kinsman, co-heir.
48367: सगन्धर्व स-गन्धर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, together with the Gandharvas.
48368: सगर स-गर, अस्, आ, अम्, having poison, poisonous; (अस्), m. the ocean, sea (Ved., enumerated among the अन्तरिक्ष-नामानि in Naigh. I. 3; also अम्, n.); N. of a king of the solar race, sovereign of Ayodhyā (son of Bāhu; he is said to have been called Sagara, as born together with a poison given to his mother by the other wife of his father; he was father of Asamañja by Keśinī and of sixty thousand sons by Sumati; the latter were turned into a heap of ashes by the sage Kapila, see भगीरथ, and their funeral ceremonies could only be performed by the waters of Gaṅgā to be brought from heaven for the purpose of purifying their remains; this was finally accomplished by the devotion of Bhagīratha, q. v., who having led the river to the sea, called it Sāgara in honour of his ancestor: Sagara is described as having subdued the Śakas, Yavanas, and other barbarous tribes, and de-prived them of their social and religious position); N. of a particular Arhat. —सगरोपाख्यान (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. ‘the story of Sagara,’ N. of the fifteenth chapter of the Svarga-khaṇḍa of the Padma-Purāṇa.
48369: सगर्भ स-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, pregnant; (अस्), m. ‘having the same womb,’ a brother by the same father and mother, a brother of whole blood (= स-होदर; cf. Gr. ἀδελφός (आ), f. a pregnant woman.
48370: सगर्भ्य, अस्, m. a brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother.
48371: सगर्व स-गर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, proud; joyful, glad, elated; (अम्), ind. haughtily.
48372: सगुडशृङ्गक स-गुडशृङ्गक, अस्, इका, अम्, furnished with cupolas.
48373: सगुण स-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having properties or qualities, &c.; possessing good qualities or attri-butes, virtuous; worldly.
48374: सगूढम् स-गूढम्, ind. secretly, privately, privily.
48375: सगोत्र स-गोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, being of the same family or kin, related; (अस्), m. a kinsman of the same family; one sprung from a common an-cestor; one connected by funeral oblations of food and water; a distant kinsman; (अम्), n. a family, race, lineage.
48376: सग्धि स-ग्धि, इस्, f. (contracted fr. सह-जग्धि, see जग्धि), eating together; (इस्, इस्, इ,), Ved. eating together.
48377: सग्मन् सग्मन्, enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि in Naigh. II. 17.
48378: सघ् सघ्, cl. 5. P. सघ्नोति, ससाघ, सघिष्यति, असघीत् or असाघीत्, सघि-तुम्, to strike, hurt, injure, kill; to receive, accept; to support, bear [cf. rt. 1. सह्]: Caus. साघयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असीषघत् or असीसघत्: Desid. सिसघिषति: Intens. सासघ्यते, सासग्धि।
48379: सघन स-घन, अस्, आ, अम्, having density or solidity, dense, solid.
48380: सङ्क सङ्-क, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Sāy. fr. rt. कै with सम्; but according to Yāska, Nir. IX. 14, either fr. rt. सच् or fr. सङ्-कॄ), sounding together, shouting; having assembled warriors; (in Naigh. II. 17. सङ्काः is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि।)
48381: सङ्कट सङ्-कट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सम् + कट, q. v.), ‘having the hips close together,’ contracted, narrow, strait; impassable, impervious; crowded; (अस्), m. a proper N.; (आ), f. a particular goddess worshipped at Benares; a particular Yoginī, (seven others are named, viz. Maṅgalā, Piṅgalā, Dhanyā, Bhrāmarī, Bhadrikā, Ulkā, Siddhi); (अम्), n. a narrow passage, strait, defile, pass; a strait, difficulty, trouble, (प्राण-सङ्कट, risk of life.) —सङ्क-टाक्ष (°ट-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘having contracted eyes,’ winking, leering; (अस्), m. the tree Grislea Tomentosa (= धव). —सङ्कटापन्न (°ट-आप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, beset with difficulties.
48382: सङ्कथ् सङ्-कथ् (सम्-कथ्), cl. 10. P. -क-थयति, -यितुम्, to relate or narrate fully, tell, com-municate, inform; to explain; to speak about or of (with acc.); to converse.
48383: सङ्-कथन, अम्, n. the act of narrating fully, narration, relation.
48384: सङ्-कथा, f. conversation, discourse, talking to-gether.
48385: सङ्-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, related, narrated, com-municated.
48386: सङ्-कथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being told or related.
48387: सङ्कन् सङ्-कन् (सम्-कन्, cf. 2. का, rt. कै), cl. 1. P. -कनति, &c. (apparently only used in the participle below), Ved. to be satisfied or pleased, &c.; [cf. rt. चक्।]
48388: सञ्-चकान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. satisfied with, pleased; praised, glorified, (Sāy. = स्तूयमान, as if fr. rt. कै with सम्।)
48389: सङ्कम्प् सङ्-कम्प् (सम्-कम्प्), cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -कम्पितुम्, to shake about, quake, tremble: Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shake or tremble.
48392: सङ्कल् 1. सङ्-कल् (सम्-कल्, see rt. 2. कल्), cl. 10. P. -कालयति, -यितुम्, to drive together, drive to; to drive away, put to flight.
48394: सङ्कल् 2. सङ्-कल् (सम्-कल्, see rt. 3. कल्), cl. 10. P. -कलयति, -यितुम्, to heap together, pile up, accumulate; to grasp, lay hold of; to consider, deem, regard as.
48395: सङ्-कल, अस्, m. collection, accumulation, quan-tity; addition.
48396: सङ्-कलन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of heaping toge-ther; contact, junction, collision, intermixture; blend-ing, twining; (अम्), n. addition (in arithmetic).
48397: सङ्-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped together, piled up, collected, brought together, blended, intermixed, arranged; added; laid hold of, grasped; (आ), f. (in arithmetical progression) the first sum; (अम्), n. addition (in arithmetic). —सङ्-कलितैक्य (°ता-ऐक्°), अम्, n. the sum of the sums or terms (of an arithmetical progression).
48399: सङ्कसुक सङ्-कसुक, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 29. fr. rt. कस् with सम्), going or moving about unsteadily, unsteady, inconstant, fickle, changeable; uncertain, doubtful; weak, feeble; bad, wicked; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 18 (having the patronymic Yāmāyana).
48400: सङ्काश् सङ्-काश् (सम्-काश्), cl. 1. A. -काशते, काशितुम्, to appear together, appear in sight, become visible: Caus. -काशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to ap-pear; to look at, see, contemplate, behold.
48401: सङ्-काश, अस्, m. appearance; presence; vicinity, (गृह-सङ्काशे, in the neighbourhood of the house, near the house); (अस्, आ, अम्), like, similar (at the end of comps., e. g. मृत्यु-सङ्काश, death-like; गज-स्°, resembling elephants); near, close at hand.
48403: सङ्किल सङ्किल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. किल् with सम्), a burning torch, fire-brand.
48406: सङ्कु सङ्कु, उस्, m. (doubtful), a hole.
48407: सङ्कुच् सङ्-कुच् (सम्-कुच्), cl. 6. 1. P. -कु-चति, -कोचति, -कोचितुम्, to shrink, become con-tracted, contract, shrivel up; to close, shut (as a flower); to contract, compress: Pass. -कुच्यते, to be con-tracted, be closed: Caus. -कोचयति, -यितुम्, to con-tract, narrow, make smaller, lessen; to close up.
48408: सङ्-कुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted, narrowed, shriveled up, shrunk, wrinkled, (अ-सङ्कुचित, not wrinkled); closed, shut, unblown (as a flower); crouching, cowering.
48409: सङ्-कोच, अस्, m. contracting, shriveling up, con-traction, shrinking; terror, fear; compression, abridge-ment, narrowness, diminution; shutting up, closing; binding, tying; a sort of skate fish; (अम्), n. saffron. —सङ्कोच-पिशुन, अम्, n. ‘manifesting contrac-tion,’ saffron.
48410: सङ्-कोचन, अम्, n. the act of contracting or shrinking, contraction, causing to shrink or close; astringing; (अस्, ई, अम्), contracting, shrinking; astringent; (ई), f. the sensitive plant (= लज्जालु).
48411: सङ्-कोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, contracting, causing to shrink or close, narrowing.
48412: सङ्-कोचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shrinking, contracting, shrivel-ing up; closing; astringent.
48413: सङ्-कोच्य, ind. having contracted or compressed, &c.
48414: सङ्कुप् सङ्-कुप् (सम्-कुप्), cl. 4. P. A. -कुप्-यति, -ते, -कोपितुम्, to become angry or enraged; to be agitated or excited: Caus. -कोपयति, -यितुम्, to make angry, enrage, provoke, excite; to become agitated or excited.
48415: सङ्-कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, aroused, excited.
48416: सङ्-कोपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making angry, en-raging, exciting.
48417: सङ्कुल सङ्कुल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कुल् with सम्; probably connected with सङ्-कर fr. सङ्-कॄ), crowded together, thronged, mixed together, commingled, confused, perplexed, disordered, incon-sistent; filled with, full of; (अस्), m., N. of a poet; (अम्), n. a crowd, throng, mob; a flock, collection; a confused fight, battle, war, mêlée; inconsistent or contradictory speech.
48418: सङ्कूज् सङ्-कूज् (सम्-कूज्), cl. 1. P. -कूजति, &c., to cry aloud, utter inarticulate sounds.
48419: सङ्-कूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, cried aloud; (अम्), n. the cry of the Cakra-vāka.
48420: सङ्कृ सङ्-कृ (सम्-कृ), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, = सं-स्-कृ, q. v.
48421: सङ्-कृति, इस्, f. a kind of metre (consisting of four lines of twenty-four syllables each); (इस्), m. a proper N.; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a class of ancient Ṛṣis.
48422: सङ्कृत् सङ्-कृत् (सम्-कृत्), cl. 6. P. -कृन्-तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut to pieces, cut up; to cut through, cut, pierce.
48423: सङ्-कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut to pieces, cut through, pierced.
48424: सङ्-कृत्य, ind. having cut to pieces, having cut up.
48425: सङ्कृष् सङ्-कृष् (सम्-कृष्), cl. 1. P. -कर्-षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw together, contract; to lace together, tighten; to draw away, withdraw; to drag away with, drag along, carry off, take away.
48426: सङ्-कर्षण, अम्, n. the act of drawing together, contracting; shortening; attracting, drawing; mak-ing rows, ploughing, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of the first-born offspring of Viṣṇu, (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 7527); epithet of Bala-deva or Bala-rāma (elder brother of Kṛṣṇa, and so called because withdrawn from the womb of Devakī and transferred to that of Rohiṇī); a proper N. —सङ्कर्षण-काण्ड, N. of a work ascribed to Jaimini. —सङ्कर्षणेश्वर-तीर्थ (°ण-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
48427: सङ्-कर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, drawing together, contracting; drawing away.
48428: सङ्-कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, drawing together, con-tracting, shortening, (काल-सङ्कर्षिन्, shortening the time; कालसङ्कर्षिणी विद्या, epithet of a particular magical incantation.)
48429: सङ्-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn together, con-tracted (as two sounds), drawn near to one another.
48430: सङ्कॄ सङ्-कॄ (सम्-कॄ), cl. 6. P. -किरति, -क-रितुम्, -करीतुम्, to pour together, mix together, commingle; to confuse; to scatter about, diffuse; to pour out, bestow liberally or abundantly (Ved.); to make full, fill: Pass. -कीर्यते, to be poured toge-ther, be intermingled or mixed; to be confused.
48431: सङ्-कर, अस्, m. mixing together, intermixture, blending, confusing, confounding, confusion, irregular mixture, unlawful intermarriage, mixture of caste, a mixed caste or race (proceeding from the union of a man with a woman of a higher caste or from the promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes, and again from the indiscriminate cohabitation of their descend-ants amongst each other; cf. योनि-सङ्कर); the union or mixing together of two figures in the same passage (in rhetoric); dust, sweepings [cf. अव-कर, p. 88]; the crackling of flame. —सङ्कर-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from a mixed marriage. —सङ्करी-करण, अम्, n. the act of mixing together, con-fusing; confusion; causing mixture or loss of caste. —सङ्करी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to mix together confusedly, cause confusion. —सङ्करी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, confused, blended or mixed confusedly; outcast.
48432: सङ्करिन्, ई, इणी, इ, confusing, confused, inter-mingled, produced by or resulting from illegal mixture of castes.
48433: सङ्-कार, अस्, m. dust, sweepings; the crackling of flame; (ई), f. a girl recently deflowered, a new bride.
48434: सङ्-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, poured together, mixed together, intermingled, confused, miscellaneous, crowded, closely packed; indistinct; scattered, strewed, spread, diffused; sprinkled (with exuding juice, as a rutting elephant); of mixed caste, of impure origin, born from a mixed marriage, impure, polluted, adul-terated; contracted, narrow; (अस्), m. a man of mixed caste, an outcast; a mixed note or mode (in music); an elephant possessing certain characteristic marks or one in rut; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —सङ्कीर्ण-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wandering about confusedly, going to various places. —सङ्-कीर्ण-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, or सङ्कीर्ण-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of mixed birth or caste, impure through illegal intermarriage, of a mongrel breed, mule. —सङ्-कीर्ण-युद्ध, अम्, n. a mixed or confused fight, mêlée.
48435: सङ्कृत् सङ्-कृत् (सम्-कॄत्), cl. 10. P. -कीर्त-यति, -यितुम्, to mention or relate fully, recite; to proclaim, announce; to celebrate or praise or com-mend greatly.
48436: सङ्-कीर्तन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of reciting or proclaiming at full; greatly praising or celebrating, extolling, lauding, honouring, glorification.
48437: सङ्-कीर्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, mentioning or de-scribing fully, proclaiming; celebrating or praising greatly.
48438: सङ्-कीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned fully; cele-brated, praised, renowned.
48439: सङ्-कीर्त्ति, इस्, m., N. of a Vaiśya (said to have been the author of certain Vedic hymns).
48440: सङ्-कीर्त्य, ind. having mentioned, having cele-brated, &c.
48441: सङ्-कीर्त्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being proclaimed or celebrated.
48442: सङ्कॢप् सङ्-कॢप् (सम्-कॢप्), cl. 1.
