54375: 1. हेलि, इस्, f. dalliance, wanton sport, amorous embrace.
54376: हेलित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded, neglected, slighted.
54377: हेलावुक्क हेलावुक्क, अस्, m. (= हेडावुक्क), a horse-dealer, horse-seller.
54378: हेलि 2. हेलि, इस्, m. (probably borrowed fr. Gr. ἥλιος), the sun.
54379: हेलु हेलु, N. of a village in Kaśmīra. —हेलु-ग्राम, अस्, m. the village Helu. —हेलु-दिण्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (दिण्ण Prākṛt for दत्त), pre-sented with (the village) Helu, having received Helu as a present.
54381: हेष् हेष् [cf. rt. ह्रेष्], cl. 1. A. हेषते, जिहेषे, हेषितुम्, to neigh (as a horse), whinny; to make any inarticulate sound, bray, roar; [cf. Gr. γίννος; Lat. hinnio (for hisnio), hin-nulus.]
54382: हेष, अस्, m. neighing; a neigh, braying, roaring. —हेष-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. making a neighing or roaring sound, roaring, (in Ṛg-veda III. 26, 5. said of lions; according to Sāy. हेष-क्रतवः = हेषा-रवस्य क्रतुः करणं येषां ते।)
54383: हेषस्, Ved. (probably) neighing, braying; sound-ing, (in Ṛg-veda X. 89. 12. Sāy. explains हेषसा by शब्द-कारिण्या हेत्या।)
54384: हेषा, f. neighing (of horses), whinnying, braying.
54385: हेषाय, Nom. A. हेषायते, -यितुम्, to neigh, whinny.
54386: हेषित, अम्, n. a neigh or any similar inarticulate sound, neighing, whinnying.
54387: हेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, neighing; (ई), m. a horse.
54388: हेहे हे-हे, ind. (हे, q. v., repeated), a vo-cative particle (used in addressing, calling, or vocife-rating).
54389: है है, ind. a vocative particle (used in calling or vociferating).
54390: हैतुक हैतुक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हेतु), causal, causative; argumentative, rationalistic; (अस्), m. a reasoner, arguer, logical reasoner; a follower of the Mīmāṃsā doctrines; one who requires a reason for everything, a rationalist, sceptic, causalist, sophist, heretic.
54391: हैतुक्य, अम्, n. causality, causativeness, (अ-है-तुक्य, अम्, n. absence of interested motives.)
54392: हैम 1. हैम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. हेमन्), wintry, brumal, cold, frigid, freezing; (अम्), n. hoar-frost, dew.
54393: 1. हैमन, अस्, ई, अम्, winterly, cold; growing in winter, suitable to winter; (अस्), m. the month Mārgaśīrṣa (= November-December); a kind of rice which grows in winter, = षष्टिक; (अस्, अम्), m. n. winter, the cold season, wintry weather.
54394: हैमन्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हेमन्त), wintry, cold; growing in winter, &c.; suitable to winter; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the winter season.
54395: हैमन्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, wintry, cold, growing in winter; (अम्), n. a kind of rice, (see हैमन above.)
54396: हैमल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. हिमल), winter, the cold season.
54397: हैमवत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हिम-वत्), snowy, covered with snow; flowing from the snowy moun-tain; bred in or belonging to the Himālaya moun-tains; (अस्), m. a sort of poison; (ई), f. epithet of the goddess Pārvatī; the river Ganges (which rises in the Himālaya mountains); N. of a wife of Viśvā-mitra; a kind of drug or perfume (= रेणुका); a kind of white orris root; common flax (= अतसी); the plant Svarṇa-kṣīrī; a kind of myrobalan (= हरीतकी); the tawny grape, (in some of these last senses probably to be connected with 2. हैम below); (अम्), n. Bhārata-varṣa or India. —है-मवत-वर्ष, अम्, n. India.
54398: हैम 2. हैम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. हेमन्), golden, made of gold; of a golden yellow colour; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva; the plant Gentiana Che-rayta; (आ or ई), f. yellow jasmine; (अम्), n. the lexicon of Hema-candra. —हैम-कोष, अस्, m. Hema-candra's lexicon. —हैम-चित्र-समुत्सेध, अस्, आ, अम्, enchased with golden pictures. —हैम-मुद्रा or हैम-मुद्रिका, f. a golden coin. —है-ममुद्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having or possessing a golden coin. —हैम-वल्कल, अस्, आ, अम्, having bark garments set with gold, clothed in gold. —हैमा-नेकार्थ (°म-अन्°), N. of a lexicon. —हैमी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become golden, turned into gold.
54399: 2. हैमन, अस्, ई, अम्, golden, made of gold.
54400: हैयङ्गवीन हैयङ्गवीन, अम्, n. (fr. ह्यस् + गो with insertion of nasal), clarified butter pre-pared from yesterday's milking; butter prepared only a day before it is used, fresh butter.
54401: हैरण्यगर्भ हैरण्यगर्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हिरण्य-गर्भ), belonging to Hiraṇya-garbha; (अस्), m. the offspring of Hiraṇya-garbha (i. e. Manu Svāyambhuva, son of Brahmā).
54402: हैरण्यवासस् हैरंयवासस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. हिरण्य + वासस्), having a golden dress or covering; (आस्), m. an arrow.
54403: हैरण्यस्तूप हैरण्यस्तूप, अस्, ई, अम्, be-longing to Hiraṇya-stūpa, q. v.; (अस्), m. a patro-nymic, (see हिरण्य-स्तूप।)
54405: हैरिक हैरिक, अस्, m. (probably connected with rt. 1. हृ, cf. हरिक), a thief.
54406: हैहय हैहय, अस्, m. (thought by some to be connected with हय, a horse), N. of a tribe of people (said to have been descendants of Yadu; they are described in the Purāṇas as separated into five divisions, viz. the Tāla-jaṅghas, Vīti-hotras, Āvantyas, Tuṇḍikeras, and Jātas; they are said to have overrun parts of India along with the Śakas or Scythian tribes); N. of the great grandson of Yadu; of Arjuna Kārtavīrya (as ninth in descent from Haihaya or as king of the Haihayas; he is said to have had a thousand arms; see कार्तवीर्य).
54407: हैहेय, अस्, m. Arjuna Kārtavīrya (= हैहय).
54408: हो हो, ind. a vocative particle used in calling to a person or in challenging (ho! hallo!); also expressive of surprise.
54409: होड् होड् [cf. rts. हुड्, हूड्], cl. 1. A. होडते, जुहोडे, &c., to disregard, disrespect (= rt. हेड्); cl. 1. P. होडति, जुहोड, &c., to go.
54410: होड, अस्, m. a raft, float, boat (= तरान्धु); a title of a particular class of Kāyasthas; a title of Śrotriya Brāhmans in Bengal.
54411: होडा होडा, f. (according to the Laghu-kaumudī), a young girl (in the language of the Vedas).
54412: होडृ होडृ, आ, m. (said to be fr. rt. हुड्; cf. हुर् under rt. हुर्छ्), a robber, foot-pad, high-way-robber.
54413: होढ 1. होढ, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. हुर् under rt. हुर्छ्], stolen; (अम्), n. stolen goods; [cf. 2. स-होढ, p. 1102.]
54414: 2. होढ, Nom. A. होढते, होढायते, see Vopa-deva XXI. 7.
54415: होतृ होतृ, ता, त्री, तृ (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 96. fr. rt. हु; according to others in the sense ‘priest,’ fr. rt. ह्वे), sacrificing, offering oblations with fire, a sacrificer; (ता), m. an offerer of an oblation or burnt-offering (with fire); a priest who at a sacrifice invokes the gods or recites the prayers of the Ṛg-veda, a priest conversant with the Ṛg-veda, (one of the four kinds of officiating priest, see ऋत्व्-इज्, p. 181; properly the Hotṛ priest has three assistants, sometimes called Puruṣas, viz. the Maitrā-varuṇa, Acchāvāka, and Grāva-stut; to these are sometimes added three others, making seven Hotṛ priests in all, viz. the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, Agnīdhra or Agnīdh, and Potṛ, though these last are properly assigned to the Brahman priest; sometimes the Neṣṭṛ is substituted for the Grāva-stut); a sacri-ficing priest (in general); an epithet of Agni or fire, (in this sense fr. rt. हु); (त्री), f. one of the eight Mūrtis or Tanus, i. e. material manifestations of Śiva, (but this may be referred to होत्रिन्, see शिव।) —होता-पोतारौ, m. du. (nom. c.) the Hotṛ and Potṛ priests. —होतृ-वूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (a rite) in which a priest has to be chosen. —होतृ-षदन, अम्, n. the Hotṛ's seat or place where the Hotṛ sits at a sacrifice, (said to be near the उत्तर-वेदि।) —होतृ-संस्था-जप, N. of a liturgical treatise. —होतॄकार (°तृ-ॠक्° or -ऌक्°), अस्, m. the mother of the Hotṛ (according to Vopa-deva, the letters ॠ, ऌ, and ॡ being employed as mystical formularies by the Hotṛ, see ॡ).
54416: होतृक, अस्, m. a minor Hotṛ priest or assistant of the Hotṛ, (see above.)
54417: होत्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. हु), anything intended or fit for offering with fire (generally clarified butter); the clarified butter so offered (= हविस्); a burnt-offering, oblation with fire, a sacrifice, (in Ṛg-veda II. 36, 1. होत्र = होतुर् याग।) —होत्र-वाहन, अस्, m. ‘bearer of the burnt-offering,’ a proper N. —होत्राशंसिन् (°र-आश्°), ई, m. ‘a repeater of the Hotṛ verses,’ a particular minor Hotṛ priest, (the Potṛ, the Neṣṭṛ, and the Āgnīdhra belong to this class.)
54418: होत्रक, अस्, m., Ved. an inferior Hotṛ priest, (the Maitrāvaruṇa or Pra-śāstṛ, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, and the Acchāvāka belong to this class; see हो-तृक।)
54419: होत्रा, f. an oblation, sacrifice; praise (= स्तुति); speech (= वाच्, Naigh. I. 11); N. of a Vedic god-dess (said to have been the wife of Agni).
54420: होत्रिन्, ई, m. a sacrificing priest; the priest who offers the oblation.
54421: होत्री, f. See under होतृ above.
54422: होत्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to an oblation, connected with a burnt-offering, &c.; (अस्), m. the priest who offers an oblation; (अम्), n. any place or chamber where oblations are offered, a sacrificial chamber.
54423: होम, अस्, m. the act of making an oblation to the Devas or gods by casting clarified butter into the fire (accompanied with prayers and invocations; this is regarded as one of the five Mahā-yajñas and called Deva-yajña, see महा-यज्ञ, देव-यज्ञ); an oblation of clarified butter, oblation with fire, burnt-offering; a sacrifice, (अयुत-होम, अस्, m. a sacri-fice of 10,000 burnt-offerings to the planets.) —हो-म-कुण्ड, अम्, n. a hole in the ground for receiv-ing the consecrated fire for an oblation; [cf. अग्नि-कुण्ड, हवनी।] —होम-द्रव्य, अम्, n. anything employed for a Homa-sacrifice or oblation. —होम-द्रव्य-परिमाण, N. of a Pari-śiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda. —होम-धान, अम्, n. a sacrificial chamber. —होम-धान्य, अम्, n. sacrificial grain; sesamum (= तिल). —होम-धूम, अस्, m. the smoke of a burnt-offering or sacrificial fire. —होम-भस्मन्, अ, n. the ashes of a burnt-offering. —होम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has offered an oblation or performed sacrifice. —होम-वेला, f. the time for the burnt-offering. —होम-शाला, f. a chamber or place for keeping the sacred fire for oblations. —होम-स्व-रोत्तर (°र-उत्°), N. of a work. —होमाग्नि (°म-अग्°), इस्, m. sacrificial fire, the fire for an oblation.
54424: होमक, अस्, m. the priest who offers the oblation (= होतृ).
54425: होमन्, अ, n. an oblation, &c. (= होम above).
54426: होमि, इस्, m. clarified butter; fire; water.
54427: होमिन्, ई, m. the priest who makes the oblation (of clarified butter &c.); an offerer of any oblation (e. g. तिल-होमिन्, an offerer of sesamum).
54428: होमीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to an oblation, fit for an oblation, belonging to a sacrifice. —होमीय-द्रव्य, अम्, n. anything used for an oblation (as clarified butter).
54429: होम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or fit for an oblation; (अम्), n. clarified butter.
54430: हौतृक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. होतृ), relating or belonging to the Hotṛ priest, sacerdotal.
54431: हौत्न, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 105. fr. rt. हु), the offerer of an oblation.
54432: हौत्र, अम्, n. (fr. होत्र), the office or function of a Hotṛ priest. —हौत्र-प्रयोग, N. of a prac-tical hand-book for the Hotṛ priests. —हौत्र-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of certain Sūtras by Kātyāyana.
54433: हौत्रक, अम्, n., N. of a Pari-śiṣṭa of the Yajur-veda.
54435: हौम्य, अस्, आ or -मी, अम् (fr. होम), belonging to or fit for a Homa or oblation; (अम्), n. clarified butter. —हौम्य-धान्य, अम्, n. sacrificial grain, sesamum.
54436: होरा होरा, f. (borrowed fr. Gr. ὥρα), the rising of a zodiacal sign; part of the duration of a sign; an hour; a mark, line; a particular scientific work or science, (probably astrological.) —होरा-फल, अम्, n. the result or effect of the rising of a sign. —होरा-मकरन्द, N. of an astrological work. —होरा-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work by Satya. —होरा-सार-सुधानिधि, N. of a work by Nārāyaṇa.
54437: होरिलसिंह होरिल-सिंह, अस्, m. a proper N.
54438: होलक होलक, अस्, m. chick-pea or pulse half parched in the pod or fried on a grass fire.
54439: होलसिंह होल-सिंह, अस्, m. a proper N.
54440: होलाक होलाक, अस्, m. a kind of sweating (practised for the cure of certain diseases).
54441: होलाका होलाका, f. (perhaps fr. the sound made in singing), the spring festival held at the ap-proach of the vernal equinox (commonly called Hūlī or Holī, and one of the most popular festivals in India; it is said to be dedicated to Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs, and is properly celebrated during the ten days pre-ceding the full moon of the month Phālguna, q. v., but usually only for the last three or four days ending with the full moon; the chief observances described are sprinkling one another with red or yellow powder in sport, addressing passers-by with jokes, singing songs in praise of the young Kṛṣṇa, and lighting fires around which rude frolics are practised; in Marāṭhī the name Holī is said to be applied also to the pile prepared for the fire; in some parts of India the Holī festival corresponds to or immediately precedes the Dola-yātrā).
54442: होली (or according to some also होलिका, हूली), the common designation of the Holākā festival or of the song sung during the festival.
54443: होहौ हो-हौ, ind. a vocative particle (ho! ho there! hallo!), an interjection used in calling or challenging.
54444: हौ, ind. a vocative particle, = हो-हौ above.
54445: हौड् हौड्, cl. 1. P. हौडति, &c., to go (= rt. हूड्).
54446: हौतृक हौतृक, हौत्न, हौत्र। See p. 1178, col. 3.
54447: ह्नु ह्नु, cl. 2. A. (Ved. also P.) ह्नुते (अपि-ह्नुतस् = अपलापं कुरुतः, Ṛg-veda VIII. 31, 7), जुह्नुवे, ह्नोष्यते, अह्नोष्ट, ह्नोतुम्, to take away, rob, abstract; to with-hold, secrete, conceal; to conceal one's self, hide from any one, dissimulate or deny before any one (with dat., e. g. देवदत्ताय ह्नुते, he hides from Devadatta, Pāṇ. I. 4, 34): Pass. ह्नूयते, Aor. अह्-नावि: Caus. ह्नावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अजुह्नवत्: Desid. जुह्नूषते: Intens. जोह्नूयते, जोह्नोति; [cf. Gr. ἀνα-νεύω, νεύω, νυστάζω, νυθός; Lat. ab-nuo, nuto, gnavus, navo, i-gnavis, se-gnis, niti, nicto, con-niveo; Goth. hneivan, hnaivs; Old Germ. hnigan; Angl. Sax. hnivan, hnigan.]
54448: ह्नव, अस्, m. secreting, hiding, concealment, (अपि-ह्नव, अस्, m. a denial, = अपलाप; cf. नि-ह्नव।)
54449: ह्नवन, अम्, n. the act of secreting, concealing, dissimulating.
54450: ह्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, withheld, secreted, hidden.
54451: ह्नुति, इस्, f. abstraction, concealment; denial.
54452: ह्नुत्वा, ind. having concealed; having dissimu-lated.
54453: ह्नोतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be secreted or con-cealed, &c.
54454: ह्मल् ह्मल्, cl. 1. P. ह्मलति, जह्माल, &c., to shake, move; to go: Caus. ह्मलयति or ह्मालयति (the former when prepo-sitions are prefixed).
54455: ह्यस् ह्यस्, ind. (perhaps fr. 5. ह + द्यस्), yesterday; [cf. Gr. χθές, ἐ-χθές, χθιζό-ς, χθεσ-ινό-ς; Lat. heri, hes-ternu-s; Goth. gistra-dagis; Old Germ. gester, ‘yesterday.’] —ह्यो-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, what happened yesterday.
54456: ह्यस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, hesternal, belonging to yesterday, produced or occurred yesterday. —ह्यस्-तन-दिन, अम्, n. the day just past, yesterday.
54457: ह्यस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hesternal, of yesterday.
54458: ह्रग् ह्रग् (also written ह्लग्), cl. 1. P. ह्रगति, जह्राग, अह्रगीत्, &c., to cover, hide, conceal: Caus. ह्रगयति, &c.
54459: ह्रणिया ह्रणिया, f. (= हृणीया at p. 1175, col. 3), censure, reproach, shame, bashfulness.
54460: ह्रद् ह्रद्, an older form of rt. ह्राद्, q. v.
54461: ह्रद, अस्, m. a large or deep piece of water, a lake, pool; a ray of light. —ह्रद-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘lake-monster,’ a crocodile, alligator. —ह्रदान्तर (°द-अन्°), अम्, n. another lake.
54462: ह्रदिनी, f. a river (either as supplying or issuing from a lake); lightning [cf. ह्रादिनी].
54463: ह्रप् ह्रप् (= rt. ह्लप्, q. v.), cl. 10. P. ह्रा-पयति, &c., to speak; to sound, creak.
54464: ह्रस् ह्रस् [cf. rts. रस्, ह्लस्], cl. 1. 54465: ह्रसित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded; made little, short-ened, curtailed, diminished.
54467: ह्रसिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. ह्रस्व), short-est, smallest; very short or small.
54468: ह्रसीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. ह्रस्व), shorter, smaller; very small or short; (असी), f. a variety of the Gāyatrī metre (containing two lines of six syllables and one line of seven).

55373: व्रश्च्, व्रट्, ट्, ट्, cutting, cutting off.
55374: व्रस्क, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of comps.), cutting.
55375: व्राधत्; according to B. R. fr. a rt. व्राध्, to excite, incite, provoke.
55376: व्लग् or व्लङ्ग्, a Vedic rt., according to Sāy. meaning ‘to go,’ &c.; used with prep. अभि, (in Ṛg-veda I. 133, 1, 2. अभि-व्लग्य = अभितो गत्वा or अभितः प्राप्य, having approached or come near, having laid hold of; according to B. R. per-haps ‘having strangled.’)
55378: शुद्ध-मुख, अस्, m. a well-trained horse.
55379: शौनःशेप, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Śunaḥ-śepa.
55381: संस्थानक, अस्, m., N. of the Śakāra in the Mṛcchakaṭi.
55382: सङ्कर; add — contamination, pollution; any contaminated object.
55383: सङ्ग्रह, N. of a grammatical work by Vyāḍi.
55384: समनग; = विद्युत्, lightning, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 124, 8.)
55385: सर्वानुदात्त (°व-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, a word which has neither Udātta nor Svarita accent.
55386: सहस्र-बाहु; add — N. of Arjuna Kārtavīrya, (Raghu-v. VI. 38.)
55388: सोमाश्रय (°म-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of Rudra or Śiva (as bearing or supporting the moon).
